verses.sa: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम्। होतारं रत्नधातमम्॥
verses.tr: agnimīḻe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam
verses.en: I laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The Hotar, lavishest of wealth.

verses.sa: अग्निः पूर्वेभिर्ऋषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत। स देवाँ एह वक्षति॥
verses.tr: agniḥ pūrvebhirṛṣibhirīḍyo nūtanairuta sa devāṃ eha vakṣati
verses.en: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers: He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत् पोषमेव दिवेदिवे। यशसं वीरवत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: agninā rayimaśnavat poṣameva divedive yaśasaṃ vīravattamam
verses.en: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.

verses.sa: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि। स इद् देवेषु गच्छति॥
verses.tr: agne yaṃ yajñamadhvaraṃ viśvataḥ paribhūrasi sa id deveṣu gacchati
verses.en: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.

verses.sa: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः। देवो देवेभिरा गमत्॥
verses.tr: agnirhotā kavikratuḥ satyaścitraśravastamaḥ devo devebhirā gamat
verses.en: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.

verses.sa: यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि। तवेत् तत् सत्यमङ्गिरः॥
verses.tr: yadaṅga dāśuṣe tvamagne bhadraṃ kariṣyasi tavet tat satyamaṅgiraḥ
verses.en: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.

verses.sa: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम्। नमो भरन्त एमसि॥
verses.tr: upa tvāgne divedive doṣāvastardhiyā vayam namo bharanta emasi
verses.en: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come;

verses.sa: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम्। वर्धमानं स्वे दमे॥
verses.tr: rājantamadhvarāṇāṃ gopāmṛtasya dīdivim vardhamānaṃ sve dame
verses.en: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.

verses.sa: स नः पितेव सूनवे ऽग्ने सूपायनो भव। सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ piteva sūnave 'gne sūpāyano bhava sacasvā naḥ svastaye
verses.en: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.

verses.sa: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः। तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: vāyavā yāhi darśateme somā araṃkṛtāḥ teṣāṃ pāhi śrudhī havam
verses.en: Beautiful Vayu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.

verses.sa: वाय उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते त्वामच्छा जरितारः। सुतसोमा अहर्विदः॥
verses.tr: vāya ukthebhirjarante tvāmacchā jaritāraḥ sutasomā aharvidaḥ
verses.en: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vayu, with their hymns of praise.

verses.sa: वायो तव प्रपृञ्चती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे। उरूची सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vāyo tava prapṛñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe urūcī somapītaye
verses.en: Vayu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम्। इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि॥
verses.tr: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam indavo vāmuśanti hi
verses.en: These, Indra-Vayu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake: The drops are yearning for you both.

verses.sa: वायविन्द्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू। तावा यातमुप द्रवत्॥
verses.tr: vāyavindraśca cetathaḥ sutānāṃ vājinīvasū tāvā yātamupa dravat
verses.en: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vayu and Indra, rich in spoil So come ye swiftly hitherward.

verses.sa: वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्कृतम्। मक्ष्वि१त्था धिया नरा॥
verses.tr: vāyavindraśca sunvata ā yātamupa niṣkṛtam makṣvi1tthā dhiyā narā
verses.en: Vayu and Indra, come to what the Soma. presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.

verses.sa: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम्। धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā
verses.en: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

verses.sa: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा। क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे॥
verses.tr: ṛtena mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtaspṛśā kratuṃ bṛhantamāśāthe
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power.

verses.sa: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया। दक्षं दधाते अपसम्॥
verses.tr: kavī no mitrāvaruṇā tuvijātā urukṣayā dakṣaṃ dadhāte apasam
verses.en: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuna, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.

verses.sa:
१०-१२ सरस्वती। गायत्री।
अश्विना  यज्वरीरिषो द्रवत्पाणी शुभस्पती। पुरुभुजा चनस्यतम्॥
verses.tr: 10-12 sarasvatī gāyatrī aśvinā yajvarīriṣo dravatpāṇī śubhaspatī purubhujā canasyatam
verses.en: Ye Asvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.

verses.sa: अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया। धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā purudaṃsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā dhiṣṇyā vanataṃ giraḥ
verses.en: Ye Asvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.

verses.sa: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः। आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी॥
verses.tr: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ā yātaṃ rudravartanī
verses.en: Nasatyas, wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः। अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ
verses.en: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः। उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ
verses.en: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.

verses.sa: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः। सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ
verses.en: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.

verses.sa: ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आ गत। दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam
verses.en: Ye Visvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमा गन्त तूर्णयः। उस्रा इव स्वसराणि॥
verses.tr: viśve devāso apturaḥ sutamā ganta tūrṇayaḥ usrā iva svasarāṇi
verses.en: Ye Visvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः। मेधं जुषन्त वह्नयः॥
verses.tr: viśve devāso asridha ehimāyāso adruhaḥ medhaṃ juṣanta vahnayaḥ
verses.en: The Visvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught

verses.sa: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती। यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः॥
verses.tr: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ
verses.en: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarasvati desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.

verses.sa: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम्। यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī
verses.en: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer o all gracious thought, Sarasvati accept our rite

verses.sa: महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना। धियो विश्वा वि राजति॥
verses.tr: maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā dhiyo viśvā vi rājati
verses.en: Sarasvati, the mighty flood,--she with be light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.

verses.sa: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे। जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि॥
verses.tr: surūpakṛtnumūtaye sudughāmiva goduhe juhūmasi dyavidyavi
verses.en: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.

verses.sa: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब। गोदा इद् रेवतो मदः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba godā id revato madaḥ
verses.en: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.

verses.sa: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम्। मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि॥
verses.tr: athā te antamānāṃ vidyāma sumatīnām mā no ati khya ā gahi
verses.en: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.

verses.sa: परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिन्द्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितम्। यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम्॥
verses.tr: parehi vigramastṛtamindraṃ pṛcchā vipaścitam yaste sakhibhya ā varam
verses.en: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.

verses.sa: उत ब्रुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत। दधाना इन्द्र इद् दुवः॥
verses.tr: uta bruvantu no nido niranyataścidārata dadhānā indra id duvaḥ
verses.en: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;

verses.sa: उत नः सुभगाँ अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः। स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ subhagāṃ arirvoceyurdasma kṛṣṭayaḥ syāmedindrasya śarmaṇi
verses.en: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.

verses.sa: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनम्। पतयन् मन्दयत्सखम्॥
verses.tr: emāśumāśave bhara yajñaśriyaṃ nṛmādanam patayan mandayatsakham
verses.en: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.

verses.sa: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः। प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: asya pītvā śatakrato ghano vṛtrāṇāmabhavaḥ prāvo vājeṣu vājinam
verses.en: Thou, Satakratu, drankest this and wast the Vrtras' slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.

verses.sa: तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो। धनानामिन्द्र सातये॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vājeṣu vājinaṃ vājayāmaḥ śatakrato dhanānāmindra sātaye
verses.en: We strengthen, Satakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.

verses.sa: यो रायो३ऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा। तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत॥
verses.tr: yo rāyo3'vanirmahāntsupāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tasmā indrāya gāyata
verses.en: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend of him who pours the juice, yea, to this Indra sing your song.

verses.sa: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत। सखायः स्तोमवाहसः॥
verses.tr: ā tvetā ni ṣīdatendramabhi pra gāyata sakhāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ
verses.en: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.

verses.sa: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम्। इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते॥
verses.tr: purūtamaṃ purūṇāmīśānaṃ vāryāṇām indraṃ some sacā sute
verses.en: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, with Soma juice outpoured.

verses.sa: स घा नो योग आ भुवत् स राये स पुरंध्याम्। गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः॥
verses.tr: sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat sa rāye sa puraṃdhyām gamadvājebhirā sa naḥ
verses.en: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.

verses.sa: यस्य संस्थे न वृण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः। तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत॥
verses.tr: yasya saṃsthe na vṛṇvate harī samatsu śatravaḥ tasmā indrāya gāyata
verses.en: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.

verses.sa: सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यन्ति वीतये। सोमासो दध्याशिरः॥
verses.tr: sutapāvne sutā ime śucayo yanti vītaye somāso dadhyāśiraḥ
verses.en: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.

verses.sa: त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः। इन्द्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sutasya pītaye sadyo vṛddho ajāyathāḥ indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato
verses.en: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preëminence.

verses.sa: आ त्वा विशन्त्वाशवः सोमास इन्द्र गिर्वणः। शं ते सन्तु प्रचेतसे॥
verses.tr: ā tvā viśantvāśavaḥ somāsa indra girvaṇaḥ śaṃ te santu pracetase
verses.en: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.

verses.sa: त्वां स्तोमा अवीवृधन् त्वामुक्था शतक्रतो। त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ stomā avīvṛdhan tvāmukthā śatakrato tvāṃ vardhantu no giraḥ
verses.en: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Satakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.

verses.sa: अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिन्द्रः सहस्रिणम्। यस्मिन् विश्वानि पौंस्या॥
verses.tr: akṣitotiḥ sanedimaṃ vājamindraḥ sahasriṇam yasmin viśvāni pauṃsyā
verses.en: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.

verses.sa: मा नो मर्ता अभि द्रुहन्तनूनामिन्द्र गिर्वणः। ईशानो यवया वधम्॥
verses.tr: mā no martā abhi druhantanūnāmindra girvaṇaḥ īśāno yavayā vadham
verses.en: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः। रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि॥
verses.tr: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
verses.en: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.

verses.sa: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे। शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा॥
verses.tr: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛvāhasā
verses.en: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

verses.sa: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे। समुषद्भिरजायथाः॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ
verses.en: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sa: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे। दधाना नाम यज्ञियम्॥
verses.tr: ādaha svadhāmanu punargarbhatvamerire dadhānā nāma yajñiyam
verses.en: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.

verses.sa: वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः। अविन्द उस्रिया अनु॥
verses.tr: vīḻu cidārujatnubhirguhā cidindra vahnibhiḥ avinda usriyā anu
verses.en: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm, Foundest the kine even in the cave.

verses.sa: देवयन्तो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद्वसुं गिरः। महामनूषत श्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: devayanto yathā matimacchā vidadvasuṃ giraḥ mahāmanūṣata śrutam
verses.en: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा। मन्दू समानवर्चसा॥
verses.tr: indreṇa saṃ hi dṛkṣase saṃjagmāno abibhyuṣā mandū samānavarcasā
verses.en: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.

verses.sa: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति। गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः॥
verses.tr: anavadyairabhidyubhirmakhaḥ sahasvadarcati gaṇairindrasya kāmyaiḥ
verses.en: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.

verses.sa: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि। समस्मिन्नृञ्जते गिरः॥
verses.tr: ataḥ parijmannā gahi divo vā rocanādadhi samasminnṛñjate giraḥ
verses.en: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.

verses.sa: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि। इन्द्रं महो वा रजसः॥
verses.tr: ito vā sātimīmahe divo vā pārthivādadhi indraṃ maho vā rajasaḥ
verses.en: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः। इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत॥
verses.tr: indramidgāthino bṛhadindramarkebhirarkiṇaḥ indraṃ vāṇīranūṣata
verses.en: Indra the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

verses.sa: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा। इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: indra iddharyoḥ sacā saṃmiśla ā vacoyujā indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद् दिवि। वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत्॥
verses.tr: indro dīrghāya cakṣasa ā sūryaṃ rohayad divi vi gobhiradrimairayat
verses.en: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च। उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: indra vājeṣu no'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे। युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhana indramarbhe havāmahe yujaṃ vṛtreṣu vajriṇam
verses.en: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

verses.sa: स नो  वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि। अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः॥
verses.tr: sa no vṛṣannamuṃ caruṃ satrādāvannapā vṛdhi asmabhyamapratiṣkutaḥ
verses.en: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.

verses.sa: तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः। न विन्धे अस्य सुष्टुतिम्॥
verses.tr: tuñjetuñje ya uttare stomā indrasya vajriṇaḥ na vindhe asya suṣṭutim
verses.en: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.

verses.sa: वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा। ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīriyartyojasā īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ
verses.en: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:

verses.sa: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति। इन्द्रः पञ्च क्षितीनाम्॥
verses.tr: ya ekaścarṣaṇīnāṃ vasūnāmirajyati indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām
verses.en: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः। अस्माकमस्तु केवलः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vo viśvataspari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākamastu kevalaḥ
verses.en: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', may he be.

verses.sa: एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम्। वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर॥
verses.tr: endra sānasiṃ rayiṃ sajitvānaṃ sadāsaham varṣiṣṭhamūtaye bhara
verses.en: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;

verses.sa: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै। त्वोतासो न्यर्वता॥
verses.tr: ni yena muṣṭihatyayā ni vṛtrā ruṇadhāmahai tvotāso nyarvatā
verses.en: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.

verses.sa: इन्द्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि। जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: indra tvotāsa ā vayaṃ vajraṃ ghanā dadīmahi jayema saṃ yudhi spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.

verses.sa: वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिन्द्र त्वया युजा वयम्। सासह्याम पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ śūrebhirastṛbhirindra tvayā yujā vayam sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.

verses.sa: महाँ इन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे। द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ indraḥ paraśca nu mahitvamastu vajriṇe dyaurna prathinā śavaḥ
verses.en: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power

verses.sa: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ। विप्रासो वा धियायवः॥
verses.tr: samohe vā ya āśata narastokasya sanitau viprāso vā dhiyāyavaḥ
verses.en: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.

verses.sa: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्र इव पिन्वते। उर्वीरापो न काकुदः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ kukṣiḥ somapātamaḥ samudra iva pinvate urvīrāpo na kākudaḥ
verses.en: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही। पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya sūnṛtā virapśī gomatī mahī pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe
verses.en: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.

verses.sa: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते। सद्यश्चित् सन्ति दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: evā hi te vibhūtaya ūtaya indra māvate sadyaścit santi dāśuṣe
verses.en: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.

verses.sa: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या। इन्द्राय सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: evā hyasya kāmyā stoma ukthaṃ ca śaṃsyā indrāya somapītaye
verses.en: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः। महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा॥
verses.tr: indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ mahāṃ abhiṣṭirojasā
verses.en: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.

verses.sa: एमेनं सृजता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने। चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये॥
verses.tr: emenaṃ sṛjatā sute mandimindrāya mandine cakriṃ viśvāni cakraye
verses.en: To Indra pour ye forth the juice, the active gladdening juice to him The gladdening, omnific God.

verses.sa: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मन्दिभिः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे। सचैषु सवनेष्वा॥
verses.tr: matsvā suśipra mandibhiḥ stomebhirviśvacarṣaṇe sacaiṣu savaneṣvā
verses.en: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.

verses.sa: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत। अजोषा वृषभं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: asṛgramindra te giraḥ prati tvāmudahāsata ajoṣā vṛṣabhaṃ patim
verses.en: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.

verses.sa: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग् राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम्। असदित् ते विभु प्रभु॥
verses.tr: saṃ codaya citramarvāg rādha indra vareṇyam asadit te vibhu prabhu
verses.en: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of' our wish, For power supreme is only thine.

verses.sa: अस्मान्त्सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः। तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः॥
verses.tr: asmāntsu tatra codayendra rāye rabhasvataḥ tuvidyumna yaśasvataḥ
verses.en: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.

verses.sa: सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत्। विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ gomadindra vājavadasme pṛthu śravo bṛhat viśvāyurdhehyakṣitam
verses.en: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.

verses.sa: अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद् द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमम्। इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः॥
verses.tr: asme dhehi śravo bṛhad dyumnaṃ sahasrasātamam indra tā rathinīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.

verses.sa: वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणन्त ऋग्मियम्। होम गन्तारमूतये॥
verses.tr: vasorindraṃ vasupatiṃ gīrbhirgṛṇanta ṛgmiyam homa gantāramūtaye
verses.en: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.

verses.sa: सुते सुते न्योकसे बृहद् बृहत एदरिः। इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति॥
verses.tr: sute sute nyokase bṛhad bṛhata edariḥ indrāya śūṣamarcati
verses.en: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.

verses.sa:
गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः।
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद् वंशमिव येमिरे॥
verses.tr: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇo'rcantyarkamarkiṇaḥ brahmāṇastvā śatakrata ud vaṃśamiva yemire
verses.en: The chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Satakratu, like a pole.

verses.sa:
यत् सानोः सानुमारुहद् भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम्।
तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति॥
verses.tr: yat sānoḥ sānumāruhad bhūryaspaṣṭa kartvam tadindro arthaṃ cetati yūthena vṛṣṇirejati
verses.en: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा।
अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara
verses.en: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.

verses.sa:
एहि स्तोमाँ अभि स्वरा ऽभि गृणीह्या रुव।
ब्रह्म च नो वसो सचेन्द्र यज्ञं च वर्धय॥
verses.tr: ehi stomāṃ abhi svarā 'bhi gṛṇīhyā ruva brahma ca no vaso sacendra yajñaṃ ca vardhaya
verses.en: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे।
शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत् सख्येषु च॥
verses.tr: ukthamindrāya śaṃsyaṃ vardhanaṃ puruniṣṣidhe śakro yathā suteṣu ṇo rāraṇat sakhyeṣu ca
verses.en: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Sakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.

verses.sa:
तमित् सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये।
स शक्र उत नः शकदिन्द्रो वसु दयमानः॥
verses.tr: tamit sakhitva īmahe taṃ rāye taṃ suvīrye sa śakra uta naḥ śakadindro vasu dayamānaḥ
verses.en: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Sakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.

verses.sa:
सुविवृतं सुनिरजमिन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः।
गवामप व्रजं वृधि कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: suvivṛtaṃ sunirajamindra tvādātamidyaśaḥ gavāmapa vrajaṃ vṛdhi kṛṇuṣva rādho adrivaḥ
verses.en: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed

verses.sa:
नहि त्वा रोदसी उभे ऋघायमाणमिन्वतः।
जेषः स्वर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि॥
verses.tr: nahi tvā rodasī ubhe ṛghāyamāṇaminvataḥ jeṣaḥ svarvatīrapaḥ saṃ gā asmabhyaṃ dhūnuhi
verses.en: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.

verses.sa:
आश्रुत्कर्ण श्रुधी हवं नू चिद्दधिष्व मे गिरः।
इन्द्र स्तोममिमं मम कृष्वा युजश्चिदन्तरम्॥
verses.tr: āśrutkarṇa śrudhī havaṃ nū ciddadhiṣva me giraḥ indra stomamimaṃ mama kṛṣvā yujaścidantaram
verses.en: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि त्वा वृषन्तमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतम्।
वृषन्तमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमाम्॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi tvā vṛṣantamaṃ vājeṣu havanaśrutam vṛṣantamasya hūmaha ūtiṃ sahasrasātamām
verses.en: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसानः सुतं पिब।
नव्यमायुः प्र सू तिर कृधी सहस्रसामृषिम्॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutaṃ piba navyamāyuḥ pra sū tira kṛdhī sahasrasāmṛṣim
verses.en: O Indra, Son of Kusika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.

verses.sa:
परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः ।
वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः॥
verses.tr: pari tvā girvaṇo gira imā bhavantu viśvataḥ vṛddhāyumanu vṛddhayo juṣṭā bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त् समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः ।
रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhant samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim
verses.en: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.

verses.sa:
सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते ।
त्वामभि प्र णोनुमो जेतारमपरा जितम्॥
verses.tr: sakhye ta indra vājino mā bhema śavasaspate tvāmabhi pra ṇonumo jetāramaparā jitam
verses.en: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः ।
यदी वाजस्य गोमतः स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघम्॥
verses.tr: pūrvīrindrasya rātayo na vi dasyantyūtayaḥ yadī vājasya gomataḥ stotṛbhyo maṃhate magham
verses.en: The gifts of Indra from of old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.

verses.sa:
पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत ।
इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: purāṃ bhinduryuvā kaviramitaujā ajāyata indro viśvasya karmaṇo dhartā vajrī puruṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.

verses.sa:
त्वं वलस्य गोमतो ऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् ।
त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस् तुज्यमानास आविषुः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ valasya gomato 'pāvaradrivo bilam tvāṃ devā abibhyuṣas tujyamānāsa āviṣuḥ
verses.en: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,

verses.sa:
तवाहं शूर रातिभिः प्रत्यायं सिन्धुमावदन् ।
उपातिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो विदुष्टे तस्य कारवः॥
verses.tr: tavāhaṃ śūra rātibhiḥ pratyāyaṃ sindhumāvadan upātiṣṭhanta girvaṇo viduṣṭe tasya kāravaḥ
verses.en: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.

verses.sa:
मायाभिरिन्द्र मायिनं त्वं शुष्णमवातिरः ।
विदुष्टे तस्य मेधिरास् तेषां श्रवांस्युत्तिर॥
verses.tr: māyābhirindra māyinaṃ tvaṃ śuṣṇamavātiraḥ viduṣṭe tasya medhirās teṣāṃ śravāṃsyuttira
verses.en: The wily Susna, Indra! thou o'er-threwest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमा अनूषत ।
सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः॥
verses.tr: indramīśānamojasābhi stomā anūṣata sahasraṃ yasya rātaya uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ
verses.en: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

verses.sa: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam asya yajñasya sukratum
verses.en: We choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

verses.sa: अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् । हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम्॥
verses.tr: agnimagniṃ havīmabhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim havyavāhaṃ purupriyam
verses.en: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

verses.sa: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः॥
verses.tr: agne devāṃ ihā vaha jajñāno vṛktabarhiṣe asi hotā na īḍyaḥ
verses.en: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

verses.sa: ताँ उशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: tāṃ uśato vi bodhaya yadagne yāsi dūtyam devairā satsi barhiṣi
verses.en: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.

verses.sa: घृताहवन दीदिवः प्रति ष्म रिषतो दह । अग्ने त्वं रक्षस्विनः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtāhavana dīdivaḥ prati ṣma riṣato daha agne tvaṃ rakṣasvinaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.

verses.sa: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड् जुह्वास्यः॥
verses.tr: agnināgniḥ samidhyate kavirgṛhapatiryuvā havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ
verses.en: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.

verses.sa: कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे । देवममीवचातनम्॥
verses.tr: kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmāṇamadhvare devamamīvacātanam
verses.en: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.

verses.sa: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति । तस्य स्म प्राविता भव॥
verses.tr: yastvāmagne haviṣpatirdūtaṃ deva saparyati tasya sma prāvitā bhava
verses.en: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.

verses.sa: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति । तस्मै पावक मृळय॥
verses.tr: yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmāṃ āvivāsati tasmai pāvaka mṛḻaya
verses.en: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.

verses.sa: स नः पावक दीदिवो ऽग्ने देवाँ इहा वह । उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo 'gne devāṃ ihā vaha upa yajñaṃ haviśca naḥ
verses.en: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.

verses.sa: स नः स्तवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा । रयिं वीरवतीमिषम्॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ stavāna ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam
verses.en: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.

verses.sa: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व नः॥
verses.tr: agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhirdevahūtibhiḥ imaṃ stomaṃ juṣasva naḥ
verses.en: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.

verses.sa:
नराशंसः, ४ इलः, ५ बर्हिः, ६ देवीर्द्वारः, ७ उषासानक्ता, ८ दैव्यो होतारौ प्रचेतसौ, ९ तिस्रो देव्यः
सरस्वतीळाभारत्यः, १० त्वष्टा, ११ वनस्पतिः, १२ स्वाहा कृतयः । गायत्री।
सुसमिद्धो न आ वह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते । होतः पावक यक्षि च॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsaḥ, 4 ilaḥ, 5 barhiḥ, 6 devīrdvāraḥ, 7 uṣāsānaktā, 8 daivyo hotārau pracetasau, 9 tisro devyaḥ sarasvatīḻābhāratyaḥ, 10 tvaṣṭā, 11 vanaspatiḥ, 12 svāhā kṛtayaḥ gāyatrī susamiddho na ā vaha devāṃ agne haviṣmate hotaḥ pāvaka yakṣi ca
verses.en: Agni, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.

verses.sa: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद् यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे । अद्या कृणुहि वीतये॥
verses.tr: madhumantaṃ tanūnapād yajñaṃ deveṣu naḥ kave adyā kṛṇuhi vītaye
verses.en: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.

verses.sa: नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन् यज्ञ उप ह्वये । मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsamiha priyamasmin yajña upa hvaye madhujihvaṃ haviṣkṛtam
verses.en: Dear Narasamsa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.

verses.sa: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईळित आ वह । असि होता मनुर्हितः॥
verses.tr: agne sukhatame rathe devāṃ īḻita ā vaha asi hotā manurhitaḥ
verses.en: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.

verses.sa: स्तृणीत बर्हिरानुषग् घृतपृष्ठं मनीषिणः । यत्रामृतस्य चक्षणम्॥
verses.tr: stṛṇīta barhirānuṣag ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ yatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇam
verses.en: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.

verses.sa: वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः । अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे॥
verses.tr: vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ adyā nūnaṃ ca yaṣṭave
verses.en: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.

verses.sa: नक्तोषासा सुपेशसा ऽस्मिन् यज्ञ उप ह्वये । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: naktoṣāsā supeśasā 'smin yajña upa hvaye idaṃ no barhirāsade
verses.en: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.

verses.sa: ता सुजिह्वा उप ह्वये होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम्॥
verses.tr: tā sujihvā upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam
verses.en: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.

verses.sa: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः । बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः॥
verses.tr: iḻā sarasvatī mahī tisro devīrmayobhuvaḥ barhiḥ sīdantvasridhaḥ
verses.en: Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.

verses.sa: इह त्वष्टारमग्रियं विश्वरूपमुप ह्वये । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः॥
verses.tr: iha tvaṣṭāramagriyaṃ viśvarūpamupa hvaye asmākamastu kevalaḥ
verses.en: Tvastar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and curs alone.

verses.sa: अव सृजा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः । प्र दातुरस्तु चेतनम्॥
verses.tr: ava sṛjā vanaspate deva devebhyo haviḥ pra dāturastu cetanam
verses.en: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.

verses.sa: स्वाहा यज्ञं कृणोतनेन्द्राय यज्वनो गृहे । तत्र देवाँ उप ह्वये॥
verses.tr: svāhā yajñaṃ kṛṇotanendrāya yajvano gṛhe tatra devāṃ upa hvaye
verses.en: With Svaha pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.

verses.sa: ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये । देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च॥
verses.tr: aibhiragne duvo giro viśvebhiḥ somapītaye devebhiryāhi yakṣi ca
verses.en: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.

verses.sa: आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणन्ति विप्र ते धियः । देवेभिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ā tvā kaṇvā ahūṣata gṛṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ devebhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: The Kanvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम् । आदित्यान् मारुतं गणम्॥
verses.tr: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam ādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam
verses.en: Indra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pusan, Bhaga, Adityas, and the Marut host.

verses.sa: प्र वो भ्रियन्त इन्दवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः । द्रप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः॥
verses.tr: pra vo bhriyanta indavo matsarā mādayiṣṇavaḥ drapsā madhvaścamūṣadaḥ
verses.en: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.

verses.sa: ईळते त्वामवस्यवः कण्वासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः॥
verses.tr: īḻate tvāmavasyavaḥ kaṇvāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ haviṣmanto araṃkṛtaḥ
verses.en: The sons of Kanva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.

verses.sa: घृतपृष्ठा मनोयुजो ये त्वा वहन्ति वह्नयः । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ghṛtapṛṣṭhā manoyujo ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ ā devāntsomapītaye
verses.en: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.

verses.sa: तान् यजत्राँ ऋतावृधो ऽग्ने पत्नीवतस्कृधि । मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय॥
verses.tr: tān yajatrāṃ ṛtāvṛdho 'gne patnīvataskṛdhi madhvaḥ sujihva pāyaya
verses.en: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.

verses.sa: ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास् ते ते पिबन्तु जिह्वया । मधोरग्ने वषट्कृति॥
verses.tr: ye yajatrā ya īḍyās te te pibantu jihvayā madhoragne vaṣaṭkṛti
verses.en: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue The meath in solemn sacrifice.

verses.sa: आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद् विश्वान्देवाँ उषर्बुधः । विप्रो होतेह वक्षति॥
verses.tr: ākīṃ sūryasya rocanād viśvāndevāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ vipro hoteha vakṣati
verses.en: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.

verses.sa: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना । पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः॥
verses.tr: viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vayu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्वं होता मनुर्हितो ऽग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hotā manurhito 'gne yajñeṣu sīdasi semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja
verses.en: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा ह्यरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः । ताभिर्देवाँ इहा वह॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hyaruṣī rathe harito deva rohitaḥ tābhirdevāṃ ihā vaha
verses.en: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणौ, ७-१० द्रविणोदाः, ११ अश्विनौ, १२अग्निः। गायत्री।
इन्द्र सोमं पिब ऋतुना ऽऽ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः । मत्सरासस्तदोकसः॥
verses.tr: mitrāvaruṇau, 7-10 draviṇodāḥ, 11 aśvinau, 12agniḥ gāyatrī indra somaṃ piba ṛtunā '' tvā viśantvindavaḥ matsarāsastadokasaḥ
verses.en: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Rtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.

verses.sa: मरुतः पिबत ऋतुना पोत्राद् यज्ञं पुनीतन । यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवः॥
verses.tr: marutaḥ pibata ṛtunā potrād yajñaṃ punītana yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā sudānavaḥ
verses.en: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Rtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.

verses.sa: अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना । त्वं हि रत्नधा असि॥
verses.tr: abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi
verses.en: O Nestar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with Rtu drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sa: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह सादया योनिषु त्रिषु । परि भूष पिब ऋतुना॥
verses.tr: agne devāṃ ihā vaha sādayā yoniṣu triṣu pari bhūṣa piba ṛtunā
verses.en: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with Rtu drink.

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु । तवेद्धि सख्यमस्तृतम्॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇādindra rādhasaḥ pibā somamṛtūṃranu taveddhi sakhyamastṛtam
verses.en: Drink Soma after the Rtus, from the Brahmana's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.

verses.sa: युवं दक्षं धृतव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभम् । ऋतुना यज्ञमाशाथे॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ dakṣaṃ dhṛtavrata mitrāvaruṇa dūḻabham ṛtunā yajñamāśāthe
verses.en: Mitra, Varuna, ye whose ways are firm--a Power that none deceives--, With Rtu ye have reached the rite.

verses.sa: द्रविणोदा द्रविणसो ग्रावहस्तासो अध्वरे । यज्ञेषु देवमीळते॥
verses.tr: draviṇodā draviṇaso grāvahastāso adhvare yajñeṣu devamīḻate
verses.en: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.

verses.sa: द्रविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शृण्विरे । देवेषु ता वनामहे॥
verses.tr: draviṇodā dadātu no vasūni yāni śṛṇvire deveṣu tā vanāmahe
verses.en: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.

verses.sa: द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत । नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत॥
verses.tr: draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata neṣṭrādṛtubhiriṣyata
verses.en: He with the Rtu fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Nestar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.

verses.sa: यत् त्वा तुरीयमृतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे । अध स्मा नो ददिर्भव॥
verses.tr: yat tvā turīyamṛtubhirdraviṇodo yajāmahe adha smā no dadirbhava
verses.en: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Rtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.

verses.sa: अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता । ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा॥
verses.tr: aśvinā pibataṃ madhu dīdyagnī śucivratā ṛtunā yajñavāhasā
verses.en: Drink ye the meath, O Asvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure, who with Rtus accept the sacrifice.

verses.sa: गार्हपत्येन सन्त्य ऋतुना यज्ञनीरसि । देवान् देवयते यज॥
verses.tr: gārhapatyena santya ṛtunā yajñanīrasi devān devayate yaja
verses.en: With Rtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.

verses.sa: आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वृषणं सोमपीतये । इन्द्र त्वा सूरचक्षसः॥
verses.tr: ā tvā vahantu harayo vṛṣaṇaṃ somapītaye indra tvā sūracakṣasaḥ
verses.en: Let thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught-- Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.

verses.sa: इमा धाना घृतस्नुवो हरी इहोप वक्षतः । इन्द्रं सुखतमे रथे॥
verses.tr: imā dhānā ghṛtasnuvo harī ihopa vakṣataḥ indraṃ sukhatame rathe
verses.en: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं प्रातर्हवामह इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: indraṃ prātarhavāmaha indraṃ prayatyadhvare indraṃ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिन्द्र केशिभिः । सुते हि त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sutamā gahi haribhirindra keśibhiḥ sute hi tvā havāmahe
verses.en: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to the draught we pour We call thee when the juice is shed.

verses.sa: सेमं नः स्तोममा गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतम् । गौरो न तृषितः पिब॥
verses.tr: semaṃ naḥ stomamā gahyupedaṃ savanaṃ sutam gauro na tṛṣitaḥ piba
verses.en: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.

verses.sa: इमे सोमास इन्दवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि । ताँ इन्द्र सहसे पिब॥
verses.tr: ime somāsa indavaḥ sutāso adhi barhiṣi tāṃ indra sahase piba
verses.en: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.

verses.sa: अयं ते स्तोमो अग्रियो हृदिस्पृगस्तु शंतमः । अथा सोमं सुतं पिब॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te stomo agriyo hṛdispṛgastu śaṃtamaḥ athā somaṃ sutaṃ piba
verses.en: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.

verses.sa: विश्वमित्सवनं सुतमिन्द्रो मदाय गच्छति । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: viśvamitsavanaṃ sutamindro madāya gacchati vṛtrahā somapītaye
verses.en: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.

verses.sa: सेमं नः काममा पृण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो । स्तवाम त्वा स्वाध्यः॥
verses.tr: semaṃ naḥ kāmamā pṛṇa gobhiraśvaiḥ śatakrato stavāma tvā svādhyaḥ
verses.en: Fulfil, O Satakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.

verses.sa: इन्द्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वृणे । ता नो मृळात ईदृशे॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇayorahaṃ samrājorava ā vṛṇe tā no mṛḻāta īdṛśe
verses.en: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuna; may they Both favour one of us like me.

verses.sa: गन्तारा हि स्थोऽवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः । धर्तारा चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: gantārā hi stho'vase havaṃ viprasya māvataḥ dhartārā carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.

verses.sa: अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिन्द्रावरुण राय आ । ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे॥
verses.tr: anukāmaṃ tarpayethāmindrāvaruṇa rāya ā tā vāṃ nediṣṭhamīmahe
verses.en: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuna, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.

verses.sa: युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनाम् । भूयाम वाजदाव्नाम्॥
verses.tr: yuvāku hi śacīnāṃ yuvāku sumatīnām bhūyāma vājadāvnām
verses.en: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.

verses.sa: इन्द्रः सहस्रदाव्नां वरुणः शंस्यानाम् । क्रतुर्भवत्युक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sahasradāvnāṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃsyānām kraturbhavatyukthyaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Varuna, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.

verses.sa: तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि । स्यादुत प्ररेचनम्॥
verses.tr: tayoridavasā vayaṃ sanema ni ca dhīmahi syāduta prarecanam
verses.en: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.

verses.sa: इन्द्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇa vāmahaṃ huve citrāya rādhase asmāntsu jigyuṣaskṛtam
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.

verses.sa: इन्द्रावरुण नू नु वां सिषासन्तीषु धीष्वा । अस्मभ्यं शर्म यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇa nū nu vāṃ siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣvā asmabhyaṃ śarma yacchatam
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.

verses.sa: प्र वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिन्द्रावरुण यां हुवे । यामृधाथे सधस्तुतिम्॥
verses.tr: pra vāmaśnotu suṣṭutirindrāvaruṇa yāṃ huve yāmṛdhāthe sadhastutim
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, to you may fair praise which I offer come, Joint eulogy which ye dignify.

verses.sa:
च, ६-८ सदसस्पतिः, ९ सदसस्पतिर्नराशंसो वा। गायत्री।
सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः॥
verses.tr: ca, 6-8 sadasaspatiḥ, 9 sadasaspatirnarāśaṃso vā gāyatrī somānaṃ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ
verses.en: O BRAHMANAPSATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kaksivan Ausija.

verses.sa: यो रेवान् यो अमीवहा वसुवित् पुष्टिवर्धनः । स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः॥
verses.tr: yo revān yo amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ sa naḥ siṣaktu yasturaḥ
verses.en: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,--may he be with us still.

verses.sa: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ् मर्त्यस्य । रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ śaṃso araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅ martyasya rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaspate
verses.en: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmanaspati.

verses.sa: स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa ghā vīro na riṣyati yamindro brahmaṇaspatiḥ somo hinoti martyam
verses.en: Ne'er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmanaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.

verses.sa: त्वं तं ब्रह्मणस्पते सोम इन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् । दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ taṃ brahmaṇaspate soma indraśca martyam dakṣiṇā pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Do, thou, O Brahmanaspati, and Indra, Soma, Daksina, Preserve that mortal from distress.

verses.sa: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । सनिं मेधामयासिषम्॥
verses.tr: sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣam
verses.en: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.

verses.sa: यस्मादृते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन । स धीनां योगमिन्वति॥
verses.tr: yasmādṛte na sidhyati yajño vipaścitaścana sa dhīnāṃ yogaminvati
verses.en: He without whom no sacrifice, e'en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.

verses.sa: आदृध्नोति हविष्कृतिं प्राञ्चं कृणोत्यध्वरम् । होत्रा देवेषु गच्छति॥
verses.tr: ādṛdhnoti haviṣkṛtiṃ prāñcaṃ kṛṇotyadhvaram hotrā deveṣu gacchati
verses.en: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.

verses.sa: नराशंसं सुधृष्टममपश्यं सप्रथस्तमम् । दिवो न सद्ममखसम्॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsaṃ sudhṛṣṭamamapaśyaṃ saprathastamam divo na sadmamakhasam
verses.en: I have seen Narasamsa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As 'twere the Household Priest of heaven.

verses.sa: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: prati tyaṃ cārumadhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.

verses.sa: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव क्रतुं परः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: nahi devo na martyo mahastava kratuṃ paraḥ marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one: O Agni, with the Maruts come:

verses.sa: ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ye maho rajaso vidurviśve devāso adruhaḥ marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: य उग्रा अर्कमानृचुरनाधृष्टास ओजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ya ugrā arkamānṛcuranādhṛṣṭāsa ojasā marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ye śubhrā ghoravarpasaḥ sukṣatrāso riśādasaḥ marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes': O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ye nākasyādhi rocane divi devāsa āsate marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: य ईङ्खयन्ति पर्वतान् तिरः समुद्रमर्णवम् । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ya īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudramarṇavam marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस् तिरः समुद्रमोजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: ā ye tanvanti raśmibhis tiraḥ samudramojasā marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā pūrvapītaye sṛjāmi somyaṃ madhu marudbhiragna ā gahi
verses.en: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.

verses.sa: अयं देवाय जन्मने स्तोमो विप्रेभिरासया । अकारि रत्नधातमः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ devāya janmane stomo viprebhirāsayā akāri ratnadhātamaḥ
verses.en: For the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.

verses.sa: य इन्द्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी । शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत॥
verses.tr: ya indrāya vacoyujā tatakṣurmanasā harī śamībhiryajñamāśata
verses.en: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.

verses.sa: तक्षन् नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथम् । तक्षन् धेनुं सबर्दुघाम्॥
verses.tr: takṣan nāsatyābhyāṃ parijmānaṃ sukhaṃ ratham takṣan dhenuṃ sabardughām
verses.en: They for the two Nasatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.

verses.sa: युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमन्त्रा ऋजूयवः । ऋभवो विष्ट्यक्रत॥
verses.tr: yuvānā pitarā punaḥ satyamantrā ṛjūyavaḥ ṛbhavo viṣṭyakrata
verses.en: The Rbhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.

verses.sa: सं वो मदासो अग्मतेन्द्रेण च मरुत्वता । आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ vo madāso agmatendreṇa ca marutvatā ādityebhiśca rājabhiḥ
verses.en: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Adityas, with the Kings.

verses.sa: उत त्यं चमसं नवं त्वष्टुर्देवस्य निष्कृतम् । अकर्त चतुरः पुनः॥
verses.tr: uta tyaṃ camasaṃ navaṃ tvaṣṭurdevasya niṣkṛtam akarta caturaḥ punaḥ
verses.en: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvastar's hand-- Four ladles have ye made thereof.

verses.sa: ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन त्रिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते । एकमेकं सुशस्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: te no ratnāni dhattana trirā sāptāni sunvate ekamekaṃ suśastibhiḥ
verses.en: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.

verses.sa: अधारयन्त वह्नयो ऽभजन्त सुकृत्यया । भागं देवेषु यज्ञियम्॥
verses.tr: adhārayanta vahnayo 'bhajanta sukṛtyayā bhāgaṃ deveṣu yajñiyam
verses.en: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.

verses.sa: इहेन्द्राग्नी उप ह्वये तयोरित् स्तोममुश्मसि । ता सोमं सोमपातमा॥
verses.tr: ihendrāgnī upa hvaye tayorit stomamuśmasi tā somaṃ somapātamā
verses.en: Indra and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise: Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.

verses.sa: ता यज्ञेषु प्र शंसतेन्द्राग्नी शुम्भता नरः । ता गायत्रेषु गायत॥
verses.tr: tā yajñeṣu pra śaṃsatendrāgnī śumbhatā naraḥ tā gāyatreṣu gāyata
verses.en: Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites: Sing praise to them in sacred songs.

verses.sa: ता मित्रस्य प्रशस्तय इन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे । सोमपा सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: tā mitrasya praśastaya indrāgnī tā havāmahe somapā somapītaye
verses.en: Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: उग्रा सन्ता हवामह उपेदं सवनं सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी एह गच्छताम्॥
verses.tr: ugrā santā havāmaha upedaṃ savanaṃ sutam indrāgnī eha gacchatām
verses.en: Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here: Indra and Agni, come to us.

verses.sa: ता महान्ता सदस्पती इन्द्राग्नी रक्ष उब्जतम् । अप्रजाः सन्त्वत्रिणः॥
verses.tr: tā mahāntā sadaspatī indrāgnī rakṣa ubjatam aprajāḥ santvatriṇaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends: Childless be the devouring ones.

verses.sa: तेन सत्येन जागृतमधि प्रचेतुने पदे । इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: tena satyena jāgṛtamadhi pracetune pade indrāgnī śarma yacchatam
verses.en: Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view Indra and Agni, send us bliss.

verses.sa:
१३-१४ द्यावापृथिव्यौ, १५ पृथिवी, १६ विष्णुर्देवा वा, १७-२१ विष्णुः। गायत्री।
प्रातर्युजा वि बोधयाश्विनावेह गच्छताम् । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: 13-14 dyāvāpṛthivyau, 15 pṛthivī, 16 viṣṇurdevā vā, 17-21 viṣṇuḥ gāyatrī prātaryujā vi bodhayāśvināveha gacchatām asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: Waken the Asvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they Approach to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa: या सुरथा रथीतमोभा देवा दिविस्पृशा । अश्विना ता हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yā surathā rathītamobhā devā divispṛśā aśvinā tā havāmahe
verses.en: We call the Asvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.

verses.sa: या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सूनृतावती । तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम्॥
verses.tr: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam
verses.en: Dropping with honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.

verses.sa: नहि वामस्ति दूरके यत्रा रथेन गच्छथः । अश्विना सोमिनो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: nahi vāmasti dūrake yatrā rathena gacchathaḥ aśvinā somino gṛham
verses.en: As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Asvins, is the home Of him who offers Soma juice.

verses.sa: हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुप ह्वये । स चेत्ता देवता पदम्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyapāṇimūtaye savitāramupa hvaye sa cettā devatā padam
verses.en: For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar. He knoweth, as a God, the place.

verses.sa: अपां नपातमवसे सवितारमुप स्तुहि । तस्य व्रतान्युश्मसि॥
verses.tr: apāṃ napātamavase savitāramupa stuhi tasya vratānyuśmasi
verses.en: That he may send us succour, praise the Waters' Offspring Savitar: Fain are we for his holy ways.

verses.sa: विभक्तारं हवामहे वसोश्चित्रस्य राधसः । सवितारं नृचक्षसम्॥
verses.tr: vibhaktāraṃ havāmahe vasościtrasya rādhasaḥ savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam
verses.en: We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.

verses.sa: सखाय आ नि षीदत सविता स्तोम्यो नु नः । दाता राधांसि शुम्भति॥
verses.tr: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata savitā stomyo nu naḥ dātā rādhāṃsi śumbhati
verses.en: Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us, Giving good gifts, is beautiful.

verses.sa: अग्ने पत्नीरिहा वह देवानामुशतीरुप । त्वष्टारं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: agne patnīrihā vaha devānāmuśatīrupa tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye
verses.en: O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods, And Tvastar, to the Soma draught.

verses.sa: आ ग्ना अग्न इहावसे होत्रां यविष्ठ भारतीम् । वरूत्रीं धिषणां वह॥
verses.tr: ā gnā agna ihāvase hotrāṃ yaviṣṭha bhāratīm varūtrīṃ dhiṣaṇāṃ vaha
verses.en: Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotra, Bharati, Varutri, Dhisana, for aid.

verses.sa: अभि नो देवीरवसा महः शर्मणा नृपत्नीः । अच्छिन्नपत्राः सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: abhi no devīravasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nṛpatnīḥ acchinnapatrāḥ sacantām
verses.en: Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us With great protection and with aid.

verses.sa: इहेन्द्राणीमुप ह्वये वरुणानीं स्वस्तये । अग्नायीं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ihendrāṇīmupa hvaye varuṇānīṃ svastaye agnāyīṃ somapītaye
verses.en: Indrani, Varunani, and Agnayi hither I invite, For weal, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम् । पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः॥
verses.tr: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sa: तयोरिद् घृतवत् पयो विप्रा रिहन्ति धीतिभिः । गन्धर्वस्य ध्रुवे पदे॥
verses.tr: tayorid ghṛtavat payo viprā rihanti dhītibhiḥ gandharvasya dhruve pade
verses.en: Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place, The singers taste through sacred songs.

verses.sa: स्योना पृथिवि भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी । यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथः॥
verses.tr: syonā pṛthivi bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī yacchā naḥ śarma saprathaḥ
verses.en: Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place: Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.

verses.sa: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे । पृथिव्याः सप्त धामभिः॥
verses.tr: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame pṛthivyāḥ sapta dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Visnu strode Through the seven regions of the earth!

verses.sa: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूह्लमस्य पांसुरे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ viṣṇurvi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam samūhlamasya pāṃsure
verses.en: Through all this world strode Visnu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

verses.sa: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः । अतो धर्माणि धारयन्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ ato dharmāṇi dhārayan
verses.en: Visnu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.

verses.sa: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Look ye on Visnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sa: तद् विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम्॥
verses.tr: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divīva cakṣurātatam
verses.en: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Visnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

verses.sa: तद् विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत् परमं पदम्॥
verses.tr: tad viprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate viṣṇoryat paramaṃ padam
verses.en: This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.

verses.sa: तीव्राः सोमास आ गह्याशीर्वन्तः सुता इमे । वायो तान्प्रस्थितान्पिब॥
verses.tr: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahyāśīrvantaḥ sutā ime vāyo tānprasthitānpiba
verses.en: Strong are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk: Drink, Vayu, the presented draughts.

verses.sa: उभा देवा दिविस्पृशेन्द्रवायू हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: ubhā devā divispṛśendravāyū havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vayu we invoke To drink of this our soma juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू मनोजुवा विप्रा हवन्त ऊतये । सहस्राक्षा धियस्पती॥
verses.tr: indravāyū manojuvā viprā havanta ūtaye sahasrākṣā dhiyaspatī
verses.en: The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vayu, swift as mind, The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.

verses.sa: मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये । जज्ञाना पूतदक्षसा॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe varuṇaṃ somapītaye jajñānā pūtadakṣasā
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, renowned as Gods of consecrated might, We call to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती । ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे॥
verses.tr: ṛtena yāvṛtāvṛdhāvṛtasya jyotiṣaspatī tā mitrāvaruṇā huve
verses.en: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuna.

verses.sa: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । करतां नः सुराधसः॥
verses.tr: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ
verses.en: Let Varuna be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids Both make us rich exceedingly.

verses.sa: मरुत्वन्तं हवामह इन्द्रमा सोमपीतये । सजूर्गणेन तृम्पतु॥
verses.tr: marutvantaṃ havāmaha indramā somapītaye sajūrgaṇena tṛmpatu
verses.en: Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he Sate him in union with his troop.

verses.sa: इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः । विश्वे मम श्रुता हवम्॥
verses.tr: indrajyeṣṭhā marudgaṇā devāsaḥ pūṣarātayaḥ viśve mama śrutā havam
verses.en: Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pusan's gifts, Hearken ye all unto my cry.

verses.sa: हत वृत्रं सुदानव इन्द्रेण सहसा युजा । मा नो दुःशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: hata vṛtraṃ sudānava indreṇa sahasā yujā mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vrtra down, ye bounteous Gods Let not the wicked master us.

verses.sa: विश्वान् देवान् हवामहे मरुतः सोमपीतये । उग्रा हि पृश्निमातरः॥
verses.tr: viśvān devān havāmahe marutaḥ somapītaye ugrā hi pṛśnimātaraḥ
verses.en: We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught, For passing strong are Prsni's Sons.

verses.sa: जयतामिव तन्यतुर्मरुतामेति धृष्णुया । यच्छुभं याथना नरः॥
verses.tr: jayatāmiva tanyaturmarutāmeti dhṛṣṇuyā yacchubhaṃ yāthanā naraḥ
verses.en: Fierce comes the Maruts' thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go Forward to victory, O Men.

verses.sa: हस्काराद् विद्युतस्पर्यऽतो जाता अवन्तु नः । मरुतो मृळयन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: haskārād vidyutasparya'to jātā avantu naḥ maruto mṛḻayantu naḥ
verses.en: Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere May they be gracious unto Us.

verses.sa: आ पूषञ्चित्रबर्हिषमाघृणे धरुणं दिवः । आजा नष्टं यथा पशुम्॥
verses.tr: ā pūṣañcitrabarhiṣamāghṛṇe dharuṇaṃ divaḥ ājā naṣṭaṃ yathā paśum
verses.en: Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pusan, him who bears up heaven, Resting on many-coloured grass.

verses.sa: पूषा राजानमाघृणिरपगूह्लं गुहा हितम् । अविन्दच्चित्रबर्हिषम्॥
verses.tr: pūṣā rājānamāghṛṇirapagūhlaṃ guhā hitam avindaccitrabarhiṣam
verses.en: Pusan the Bright has found the King, concealed and hidden in a cave, Who rests on grass of many hues.

verses.sa: उतो स मह्यमिन्दुभिः षड् युक्ताँ अनुसेषिधत् । गोभिर्यवं न चर्कृषत्॥
verses.tr: uto sa mahyamindubhiḥ ṣaḍ yuktāṃ anuseṣidhat gobhiryavaṃ na carkṛṣat
verses.en: And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops, As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.

verses.sa: अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम् । पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः॥
verses.tr: ambayo yantyadhvabhirjāmayo adhvarīyatām pṛñcatīrmadhunā payaḥ
verses.en: Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants, Mingling their sweetness with the milk.

verses.sa: अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह । ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha tā no hinvantvadhvaram
verses.en: May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.

verses.sa: अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः । सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः॥
verses.tr: apo devīrupa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ sindhubhyaḥ kartvaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst; Oblations to the Streams be given.

verses.sa: अप्स्व१न्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमपामुत प्रशस्तये । देवा भवत वाजिनः॥
verses.tr: apsva1ntaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamapāmuta praśastaye devā bhavata vājinaḥ
verses.en: Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.

verses.sa: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा । अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवमापश्च विश्वभेषजीः॥
verses.tr: apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā agniṃ ca viśvaśambhuvamāpaśca viśvabheṣajīḥ
verses.en: Within the Waters--Soma thus hath told me--dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.

verses.sa: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे ३ मम । ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve 3 mama jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.

verses.sa: इदमापः प्र वहत यत् किं च दुरितं मयि । यद् वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम्॥
verses.tr: idamāpaḥ pra vahata yat kiṃ ca duritaṃ mayi yad vāhamabhidudroha yadvā śepa utānṛtam
verses.en: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought. If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

verses.sa: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि । पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: āpo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samagasmahi payasvānagna ā gahi taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
verses.en: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come: O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

verses.sa: सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा । विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात् सह ऋषिभिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja saṃ prajayā samāyuṣā vidyurme asya devā indro vidyāt saha ṛṣibhiḥ
verses.en: Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the Rsis, know.

verses.sa:
कस्य नूनं कतमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम ।
को नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात् पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: kasya nūnaṃ katamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma ko no mahyā aditaye punardāt pitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: Who now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us? Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वयं प्रथमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम ।
स नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात् पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: agnervayaṃ prathamasyāmṛtānāṃ manāmahe cāru devasya nāma sa no mahyā aditaye punardāt pitaraṃ ca dṛśeyaṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: Agni the God the first among the Immortals,--of his auspicious name let us bethink us. He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा देव सवितरीशानं वार्याणाम् । सदावन्भागमीमहे॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā deva savitarīśānaṃ vāryāṇām sadāvanbhāgamīmahe
verses.en: To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us Continually, for our share we come-

verses.sa: यश्चिद्धि त इत्था भगः शशमानः पुरा निदः । अद्वेषो हस्तयोर्दधे॥
verses.tr: yaściddhi ta itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ adveṣo hastayordadhe
verses.en: Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid, Free from all hatred, in thy hands

verses.sa: भगभक्तस्य ते वयमुदशेम तवावसा । मूर्धानं राय आरभे॥
verses.tr: bhagabhaktasya te vayamudaśema tavāvasā mūrdhānaṃ rāya ārabhe
verses.en: Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.

verses.sa:
नहि ते क्षत्रं न सहो न मन्युं वयश्चनामी पतयन्त आपुः ।
नेमा आपो अनिमिषं चरन्तीर्न ये वातस्य प्रमिनन्त्यभ्वम्॥
verses.tr: nahi te kṣatraṃ na saho na manyuṃ vayaścanāmī patayanta āpuḥ nemā āpo animiṣaṃ carantīrna ye vātasya praminantyabhvam
verses.en: Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit; Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.

verses.sa:
अबुध्ने राजा वरुणो वनस्योर्ध्वं स्तूपं ददते पूतदक्षः ।
नीचीनाः स्थुरुपरि बुध्न एषामस्मे अन्तर्निहिताः केतवः स्युः॥
verses.tr: abudhne rājā varuṇo vanasyordhvaṃ stūpaṃ dadate pūtadakṣaḥ nīcīnāḥ sthurupari budhna eṣāmasme antarnihitāḥ ketavaḥ syuḥ
verses.en: Varuna, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region. Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.

verses.sa:
उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ ।
अपदे पादा प्रतिधातवेऽकरुतापवक्ता हृदयाविधश्चित्॥
verses.tr: uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit
verses.en: King Varuna hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit.

verses.sa:
शतं ते राजन् भिषजः सहस्रमुर्वी गभीरा सुमतिष्टे अस्तु ।
बाधस्व दूरे निऋतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasramurvī gabhīrā sumatiṣṭe astu bādhasva dūre niṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumugdhyasmat
verses.en: A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours. Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e'en the sin we have committed.

verses.sa:
अमी य ऋक्षा निहितास उच्चा नक्तं ददृश्रे कुह चिद् दिवेयुः ।
अदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्तमेति॥
verses.tr: amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā naktaṃ dadṛśre kuha cid diveyuḥ adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vicākaśaccandramā naktameti
verses.en: Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us? Varuna's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor

verses.sa:
तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस् तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः ।
अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः॥
verses.tr: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas tadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ aheḻamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
verses.en: I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation. Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

verses.sa:
तदिन्नक्तं तद् दिवा मह्यमाहुस् तदयं केतो हृद आ वि चष्टे ।
शुनःशेपो यमह्वद् गृभीतः सो अस्मान् राजा वरुणो मुमोक्तु॥
verses.tr: tadinnaktaṃ tad divā mahyamāhus tadayaṃ keto hṛda ā vi caṣṭe śunaḥśepo yamahvad gṛbhītaḥ so asmān rājā varuṇo mumoktu
verses.en: Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth. May he to whom prayed fettered Sunahsepa, may he the Sovran Varuna release us.

verses.sa:
शुनःशेपो ह्यह्वद् गृभीतस् त्रिष्वादित्यं द्रुपदेषु बद्धः ।
अवैनं राजा वरुणः ससृज्याद् विद्वाँ अदब्धो वि मुमोक्तु पाशान्॥
verses.tr: śunaḥśepo hyahvad gṛbhītas triṣvādityaṃ drupadeṣu baddhaḥ avainaṃ rājā varuṇaḥ sasṛjyād vidvāṃ adabdho vi mumoktu pāśān
verses.en: Bound to three pillars captured Sunahsepa thus to the Aditya made his supplication. Him may the Sovran Varuna deliver, wise, ne'er deceived, loosen the bonds that bind him.

verses.sa:
अव ते हेळो वरुण नमोभिरव यज्ञेभिरीमहे हविर्भिः ।
क्षयन्नस्मभ्यमसुर प्रचेता राजन्नेनांसि शिश्रथः कृतानि॥
verses.tr: ava te heḻo varuṇa namobhirava yajñebhirīmahe havirbhiḥ kṣayannasmabhyamasura pracetā rājannenāṃsi śiśrathaḥ kṛtāni
verses.en: With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuna, we deprecate thine anger: Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय ।
अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम॥
verses.tr: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
verses.en: Loosen the bonds, O Varuna, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Aditya.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि ते विशो यथा प्र देव वरुण व्रतम् । मिनीमसि द्यविद्यवि॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam minīmasi dyavidyavi
verses.en: Whatever law of thine, O God, O Varuna, as we are men, Day after day we violate.

verses.sa: मा नो वधाय हत्नवे जिहीळानस्य रीरधः । मा हृणानस्य मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: mā no vadhāya hatnave jihīḻānasya rīradhaḥ mā hṛṇānasya manyave
verses.en: give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath, To thy fierce anger when displeased.

verses.sa: वि मृळीकाय ते मनो रथीरश्वं न संदितम् । गीर्भिर्वरुण सीमहि॥
verses.tr: vi mṛḻīkāya te mano rathīraśvaṃ na saṃditam gīrbhirvaruṇa sīmahi
verses.en: To gain thy mercy, Varuna, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds The charioteer his tethered horse.

verses.sa: परा हि मे विमन्यवः पतन्ति वस्यइष्टये । वयो न वसतीरुप॥
verses.tr: parā hi me vimanyavaḥ patanti vasyaiṣṭaye vayo na vasatīrupa
verses.en: They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealths As to their nests the birds of air.

verses.sa: कदा क्षत्रश्रियं नरमा वरुणं करामहे । मृळीकायोरुचक्षसम्॥
verses.tr: kadā kṣatraśriyaṃ naramā varuṇaṃ karāmahe mṛḻīkāyorucakṣasam
verses.en: When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might, Him, the far-seeing Varuna?

verses.sa: तदित् समानमाशाते वेनन्ता न प्र युच्छतः । धृतव्रताय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: tadit samānamāśāte venantā na pra yucchataḥ dhṛtavratāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail The ever-faithful worshipper.

verses.sa: वेदा यो वीनां पदमन्तरिक्षेण पतताम् । वेद नावः समुद्रियः॥
verses.tr: vedā yo vīnāṃ padamantarikṣeṇa patatām veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ
verses.en: He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea, He knows the ships that are thereon.

verses.sa: वेद मासो धृतव्रतो द्वादश प्रजावतः । वेदा य उपजायते॥
verses.tr: veda māso dhṛtavrato dvādaśa prajāvataḥ vedā ya upajāyate
verses.en: True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny: He knows the moon of later birth.

verses.sa: वेद वातस्य वर्तनिमुरोॠष्वस्य बृहतः । वेदा ये अध्यासते॥
verses.tr: veda vātasya vartanimuroṝṣvasya bṛhataḥ vedā ye adhyāsate
verses.en: He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind: He knows the Gods who dwell above.

verses.sa: नि षसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्या३स्वा । साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: ni ṣasāda dhṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyā3svā sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ
verses.en: Varuna, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he, Most wise, sits there to govern all.

verses.sa: अतो विश्वान्यद्भुता चिकित्वाँ अभि पश्यति । कृतानि या च कर्त्वा॥
verses.tr: ato viśvānyadbhutā cikitvāṃ abhi paśyati kṛtāni yā ca kartvā
verses.en: From thence percerving he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been, And what hereafter will be done.

verses.sa: स नो विश्वाहा सुक्रतुरादित्यः सुपथा करत् । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत्॥
verses.tr: sa no viśvāhā sukraturādityaḥ supathā karat pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
verses.en: May that Aditya, very wise, make fair paths for us all our days: May he prolong our lives for us.

verses.sa: बिभ्रद् द्रपिं हिरण्ययं वरुणो वस्त निर्णिजम् । परि स्पशो नि षेदिरे॥
verses.tr: bibhrad drapiṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇo vasta nirṇijam pari spaśo ni ṣedire
verses.en: Varuna, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe. His spies are seated found about.

verses.sa: न यं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो न द्रुह्वाणो जनानाम् । न देवमभिमातयः॥
verses.tr: na yaṃ dipsanti dipsavo na druhvāṇo janānām na devamabhimātayaḥ
verses.en: The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o'er men, Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.

verses.sa: उत यो मानुषेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या । अस्माकमुदरेष्वा॥
verses.tr: uta yo mānuṣeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā asmākamudareṣvā
verses.en: He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete, To our own bodies giving it.

verses.sa: परा मे यन्ति धीतयो गावो न गव्यूतीरनु । इच्छन्तीरुरुचक्षसम्॥
verses.tr: parā me yanti dhītayo gāvo na gavyūtīranu icchantīrurucakṣasam
verses.en: Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him, As kine unto their pastures move.

verses.sa: सं नु वोचावहै पुनर्यतो मे मध्वाभृतम् । होतेव क्षदसे प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ nu vocāvahai punaryato me madhvābhṛtam hoteva kṣadase priyam
verses.en: Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like Thou eatest what is dear to thee.

verses.sa: दर्शं नु विश्वदर्शतं दर्शं रथमधि क्षमि । एता जुषत मे गिरः॥
verses.tr: darśaṃ nu viśvadarśataṃ darśaṃ rathamadhi kṣami etā juṣata me giraḥ
verses.en: Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth: He hath accepted these my songs.

verses.sa: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृळय । त्वामवस्युरा चके॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḻaya tvāmavasyurā cake
verses.en: Varuna, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day Longing for help I cried to thee.

verses.sa: त्वं विश्वस्यू मेधिर दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजसि । स यामनि प्रति श्रुधि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viśvasyū medhira divaśca gmaśca rājasi sa yāmani prati śrudhi
verses.en: Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven Hear, as thou goest on thy way.

verses.sa: उदुत्तमं मुमुग्धि नो वि पाशं मध्यमं चृत । अवाधमानि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: uduttamaṃ mumugdhi no vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta avādhamāni jīvase
verses.en: Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose The bonds below, that I may live.

verses.sa: वसिष्वा हि मियेध्य वस्त्राण्यूर्जां पते । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज॥
verses.tr: vasiṣvā hi miyedhya vastrāṇyūrjāṃ pate semaṃ no adhvaraṃ yaja
verses.en: O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes, And offer this our sacrifice.

verses.sa: नि नो होता वरेण्यः सदा यविष्ठ मन्मभिः । अग्ने दिवित्मता वचः॥
verses.tr: ni no hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manmabhiḥ agne divitmatā vacaḥ
verses.en: Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest, most youthful, through our hymns, O Agni, through our heavenly word.

verses.sa: आ हि ष्मा सूनवे पितापिर्यजत्यापये । सखा सख्ये वरेण्यः॥
verses.tr: ā hi ṣmā sūnave pitāpiryajatyāpaye sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ
verses.en: For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth, And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.
