verses.sa: आ नो बर्ही रिशादसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । सीदन्तु मनुषो यथा॥
verses.tr: ā no barhī riśādaso varuṇo mitro aryamā sīdantu manuṣo yathā
verses.en: Here let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Like men, upon our sacred grass.

verses.sa: पूर्व्य होतरस्य नो मन्दस्व सख्यस्य च । इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः॥
verses.tr: pūrvya hotarasya no mandasva sakhyasya ca imā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ
verses.en: O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship: Hearken thou well to these our songs.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि शश्वता तना देवंदेवं यजामहे । त्वे इद्धूयते हविः॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi śaśvatā tanā devaṃdevaṃ yajāmahe tve iddhūyate haviḥ
verses.en: Whate'er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered up in thee

verses.sa: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः । प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम्॥
verses.tr: priyo no astu viśpatirhotā mandro vareṇyaḥ priyāḥ svagnayo vayam
verses.en: May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may We, with bright fires, be dear to him.

verses.sa: स्वग्नयो हि वार्यं देवासो दधिरे च नः । स्वग्नयो मनामहे॥
verses.tr: svagnayo hi vāryaṃ devāso dadhire ca naḥ svagnayo manāmahe
verses.en: The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.

verses.sa: अथा न उभयेषाममृत मर्त्यानाम् । मिथः सन्तु प्रशस्तयः॥
verses.tr: athā na ubhayeṣāmamṛta martyānām mithaḥ santu praśastayaḥ
verses.en: And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men Belong to us and thee alike.

verses.sa: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः । चनो धाः सहसो यहो॥
verses.tr: viśvebhiragne agnibhirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ vacaḥ cano dhāḥ sahaso yaho
verses.en: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O Son of Strength.

verses.sa: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम्॥
verses.tr: aśvaṃ na tvā vāravantaṃ vandadhyā agniṃ namobhiḥ samrājantamadhvarāṇām
verses.en: With worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of sacred rites.

verses.sa: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात्॥
verses.tr: sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ mīḍhvāṃ asmākaṃ babhūyāt
verses.en: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.

verses.sa: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद् विश्वायुः॥
verses.tr: sa no dūrāccāsācca ni martyādaghāyoḥ pāhi sadamid viśvāyuḥ
verses.en: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore Protect us from the sinful man.

verses.sa: इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः॥
verses.tr: imamū ṣu tvamasmākaṃ saniṃ gāyatraṃ navyāṃsam agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods, And this our newest song of praise.

verses.sa: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य॥
verses.tr: ā no bhaja parameṣvā vājeṣu madhyameṣu śikṣā vasvo antamasya
verses.en: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below, A share of strength that is between.

verses.sa: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि॥
verses.tr: vibhaktāsi citrabhāno sindhorūrmā upāka ā sadyo dāśuṣe kṣarasi
verses.en: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou Swift streamest to the worshipper.

verses.sa: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.

verses.sa: नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः॥
verses.tr: nakirasya sahantya paryetā kayasya cit vājo asti śravāyyaḥ
verses.en: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One: Nay, very glorious power is his.

verses.sa: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता॥
verses.tr: sa vājaṃ viśvacarṣaṇirarvadbhirastu tarutā viprebhirastu sanitā
verses.en: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight, And with the singers win the spoil.

verses.sa: जराबोध तद् विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकम्॥
verses.tr: jarābodha tad viviḍḍhi viśeviśe yajñiyāya stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam
verses.en: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him Adorable in every house.

verses.sa: स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु॥
verses.tr: sa no mahāṃ animāno dhūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ dhiye vājāya hinvatu
verses.en: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright, Urge us to strength and holy thought.

verses.sa: स रेवाँ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः॥
verses.tr: sa revāṃ iva viśpatirdaivyaḥ ketuḥ śṛṇotu naḥ ukthairagnirbṛhadbhānuḥ
verses.en: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.

verses.sa:
नमो महद्भ्यो नमो अर्भकेभ्यो नमो युवभ्यो नम आशिनेभ्यः ।
यजाम देवान्यदि शक्नवाम मा ज्यायसः शंसमा वृक्षि देवाः॥
verses.tr: namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyo namo yuvabhyo nama āśinebhyaḥ yajāma devānyadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṃsamā vṛkṣi devāḥ
verses.en: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder! Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.

verses.sa: यत्र ग्रावा पृथुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः॥
verses.tr: yatra grāvā pṛthubudhna ūrdhvo bhavati sotave ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ
verses.en: There where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa: यत्र द्वाविव जघनाधिषवण्या कृता । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः॥
verses.tr: yatra dvāviva jaghanādhiṣavaṇyā kṛtā ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ
verses.en: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa: यत्र नार्यपच्यवमुपच्यवं च शिक्षते । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः॥
verses.tr: yatra nāryapacyavamupacyavaṃ ca śikṣate ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ
verses.en: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa: यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन् यमितवा इव । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः॥
verses.tr: yatra manthāṃ vibadhnate raśmīn yamitavā iva ulūkhalasutānāmavedvindra jalgulaḥ
verses.en: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

verses.sa: यच्चिद्धि त्वं गृहेगृह उलूखलक युज्यसे । इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयतामिव दुन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛha ulūkhalaka yujyase iha dyumattamaṃ vada jayatāmiva dundubhiḥ
verses.en: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work, Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.

verses.sa: उत स्म ते वनस्पते वातो वि वात्यग्रमित् । अथो इन्द्राय पातवे सुनु सोममुलूखल॥
verses.tr: uta sma te vanaspate vāto vi vātyagramit atho indrāya pātave sunu somamulūkhala
verses.en: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee, Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.

verses.sa: आयजी वाजसातमा ता ह्यु१च्चा विजर्भृतः । हरी इवान्धांसि बप्सता॥
verses.tr: āyajī vājasātamā tā hyu1ccā vijarbhṛtaḥ harī ivāndhāṃsi bapsatā
verses.en: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements, Like two bay horses champing herbs.

verses.sa: ता नो अद्य वनस्पती ऋष्वावृष्वेभिः सोतृभिः । इन्द्राय मधुमत्सुतम्॥
verses.tr: tā no adya vanaspatī ṛṣvāvṛṣvebhiḥ sotṛbhiḥ indrāya madhumatsutam
verses.en: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.

verses.sa: उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । नि धेहि गोरधि त्वचि॥
verses.tr: ucchiṣṭaṃ camvorbhara somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja ni dhehi goradhi tvaci
verses.en: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour, and on the ox-hide set the dregs.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ता इव स्मसि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi satya somapā anāśastā iva smasi ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
शिप्रिन् वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: śiprin vājānāṃ pate śacīvastava daṃsanā ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
नि ष्वापया मिथूदृशा सस्तामबुध्यमाने ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: ni ṣvāpayā mithūdṛśā sastāmabudhyamāne ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
ससन्तु त्या अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: sasantu tyā arātayo bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र गर्दभं मृण नुवन्तं पापयामुया ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: samindra gardabhaṃ mṛṇa nuvantaṃ pāpayāmuyā ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: patāti kuṇḍṛṇācyā dūraṃ vāto vanādadhi ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course! Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa:
सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कृकदाश्वम् ।
आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ॥
verses.tr: sarvaṃ parikrośaṃ jahi jambhayā kṛkadāśvam ā tū na indra śaṃsaya goṣvaśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvīmagha
verses.en: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine In thousands, O most wealthy One.

verses.sa: आ व इन्द्रं क्रिविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् । मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः॥
verses.tr: ā va indraṃ kriviṃ yathā vājayantaḥ śatakratum maṃhiṣṭhaṃ siñca indubhiḥ
verses.en: We seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,

verses.sa: शतं वा यः शुचीनां सहस्रं वा समाशिराम् । एदु निम्नं न रीयते॥
verses.tr: śataṃ vā yaḥ śucīnāṃ sahasraṃ vā samāśirām edu nimnaṃ na rīyate
verses.en: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts Flow, even as down a depth, to him;

verses.sa: सं यन्मदाय शुष्मिण एना ह्यस्योदरे । समुद्रो न व्यचो दधे॥
verses.tr: saṃ yanmadāya śuṣmiṇa enā hyasyodare samudro na vyaco dadhe
verses.en: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room Within his belly, like the sea.

verses.sa: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे॥
verses.tr: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim vacastaccinna ohase
verses.en: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest too for this our prayer.

verses.sa: स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता॥
verses.tr: stotraṃ rādhānāṃ pate girvāho vīra yasya te vibhūtirastu sūnṛtā
verses.en: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness Be his who sings the laud to thee.

verses.sa: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvastiṣṭhā na ūtaye'sminvāje śatakrato samanyeṣu bravāvahai
verses.en: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight In others too let us agree.

verses.sa: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये॥
verses.tr: yogeyoge tavastaraṃ vājevāje havāmahe sakhāya indramūtaye
verses.en: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.

verses.sa: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्  सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā ghā gamadyadi śravat sahasriṇībhirūtibhiḥ vājebhirupa no havam
verses.en: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.

verses.sa: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे॥
verses.tr: anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiṃ naram yaṃ te pūrvaṃ pitā huve
verses.en: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

verses.sa: तं त्वा वयं विश्ववारा ऽऽ शास्महे पुरुहूत । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vayaṃ viśvavārā '' śāsmahe puruhūta sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyaḥ
verses.en: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all precious gifts, O Friend, Kind God to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम् । सखे वज्रिन्त्सखीनाम्॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ śipriṇīnāṃ somapāḥ somapāvnām sakhe vajrintsakhīnām
verses.en: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames And of our Soma-drinking friends.

verses.sa: तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन्तथा कृणु । यथा त उश्मसीष्टये॥
verses.tr: tathā tadastu somapāḥ sakhe vajrintathā kṛṇu yathā ta uśmasīṣṭaye
verses.en: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act To aid each wish as we desire.

verses.sa: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम॥
verses.tr: revatīrnaḥ sadhamāda indre santu tuvivājāḥ kṣumanto yābhirmadema
verses.en: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.

verses.sa: आ घ त्वावान्  त्मनाप्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः॥
verses.tr: ā gha tvāvān tmanāptaḥ stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇaviyānaḥ ṛṇorakṣaṃ na cakryoḥ
verses.en: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car.

verses.sa: आ यद् दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: ā yad duvaḥ śatakratavā kāmaṃ jaritṝṇām ṛṇorakṣaṃ na śacībhiḥ
verses.en: That, Satakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

verses.sa:
शश्वदिन्द्रः पोप्रुथद्भिर्जिगाय नानदद्भिः शाश्वसद्भिर्धनानि ।
स नो हिरण्यरथं दंसनावान्त्स नः सनिता सनये स नोऽदात्॥
verses.tr: śaśvadindraḥ popruthadbhirjigāya nānadadbhiḥ śāśvasadbhirdhanāni sa no hiraṇyarathaṃ daṃsanāvāntsa naḥ sanitā sanaye sa no'dāt
verses.en: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.

verses.sa: आश्विनावश्वावत्येषा यातं शवीरया । गोमद् दस्रा हिरण्यवत्॥
verses.tr: āśvināvaśvāvatyeṣā yātaṃ śavīrayā gomad dasrā hiraṇyavat
verses.en: Come, Asvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine, And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa: समानयोजनो हि वां रथो दस्रावमर्त्यः । समुद्रे अश्विनेयते॥
verses.tr: samānayojano hi vāṃ ratho dasrāvamartyaḥ samudre aśvineyate
verses.en: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts, Travels, O Asvins, in the sea.

verses.sa: न्य१घ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । परि द्यामन्यदीयते॥
verses.tr: nya1ghnyasya mūrdhani cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ pari dyāmanyadīyate
verses.en: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep, The other round the sky revolves.

verses.sa: कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये । कं नक्षसे विभावरि॥
verses.tr: kasta uṣaḥ kadhapriye bhuje marto amartye kaṃ nakṣase vibhāvari
verses.en: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou? To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?

verses.sa: वयं हि ते अमन्मह्याऽऽन्तादा पराकात् । अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ hi te amanmahyā''ntādā parākāt aśve na citre aruṣi
verses.en: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away, Red-hued and like a dappled mare.

verses.sa: त्वं त्येभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyebhirā gahi vājebhirduhitardivaḥ asme rayiṃ ni dhāraya
verses.en: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings, And send thou riches down to us.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा
।तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरस्तमः कविर्देवानां परि भूषसि व्रतम् ।
विभुर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय मेधिरो द्विमाता शयुः कतिधा चिदायवे॥
verses.tr: tvamagne prathamo aṅgirastamaḥ kavirdevānāṃ pari bhūṣasi vratam vibhurviśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiro dvimātā śayuḥ katidhā cidāyave
verses.en: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods. Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रथमो मातरिश्वन आविर्भव सुक्रतूया विवस्वते ।
अरेजेतां रोदसी होतृवूर्ये ऽसघ्नोर्भारमयजो महो वसो॥
verses.tr: tvamagne prathamo mātariśvana āvirbhava sukratūyā vivasvate arejetāṃ rodasī hotṛvūrye 'saghnorbhāramayajo maho vaso
verses.en: To Matarisvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power. Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने मनवे द्यामवाशयः पुरूरवसे सुकृते सुकृत्तरः ।
श्वात्रेण यत् पित्रोर्मुच्यसे पर्या त्वा पूर्वमनयन्नापरं पुनः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne manave dyāmavāśayaḥ purūravase sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ śvātreṇa yat pitrormucyase paryā tvā pūrvamanayannāparaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Pururavas. When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वृषभः पुष्टिवर्धन उद्यतस्रुचे भवसि श्रवाय्यः ।
य आहुतिं परि वेदा वषट्कृतिमेकायुरग्रे विश आविवाससि॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vṛṣabhaḥ puṣṭivardhana udyatasruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ ya āhutiṃ pari vedā vaṣaṭkṛtimekāyuragre viśa āvivāsasi
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up. Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वृजिनवर्तनिं नरं सक्मन् पिपर्षि विदथे विचर्षणे ।
यः शूरसाता परितक्म्ये धने दभ्रेभिश्चित् समृता हंसि भूयसः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vṛjinavartaniṃ naraṃ sakman piparṣi vidathe vicarṣaṇe yaḥ śūrasātā paritakmye dhane dabhrebhiścit samṛtā haṃsi bhūyasaḥ
verses.en: Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e'en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways. Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमग्ने अमृतत्व उत्तमे मर्तं दधासि श्रवसे दिवेदिवे ।
यस्तातृषाण उभयाय जन्मने मयः कृणोषि प्रय आ च सूरये॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tamagne amṛtatva uttame martaṃ dadhāsi śravase divedive yastātṛṣāṇa ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kṛṇoṣi praya ā ca sūraye
verses.en: For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality, Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने सनये धनानां यशसं कारुं कृणुहि स्तवानः ।
ऋध्याम कर्मापसा नवेन देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne sanaye dhanānāṃ yaśasaṃ kāruṃ kṛṇuhi stavānaḥ ṛdhyāma karmāpasā navena devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ
verses.en: O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches: May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने पित्रोरुपस्थ आ देवो देवेष्वनवद्य जागृविः ।
तनूकृद् बोधि प्रमतिश्च कारवे त्वं कल्याण वसु विश्वमोपिषे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne pitrorupastha ā devo deveṣvanavadya jāgṛviḥ tanūkṛd bodhi pramatiśca kārave tvaṃ kalyāṇa vasu viśvamopiṣe
verses.en: O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good. Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रमतिस्त्वं पितासि नस्त्वं वयस्कृत् तव जामयो वयम् ।
सं त्वा रायः शतिनः सं सहस्रिणः सुवीरं यन्ति व्रतपामदाभ्य॥
verses.tr: tvamagne pramatistvaṃ pitāsi nastvaṃ vayaskṛt tava jāmayo vayam saṃ tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ saṃ sahasriṇaḥ suvīraṃ yanti vratapāmadābhya
verses.en: Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou: we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life. In thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने प्रथममायुमायवे देवा अकृण्वन् नहुषस्य विश्पतिम् ।
इळामकृण्वन् मनुषस्य शासनीं पितुर्यत् पुत्रो ममकस्य जायते॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne prathamamāyumāyave devā akṛṇvan nahuṣasya viśpatim iḻāmakṛṇvan manuṣasya śāsanīṃ pituryat putro mamakasya jāyate
verses.en: Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahusa. Ila they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य ।
त्राता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषं रक्षमाणस्तव व्रते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vandya trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate
verses.en: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने यज्यवे पायुरन्तरो ऽनिषङ्गाय चतुरक्ष इध्यसे ।
यो रातहव्यो ऽवृकाय धायसे कीरेश्चिन् मन्त्रं मनसा वनोषि तम्॥
verses.tr: tvamagne yajyave pāyurantaro 'niṣaṅgāya caturakṣa idhyase yo rātahavyo 'vṛkāya dhāyase kīreścin mantraṃ manasā vanoṣi tam
verses.en: Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmed. With fond heart thou acceptest e'en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न उरुशंसाय वाघते स्पार्हं यद् रेक्णः परमं वनोषि तत् ।
आध्रस्य चित् प्रमतिरुच्यसे पिता प्र पाकं शास्सि प्र दिशो विदुष्टरः॥
verses.tr: tvamagna uruśaṃsāya vāghate spārhaṃ yad rekṇaḥ paramaṃ vanoṣi tat ādhrasya cit pramatirucyase pitā pra pākaṃ śāssi pra diśo viduṣṭaraḥ
verses.en: Thou, Agni gainest for the loudly-praising priest the highest wealth, the object of a man's desire. Thou art called Father, caring even for the weak, and wisest, to the simple one thou teachest lore.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने प्रयतदक्षिणं नरं वर्मेव स्यूतं परि पासि विश्वतः ।
स्वादुक्षद्मा यो वसतौ स्योनकृज् जीवयाजं यजते सोपमा दिवः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne prayatadakṣiṇaṃ naraṃ varmeva syūtaṃ pari pāsi viśvataḥ svādukṣadmā yo vasatau syonakṛj jīvayājaṃ yajate sopamā divaḥ
verses.en: Agni, the man who giveth guerdon to the priests, like well-sewn armour thou guardest on every side. He who with grateful food shows kindness in his house, an offerer to the living, is the type of heaven.

verses.sa:
इमामग्ने शरणिं मीमृषो न इममध्वानं यमगाम दूरात् ।
आपिः पिता प्रमतिः सोम्यानां भृमिरस्यृषिकृन् मर्त्यानाम्॥
verses.tr: imāmagne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo na imamadhvānaṃ yamagāma dūrāt āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhṛmirasyṛṣikṛn martyānām
verses.en: Pardon, we pray, this sin of ours, O Agni,--the path which we have trodden, widely straying, Dear Friend and Father, caring for the pious, who speedest nigh and who inspirest mortals.

verses.sa:
मनुष्वदग्ने अङ्गिरस्वदङ्गिरो ययातिवत् सदने पूर्ववच्छुचे ।
अच्छ याह्या वहा दैव्यं जनमा सादय बर्हिषि यक्षि च प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: manuṣvadagne aṅgirasvadaṅgiro yayātivat sadane pūrvavacchuce accha yāhyā vahā daivyaṃ janamā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam
verses.en: As erst to Manus, to Yayati, Angiras, so Angiras! pure Agni! come thou to our hall Bring hither the celestial host and seat them here upon the sacred grass, and offer what they love.

verses.sa:
एतेनाग्ने ब्रह्मणा वावृधस्व शक्ती वा यत्ते चकृमा विदा वा ।
उत प्र णेष्यभि वस्यो अस्मान् त्सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या॥
verses.tr: etenāgne brahmaṇā vāvṛdhasva śaktī vā yatte cakṛmā vidā vā uta pra ṇeṣyabhi vasyo asmān tsaṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā
verses.en: By this our prayer be thou, O Agni, strengthened, prayer made by us after our power and knowledge. Lead thou us, therefore, to increasing riches; endow us with thy strength-bestowing favour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य नु वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यानि चकार प्रथमानि वज्री ।
अहन्नहिमन्वपस्ततर्द प्र वक्षणा अभिनत् पर्वतानाम्॥
verses.tr: indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinat parvatānām
verses.en: I will declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

verses.sa:
अहन्नहिं पर्वते शिश्रियाणं त्वष्टास्मै वज्रं स्वर्यं ततक्ष ।
वाश्रा इव धेनवः स्यन्दमाना अञ्जः समुद्रमव जग्मुरापः॥
verses.tr: ahannahiṃ parvate śiśriyāṇaṃ tvaṣṭāsmai vajraṃ svaryaṃ tatakṣa vāśrā iva dhenavaḥ syandamānā añjaḥ samudramava jagmurāpaḥ
verses.en: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashṭar fashioned. Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.

verses.sa:
वृषायमाणो ऽवृणीत सोमं त्रिकद्रुकेष्वपिबत् सुतस्य ।
आ सायकं मघवादत्त वज्रमहन्नेनं प्रथमजामहीनाम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāyamāṇo 'vṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣvapibat sutasya ā sāyakaṃ maghavādatta vajramahannenaṃ prathamajāmahīnām
verses.en: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma, and in three sacred beakers drank the juices. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राहन् प्रथमजामहीनामान्मायिनाममिनाः प्रोत मायाः ।
आत् सूर्यं जनयन् द्यामुषासं तादीत्ना शत्रुं न किला विवित्से॥
verses.tr: yadindrāhan prathamajāmahīnāmānmāyināmamināḥ prota māyāḥ āt sūryaṃ janayan dyāmuṣāsaṃ tādītnā śatruṃ na kilā vivitse
verses.en: When, Indra, thou hadst slain the dragons’ firstborn, and overcome the charms of the enchanters, Then, giving life to Sun and Dawn and Heaven, thou foundest not one foe to stand against thee.

verses.sa:
अहन् वृत्रं वृत्रतरं व्यंसमिन्द्रो वज्रेण महता वधेन ।
स्कन्धांसीव कुलिशेना विवृक्णाऽहिः शयत उपपृक् पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: ahan vṛtraṃ vṛtrataraṃ vyaṃsamindro vajreṇa mahatā vadhena skandhāṃsīva kuliśenā vivṛkṇā'hiḥ śayata upapṛk pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Indra with his own great and deadly thunder smote into pieces Vṛitra, worst of Vṛitras. As trunks of trees, what time the axe hath felled them, low on the earth so lies the prostrate Dragon.

verses.sa:
अयोद्धेव दुर्मद आ हि जुह्वे महावीरं तुविबाधमृजीषम् ।
नातारीदस्य समृतिं वधानां सं रुजानाः पिपिष इन्द्रशत्रुः॥
verses.tr: ayoddheva durmada ā hi juhve mahāvīraṃ tuvibādhamṛjīṣam nātārīdasya samṛtiṃ vadhānāṃ saṃ rujānāḥ pipiṣa indraśatruḥ
verses.en: He, like a mad weak warrior, challenged Indra, the great impetuous many-slaying Hero. He, brooking not the clashing of the weapons, crushed—Indra’s foe—the shattered forts in falling.

verses.sa:
अपादहस्तो अपृतन्यदिन्द्रमास्य वज्रमधि सानौ जघान ।
वृष्णो वध्रिः प्रतिमानं बुभूषन् पुरुत्रा वृत्रो अशयद्व्य व्यस्तः॥
verses.tr: apādahasto apṛtanyadindramāsya vajramadhi sānau jaghāna vṛṣṇo vadhriḥ pratimānaṃ bubhūṣan purutrā vṛtro aśayadvya vyastaḥ
verses.en: Footless and handless still he challenged Indra, who smote him with his bolt between the shoulders. Emasculate yet claiming manly vigour, thus Vṛitra lay with scattered limbs dissevered.

verses.sa:
नदं न भिन्नममुया शयानं मनो रुहाणा अति यन्त्यापः ।
याश्चिद् वृत्रो महिना पर्यतिष्ठत् तासामहिः पत्सुतःशीर्बभूव॥
verses.tr: nadaṃ na bhinnamamuyā śayānaṃ mano ruhāṇā ati yantyāpaḥ yāścid vṛtro mahinā paryatiṣṭhat tāsāmahiḥ patsutaḥśīrbabhūva
verses.en: There as he lies like a bank-bursting river, the waters taking courage flow above him. The Dragon lies beneath the feet of torrents which Vṛitra with his greatness had encompassed.

verses.sa:
नीचावया अभवद् वृत्रपुत्रेन्द्रो अस्या अव वधर्जभार ।
उत्तरा सूरधरः पुत्र आसीद् दानुः शये सहवत्सा न धेनुः॥
verses.tr: nīcāvayā abhavad vṛtraputrendro asyā ava vadharjabhāra uttarā sūradharaḥ putra āsīd dānuḥ śaye sahavatsā na dhenuḥ
verses.en: Then humbled was the strength of Vṛitra’s mother: Indra hath cast his deadly bolt against her. The mother was above, the son was under, and like a cow beside her calf lay Dânu.

verses.sa:
अतिष्ठन्तीनामनिवेशनानां काष्ठानां मध्ये निहितं शरीरम् ।
वृत्रस्य निण्यं वि चरन्त्यापो दीर्घं तम आशयदिन्द्रशत्रुः॥
verses.tr: atiṣṭhantīnāmaniveśanānāṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ madhye nihitaṃ śarīram vṛtrasya niṇyaṃ vi carantyāpo dīrghaṃ tama āśayadindraśatruḥ
verses.en: Rolled in the midst of never-ceasing currents flowing without a rest for ever onward, The waters bear off Vṛitra’s nameless body: the foe of Indra sank to during darkness.

verses.sa:
दासपत्नीरहिगोपा अतिष्ठन् निरुद्धा आपः पणिनेव गावः ।
अपां बिलमपिहितं यदासीद् वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अप तद् ववार॥
verses.tr: dāsapatnīrahigopā atiṣṭhan niruddhā āpaḥ paṇineva gāvaḥ apāṃ bilamapihitaṃ yadāsīd vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ apa tad vavāra
verses.en: Guarded by Ahi stood the thralls of Dâsas, the waters stayed like kine held by the robber. But he, when he had smitten Vṛitra, opened the cave wherein the floods had been imprisoned.

verses.sa:
अश्व्यो वारो अभवस्तदिन्द्र सृके यत् त्वा प्रत्यहन् देव एकः ।
अजयो गा अजयः शूर सोममवासृजः सर्तवे सप्त सिन्धून्॥
verses.tr: aśvyo vāro abhavastadindra sṛke yat tvā pratyahan deva ekaḥ ajayo gā ajayaḥ śūra somamavāsṛjaḥ sartave sapta sindhūn
verses.en: A horse's tail wast thou when he, O Indra, smote on thy bolt; thou, God without a second, Thou hast won back the kine, hast won the Soma; thou hast let loose to flow the Seven Rivers.

verses.sa:
नास्मै विद्युन्न तन्यतुः सिषेध न यां मिहमकिरद् ध्रादुनिं च ।
इन्द्रश्च यद् युयुधाते अहिश्चोतापरीभ्यो मघवा वि जिग्ये॥
verses.tr: nāsmai vidyunna tanyatuḥ siṣedha na yāṃ mihamakirad dhrāduniṃ ca indraśca yad yuyudhāte ahiścotāparībhyo maghavā vi jigye
verses.en: Nothing availed him lightning, nothing thunder, hailstorm or mist which he had spread around him: When Indra and the Dragon strove in battle, Maghavan gained the victory for ever.

verses.sa:
अहेर्यातारं कमपश्य इन्द्र हृदि यत्ते जघ्नुषो भीरगच्छत् ।
नव च यन् नवतिं च स्रवन्तीः श्येनो न भीतो अतरो रजांसि॥
verses.tr: aheryātāraṃ kamapaśya indra hṛdi yatte jaghnuṣo bhīragacchat nava ca yan navatiṃ ca sravantīḥ śyeno na bhīto ataro rajāṃsi
verses.en: Whom sawest thou to avenge the Dragon, Indra, that fear possessed thy heart when thou hadst slain him; That, like a hawk affrighted through the regions, thou crossedst nine-and-ninety flowing rivers?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यातोऽवसितस्य राजा शमस्य च शृङ्गिणो वज्रबाहुः ।
सेदु राजा क्षयति चर्षणीनामरान् न नेमिः परि ता बभूव॥
verses.tr: indro yāto'vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇo vajrabāhuḥ sedu rājā kṣayati carṣaṇīnāmarān na nemiḥ pari tā babhūva
verses.en: Indra is King of all that moves and moves not, of creatures tame and horned, the Thunder-wielder. Over all living men he rules as Sovran, containing all as spokes within the felly.

verses.sa:
एतायामोप गव्यन्त इन्द्रमस्माकं सु प्रमतिं वावृधाति ।
अनामृणः कुविदादस्य रायो गवां केतं परमावर्जते नः॥
verses.tr: etāyāmopa gavyanta indramasmākaṃ su pramatiṃ vāvṛdhāti anāmṛṇaḥ kuvidādasya rāyo gavāṃ ketaṃ paramāvarjate naḥ
verses.en: Come, fain for booty let us seek to Indra: yet more shall he increase his care that guides us. Will not the Indestructible endow us with perfect knowledge of this wealth, of cattle?

verses.sa:
उपेदहं धनदामप्रतीतं जुष्टां न श्येनो वसतिं पतामि ।
इन्द्रं नमस्यन्नुपमेभिरर्कैर्यः स्तोतृभ्यो हव्यो अस्ति यामन्॥
verses.tr: upedahaṃ dhanadāmapratītaṃ juṣṭāṃ na śyeno vasatiṃ patāmi indraṃ namasyannupamebhirarkairyaḥ stotṛbhyo havyo asti yāman
verses.en: I fly to him invisible Wealth-giver as flies the falcon to his cherished eyrie, With fairest hymns of praise adoring Indra, whom those who laud him must invoke in battle.

verses.sa:
नि सर्वसेन इषुधीँरसक्त समर्यो गा अजति यस्य वष्टि ।
चोष्कूयमाण इन्द्र भूरि वामं मा पणिर्भूरस्मदधि प्रवृद्ध॥
verses.tr: ni sarvasena iṣudhīṃrasakta samaryo gā ajati yasya vaṣṭi coṣkūyamāṇa indra bhūri vāmaṃ mā paṇirbhūrasmadadhi pravṛddha
verses.en: Mid all his host, he bindeth on the quiver: he driveth cattle from what foe he pleaseth: Gathering up great store of riches, Indra. be thou no trafficker with us, most mighty.

verses.sa:
वधीर्हि दस्युं धनिनं घनेनँ एकश्चरन्नुपशाकेभिरिन्द्र ।
धनोरधि विषुणक्ते व्यायन्नयज्वानः सनकाः प्रेतिमीयुः॥
verses.tr: vadhīrhi dasyuṃ dhaninaṃ ghanenaṃ ekaścarannupaśākebhirindra dhanoradhi viṣuṇakte vyāyannayajvānaḥ sanakāḥ pretimīyuḥ
verses.en: Thou slewest with thy bolt the wealthy Dasyu, alone, yet going with thy helpers, Indra! Far from the floor of heaven in all directions, the ancient riteless ones fled to destruction.

verses.sa:
परा चिच्छीर्षा ववृजुस्त इन्द्राऽयज्वानो यज्वभिः स्पर्धमानाः ।
प्र यद् दिवो हरिवः स्थातरुग्र  निरव्रताँ अधमो रोदस्योः॥
verses.tr: parā cicchīrṣā vavṛjusta indrā'yajvāno yajvabhiḥ spardhamānāḥ pra yad divo harivaḥ sthātarugra niravratāṃ adhamo rodasyoḥ
verses.en: Fighting with pious worshippers, the riteless turned and fled, Indra! with averted faces. When thou, fierce Lord of the Bay Steeds, the Stayer, blewest from earth and heaven and sky the godless.

verses.sa:
अयुयुत्सन्ननवद्यस्य सेनामयातयन्त क्षितयो नवग्वाः ।
वृषायुधो न वध्रयो निरष्टाः प्रवद्भिरिन्द्राच्चितयन्त आयन्॥
verses.tr: ayuyutsannanavadyasya senāmayātayanta kṣitayo navagvāḥ vṛṣāyudho na vadhrayo niraṣṭāḥ pravadbhirindrāccitayanta āyan
verses.en: They met in fight the army of the blameless: then the Navagvas put forth all their power. They, like emasculates with men contending, fled, conscious, by steep paths from Indra, scattered.

verses.sa:
त्वमेतान् रुदतो जक्षतश्चायोधयो रजस इन्द्र पारे ।
अवादहो दिव आ दस्युमुच्चा प्र सुन्वतः स्तुवतः शंसमावः॥
verses.tr: tvametān rudato jakṣataścāyodhayo rajasa indra pāre avādaho diva ā dasyumuccā pra sunvataḥ stuvataḥ śaṃsamāvaḥ
verses.en: Whether they weep or laugh, thou hast o'erthrown them, O Indra, on the sky's extremest limit. The Dasyu thou hast burned from heaven, and welcomed the prayer of him who pours the juice and lauds thee.

verses.sa:
चक्राणासः परीणहं पृथिव्या हिरण्येन मणिना शुम्भमानाः ।
न हिन्वानासस्तितिरुस्त इन्द्रं परि स्पशो अदधात् सूर्येण॥
verses.tr: cakrāṇāsaḥ parīṇahaṃ pṛthivyā hiraṇyena maṇinā śumbhamānāḥ na hinvānāsastitirusta indraṃ pari spaśo adadhāt sūryeṇa
verses.en: Adorned with their array of gold and jewels, they o'er the earth a covering veil extended. Although they hastened, they o'ercame not Indra: their spies he compassed with the Sun of morning.

verses.sa:
परि यदिन्द्र रोदसी उभे अबुभोजीर्महिना विश्वतः सीम् ।
अमन्यमानाँ अभि मन्यमानैर्निर्ब्रह्मभिरधमो दस्युमिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: pari yadindra rodasī ubhe abubhojīrmahinā viśvataḥ sīm amanyamānāṃ abhi manyamānairnirbrahmabhiradhamo dasyumindra
verses.en: As thou enjoyest heaven and earth, O Indra, on every side surrounded with thy greatness, So thou with priests bast blown away the Dasyu, and those who worship not with those who worship.

verses.sa:
न ये दिवः पृथिव्या अन्तमापुर्न मायाभिर्धनदां पर्यभूवन् ।
युजं वज्रं वृषभश्चक्र इन्द्रो निर्ज्योतिषा तमसो गा अदुक्षत्॥
verses.tr: na ye divaḥ pṛthivyā antamāpurna māyābhirdhanadāṃ paryabhūvan yujaṃ vajraṃ vṛṣabhaścakra indro nirjyotiṣā tamaso gā adukṣat
verses.en: They who pervaded earth's extremest limit subdued not with their charms the Wealth-bestower: Indra, the Bull, made his ally the thunder, and with its light milked cows from out the darkness.

verses.sa:
अनु स्वधामक्षरन्नापो अस्यावर्धत मध्य आ नाव्यानाम् ।
सध्रीचीनेन मनसा तमिन्द्र ओजिष्ठेन हन्मनाहन्नभि द्यून्॥
verses.tr: anu svadhāmakṣarannāpo asyāvardhata madhya ā nāvyānām sadhrīcīnena manasā tamindra ojiṣṭhena hanmanāhannabhi dyūn
verses.en: The waters flowed according to their nature; he raid the navigable streams waxed mighty. Then Indra, with his spirit concentrated, smote him for ever with his strongest weapon.

verses.sa:
न्याविध्यदिलीबिशस्य दृह्ला वि शृङ्गिणमभिनच्छुष्णमिन्द्रः ।
यावत्तरो मघवन् यावदोजो वज्रेण शत्रुमवधीः पृतन्युम्॥
verses.tr: nyāvidhyadilībiśasya dṛhlā vi śṛṅgiṇamabhinacchuṣṇamindraḥ yāvattaro maghavan yāvadojo vajreṇa śatrumavadhīḥ pṛtanyum
verses.en: Indra broke through Ilibisa's strong castles, and Susna with his horn he cut to pieces: Thou, Maghavan, for all his might and swiftness, slewest thy fighting foeman with thy thunder

verses.sa:
अभि सिध्मो अजिगादस्य शत्रून् वि तिग्मेन वृषभेणा पुरोऽभेत् ।
सं वज्रेणासृजद् वृत्रमिन्द्रः प्र स्वां मतिमतिरच्छाशदानः॥
verses.tr: abhi sidhmo ajigādasya śatrūn vi tigmena vṛṣabheṇā puro'bhet saṃ vajreṇāsṛjad vṛtramindraḥ pra svāṃ matimatiracchāśadānaḥ
verses.en: Fierce on his enemies fell Indra's weapon: with. his sharp bull he rent their forts in pieces. He with his thunderbolt dealt blows on Vrtra; and conquered, executing all his purpose.

verses.sa:
आवः कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन् प्रावो युध्यन्तं वृषभं दशद्युम् ।
शफच्युतो रेणुर्नक्षत द्यामुच्छ्वैत्रेयो नृषाह्याय तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: āvaḥ kutsamindra yasmiñcākan prāvo yudhyantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ daśadyum śaphacyuto reṇurnakṣata dyāmucchvaitreyo nṛṣāhyāya tasthau
verses.en: Indra, thou helpest Kutsa whom thou lovedst, and guardedst brave Dagadyu when he battled, The dust of trampling horses rose to heaven, and Svitra's son stood up again for conquest.

verses.sa:
आवः शमं वृषभं तुग्सु क्षेत्रजेषे मघवञ्छ्वित्र्यं गाम् ।
ज्योक् चक्चि चिदत्र तस्थिवांसो अक्रञ्छत्रूयतामधरा वेदनाकः॥
verses.tr: āvaḥ śamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tugsu kṣetrajeṣe maghavañchvitryaṃ gām jyok cakci cidatra tasthivāṃso akrañchatrūyatāmadharā vedanākaḥ
verses.en: Svitra's mild steer, O Maghavan thou helpest in combat for the land, mid Tugra's houses. Long stood they there before the task was ended: thou wast the master of the foemen's treasure.

verses.sa:
त्रिश्चिन् नो अद्या भवतं नवेदसा विभुर्वां याम उत रातिरश्विना ।
युवोर्हि यन्त्रं हिम्येव वाससो ऽभ्यायंसेन्या भवतं मनीषिभिः॥
verses.tr: triścin no adyā bhavataṃ navedasā vibhurvāṃ yāma uta rātiraśvinā yuvorhi yantraṃ himyeva vāsaso 'bhyāyaṃsenyā bhavataṃ manīṣibhiḥ
verses.en: Ye who observe this day be with us even thrice: far-stretching is you bounty, Asvins and your course. To you, as to a cloak in winter, we cleave close: you are to be drawn nigh unto us by the wise.

verses.sa:
त्रयः पवयो मधुवाहने रथे सोमस्य वेनामनु विश्व इद् विदुः ।
त्रयः स्कम्भासः स्कभितास आरभे त्रिर्नक्तं याथस्त्रिर्वश्विना दिवा॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ pavayo madhuvāhane rathe somasya venāmanu viśva id viduḥ trayaḥ skambhāsaḥ skabhitāsa ārabhe trirnaktaṃ yāthastrirvaśvinā divā
verses.en: Three are the fellies in your honey-bearing car, that travels after Soma's loved one, as all know. Three are the pillars set upon it for support: thrice journey ye by night, O Asvins, thrice by day.

verses.sa:
समाने अहन् त्रिरवद्यगोहना त्रिरद्य यज्ञं मधुना मिमिक्षतम् ।
त्रिर्वाजवतीरिषो अश्विना युवं दोषा अस्मभ्यमुषसश्च पिन्वतम्॥
verses.tr: samāne ahan triravadyagohanā triradya yajñaṃ madhunā mimikṣatam trirvājavatīriṣo aśvinā yuvaṃ doṣā asmabhyamuṣasaśca pinvatam
verses.en: Thrice in the self-same day, ye Gods who banish want, sprinkle ye thrice to-day our sacrifice with meath; And thrice vouchsafe us store of food with plenteous strength, at evening, O ye Asvins, and at break of day.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातं त्रिरनुव्रते जने त्रिः सुप्राव्ये त्रेधेव शिक्षतम् ।
त्रिर्नान्द्यं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिः पृक्षो अस्मे अक्षरेव पिन्वतम्॥
verses.tr: trirvartiryātaṃ triranuvrate jane triḥ suprāvye tredheva śikṣatam trirnāndyaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ triḥ pṛkṣo asme akṣareva pinvatam
verses.en: Thrice come ye to our home, thrice to the righteous folk, thrice triply aid the man who well deserves your help. Thrice, O ye Asvins, bring us what shall make us glad; thrice send us store of food as nevermore to fail.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो रयिं वहतमश्विना युवं त्रिर्देवताता त्रिरुतावतं धियः ।
त्रिः सौभगत्वं त्रिरुत श्रवांसि नस् त्रिष्ठं वां सूरे दुहिता रुहद् रथम्॥
verses.tr: trirno rayiṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ trirdevatātā trirutāvataṃ dhiyaḥ triḥ saubhagatvaṃ triruta śravāṃsi nas triṣṭhaṃ vāṃ sūre duhitā ruhad ratham
verses.en: Thrice, O ye Asvins, bring to us abundant wealth: thrice in the Gods' assembly, thrice assist our thoughts. Thrice, grant ye us prosperity, thrice grant us fame; for the Sun's daughter hath mounted your three-wheeled car.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो अश्विना दिव्यानि भेषजा त्रिः पार्थिवानि त्रिरु दत्तमद्भ्यः ।
ओमानं शंयोर्ममकाय सूनव त्रिधातु शर्म वहतं शुभस्पती॥
verses.tr: trirno aśvinā divyāni bheṣajā triḥ pārthivāni triru dattamadbhyaḥ omānaṃ śaṃyormamakāya sūnava tridhātu śarma vahataṃ śubhaspatī
verses.en: Thrice, Asvins, grant to us the heavenly medicines, thrice those of earth and thrice those that the waters hold, Favour and health and strength bestow upon my son; triple protection, Lords of Splendour, grant to him.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्नो अश्विना यजता दिवेदिवे परि त्रिधातु पृथिवीमशायतम् ।
तिस्रो नासत्या रथ्या परावत आत्मेव वातः स्वसराणि गच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: trirno aśvinā yajatā divedive pari tridhātu pṛthivīmaśāyatam tisro nāsatyā rathyā parāvata ātmeva vātaḥ svasarāṇi gacchatam
verses.en: Thrice are ye to be worshipped day by day by us: thrice, O ye Asvins, ye travel around the earth. Car-borne from far away, O ye Nasatyas, come, like vital air to bodies, come ye to the three.

verses.sa:
त्रिरश्विना सिन्धुभिः सप्तमातृभिस्त्रय आहावास्त्रेधा हविष्कृतम् ।
तिस्रः पृथिवीरुपरि प्रवा दिवो नाकं रक्षेथे द्युभिरक्तुभिर्हितम्॥
verses.tr: triraśvinā sindhubhiḥ saptamātṛbhistraya āhāvāstredhā haviṣkṛtam tisraḥ pṛthivīrupari pravā divo nākaṃ rakṣethe dyubhiraktubhirhitam
verses.en: Thrice, O ye Asvins, with the Seven Mother Streams; three are the jars, the triple offering is prepared. Three are the worlds, and moving on above the sky ye guard the firm-set vault of heaven through days and nights.

verses.sa:
क्व१ त्री चक्रा त्रिवृतो रथस्य क्व१ त्रयो वन्धुरो ये सनीळाः ।
कदा योगो वाजिनो रासभस्य येन यज्ञं नासत्योपयाथः॥
verses.tr: kva1 trī cakrā trivṛto rathasya kva1 trayo vandhuro ye sanīḻāḥ kadā yogo vājino rāsabhasya yena yajñaṃ nāsatyopayāthaḥ
verses.en: Where are the three wheels of your triple chariot, where are the three seats thereto firmly fastened? When will ye yoke the mighty ass that draws it, to bring you to our sacrifice. Nasatyas?

verses.sa:
आ नासत्या गच्छतं हूयते हविर्मध्वः पिबतं मधुपेभिरासभिः ।
युवोर्हि पूर्वं सवितोषसो रथमृताय चित्रं घृतवन्तमिष्यति॥
verses.tr: ā nāsatyā gacchataṃ hūyate havirmadhvaḥ pibataṃ madhupebhirāsabhiḥ yuvorhi pūrvaṃ savitoṣaso rathamṛtāya citraṃ ghṛtavantamiṣyati
verses.en: Nasatyas, come: the sacred gift is offered up; drink the sweet juice with lips that know the sweetness well. Savitar sends, before the dawn of day, your car, fraught with oil, various-coloured, to our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ नासत्या त्रिभिरेकादशैरिह देवेभिर्यातं मधुपेयमश्विना ।
प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा॥
verses.tr: ā nāsatyā tribhirekādaśairiha devebhiryātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā
verses.en: Come, O Nasatyas, with the thrice-eleven Gods; come, O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath. Make long our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off our enemies; be with us evermore.

verses.sa:
आ नो अश्विना त्रिवृता रथेनाऽर्वाञ्चं रयिं वहतं सुवीरम् ।
शृण्वन्ता वामवसे जोहवीमि वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: ā no aśvinā trivṛtā rathenā'rvāñcaṃ rayiṃ vahataṃ suvīram śṛṇvantā vāmavase johavīmi vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau
verses.en: Borne in your triple car, O Asvins, bring us present prosperity with noble offspring. I cry to you who hear me for protection be ye our helpers where men win the booty.

verses.sa: ह्वयाम्यग्निं प्रथमं स्वस्तये ह्वयामि मित्रावरुणाविहावसे । ह्वयामि रात्रीं जगतो निवेशनीं ह्वयामि देवं सवितारमूतये॥
verses.tr: hvayāmyagniṃ prathamaṃ svastaye hvayāmi mitrāvaruṇāvihāvase hvayāmi rātrīṃ jagato niveśanīṃ hvayāmi devaṃ savitāramūtaye
verses.en: Agni I first invoke for our prosperity; I call on Mitra, Varuna, to aid us here. I call on Night who gives rest to all moving life; I call on Savitar the God to lend us help.

verses.sa:
आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च ।
हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेनाऽऽ देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā'' devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan
verses.en: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne in his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God who looks on every creature.

verses.sa:
याति देवः प्रवता यात्युद्वता याति शुभ्राभ्यां यजतो हरिभ्याम् ।
आ देवो याति सविता परावतो ऽप विश्वा दुरिता बाधमानः॥
verses.tr: yāti devaḥ pravatā yātyudvatā yāti śubhrābhyāṃ yajato haribhyām ā devo yāti savitā parāvato 'pa viśvā duritā bādhamānaḥ
verses.en: The God moves by the upward path, the downward; with two bright Bays, adorable, he journeys. Savitar comes, the God from the far distance, and chases from us all distress and sorrow.

verses.sa:
अभीवृतं कृशनैर्विश्वरूपं हिरण्यशम्यं यजतो बृहन्तम् ।
आस्थाद् रथं सविता चित्रभानुः कृष्णा रजांसि तविषीं दधानः॥
verses.tr: abhīvṛtaṃ kṛśanairviśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyaśamyaṃ yajato bṛhantam āsthād rathaṃ savitā citrabhānuḥ kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi taviṣīṃ dadhānaḥ
verses.en: His chariot decked with pearl, of various colours, lofty, with golden pole, the God hath mounted, The many-rayed One, Savitar the holy, bound, bearing power and might, for darksome regions.

verses.sa:
वि जनाञ्छ्यावाः शितिपादो अख्यन् रथं हिरण्यप्रउगं वहन्तः ।
शश्वद् विशः सवितुर्दैव्यस्योपस्थे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: vi janāñchyāvāḥ śitipādo akhyan rathaṃ hiraṇyapraugaṃ vahantaḥ śaśvad viśaḥ saviturdaivyasyopasthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: Drawing the gold-yoked car his Bays, white-footed, have manifested light to all the peoples. Held in the lap of Savitar, divine One, all men, all beings have their place for ever.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो द्यावः सवितुर्द्वा उपस्थाँ एका यमस्य भुवने विराषाट् ।
आणिं न रथ्यममृताधि तस्थुरिह ब्रवीतु य उ तच्चिकेतत्॥
verses.tr: tisro dyāvaḥ saviturdvā upasthāṃ ekā yamasya bhuvane virāṣāṭ āṇiṃ na rathyamamṛtādhi tasthuriha bravītu ya u tacciketat
verses.en: Three heavens there are; two Savitar's, adjacent: in Yama's world is one, the home of heroes, As on a linch-pin, firm, rest things immortal: he who hath known it let him here declare it.

verses.sa:
वि सुपर्णो अन्तरिक्षाण्यख्यद्ग गभीरवेपा असुरः सुनीथः ।
क्वे३दानीं सूर्यः कश्चिकेत कतमां द्यां रश्मिरस्या ततान॥
verses.tr: vi suparṇo antarikṣāṇyakhyadga gabhīravepā asuraḥ sunīthaḥ kve3dānīṃ sūryaḥ kaściketa katamāṃ dyāṃ raśmirasyā tatāna
verses.en: He, strong of wing, hath lightened up the regions, deep-quivering Asura, the gentle Leader. Where now is Surya, where is one to tell us to what celestial sphere his ray hath wandered?

verses.sa:
अष्टौ व्यख्यत् ककुभः पृथिव्यास् त्री धन्व योजना सप्त सिन्धून् ।
हिरण्याक्षः सविता देव आगाद् दधद्रत्ना दाशुषे वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: aṣṭau vyakhyat kakubhaḥ pṛthivyās trī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgād dadhadratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.en: The earth's eight points his brightness hath illumined, three desert regions and the Seven Rivers. God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving choice treasures unto him who worships.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिः सविता विचर्षणिरुभे द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरीयते ।
अपामीवां बाधते वेति सूर्यमभि कृष्णेन रजसा द्यामृणोति॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇirubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarīyate apāmīvāṃ bādhate veti sūryamabhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyāmṛṇoti
verses.en: The golden-handed Savitar, far-seeing, goes on his way between the earth and heaven, Drives away sickness, bids the Sun approach us, and spreads the bright sky through the darksome region.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यहस्तो असुरः सुनीथः सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् ।
अपसेधन् रक्षसो यातुधानानस्थाद् देवः प्रतिदोषं गृणानः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḻīkaḥ svavāṃ yātvarvāṅ apasedhan rakṣaso yātudhānānasthād devaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ
verses.en: May he, gold-handed Asura, kind Leader, come hither to us with his help and favour. Driving off Raksasas and Yatudhanas, the God is present, praised in hymns at evening.

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्थाः सवितः पूर्व्यासो ऽरेणवः सुकृता अन्तरिक्षे ।
तेभिर्नो अद्य पथिभिः सुगेभी रक्षा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देव॥
verses.tr: ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso 'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe tebhirno adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva
verses.en: O Savitar, thine ancient dustless pathways are well established in the air's mid-region: O God, come by those paths so fair to travel, preserve thou us from harm this day, and bless us.

verses.sa:
प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् ।
अग्निं सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिरीमहे यं सीमिदन्य ईळते॥
verses.tr: pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām agniṃ sūktebhirvacobhirīmahe yaṃ sīmidanya īḻate
verses.en: With words sent forth in holy hymns, Agni we supplicate, the Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others also praise.

verses.sa:
जनासो अग्निं दधिरे सहोवृधं हविष्मन्तो विधेम ते ।
स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना इहाविता भवा वाजेषु सन्त्य॥
verses.tr: janāso agniṃ dadhire sahovṛdhaṃ haviṣmanto vidhema te sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā ihāvitā bhavā vājeṣu santya
verses.en: Men have won Agni, him who makes their strength abound: we, with oblations, worship thee. Our gracious-minded Helper in our deeds of might, be thou, O Excellent, this day.

verses.sa:
प्र त्वा दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् ।
महस्ते सतो वि चरन्त्यर्चयो दिवि स्पृशन्ति भानवः॥
verses.tr: pra tvā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe hotāraṃ viśvavedasam mahaste sato vi carantyarcayo divi spṛśanti bhānavaḥ
verses.en: Thee for our messenger we choose, thee, the Omniscient, for our Priest. The flames of thee the mighty are spread wide around: thy splendour reaches to the sky.

verses.sa:
देवासस्त्वा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा सं दूतं प्रत्नमिन्धते ।
विश्वं सो अग्ने जयति त्वया धनं यस्ते ददाश मर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: devāsastvā varuṇo mitro aryamā saṃ dūtaṃ pratnamindhate viśvaṃ so agne jayati tvayā dhanaṃ yaste dadāśa martyaḥ
verses.en: The Gods enkindle thee their ancient messenger,--Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman. That mortal man, O Agni, gains through thee all wealth, who hath poured offerings unto thee.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रो होता गृहपतिरग्ने दूतो विशामसि ।
त्वे विश्वा संगतानि व्रता ध्रुवा यानि देवा अकृण्वत॥
verses.tr: mandro hotā gṛhapatiragne dūto viśāmasi tve viśvā saṃgatāni vratā dhruvā yāni devā akṛṇvata
verses.en: Thou, Agni, art a cheering Priest, Lord of the House, men's messenger: All constant high decrees established by the Gods, gathered together, meet in thee.

verses.sa:
त्वे इदग्ने सुभगे यविष्ठ्य विश्वमा हूयते हविः ।
स त्वं नो अद्य सुमना उतापरं यक्षि देवान्त्सुवीर्या॥
verses.tr: tve idagne subhage yaviṣṭhya viśvamā hūyate haviḥ sa tvaṃ no adya sumanā utāparaṃ yakṣi devāntsuvīryā
verses.en: In thee, the auspicious One, O Agni, youthfullest, each sacred gift is offered up: This day, and after, gracious, worship thou our Gods, that we may have heroic sons.

verses.sa:
तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते ।
होत्राभिरग्निं मनुषः समिन्धते तितिर्वांसो अति स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: taṃ ghemitthā namasvina upa svarājamāsate hotrābhiragniṃ manuṣaḥ samindhate titirvāṃso ati sridhaḥ
verses.en: To him in his own splendour bright draw near in worship the devout. Men kindle Agni with their sacrificial gifts, victorious o'er the enemies.

verses.sa:
घ्नन्तो वृत्रमतरन् रोदसी अप उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे ।
भुवत् कण्वे वृषा द्युम्न्याहुतः क्रन्ददश्वो गविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: ghnanto vṛtramataran rodasī apa uru kṣayāya cakrire bhuvat kaṇve vṛṣā dyumnyāhutaḥ krandadaśvo gaviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Vrtra they smote and slew, and made the earth and heaven and firmament a wide abode. The glorious Bull, invoked, hath stood at Kanva's side: loud neighed the Steed in frays for kine.

verses.sa:
सं सीदस्व महाँ असि शोचस्व देववीतमः ।
वि धूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ asi śocasva devavītamaḥ vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam
verses.en: Seat thee, for thou art mighty; shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा देवासो मनवे दधुरिह यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन ।
यं कण्वो मेध्यातिथिर्धनस्पृतं यं वृषा यमुपस्तुतः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā devāso manave dadhuriha yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana yaṃ kaṇvo medhyātithirdhanaspṛtaṃ yaṃ vṛṣā yamupastutaḥ
verses.en: Bearer of offerings, whom, best sacrificing Priest, the Gods for Manu's sake ordained; Whom Kanva, whom Medhyatithi made the source of wealth, and Vrsan and Upastuta.

verses.sa:
यमग्निं मेध्यातिथिः कण्व ईध ऋतादधि ।
तस्य प्रेषो दीदियुस्तमिमा ऋचस् तमग्निं वर्धयामसि॥
verses.tr: yamagniṃ medhyātithiḥ kaṇva īdha ṛtādadhi tasya preṣo dīdiyustamimā ṛcas tamagniṃ vardhayāmasi
verses.en: Him, Agni, whom Medhyatithi, whom Kanva kindled for his rite, Him these our songs of praise, him, Agni, we extol: his powers shine out preeminent.

verses.sa:
रायस्पूर्धि स्वधावोऽस्ति हि ते ऽग्ने देवेष्वाप्यम् ।
त्वं वाजस्य श्रुत्यस्य राजसि स नो मृळ महाँ असि॥
verses.tr: rāyaspūrdhi svadhāvo'sti hi te 'gne deveṣvāpyam tvaṃ vājasya śrutyasya rājasi sa no mṛḻa mahāṃ asi
verses.en: Make our wealth perfect thou, O Agni, Lord divine: for thou hast kinship with the Gods. Thou rulest as a King o'er widely-famous strength: be good to us, for thou art great.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता ।
ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे॥
verses.tr: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe
verses.en: Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God: Erect as strength-bestower we call aloud, with unguents and with priests, on thee.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्यंहसो नि केतुना विश्वं समत्रिणं दह ।
कृधी न ऊर्ध्वाञ्चरथाय जीवसे विदा देवेषु नो दुवः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo naḥ pāhyaṃhaso ni ketunā viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha kṛdhī na ūrdhvāñcarathāya jīvase vidā deveṣu no duvaḥ
verses.en: Erect, preserve us from sore trouble; with thy flame burn thou each ravening demon dead. Raise thou us up that we may walk and live: so thou shalt find our worship mid the Gods.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्ने रक्षसः पाहि धूर्तेरराव्णः ।
पाहि रीषत उत वा जिघांसतो बृहद्भानो यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: pāhi no agne rakṣasaḥ pāhi dhūrterarāvṇaḥ pāhi rīṣata uta vā jighāṃsato bṛhadbhāno yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: Preserve us, Agni, from the fiend, preserve us from malicious wrong. Save us from him who fain would injure us or slay, Most Youthful, thou with lofty light.

verses.sa:
घनेव विष्वग्वि जह्यराव्णस् तपुर्जम्भ यो अस्मध्रुक् ।
यो मर्त्यः शिशीते अत्यक्तुभिर्मा नः स रिपुरीशत॥
verses.tr: ghaneva viṣvagvi jahyarāvṇas tapurjambha yo asmadhruk yo martyaḥ śiśīte atyaktubhirmā naḥ sa ripurīśata
verses.en: Smite down as with a club, thou who hast fire for teeth, smite thou the wicked, right and left. Let not the man who plots against us in the night, nor any foe prevail o'er us.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वव्ने सुवीर्यमग्निः कण्वाय सौभगम् ।
अग्निः प्रावन् मित्रोत मेध्यातिथिमग्निः साता उपस्तुतम्॥
verses.tr: agnirvavne suvīryamagniḥ kaṇvāya saubhagam agniḥ prāvan mitrota medhyātithimagniḥ sātā upastutam
verses.en: Agni hath given heroic might to Kanva, and felicity: Agni hath helped our friends, hath helped Medhyatithi, hath helped Upastuta to win.

verses.sa:
अग्निना तुर्वशं यदुं परावत उग्रादेवं हवामहे ।
अग्निर्नयन्नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं तुर्वीतिं दस्यवे सहः॥
verses.tr: agninā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ parāvata ugrādevaṃ havāmahe agnirnayannavavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ turvītiṃ dasyave sahaḥ
verses.en: We call on Ugradeva, Yadu, Turvasa, by means of Agni, from afar; Agni, bring Navavastva and Brhadratha, Turviti, to subdue the foe.

verses.sa:
नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते ।
दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: ni tvāmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanāya śaśvate dīdetha kaṇva ṛtajāta ukṣito yaṃ namasyanti kṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Manu hath stablished thee a light, Agni, for all the race of men: Sprung from the Law, oil-fed, for Kanva hast thou blazed, thou whom the people reverence.

verses.sa:
त्वेषासो अग्नेरमवन्तो अर्चयो भीमासो न प्रतीतये ।
रक्षस्विनः सदमिद् यातुमावतो विश्वं समत्रिणं दह॥
verses.tr: tveṣāso agneramavanto arcayo bhīmāso na pratītaye rakṣasvinaḥ sadamid yātumāvato viśvaṃ samatriṇaṃ daha
verses.en: The flames of Agni full of splendour and of might are fearful, not to be approached. Consume for ever all demons and sorcerers, consume thou each devouring fiend.

verses.sa: क्रीळं वः शर्धो मारुतमनर्वाणं रथेशुभम् । कण्वा अभि प्र गायत॥
verses.tr: krīḻaṃ vaḥ śardho mārutamanarvāṇaṃ ratheśubham kaṇvā abhi pra gāyata
verses.en: Sing forth, O Kanvas, to your band of Maruts unassailable, Sporting, resplendent on their car

verses.sa: ये पृषतीभिर्ऋष्टिभिः साकं वाशीभिरञ्जिभिः । अजायन्त स्वभानवः॥
verses.tr: ye pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiḥ sākaṃ vāśībhirañjibhiḥ ajāyanta svabhānavaḥ
verses.en: They who, self-luminous, were born together, with the spotted deer, Spears, swords, and glittering ornaments.

verses.sa: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद् वदान् । नि यामञ्चित्रमृञ्जते॥
verses.tr: iheva śṛṇva eṣāṃ kaśā hasteṣu yad vadān ni yāmañcitramṛñjate
verses.en: One hears, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold They gather glory on their way.

verses.sa: प्र वः शर्धाय घृष्वये त्वेषद्युम्नाय शुष्मिणे । देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ śardhāya ghṛṣvaye tveṣadyumnāya śuṣmiṇe devattaṃ brahma gāyata
verses.en: Now sing ye forth the God-given hymn to your exultant Marut host, The fiercely-vigorous, the strong.

verses.sa: प्र शंसा गोष्वघ्न्यं क्रीळं यच्छर्धो मारुतम् । जम्भे रसस्य वावृधे॥
verses.tr: pra śaṃsā goṣvaghnyaṃ krīḻaṃ yacchardho mārutam jambhe rasasya vāvṛdhe
verses.en: Praise ye the Bull among the cows; for 'tis the Maruts' sportive band: It strengthened as it drank the rain.

verses.sa: को वो वर्षिष्ठ आ नरो दिवश्च ग्मश्च धूतयः । यत्सीमन्तं न धूनुथ॥
verses.tr: ko vo varṣiṣṭha ā naro divaśca gmaśca dhūtayaḥ yatsīmantaṃ na dhūnutha
verses.en: Who is your mightiest, Heroes, when, O shakers of the earth and heaven, Ye shake them like a garment's hem?

verses.sa: नि वो यामाय मानुषो दध्र उग्राय मन्यवे । जिहीत पर्वतो गिरिः॥
verses.tr: ni vo yāmāya mānuṣo dadhra ugrāya manyave jihīta parvato giriḥ
verses.en: At your approach man holds him down before the fury of your wrath: The rugged-jointed mountain yields.

verses.sa: येषामज्मेषु पृथिवी जुजुर्वाँ इव विश्पतिः । भिया यामेषु रेजते॥
verses.tr: yeṣāmajmeṣu pṛthivī jujurvāṃ iva viśpatiḥ bhiyā yāmeṣu rejate
verses.en: They at whose racings forth the earth, like an age-weakened lord of men, Trembles in terror on their ways.

verses.sa: स्थिरं हि जानमेषां वयो मातुर्निरेतवे । यत् सीमनु द्विता शवः॥
verses.tr: sthiraṃ hi jānameṣāṃ vayo māturniretave yat sīmanu dvitā śavaḥ
verses.en: Strong is their birth: vigour have they to issue from their Mother; strength, Yea, even twice enough, is theirs.

verses.sa: उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा अज्मेष्वत्नत । वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे॥
verses.tr: udu tye sūnavo giraḥ kāṣṭhā ajmeṣvatnata vāśrā abhijñu yātave
verses.en: And these, the Sons, the Singers, in their racings have enlarged the bounds, So that the kine must walk knee-deep.

verses.sa: त्यं चिद् घा दीर्घं पृथुं मिहो नपातममृध्रम् । प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cid ghā dīrghaṃ pṛthuṃ miho napātamamṛdhram pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ
verses.en: Before them, on the ways they go, they drop this offspring of the cloud, Long, broad, and inexhaustible.

verses.sa: मरुतो यद्ध वो बलं जनाँ अचुच्यवीतन । गिरीँरचुच्यवीतन॥
verses.tr: maruto yaddha vo balaṃ janāṃ acucyavītana girīṃracucyavītana
verses.en: O Maruts, as your strength is great, so have ye cast men down on earth, So have ye made the mountains fall.

verses.sa: यद्ध यान्ति मरुतः सं ह ब्रुवतेऽध्वन्ना । शृणोति कश्चिदेषाम्॥
verses.tr: yaddha yānti marutaḥ saṃ ha bruvate'dhvannā śṛṇoti kaścideṣām
verses.en: The while the Maruts pass along, they talk together on the way: Doth any hear them as they speak?

verses.sa: प्र यात शीभमाशुभिः सन्ति कण्वेषु वो दुवः । तत्रो षु मादयाध्वै॥
verses.tr: pra yāta śībhamāśubhiḥ santi kaṇveṣu vo duvaḥ tatro ṣu mādayādhvai
verses.en: Come quick with swift steeds, for ye have worshippers among Kanva's sons May you rejoice among them well.

verses.sa: अस्ति हि ष्मा मदाय वः स्मसि ष्मा वयमेषाम् । विश्वं चिदायुर्जीवसे॥
verses.tr: asti hi ṣmā madāya vaḥ smasi ṣmā vayameṣām viśvaṃ cidāyurjīvase
verses.en: All is prepared for your delight. We are their servants evermore, To live as long as life may last.

verses.sa: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियः पिता पुत्रं न हस्तयोः । दधिध्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः॥
verses.tr: kaddha nūnaṃ kadhapriyaḥ pitā putraṃ na hastayoḥ dadhidhve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
verses.en: What now? When will ye take us by both hands, as a dear sire his son, Gods, for whom sacred grass is clipped?

verses.sa: क्व नूनं कद् वो अर्थं गन्ता दिवो न पृथिव्याः । क्व वो गावो न रण्यन्ति॥
verses.tr: kva nūnaṃ kad vo arthaṃ gantā divo na pṛthivyāḥ kva vo gāvo na raṇyanti
verses.en: Now whither? To what goal of yours go ye in heaven, and not on earth? Where do your cows disport themselves?

verses.sa: क्व वः सुम्ना नव्यांसि मरुतः क्व सुविता । क्वो३ विश्वानि सौभगा॥
verses.tr: kva vaḥ sumnā navyāṃsi marutaḥ kva suvitā kvo3 viśvāni saubhagā
verses.en: Where are your newest favours shown? Where, Maruts, your prosperity? Where all your high felicities?

verses.sa: यद् यूयं पृश्निमातरो मर्तासः स्यातन । स्तोता वो अमृतः स्यात्॥
verses.tr: yad yūyaṃ pṛśnimātaro martāsaḥ syātana stotā vo amṛtaḥ syāt
verses.en: If, O ye Maruts, ye the Sons whom Prsni bore, were mortal, and Immortal he who sings your praise.

verses.sa: मा वो मृगो न यवसे जरिता भूदजोष्यः । पथा यमस्य गादुप॥
verses.tr: mā vo mṛgo na yavase jaritā bhūdajoṣyaḥ pathā yamasya gādupa
verses.en: Then never were your praiser loathed like a wild beast in pasture-land, Nor should he go on Yama's path.

verses.sa: मो षु णः परापरा निऋतिर्दुर्हणा वधीत् । पदीष्ट तृष्णया सह॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu ṇaḥ parāparā niṛtirdurhaṇā vadhīt padīṣṭa tṛṣṇayā saha
verses.en: Let not destructive plague on plague hard to be conquered, strike its down: Let each, with drought, depart from us.

verses.sa: सत्यं त्वेषा अमवन्तो धन्वञ्चिदा रुद्रियासः । मिहं कृण्वन्त्यवाताम्॥
verses.tr: satyaṃ tveṣā amavanto dhanvañcidā rudriyāsaḥ mihaṃ kṛṇvantyavātām
verses.en: Truly, they the fierce and mighty Sons of Rudra send their windless Rain e'en on the desert places.

verses.sa: वाश्रेव विद्युन्मिमाति वत्सं न माता सिषक्ति । यदेषां वृष्टिरसर्जि॥
verses.tr: vāśreva vidyunmimāti vatsaṃ na mātā siṣakti yadeṣāṃ vṛṣṭirasarji
verses.en: Like a cow the lightning lows and follows, motherlike, her youngling, When their rain-flood hath been loosened.

verses.sa: दिवा चित्तमः कृण्वन्ति पर्जन्येनोदवाहेन । यत्पृथिवीं व्युन्दन्ति॥
verses.tr: divā cittamaḥ kṛṇvanti parjanyenodavāhena yatpṛthivīṃ vyundanti
verses.en: When they inundate the earth they spread forth darkness e'en in day time, With the water-laden rain-cloud.

verses.sa: अध स्वनान्मरुतां विश्वमा सद्म पार्थिवम् । अरेजन्त प्र मानुषाः॥
verses.tr: adha svanānmarutāṃ viśvamā sadma pārthivam arejanta pra mānuṣāḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, at your voice's sound this earthly habitation shakes, And each man reels who dwells therein.

verses.sa: मरुतो वीळुपाणिभिश् चित्रा रोधस्वतीरनु । यातेमखिद्रयामभिः॥
verses.tr: maruto vīḻupāṇibhiś citrā rodhasvatīranu yātemakhidrayāmabhiḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, with your strong-hoofed steeds, unhindered in their courses, haste Along the bright embanked streams.

verses.sa: स्थिरा वः सन्तु नेमयो रथा अश्वास एषाम् । सुसंस्कृता अभीशवः॥
verses.tr: sthirā vaḥ santu nemayo rathā aśvāsa eṣām susaṃskṛtā abhīśavaḥ
verses.en: Firm be the fellies of your wheels, steady your horses and your cars, And may your reins be fashioned well.

verses.sa: अच्छा वदा तना गिरा जरायै ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् । अग्निं मित्रं न दर्शतम्॥
verses.tr: acchā vadā tanā girā jarāyai brahmaṇaspatim agniṃ mitraṃ na darśatam
verses.en: Invite thou hither with this song, for praise, Agni the Lord of Prayer, Him who is fair as Mitra is.

verses.sa: मिमीहि श्लोकमास्ये पर्जन्य इव ततनः । गाय गायत्रमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: mimīhi ślokamāsye parjanya iva tatanaḥ gāya gāyatramukthyam
verses.en: Form in thy mouth the hymn of praise expand thee like, a rainy cloud Sing forth the measured eulogy.

verses.sa: वन्दस्व मारुतं गणं त्वेषं पनस्युमर्किणम् । अस्मे वृद्धा असन्निह॥
verses.tr: vandasva mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumarkiṇam asme vṛddhā asanniha
verses.en: Sing glory to the Marut host, praiseworthy, tuneful, vigorous: Here let the Strong Ones dwell with us.

verses.sa:
प्र यदित्था परावतः शोचिर्न मानमस्यथ ।
कस्य क्रत्वा मरुतः कस्य वर्पसा कं याथ कं ह धूतयः॥
verses.tr: pra yaditthā parāvataḥ śocirna mānamasyatha kasya kratvā marutaḥ kasya varpasā kaṃ yātha kaṃ ha dhūtayaḥ
verses.en: When thus, like flame, from far away, Maruts, ye cast your measure forth, To whom go Ye, to whom, O shakers of the earth, moved by whose wisdom, whose design?

verses.sa:
स्थिरा वः सन्त्वायुधा पराणुदे वीळू उत प्रतिष्कभे ।
युष्माकमस्तु तविषी पनीयसी मा मर्त्यस्य मायिनः॥
verses.tr: sthirā vaḥ santvāyudhā parāṇude vīḻū uta pratiṣkabhe yuṣmākamastu taviṣī panīyasī mā martyasya māyinaḥ
verses.en: Strong let your weapons be to drive away your foes, firm for resistance let them be. Yea, passing glorious must be your warrior might, not as a guileful mortal's strength.

verses.sa:
परा ह यत् स्थिरं हथ नरो वर्तयथा गुरु ।
वि याथन वनिनः पृथिव्या व्याशाः पर्वतानाम्॥
verses.tr: parā ha yat sthiraṃ hatha naro vartayathā guru vi yāthana vaninaḥ pṛthivyā vyāśāḥ parvatānām
verses.en: When what is strong ye overthrow, and whirl about each ponderous thing, Heroes, your course is through the forest trees of earth, and through the fissures of the rocks.

verses.sa:
नहि वः शत्रुर्विविदे अधि द्यवि न भूम्यां रिशादसः ।
युष्माकमस्तु तविषी तना युजा रुद्रासो नू चिदाधृषे॥
verses.tr: nahi vaḥ śatrurvivide adhi dyavi na bhūmyāṃ riśādasaḥ yuṣmākamastu taviṣī tanā yujā rudrāso nū cidādhṛṣe
verses.en: Consumers of your foes, no enemy of yours is found in heaven or on the earth: Ye Rudras, may the strength, held in this bond, be yours, to bid defiance even now.

verses.sa:
प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान्वि विञ्चन्ति वनस्पतीन् ।
प्रो आरत मरुतो दुर्मदा इव देवासः सर्वया विशा॥
verses.tr: pra vepayanti parvatānvi viñcanti vanaspatīn pro ārata maruto durmadā iva devāsaḥ sarvayā viśā
verses.en: They make the mountains rock and reel, they rend the forest-kings apart. Onward, ye Maruts, drive, like creatures drunk with wine, ye, Gods with all your company.

verses.sa:
उपो रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः ।
आ वो यामाय पृथिवी चिदश्रोदबीभयन्त मानुषाः॥
verses.tr: upo ratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ praṣṭirvahati rohitaḥ ā vo yāmāya pṛthivī cidaśrodabībhayanta mānuṣāḥ
verses.en: Ye to your chariot have yoked the spotted deer: a red deer, as a leader, draws. Even the Earth herself listened as ye came near, and men were sorely terrified.

verses.sa:
आ वो मक्षू तनाय कं रुद्रा अवो वृणीमहे ।
गन्ता नूनं नोऽवसा यथा पुरेत्था कण्वाय बिभ्युषे॥
verses.tr: ā vo makṣū tanāya kaṃ rudrā avo vṛṇīmahe gantā nūnaṃ no'vasā yathā puretthā kaṇvāya bibhyuṣe
verses.en: O Rudras, quickly we desire your succour for this work of ours. Come to us with your aid as in the days of old, so now for frightened Kanva's sake.

verses.sa:
युष्मेषितो मरुतो मर्त्येषित आ यो नो अभ्व ईषते ।
वि तं युयोत शवसा व्योजसा वि युष्माकाभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: yuṣmeṣito maruto martyeṣita ā yo no abhva īṣate vi taṃ yuyota śavasā vyojasā vi yuṣmākābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Should any monstrous foe, O Maruts, sent by you or sent by mortals threaten us, Tear ye him from us with your power and with your might, and with the succours that are yours.

verses.sa:
असामि हि प्रयज्यवः कण्वं दद प्रचेतसः ।
असामिभिर्मरुत आ न ऊतिभिर्गन्ता वृष्टिं न विद्युतः॥
verses.tr: asāmi hi prayajyavaḥ kaṇvaṃ dada pracetasaḥ asāmibhirmaruta ā na ūtibhirgantā vṛṣṭiṃ na vidyutaḥ
verses.en: For ye, the worshipful and wise, have guarded Kanva perfectly. O Maruts, come to us with full protecting help, as lightning flashes seek the rain.

verses.sa:
असाम्योजो बिभृथा सुदानवो ऽसामि धूतयः शवः ।
ऋषिद्विषे मरुतः परिमन्यव इषुं न सृजत द्विषम्॥
verses.tr: asāmyojo bibhṛthā sudānavo 'sāmi dhūtayaḥ śavaḥ ṛṣidviṣe marutaḥ parimanyava iṣuṃ na sṛjata dviṣam
verses.en: Whole strength have ye, O Bounteous Ones; perfect, earth-shakers, is your might. Maruts, against the poet's wrathful enemy send ye an enemy like a dart.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवयन्तस्त्वेमहे ।
उप प्र यन्तु मरुतः सुदानव इन्द्र प्राशूर्भवा सचा॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā
verses.en: O BRAMANASPATI, stand up: God-serving men we pray to thee. May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra, most swift, be thou with them.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि सहसस्पुत्र मर्त्य उपब्रूते धने हिते ।
सुवीर्यं मरुत आ स्वश्व्यं दधीत यो व आचके॥
verses.tr: tvāmiddhi sahasasputra martya upabrūte dhane hite suvīryaṃ maruta ā svaśvyaṃ dadhīta yo va ācake
verses.en: O Son of Strength, each mortal calls to thee for aid when spoil of battle waits for him. O Maruts, may this man who loves you well obtain wealth of good steeds and hero might.

verses.sa:
प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता ।
अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ
verses.en: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may Sunrta the Goddess come, And Gods bring to this rite which gives the five-fold gift the Hero, lover of mankind.

verses.sa:
यो वाघते ददाति सूनरं वसु स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः ।
तस्मा इळां सुवीरामा यजामहे सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम्॥
verses.tr: yo vāghate dadāti sūnaraṃ vasu sa dhatte akṣiti śravaḥ tasmā iḻāṃ suvīrāmā yajāmahe supratūrtimanehasam
verses.en: He who bestows a noble guerdon on the priest wins fame that never shall decay. For him we offer sacred hero-giving food, peerless and conquering easily.

verses.sa:
प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम् ।
यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे॥
verses.tr: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire
verses.en: Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn of praise, Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods, have made their dwelling place.

verses.sa:
तमिद् वोचेमा विदथेषु शम्भुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् ।
इमां च वाचं प्रतिहर्यथा नरो विश्वेद् वामा वो अश्नवत्॥
verses.tr: tamid vocemā vidatheṣu śambhuvaṃ mantraṃ devā anehasam imāṃ ca vācaṃ pratiharyathā naro viśved vāmā vo aśnavat
verses.en: May we in holy synods, Gods! recite that hymn, peerless, that brings felicity. If you, O Heroes, graciously accept this word, may it obtain all bliss from you.

verses.sa:
को देवयन्तमश्नवज् जनं को वृक्तबर्हिषम् ।
प्रप्र दाश्वान् पस्त्याभिरस्थितान्तर्वावत् क्षयं दधे॥
verses.tr: ko devayantamaśnavaj janaṃ ko vṛktabarhiṣam prapra dāśvān pastyābhirasthitāntarvāvat kṣayaṃ dadhe
verses.en: Who shall approach the pious? who the man whose sacred grass is trimmed? The offerer with his folk advances more and more: he fills his house with precious things.

verses.sa:
उप क्षत्रं पृञ्चीत हन्ति राजभिर्भये चित् सुक्षितिं दधे ।
नास्य वर्ता न तरुता महाधने नार्भे अस्ति वज्रिणः॥
verses.tr: upa kṣatraṃ pṛñcīta hanti rājabhirbhaye cit sukṣitiṃ dadhe nāsya vartā na tarutā mahādhane nārbhe asti vajriṇaḥ
verses.en: He amplifies his lordly might, with kings he slays: e'en mid alarms he dwells secure In great or lesser fight none checks him, none subdues,--the wielder of the thunderbolt.

verses.sa: यं रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । नू चित्स दभ्यते जनः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ rakṣanti pracetaso varuṇo mitro aryamā nū citsa dabhyate janaḥ
verses.en: Ne'ER is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, The excellently wise, protect.

verses.sa: यं बाहुतेव पिप्रति पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः । अरिष्टः सर्व एधते॥
verses.tr: yaṃ bāhuteva piprati pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ ariṣṭaḥ sarva edhate
verses.en: He prospers ever, free from scathe, whom they, as with full hands, enrich, Whom they preserve from every foe.

verses.sa: वि दुर्गा वि द्विषः पुरो घ्नन्ति राजान एषाम् । नयन्ति दुरिता तिरः॥
verses.tr: vi durgā vi dviṣaḥ puro ghnanti rājāna eṣām nayanti duritā tiraḥ
verses.en: The Kings drive far away from him his troubles and his enemies, And lead him safely o'er distress.

verses.sa: सुगः पन्था अनृक्षर आदित्यास ऋतं यते । नात्रावखादो अस्ति वः॥
verses.tr: sugaḥ panthā anṛkṣara ādityāsa ṛtaṃ yate nātrāvakhādo asti vaḥ
verses.en: Thornless, Adityas, is the path, easy for him who seeks the Law: With him is naught to anger you.

verses.sa: यं यज्ञं नयथा नर आदित्या ऋजुना पथा । प्र वः स धीतये नशत्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ yajñaṃ nayathā nara ādityā ṛjunā pathā pra vaḥ sa dhītaye naśat
verses.en: What sacrifice, Adityas, ye Heroes guide by the path direct,-- May that come nigh unto your thought.

verses.sa: स रत्नं मर्त्यो वसु विश्वं तोकमुत त्मना । अच्छा गच्छत्यस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: sa ratnaṃ martyo vasu viśvaṃ tokamuta tmanā acchā gacchatyastṛtaḥ
verses.en: That mortal, ever unsubdued, gains wealth and every precious thing, And children also of his own.

verses.sa: कथा राधाम सखायः स्तोमं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । महि प्सरो वरुणस्य॥
verses.tr: kathā rādhāma sakhāyaḥ stomaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ mahi psaro varuṇasya
verses.en: How, my friends, shall we prepare Aryaman's and Mitra's laud, Glorious food of Varuna?

verses.sa: मा वो घ्नन्तं मा शपन्तं प्रति वोचे देवयन्तम् । सुम्नैरिद् व आ विवासे॥
verses.tr: mā vo ghnantaṃ mā śapantaṃ prati voce devayantam sumnairid va ā vivāse
verses.en: I point not out to you a man who strikes the pious, or reviles: Only with hymns I call you nigh.

verses.sa: चतुरश्चिद् ददमानाद् बिभीयादा निधातोः । न दुरुक्ताय स्पृहयेत्॥
verses.tr: caturaścid dadamānād bibhīyādā nidhātoḥ na duruktāya spṛhayet
verses.en: Let him not love to speak ill words: but fear the One who holds all four Within his hand, until they fall.

verses.sa: सं पूषन्नध्वनस्तिर व्यंहो विमुचो नपात् । सक्ष्वा देव प्र णस्पुरः॥
verses.tr: saṃ pūṣannadhvanastira vyaṃho vimuco napāt sakṣvā deva pra ṇaspuraḥ
verses.en: Shorten our ways, O Pusan, move aside obstruction in the path: Go close before us, cloud-born God.

verses.sa: यो नः पूषन्नघो वृको दुःशेव आदिदेशति । अप स्म तं पथो जहि॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ pūṣannagho vṛko duḥśeva ādideśati apa sma taṃ patho jahi
verses.en: Drive, Pusan, from our road the wolf, the wicked inauspicious wolf, Who lies in wait to injure us.

verses.sa: अप त्यं परिपन्थिनं मुषीवाणं हुरश्चितम् । दूरमधि स्रुतेरज॥
verses.tr: apa tyaṃ paripanthinaṃ muṣīvāṇaṃ huraścitam dūramadhi sruteraja
verses.en: Who lurks about the path we take, the robber with a guileful heart: Far from the road chase him away.

verses.sa: त्वं तस्य द्वयाविनो ऽघशंसस्य कस्य चित् । पदाभि तिष्ठ तपुषिम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tasya dvayāvino 'ghaśaṃsasya kasya cit padābhi tiṣṭha tapuṣim
verses.en: Tread with thy foot and trample out the firebrand of the wicked one, The double-tongued, whoe'er he be.

verses.sa: आ तत्ते दस्र मन्तुमः पूषन्नवो वृणीमहे । येन पितॄनचोदयः॥
verses.tr: ā tatte dasra mantumaḥ pūṣannavo vṛṇīmahe yena pitṝnacodayaḥ
verses.en: Wise Pusan, Wonder-Worker, we claim of thee now the aid wherewith Thou furtheredst our sires of old.

verses.sa: अधा नो विश्वसौभग हिरण्यवाशीमत्तम । धनानि सुषणा कृधि॥
verses.tr: adhā no viśvasaubhaga hiraṇyavāśīmattama dhanāni suṣaṇā kṛdhi
verses.en: So, Lord of all prosperity, best wielder of the golden sword, Make riches easy to be won.

verses.sa: अति नः सश्चतो नय सुगा नः सुपथा कृणु । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः॥
verses.tr: ati naḥ saścato naya sugā naḥ supathā kṛṇu pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ
verses.en: Past all pursuers lead us, make pleasant our path and fair to tread: O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa: अभि सूयवसं नय न नवज्वारो अध्वने । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः॥
verses.tr: abhi sūyavasaṃ naya na navajvāro adhvane pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ
verses.en: Lead us to meadows rich in grass: send on our way no early heat: O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa: शग्धि पूर्धि प्र यंसि च शिशीहि प्रास्युदरम् । पूषन्निह क्रतुं विदः॥
verses.tr: śagdhi pūrdhi pra yaṃsi ca śiśīhi prāsyudaram pūṣanniha kratuṃ vidaḥ
verses.en: Be gracious to us, fill us full, give, feed us, and invigorate: O Pusan, find thou power for this.

verses.sa: न पूषणं मेथामसि सूक्तैरभि गृणीमसि । वसूनि दस्ममीमहे॥
verses.tr: na pūṣaṇaṃ methāmasi sūktairabhi gṛṇīmasi vasūni dasmamīmahe
verses.en: No blame have we for Pusan; him we magnify with songs of praise: We seek the Mighty One for wealth.

verses.sa: कद् रुद्राय प्रचेतसे मीह्ळुष्टमाय तव्यसे । वोचेम शंतमं हृदे॥
verses.tr: kad rudrāya pracetase mīhḻuṣṭamāya tavyase vocema śaṃtamaṃ hṛde
verses.en: What shall we sing to Rudra, strong, most bounteous, excellently wise, That shall be dearest to his heart?

verses.sa: यथा नो अदितिः करत् पश्वे नृभ्यो यथा गवे । यथा तोकाय रुद्रियम्॥
verses.tr: yathā no aditiḥ karat paśve nṛbhyo yathā gave yathā tokāya rudriyam
verses.en: That Aditi may grant the grace of Rudra to our folk, our kine, Our cattle and our progeny;

verses.sa: यथा नो मित्रो वरुणो यथा रुद्रश्चिकेतति । यथा विश्वे सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: yathā no mitro varuṇo yathā rudraściketati yathā viśve sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: That Mitra and that Varuna, that Rudra may remember us, Yea, all the Gods with one accord.

verses.sa: गाथपतिं मेधपतिं रुद्रं जलाषभेषजम् । तच्छंयोः सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: gāthapatiṃ medhapatiṃ rudraṃ jalāṣabheṣajam tacchaṃyoḥ sumnamīmahe
verses.en: To Rudra Lord of sacrifice, of hymns and balmy medicines, We pray for joy and health and strength.

verses.sa: यः शुक्र इव सूर्यो हिरण्यमिव रोचते । श्रेष्ठो देवानां वसुः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śukra iva sūryo hiraṇyamiva rocate śreṣṭho devānāṃ vasuḥ
verses.en: He shines in splendour like the Sun, refulgent as bright gold is he, The good, the best among the Gods.

verses.sa: शं नः करत्यर्वते सुगं मेषाय मेष्ये । नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो गवे॥
verses.tr: śaṃ naḥ karatyarvate sugaṃ meṣāya meṣye nṛbhyo nāribhyo gave
verses.en: May he grant health into our steeds, wellbeing to our rams and ewes, To men, to women, and to kine.

verses.sa: अस्मे सोम श्रियमधि नि धेहि शतस्य नृणाम् । महि श्रवस्तुविनृम्णम्॥
verses.tr: asme soma śriyamadhi ni dhehi śatasya nṛṇām mahi śravastuvinṛmṇam
verses.en: O Soma, set thou upon us the glory of a hundred men, The great renown of mighty chiefs.

verses.sa: मा नः सोमपरिबाधो मारातयो जुहुरन्त । आ न इन्दो वाजे भज॥
verses.tr: mā naḥ somaparibādho mārātayo juhuranta ā na indo vāje bhaja
verses.en: Let not malignities, nor those who trouble Soma, hinder us. Indu, give us a share of strength.

verses.sa:
यास्ते प्रजा अमृतस्य परस्मिन्धामन्नृतस्य ।
मूर्धा नाभा सोम वेन आभूषन्तीः सोम वेदः॥
verses.tr: yāste prajā amṛtasya parasmindhāmannṛtasya mūrdhā nābhā soma vena ābhūṣantīḥ soma vedaḥ
verses.en: Soma! head, central point, love these; Soma! know these as serving thee, Children of thee Immortal, at the highest place of holy law.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश् चित्रं राधो अमर्त्य ।
आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाँ उषर्बुधः॥
verses.tr: agne vivasvaduṣasaś citraṃ rādho amartya ā dāśuṣe jātavedo vahā tvamadyā devāṃ uṣarbudhaḥ
verses.en: Immortal Jatavedas, thou many-hued fulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनो ऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ।
सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत्॥
