verses.tr: juṣṭo hi dūto asi havyavāhano 'gne rathīradhvarāṇām sajūraśvibhyāmuṣasā suvīryamasme dhehi śravo bṛhat
verses.en: For thou art offering-bearer and loved messenger, the charioteer of sacrifice: Accordant with the Asvins and with Dawn grant us heroic strength and lofty fame.

verses.sa:
अद्या दूतं वृणीमहे वसुमग्निं पुरुप्रियम् ।
धूमकेतुं भाऋजीकं व्युष्टिषु यज्ञानामध्वरश्रियम्॥
verses.tr: adyā dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe vasumagniṃ purupriyam dhūmaketuṃ bhāṛjīkaṃ vyuṣṭiṣu yajñānāmadhvaraśriyam
verses.en: As messenger we choose to-day Agni the good whom many love, Smoke-bannered spreader of the light, at break of day glory of sacrificial rites.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठं यविष्ठमतिथिं स्वाहुतं जुष्टं जनाय दाशुषे ।
देवाँ अच्छा यातवे जातवेदसमग्निमीळे व्युष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭhaṃ yaviṣṭhamatithiṃ svāhutaṃ juṣṭaṃ janāya dāśuṣe devāṃ acchā yātave jātavedasamagnimīḻe vyuṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Him noblest and most youthful, richly worshipped guest, dear to the men who offer gifts, Him, Agni Jatavedas, I beseech at dawn that he may bring the Gods to us.

verses.sa:
स्तविष्यामि त्वामहं विश्वस्यामृत भोजन ।
अग्ने त्रातारममृतं मियेध्य यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहन॥
verses.tr: staviṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ viśvasyāmṛta bhojana agne trātāramamṛtaṃ miyedhya yajiṣṭhaṃ havyavāhana
verses.en: Thee, Agni, will I glorify, deathless nourisher of the world, Immortal, offering-bearer, meet for sacred food, preserver, best at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सुशंसो बोधि गृणते यविष्ठ्य मधुजिह्वः स्वाहुतः ।
प्रस्कण्वस्य प्रतिरन्नायुर्जीवसे नमस्या दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: suśaṃso bodhi gṛṇate yaviṣṭhya madhujihvaḥ svāhutaḥ praskaṇvasya pratirannāyurjīvase namasyā daivyaṃ janam
verses.en: Tell good things to thy praiser, O most youthful God, as richly worshipped, honey-tongued, And, granting to Praskanva lengthened days of life, show honour to the Heavenly Host.

verses.sa:
होतारं विश्ववेदसं सं हि त्वा विश इन्धते ।
स आ वह पुरुहूत प्रचेतसो ऽग्ने देवाँ इह द्रवत्॥
verses.tr: hotāraṃ viśvavedasaṃ saṃ hi tvā viśa indhate sa ā vaha puruhūta pracetaso 'gne devāṃ iha dravat
verses.en: For the men, Agni, kindle thee as all possessor and as Priest; So Agni, much-invoked, bring hither with all speed the Gods, the excellently wise,

verses.sa:
सवितारमुषसमश्विना भगमग्निं व्युष्टिषु क्षपः ।
कण्वासस्त्वा सुतसोमास इन्धते हव्यवाहं स्वध्वर॥
verses.tr: savitāramuṣasamaśvinā bhagamagniṃ vyuṣṭiṣu kṣapaḥ kaṇvāsastvā sutasomāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ svadhvara
verses.en: At dawn of day, at night, Usas and Savitar, the Asvins, Bhaga, Agni's self: Skilled in fair rites, with Soma poured, the Kanvas light thee, the oblation-wafting God.

verses.sa:
पतिर्ह्यध्वराणामग्ने दूतो विशामसि ।
उषर्बुध आ वह सोमपीतये देवाँ अद्य स्वर्दृशः॥
verses.tr: patirhyadhvarāṇāmagne dūto viśāmasi uṣarbudha ā vaha somapītaye devāṃ adya svardṛśaḥ
verses.en: For, Agni, Lord of sacrifice and messenger of men art thou: Bring thou the Gods who wake at dawn who see the light, this day to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पूर्वा अनूषसो विभावसो दीदेथ विश्वदर्शतः ।
असि ग्रामेष्वविता पुरोहितो ऽसि यज्ञेषु मानुषः॥
verses.tr: agne pūrvā anūṣaso vibhāvaso dīdetha viśvadarśataḥ asi grāmeṣvavitā purohito 'si yajñeṣu mānuṣaḥ
verses.en: Thou shonest forth, O Agni, after former dawns, all visible, O rich in light. Thou art our help in battle-strife, the Friend of man, the great high priest in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा यज्ञस्य साधनमग्ने होतारमृत्विजम् ।
मनुष्वद् देव धीमहि प्रचेतसं जीरं दूतममर्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: ni tvā yajñasya sādhanamagne hotāramṛtvijam manuṣvad deva dhīmahi pracetasaṃ jīraṃ dūtamamartyam
verses.en: Like Manu, we will stablish thee, Agni, performer of the rite, Invoker, ministering Priest, exceeding wise, the swift immortal messenger.

verses.sa:
यद् देवानां मित्रमहः पुरोहितो ऽन्तरो यासि दूत्यम् ।
सिन्धोरिव प्रस्वनितास ऊर्मयो ऽग्नेर्भ्राजन्ते अर्चयः॥
verses.tr: yad devānāṃ mitramahaḥ purohito 'ntaro yāsi dūtyam sindhoriva prasvanitāsa ūrmayo 'gnerbhrājante arcayaḥ
verses.en: When as the Gods' High Priest, by many loved, thou dost their mission as their nearest Friend, Then, like the far-resounding billows of the flood, thy flames, O Agni, roar aloud.

verses.sa:
श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः ।
आ सीदन्तु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावाणो अध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram
verses.en: Hear, Agni, who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods; Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
शृण्वन्तु स्तोमं मरुतः सुदानवो ऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः ।
पिबतु सोमं वरुणो धृतव्रतो ऽश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः॥
verses.tr: śṛṇvantu stomaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo 'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ pibatu somaṃ varuṇo dhṛtavrato 'śvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ
verses.en: Let those who strengthen Law, who bountifully give, the life-tongued Maruts, hear our praise. May Law-supporting Varuna with the Asvins twain and Usas, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने वसूँरिह रुद्राँ आदित्याँ उत । यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम्॥
verses.tr: tvamagne vasūṃriha rudrāṃ ādityāṃ uta yajā svadhvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam
verses.en: Worship the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras, the Adityas, all Who spring from Manu, those who know fair rites, who pour their blessings down.

verses.sa: श्रुष्टीवानो हि दाशुषे देवा अग्ने विचेतसः । तान् रोहिदश्व गिर्वणस् त्रयस्त्रिंशतमा वह॥
verses.tr: śruṣṭīvāno hi dāśuṣe devā agne vicetasaḥ tān rohidaśva girvaṇas trayastriṃśatamā vaha
verses.en: Agni, the Gods who understand give ear unto the worshipper: Lord of Red Steeds, who lovest song, bring thou those Three-and-Thirty Gods.

verses.sa: प्रियमेधवदत्रिवज् जातवेदो विरूपवत् । अङ्गिरस्वन्महिव्रत प्रस्कण्वस्य श्रुधी हवम्॥
verses.tr: priyamedhavadatrivaj jātavedo virūpavat aṅgirasvanmahivrata praskaṇvasya śrudhī havam
verses.en: O Jatavedas, great in act, hearken thou to Praskanva's call, As Priyamedha erst was heard, Atri, Virupa, Angiras.

verses.sa: महिकेरव ऊतये प्रियमेधा अहूषत । राजन्तमध्वराणामग्निं शुक्रेण शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: mahikerava ūtaye priyamedhā ahūṣata rājantamadhvarāṇāmagniṃ śukreṇa śociṣā
verses.en: The sons of Priyamedha skilled in lofty praise have called for help On Agni who with fulgent flame is Ruler of all holy rites.

verses.sa: घृताहवन सन्त्येमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः । याभिः कण्वस्य सूनवो हवन्तेऽवसे त्वा॥
verses.tr: ghṛtāhavana santyemā u ṣu śrudhī giraḥ yābhiḥ kaṇvasya sūnavo havante'vase tvā
verses.en: Hear thou, invoked with holy oil, bountiful giver of rewards, These eulogies, whereby the sons of Kanva call thee to their aid.

verses.sa: त्वां चित्रश्रवस्तम हवन्ते विक्षु जन्तवः । शोचिष्केशं पुरुप्रियाग्ने हव्याय वोह्ळवे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ śociṣkeśaṃ purupriyāgne havyāya vohḻave
verses.en: O Agni, loved by many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame, to be the bearer of their gifts.

verses.sa: नि त्वा होतारमृत्विजं दधिरे वसुवित्तमम् । श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं विप्रा अग्ने दिविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: ni tvā hotāramṛtvijaṃ dadhire vasuvittamam śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ viprā agne diviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Thee, Agni, best to find out wealth, most widely famous, quick to hear, Singers have stablished in their rites Herald and ministering Priest.

verses.sa: आ त्वा विप्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतसोमा अभि प्रयः । बृहद् भा बिभ्रतो हविरग्ने मर्ताय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: ā tvā viprā acucyavuḥ sutasomā abhi prayaḥ bṛhad bhā bibhrato haviragne martāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: Singers with Soma pressed have made thee, Agni, hasten to the feast, Great light to mortal worshipper, what time they bring the sacred gift.

verses.sa: प्रातर्याव्णः सहस्कृत सोमपेयाय सन्त्य । इहाद्य दैव्यं जनं बर्हिरा सादया वसो॥
verses.tr: prātaryāvṇaḥ sahaskṛta somapeyāya santya ihādya daivyaṃ janaṃ barhirā sādayā vaso
verses.en: Good, bounteous, Son of Strength, this day seat here on sacred grass the Gods Who come at early morn, the host of heaven, to drink the Soma juice

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चं दैव्यं जनमग्ने यक्ष्व सहूतिभिः । अयं सोमः सुदानवस् तं पात तिरोअह्न्यम्॥
verses.tr: arvāñcaṃ daivyaṃ janamagne yakṣva sahūtibhiḥ ayaṃ somaḥ sudānavas taṃ pāta tiroahnyam
verses.en: Bring with joint invocations thou, O Agni, the celestial host: Here stands the Soma, bounteous Gods drink this expressed ere yesterday.

verses.sa: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत्॥
verses.tr: eṣo uṣā apūrvyā vyucchati priyā divaḥ stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat
verses.en: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear Daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise,

verses.sa: या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् । धिया देवा वसुविदा॥
verses.tr: yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām dhiyā devā vasuvidā
verses.en: Sons of the Sea, mighty to save discoverers of riches, ye Gods with deep thought who find out wealth.

verses.sa: वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि । यद् वां रथो विभिष्पतात्॥
verses.tr: vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadhi viṣṭapi yad vāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt
verses.en: Your giant coursers hasten on over the region all in flames, When your car flies with winged steeds.

verses.sa: हविषा जारो अपां पिपर्ति पपुरिर्नरा । पिता कुटस्य चर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: haviṣā jāro apāṃ piparti papurirnarā pitā kuṭasya carṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: He, liberal, lover of the flood, Lord of the House, the vigilant, Chiefs! with oblations feeds you full.

verses.sa: आदारो वां मतीनां नासत्या मतवचसा । पातं सोमस्य धृष्णुया॥
verses.tr: ādāro vāṃ matīnāṃ nāsatyā matavacasā pātaṃ somasya dhṛṣṇuyā
verses.en: Ye have regard unto our hymns, Nasatyas, thinking of our words: Drink boldly of the Soma juice.

verses.sa: या नः पीपरदश्विना ज्योतिष्मती तमस्तिरः । तामस्मे रासाथामिषम्॥
verses.tr: yā naḥ pīparadaśvinā jyotiṣmatī tamastiraḥ tāmasme rāsāthāmiṣam
verses.en: Vouchsafe to us, O Asvin Pair, such strength as, with attendant light, May through the darkness carry us.

verses.sa: आ नो नावा मतीनां यातं पाराय गन्तवे । युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम्॥
verses.tr: ā no nāvā matīnāṃ yātaṃ pārāya gantave yuñjāthāmaśvinā ratham
verses.en: Come in the ship of these our hymns to bear you to the hither shore O Asvins, harness ye the car.

verses.sa: अरित्रं वां दिवस्पृथु तीर्थे सिन्धूनां रथः । धिया युयुज्र इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: aritraṃ vāṃ divaspṛthu tīrthe sindhūnāṃ rathaḥ dhiyā yuyujra indavaḥ
verses.en: The heaven's wide vessel is your own on the flood's shore your chariot waits Drops, with the hymn, have been prepared.

verses.sa: दिवस्कण्वास इन्दवो वसु सिन्धूनां पदे । स्वं वव्रिं कुह धित्सथः॥
verses.tr: divaskaṇvāsa indavo vasu sindhūnāṃ pade svaṃ vavriṃ kuha dhitsathaḥ
verses.en: Kanvas, the drops are in the heaven; the wealth is at the waters' place: Where will ye manifest your form?

verses.sa: अभूदु भा उ अंशवे हिरण्यं प्रति सूर्यः । व्यख्यज्जिह्वयासितः॥
verses.tr: abhūdu bhā u aṃśave hiraṇyaṃ prati sūryaḥ vyakhyajjihvayāsitaḥ
verses.en: Light came to lighten up the branch, the Sun appeared as it were gold: And with its tongue shone forth the dark.

verses.sa: अभूदु पारमेतवे पन्था ऋतस्य साधुया । अदर्शि वि स्रुतिर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: abhūdu pārametave panthā ṛtasya sādhuyā adarśi vi srutirdivaḥ
verses.en: The path of sacrifice was made to travel to the farther goal: The road of heaven was manifest.

verses.sa: तत्तदिदश्विनोरवो जरिता प्रति भूषति । मदे सोमस्य पिप्रतोः॥
verses.tr: tattadidaśvinoravo jaritā prati bhūṣati made somasya pipratoḥ
verses.en: The singer of their praise awaits whatever grace the Asvins give, who save when Soma gladdens them.

verses.sa: वावसाना विवस्वति सोमस्य पीत्या गिरा । मनुष्वच्छम्भू आ गतम्॥
verses.tr: vāvasānā vivasvati somasya pītyā girā manuṣvacchambhū ā gatam
verses.en: Ye dwellers with Vivasvan come, auspicious, as to Manu erst; come to the Soma and our praise.

verses.sa: युवोरुषा अनु श्रियं परिज्मनोरुपाचरत् । ऋता वनथो अक्तुभिः॥
verses.tr: yuvoruṣā anu śriyaṃ parijmanorupācarat ṛtā vanatho aktubhiḥ
verses.en: O circumambient Asvins, Dawn follows the brightness of your way: Approve with beams our solemn rites.

verses.sa: उभा पिबतमश्विनोभा नः शर्म यच्छतम् । अविद्रियाभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ubhā pibatamaśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam avidriyābhirūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Drink ye of our libations, grant protection, O ye Asvins Twain, With aids which none may interrupt.

verses.sa:
अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ।
तमश्विना पिबतं तिरोअह्न्यं धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā tamaśvinā pibataṃ tiroahnyaṃ dhattaṃ ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Asvins, for you who strengthen Law this sweetest Soma hath been shed. Drink this expressed ere yesterday and give riches to him who offers it.

verses.sa:
त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता सुपेशसा रथेना यातमश्विना ।
कण्वासो वां ब्रह्म कृण्वन्त्यध्वरे तेषां सु शृणुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā supeśasā rathenā yātamaśvinā kaṇvāso vāṃ brahma kṛṇvantyadhvare teṣāṃ su śṛṇutaṃ havam
verses.en: Come, O ye Asvins, mounted on your triple car three-seated, beautiful of form To you at sacrifice the Kanvas send the prayer: graciously listen to their call.

verses.sa:
अश्विना मधुमत्तमं पातं सोममृतावृधा ।
अथाद्य दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे दाश्वांसमुप गच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: aśvinā madhumattamaṃ pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā athādya dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe dāśvāṃsamupa gacchatam
verses.en: O Asvins, ye who strengthen Law, drink ye this sweetest Soma juice. Borne on your wealth-fraught car come ye this day to him who offers, ye of wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
त्रिषधस्थे बर्हिषि विश्ववेदसा मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् ।
कण्वासो वां सुतसोमा अभिद्यवो युवां हवन्ते अश्विना॥
verses.tr: triṣadhasthe barhiṣi viśvavedasā madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam kaṇvāso vāṃ sutasomā abhidyavo yuvāṃ havante aśvinā
verses.en: Omniscient Asvins, on the thrice-heaped grass bedew with the sweet juice the sacrifice. The sons of Kanva, striving heavenward, call on you with draughts of Soma juice out-poured.

verses.sa:
याभिः कण्वमभिष्टिभिः प्रावतं युवमश्विना ।
ताभिः ष्व१स्माँ अवतं शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ kaṇvamabhiṣṭibhiḥ prāvataṃ yuvamaśvinā tābhiḥ ṣva1smāṃ avataṃ śubhaspatī pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā
verses.en: O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye guarded Kanva carefully, Keep us, O Lords of Splendour: drink the Soma juice, ye strengtheners of holy law.

verses.sa:
सुदासे दस्रा वसु बिभ्रता रथे पृक्षो वहतमश्विना ।
रयिं समुद्रादुत वा दिवस्पर्यस्मे धत्तं पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: sudāse dasrā vasu bibhratā rathe pṛkṣo vahatamaśvinā rayiṃ samudrāduta vā divasparyasme dhattaṃ puruspṛham
verses.en: O Mighty Ones, ye gave Sudas abundant food, brought on your treasure-laden car; So now vouchsafe to us the wealth which many crave, either from heaven or from the sea.

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अधि तुर्वशे ।
अतो रथेन सुवृता न आ गतं साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: yannāsatyā parāvati yadvā stho adhi turvaśe ato rathena suvṛtā na ā gataṃ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: Nasatyas, whether ye be far away or close to Turvasa, Borne on your lightly-rolling chariot come to us, together with the sunbeams come.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चा वां सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप ।
इषं पृञ्चन्ता सुकृते सुदानव आ बर्हिः सीदतं नरा॥
verses.tr: arvāñcā vāṃ saptayo'dhvaraśriyo vahantu savanedupa iṣaṃ pṛñcantā sukṛte sudānava ā barhiḥ sīdataṃ narā
verses.en: So let your coursers, ornaments of sacrifice, bring you to our libations here. Bestowing food on him who acts and gives aright, sit, Chiefs, upon the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
तेन नासत्या गतं रथेन सूर्यत्वचा ।
येन शश्वदूहथुर्दाशुषे वसु मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: tena nāsatyā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā yena śaśvadūhathurdāśuṣe vasu madhvaḥ somasya pītaye
verses.en: Come, O Nasatyas, on your car decked with a sunbright canopy, Whereon ye ever bring wealth to the worshipper, to drink the Soma's pleasant juice.

verses.sa:
उक्थेभिरर्वागवसे पुरूवसू अर्कैश्च नि ह्वयामहे ।
शश्वत् कण्वानां सदसि प्रिये हि कं सोमं पपथुरश्विना॥
verses.tr: ukthebhirarvāgavase purūvasū arkaiśca ni hvayāmahe śaśvat kaṇvānāṃ sadasi priye hi kaṃ somaṃ papathuraśvinā
verses.en: With lauds and songs of praise we call them down to us, that they, most rich, may succour us; For ye have ever in the Kanvas' well-loved house, O Asvins, drunk the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सह वामेन न उषो व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः ।
सह द्युम्नेन बृहता विभावरि राया देवि दास्वती॥
verses.tr: saha vāmena na uṣo vyucchā duhitardivaḥ saha dyumnena bṛhatā vibhāvari rāyā devi dāsvatī
verses.en: Dawn on us with prosperity, O Usas, Daughter of the Sky, Dawn with great glory, Goddess, Lady of the Light, dawn thou with riches, Bounteous One.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्वसुविदो भूरि च्यवन्त वस्तवे ।
उदीरय प्रति मा सूनृता उषश् चोद राधो मघोनाम्॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvasuvido bhūri cyavanta vastave udīraya prati mā sūnṛtā uṣaś coda rādho maghonām
verses.en: They, bringing steeds and kine, boon-givers of all wealth, have oft sped forth to lighten us. O Usas, waken up for me the sounds of joy: send us the riches of the great.

verses.sa:
उवासोषा उच्छाच्च नु देवी जीरा रथानाम् ।
ये अस्या आचरणेषु दध्रिरे समुद्रे न श्रवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: uvāsoṣā ucchācca nu devī jīrā rathānām ye asyā ācaraṇeṣu dadhrire samudre na śravasyavaḥ
verses.en: Usas hath dawned, and now shall dawn, the Goddess, driver forth of cars Which, as she cometh nigh, have fixed their thought on her, like glory-seekers on the flood.

verses.sa:
उषो ये ते प्र यामेषु युञ्जते मनो दानाय सूरयः ।
अत्राह तत्कण्व एषां कण्वतमो नाम गृणाति नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: uṣo ye te pra yāmeṣu yuñjate mano dānāya sūrayaḥ atrāha tatkaṇva eṣāṃ kaṇvatamo nāma gṛṇāti nṛṇām
verses.en: Here Kanva, chief of Kanva's race, sings forth aloud the glories of the heroes' names,-- The. princes who, O Usas, as thou comest near, direct their thoughts to liberal gifts.

verses.sa:
आ घा योषेव सूनर्युषा याति प्रभुञ्जती ।
जरयन्ती वृजनं पद्वदीयत उत्पातयति पक्षिणः॥
verses.tr: ā ghā yoṣeva sūnaryuṣā yāti prabhuñjatī jarayantī vṛjanaṃ padvadīyata utpātayati pakṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: Like a good matron Usas comes carefully tending everything: Rousing all life she stirs all creatures that have feet, and makes the birds of air fly up.

verses.sa:
वि या सृजति समनं व्य१र्थिनः पदं न वेत्योदती ।
वयो नकिष्टे पप्तिवांस आसते व्युष्टौ वाजिनीवति॥
verses.tr: vi yā sṛjati samanaṃ vya1rthinaḥ padaṃ na vetyodatī vayo nakiṣṭe paptivāṃsa āsate vyuṣṭau vājinīvati
verses.en: She sends the busy forth, each man to his pursuit: delay she knows not as she springs. O rich in opulence, after thy dawning birds that have flown forth no longer rest.

verses.sa:
एषायुक्त परावतः सूर्यस्योदयनादधि ।
शतं रथेभिः सुभगोषा इयं वि यात्यभि मानुषान्॥
verses.tr: eṣāyukta parāvataḥ sūryasyodayanādadhi śataṃ rathebhiḥ subhagoṣā iyaṃ vi yātyabhi mānuṣān
verses.en: This Dawn hath yoked her steeds afar, beyond the rising of the Sun: Borne on a hundred chariots she, auspicious Dawn, advances on her way to Men.

verses.sa:
विश्वमस्या नानाम चक्षसे जगज् ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी ।
अप द्वेषो मघोनी दुहिता दिव उषा उच्छदप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: viśvamasyā nānāma cakṣase jagaj jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī apa dveṣo maghonī duhitā diva uṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ
verses.en: To meet her glance all living creatures bend them down: Excellent One, she makes the light. Usas, the Daughter of the Sky, the opulent, shines foes and enmities away.

verses.sa:
उष आ भाहि भानुना चन्द्रेण दुहितर्दिवः ।
आवहन्ती भूर्यस्मभ्यं सौभगं व्युच्छन्ती दिविष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: uṣa ā bhāhi bhānunā candreṇa duhitardivaḥ āvahantī bhūryasmabhyaṃ saubhagaṃ vyucchantī diviṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Shine on us with thy radiant light, O Usas, Daughter of the Sky, Bringing to us great store of high felicity, and beaming on our solemn rites.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि प्राणनं जीवनं त्वे वि यदुच्छसि सूनरि ।
सा नो रथेन बृहता विभावरि श्रुधि चित्रामघे हवम्॥
verses.tr: viśvasya hi prāṇanaṃ jīvanaṃ tve vi yaducchasi sūnari sā no rathena bṛhatā vibhāvari śrudhi citrāmaghe havam
verses.en: For in thee is each living creature's breath and life, when, Excellent! thou dawnest forth. Borne on thy lofty car, O Lady of the Light, hear, thou of wondrous wealth, our call.

verses.sa:
उषो वाजं हि वंस्व यश्चित्रो मानुषे जने ।
तेना वह सुकृतो अध्वराँ उप ये त्वा गृणन्ति वह्नयः॥
verses.tr: uṣo vājaṃ hi vaṃsva yaścitro mānuṣe jane tenā vaha sukṛto adhvarāṃ upa ye tvā gṛṇanti vahnayaḥ
verses.en: O Usas, win thyself the strength which among men is wonderful. Bring thou thereby the pious unto holy rites, those who as priests sing praise to thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वान् देवाँ आ वह सोमपीतये ऽन्तरिक्षादुषस्त्वम् ।
सास्मासु धा गोमदश्वावदुक्थ्य१मुषो वाजं सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: viśvān devāṃ ā vaha somapītaye 'ntarikṣāduṣastvam sāsmāsu dhā gomadaśvāvadukthya1muṣo vājaṃ suvīryam
verses.en: Bring from the firmament, O Usas, all the Gods, that they may drink our Soma juice, And, being what thou art, vouchsafe us kine and steeds, strength meet for praise and hero might.

verses.sa:
यस्या रुशन्तो अर्चयः प्रति भद्रा अदृक्षत ।
सा नो रयिं विश्ववारं सुपेशसमुषा ददातु सुग्म्यम्॥
verses.tr: yasyā ruśanto arcayaḥ prati bhadrā adṛkṣata sā no rayiṃ viśvavāraṃ supeśasamuṣā dadātu sugmyam
verses.en: May Usas whose auspicious rays are seen resplendent round about, Grant us great riches, fair in form, of all good things, wealth which light labour may attain.

verses.sa:
ये चिद्धि त्वामृषयः पूर्व ऊतये जुहूरेऽवसे महि ।
सा नः स्तोमाँ अभि गृणीहि राधसोषः शुक्रेण शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: ye ciddhi tvāmṛṣayaḥ pūrva ūtaye juhūre'vase mahi sā naḥ stomāṃ abhi gṛṇīhi rādhasoṣaḥ śukreṇa śociṣā
verses.en: Mighty One, whom the Rsis of old time invoked for their protection and their help, O Usas, graciously answer our songs of praise with bounty and with brilliant light.

verses.sa:
उषो यदद्य भानुना वि द्वारावृणवो दिवः ।
प्र नो यच्छतादवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिः प्र देवि गोमतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: uṣo yadadya bhānunā vi dvārāvṛṇavo divaḥ pra no yacchatādavṛkaṃ pṛthu cchardiḥ pra devi gomatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Usas, as thou with light to day hast opened the twin doors of heaven, So grant thou us a dwelling wide and free from foes. O Goddess, give us food with kine.

verses.sa:
सं नो राया बृहता विश्वपेशसा मिमिक्ष्वा समिळाभिरा ।
सं द्युम्नेन विश्वतुरोषो महि सं वाजैर्वाजिनीवति॥
verses.tr: saṃ no rāyā bṛhatā viśvapeśasā mimikṣvā samiḻābhirā saṃ dyumnena viśvaturoṣo mahi saṃ vājairvājinīvati
verses.en: Bring us to wealth abundant, sent in every shape, to plentiful refreshing food, To all-subduing splendour, Usas, Mighty One, to strength, thou rich in spoil and wealth.

verses.sa:
उषो भद्रेभिरा गहि दिवश्चिद् रोचनादधि ।
वहन्त्वरुणप्सव उप त्वा सोमिनो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: uṣo bhadrebhirā gahi divaścid rocanādadhi vahantvaruṇapsava upa tvā somino gṛham
verses.en: E'EN from above the sky's bright realm come, Usas, by auspicious ways: Let red steeds bear thee to the house of him who pours the Soma, juice.

verses.sa:
सुपेशसं सुखं रथं यमध्यस्था उषस्त्वम् ।
तेना सुश्रवसं जनं प्रावाद्य दुहितर्दिवः॥
verses.tr: supeśasaṃ sukhaṃ rathaṃ yamadhyasthā uṣastvam tenā suśravasaṃ janaṃ prāvādya duhitardivaḥ
verses.en: The chariot which thou mountest, fair of shape, O Usas light to move,-- Therewith, O Daughter of the Sky, aid men of noble fame today.

verses.sa:
वयश्चित् ते पतत्रिणो द्विपच्चतुष्पदर्जुनि ।
उषः प्रारन्नृतूँरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि॥
verses.tr: vayaścit te patatriṇo dvipaccatuṣpadarjuni uṣaḥ prārannṛtūṃranu divo antebhyaspari
verses.en: Bright Usas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir, And round about flock winged birds from all the boundaries of heaven.

verses.sa:
व्युच्छन्ती हि रश्मिभिर्विश्वमाभासि रोचनम् ।
तां त्वामुषर्वसूयवो गीर्भिः कण्वा अहूषत॥
verses.tr: vyucchantī hi raśmibhirviśvamābhāsi rocanam tāṃ tvāmuṣarvasūyavo gīrbhiḥ kaṇvā ahūṣata
verses.en: Thou dawning with thy beams of light illumest all the radiant realm. Thee, as thou art, the Kanvas, fain for wealth, have called with sacred songs.

verses.sa: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः । दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
verses.en: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Surya, that all may look on him.

verses.sa: अप त्ये तायवो यथा नक्षत्रा यन्त्यक्तुभिः । सूराय विश्वचक्षसे॥
verses.tr: apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yantyaktubhiḥ sūrāya viśvacakṣase
verses.en: The constellations pass away, like thieves, together with their beams, Before the all-beholding Sun.

verses.sa: अदृश्रमस्य केतवो वि रश्मयो जनाँ अनु । भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा॥
verses.tr: adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṃ anu bhrājanto agnayo yathā
verses.en: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent o'er the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze.

verses.sa: तरणिर्विश्वदर्शतो ज्योतिष्कृदसि सूर्य । विश्वमा भासि रोचनम्॥
verses.tr: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya viśvamā bhāsi rocanam
verses.en: Swift and all beautiful art thou, O Surya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.

verses.sa: प्रत्यङ् देवानां विशः प्रत्यङ्ङुदेषि मानुषान् । प्रत्यङ् विश्वं स्वर्दृशे॥
verses.tr: pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅudeṣi mānuṣān pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svardṛśe
verses.en: Thou goest to the hosts of Gods, thou comest hither to mankind, Hither all light to be beheld.

verses.sa: येना पावक चक्षसा भुरण्यन्तं जनाँ अनु । त्वं वरुण पश्यसि॥
verses.tr: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṃ anu tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
verses.en: With that same eye of thine wherewith thou lookest brilliant Varuna, Upon the busy race of men,

verses.sa: वि द्यामेषि रजस्पृथ्वहा मिमानो अक्तुभिः । पश्यञ्जन्मानि सूर्य॥
verses.tr: vi dyāmeṣi rajaspṛthvahā mimāno aktubhiḥ paśyañjanmāni sūrya
verses.en: Traversing sky and wide mid-air, thou metest with thy beams our days, Sun, seeing all things that have birth.

verses.sa: सप्त त्वा हरितो रथे वहन्ति देव सूर्य । शोचिष्केशं विचक्षण॥
verses.tr: sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇa
verses.en: Seven Bay Steeds harnessed to thy car bear thee, O thou farseeing One, God, Surya, with the radiant hair.

verses.sa: अयुक्त सप्त शुन्ध्युवः सूरो रथस्य नप्त्यः । ताभिर्याति स्वयुक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ tābhiryāti svayuktibhiḥ
verses.en: Surya hath yoked the pure bright Seven, the daughters of the car; with these, His own dear team, he goeth forth.

verses.sa: उद्वयं तमसस्परि ज्योतिष्पश्यन्त उत्तरम् । देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udvayaṃ tamasaspari jyotiṣpaśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Surya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

verses.sa: उद्यन्नद्य मित्रमह आरोहन्नुत्तरां दिवम् । हृद्रोगं मम सूर्य हरिमाणं च नाशय॥
verses.tr: udyannadya mitramaha ārohannuttarāṃ divam hṛdrogaṃ mama sūrya harimāṇaṃ ca nāśaya
verses.en: Rising this day, O rich in friends, ascending to the loftier heaven, Surya remove my heart's disease, take from me this my yellow hue.

verses.sa: शुकेषु मे हरिमाणं रोपणाकासु दध्मसि । अथो हारिद्रवेषु मे हरिमाणं नि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: śukeṣu me harimāṇaṃ ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi atho hāridraveṣu me harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi
verses.en: To parrots and to starlings let us give away my yellowness, Or this my yellowness let us transfer to Haritala trees.

verses.sa: उदगादयमादित्यो विश्वेन सहसा सह । द्विषन्तं मह्यं रन्धयन् मो  अहं द्विषते रधम्॥
verses.tr: udagādayamādityo viśvena sahasā saha dviṣantaṃ mahyaṃ randhayan mo ahaṃ dviṣate radham
verses.en: With all his conquering vigour this Aditya hath gone up on high, Giving my foe into mine hand: let me not be my foeman's prey.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवम् ।
यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषा भुजे मंहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ meṣaṃ puruhūtamṛgmiyamindraṃ gīrbhirmadatā vasvo arṇavam yasya dyāvo na vicaranti mānuṣā bhuje maṃhiṣṭhamabhi vipramarcata
verses.en: Make glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy of songs of praise, Indra, the sea of wealth; Whose gracious deeds for men spread like the heavens abroad: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good.

verses.sa:
अभीमवन्वन्त्स्वभिष्टिमूतयो ऽन्तरिक्षप्रां तविषीभिरावृतम् ।
इन्द्रं दक्षास ऋभवो मदच्युतं शतक्रतुं जवनी सूनृतारुहत्॥
verses.tr: abhīmavanvantsvabhiṣṭimūtayo 'ntarikṣaprāṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtam indraṃ dakṣāsa ṛbhavo madacyutaṃ śatakratuṃ javanī sūnṛtāruhat
verses.en: As aids the skilful Rbhus yearned to Indra strong to save, who fills mid-air, encompassed round with might, Rushing in rapture; and o'er Satakratu came the gladdening shout that urged him on to victory.

verses.sa:
त्वं गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरपोतात्रये शतदुरेषु गातुवित् ।
ससेन चिद् विमदायावहो वस्वाजावद्रिं वावसानस्य नर्तयन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapotātraye śatadureṣu gātuvit sasena cid vimadāyāvaho vasvājāvadriṃ vāvasānasya nartayan
verses.en: Thou hast disclosed the kine's stall for the Angirases, and made a way for Atri by a hundred doors. On Vimada thou hast bestowed both food and wealth, making thy bolt dance in the sacrificer's fight.

verses.sa:
त्वमपामपिधानावृणोरपाधारयः पर्वते दानुमद्वसु ।
वृत्रं यदिन्द्र शवसावधीरहिमादित् सूर्यं दिव्यारोहयो दृशे॥
verses.tr: tvamapāmapidhānāvṛṇorapādhārayaḥ parvate dānumadvasu vṛtraṃ yadindra śavasāvadhīrahimādit sūryaṃ divyārohayo dṛśe
verses.en: Thou hast unclosed the prisons of the waters; thou hast in the mountain seized the treasure rich in gifts. When thou hadst slain with might the dragon Vrtra, thou, Indra, didst raise the Sun in heaven for all to see.

verses.sa:
त्वं मायाभिरप मायिनोऽधमः स्वधाभिर्ये अधि शुप्तावजुह्वत ।
त्वं पिप्रोर्नृमणः प्रारुजः पुरः प्र ऋजिश्वानं दस्युहत्येष्वाविथ॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ māyābhirapa māyino'dhamaḥ svadhābhirye adhi śuptāvajuhvata tvaṃ piprornṛmaṇaḥ prārujaḥ puraḥ pra ṛjiśvānaṃ dasyuhatyeṣvāvitha
verses.en: With wondrous might thou blewest enchanter fiends away, with powers celestial those who called on thee in jest. Thou, hero-hearted, hast broken down Pipru's forts, and helped Rjisvan when the Dasyus were struck dead.

verses.sa:
त्वं कुत्सं शुष्णहत्येष्वाविथारन्धयोऽतिथिग्वाय शम्बरम् ।
महान्तं चिदर्बुदं नि क्रमीः पदा सनादेव दस्युहत्याय जज्ञिषे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ kutsaṃ śuṣṇahatyeṣvāvithārandhayo'tithigvāya śambaram mahāntaṃ cidarbudaṃ ni kramīḥ padā sanādeva dasyuhatyāya jajñiṣe
verses.en: Thou savedst Kutsa when Susna was smitten down; to Atithigva gavest Sambara for a prey. E'en mighty Arbuda thou troddest under foot: thou from of old wast born to strike the Dasyus dead.

verses.sa:
त्वे विश्वा तविषी सध्र्यग्घिता तव राधः सोमपीथाय हर्षते ।
तव वज्रश्चिकिते बाह्वोर्हितो वृश्चा शत्रोरव विश्वानि वृष्ण्या॥
verses.tr: tve viśvā taviṣī sadhryagghitā tava rādhaḥ somapīthāya harṣate tava vajraścikite bāhvorhito vṛścā śatrorava viśvāni vṛṣṇyā
verses.en: All power and might is closely gathered up in thee; thy bounteous spirit joys in drinking Soma juice. Known is the thunderbolt that lies within thine arms: rend off therewith all manly prowess of our foe.

verses.sa:
वि जानीह्यार्यान्ये च दस्यवो बर्हिष्मते रन्धया शासदव्रतान् ।
शाकी भव यजमानस्य चोदिता विश्वेत् ता ते सधमादेषु चाकन॥
verses.tr: vi jānīhyāryānye ca dasyavo barhiṣmate randhayā śāsadavratān śākī bhava yajamānasya coditā viśvet tā te sadhamādeṣu cākana
verses.en: Discern thou well Aryas and Dasyus; punishing the lawless give them up to him whose grass is strewn. Be thou the sacrificer's strong encourager all these thy deeds are my delight at festivals.

verses.sa:
अनुव्रताय रन्धयन्नपव्रतानाभूभिरिन्द्रः श्नथयन्ननाभुवः ।
वृद्धस्य चिद् वर्धतो द्यामिनक्षतः स्तवानो वम्रो वि जघान संदिहः॥
verses.tr: anuvratāya randhayannapavratānābhūbhirindraḥ śnathayannanābhuvaḥ vṛddhasya cid vardhato dyāminakṣataḥ stavāno vamro vi jaghāna saṃdihaḥ
verses.en: Indra gives up the lawless to the pious man, destroying by the Strong Ones those who have no strength. Vamra when glorified destroyed the gathered piles of the still waxing great one who would reach the heaven.

verses.sa:
तक्षद् यत्त उशना सहसा सहो वि रोदसी मज्मना बाधते शवः ।
आ त्वा वातस्य नृमणो मनोयुज आ पूर्यमाणमवहन्नभि श्रवः॥
verses.tr: takṣad yatta uśanā sahasā saho vi rodasī majmanā bādhate śavaḥ ā tvā vātasya nṛmaṇo manoyuja ā pūryamāṇamavahannabhi śravaḥ
verses.en: The might which Usana hath formed for thee with might rends in its greatness and with strength both worlds apart. O Hero-souled, the steeds of Vata, yoked by thought, have carried thee to fame while thou art filled with power.

verses.sa:
मन्दिष्ट यदुशने काव्ये सचाँ इन्द्रो वङ्कू वङ्कुतराधि तिष्ठति ।
उग्रो ययिं निरपः स्रोतसासृजद्वि शुष्णस्य दृंहिता ऐरयत्पुरः॥
verses.tr: mandiṣṭa yaduśane kāvye sacāṃ indro vaṅkū vaṅkutarādhi tiṣṭhati ugro yayiṃ nirapaḥ srotasāsṛjadvi śuṣṇasya dṛṃhitā airayatpuraḥ
verses.en: When Indra hath rejoiced with Kavya Usana, he mounts his steeds who swerve wider and wider yet. The Strong hath loosed his bolt with the swift rush of rain, and he hath rent in pieces Susna's firm-built forts.

verses.sa:
आ स्मा रथं वृषपाणेषु तिष्ठसि शार्यातस्य प्रभृता येषु मन्दसे ।
इन्द्र यथा सुतसोमेषु चाकनोऽनर्वाणं श्लोकमा रोहसे दिवि॥
verses.tr: ā smā rathaṃ vṛṣapāṇeṣu tiṣṭhasi śāryātasya prabhṛtā yeṣu mandase indra yathā sutasomeṣu cākano'narvāṇaṃ ślokamā rohase divi
verses.en: Thou mountest on thy car amid strong Soma draughts: Saryata brought thee those in which thou hast delight. Indra, when thou art pleased with men whose Soma flows thou risest to unchallenged glory in the sky.

verses.sa:
अददा अर्भां महते वचस्यवे कक्षीवते वृचयामिन्द्र सुन्वते ।
मेनाभवो वृषणश्वस्य सुक्रतो विश्वेत् ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या॥
verses.tr: adadā arbhāṃ mahate vacasyave kakṣīvate vṛcayāmindra sunvate menābhavo vṛṣaṇaśvasya sukrato viśvet tā te savaneṣu pravācyā
verses.en: To old Kaksivan, Soma-presser, skilled in song, O Indra, thou didst give the youthful Vrcaya. Thou, very wise, wast Mena, Vrsanaiva's child: those deeds of thine must all be told at Soma feasts.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अश्रायि सुध्यो निरेके पज्रेषु स्तोमो दुर्यो न यूपः ।
अश्वयुर्गव्यू रथयुर्वसूयुरिन्द्र इद्रायः क्षयति प्रयन्ता॥
verses.tr: indro aśrāyi sudhyo nireke pajreṣu stomo duryo na yūpaḥ aśvayurgavyū rathayurvasūyurindra idrāyaḥ kṣayati prayantā
verses.en: The good man's refuge in his need is Indra, firm as a doorpost, praised among the Pajras. Indra alone is Lord of wealth, the Giver, lover of riches, chariots, kine, and horses.

verses.sa:
इदं नमो वृषभाय स्वराजे सत्यशुष्माय तवसेऽवाचि ।
अस्मिन्निन्द्र वृजने सर्ववीराः स्मत्सूरिभिस्तव शर्मन्त्स्याम॥
verses.tr: idaṃ namo vṛṣabhāya svarāje satyaśuṣmāya tavase'vāci asminnindra vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ smatsūribhistava śarmantsyāma
verses.en: To him the Mighty One, the self-resplendent, verily strong and great, this praise is uttered. May we and all the heroes, with the princes, be, in this fray, O Indra, in thy keeping.

verses.sa:
त्यं सु मेषं महया स्वर्विदं शतं यस्य सुभ्वः साकमीरते ।
अत्यं न वाजं हवनस्यदं रथमेन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ su meṣaṃ mahayā svarvidaṃ śataṃ yasya subhvaḥ sākamīrate atyaṃ na vājaṃ havanasyadaṃ rathamendraṃ vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ
verses.en: I GLORIFY that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred nobly-natured ones go forth with him. With hymns may I turn hither Indra to mine aid,--the Car which like a strong steed hasteth to the call.

verses.sa:
स पर्वतो न धरुणेष्वच्युतः सहस्रमूतिस्तविषीषु वावृधे ।
इन्द्रो यद् वृत्रमवधीन्नदीवृतमुब्जन्नर्णांसि जर्हृषाणो अन्धसा॥
verses.tr: sa parvato na dharuṇeṣvacyutaḥ sahasramūtistaviṣīṣu vāvṛdhe indro yad vṛtramavadhīnnadīvṛtamubjannarṇāṃsi jarhṛṣāṇo andhasā
verses.en: Like as a mountain on firm basis, unremoved, he, thousandfold protector, waxed in mighty strength, When Indra, joying in the draughts of Soma juice, forced the clouds, slaying Vrtra stayer of their flow.

verses.sa:
स हि द्वरो द्वरिषु वव्र ऊधनि चन्द्रबुध्नो मदवृद्धो मनीषिभिः ।
इन्द्रं तमह्वे स्वपस्यया धिया मंहिष्ठरातिं स हि पप्रिरन्धसः॥
verses.tr: sa hi dvaro dvariṣu vavra ūdhani candrabudhno madavṛddho manīṣibhiḥ indraṃ tamahve svapasyayā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭharātiṃ sa hi paprirandhasaḥ
verses.en: For he stays e'en the stayers, spread o'er laden cloud, rooted in light, strengthened in rapture by the wise. Indra with thought, with skilled activity, I call, most liberal giver, for he sates him with the juice.

verses.sa:
आ यं पृणन्ति दिवि सद्मबर्हिषः समुद्रं न सुभ्व१ः स्वा अभिष्टयः ।
तं वृत्रहत्ये अनु तस्थुरूतयः शुष्मा इन्द्रमवाता अह्रुतप्सवः॥
verses.tr: ā yaṃ pṛṇanti divi sadmabarhiṣaḥ samudraṃ na subhva1ḥ svā abhiṣṭayaḥ taṃ vṛtrahatye anu tasthurūtayaḥ śuṣmā indramavātā ahrutapsavaḥ
verses.en: Whom those that flow in heaven on sacred grass, his own assistants, nobly-natured, fill full like the sea,-- Beside that Indra when he smote down Vrtra stood his helpers, straight in form, mighty, invincible.

verses.sa:
अभि स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यतो रघ्वीरिव प्रवणे सस्रुरूतयः ।
इन्द्रो यद् वज्री धृषमाणो अन्धसा भिनद् वलस्य परिधीँरिव त्रितः॥
verses.tr: abhi svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyato raghvīriva pravaṇe sasrurūtayaḥ indro yad vajrī dhṛṣamāṇo andhasā bhinad valasya paridhīṃriva tritaḥ
verses.en: To him, as in wild joy he fought with him who stayed the rain, his helpers sped like swift streams down a slope, When Indra, thunder-armed, made bold by Soma draughts, as Trta cleaveth Vala's fences, cleft him through.

verses.sa:
परीं घृणा चरति तित्विषे शवो ऽपो वृत्वी रजसो बुध्नमाशयत् ।
वृत्रस्य यत् प्रवणे दुर्गृभिश्वनो निजघन्थ हन्वोरिन्द्र तन्यतुम्॥
verses.tr: parīṃ ghṛṇā carati titviṣe śavo 'po vṛtvī rajaso budhnamāśayat vṛtrasya yat pravaṇe durgṛbhiśvano nijaghantha hanvorindra tanyatum
verses.en: Splendour encompassed thee, forth shone thy warrior might: the rain-obstructer lay in mid-air's lowest deep, What time, O Indra, thou didst cast thy thunder down upon the jaws of Vritra hard to be restrained.

verses.sa:
ह्रदं न हि त्वा न्यृषन्त्यूर्मयो ब्रह्माणीन्द्र तव यानि वर्धना ।
त्वष्टा चित्ते युज्यं वावृधे शवस्ततक्ष वज्रमभिभूत्योजसम्॥
verses.tr: hradaṃ na hi tvā nyṛṣantyūrmayo brahmāṇīndra tava yāni vardhanā tvaṣṭā citte yujyaṃ vāvṛdhe śavastatakṣa vajramabhibhūtyojasam
verses.en: The hymns which magnify thee, Indra, reach to thee even as water-brooks flow down and fill the lake. Tvastar gave yet more force to thine appropriate strength, and forged thy thunderbolt of overpowering might.

verses.sa:
जघन्वाँ उ हरिभिः सम्भृतक्रतविन्द्र वृत्रं मनुषे गातुयन्नपः ।
अयच्छथा बाह्वोर्वज्रमायसमधारयो दिव्या सूर्यं दृशे॥
verses.tr: jaghanvāṃ u haribhiḥ sambhṛtakratavindra vṛtraṃ manuṣe gātuyannapaḥ ayacchathā bāhvorvajramāyasamadhārayo divyā sūryaṃ dṛśe
verses.en: When, Indra, thou whose power is linked with thy Bay Steeds hadst smitten Vrtra, causing floods to flow for man, Thou heldst in thine arms the metal thunderbolt, and settest in the heaven the Sun for all to see.

verses.sa:
बृहत् स्वश्चन्द्रममवद् यदुक्थ्य १ मकृण्वत भियसा रोहणं दिवः ।
यन्मानुषप्रधना इन्द्रमूतयः स्वर्नृषाचो मरुतोऽमदन्ननु॥
verses.tr: bṛhat svaścandramamavad yadukthya 1 makṛṇvata bhiyasā rohaṇaṃ divaḥ yanmānuṣapradhanā indramūtayaḥ svarnṛṣāco maruto'madannanu
verses.en: In fear they raised the lofty self-resplendent hymn, praise giving and effectual, leading up to heaven, When Indra's helpers fighting for the good of men, the Maruts, faithful to mankind, joyed in the light.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्चिदस्यामवाँ अहेः स्वनादयोयवीद् भियसा वज्र इन्द्र ते ।
वृत्रस्य यद् बद्बधानस्य रोदसी मदे सुतस्य शवसाभिनच्छिरः॥
verses.tr: dyauścidasyāmavāṃ aheḥ svanādayoyavīd bhiyasā vajra indra te vṛtrasya yad badbadhānasya rodasī made sutasya śavasābhinacchiraḥ
verses.en: Then Heaven himself, the mighty, at that Dragon's roar reeled back in terror when, Indra, thy thunderbolt In the wild joy of Soma had struck off with might the head of Vrtra, tyrant of the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
यदिन्न्विन्द्र पृथिवी दशभुजिरहानि विश्वा ततनन्त कृष्टयः ।
अत्राह ते मघवन् विश्रुतं सहो द्यामनु शवसा बर्हणा भुवत्॥
verses.tr: yadinnvindra pṛthivī daśabhujirahāni viśvā tatananta kṛṣṭayaḥ atrāha te maghavan viśrutaṃ saho dyāmanu śavasā barhaṇā bhuvat
verses.en: O Indra, were this earth extended forth tenfold, and men who dwell therein multiplied day by day, Still here thy conquering might, Maghavan, would be famed: it hath waxed vast as heaven in majesty and power.

verses.sa:
त्वमस्य पारे रजसो व्योमनः स्वभूत्योजा अवसे धृषन्मनः ।
चकृषे भूमिं प्रतिमानमोजसो ऽपः स्वः परिभूरेष्या दिवम्॥
verses.tr: tvamasya pāre rajaso vyomanaḥ svabhūtyojā avase dhṛṣanmanaḥ cakṛṣe bhūmiṃ pratimānamojaso 'paḥ svaḥ paribhūreṣyā divam
verses.en: Thou, bold of heart, in thine own native might, for help, upon the limit of this mid-air and of heaven, Hast made the earth to be the pattern of thy strength: embracing flood and light thou reachest to the sky.

verses.sa:
त्वं भुवः प्रतिमानं पृथिव्या ऋष्ववीरस्य बृहतः पतिर्भूः ।
विश्वमाप्रा अन्तरिक्षं महित्वा सत्यमद्धा नकिरन्यस्त्वावान्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā ṛṣvavīrasya bṛhataḥ patirbhūḥ viśvamāprā antarikṣaṃ mahitvā satyamaddhā nakiranyastvāvān
verses.en: Thou art the counterpart of earth, the Master of lofty heaven with all its mighty Heroes: Thou hast filled all the region with thy greatness: yea, of a truth there is none other like thee.

verses.sa:
न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी अनु व्यचो न सिन्धवो रजसो अन्तमानशुः ।
नोत स्ववृष्टिं मदे अस्य युध्यत एको अन्यच्चकृषे विश्वमानुषक्॥
verses.tr: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī anu vyaco na sindhavo rajaso antamānaśuḥ nota svavṛṣṭiṃ made asya yudhyata eko anyaccakṛṣe viśvamānuṣak
verses.en: Whose amplitude the heaven and earth have not attained, whose bounds the waters of mid-air have never reached,-- Not, when in joy he fights the stayer of the rain: thou, and none else, hast made all things in order due.

verses.sa:
आर्चन्नत्र मरुतः सस्मिन्नाजौ विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा ।
वृत्रस्य यद् भृष्टिमता वधेन नि त्वमिन्द्र प्रत्यानं जघन्थ॥
verses.tr: ārcannatra marutaḥ sasminnājau viśve devāso amadannanu tvā vṛtrasya yad bhṛṣṭimatā vadhena ni tvamindra pratyānaṃ jaghantha
verses.en: The Maruts sang thy praise in this encounter, and in thee all the Deities delighted, What time thou, Indra, with thy spiky weapon, thy deadly bolt, smotest the face of Vrtra.

verses.sa:
न्यू ३ षु वाचं प्र महे भरामहे गिर इन्द्राय सदने विवस्वतः ।
नू चिद्धि रत्नं ससतामिवाविदन्न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते॥
verses.tr: nyū 3 ṣu vācaṃ pra mahe bharāmahe gira indrāya sadane vivasvataḥ nū ciddhi ratnaṃ sasatāmivāvidanna duṣṭutirdraviṇodeṣu śasyate
verses.en: I WE will present fair praise unto the Mighty One, our hymns to Indra in Vivasvan's dwelling-place; For he hath ne'er found wealth in those who seem to sleep: those who give wealth to men accept no paltry praise.

verses.sa:
दुरो अश्वस्य दुर इन्द्र गोरसि दुरो यवस्य वसुन इनस्पतिः ।
शिक्षानरः प्रदिवो अकामकर्शनः सखा सखिभ्यस्तमिदं गृणीमसि॥
verses.tr: duro aśvasya dura indra gorasi duro yavasya vasuna inaspatiḥ śikṣānaraḥ pradivo akāmakarśanaḥ sakhā sakhibhyastamidaṃ gṛṇīmasi
verses.en: Giver of horses, Indra, giver, thou, of kine, giver of barley, thou art Lord and guard of wealth: Man's helper from of old, not disappointing hope, Friend of our friends, to thee as such we sing this praise.

verses.sa:
शचीव इन्द्र पुरुकृद् द्युमत्तम तवेदिदमभितश्चेकिते वसु ।
अतः संगृभ्याभिभूत आ भर मा त्वायतो जरितुः काममूनयीः॥
verses.tr: śacīva indra purukṛd dyumattama tavedidamabhitaścekite vasu ataḥ saṃgṛbhyābhibhūta ā bhara mā tvāyato jarituḥ kāmamūnayīḥ
verses.en: Indra, most splendid, powerful, rich in mighty deeds, this treasure spread around is known to be thine own. Gather therefrom, O Conqueror, and bring to us: fail not the hope of him who loves and sings to thee.

verses.sa:
एभिर्द्युभिः सुमना एभिरिन्दुभिर्निरुन्धानो अमतिं गोभिरश्विना ।
इन्द्रेण दस्युं दरयन्त इन्दुभिर्युतद्वेषसः समिषा रभेमहि॥
verses.tr: ebhirdyubhiḥ sumanā ebhirindubhirnirundhāno amatiṃ gobhiraśvinā indreṇa dasyuṃ darayanta indubhiryutadveṣasaḥ samiṣā rabhemahi
verses.en: Well pleased with these bright flames and with these Soma drops, take thou away our poverty with seeds and kine. With Indra scattering the Dasyu through these drops, freed from their hate may we obtain abundant food.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र राया समिषा रभेमहि सं वाजेभिः पुरुश्चन्द्रैरभिद्युभिः ।
सं देव्या प्रमत्या वीरशुष्मया गोअग्रयाश्वावत्या रभेमहि॥
verses.tr: samindra rāyā samiṣā rabhemahi saṃ vājebhiḥ puruścandrairabhidyubhiḥ saṃ devyā pramatyā vīraśuṣmayā goagrayāśvāvatyā rabhemahi
verses.en: Let us obtain, O Indra, plenteous wealth and food, with strength exceeding glorious, shining to the sky: May we obtain the Goddess Providence, the strength of heroes, special source of cattle, rich in steeds.

verses.sa:
ते त्वा मदा अमदन् तानि वृष्ण्या ते सोमासो वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पते ।
यत् कारवे दश वृत्राण्यप्रति बर्हिष्मते नि सहस्राणि बर्हयः॥
verses.tr: te tvā madā amadan tāni vṛṣṇyā te somāso vṛtrahatyeṣu satpate yat kārave daśa vṛtrāṇyaprati barhiṣmate ni sahasrāṇi barhayaḥ
verses.en: These our libations strength-inspiring, Soma draughts, gladdened thee in the fight with Vrtra, Hero Lord, What time thou slewest for the singer with trimmed grass ten thousand Vrtras, thou resistless in thy might.

verses.sa:
युधा युधमुप घेदेषि धृष्णुया पुरा पुरं समिदं हंस्योजसा ।
नम्या यदिन्द्र सख्या परावति निबर्हयो नमुचिं नाम मायिनम्॥
verses.tr: yudhā yudhamupa ghedeṣi dhṛṣṇuyā purā puraṃ samidaṃ haṃsyojasā namyā yadindra sakhyā parāvati nibarhayo namuciṃ nāma māyinam
verses.en: Thou goest on from fight to fight intrepidly, destroying castle after castle here with strength. Thou, Indra, with thy friend who makes the foe bow down, slewest from far away the guileful Namuci.

verses.sa:
त्वं करञ्जमुत पर्णयं वधीस्तेजिष्ठयातिथिग्वस्य वर्तनी ।
त्वं शता वङ्गृदस्याभिनत् पुरो ऽनानुदः परिषूता ऋजिश्वना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ karañjamuta parṇayaṃ vadhīstejiṣṭhayātithigvasya vartanī tvaṃ śatā vaṅgṛdasyābhinat puro 'nānudaḥ pariṣūtā ṛjiśvanā
verses.en: Thou hast struck down in death Karañja, Parnaya, in Atithigva's very glorious going forth. Unyielding, when Rjisvan compassed them with siege, thou hast destroyed the hundred forts of Vangrida.

verses.sa:
त्वमेताञ्जनराज्ञो द्विर्दशाऽबन्धुना सुश्रवसोपजग्मुषः ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नवतिं नव श्रुतो नि चक्रेण रथ्या दुष्पदावृणक्॥
verses.tr: tvametāñjanarājño dvirdaśā'bandhunā suśravasopajagmuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā navatiṃ nava śruto ni cakreṇa rathyā duṣpadāvṛṇak
verses.en: With all-outstripping chariot-wheel, O Indra, thou far-famed, hast overthrown the twice ten Kings of men, With sixty thousand nine-and-ninety followers, who came in arms to fight with friendless Susravas.

verses.sa:
त्वमाविथ सुश्रवसं तवोतिभिस्तव त्रामभिरिन्द्र तूर्वयाणम् ।
त्वमस्मै कुत्समतिथिग्वमायुं महे राज्ञे यूने अरन्धनायः॥
verses.tr: tvamāvitha suśravasaṃ tavotibhistava trāmabhirindra tūrvayāṇam tvamasmai kutsamatithigvamāyuṃ mahe rājñe yūne arandhanāyaḥ
verses.en: Thou hast protected Susravas with succour, and Turvayana with thine aid, O Indra. Thou madest Kutsa, Atithigva, Ayu, subject unto this King, the young, the mighty.

verses.sa:
य उदृचीन्द्र देवगोपाः सखायस्ते शिवतमा असाम ।
त्वां स्तोषाम त्वया सुवीरा द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: ya udṛcīndra devagopāḥ sakhāyaste śivatamā asāma tvāṃ stoṣāma tvayā suvīrā drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: May we protected by the Gods hereafter remain thy very prosperous friends, O Indra. Thee we extol, enjoying through thy favour life long and joyful and with store of heroes.

verses.sa:
मा नो अस्मिन् मघवन् पृत्स्वंहसि नहि ते अन्तः शवसः परीणशे ।
अक्रन्दयो नद्यो ३ रोरुवद् वना कथा न क्षोणीर्भियसा समारत॥
verses.tr: mā no asmin maghavan pṛtsvaṃhasi nahi te antaḥ śavasaḥ parīṇaśe akrandayo nadyo 3 roruvad vanā kathā na kṣoṇīrbhiyasā samārata
verses.en: Urge us not, Maghavan, to this distressful fight, for none may comprehend the limit of thy strength. Thou with fierce shout hast made the woods and rivers roar: did not men run in crowds together in their fear?

verses.sa:
अर्चा शक्राय शाकिने शचीवते शृण्वन्तमिन्द्रं महयन्नभि ष्टुहि ।
यो धृष्णुना शवसा रोदसी उभे वृषा वृषत्वा वृषभो न्यृञ्जते॥
verses.tr: arcā śakrāya śākine śacīvate śṛṇvantamindraṃ mahayannabhi ṣṭuhi yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā rodasī ubhe vṛṣā vṛṣatvā vṛṣabho nyṛñjate
verses.en: Sing hymns of praise to Sakra, Lord of power and might; laud thou and magnify Indra who heareth thee, Who with his daring might, a Bull exceeding strong in strength, maketh him master of the heaven and earth.

verses.sa:
अर्चा दिवे बृहते शूष्यं १ वचः स्वक्षत्रं यस्य धृषतो धृषन्मनः ।
बृहच्छ्रवा असुरो बर्हणा कृतः पुरो हरिभ्यां वृषभो रथो हि षः॥
verses.tr: arcā dive bṛhate śūṣyaṃ 1 vacaḥ svakṣatraṃ yasya dhṛṣato dhṛṣanmanaḥ bṛhacchravā asuro barhaṇā kṛtaḥ puro haribhyāṃ vṛṣabho ratho hi ṣaḥ
verses.en: Sing forth to lofty Dyaus a strength-bestowing song, the Bold, whose resolute mind hath independent sway. High glory hath the Asura, compact of strength, drawn on by two Bay Steeds: a Bull, a Car is he.

verses.sa:
त्वं दिवो बृहतः सानु कोपयो ऽव त्मना धृषता शम्बरं भिनत् ।
यन्मायिनो व्रन्दिनो मन्दिना धृषच्छितां गभस्तिमशनिं पृतन्यसि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ divo bṛhataḥ sānu kopayo 'va tmanā dhṛṣatā śambaraṃ bhinat yanmāyino vrandino mandinā dhṛṣacchitāṃ gabhastimaśaniṃ pṛtanyasi
verses.en: The ridges of the lofty heaven thou madest shake; thou, daring, of thyself smotest through Sambara, When bold with gladdening juice, thou warredst with thy bolt, sharp and two-edged, against the banded sorcerers.

verses.sa:
नि यद् वृणक्षि श्वसनस्य मूर्धनि शुष्णस्य चिद् व्रन्दिनो रोरुवद् वना ।
प्राचीनेन मनसा बर्हणावता यदद्या चित्कृणवः कस्त्वा परि॥
verses.tr: ni yad vṛṇakṣi śvasanasya mūrdhani śuṣṇasya cid vrandino roruvad vanā prācīnena manasā barhaṇāvatā yadadyā citkṛṇavaḥ kastvā pari
verses.en: When with a roar that fills the woods, thou forcest down on wind's head the stores which Susna kept confined, Who shall have power to stay thee firm and eager-souled from doing still this day what thou of old hast done?

verses.sa:
त्वमाविथ नर्यं तुर्वशं यदुं त्वं तुर्वीतिं वय्यं शतक्रतो ।
त्वं रथमेतशं कृत्व्ये धने त्वं पुरो नवतिं दम्भयो नव॥
verses.tr: tvamāvitha naryaṃ turvaśaṃ yaduṃ tvaṃ turvītiṃ vayyaṃ śatakrato tvaṃ rathametaśaṃ kṛtvye dhane tvaṃ puro navatiṃ dambhayo nava
verses.en: Thou helpest Narya, Turvasa, and Yadu, and Vayya's son Turviti, Satakratu! Thou helpest horse and car in final battle thou breakest down the nine-and-ninety castles.

verses.sa:
स घा राजा सत्पतिः शूशुवज्जनो रातहव्यः प्रति यः शासमिन्वति ।
उक्था वा यो अभिगृणाति राधसा दानुरस्मा उपरा पिन्वते दिवः॥
verses.tr: sa ghā rājā satpatiḥ śūśuvajjano rātahavyaḥ prati yaḥ śāsaminvati ukthā vā yo abhigṛṇāti rādhasā dānurasmā uparā pinvate divaḥ
verses.en: A hero-lord is he, King of a mighty folk, who offers free oblations and promotes the Law, Who with a bounteous guerdon welcomes hymns of praise: for him flows down the abundant stream below the sky.

verses.sa:
असमं क्षत्रमसमा मनीषा प्र सोमपा अपसा सन्तु नेमे ।
ये त इन्द्र ददुषो वर्धयन्ति महि क्षत्रं स्थविरं वृष्ण्यं च॥
verses.tr: asamaṃ kṣatramasamā manīṣā pra somapā apasā santu neme ye ta indra daduṣo vardhayanti mahi kṣatraṃ sthaviraṃ vṛṣṇyaṃ ca
verses.en: His power is matchless, matchless is his wisdom; chief, through their work, be some who drink the Soma, Those, Indra, who increase the lordly power, the firm heroic strength of thee the Giver.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदेते बहुला अद्रिदुग्धाश्चमूषदश्चमसा इन्द्रपानाः ।
व्यश्नुहि तर्पया काममेषामथा मनो वसुदेयाय कृष्व॥
verses.tr: tubhyedete bahulā adridugdhāścamūṣadaścamasā indrapānāḥ vyaśnuhi tarpayā kāmameṣāmathā mano vasudeyāya kṛṣva
verses.en: Therefore for thee are these abundant beakers Indra's drink, stone-pressed juices held in ladles. Quaff them and satisfy therewith thy longing; then fix thy mind upon bestowing treasure.

verses.sa:
अपामतिष्ठद्धरुणह्वरं तमो ऽन्तर्वृत्रस्य जठरेषु पर्वतः ।
अभीमिन्द्रो नद्यो वव्रिणा हिता विश्वा अनुष्ठाः प्रवणेषु जिघ्नते॥
verses.tr: apāmatiṣṭhaddharuṇahvaraṃ tamo 'ntarvṛtrasya jaṭhareṣu parvataḥ abhīmindro nadyo vavriṇā hitā viśvā anuṣṭhāḥ pravaṇeṣu jighnate
verses.en: There darkness stood, the vault that stayed the waters' flow: in Vrtra's hollow side the rain-cloud lay concealed. But Indra smote the rivers which the obstructer stayed, flood following after flood, down steep declivities.

verses.sa:
स शेवृधमधि धा द्युम्नमस्मे महि क्षत्रं जनाषाळिन्द्र तव्यम् ।
रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीन् राये च नः स्वपत्या इषे धाः॥
verses.tr: sa śevṛdhamadhi dhā dyumnamasme mahi kṣatraṃ janāṣāḻindra tavyam rakṣā ca no maghonaḥ pāhi sūrīn rāye ca naḥ svapatyā iṣe dhāḥ
verses.en: So give us, Indra, bliss-increasing glory give us great sway and strength that conquers people. Preserve our wealthy patrons, save our princes; vouchsafe us wealth and food with noble offspring.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदस्य वरिमा वि पप्रथ इन्द्रं न मह्ना पृथिवी चन प्रति ।
भीमस्तुविष्माञ्चर्षणिभ्य आतपः शिशीते वज्रं तेजसे न वंसगः॥
verses.tr: divaścidasya varimā vi papratha indraṃ na mahnā pṛthivī cana prati bhīmastuviṣmāñcarṣaṇibhya ātapaḥ śiśīte vajraṃ tejase na vaṃsagaḥ
verses.en: Though e'en this heaven's wide space and earth have spread them out, nor heaven nor earth may be in greatness Indra's match. Awful and very mighty, causing woe to men, he whets his thunderbolt for sharpness, as a bull.

verses.sa:
सो अर्णवो न नद्यः समुद्रियः प्रति गृभ्णाति विश्रिता वरीमभिः ।
इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये वृषायते सनात् स युध्म ओजसा पनस्यते॥
verses.tr: so arṇavo na nadyaḥ samudriyaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti viśritā varīmabhiḥ indraḥ somasya pītaye vṛṣāyate sanāt sa yudhma ojasā panasyate
verses.en: Like as the watery ocean, so doth he receive the rivers spread on all sides in their ample width. He bears him like a bull to drink of Soma juice, and will, as Warrior from of old, be praised for might.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं न भोजसे महो नृम्णस्य धर्मणामिरज्यसि ।
प्र वीर्येण देवताति चेकिते विश्वस्मा उग्रः कर्मणे पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ na bhojase maho nṛmṇasya dharmaṇāmirajyasi pra vīryeṇa devatāti cekite viśvasmā ugraḥ karmaṇe purohitaḥ
verses.en: Thou swayest, Indra, all kinds of great manly power, so as to bend, as't were, even that famed mountain down. Foremost among the Gods is he through hero might, set in the van, the Strong One, for each arduous deed.

verses.sa:
स इद् वने नमस्युभिर्वचस्यते चारु जनेषु प्रब्रुवाण इन्द्रियम् ।
वृषा छन्दुर्भवति हर्यतो वृषा क्षेमेण धेनां मघवा यदिन्वति॥
verses.tr: sa id vane namasyubhirvacasyate cāru janeṣu prabruvāṇa indriyam vṛṣā chandurbhavati haryato vṛṣā kṣemeṇa dhenāṃ maghavā yadinvati
verses.en: He only in the wood is praised by worshippers, when he shows forth to men his own fair Indra-power. A friendly Bull is he, a Bull to be desired when Maghavan auspiciously sends forth his voice.

verses.sa:
स इन्महानि समिथानि मज्मना कृणोति युध्म ओजसा जनेभ्यः ।
अधा चन श्रद् दधति त्विषीमत इन्द्राय वज्रं निघनिघ्नते वधम्॥
verses.tr: sa inmahāni samithāni majmanā kṛṇoti yudhma ojasā janebhyaḥ adhā cana śrad dadhati tviṣīmata indrāya vajraṃ nighanighnate vadham
verses.en: Yet verily the Warrior in his vigorous strength stirreth up with his might great battles for mankind; And men have faith in Indra, the resplendent One, what time he hurleth down his bolt, his dart of death.

verses.sa:
स हि श्रवस्युः सदनानि कृत्रिमा क्ष्मया वृधान ओजसा विनाशयन् ।
ज्योतींषि कृण्वन्नवृकाणि यज्यवे ऽव सुक्रतुः सर्तवा अपः सृजत्॥
verses.tr: sa hi śravasyuḥ sadanāni kṛtrimā kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā vināśayan jyotīṃṣi kṛṇvannavṛkāṇi yajyave 'va sukratuḥ sartavā apaḥ sṛjat
verses.en: Though, fain for glory, and with strength increased on earth, he with great might destroys the dwellings made with art, He makes the lights of heaven shine forth secure, he bids, exceeding wise, the floods flow for his worshipper.

verses.sa:
दानाय मनः सोमपावन्नस्तु ते ऽर्वाञ्चा हरी वन्दनश्रुदा कृधि ।
यमिष्ठासः सारथयो य इन्द्र ते न त्वा केता आ दभ्नुवन्ति भूर्णयः॥
verses.tr: dānāya manaḥ somapāvannastu te 'rvāñcā harī vandanaśrudā kṛdhi yamiṣṭhāsaḥ sārathayo ya indra te na tvā ketā ā dabhnuvanti bhūrṇayaḥ
verses.en: Drinker of Soma, let thy heart incline to give; bring thy Bays hitherward, O thou who hearest praise. Those charioteers of' thine, best skilled to draw the rein, the rapid sunbeams, Indra, lead thee not astray.

verses.sa:
अप्रक्षितं वसु बिभर्षि हस्तयोरषाह्ळं सहस्तन्वि श्रुतो दधे ।
आवृतासोऽवतासो न कर्तृभिस्तनूषु ते क्रतव इन्द्र भूरयः॥
verses.tr: aprakṣitaṃ vasu bibharṣi hastayoraṣāhḻaṃ sahastanvi śruto dadhe āvṛtāso'vatāso na kartṛbhistanūṣu te kratava indra bhūrayaḥ
verses.en: Thou bearest in both hands treasure that never fails; the famed One in his body holds unvanquished might. O Indra, in thy members many powers abide, like wells surrounded by the ministering priests.

verses.sa:
एष प्र पूर्वीरव तस्य चम्रिषो ऽत्यो न योषामुदयंस्त भुर्वणिः ।
दक्षं महे पाययते हिरण्ययं रथमावृत्या हरियोगमृभ्वसम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa pra pūrvīrava tasya camriṣo 'tyo na yoṣāmudayaṃsta bhurvaṇiḥ dakṣaṃ mahe pāyayate hiraṇyayaṃ rathamāvṛtyā hariyogamṛbhvasam
verses.en: For this man's full libations held in ladles, he hath roused him, eager, as a horse to meet the mare. He stays his golden car, yoked with Bay Horses, swift, and drinks the Soma juice which strengthens for great deeds.

verses.sa:
तं गूर्तयो नेमन्निषः परीणसः समुद्रं न संचरणे सनिष्यवः ।
पतिं दक्षस्य विदथस्य नू सहो गिरिं न वेना अधि रोह तेजसा॥
verses.tr: taṃ gūrtayo nemanniṣaḥ parīṇasaḥ samudraṃ na saṃcaraṇe saniṣyavaḥ patiṃ dakṣasya vidathasya nū saho giriṃ na venā adhi roha tejasā
verses.en: To him the guidance-following songs of praise flow full, as those who seek gain go in company to the flood. To him the Lord of power, the holy synod's might, as to a hill, with speed, ascend the loving ones.

verses.sa:
स तुर्वणिर्महाँ अरेणु पौंस्ये गिरेर्भृष्टिर्न भ्राजते तुजा शवः ।
येन शुष्णं मायिनमायसो मदे दुध्र आभूषु रामयन्नि दामनि॥
verses.tr: sa turvaṇirmahāṃ areṇu pauṃsye girerbhṛṣṭirna bhrājate tujā śavaḥ yena śuṣṇaṃ māyinamāyaso made dudhra ābhūṣu rāmayanni dāmani
verses.en: Victorious, great is he; in manly battle shines, unstained with dust, his might, as shines a mountain peak; Wherewith the iron one, fierce e'en against the strong, in rapture, fettered wily Sushna fast in bonds.

verses.sa:
देवी यदि तविषी त्वावृधोतय इन्द्रं सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः ।
यो धृष्णुना शवसा बाधते तम इयर्ति रेणुं बृहदर्हरिष्वणिः॥
verses.tr: devī yadi taviṣī tvāvṛdhotaya indraṃ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ yo dhṛṣṇunā śavasā bādhate tama iyarti reṇuṃ bṛhadarhariṣvaṇiḥ
verses.en: When Strength the Goddess, made more strong for help by thee, waits upon Indra as the Sun attends the Dawn, Then. he who with his might unflinching kills the gloom stirs up the dust aloft, with joy and triumphing.

verses.sa:
वि यत् तिरो धरुणमच्युतं रजो ऽतिष्ठिपो दिव आतासु बर्हणा ।
स्वर्मीह्ले यन्मद इन्द्र हर्ष्याहन् वृत्रं निरपामौब्जो अर्णवम्॥
verses.tr: vi yat tiro dharuṇamacyutaṃ rajo 'tiṣṭhipo diva ātāsu barhaṇā svarmīhle yanmada indra harṣyāhan vṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjo arṇavam
verses.en: When thou with might, upon the framework of the heaven, didst fix, across, air's region firmly, unremoved, In the light-winning war, Indra, in rapturous joy, thou smotest Vrtra dead and broughtest floods of rain.

verses.sa:
त्वं दिवो धरुणं धिष ओजसा पृथिव्या इन्द्र सदनेषु माहिनः ।
त्वं सुतस्य मदे अरिणा अपो वि वृत्रस्य समया पाष्यारुजः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ divo dharuṇaṃ dhiṣa ojasā pṛthivyā indra sadaneṣu māhinaḥ tvaṃ sutasya made ariṇā apo vi vṛtrasya samayā pāṣyārujaḥ
verses.en: Thou with thy might didst grasp, the holder-up of heaven, thou who art mighty also in the seats of earth. Thou, gladdened by the juice, hast set the waters free, and broken Vrtra's stony fences through and through.

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय बृहते बृहद्रये सत्यशुष्माय तवसे मतिं भरे ।
अपामिव प्रवणे यस्य दुर्धरं राधो विश्वायु शवसे अपावृतम्॥
verses.tr: pra maṃhiṣṭhāya bṛhate bṛhadraye satyaśuṣmāya tavase matiṃ bhare apāmiva pravaṇe yasya durdharaṃ rādho viśvāyu śavase apāvṛtam
verses.en: To him most liberal, lofty Lord of lofty wealth, verily powerful and strong, I bring my hymn,-- Whose checkless bounty, as of waters down a slope, is spread abroad for all that live, to give them strength.

verses.sa:
अध ते विश्वमनु हासदिष्टय आपो निम्नेव सवना हविष्मतः ।
यत् पर्वते न समशीत हर्यत इन्द्रस्य वज्रः श्नथिता हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: adha te viśvamanu hāsadiṣṭaya āpo nimneva savanā haviṣmataḥ yat parvate na samaśīta haryata indrasya vajraḥ śnathitā hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Now all this world, for worship, shall come after thee--the offerer's libations like floods to the depth, When the well-loved one seems to rest upon the hill, the thunderbolt of Indra, shatterer wrought of gold.

verses.sa:
अस्मै भीमाय नमसा समध्वर उषो न शुभ्र आ भरा पनीयसे ।
यस्य धाम श्रवसे नामेन्द्रियं ज्योतिरकारि हरितो नायसे॥
verses.tr: asmai bhīmāya namasā samadhvara uṣo na śubhra ā bharā panīyase yasya dhāma śravase nāmendriyaṃ jyotirakāri harito nāyase
verses.en: To him the terrible, most meet for lofty praise, like bright Dawn, now bring gifts with reverence in this rite, Whose being, for renown, yea, Indra-power and light, have been created, like bay steeds, to move with speed.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो ।
नहि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत् क्षोणीरिव प्रति नो हर्य तद् वचः॥
verses.tr: ime ta indra te vayaṃ puruṣṭuta ye tvārabhya carāmasi prabhūvaso nahi tvadanyo girvaṇo giraḥ saghat kṣoṇīriva prati no harya tad vacaḥ
verses.en: Thine, Indra, praised by many, excellently rich! are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. Lover of praise, none else but thou receives our laud: as earth loves all her creatures, love thou this our hymn.

verses.sa:
भूरि त इन्द्र वीर्यं १ तव स्मस्यस्य स्तोतुर्मघवन् काममा पृण ।
अनु ते द्यौर्बृहती वीर्यं मम इयं च ते पृथिवी नेम ओजसे॥
verses.tr: bhūri ta indra vīryaṃ 1 tava smasyasya stoturmaghavan kāmamā pṛṇa anu te dyaurbṛhatī vīryaṃ mama iyaṃ ca te pṛthivī nema ojase
verses.en: Great is thy power, O Indra, we are thine. Fulfil, O Maghavan, the wish of this thy worshipper. After thee lofty heaven hath measured out its strength: to thee and to thy power this earth hath bowed itself.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र पर्वतं महामुरुं वज्रेण वज्रिन् पर्वशश्चकर्तिथ ।
अवासृजो निवृताः सर्तवा अपः सत्रा विश्वं दधिषे केवलं सहः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tamindra parvataṃ mahāmuruṃ vajreṇa vajrin parvaśaścakartitha avāsṛjo nivṛtāḥ sartavā apaḥ satrā viśvaṃ dadhiṣe kevalaṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: Thou, who hast thunder for thy weapon, with thy bolt hast shattered into pieces this broad massive cloud. Thou hast sent down the obstructed floods that they may flow: thou hast, thine own for ever, all victorious might.

verses.sa:
नू चित् सहोजा अमृतो नि तुन्दते होता यद् दूतो अभवद् विवस्वतः ।
वि साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभी रजो मम आ देवताता हविषा विवासति॥
verses.tr: nū cit sahojā amṛto ni tundate hotā yad dūto abhavad vivasvataḥ vi sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhī rajo mama ā devatātā haviṣā vivāsati
verses.en: Ne'ER waxeth faint the Immortal, Son of Strength, since he, the Herald, hath become Vivasvan's messenger. On paths most excellent he measured out mid-air: he with oblation calls to service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
आ स्वमद्म युवमानो अजरस्तृष्वविष्यन्नतसेषु तिष्ठति ।
अत्यो न पृष्ठं प्रुषितस्य रोचते दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: ā svamadma yuvamāno ajarastṛṣvaviṣyannataseṣu tiṣṭhati atyo na pṛṣṭhaṃ pruṣitasya rocate divo na sānu stanayannacikradat
verses.en: Never decaying, seizing his appropriate food, rapidly, eagerly through the dry wood he spreads. His back, as he is sprinkled, glistens like a horse: loud hath he roared and shouted like the heights of heaven?

verses.sa:
क्राणा रुद्रेभिर्वसुभिः पुरोहितो होता निषत्तो रयिषाळमर्त्यः ।
रथो न विक्ष्वृञ्जसान आयुषु व्यानुषग्वार्या देव ऋण्वति॥
verses.tr: krāṇā rudrebhirvasubhiḥ purohito hotā niṣatto rayiṣāḻamartyaḥ ratho na vikṣvṛñjasāna āyuṣu vyānuṣagvāryā deva ṛṇvati
verses.en: Set high in place o'er all that Vasus, Rudras do, immortal, Lord of riches, seated as High Priest; Hastening like a car to men, to those who live, the God without delay gives boons to be desired.

verses.sa:
वि वातजूतो अतसेषु तिष्ठते वृथा जुहूभिः सृण्या तुविष्वणिः ।
तृषु यदग्ने वनिनो वृषायसे कृष्णं त एम रुशदूर्मे अजर॥
verses.tr: vi vātajūto ataseṣu tiṣṭhate vṛthā juhūbhiḥ sṛṇyā tuviṣvaṇiḥ tṛṣu yadagne vanino vṛṣāyase kṛṣṇaṃ ta ema ruśadūrme ajara
verses.en: Urged by the wind be spreads through dry wood as he lists, armed with his tongues for sickles, with a mighty roar. Black is thy path, Agni, changeless, with glittering waves! when like a bull thou rushest eager to the trees.

verses.sa:
तपुर्जम्भो वन आ वातचोदितो यूथे न साह्वाँ अव वाति वंसगः ।
अभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाजसा रजः स्थातुश्चरथं भयते पतत्रिणः॥
verses.tr: tapurjambho vana ā vātacodito yūthe na sāhvāṃ ava vāti vaṃsagaḥ abhivrajannakṣitaṃ pājasā rajaḥ sthātuścarathaṃ bhayate patatriṇaḥ
verses.en: With teeth of flame, wind-driven, through the wood he speeds, triumphant like a bull among the herd of cows, With bright strength roaming to the everlasting air: things fixed, things moving quake before him as he flies.

verses.sa:
दधुष्ट्वा भृगवो मानुषेष्वा रयिं न चारुं सुहवं जनेभ्यः ।
होतारमग्ने अतिथिं वरेण्यं मित्रं न शेवं दिव्याय जन्मने॥
verses.tr: dadhuṣṭvā bhṛgavo mānuṣeṣvā rayiṃ na cāruṃ suhavaṃ janebhyaḥ hotāramagne atithiṃ vareṇyaṃ mitraṃ na śevaṃ divyāya janmane
verses.en: The Bhrgus established thee among mankind for men, like as a treasure, beauteous, easy to invoke; Thee, Agni, as a herald and choice-worthy guest, as an auspicious Friend to the Celestial Race.

verses.sa:
होतारं सप्त जुह्वो ३ यजिष्ठं यं वाघतो वृणते अध्वरेषु ।
अग्निं विश्वेषामरतिं वसूनां सपर्यामि प्रयसा यामि रत्नम्॥
verses.tr: hotāraṃ sapta juhvo 3 yajiṣṭhaṃ yaṃ vāghato vṛṇate adhvareṣu agniṃ viśveṣāmaratiṃ vasūnāṃ saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam
verses.en: Agni, the seven tongues' deftest Sacrificer, him whom the priests elect at solemn worship, The Herald, messenger of all the Vasus, I serve with dainty food, I ask for riches.

verses.sa:
अच्छिद्रा सूनो सहसो नो अद्य स्तोतृभ्यो मित्रमहः शर्म यच्छ ।
अग्ने गृणन्तमंहस उरुष्योर्जो नपात् पूर्भिरायसीभिः॥
verses.tr: acchidrā sūno sahaso no adya stotṛbhyo mitramahaḥ śarma yaccha agne gṛṇantamaṃhasa uruṣyorjo napāt pūrbhirāyasībhiḥ
verses.en: Grant, Son of Strength, thou rich in friends, a refuge without a flaw this day to us thy praisers. O Agni, Son of Strength, with forts of iron preserve thou from distress the man who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
भवा वरूथं गृणते विभावो भवा मघवन् मघवद्भ्यः शर्म ।
उरुष्याग्ने अंहसो गृणन्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: bhavā varūthaṃ gṛṇate vibhāvo bhavā maghavan maghavadbhyaḥ śarma uruṣyāgne aṃhaso gṛṇantaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Be thou a refuge, Bright One, to the singer, a shelter, Bounteous Lord, to those who worship. Preserve the singer from distress, O Agni. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
वया इदग्ने अग्नयस्ते अन्ये त्वे विश्वे अमृता मादयन्ते ।
वैश्वानर नाभिरसि क्षितीनां स्थूणेव जनाँ उपमिद् ययन्थ॥
verses.tr: vayā idagne agnayaste anye tve viśve amṛtā mādayante vaiśvānara nābhirasi kṣitīnāṃ sthūṇeva janāṃ upamid yayantha
verses.en: The other fires are, verily, thy branches; the Immortals all rejoice in thee, O Agni. Centre art thou, Vaisvanara, of the people, sustaining men like a deep-founded pillar.

verses.sa:
मूर्धा दिवो नाभिरग्निः पृथिव्या अथाभवदरती रोदस्योः ।
तं त्वा देवासोऽजनयन्त देवं वैश्वानर ज्योतिरिदार्याय॥
verses.tr: mūrdhā divo nābhiragniḥ pṛthivyā athābhavadaratī rodasyoḥ taṃ tvā devāso'janayanta devaṃ vaiśvānara jyotiridāryāya
verses.en: The forehead of the sky, earth's centre, Agni became the messenger of earth and heaven. Vaisvanara, the Deities produced thee, a God, to be a light unto the Arya.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्ये न रश्मयो ध्रुवासो वैश्वानरे दधिरेऽग्ना वसूनि ।
या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु या मानुषेष्वसि तस्य राजा॥
verses.tr: ā sūrye na raśmayo dhruvāso vaiśvānare dadhire'gnā vasūni yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu yā mānuṣeṣvasi tasya rājā
verses.en: As in the Sun firm rays are set for ever, treasures are in Vaisvanara, in Agni. Of all the riches in the hills, the waters, the herbs, among mankind, thou art the Sovran.

verses.sa:
बृहती इव सूनवे रोदसी गिरो होता मनुष्यो ३ न दक्षः ।
स्वर्वते सत्यशुष्माय पूर्वीर्वैश्वानराय नृतमाय यह्वीः॥
verses.tr: bṛhatī iva sūnave rodasī giro hotā manuṣyo 3 na dakṣaḥ svarvate satyaśuṣmāya pūrvīrvaiśvānarāya nṛtamāya yahvīḥ
verses.en: As the great World-halves, so are their Son's praises; skilled, as a man, to act, is he the Herald. Vaisvanara, celestial, truly mighty, most manly One, hath many a youthful consort.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चित् ते बृहतो जातवेदो वैश्वानर प्र रिरिचे महित्वम् ।
राजा कृष्टीनामसि मानुषीणां युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: divaścit te bṛhato jātavedo vaiśvānara pra ririce mahitvam rājā kṛṣṭīnāmasi mānuṣīṇāṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha
verses.en: Even the lofty heaven, O Jatavedas Vaisvanara, hath not attained thy greatness. Thou art the King of lands where men are settled, thou hast brought comfort to the Gods in battle.

verses.sa:
प्र नू महित्वं वृषभस्य वोचं यं पूरवो वृत्रहणं सचन्ते ।
वैश्वानरो दस्युमग्निर्जघन्वाँ अधूनोत् काष्ठा अव शम्बरं भेत्॥
verses.tr: pra nū mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya vocaṃ yaṃ pūravo vṛtrahaṇaṃ sacante vaiśvānaro dasyumagnirjaghanvāṃ adhūnot kāṣṭhā ava śambaraṃ bhet
verses.en: Now will I tell the greatness of the Hero whom Puru's sons follow as Vrtra's slayer: Agni Vaisvanara struck down the Dasyu, cleave Sambara through and shattered down his fences.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो महिम्ना विश्वकृष्टिर्भरद्वाजेषु यजतो विभावा ।
शातवनेये शतिनीभिरग्निः पुरुणीथे जरते सूनृतावान्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro mahimnā viśvakṛṣṭirbharadvājeṣu yajato vibhāvā śātavaneye śatinībhiragniḥ puruṇīthe jarate sūnṛtāvān
verses.en: Vaisvanara, dwelling by his might with all men, far-shining, holy mid the Bharadvajas, Is lauded, excellent, with hundred praises by Purunitha, son of Satavani.

verses.sa:
वह्निं यशसं विदथस्य केतुं सुप्राव्यं दूतं सद्योअर्थम् ।
द्विजन्मानं रयिमिव प्रशस्तं रातिं भरद् भृगवे मातरिश्वा॥
verses.tr: vahniṃ yaśasaṃ vidathasya ketuṃ suprāvyaṃ dūtaṃ sadyoartham dvijanmānaṃ rayimiva praśastaṃ rātiṃ bharad bhṛgave mātariśvā
verses.en: As 'twere Some goodly treasure Matarisvan brought, as a gift, the glorious Priest to Bhrgu, Banner of sacrifice, the good Protector, child of two births, the swiftly moving envoy.

verses.sa:
अस्य शासुरुभयासः सचन्ते हविष्मन्त उशिजो ये च मर्ताः ।
दिवश्चित् पूर्वो न्यसादि होता ऽऽपृच्छ्यो विश्पतिर्विक्षु वेधाः॥
verses.tr: asya śāsurubhayāsaḥ sacante haviṣmanta uśijo ye ca martāḥ divaścit pūrvo nyasādi hotā ''pṛcchyo viśpatirvikṣu vedhāḥ
verses.en: Both Gods and men obey this Ruler's order, Gods who are worshipped, men who yearn and worship. As Priest he takes his seat ere break of morning, House-Lord, adorable with men, Ordainer.

verses.sa:
तं नव्यसी हृद आ जायमानमस्मत् सुकीर्तिर्मधुजिह्वमश्याः ।
यमृत्विजो वृजने मानुषासः प्रयस्वन्त आयवो जीजनन्त॥
verses.tr: taṃ navyasī hṛda ā jāyamānamasmat sukīrtirmadhujihvamaśyāḥ yamṛtvijo vṛjane mānuṣāsaḥ prayasvanta āyavo jījananta
verses.en: May our fair praise, heart-born, most recent, reach him whose tongue, e'en at his birth, is sweet as honey; Whom mortal priests, men, with their strong endeavour, supplied with dainty viands, have created.

verses.sa:
उशिक् पावको वसुर्मानुषेषु वरेण्यो होताधायि विक्षु ।
दमूना गृहपतिर्दम आँ अग्निर्भुवद् रयिपती रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: uśik pāvako vasurmānuṣeṣu vareṇyo hotādhāyi vikṣu damūnā gṛhapatirdama āṃ agnirbhuvad rayipatī rayīṇām
verses.en: Good to mankind, the yearning Purifier hath among men been placed as Priest choice-worthy. May Agni be our Friend, Lord of the Household, protector of the riches in the dwelling.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं पतिमग्ने रयीणां प्र शंसामो मतिभिर्गोतमासः ।
आशुं न वाजम्भरं मर्जयन्तः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vayaṃ patimagne rayīṇāṃ pra śaṃsāmo matibhirgotamāsaḥ āśuṃ na vājambharaṃ marjayantaḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: As such we Gotamas with hymns extol thee, O Agni, as the guardian Lord of riches, Decking thee like a horse, the swift prizewinner. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र तवसे तुराय प्रयो न हर्मि स्तोमं माहिनाय ।
ऋचीषमायाध्रिगव ओहमिन्द्राय ब्रह्माणि राततमा॥
verses.tr: asmā idu pra tavase turāya prayo na harmi stomaṃ māhināya ṛcīṣamāyādhrigava ohamindrāya brahmāṇi rātatamā
verses.en: Even to him, swift, strong and high. exalted, I bring my song of praise as dainty viands, My thought to him resistless, praise-deserving, prayers offered most especially to Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्रय इव प्र यंसि भराम्याङ्गूषं बाधे सुवृक्ति ।
इन्द्राय हृदा मनसा मनीषा प्रत्नाय पत्ये धियो मर्जयन्त॥
verses.tr: asmā idu praya iva pra yaṃsi bharāmyāṅgūṣaṃ bādhe suvṛkti indrāya hṛdā manasā manīṣā pratnāya patye dhiyo marjayanta
verses.en: Praise, like oblation, I present, and utter aloud my song, my fair hymn to the Victor. For Indra, who is Lord of old, the singers have decked their lauds with heart and mind and spirit.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यमुपमं स्वर्षां भराम्याङ्गूषमास्येन ।
मंहिष्ठमच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनां सुवृक्तिभिः सूरिं वावृधध्यै॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tyamupamaṃ svarṣāṃ bharāmyāṅgūṣamāsyena maṃhiṣṭhamacchoktibhirmatīnāṃ suvṛktibhiḥ sūriṃ vāvṛdhadhyai
verses.en: To him then with my lips mine adoration, winning heaven's light, most excellent, I offer, To magnify with songs of invocation and with fair hymns the Lord, most bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु स्तोमं सं हिनोमि रथं न तष्टेव तत्सिनाय ।
गिरश्च गिर्वाहसे सुवृक्तीन्द्राय विश्वमिन्वं मेधिराय॥
verses.tr: asmā idu stomaṃ saṃ hinomi rathaṃ na taṣṭeva tatsināya giraśca girvāhase suvṛktīndrāya viśvaminvaṃ medhirāya
verses.en: Even for him I frame a laud, as fashions the wright a chariot for the man who needs it,-- Praises to him who gladly hears our praises, a hymn well-formed, all-moving, to wise Indra.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु सप्तिमिव श्रवस्येन्द्रायार्कं जुह्वा ३ समञ्जे ।
वीरं दानौकसं वन्दध्यै पुरां गूर्तश्रवसं दर्माणम्॥
verses.tr: asmā idu saptimiva śravasyendrāyārkaṃ juhvā 3 samañje vīraṃ dānaukasaṃ vandadhyai purāṃ gūrtaśravasaṃ darmāṇam
verses.en: So with my tongue I deck, to please that Indra, my hymn, as 'twere a horse, through love of glory, To reverence the Hero, bounteous Giver, famed far and wide, destroyer of the castles.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्वष्टा तक्षद् वज्रं स्वपस्तमं स्वर्यं १ रणाय ।
वृत्रस्य चिद् विदद्येन मर्म तुजन्नीशानस्तुजता कियेधाः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tvaṣṭā takṣad vajraṃ svapastamaṃ svaryaṃ 1 raṇāya vṛtrasya cid vidadyena marma tujannīśānastujatā kiyedhāḥ
verses.en: Even for him hath Tvastar forged the thunder, most deftly wrought, celestial, for the battle, Wherewith he reached the vital parts of Vrtra, striking-the vast, the mighty with the striker.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु मातुः सवनेषु सद्यो महः पितुं पपिवाञ्चार्वन्ना ।
मुषायद् विष्णुः पचतं सहीयान् विध्यद् वराहं तिरो अद्रिमस्ता॥
verses.tr: asyedu mātuḥ savaneṣu sadyo mahaḥ pituṃ papivāñcārvannā muṣāyad viṣṇuḥ pacataṃ sahīyān vidhyad varāhaṃ tiro adrimastā
verses.en: As soon as, at libations of his mother, great Visnu had drunk up the draught, he plundered. The dainty cates, the cooked mess; but One stronger transfixed the wild boar, shooting through the mountain.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु ग्नाश्चिद् देवपत्नीरिन्द्रायार्कमहिहत्य ऊवुः ।
परि द्यावापृथिवी जभ्र उर्वी नास्य ते महिमानं परि ष्टः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu gnāścid devapatnīrindrāyārkamahihatya ūvuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī jabhra urvī nāsya te mahimānaṃ pari ṣṭaḥ
verses.en: To him, to Indra, when he slew the Dragon, the Dames, too, Consorts of the Gods, wove praises. The mighty heaven and earth hath he encompassed: thy greatness heaven and earth, combined, exceed not.

verses.sa:
अस्येदेव प्र रिरिचे महित्वं दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्यन्तरिक्षात् ।
स्वराळिन्द्रो दम आ विश्वगूर्तः स्वरिरमत्रो ववक्षे रणाय॥
verses.tr: asyedeva pra ririce mahitvaṃ divaspṛthivyāḥ paryantarikṣāt svarāḻindro dama ā viśvagūrtaḥ svariramatro vavakṣe raṇāya
verses.en: Yea, of a truth, his magnitude surpasseth the magnitude of earth, mid-air, and heaven. Indra, approved by all men, self-resplendent, waxed in his home, loud-voiced and strong for battle.

verses.sa:
अस्येदेव शवसा शुषन्तं वि वृश्चद् वज्रेण वृत्रमिन्द्रः ।
गा न व्राणा अवनीरमुञ्चदभि श्रवो दावने सचेताः॥
verses.tr: asyedeva śavasā śuṣantaṃ vi vṛścad vajreṇa vṛtramindraḥ gā na vrāṇā avanīramuñcadabhi śravo dāvane sacetāḥ
verses.en: Through his own strength Indra with bolt of thunder cut piece-meal Vrtra, drier up of waters. He let the floods go free, like cows imprisoned, for glory, with a heart inclined to bounty.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु त्वेषसा रन्त सिन्धवः परि यद् वज्रेण सीमयच्छत् ।
ईशानकृद् दाशुषे दशस्यन् तुर्वीतये गाधं तुर्वणिः कः॥
verses.tr: asyedu tveṣasā ranta sindhavaḥ pari yad vajreṇa sīmayacchat īśānakṛd dāśuṣe daśasyan turvītaye gādhaṃ turvaṇiḥ kaḥ
verses.en: The rivers played, through his impetuous splendour, since with his bolt he compassed them on all sides. Using his might and favouring him who worshipped, he made a ford, victorious, for Turviti.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु प्र भरा तूतुजानो वृत्राय वज्रमीशानः कियेधाः ।
गोर्न पर्व वि रदा तिरश्चेष्यन्नर्णांस्यपां चरध्यै॥
verses.tr: asmā idu pra bharā tūtujāno vṛtrāya vajramīśānaḥ kiyedhāḥ gorna parva vi radā tiraśceṣyannarṇāṃsyapāṃ caradhyai
verses.en: Vast, with thine ample power, with eager movement, against this Vrtra cast thy bolt of thunder. Rend thou his joints, as of an ox, dissevered, with bolt oblique, that floods of rain may follow.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु प्र ब्रूहि पूर्व्याणि तुरस्य कर्माणि नव्य उक्थैः ।
युधे यदिष्णान आयुधान्यृघायमाणो निरिणाति शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: asyedu pra brūhi pūrvyāṇi turasya karmāṇi navya ukthaiḥ yudhe yadiṣṇāna āyudhānyṛghāyamāṇo niriṇāti śatrūn
verses.en: Sing with new lauds his exploits wrought aforetime, the deeds of him, yea, him who moveth swiftly, When, hurling forth his weapons in the battle, he with impetuous wrath lays low the foemen.

verses.sa:
अस्येदु भिया गिरयश्च दृह्ला द्यावा च भूमा जनुषस्तुजेते ।
उपो वेनस्य जोगुवान ओणिं सद्यो भुवद् वीर्याय नोधाः॥
verses.tr: asyedu bhiyā girayaśca dṛhlā dyāvā ca bhūmā januṣastujete upo venasya joguvāna oṇiṃ sadyo bhuvad vīryāya nodhāḥ
verses.en: When he, yea, he, comes forth the firm. Set mountains and the whole heaven and earth, tremble for terror. May Nodhas, ever praising the protection of that dear Friend, gain quickly strength heroic.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इदु त्यदनु दाय्येषामेको यद् वव्ने भूरेरीशानः ।
प्रैतशं सूर्ये पस्पृधानं सौवश्व्ये सुष्विमावदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: asmā idu tyadanu dāyyeṣāmeko yad vavne bhūrerīśānaḥ praitaśaṃ sūrye paspṛdhānaṃ sauvaśvye suṣvimāvadindraḥ
verses.en: Now unto him of these things hath been given what he who rules alone o'er much, electeth. Indra hath helped Etasa, Soma-presser, contending in the race of steeds with Surya.

verses.sa:
एवा ते हारियोजना सुवृक्तीन्द्र ब्रह्माणि गोतमासो अक्रन् ।
ऐषु विश्वपेशसं धियं धाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: evā te hāriyojanā suvṛktīndra brahmāṇi gotamāso akran aiṣu viśvapeśasaṃ dhiyaṃ dhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Thus to thee, Indra, yoker of Bay Coursers, the Gotamas have brought their prayers to please thee. Bestow upon them thought, decked with all beauty. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
प्र मन्महे शवसानाय शूषमाङ्गूषं गिर्वणसे अङ्गिरस्वत् ।
सुवृक्तिभिः स्तुवत ऋग्मियायाऽर्चामार्कं नरे विश्रुताय॥
verses.tr: pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣamāṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat suvṛktibhiḥ stuvata ṛgmiyāyā'rcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya
verses.en: Like Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty. Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे महि नमो भरध्वमाङ्गूष्यं शवसानाय साम ।
येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञा अर्चन्तो अङ्गिरसो गा अविन्दन्॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamāṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan
verses.en: Unto the great bring ye great adoration, a chant with praise to him exceeding mighty, Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises and knowing well the places, found the cattle.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्याङ्गिरसां चेष्टौ विदत् सरमा तनयाय धासिम् ।
बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद् गाः समुस्रियाभिर्वावशन्त नरः॥
verses.tr: indrasyāṅgirasāṃ ceṣṭau vidat saramā tanayāya dhāsim bṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidad gāḥ samusriyābhirvāvaśanta naraḥ
verses.en: When Indra and the Angirases desired it, Sarama found provision for her offspring. Brhaspati cleft the mountain, found the cattle: the heroes shouted with the kine in triumph.

verses.sa:
स सुष्टुभा स स्तुभा सप्त विप्रैः स्वरेणाद्रिं स्वर्यो ३ नवग्वैः ।
सरण्युभिः फलिगमिन्द्र शक्र वलं रवेण दरयो दशग्वैः॥
