verses.tr: sa suṣṭubhā sa stubhā sapta vipraiḥ svareṇādriṃ svaryo 3 navagvaiḥ saraṇyubhiḥ phaligamindra śakra valaṃ raveṇa darayo daśagvaiḥ
verses.en: Mid shout, loud shout, and roar, with the Navagvas, seven singers, hast thou, heavenly, rent the mountain; Thou hast, with speeders, with Dasagvas, Indra, Sakra, with thunder rent obstructive Vala.

verses.sa:
गृणानो अङ्गिरोभिर्दस्म वि वरुषसा सूर्येण गोभिरन्धः ।
वि भूम्या अप्रथय इन्द्र सानु दिवो रज उपरमस्तभायः॥
verses.tr: gṛṇāno aṅgirobhirdasma vi varuṣasā sūryeṇa gobhirandhaḥ vi bhūmyā aprathaya indra sānu divo raja uparamastabhāyaḥ
verses.en: Praised by Angirases, thou, foe-destroyer, hast, with the Dawn, Sun, rays, dispelled the darkness. Thou Indra, hast spread out the earth's high ridges, and firmly fixed the region under heaven.

verses.sa:
तदु प्रयक्षतममस्य कर्म दस्मस्य चारुतममस्ति दंसः ।
उपह्वरे यदुपरा अपिन्वन् मध्वर्णसो नद्य १ श्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: tadu prayakṣatamamasya karma dasmasya cārutamamasti daṃsaḥ upahvare yaduparā apinvan madhvarṇaso nadya 1 ścatasraḥ
verses.en: This is the deed most worthy of all honour, the fairest marvel of the Wonder-Worker, That, nigh where heaven bends down, he made four rivers flow full with waves that carry down sweet water.

verses.sa:
द्विता वि वव्रे सनजा सनीळे अयास्यः स्तवमानेभिरर्कैः ।
भगो न मेने परमे व्योमन्नधारयद् रोदसी सुदंसाः॥
verses.tr: dvitā vi vavre sanajā sanīḻe ayāsyaḥ stavamānebhirarkaiḥ bhago na mene parame vyomannadhārayad rodasī sudaṃsāḥ
verses.en: Unwearied, won with lauding hymns, he parted of old the ancient Pair, united ever. In highest sky like Bhaga, he the doer of marvels set both Dames and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
सनाद् दिवं परि भूमा विरूपे पुनर्भुवा युवती स्वेभिरेवैः ।
कृष्णेभिरक्तोषा रुशद्भिर्वपुर्भिरा चरतो अन्यान्या॥
verses.tr: sanād divaṃ pari bhūmā virūpe punarbhuvā yuvatī svebhirevaiḥ kṛṣṇebhiraktoṣā ruśadbhirvapurbhirā carato anyānyā
verses.en: Still born afresh, young Dames, each in her manner, unlike in hue, the Pair in alternation Round heaven and earth from ancient time have travelled, Night with her dark limbs, Dawn with limbs of splendour.

verses.sa:
सनेमि सख्यं स्वपस्यमानः सूनुर्दाधार शवसा सुदंसाः ।
आमासु चिद् दधिषे पक्वमन्तः पयः कृष्णासु रुशद् रोहिणीषु॥
verses.tr: sanemi sakhyaṃ svapasyamānaḥ sūnurdādhāra śavasā sudaṃsāḥ āmāsu cid dadhiṣe pakvamantaḥ payaḥ kṛṣṇāsu ruśad rohiṇīṣu
verses.en: Rich in good actions, skilled in operation, the Son with might maintains his perfect friendship. Thou in the raw cows, black of hue or ruddy, storest the ripe milk glossy white in colour.

verses.sa:
सनात् सनीळा अवनीरवाता व्रता रक्षन्ते अमृताः सहोभिः ।
पुरू सहस्रा जनयो न पत्नीर्दुवस्यन्ति स्वसारो अह्रयाणम्॥
verses.tr: sanāt sanīḻā avanīravātā vratā rakṣante amṛtāḥ sahobhiḥ purū sahasrā janayo na patnīrduvasyanti svasāro ahrayāṇam
verses.en: Their paths, of old connected, rest uninjured; they with great might preserve the immortal statutes. For many thousand holy works the Sisters wait on the haughty Lord like wives and matrons.

verses.sa:
सनायुवो नमसा नव्यो अर्कैर्वसूयवो मतयो दस्म दद्रुः ।
पतिं न पत्नीरुशतीरुशन्तं स्पृशन्ति त्वा शवसावन् मनीषाः॥
verses.tr: sanāyuvo namasā navyo arkairvasūyavo matayo dasma dadruḥ patiṃ na patnīruśatīruśantaṃ spṛśanti tvā śavasāvan manīṣāḥ
verses.en: Thoughts ancient, seeking wealth, with adoration, with newest lauds have sped to thee, O Mighty. As yearning wives cleave to their yearning husband, so cleave our hymns to thee, O Lord most potent.

verses.sa:
सनादेव तव रायो गभस्तौ न क्षीयन्ते नोप दस्यन्ति दस्म ।
द्युमाँ असि क्रतुमाँ इन्द्र धीरः शिक्षा शचीवस्तव नः शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: sanādeva tava rāyo gabhastau na kṣīyante nopa dasyanti dasma dyumāṃ asi kratumāṃ indra dhīraḥ śikṣā śacīvastava naḥ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Strong God, the riches which thy hands have holden from days of old have perished not nor wasted. Splendid art thou, O Indra, wise, unbending: strengthen us with might, O Lord of Power.

verses.sa:
सनायते गोतम इन्द्र नव्यमतक्षद् ब्रह्म हरियोजनाय ।
सुनीथाय नः शवसान नोधाः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: sanāyate gotama indra navyamatakṣad brahma hariyojanāya sunīthāya naḥ śavasāna nodhāḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: O mighty Indra, Gotama's son Nodhas hath fashioned this new prayer to thee Eternal, Sure leader, yoker of the Tawny Coursers. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
त्वं महाँ इन्द्र यो ह शुष्मैर्द्यावा जज्ञानः पृथिवी अमे धाः ।
यद्ध ते विश्वा गिरयश्चिदभ्वा भिया दृह्लासः किरणा नैजन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ mahāṃ indra yo ha śuṣmairdyāvā jajñānaḥ pṛthivī ame dhāḥ yaddha te viśvā girayaścidabhvā bhiyā dṛhlāsaḥ kiraṇā naijan
verses.en: Thou art the Mighty One; when born, O Indra, with power thou terrifiedst earth and heaven; When, in their fear of thee, all firm-set mountains and monstrous creatures shook like dust before thee.

verses.sa:
आ यद्धरी इन्द्र विव्रता वेरा ते वज्रं जरिता बाह्वोर्धात् ।
येनाविहर्यतक्रतो अमित्रान् पुर इष्णासि पुरुहूत पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: ā yaddharī indra vivratā verā te vajraṃ jaritā bāhvordhāt yenāviharyatakrato amitrān pura iṣṇāsi puruhūta pūrvīḥ
verses.en: When thy two wandering Bays thou drawest hither, thy praiser laid within thine arms the thunder, Wherewith, O Much-invoked, in will resistless, thou smitest foemen down and many a castle.

verses.sa:
त्वं सत्य इन्द्र धृष्णुरेतान् त्वमृभुक्षा नर्यस्त्वं षाट् ।
त्वं शुष्णं वृजने पृक्ष आणौ यूने कुत्साय द्युमते सचाहन्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ satya indra dhṛṣṇuretān tvamṛbhukṣā naryastvaṃ ṣāṭ tvaṃ śuṣṇaṃ vṛjane pṛkṣa āṇau yūne kutsāya dyumate sacāhan
verses.en: Faithful art thou, these thou defiest, Indra; thou art the Rbhus' Lord, heroic, victor. Thou, by his side, for young and glorious Kutsa, with steed and car in battle slewest Susna,

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र चोदीः सखा वृत्रं यद् वज्रिन् वृषकर्मन्नुभ्नाः ।
यद्ध शूर वृषमणः पराचैर्वि दस्यूँर्योनावकृतो वृथाषाट्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadindra codīḥ sakhā vṛtraṃ yad vajrin vṛṣakarmannubhnāḥ yaddha śūra vṛṣamaṇaḥ parācairvi dasyūṃryonāvakṛto vṛthāṣāṭ
verses.en: That, as a friend, thou furtheredst, O Indra, when, Thunderer, strong in act, thou crushedst Vrtra; When, Hero, thou, great-souled, with easy conquest didst rend the Dasyus in their distant dwelling.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्रारिषण्यन् दृह्लस्य चिन्मर्तानामजुष्टौ ।
व्य १ स्मदा काष्ठा अर्वते वर्घनेव वज्रिञ्छ्नथिह्यमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadindrāriṣaṇyan dṛhlasya cinmartānāmajuṣṭau vya 1 smadā kāṣṭhā arvate varghaneva vajriñchnathihyamitrān
verses.en: This doest thou, and art not harmed, O Indra, e'en in the anger of the strongest mortal. Lay thou the race-course open for our horses: as with a club, slay, Thunder-armed! our foemen.

verses.sa:
त्वां ह त्यदिन्द्रार्णसातौ स्वर्मीह्ले नर आजा हवन्ते ।
तव स्वधाव इयमा समर्य ऊतिर्वाजेष्वतसाय्या भूत्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ ha tyadindrārṇasātau svarmīhle nara ājā havante tava svadhāva iyamā samarya ūtirvājeṣvatasāyyā bhūt
verses.en: Hence men invoke thee, Indra, in the tumult of battle, in the light-bestowing conflict. This aid of thine, O Godlike One, was ever to be implored in deeds of might in combat.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदिन्द्र सप्त युध्यन्पु पुरो वज्रिन् पुरुकुत्साय दर्दः ।
बर्हिर्न यत् सुदासे वृथा वर्गंहो राजन् वरिवः पूरवे कः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ha tyadindra sapta yudhyanpu puro vajrin purukutsāya dardaḥ barhirna yat sudāse vṛthā vargaṃho rājan varivaḥ pūrave kaḥ
verses.en: Warring for Purukutsa thou, O Indra, Thunder-armed! breakest down the seven castles; Easily, for Sudas, like grass didst rend them, and out of need, King, broughtest gain to Puru.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यां न इन्द्र देव चित्रामिषमापो न पीपयः परिज्मन् ।
यया शूर प्रत्यस्मभ्यं यंसि त्मनमूर्जं न विश्वध क्षरध्यै॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyāṃ na indra deva citrāmiṣamāpo na pīpayaḥ parijman yayā śūra pratyasmabhyaṃ yaṃsi tmanamūrjaṃ na viśvadha kṣaradhyai
verses.en: O Indra, God who movest round about us, feed us with varied food plenteous as water- Food wherewithal, O Hero, thou bestowest vigour itself to flow to us for ever.

verses.sa:
अकारि त इन्द्र गोतमेभिर्ब्रह्माण्योक्ता नमसा हरिभ्याम् ।
सुपेशसं वाजमा भरा नः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: akāri ta indra gotamebhirbrahmāṇyoktā namasā haribhyām supeśasaṃ vājamā bharā naḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Prayers have been made by Gotamas, O Indra, addressed to thee, with laud for thy Bay Horses. Bring us in noble shape abundant riches. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
वृष्णे शर्धाय सुमखाय वेधसे नोधः सुवृक्तिं प्र भरा मरुद्भ्यः ।
अपो न धीरो मनसा सुहस्त्यो गिरः समञ्जे विदथेष्वाभुवः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṇe śardhāya sumakhāya vedhase nodhaḥ suvṛktiṃ pra bharā marudbhyaḥ apo na dhīro manasā suhastyo giraḥ samañje vidatheṣvābhuvaḥ
verses.en: Bring for the manly host, wise and majestical, O Nodhas, for the Maruts bring thou a pure gift. I deck my songs as one deft-handed, wise in mind prepares the water that hath power in solemn rites.

verses.sa:
ते जज्ञिरे दिव ऋष्वास उक्षणो रुद्रस्य मर्या असुरा अरेपसः ।
पावकासः शुचयः सूर्या इव सत्वानो न द्रप्सिनो घोरवर्पसः॥
verses.tr: te jajñire diva ṛṣvāsa ukṣaṇo rudrasya maryā asurā arepasaḥ pāvakāsaḥ śucayaḥ sūryā iva satvāno na drapsino ghoravarpasaḥ
verses.en: They spring to birth, the lofty Ones, the Bulls of Heaven, divine, the youths of Rudra, free from spot and stain; The purifiers, shining brightly even as suns, awful of form like giants, scattering rain-drops down.

verses.sa:
युवानो रुद्रा अजरा अभोग्घनो ववक्षुरध्रिगावः पर्वता इव ।
दृह्ला चिद् विश्वा भुवनानि पार्थिवा प्र च्यावयन्ति दिव्यानि मज्मना॥
verses.tr: yuvāno rudrā ajarā abhogghano vavakṣuradhrigāvaḥ parvatā iva dṛhlā cid viśvā bhuvanāni pārthivā pra cyāvayanti divyāni majmanā
verses.en: Young Rudras, demon-slayers, never growing old, they have waxed, even as mountains, irresistible. They make all beings tremble with their mighty strength, even the very strongest, both of earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
चित्रैरञ्जिभिर्वपुषे व्यञ्जते वक्षःसु रुक्माँ अधि येतिरे शुभे ।
अंसेष्वेषां नि मिमृक्षृर्ऋष्टयः साकं जज्ञिरे स्वधया दिवो नरः॥
verses.tr: citrairañjibhirvapuṣe vyañjate vakṣaḥsu rukmāṃ adhi yetire śubhe aṃseṣveṣāṃ ni mimṛkṣṛrṛṣṭayaḥ sākaṃ jajñire svadhayā divo naraḥ
verses.en: With glittering ornaments they deck them forth for show; for beauty on their breasts they bind their chains of gold. The lances on their shoulders pound to pieces; they were born together, of themselves, the Men of Heaven.

verses.sa:
ईशानकृतो धुनयो रिशादसो वातान् विद्युतस्तविषीभिरक्रत ।
दुहन्त्यूधर्दिव्यानि धूतयो भूमिं पिन्वन्ति पयसा परिज्रयः॥
verses.tr: īśānakṛto dhunayo riśādaso vātān vidyutastaviṣībhirakrata duhantyūdhardivyāni dhūtayo bhūmiṃ pinvanti payasā parijrayaḥ
verses.en: Loud roarers, giving strength, devourers of the foe, they make the winds, they make the lightnings with their powers. The restless shakers drain the udders of the sky, and ever wandering round fill the earth full with milk.

verses.sa:
पिन्वन्त्यपो मरुतः सुदानवः पयो घृतवद् विदथेष्वाभुवः ।
अत्यं न मिहे वि नयन्ति वाजिनमुत्सं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: pinvantyapo marutaḥ sudānavaḥ payo ghṛtavad vidatheṣvābhuvaḥ atyaṃ na mihe vi nayanti vājinamutsaṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitam
verses.en: The bounteous Maruts with the fatness dropping milk fill full the waters which avail in solemn rites. They lead, as 'twere, the Strong Horse forth, that it may rain: they milk the thundering, the never-failing spring.

verses.sa:
महिषासो मायिनश्चित्रभानवो गिरयो न स्वतवसो रघुष्यदः ।
मृगा इव हस्तिनः खादथा वना यदारुणीषु तविषीरयुग्ध्वम्॥
verses.tr: mahiṣāso māyinaścitrabhānavo girayo na svatavaso raghuṣyadaḥ mṛgā iva hastinaḥ khādathā vanā yadāruṇīṣu taviṣīrayugdhvam
verses.en: Mighty, with wondrous power and marvellously bright, selfstrong like mountains, ye glide swiftly on your way. Like the wild elephants ye eat the forests up when ye assume your strength among the bright red flames.

verses.sa:
सिंहा इव नानदति प्रचेतसः पिशा इव सुपिशो विश्ववेदसः ।
क्षपो जिन्वन्तः पृषतीभिर्ऋष्टिभिः समित्सबाधः शवसाहिमन्यवः॥
verses.tr: siṃhā iva nānadati pracetasaḥ piśā iva supiśo viśvavedasaḥ kṣapo jinvantaḥ pṛṣatībhirṛṣṭibhiḥ samitsabādhaḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ
verses.en: Exceeding wise they roar like lions mightily, they, all-possessing, are beauteous as antelopes; Stirring the darkness with lances and spotted deer, combined as priests, with serpents' fury through their might.

verses.sa:
रोदसी आ वदता गणश्रियो नृषाचः शूराः शवसाहिमन्यवः ।
आ वन्धुरेष्वमतिर्न दर्शता विद्युन्न तस्थौ मरुतो रथेषु वः॥
verses.tr: rodasī ā vadatā gaṇaśriyo nṛṣācaḥ śūrāḥ śavasāhimanyavaḥ ā vandhureṣvamatirna darśatā vidyunna tasthau maruto ratheṣu vaḥ
verses.en: Heroes who march in companies, befriending man, with serpents' ire through strength, ye greet the earth and heaven. Upon the seats, O Maruts, of your chariots, upon the cars stands lightning visible as light.

verses.sa:
विश्ववेदसो रयिभिः समोकसः संमिश्लासस्तविषीभिर्विरप्शिनः ।
अस्तार इषं दधिरे गभस्त्योरनन्तशुष्मा वृषखादयो नरः॥
verses.tr: viśvavedaso rayibhiḥ samokasaḥ saṃmiślāsastaviṣībhirvirapśinaḥ astāra iṣaṃ dadhire gabhastyoranantaśuṣmā vṛṣakhādayo naraḥ
verses.en: Lords of all riches, dwelling in the home of wealth, endowed with mighty vigour, singers loud of voice, Heroes, of powers infinite, armed with strong men's rings, the archers, they have laid the arrow on their arms.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेभिः पविभिः पयोवृध उज्जिघ्नन्त आपथ्यो ३ न पर्वतान् ।
मखा अयासः स्वसृतो ध्रुवच्युतो दुध्रकृतो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayebhiḥ pavibhiḥ payovṛdha ujjighnanta āpathyo 3 na parvatān makhā ayāsaḥ svasṛto dhruvacyuto dudhrakṛto maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: They who with golden fellies make the rain increase drive forward the big clouds like wanderers on the way. Self-moving, brisk, unwearied, they o'erthrow the firm; the Maruts with bright lances make all things to reel.

verses.sa:
घृषुं पावकं वनिनं विचर्षणिं रुद्रस्य सूनुं हवसा गृणीमसि ।
रजस्तुरं तवसं मारुतं गणमृजीषिणं वृषणं सश्चत श्रिये॥
verses.tr: ghṛṣuṃ pāvakaṃ vaninaṃ vicarṣaṇiṃ rudrasya sūnuṃ havasā gṛṇīmasi rajasturaṃ tavasaṃ mārutaṃ gaṇamṛjīṣiṇaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ saścata śriye
verses.en: The progeny of Rudra we invoke with prayer, the brisk, the bright, the worshipful, the active Ones To the strong band of Maruts cleave for happiness, the chasers of the sky, impetuous, vigorous.

verses.sa:
प्र नू स मर्तः शवसा जनाँ अति तस्थौ व ऊती मरुतो यमावत ।
अर्वद्भिर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिरापृच्छ्यं क्रतुमा क्षेति पुष्यति॥
verses.tr: pra nū sa martaḥ śavasā janāṃ ati tasthau va ūtī maruto yamāvata arvadbhirvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhirāpṛcchyaṃ kratumā kṣeti puṣyati
verses.en: Maruts, the man whom ye have guarded with your help, he verily in strength surpasseth all mankind. Spoil with his steeds he gaineth, treasure with his men; he winneth honourable strength and prospereth.

verses.sa:
चर्कृत्यं मरुतः पृत्सु दुष्टरं द्युमन्तं शुष्मं मघवत्सु धत्तन ।
धनस्पृतमुक्थ्यं विश्वचर्षणिं तोकं पुष्येम तनयं शतं हिमाः॥
verses.tr: carkṛtyaṃ marutaḥ pṛtsu duṣṭaraṃ dyumantaṃ śuṣmaṃ maghavatsu dhattana dhanaspṛtamukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇiṃ tokaṃ puṣyema tanayaṃ śataṃ himāḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, to the worshippers give glorious strength invincible in battle, brilliant, bringing wealth, Praiseworthy, known to all men. May we foster well, during a hundred winters, son and progeny.

verses.sa:
नू ष्ठिरं मरुतो वीरवन्तमृतीषाहं रयिमस्मासु धत्त ।
सहस्रिणं शतिनं शूशुवांसं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: nū ṣṭhiraṃ maruto vīravantamṛtīṣāhaṃ rayimasmāsu dhatta sahasriṇaṃ śatinaṃ śūśuvāṃsaṃ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Will ye then, O ye Maruts, grant us riches, durable, rich in men, defying onslaught. A hundred, thousandfold, ever increasing? May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
पश्वा न तायुं, गुहा चतन्तं नमो युजानं, नमो वहन्तम्॥
सजोषा धीराः, पदैरनु ग्मन्नुप त्वा सीदन्, विश्वे यजत्राः ॥१॥
verses.tr: paśvā na tāyuṃ, guhā catantaṃ namo yujānaṃ, namo vahantam sajoṣā dhīrāḥ, padairanu gmannupa tvā sīdan, viśve yajatrāḥ 1
verses.en: One-MINDED, wise, they tracked thee like a thief lurking in dark cave with a stolen cow: Thee claiming worship, bearing it to Gods: there nigh to thee sate all the Holy Ones.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य देवा, अनु व्रता गुर्भुवत् परिष्टिर्द्यौर्न भूम॥
वर्धन्तीमापः, पन्वा सुशिश्विमृतस्य योना, गर्भे सुजातम् ॥२॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya devā, anu vratā gurbhuvat pariṣṭirdyaurna bhūma vardhantīmāpaḥ, panvā suśiśvimṛtasya yonā, garbhe sujātam 2
verses.en: The Gods approached the ways of holy Law; there was a gathering vast as heaven itself. The waters feed with praise the growing Babe, born nobly in the womb, the seat of Law.

verses.sa:
पुष्टिर्न रण्वा, क्षितिर्न पृथ्वी गिरिर्न भुज्म, क्षोदो न शम्भु॥
अत्यो नाज्मन्, त्सर्गप्रतक्तः सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः, क ईं वराते ॥३॥
verses.tr: puṣṭirna raṇvā, kṣitirna pṛthvī girirna bhujma, kṣodo na śambhu atyo nājman, tsargaprataktaḥ sindhurna kṣodaḥ, ka īṃ varāte 3
verses.en: Like grateful food, like some wide dwelling place, like a fruit-bearing hill, a wholesome stream. Like a steed urged to run in swift career, rushing like Sindhu, who may check his course?

verses.sa:
जामिः सिन्धूनां, भ्रातेव स्वस्रामिभ्यान्न राजा, वनान्यत्ति॥
यद् वातजूतो, वना व्यस्थादग्निर्ह दाति, रोमा पृथिव्याः ॥४॥
verses.tr: jāmiḥ sindhūnāṃ, bhrāteva svasrāmibhyānna rājā, vanānyatti yad vātajūto, vanā vyasthādagnirha dāti, romā pṛthivyāḥ 4
verses.en: Kin as a brother to his sister floods, he eats the woods as a King eats the rich. When through the forest, urged by wind, he spreads, verily Agni shears the hair of earth.

verses.sa:
श्वसित्यप्सु, हंसो न सीदन् क्रत्वा चेतिष्ठो, विशामुषर्भुत्॥
सोमो न वेधा, ऋतप्रजातः पशुर्न शिश्वा, विभुर्दूरेभाः ॥५॥
verses.tr: śvasityapsu, haṃso na sīdan kratvā cetiṣṭho, viśāmuṣarbhut somo na vedhā, ṛtaprajātaḥ paśurna śiśvā, vibhurdūrebhāḥ 5
verses.en: Like a swan sitting in the floods he pants wisest in mind mid men he wakes at morn. A Sage like Soma, sprung from Law, he grew like some young creature, mighty, shining far.

verses.sa:
रयिर्न चित्रा, सूरो न संदृगायुर्न प्राणो, नित्यो न सूनुः॥
तक्वा न भूर्णिर्वना सिषक्ति पयो न धेनुः, शुचिर्विभावा ॥१॥
verses.tr: rayirna citrā, sūro na saṃdṛgāyurna prāṇo, nityo na sūnuḥ takvā na bhūrṇirvanā siṣakti payo na dhenuḥ, śucirvibhāvā 1
verses.en: Like the Sun's glance, like wealth of varied sort, like breath which is the life, like one's own son, Like a swift bird, a cow who yields her milk, pure and refulgent to the wood he speeds.

verses.sa:
दाधार क्षेममोको न रण्वो यवो न पक्वो, जेता जनानाम्॥
ऋषिर्न स्तुभ्वा, विक्षु प्रशस्तो वाजी न प्रीतो, वयो दधाति ॥२॥
verses.tr: dādhāra kṣemamoko na raṇvo yavo na pakvo, jetā janānām ṛṣirna stubhvā, vikṣu praśasto vājī na prīto, vayo dadhāti 2
verses.en: He offers safety like a pleasant home, like ripened corn, the Conqueror of men. Like a Seer lauding, famed among the folk; like a steed friendly he vouchsafes us power.

verses.sa:
दुरोकशोचिः, क्रतुर्न नित्यो जायेव योनावरं विश्वस्मै॥
चित्रो यदभ्राट्, छ्वेतो न विक्षु रथो न रुक्मी, त्वेषः समत्सु ॥३॥
verses.tr: durokaśociḥ, kraturna nityo jāyeva yonāvaraṃ viśvasmai citro yadabhrāṭ, chveto na vikṣu ratho na rukmī, tveṣaḥ samatsu 3
verses.en: With flame insatiate, like eternal might; caring for each one like a dame at home; Bright when he shines forth, whitish mid the folk, like a car, gold-decked, thundering to the fight.

verses.sa:
सेनेव सृष्टामं दधात्यस्तुर्न दिद्युत्, त्वेषप्रतीका॥
यमो ह जातो, यमो जनित्वं जारः कनीनां, पतिर्जनीनाम् ॥४॥
verses.tr: seneva sṛṣṭāmaṃ dadhātyasturna didyut, tveṣapratīkā yamo ha jāto, yamo janitvaṃ jāraḥ kanīnāṃ, patirjanīnām 4
verses.en: He strikes with terror like a dart shot forth, e'en like an archer's arrow tipped with flame; Master of present and of future life, the maidens' lover and the matrons' Lord.

verses.sa:
तं वश्चराथा, वयं वसत्यास्तं न गावो, नक्षन्त इद्धम्॥
सिन्धुर्न क्षोदः, प्र नीचीरैनोन्नवन्त गावः, स्व १ र्दृशीके ॥५॥
verses.tr: taṃ vaścarāthā, vayaṃ vasatyāstaṃ na gāvo, nakṣanta iddham sindhurna kṣodaḥ, pra nīcīrainonnavanta gāvaḥ, sva 1 rdṛśīke 5
verses.en: To him lead all your ways: may we attain the kindled God as cows their home at eve. He drives the flames below as floods their swell: the rays rise up to the fair place of heaven.

verses.sa:
वनेषु जायुर्मर्तेषु मित्रो वृणीते श्रुष्टिं, राजेवाजुर्यम्॥
क्षेमो न साधुः, क्रतुर्न भद्रो भुवत्स्वाधी, र्होता हव्यवाट् ॥१॥
verses.tr: vaneṣu jāyurmarteṣu mitro vṛṇīte śruṣṭiṃ, rājevājuryam kṣemo na sādhuḥ, kraturna bhadro bhuvatsvādhī, rhotā havyavāṭ 1
verses.en: Victorious in the wood, Friend among men, ever he claims obedience as a King. Gracious like peace, blessing like mental power, Priest was he, offering-bearer, full of thought.

verses.sa:
हस्ते दधानो, नृम्णा विश्वान्यमे देवान् धाद् गुहा निषीदन्॥
विदन्तीमत्र, नरो धियंधा हृदा यत् तष्टान् मन्त्राँ अशंसन् ॥२॥
verses.tr: haste dadhāno, nṛmṇā viśvānyame devān dhād guhā niṣīdan vidantīmatra, naro dhiyaṃdhā hṛdā yat taṣṭān mantrāṃ aśaṃsan 2
verses.en: He, bearing in his hand all manly might, crouched in the cavern, struck the Gods with fear. Men filled with understanding find him there, when they have sting prayers formed within their heart.

verses.sa:
अजो न क्षां, दाधार पृथिवीं तस्तम्भ द्यां मन्त्रेभिः सत्यैः॥
प्रिया पदानि, पश्वो नि पाहि विश्वायुरग्ने, गुहा गुहं गाः ॥३॥
verses.tr: ajo na kṣāṃ, dādhāra pṛthivīṃ tastambha dyāṃ mantrebhiḥ satyaiḥ priyā padāni, paśvo ni pāhi viśvāyuragne, guhā guhaṃ gāḥ 3
verses.en: He, like the Unborn, holds the broad earth up; and with effective utterance fixed the sky. O Agni, guard the spots which cattle love: thou, life of all, hast gone from lair to lair.

verses.sa:
य ईं चिकेत, गुहा भवन्तमा यः ससाद धारामृतस्य॥
वि ये चृतन्त्यृता सपन्त आदिद् वसूनि प्र ववाचास्मै ॥४॥
verses.tr: ya īṃ ciketa, guhā bhavantamā yaḥ sasāda dhārāmṛtasya vi ye cṛtantyṛtā sapanta ādid vasūni pra vavācāsmai 4
verses.en: Whoso hath known him dwelling in his lair, and hath approached the stream of holy Law,-- They who release him, paying sacred rites,--truly to such doth he announce great wealth.

verses.sa:
वि यो वीरुत्सु, रोधन्महित्वोत प्रजा, उत प्रसूष्वन्तः॥
चित्तिरपां, दमे विश्वायुः सद्मेव धीराः, संमाय चक्रुः ॥५॥
verses.tr: vi yo vīrutsu, rodhanmahitvota prajā, uta prasūṣvantaḥ cittirapāṃ, dame viśvāyuḥ sadmeva dhīrāḥ, saṃmāya cakruḥ 5
verses.en: He who grows mightily in herbs, within each fruitful mother and each babe she bears, Wise, life of all men, in the waters' home,--for him have sages built as 'twere a seat.

verses.sa:
श्रीणन्नुप स्थाद्, दिवं भुरण्युः स्थातुश्चरथमक्तून् व्यूर्णोत्॥
परि यदेषामेको विश्वेषां भुवद् देवो, देवानां महित्वा॥
verses.tr: śrīṇannupa sthād, divaṃ bhuraṇyuḥ sthātuścarathamaktūn vyūrṇot pari yadeṣāmeko viśveṣāṃ bhuvad devo, devānāṃ mahitvā
verses.en: Commingling, restless, he ascends the sky, unveiling nights and all that stands or moves, As he the sole God is preeminent in greatness among all these other Gods.

verses.sa:
आदित् ते विश्वे क्रतुं जुषन्त शुष्काद् यद् देव, जीवो जनिष्ठाः॥
भजन्त विश्वे, देवत्वं नाम ऋतं सपन्तो, अमृतमेवैः॥
verses.tr: ādit te viśve kratuṃ juṣanta śuṣkād yad deva, jīvo janiṣṭhāḥ bhajanta viśve, devatvaṃ nāma ṛtaṃ sapanto, amṛtamevaiḥ
verses.en: All men are joyful in thy power, O God, that living from the dry wood thou art born. All truly share thy Godhead while they keep, in their accustomed ways, eternal Law.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य प्रेषा ऋतस्य धीतिर्विश्वायुर्विश्वे अपांसि चक्रुः॥
यस्तुभ्यं दाशाद्, यो वा ते शिक्षात् तस्मै चिकित्वान् रयिं दयस्व ॥३॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya preṣā ṛtasya dhītirviśvāyurviśve apāṃsi cakruḥ yastubhyaṃ dāśād, yo vā te śikṣāt tasmai cikitvān rayiṃ dayasva 3
verses.en: Strong is the thought of Law, the Law's behest; all works have they performed; he quickens all. Whoso will bring oblation, gifts to thee, to him, bethinking thee, vouchsafe thou wealth.

verses.sa:
होता निषत्तो, मनोरपत्ये स चिन्न्वासां, पती रयीणाम्॥
इच्छन्त रेतो, मिथस्तनूषु सं जानत स्वैर्दक्षैरमूराः ॥४॥
verses.tr: hotā niṣatto, manorapatye sa cinnvāsāṃ, patī rayīṇām icchanta reto, mithastanūṣu saṃ jānata svairdakṣairamūrāḥ 4
verses.en: Seated as Priest with Manu's progeny, of all these treasures he alone is Lord. Men yearn for children to prolong their line, and are not disappointed in their hope.

verses.sa:
पितुर्न पुत्राः, क्रतुं जुषन्त श्रोषन् ये अस्य, शासं तुरासः॥
वि राय और्णोद्, दुरः पुरुक्षुः पिपेश नाकं, स्तृभिर्दमूनाः ॥५॥
verses.tr: piturna putrāḥ, kratuṃ juṣanta śroṣan ye asya, śāsaṃ turāsaḥ vi rāya aurṇod, duraḥ purukṣuḥ pipeśa nākaṃ, stṛbhirdamūnāḥ 5
verses.en: Eagerly they who hear his word fulfil his wish as sons obey their sire's behest. He, rich in food, unbars his wealth like doors: he, the House-Friend, hath decked heaven's vault with stars.

verses.sa:
शुक्रः शुशुक्वाँ, उषो न जारः पप्रा समीची, दिवो न ज्योतिः॥
परि प्रजातः, क्रत्वा बभूथ भुवो देवानां, पिता पुत्रः सन्॥
verses.tr: śukraḥ śuśukvāṃ, uṣo na jāraḥ paprā samīcī, divo na jyotiḥ pari prajātaḥ, kratvā babhūtha bhuvo devānāṃ, pitā putraḥ san
verses.en: Bright, splendid, like Dawn's lover, he hath filled the two joined worlds as with the light of heaven. When born, with might thou hast encompassed them: Father of Gods, and yet their Son wast thou.

verses.sa:
वेधा अदृप्तो, अग्निर्विजानन्नूधर्न गोनां, स्वाद्मा पितूनाम्॥
जने न शेव, आहूर्यः सन् मध्ये निषत्तो, रण्वो दुरोणे॥
verses.tr: vedhā adṛpto, agnirvijānannūdharna gonāṃ, svādmā pitūnām jane na śeva, āhūryaḥ san madhye niṣatto, raṇvo duroṇe
verses.en: Agni, the Sage, the humble, who discerns like the cow's udder, the sweet taste of food, Like a bliss-giver to be drawn to men, sits gracious in the middle of the house.

verses.sa:
पुत्रो न जातो, रण्वो दुरोणे वाजी न प्रीतो विशो वि तारीत्॥
विशो यदह्वे, नृभिः सनीळा अग्निर्देवत्वा, विश्वान्यश्याः ॥३॥
verses.tr: putro na jāto, raṇvo duroṇe vājī na prīto viśo vi tārīt viśo yadahve, nṛbhiḥ sanīḻā agnirdevatvā, viśvānyaśyāḥ 3
verses.en: Born in the dwelling like a lovely son, pleased, like a strong steed, he bears on the folk. What time the men and I, with heroes, call, may Agni then gain all through Godlike power.

verses.sa:
नकिष्ट एता, व्रता मिनन्ति नृभ्यो यदेभ्यः, श्रुष्टिं चकर्थ॥
तत् तु ते दंसो, यदहन्त्समानैर्नृभिर्यद् युक्तो, विवे रपांसि ॥४॥
verses.tr: nakiṣṭa etā, vratā minanti nṛbhyo yadebhyaḥ, śruṣṭiṃ cakartha tat tu te daṃso, yadahantsamānairnṛbhiryad yukto, vive rapāṃsi 4
verses.en: None breaks these holy laws of thine when thou hast granted audience to these chieftains here. This is thy boast, thou smotest with thy peers, and joined with heroes dravest off disgrace.

verses.sa:
उषो न जारो, विभावोस्रः संज्ञातरूपश्चिकेतदस्मै॥
त्मना वहन्तो दुरो व्यृण्वन् नवन्त विश्वे स्व १ र्दृशीके ॥५॥
verses.tr: uṣo na jāro, vibhāvosraḥ saṃjñātarūpaściketadasmai tmanā vahanto duro vyṛṇvan navanta viśve sva 1 rdṛśīke 5
verses.en: Like the Dawn's lover, spreading light, well-known as hued like morn, may he remember me. They, bearing of themselves, unbar the doors: they all ascend to the fair place of heaven.

verses.sa:
वनेम पूर्वीरर्यो मनीषा अग्निः सुशोको, विश्वान्यश्याः॥
आ दैव्यानि, व्रता चिकित्वाना मानुषस्य, जनस्य जन्म॥
verses.tr: vanema pūrvīraryo manīṣā agniḥ suśoko, viśvānyaśyāḥ ā daivyāni, vratā cikitvānā mānuṣasya, janasya janma
verses.en: May we, the pious, win much food by prayer, may Agni with fair light pervade each act,-- He the observer of the heavenly laws of Gods, and of the race of mortal man.

verses.sa:
गर्भो यो अपां, गर्भो वनानां गर्भश्च स्थातां, गर्भश्चरथाम्॥
अद्रौ चिदस्मा, अन्तर्दुरोणे विशां न विश्वो, अमृतः स्वाधीः॥
verses.tr: garbho yo apāṃ, garbho vanānāṃ garbhaśca sthātāṃ, garbhaścarathām adrau cidasmā, antarduroṇe viśāṃ na viśvo, amṛtaḥ svādhīḥ
verses.en: He who is germ of waters, germ of woods, germ of all things that move not and that move,-- To him even in the rock and in the house: Immortal One, he cares for all mankind.

verses.sa:
स हि क्षपावाँ, अग्नी रयीणां दाशद् यो अस्मा, अरं सूक्तैः॥
एता चिकित्वो, भूमा नि पाहि देवानां जन्म, मर्तांश्च विद्वान् ॥३॥
verses.tr: sa hi kṣapāvāṃ, agnī rayīṇāṃ dāśad yo asmā, araṃ sūktaiḥ etā cikitvo, bhūmā ni pāhi devānāṃ janma, martāṃśca vidvān 3
verses.en: Agni is Lord of riches for the man who serves him readily with sacred songs. Protect these beings thou with careful thought, knowing the races both of Gods and men.

verses.sa:
वर्धान्यं पूर्वीः, क्षपो विरूपाः स्थातुश्च रथमृतप्रवीतम्॥
अराधि होता, स्व १र्निषत्तः कृण्वन् विश्वान्यपांसि सत्या ॥४॥
verses.tr: vardhānyaṃ pūrvīḥ, kṣapo virūpāḥ sthātuśca rathamṛtapravītam arādhi hotā, sva 1rniṣattaḥ kṛṇvan viśvānyapāṃsi satyā 4
verses.en: Whom many dawns and nights, unlike, make strong, whom, born in Law, all things that move and stand,-- He hath been won, Herald who sits in light, making effectual all our holy works.

verses.sa:
गोषु प्रशस्तिं, वनेषु धिषे भरन्त विश्वे, बलिं स्वर्णः॥
वि त्वा नरः, पुरुत्रा सपर्यन् पितुर्न जिव्रेर्वि वेदो भरन्त ॥५॥
verses.tr: goṣu praśastiṃ, vaneṣu dhiṣe bharanta viśve, baliṃ svarṇaḥ vi tvā naraḥ, purutrā saparyan piturna jivrervi vedo bharanta 5
verses.en: Thou settest value on our cows and woods: all shall bring tribute to us to the light. Men have served thee in many and sundry spots, parting, as 'twere, an aged father's wealth.

verses.sa: साधुर्न गृध्नुरस्तेव शूरो यातेव भीमस्त्वेषः समत्सु ॥६॥
verses.tr: sādhurna gṛdhnurasteva śūro yāteva bhīmastveṣaḥ samatsu 6
verses.en: Like a brave archer, like one skilled and bold, a fierce avenger, so he shines in fight.

verses.sa:
उप प्र जिन्वन्नुशतीरुशन्तं पतिं न नित्यं जनयः सनीळाः ।
स्वसारः श्यावीमरुषीमजुष्रञ् चित्रमुच्छन्तीमुषसं न गावः॥
verses.tr: upa pra jinvannuśatīruśantaṃ patiṃ na nityaṃ janayaḥ sanīḻāḥ svasāraḥ śyāvīmaruṣīmajuṣrañ citramucchantīmuṣasaṃ na gāvaḥ
verses.en: Loving the loving One, as wives their husband, the sisters of one home have urged him forward, Bright-coloured, even, as the cows love morning, dark, breaking forth to view, and redly beaming.

verses.sa:
वीळु चिद् दृह्ला पितरो न उक्थैरद्रिं रुजन्नङ्गिरसो रवेण ।
चक्रुर्दिवो बृहतो गातुमस्मे अहः स्वर्विविदुः केतुमुस्राः॥
verses.tr: vīḻu cid dṛhlā pitaro na ukthairadriṃ rujannaṅgiraso raveṇa cakrurdivo bṛhato gātumasme ahaḥ svarvividuḥ ketumusrāḥ
verses.en: Our sires with lauds burst e'en the firm-set fortress, yea, the Angirases, with roar, the mountain. They made for us a way to reach high heaven, they found us day, light, day's sign, beams of morning.

verses.sa:
दधन्नृतं धनयन्नस्य धीतिमादिदर्यो दिधिष्वो ३ विभृत्राः ।
अतृष्यन्तीरपसो यन्त्यच्छा देवाञ्जन्म प्रयसा वर्धयन्तीः॥
verses.tr: dadhannṛtaṃ dhanayannasya dhītimādidaryo didhiṣvo 3 vibhṛtrāḥ atṛṣyantīrapaso yantyacchā devāñjanma prayasā vardhayantīḥ
verses.en: They stablished order, made his service fruitful; then parting them among the longing faithful, Not thirsting after aught, they come, most active, while with sweet food the race of Gods they strengthen.

verses.sa:
मथीद् यदीं विभृतो मातरिश्वा गृहेगृहे श्येतो जेन्यो भूत् ।
आदीं राज्ञे न सहीयसे सचा सन्ना दूत्यं १ भृगवाणो विवाय॥
verses.tr: mathīd yadīṃ vibhṛto mātariśvā gṛhegṛhe śyeto jenyo bhūt ādīṃ rājñe na sahīyase sacā sannā dūtyaṃ 1 bhṛgavāṇo vivāya
verses.en: Since Matarisvan, far-diffused, hath stirred him, and he in every house grown bright and noble, He, Bhrgu-like I hath gone as his companion, as on commission to a greater Sovran.

verses.sa:
महे यत् पित्र ईं रसं दिवे करव त्सरत् पृशन्यश्चिकित्वान् ।
सृजदस्ता धृषता दिद्युमस्मै स्वायां देवो दुहितरि त्विषिं धात्॥
verses.tr: mahe yat pitra īṃ rasaṃ dive karava tsarat pṛśanyaścikitvān sṛjadastā dhṛṣatā didyumasmai svāyāṃ devo duhitari tviṣiṃ dhāt
verses.en: When man poured juice to Heaven, the mighty Father, he knew and freed himself from close embracement. The archer boldly shot at him his arrow, and the God threw his splendour on his Daughter.

verses.sa:
स्व आ यस्तुभ्यं दम आ विभाति नमो वा दाशादुशतो अनु द्यून् ।
वर्धो अग्ने वयो अस्य द्विबर्हा यासद् राया सरथं यं जुनासि॥
verses.tr: sva ā yastubhyaṃ dama ā vibhāti namo vā dāśāduśato anu dyūn vardho agne vayo asya dvibarhā yāsad rāyā sarathaṃ yaṃ junāsi
verses.en: Whoso, hath flames for thee within his dwelling, or brings the worship which thou lovest daily, Do thou of double might increase his substance: may he whom thou incitest meet with riches.

verses.sa:
अग्निं विश्वा अभि पृक्षः सचन्ते समुद्रं न स्रवतः सप्त यह्वीः ।
न जामिभिर्वि चिकिते वयो नो विदा देवेषु प्रमतिं चिकित्वान्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ viśvā abhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante samudraṃ na sravataḥ sapta yahvīḥ na jāmibhirvi cikite vayo no vidā deveṣu pramatiṃ cikitvān
verses.en: All sacrificial viands wait on Agni as the Seven mighty Rivers seek the ocean. Not by our brethren was our food discovered: find with the Gods care for us, thou who knowest.

verses.sa:
आ यदिषे नृपतिं तेज आनट् छुचि रेतो निषिक्तं द्यौरभीके ।
अग्निः शर्धमनवद्यं युवानं स्वाध्यं जनयत् सूदयच्च॥
verses.tr: ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ chuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayat sūdayacca
verses.en: When light hath filled the Lord of men for increase, straight from the heaven descends the limpid moisture. Agni hath brought to light and filled with spirit the youthful host blameless and well providing.

verses.sa:
मनो न योऽध्वनः सद्य एत्येकः सत्रा सूरो वस्व ईशे ।
राजाना मित्रावरुणा सुपाणी गोषु प्रियममृतं रक्षमाणा॥
verses.tr: mano na yo'dhvanaḥ sadya etyekaḥ satrā sūro vasva īśe rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī goṣu priyamamṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇā
verses.en: He who like thought goes swiftly on his journey, the Sun, alone is ever Lord of riches. The Kings with fair hands, Varuna and Mitra, protect the precious nectar in our cattle.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्ने सख्या पित्र्याणि प्र मर्षिष्ठा अभि विदुष्कविः सन् ।
नभो न रूपं जरिमा मिनाति पुरा तस्या अभिशस्तेरधीहि॥
verses.tr: mā no agne sakhyā pitryāṇi pra marṣiṣṭhā abhi viduṣkaviḥ san nabho na rūpaṃ jarimā mināti purā tasyā abhiśasteradhīhi
verses.en: O Agni, break not our ancestral friendship, Sage as thou art, endowed with deepest knowledge. Old age, like gathering cloud, impairs the body: before that evil be come nigh protect me.

verses.sa:
नि काव्या वेधसः शश्वतस्कर्हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि ।
अग्निर्भुवद् रयिपती रयीणां सत्रा चक्राणो अमृतानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: ni kāvyā vedhasaḥ śaśvataskarhaste dadhāno naryā purūṇi agnirbhuvad rayipatī rayīṇāṃ satrā cakrāṇo amṛtāni viśvā
verses.en: Though holding many gifts for men, he humbleth the higher powers of each wise ordainer. Agni is now the treasure-lord of treasures, for ever granting all immortal bounties.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वत्सं परि षन्तं न विन्दन्निच्छन्तो विश्वे अमृता अमूराः ।
श्रमयुवः पदव्यो धियंधास्तस्थुः पदे परमे चार्वग्नेः॥
verses.tr: asme vatsaṃ pari ṣantaṃ na vindannicchanto viśve amṛtā amūrāḥ śramayuvaḥ padavyo dhiyaṃdhāstasthuḥ pade parame cārvagneḥ
verses.en: The Gods infallible all searching found not him, the dear Babe who still is round about us. Worn weary, following his track, devoted, they reached the lovely highest home of Agni.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो यदग्ने शरदस्त्वामिच्छुचिं घृतेन शुचयः सपर्यान् ।
नामानि चिद् दधिरे यज्ञियान्यसूदयन्त तन्व १ः सुजाताः॥
verses.tr: tisro yadagne śaradastvāmicchuciṃ ghṛtena śucayaḥ saparyān nāmāni cid dadhire yajñiyānyasūdayanta tanva 1ḥ sujātāḥ
verses.en: Because with holy oil the pure Ones, Agni, served thee the very pure three autumn seasons, Therefore they won them holy names for worship, and nobly born they dignified their bodies.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी बृहती वेविदानाः प्र रुद्रिया जभ्रिरे यज्ञियासः ।
विदन्मर्तो नेमधिता चिकित्वानग्निं पदे परमे तस्थिवांसम्॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī bṛhatī vevidānāḥ pra rudriyā jabhrire yajñiyāsaḥ vidanmarto nemadhitā cikitvānagniṃ pade parame tasthivāṃsam
verses.en: Making them known to spacious earth and heaven, the holy Ones revealed the powers of Rudra. The mortal band, discerning in the distance, found Agni standing in the loftiest station.

verses.sa:
संजानाना उप सीदन्नभिज्ञु पत्नीवन्तो नमस्यं नमस्यन् ।
रिरिक्वांसस्तन्वः कृण्वत स्वाः सखा सख्युर्निमिषि रक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: saṃjānānā upa sīdannabhijñu patnīvanto namasyaṃ namasyan ririkvāṃsastanvaḥ kṛṇvata svāḥ sakhā sakhyurnimiṣi rakṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Nigh they approached, one-minded, with their spouses, kneeling to him adorable paid worship. Friend finding in his own friend's eye protection, they made their own the bodies which they chastened.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त यद् गुह्यानि त्वे इत् पदाविदन्निहिता यज्ञियासः ।
तेभी रक्षन्ते अमृतं सजोषाः पशूञ्च स्थातॄञ्चरथं च पाहि॥
verses.tr: triḥ sapta yad guhyāni tve it padāvidannihitā yajñiyāsaḥ tebhī rakṣante amṛtaṃ sajoṣāḥ paśūñca sthātṝñcarathaṃ ca pāhi
verses.en: Soon as the holy beings had discovered the thrice-seven mystic things contained within thee, With these, one-minded, they preserve the Amrta: guard thou the life of all their plants and cattle.

verses.sa:
विद्वाँ अग्ने वयुनानि क्षितीनां व्यानुषक् छुरुधो जीवसे धाः ।
अन्तर्विद्वाँ अध्वनो देवयानानतन्द्रो दूतो अभवो हविर्वाट्॥
verses.tr: vidvāṃ agne vayunāni kṣitīnāṃ vyānuṣak churudho jīvase dhāḥ antarvidvāṃ adhvano devayānānatandro dūto abhavo havirvāṭ
verses.en: Thou, Agni, knower of men's works, hast sent us good food in constant course for our subsistence: Thou deeply skilled in paths of Gods becamest an envoy never wearied, offering-bearer.

verses.sa:
स्वाध्यो दिव आ सप्त यह्वी रायो दुरो व्यृतज्ञा अजानन् ।
विदद् गव्यं सरमा दृह्लमूर्वं येना नु कं मानुषी भोजते विट्॥
verses.tr: svādhyo diva ā sapta yahvī rāyo duro vyṛtajñā ajānan vidad gavyaṃ saramā dṛhlamūrvaṃ yenā nu kaṃ mānuṣī bhojate viṭ
verses.en: Knowing the Law, the seven strong floods from heaven, full of good thought, discerned the doors of riches. Sarama found the cattle's firm-built prison whereby the race of man is still supported.

verses.sa:
आ ये विश्वा स्वपत्यानि तस्थुः कृण्वानासो अमृतत्वाय गातुम् ।
मह्ना महद्भिः पृथिवी वि तस्थे माता पुत्रैरदितिर्धायसे वेः॥
verses.tr: ā ye viśvā svapatyāni tasthuḥ kṛṇvānāso amṛtatvāya gātum mahnā mahadbhiḥ pṛthivī vi tasthe mātā putrairaditirdhāyase veḥ
verses.en: They who approached all noble operations making a path that leads to life immortal, To be the Bird's support, the spacious mother, Aditi, and her great Sons stood in power.

verses.sa:
अधि श्रियं नि दधुश्चारुमस्मिन् दिवो यदक्षी अमृता अकृण्वन् ।
अध क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो न सृष्टाः प्र नीचीरग्ने अरुषीरजानन्॥
verses.tr: adhi śriyaṃ ni dadhuścārumasmin divo yadakṣī amṛtā akṛṇvan adha kṣaranti sindhavo na sṛṣṭāḥ pra nīcīragne aruṣīrajānan
verses.en: When Gods immortal made both eyes of heaven, they gave to him the gift of beauteous glory. Now they flow forth like rivers set in motion: they knew the Red Steeds coming down, O Agni.

verses.sa:
रयिर्न यः पितृवित्तो वयोधाः सुप्रणीतिश्चिकितुषो न शासुः ।
स्योनशीरतिथिर्न प्रीणानो होतेव सद्म विधतो वि तारीत्॥
verses.tr: rayirna yaḥ pitṛvitto vayodhāḥ supraṇītiścikituṣo na śāsuḥ syonaśīratithirna prīṇāno hoteva sadma vidhato vi tārīt
verses.en: I. HE who gives food, like patrimonial riches and guides aright like some wise man's instruction, Loved like a guest who lies in pleasant lodging,--may he, as Priest, prosper his servant's dwelling.

verses.sa:
देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा क्रत्वा निपाति वृजनानि विश्वा ।
पुरुप्रशस्तो अमतिर्न सत्य आत्मेव शेवो दिधिषाय्यो भूत्॥
verses.tr: devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā kratvā nipāti vṛjanāni viśvā purupraśasto amatirna satya ātmeva śevo didhiṣāyyo bhūt
verses.en: He who like Savitar the God, true-minded protecteth with his power. all acts of vigour, Truthful, like splendour, glorified by many, like breath joy-giving,--all must strive to win him.

verses.sa:
देवो न यः पृथिवीं विश्वधाया उपक्षेति हितमित्रो न राजा ।
पुरःसदः शर्मसदो न वीरा अनवद्या पतिजुष्टेव नारी॥
verses.tr: devo na yaḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upakṣeti hitamitro na rājā puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā anavadyā patijuṣṭeva nārī
verses.en: He who on earth dwells like a king surrounded by faithful friends, like a God all-sustaining, Like heroes who preside, who sit in safety: like as a blameless dame dear to her husband.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा नरो दम आ नित्यमिद्धमग्ने सचन्त क्षितिषु ध्रुवासु ।
अधि द्युम्नं नि दधुर्भूर्यस्मिन् भवा विश्वायुर्धरुणो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā naro dama ā nityamiddhamagne sacanta kṣitiṣu dhruvāsu adhi dyumnaṃ ni dadhurbhūryasmin bhavā viśvāyurdharuṇo rayīṇām
verses.en: Thee, such, in settlements secure, O Agni, our men serve ever kindled in each dwelling. On him have they laid splendour in abundance: dear to all men, bearer be he of riches.

verses.sa:
वि पृक्षो अग्ने मघवानो अश्युर्वि सूरयो ददतो विश्वमायुः ।
सनेम वाजं समिथेष्वर्यो भागं देवेषु श्रवसे दधानाः॥
verses.tr: vi pṛkṣo agne maghavāno aśyurvi sūrayo dadato viśvamāyuḥ sanema vājaṃ samitheṣvaryo bhāgaṃ deveṣu śravase dadhānāḥ
verses.en: May thy rich worshippers win food, O Agni, and princes gain long life who bring oblation. May we get booty from our foe in battle, presenting to the Gods their share for glory.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य हि धेनवो वावशानाः स्मदूध्नीः पीपयन्त द्युभक्ताः ।
परावतः सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा वि सिन्धवः समया सस्रुरद्रिम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya hi dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ smadūdhnīḥ pīpayanta dyubhaktāḥ parāvataḥ sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā vi sindhavaḥ samayā sasruradrim
verses.en: The cows of holy law, sent us by Heaven, have swelled with laden udders, loudly lowing; Soliciting his favour, from a distance the rivers to the rock have flowed together.

verses.sa:
त्वे अग्ने सुमतिं भिक्षमाणा दिवि श्रवो दधिरे यज्ञियासः ।
नक्ता च चक्रुरुषसा विरूपे कृष्णं च वर्णमरुणं च सं धुः॥
verses.tr: tve agne sumatiṃ bhikṣamāṇā divi śravo dadhire yajñiyāsaḥ naktā ca cakruruṣasā virūpe kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇamaruṇaṃ ca saṃ dhuḥ
verses.en: Agni, with thee, soliciting thy favour, the holy Ones have gained glory in heaven. They made the Night and Dawn of different colours, and set the black and purple hues together.

verses.sa:
यान् राये मर्तान्त्सुषूदो अग्ने ते स्याम मघवानो वयं च ।
छायेव विश्वं भुवनं सिसक्ष्यापप्रिवान् रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: yān rāye martāntsuṣūdo agne te syāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca chāyeva viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sisakṣyāpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam
verses.en: May we and those who worship be the mortals whom thou, O Agni, leadest on to riches. Thou hast filled earth and heaven and air's mid-region, and followest the whole world like a shadow.

verses.sa:
अर्वद्भिरग्ने अर्वतो नृभिर्नॄन् वीरैर्वीरान् वनुयामा त्वोताः ।
ईशानासः पितृवित्तस्य रायो वि सूरयः शतहिमा नो अश्युः॥
verses.tr: arvadbhiragne arvato nṛbhirnṝn vīrairvīrān vanuyāmā tvotāḥ īśānāsaḥ pitṛvittasya rāyo vi sūrayaḥ śatahimā no aśyuḥ
verses.en: Aided by thee, O Agni, may we conquer steeds with steeds, men with men, heroes with heroes, Lords of the wealth transmitted by our fathers: and may our princes live a hundred winters.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्न उचथानि वेधो जुष्टानि सन्तु मनसे हृदे च ।
शकेम रायः सुधुरो यमं ते ऽधि श्रवो देवभक्तं दधानाः॥
verses.tr: etā te agna ucathāni vedho juṣṭāni santu manase hṛde ca śakema rāyaḥ sudhuro yamaṃ te 'dhi śravo devabhaktaṃ dadhānāḥ
verses.en: May these our hymns of praise, Agni, Ordainer, be pleasant to thee in thy heart and spirit. May we have power to hold thy steeds of riches, laying on thee the God-sent gift of glory.

verses.sa: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये । आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते॥
verses.tr: upaprayanto adhvaraṃ mantraṃ vocemāgnaye āre asme ca śṛṇvate
verses.en: As forth to sacrifice we go, a hymn to a hymn let us say, Who hears us even when afar;

verses.sa: यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः संजग्मानासु कृष्टिषु । अरक्षद् दाशुषे गयम्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ snīhitīṣu pūrvyaḥ saṃjagmānāsu kṛṣṭiṣu arakṣad dāśuṣe gayam
verses.en: Who, from of old, in carnage, when the people gathered, hath preserved His household for the worshipper.

verses.sa: उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि । धनंजयो रणेरणे॥
verses.tr: uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvṛtrahājani dhanaṃjayo raṇeraṇe
verses.en: And let men say, Agni is born, e'en he who slayeth Vrtra, he Who winneth wealth in every fight.

verses.sa: यस्य दूतो असि क्षये वेषि हव्यानि वीतये । दस्मत् कृणोष्यध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: yasya dūto asi kṣaye veṣi havyāni vītaye dasmat kṛṇoṣyadhvaram
verses.en: Him in whose house an envoy thou lovest to taste his offered gifts, And strengthenest his sacrifice,

verses.sa: तमित् सुहव्यमङ्गिरः सुदेवं सहसो यहो । जना आहुः सुबर्हिषम्॥
verses.tr: tamit suhavyamaṅgiraḥ sudevaṃ sahaso yaho janā āhuḥ subarhiṣam
verses.en: Him, Angiras, thou Son of Strength, all men call happy in his God, His offerings, and his sacred grass.

verses.sa: आ च वहासि ताँ इह देवाँ उप प्रशस्तये । हव्या सुश्चन्द्र वीतये॥
verses.tr: ā ca vahāsi tāṃ iha devāṃ upa praśastaye havyā suścandra vītaye
verses.en: Hitherward shalt thou bring these Gods to our laudation and to taste. These offered gifts, fair-shining One.

verses.sa: न योरुपब्दिरश्व्यः शृण्वे रथस्य कच्चन । यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम्॥
verses.tr: na yorupabdiraśvyaḥ śṛṇve rathasya kaccana yadagne yāsi dūtyam
verses.en: When, Agni, on thine embassage thou goest not a sound is heard of steed or straining of thy car.

verses.sa: त्वोतो वाज्यह्रयो ऽभि पूर्वस्मादपरः । प्र दाश्वाँ अग्ने अस्थात्॥
verses.tr: tvoto vājyahrayo 'bhi pūrvasmādaparaḥ pra dāśvāṃ agne asthāt
verses.en: Aided by thee uninjured, strong, one after other, goes he forth: Agni, the offerer forward steps.

verses.sa: उत द्युमत् सुवीर्यं बृहदग्ने विवाससि । देवेभ्यो देव दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: uta dyumat suvīryaṃ bṛhadagne vivāsasi devebhyo deva dāśuṣe
verses.en: And splendid strength, heroic, high, Agni, thou grantest from the Gods, Thou God, to him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
जुषस्व सप्रथस्तमं वचो देवप्सरस्तमम् ।
हव्या जुह्वान आसनि॥
verses.tr: juṣasva saprathastamaṃ vaco devapsarastamam havyā juhvāna āsani
verses.en: Accept our loudest-sounding hymn, food most delightful to the Gods, Pouring our offerings in thy mouth.

verses.sa:
अथा ते अङ्गिरस्तमाग्ने वेधस्तम प्रियम् ।
वोचेम ब्रह्म सानसि॥
verses.tr: athā te aṅgirastamāgne vedhastama priyam vocema brahma sānasi
verses.en: Now, Agni, will we say to thee, O wisest and best Angiras, Our precious, much-availing prayer.

verses.sa:
कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः ।
को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: kaste jāmirjanānāmagne ko dāśvadhvaraḥ ko ha kasminnasi śritaḥ
verses.en: Who, Agni, is thy kin, of men? who is thy worthy worshipper? On whom dependent? who art thou?

verses.sa:
त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः ।
सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ jāmirjanānāmagne mitro asi priyaḥ sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ
verses.en: The kinsman, Agni, of mankind, their well beloved Friend art thou, A Friend whom friends may supplicate.

verses.sa:
यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाँ ऋतं बृहत् ।
अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम्॥
verses.tr: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devāṃ ṛtaṃ bṛhat agne yakṣi svaṃ damam
verses.en: Bring to us Mitra, Varuna, bring the Gods to mighty sacrifice. Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

verses.sa:
का त उपेतिर्मनसो वराय भुवदग्ने शंतमा का मनीषा ।
को वा यज्ञैः परि दक्षं त आप केन वा ते मनसा दाशेम॥
verses.tr: kā ta upetirmanaso varāya bhuvadagne śaṃtamā kā manīṣā ko vā yajñaiḥ pari dakṣaṃ ta āpa kena vā te manasā dāśema
verses.en: How may the mind draw nigh to please thee, Agni? What hymn of praise shall bring us greatest blessing? Or who hath gained thy power by sacrifices? or with what mind shall we bring thee oblations?

verses.sa:
एह्यग्न इह होता नि षीदादब्धः सु पुरएता भवा नः ।
अवतां त्वा रोदसी विश्वमिन्वे यजा महे सौमनसाय देवान्॥
verses.tr: ehyagna iha hotā ni ṣīdādabdhaḥ su puraetā bhavā naḥ avatāṃ tvā rodasī viśvaminve yajā mahe saumanasāya devān
verses.en: Come hither, Agni; sit thee down as Hotar; be thou who never wast deceived our leader. May Heaven and Earth, the all-pervading, love thee: worship the Gods to win for us their favour.

verses.sa:
प्र सु विश्वान् रक्षसो धक्ष्यग्ने भवा यज्ञानामभिशस्तिपावा ।
अथा वह सोमपतिं हरिभ्यामातिथ्यमस्मै चकृमा सुदाव्ने॥
verses.tr: pra su viśvān rakṣaso dhakṣyagne bhavā yajñānāmabhiśastipāvā athā vaha somapatiṃ haribhyāmātithyamasmai cakṛmā sudāvne
verses.en: Burn thou up all the Raksasas, O Agni; ward thou off curses from our sacrifices. Bring hither with his Bays the Lord of Soma: here is glad welcome for the Bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
प्रजावता वचसा वह्निरासा ऽऽ च हुवे नि च सत्सीह देवैः ।
वेषि होत्रमुत पोत्रं यजत्र बोधि प्रयन्तर्जनितर्वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: prajāvatā vacasā vahnirāsā '' ca huve ni ca satsīha devaiḥ veṣi hotramuta potraṃ yajatra bodhi prayantarjanitarvasūnām
verses.en: Thou Priest with lip and voice that bring us children hast been invoked. Here with the Gods be seated. Thine is the task of Cleanser and Presenter: waken us, Wealth-bestower and Producer.

verses.sa:
यथा विप्रस्य मनुषो हविर्भिर्देवाँ अयजः कविभिः कविः सन् ।
एवा होतः सत्यतर त्वमद्याग्ने मन्द्रया जुह्वा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: yathā viprasya manuṣo havirbhirdevāṃ ayajaḥ kavibhiḥ kaviḥ san evā hotaḥ satyatara tvamadyāgne mandrayā juhvā yajasva
verses.en: As with oblations of the priestly Manus thou worshippedst the Gods, a Sage with sages, So now, O truthfullest Invoker Agni, worship this day with joy-bestowing ladle.

verses.sa:
कथा दाशेमाग्नये कास्मै देवजुष्टोच्यते भामिने गीः ।
यो मर्त्येष्वमृत ऋतावा होता यजिष्ठ इत् कृणोति देवान्॥
verses.tr: kathā dāśemāgnaye kāsmai devajuṣṭocyate bhāmine gīḥ yo martyeṣvamṛta ṛtāvā hotā yajiṣṭha it kṛṇoti devān
verses.en: How shall we pay oblation unto Agni? What hymn, Godloved, is said to him refulgent? Who, deathless, true to Law, mid men a herald, bringeth the Gods as best of sacrificers?

verses.sa:
यो अध्वरेषु शंतम ऋतावा होता तमू नमोभिरा कृणुध्वम् ।
अग्निर्यद् वेर्मर्ताय देवान्त्स चा बोधाति मनसा यजाति॥
verses.tr: yo adhvareṣu śaṃtama ṛtāvā hotā tamū namobhirā kṛṇudhvam agniryad vermartāya devāntsa cā bodhāti manasā yajāti
verses.en: Bring him with reverence hither, most propitious in sacrifices, true to Law, the herald; For Agni, when he seeks the Gods for mortals, knows them full well and worships them in spirit.

verses.sa:
स हि क्रतुः स मर्यः स साधुर्मित्रो न भूदद्भुतस्य रथीः ।
तं मेधेषु प्रथमं देवयन्तीर्विश उप ब्रुवते दस्ममारीः॥
verses.tr: sa hi kratuḥ sa maryaḥ sa sādhurmitro na bhūdadbhutasya rathīḥ taṃ medheṣu prathamaṃ devayantīrviśa upa bruvate dasmamārīḥ
verses.en: For he is mental power, a man, and perfect; he is the bringer, friend-like, of the wondrous. The pious Aryan tribes at sacrifices address them first to him who doeth marvels.

verses.sa:
स नो नृणां नृतमो रिशादा अग्निर्गिरोऽवसा वेतु धीतिम् ।
तना च ये मघवानः शविष्ठा वाजप्रसूता इषयन्त मन्म॥
verses.tr: sa no nṛṇāṃ nṛtamo riśādā agnirgiro'vasā vetu dhītim tanā ca ye maghavānaḥ śaviṣṭhā vājaprasūtā iṣayanta manma
verses.en: May Agni, foe-destroyer, manliest Hero, accept with love our hymns and our devotion. So may the liberal lords whose strength is strongest, urged by their riches, stir our thoughts with vigour.

verses.sa:
एवाग्निर्गोतमेभिर्ऋतावा विप्रेभिरस्तोष्ट जातवेदाः ।
स एषु द्युम्नं पीपयत् स वाजं स पुष्टिं याति जोषमा चिकित्वान्॥
verses.tr: evāgnirgotamebhirṛtāvā viprebhirastoṣṭa jātavedāḥ sa eṣu dyumnaṃ pīpayat sa vājaṃ sa puṣṭiṃ yāti joṣamā cikitvān
verses.en: Thus Agni Jatavedas, true to Order, hath by the priestly Gotamas been lauded. May he augment in them splendour and vigour: observant, as he lists, he gathers increase.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा गोतमा गिरा जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā gotamā girā jātavedo vicarṣaṇe dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ
verses.en: O JATAVEDAS, keen and swift, we Gotamas with sacred song exalt thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा गोतमो गिरा रायस्कामो दुवस्यति ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā gotamo girā rāyaskāmo duvasyati dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ
verses.en: Thee, as thou art, desiring wealth Gotama worships with his song: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा वाजसातममङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā vājasātamamaṅgirasvaddhavāmahe dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ
verses.en: As such, like Angiras we call on thee best winner of the spoil: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा वृत्रहन्तमं यो दस्यूँरवधूनुषे ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā vṛtrahantamaṃ yo dasyūṃravadhūnuṣe dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ
verses.en: Thee, best of Vrtra-slayers, thee who shakest off our Dasyu foes: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम रहूगणा अग्नये मधुमद् वचः ।
द्युम्नैरभि प्र णोनुमः॥
verses.tr: avocāma rahūgaṇā agnaye madhumad vacaḥ dyumnairabhi pra ṇonumaḥ
verses.en: A pleasant song to Agni we, sons of Rahugana, have sung: We laud thee for thy glories' sake.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकेशो रजसो विसारे ऽहिर्धुनिर्वात इव ध्रजीमान् ।
शुचिभ्राजा उषसो नवेदा यशस्वतीरपस्युवो न सत्याः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāre 'hirdhunirvāta iva dhrajīmān śucibhrājā uṣaso navedā yaśasvatīrapasyuvo na satyāḥ
verses.en: He in mid-air's expanse hath golden tresses; a raging serpent, like the rushing tempest: Purely refulgent, knowing well the morning; like honourable dames, true, active workers.

verses.sa:
आ ते सुपर्णा अमिनन्तँ एवैः कृष्णो नोनाव वृषभो यदीदम् ।
शिवाभिर्न स्मयमानाभिरागात् पतन्ति मिहः स्तनयन्त्यभ्रा॥
verses.tr: ā te suparṇā aminantaṃ evaiḥ kṛṣṇo nonāva vṛṣabho yadīdam śivābhirna smayamānābhirāgāt patanti mihaḥ stanayantyabhrā
verses.en: Thy well-winged flashes strengthen in their manner, when the black Bull hath bellowed round about us. With drops that bless and seem to smile he cometh: the waters fall, the clouds utter their thunder.

verses.sa:
यदीमृतस्य पयसा पियानो नयन्नृतस्य पथिभी रजिष्ठैः ।
अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः परिज्मा त्वचं पृञ्चन्त्युपरस्य योनौ॥
verses.tr: yadīmṛtasya payasā piyāno nayannṛtasya pathibhī rajiṣṭhaiḥ aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā tvacaṃ pṛñcantyuparasya yonau
verses.en: When he comes streaming with the milk of worship, conducting by directest paths of Order Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, Parijman fill the hide full where lies the nether press-stone.

verses.sa: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः॥
verses.tr: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jatavedas, high renown.

verses.sa: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीळेन्यो गिरा । रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: sa idhāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḻenyo girā revadasmabhyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi
verses.en: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

verses.sa: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः । स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति॥
verses.tr: kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasaḥ sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati
verses.en: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks, Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Raksasas.

verses.sa: अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि । विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य॥
verses.tr: avā no agna ūtibhirgāyatrasya prabharmaṇi viśvāsu dhīṣu vandya
verses.en: Adorable in all our rites, favour us, Agni, with thine aid, When the great hymn is chanted forth.

verses.sa: आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् । विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: ā no agne rayiṃ bhara satrāsāhaṃ vareṇyam viśvāsu pṛtsu duṣṭaram
verses.en: Bring to us ever-conquering wealth, wealth, Agni, worthy of our choice, In all our frays invincible.

verses.sa: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् । मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: ā no agne sucetunā rayiṃ viśvāyupoṣasam mārḍīkaṃ dhehi jīvase
verses.en: Give us, O Agni, through thy grace wealth that supporteth all our life, Thy favour so that we may live.

verses.sa: प्र पूतास्तिग्मशोचिषे वाचो गोतमाग्नये । भरस्व सुम्नयुर्गिरः॥
verses.tr: pra pūtāstigmaśociṣe vāco gotamāgnaye bharasva sumnayurgiraḥ
verses.en: O Gotama, desiring bliss present thy songs composed with care To Agni of the pointed flames.

verses.sa: यो नो अग्नेऽभिदासत्यन्ति दूरे पदीष्ट सः । अस्माकमिद् वृधे भव॥
verses.tr: yo no agne'bhidāsatyanti dūre padīṣṭa saḥ asmākamid vṛdhe bhava
verses.en: May the man fall, O Agni, who near or afar assaileth us: Do thou increase and prosper us.

verses.sa: सहस्राक्षो विचर्षणिरग्नी रक्षांसि सेधति । होता गृणीत उक्थ्यः॥
verses.tr: sahasrākṣo vicarṣaṇiragnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati hotā gṛṇīta ukthyaḥ
verses.en: Keen and swift Agni, thousand-eyed, chaseth the Raksasas afar: He singeth, herald meet for lauds.

verses.sa:
इत्था हि सोम इन्मदे ब्रह्मा चकार वर्धनम् ।
शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: itthā hi soma inmade brahmā cakāra vardhanam śaviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahimarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Thus in the Soma, in wild joy the Brahman hath exalted thee: Thou, mightiest thunder-armed, hast driven by force the Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
स त्वामदद् वृषा मदः सोमः श्येनाभृतः सुतः ।
येना वृत्रं निरद्भ्यो जघन्थ वज्रिन्नोजसार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa tvāmadad vṛṣā madaḥ somaḥ śyenābhṛtaḥ sutaḥ yenā vṛtraṃ niradbhyo jaghantha vajrinnojasārcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: The mighty flowing Soma-draught, brought by the Hawk, hath gladdened thee, That in thy strength, O Thunderer, thou hast struck down Vrtra from the floods, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यंसते ।
इन्द्र नृम्णं हि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपो ऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: prehyabhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo 'rcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked. Manliness, Indra, is thy might: stay Vrtra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
निरिन्द्र भूम्या अधि वृत्रं जघन्थ निर्दिवः ।
सृजा मरुत्वतीरव जीवधन्या इमा अपो ऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: nirindra bhūmyā adhi vṛtraṃ jaghantha nirdivaḥ sṛjā marutvatīrava jīvadhanyā imā apo 'rcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Thou smotest Vrtra from the earth, smotest him, Indra, from the sky. Let these life-fostering waters flow attended by the Marut host, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य दोधतः सानुं वज्रेण हीळितः ।
अभिक्रम्याव जिघ्नते ऽपः सर्माय चोदयन्नर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: indro vṛtrasya dodhataḥ sānuṃ vajreṇa hīḻitaḥ abhikramyāva jighnate 'paḥ sarmāya codayannarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: The wrathful Indra with his bolt of thunder rushing on the foe, Smote fierce on trembling Vrtra's back, and loosed the waters free to run, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
अधि सानौ नि जिघ्नते वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ।
मन्दान इन्द्रो अन्धसः सखिभ्यो गातुमिच्छत्यर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: adhi sānau ni jighnate vajreṇa śataparvaṇā mandāna indro andhasaḥ sakhibhyo gātumicchatyarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: With hundred-jointed thunderbolt Indra hath struck him on the back, And, while rejoicing in the juice, seeketh prosperity for friends, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवो ऽनुत्तं वज्रिन् वीर्यम् ।
यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तमु त्वं माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: indra tubhyamidadrivo 'nuttaṃ vajrin vīryam yaddha tyaṃ māyinaṃ mṛgaṃ tamu tvaṃ māyayāvadhīrarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Indra, unconquered might is thine, Thunderer, Caster of the Stone; For thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death the guileful beast, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
वि ते वज्रासो अस्थिरन्नवतिं नाव्या ३ अनु ।
महत् त इन्द्र वीर्यं बाह्वोस्ते बलं हितमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: vi te vajrāso asthirannavatiṃ nāvyā 3 anu mahat ta indra vīryaṃ bāhvoste balaṃ hitamarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Far over ninety spacious floods thy thunderbolts were cast abroad: Great, Indra, is thy hero might, and strength is seated in thine arms, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
सहस्रं साकमर्चत परि ष्टोभत विंशतिः ।
शतैनमन्वनोनवुरिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: sahasraṃ sākamarcata pari ṣṭobhata viṃśatiḥ śatainamanvanonavurindrāya brahmodyatamarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Laud him a thousand all at once, shout twenty forth the hymn of praise. Hundreds have sung aloud to him, to Indra hath the prayer been raised, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य तविषीं निरहन्त्सहसा सहः ।
महत् तदस्य पौंस्यं वृत्रं जघन्वाँ असृजदर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: indro vṛtrasya taviṣīṃ nirahantsahasā sahaḥ mahat tadasya pauṃsyaṃ vṛtraṃ jaghanvāṃ asṛjadarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Indra hath smitten down the power of Vrtra,--might with stronger might. This was his manly exploit, he slew Vrtra and let loose the floods, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इमे चित् तव मन्यवे वेपेते भियसा मही ।
यदिन्द्र वज्रिन्नोजसा वृत्रं मरुत्वाँ अवधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: ime cit tava manyave vepete bhiyasā mahī yadindra vajrinnojasā vṛtraṃ marutvāṃ avadhīrarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Yea, even this great Pair of Worlds trembled in terror at thy wrath, When, Indra, Thunderer, Marut-girt, thou slewest Vrtra in thy strength, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
न वेपसा न तन्यतेन्द्रं वृत्रो वि बीभयत् ।
अभ्येनं वज्र आयसः सहस्रभृष्टिरायतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: na vepasā na tanyatendraṃ vṛtro vi bībhayat abhyenaṃ vajra āyasaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirāyatārcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: But Vrtra scared not Indra with his shaking or his thunder roar. On him that iron thunderbolt fell fiercely with its thousand points, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
यद् वृत्रं तव चाशनिं वज्रेण समयोधयः ।
अहिमिन्द्र जिघांसतो दिवि ते बद्बधे शवो ऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: yad vṛtraṃ tava cāśaniṃ vajreṇa samayodhayaḥ ahimindra jighāṃsato divi te badbadhe śavo 'rcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: When with the thunder thou didst make thy dart and Vrtra meet in war, Thy might, O Indra, fain to slay the Dragon, was set firm in heaven, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
अभिष्टने ते अद्रिवो यत् स्था जगच्च रेजते ।
त्वष्टा चित् तव मन्यव इन्द्र वेविज्यते भियार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: abhiṣṭane te adrivo yat sthā jagacca rejate tvaṣṭā cit tava manyava indra vevijyate bhiyārcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: When at thy shout, O Thunder-armed, each thing both fixed and moving shook, E'en Tvastar trembled at thy wrath and quaked with fear because of thee, lauding thine own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
नहि नु यादधीमसीन्द्रं को वीर्या परः ।
तस्मिन्नृम्णमुत क्रतुं देवा ओजांसि सं दधुरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: nahi nu yādadhīmasīndraṃ ko vīryā paraḥ tasminnṛmṇamuta kratuṃ devā ojāṃsi saṃ dadhurarcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: There is not, in our knowledge, one who passeth Indra in his strength: In him the Deities have stored manliness, insight, power and might, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
यामथर्वा मनुष्पिता दध्यङ् धियमत्नत ।
तस्मिन् ब्रह्माणि पूर्वथेन्द्र उक्था समग्मतार्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: yāmatharvā manuṣpitā dadhyaṅ dhiyamatnata tasmin brahmāṇi pūrvathendra ukthā samagmatārcannanu svarājyam
verses.en: Still as of old, whatever rite Atharvan, Manus sire of all, Dadhyach performed, their prayer and praise united in that Indra meet, lauding his own imperial sway.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः ।
तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतेमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत्॥
verses.tr: indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ taminmahatsvājiṣūtemarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no'viṣat
verses.en: The men have lifted Indra up, the Vrtra slayer, to joy and strength: Him, verily, we invocate in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might.

verses.sa:
असि हि वीर सेन्यो ऽसि भूरि पराददिः ।
असि दभ्रस्य चिद् वृधो यजमानाय शिक्षसि सुन्वते भूरि ते वसु॥
verses.tr: asi hi vīra senyo 'si bhūri parādadiḥ asi dabhrasya cid vṛdho yajamānāya śikṣasi sunvate bhūri te vasu
verses.en: Thou, Hero, art a warrior, thou art giver of abundant spoil. Strengthening e'en the feeble, thou aidest the sacrificer, thou givest the offerer ample wealth.

verses.sa:
यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धना ।
युक्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कं हनः कं वसौ दधो ऽस्माँ इन्द्र वसौ दधः॥
verses.tr: yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanā yukṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho 'smāṃ indra vasau dadhaḥ
verses.en: When war and battles are on foot, booty is laid before the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing Bays. Whom wilt thou slay and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा महाँ अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृधे शवः ।
श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवान् दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसम्॥
verses.tr: kratvā mahāṃ anuṣvadhaṃ bhīma ā vāvṛdhe śavaḥ śriya ṛṣva upākayorni śiprī harivān dadhe hastayorvajramāyasam
verses.en: Mighty through wisdom, as he lists, terrible, he hath waxed in strength. Lord of Bay Steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory's sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
आ पप्रौ पार्थिवं रजो बद्बधे रोचना दिवि ।
न त्वावाँ इन्द्र कश्चन न जातो न जनिष्यते ऽति विश्वं ववक्षिथ॥
verses.tr: ā paprau pārthivaṃ rajo badbadhe rocanā divi na tvāvāṃ indra kaścana na jāto na janiṣyate 'ti viśvaṃ vavakṣitha
verses.en: He filled the earthly atmosphere and pressed against the lights in heaven. None like thee ever hath been born, none, Indra, will be born like thee. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.

verses.sa:
यो अर्यो मर्तभोजनं पराददाति दाशुषे ।
इन्द्रो अस्मभ्यं शिक्षतु वि भजा भूरि ते वसु भक्षीय तव राधसः॥
verses.tr: yo aryo martabhojanaṃ parādadāti dāśuṣe indro asmabhyaṃ śikṣatu vi bhajā bhūri te vasu bhakṣīya tava rādhasaḥ
verses.en: May he who to the offerer gives the foeman's man-sustaining food, May Indra lend his aid to us. Deal forth--abundant is thy wealth--that in thy bounty I may share.

verses.sa:
मदेमदे हि नो ददिर्यूथा गवामृजुक्रतुः ।
सं गृभाय पुरू शतोभयाहस्त्या वसु शिशीहि राय आ भर॥
verses.tr: mademade hi no dadiryūthā gavāmṛjukratuḥ saṃ gṛbhāya purū śatobhayāhastyā vasu śiśīhi rāya ā bhara
verses.en: He, righteous-hearted, at each time of rapture gives us herds of kine. Gather in both thy hands for us treasures of many hundred sorts. Sharpen thou us, and bring us wealth.

verses.sa:
मादयस्व सुते सचा शवसे शूर राधसे ।
विद्मा हि त्वा पुरूवसुमुप कामान्त्ससृज्महे ऽथा नोऽविता भव॥
verses.tr: mādayasva sute sacā śavase śūra rādhase vidmā hi tvā purūvasumupa kāmāntsasṛjmahe 'thā no'vitā bhava
verses.en: Refresh thee, Hero, with the juice outpoured for bounty and for strength. We know thee Lord of ample store, to thee have sent our hearts' desires: be therefore our Protector thou.

verses.sa:
एते त इन्द्र जन्तवो विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम् ।
अन्तर्हि ख्यो जनानामर्यो वेदो अदाशुषां तेषां नो वेद आ भर॥
verses.tr: ete ta indra jantavo viśvaṃ puṣyanti vāryam antarhi khyo janānāmaryo vedo adāśuṣāṃ teṣāṃ no veda ā bhara
verses.en: These people, Indra, keep for thee all that is worthy of thy choice. Discover thou, as Lord, the wealth of men who offer up no gifts: bring thou to us this wealth of theirs.

verses.sa:
उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन् मातथा इव ।
यदा नः सूनृतावतः कर आदर्थयास इद् योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavan mātathā iva yadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara ādarthayāsa id yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Graciously listen to our songs, Maghavan, be not negligent. As thou hast made us full of joy and lettest us solicit thee, now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत ।
अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Well have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away. The sages luminous in themselves have. praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं मघवन् वन्दिषीमहि ।
प्र नूनं पूर्णवन्धुरः स्तुतो याहि वशाँ अनु योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ maghavan vandiṣīmahi pra nūnaṃ pūrṇavandhuraḥ stuto yāhi vaśāṃ anu yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Maghavan, we will reverence thee who art so fair to look upon. Thus praised, according to our wish come now with richly laden car. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
स घा तं वृषणं रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदम् ।
यः पात्रं हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्र चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindra ciketati yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: He will in very truth ascend the powerful car that finds the kine, Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the Tawny Coursers' harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
युक्तस्ते अस्तु दक्षिण उत सव्यः शतक्रतो ।
तेन जायामुप प्रियां मन्दानो याह्यन्धसो योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी॥
verses.tr: yuktaste astu dakṣiṇa uta savyaḥ śatakrato tena jāyāmupa priyāṃ mandāno yāhyandhaso yojā nvindra te harī
verses.en: Let, Lord of Hundred Powers, thy Steeds be harnessed on the right and left. Therewith in rapture of the juice, draw near to thy beloved Spouse. Now, Indra, yoke thy two Bay Steeds.

verses.sa:
युनज्मि ते ब्रह्मणा केशिना हरी उप प्र याहि दधिषे गभस्त्योः ।
उत् त्वा सुतासो रभसा अमन्दिषुः पूषण्वान् वज्रिन्त्समु पत्न्यामदः॥
verses.tr: yunajmi te brahmaṇā keśinā harī upa pra yāhi dadhiṣe gabhastyoḥ ut tvā sutāso rabhasā amandiṣuḥ pūṣaṇvān vajrintsamu patnyāmadaḥ
verses.en: With holy prayer I yoke thy long-maned pair of Bays: come hitherward; thou holdest them in both thy hands. The stirring draughts of juice outpoured have made thee glad: thou, Thunderer, hast rejoiced with Pusan and thy Spouse.

verses.sa:
अश्वावति प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति सुप्रावीरिन्द्र मर्त्यस्तवोतिभिः ।
तमित् पृणक्षि वसुना भवीयसा सिन्धुमापो यथाभितो विचेतसः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvati prathamo goṣu gacchati suprāvīrindra martyastavotibhiḥ tamit pṛṇakṣi vasunā bhavīyasā sindhumāpo yathābhito vicetasaḥ
verses.en: Indra, the mortal man well guarded by thine aid goes foremost in the wealth of horses and of kine. With amplest wealth thou fillest him, as round about the waters clearly seen afar fill Sindhu full.

verses.sa:
आपो न देवीरुप यन्ति होत्रियमवः पश्यन्ति विततं यथा रजः ।
प्राचैर्देवासः प्र णयन्ति देवयुं ब्रह्मप्रियं जोषयन्ते वरा इव॥
verses.tr: āpo na devīrupa yanti hotriyamavaḥ paśyanti vitataṃ yathā rajaḥ prācairdevāsaḥ pra ṇayanti devayuṃ brahmapriyaṃ joṣayante varā iva
verses.en: The heavenly Waters come not nigh the priestly bowl: they but look down and see how far mid-air is spread: The Deities conduct the pious man to them: like suitors they delight in him who loveth prayer.

verses.sa:
अधि द्वयोरदधा उक्थ्यं १ वचो यतस्रुचा मिथुना या सपर्यतः ।
असंयत्तो व्रते ते क्षेति पुष्यति भद्रा शक्तिर्यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: adhi dvayoradadhā ukthyaṃ 1 vaco yatasrucā mithunā yā saparyataḥ asaṃyatto vrate te kṣeti puṣyati bhadrā śaktiryajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: Praiseworthy blessing hast thou laid upon the pair who with uplifted ladle serve thee, man and wife. Unchecked he dwells and prospers in thy law: thy power brings blessing to the sacrificer pouring gifts.

verses.sa:
आदङ्गिराः प्रथमं दधिरे वय इद्धाग्नयः शम्या ये सुकृत्यया ।
सर्वं पणेः समविन्दन्त भोजनमश्वावन्तं गोमन्तमा पशुं नरः॥
verses.tr: ādaṅgirāḥ prathamaṃ dadhire vaya iddhāgnayaḥ śamyā ye sukṛtyayā sarvaṃ paṇeḥ samavindanta bhojanamaśvāvantaṃ gomantamā paśuṃ naraḥ
verses.en: First the Angirases won themselves vital power, whose fires were kindled through good deeds and sacrifice. The men together found the Pani's hoarded wealth, the cattle, and the wealth in horses and in kine.

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरथर्वा प्रथमः पथस्तते ततः सूर्यो व्रतपा वेन आजनि ।
आ गा आजदुशना काव्यः सचा यमस्य जातममृतं यजामहे॥
verses.tr: yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate tataḥ sūryo vratapā vena ājani ā gā ājaduśanā kāvyaḥ sacā yamasya jātamamṛtaṃ yajāmahe
verses.en: Atharvan first by sacrifices laid the paths then, guardian of the Law, sprang up the loving Sun. Usana Kavya straightway hither drove the kine. Let us with offerings honour Yama's deathless birth.

verses.sa:
बर्हिर्वा यत् स्वपत्याय वृज्यते ऽर्को वा श्लोकमाघोषते दिवि ।
ग्रावा यत्र वदति कारुरुक्थ्य १ स्तस्येदिन्द्रो अभिपित्वेषु रण्यति॥
verses.tr: barhirvā yat svapatyāya vṛjyate 'rko vā ślokamāghoṣate divi grāvā yatra vadati kārurukthya 1 stasyedindro abhipitveṣu raṇyati
verses.en: When sacred grass is trimmed to aid the auspicious work, or the hymn makes its voice of praise sound to the sky. Where the stone rings as 'twere a singer skilled in laud,--Indra in truth delights when these come near to him.

verses.sa:
असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि ।
आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियं रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: asāvi soma indra te śaviṣṭha dhṛṣṇavā gahi ā tvā pṛṇaktvindriyaṃ rajaḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: The Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra; mightiest, bold One, come. May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as the Sun fills mid-air with rays.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्धरी वहतो ऽप्रतिधृष्टशवसम् ।
ऋषीणां च स्तुतीरुप यज्ञं च मानुषाणाम्॥
verses.tr: indramiddharī vahato 'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām
verses.en: His pair of Tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to Rsis' songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठ वृत्रहन् रथं युक्ता ते ब्रह्मणा हरी ।
अर्वाचीनं सु ते मनो ग्रावा कृणोतु वग्नुना॥
verses.tr: ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahan rathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā
verses.en: Slayer of Vrtra, mount thy car; thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hitherward.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् ।
शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन् धारा ऋतस्य सादने॥
verses.tr: imamindra sutaṃ piba jyeṣṭhamamartyaṃ madam śukrasya tvābhyakṣaran dhārā ṛtasya sādane
verses.en: This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent. Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय नूनमर्चतोक्थानि च ब्रवीतन ।
सुता अमत्सुरिन्दवो ज्येष्ठं नमस्यता सहः॥
verses.tr: indrāya nūnamarcatokthāni ca bravītana sutā amatsurindavo jyeṣṭhaṃ namasyatā sahaḥ
verses.en: Sing glory now to Indra, say to him your solemn eulogies. The drops poured forth have made him glad: pay reverence to his might supreme.

verses.sa:
नकिष्ट्वद् रथीतरो हरी यदिन्द्र यच्छसे ।
नकिष्ट्वानु मज्मना नकिः स्वश्व आनशे॥
verses.tr: nakiṣṭvad rathītaro harī yadindra yacchase nakiṣṭvānu majmanā nakiḥ svaśva ānaśe
verses.en: When, Indra, thou dost yoke thy Steeds, there is no better charioteer: None hath surpassed thee in thy might, none with good steeds o'ertaken thee.

verses.sa:
य एक इद् विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे ।
ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: ya eka id vidayate vasu martāya dāśuṣe īśāno apratiṣkuta indro aṅga
verses.en: He who alone bestoweth on mortal man who offereth gifts, The ruler of resistless power, is Indra, sure.

verses.sa:
कदा मर्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् ।
कदा नः शुश्रवद् गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: kadā martamarādhasaṃ padā kṣumpamiva sphurat kadā naḥ śuśravad gira indro aṅga
verses.en: When will he trample, like a weed, the man who hath no gift for him? When, verily, will Indra hear our songs of praise?

verses.sa:
यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाँ आविवासति ।
उग्रं तत् पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग॥
verses.tr: yaściddhi tvā bahubhya ā sutāvāṃ āvivāsati ugraṃ tat patyate śava indro aṅga
verses.en: He who with Soma juice prepared amid the many honours thee,-- Verily Indra gains thereby tremendous might.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मध्वः पिबन्ति गौर्यः ।
या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभसे वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: svādoritthā viṣūvato madhvaḥ pibanti gauryaḥ yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhase vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste, the bright cows drink, Who for the sake of splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य पृशनायुवः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः ।
प्रिया इन्द्रस्य धेनवो वज्रं हिन्वन्ति सायकं वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: tā asya pṛśanāyuvaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ priyā indrasya dhenavo vajraṃ hinvanti sāyakaṃ vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: Craving his touch the dappled kine mingle the Soma with their milk. The milch-kine dear to Indra send forth his death-dealing thunderbolt, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य नमसा सहः सपर्यन्ति प्रचेतसः ।
व्रतान्यस्य सश्चिरे पुरूणि पूर्वचित्तये वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: tā asya namasā sahaḥ saparyanti pracetasaḥ vratānyasya saścire purūṇi pūrvacittaye vasvīranu svarājyam
verses.en: With veneration, passing wise, honouring his victorious might, They follow close his many laws to win them due preeminence, good in their own supremacy.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव॥
verses.tr: indro dadhīco asthabhirvṛtrāṇyapratiṣkutaḥ jaghāna navatīrnava
verses.en: With bones of Dadhyac for his arms, Indra, resistless in attack, Struck nine-and-ninety Vrtras dead.

verses.sa: इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् । तद् विदच्छर्यणावति॥
verses.tr: icchannaśvasya yacchiraḥ parvateṣvapaśritam tad vidaccharyaṇāvati
verses.en: He, searching for the horse's head, removed among the mountains, found At Saryanavan what he sought.

verses.sa: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे॥
verses.tr: atrāha goramanvata nāma tvaṣṭurapīcyam itthā candramaso gṛhe
verses.en: Then verily they recognized the essential form of Tvastar's Bull, Here in the mansion of the Moon.

verses.sa:
को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् ।
आसन्निषून् हृत्स्वसो मयोभून् य एषां भृत्यामृणधत् स जीवात्॥
verses.tr: ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn āsanniṣūn hṛtsvaso mayobhūn ya eṣāṃ bhṛtyāmṛṇadhat sa jīvāt
verses.en: Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, With shaft-armed mouths, heart-piercing, health-bestowing? Long shall he live who richly pays their service.

verses.sa:
क ईषते तुज्यते को बिभाय को मंसते सन्तमिन्द्रं को अन्ति ।
कस्तोकाय क इभायोत राये ऽधि ब्रवत् तन्वे ३ को जनाय॥
verses.tr: ka īṣate tujyate ko bibhāya ko maṃsate santamindraṃ ko anti kastokāya ka ibhāyota rāye 'dhi bravat tanve 3 ko janāya
verses.en: Who fleeth forth? who suffereth? who feareth? Who knoweth Indra present, Indra near us? Who sendeth benediction on his offspring, his household, wealth and person, and the People?

verses.sa:
को अग्निमीट्टे हविषा घृतेन स्रुचा यजाता ऋतुभिर्ध्रुवेभिः ।
कस्मै देवा आ वहानाशु होम को मंसते वीतिहोत्रः सुदेवः॥
verses.tr: ko agnimīṭṭe haviṣā ghṛtena srucā yajātā ṛtubhirdhruvebhiḥ kasmai devā ā vahānāśu homa ko maṃsate vītihotraḥ sudevaḥ
verses.en: Who with poured oil and offering honours Agni, with ladle worships at appointed seasons? To whom to the Gods bring oblation quickly? What offerer, God-favoured, knows him thoroughly?

verses.sa:
त्वमङ्ग प्र शंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् ।
न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः॥
verses.tr: tvamaṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
verses.en: Thou as a God, O Mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.

verses.sa:
मा ते राधांसि मा त ऊतयो वसो ऽस्मान् कदा चना दभन् ।
विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ॥
verses.tr: mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso 'smān kadā canā dabhan viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā
verses.en: Let not thy bounteous gifts, let not thy saving help fail us, good Lord, at any time; And measure out to us, thou lover of mankind, all riches hitherward from men.

verses.sa:
प्र ये शुम्भन्ते जनयो न सप्तयो यामन् रुद्रस्य सूनवः सुदंससः ।
रोदसी हि मरुतश्चक्रिरे वृधे मदन्ति वीरा विदथेषु घृष्वयः॥
verses.tr: pra ye śumbhante janayo na saptayo yāman rudrasya sūnavaḥ sudaṃsasaḥ rodasī hi marutaścakrire vṛdhe madanti vīrā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ
verses.en: They who are glancing forth, like women, on their way, doers of mighty deeds, swift racers, Rudra's Sons, The Maruts have made heaven and earth increase and grow: in sacrifices they delight, the strong and wild.

verses.sa:
त उक्षितासो महिमानमाशत दिवि रुद्रासो अधि चक्रिरे सदः ।
अर्चन्तो अर्कं जनयन्त इन्द्रियमधि श्रियो दधिरे पृश्निमातरः॥
verses.tr: ta ukṣitāso mahimānamāśata divi rudrāso adhi cakrire sadaḥ arcanto arkaṃ janayanta indriyamadhi śriyo dadhire pṛśnimātaraḥ
verses.en: Grown to their perfect strength greatness have they attained; the Rudras have established their abode in heaven. Singing their song of praise and generating might, they have put glory on, the Sons whom Prsni bare.

verses.sa:
गोमातरो यच्छुभयन्ते अञ्जिभिस्तनूषु शुभ्रा दधिरे विरुक्मतः ।
बाधन्ते विश्वमभिमातिनमप वर्त्मान्येषामनु रीयते घृतम्॥
verses.tr: gomātaro yacchubhayante añjibhistanūṣu śubhrā dadhire virukmataḥ bādhante viśvamabhimātinamapa vartmānyeṣāmanu rīyate ghṛtam
