verses.en: When, Children of the Cow, they shine in bright attire, and on their fair limbs lay their golden ornaments, They drive away each adversary from their path, and, following their traces, fatness floweth down,

verses.sa:
वि ये भ्राजन्ते सुमखास ऋष्टिभिः प्रच्यावयन्तो अच्युता चिदोजसा ।
मनोजुवो यन्मरुतो रथेष्वा वृषव्रातासः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम्॥
verses.tr: vi ye bhrājante sumakhāsa ṛṣṭibhiḥ pracyāvayanto acyutā cidojasā manojuvo yanmaruto ratheṣvā vṛṣavrātāsaḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam
verses.en: When, mighty Warriors, ye who glitter with your spears, o'erthrowing with your strength e'en what is ne'er o'erthrown, When, O ye Maruts, ye the host that send the rain, had harnessed to your cars the thought-fleet spotted deer.

verses.sa:
प्र यद् रथेषु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं वाजे अद्रिं मरुतो रंहयन्तः ।
उतारुषस्य वि ष्यन्ति धाराश्चर्मेवोदभिर्व्युन्दन्ति भूम॥
verses.tr: pra yad ratheṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ vāje adriṃ maruto raṃhayantaḥ utāruṣasya vi ṣyanti dhārāścarmevodabhirvyundanti bhūma
verses.en: When ye have harnessed to your cars the spotted deer, urging the thunderbolt, O Maruts, to the fray, Forth rush the torrents of the dark red stormy cloud, and moisten, like a skin, the earth with water-floods.

verses.sa:
आ वो वहन्तु सप्तयो रघुष्यदो रघुपत्वानः प्र जिगात बाहुभिः ।
सीदता बर्हिरुरु वः सदस्कृतं मादयध्वं मरुतो मध्वो अन्धसः॥
verses.tr: ā vo vahantu saptayo raghuṣyado raghupatvānaḥ pra jigāta bāhubhiḥ sīdatā barhiruru vaḥ sadaskṛtaṃ mādayadhvaṃ maruto madhvo andhasaḥ
verses.en: Let your swift-gliding coursers bear you hitherward with their fleet pinions. Come ye forward with your arms. Sit on the grass; a wide seat hath been made for you: delight yourselves, O Maruts, in the pleasant food.

verses.sa:
तेऽवर्धन्त स्वतवसो महित्वना नाकं तस्थुरुरु चक्रिरे सदः ।
विष्णुर्यद्धावद्वृषणं मदच्युतं वयो न सीदन्नधि बर्हिषि प्रिये॥
verses.tr: te'vardhanta svatavaso mahitvanā nākaṃ tasthururu cakrire sadaḥ viṣṇuryaddhāvadvṛṣaṇaṃ madacyutaṃ vayo na sīdannadhi barhiṣi priye
verses.en: Strong in their native strength to greatness have they grown, stepped to the firmament and made their dwelling wide. When Visnu saved the Soma bringing wild delight, the Maruts sate like birds on their dear holy grass.

verses.sa:
शूरा इवेद्यु युयुधयो न जग्मयः श्रवस्यवो न पृतनासु येतिरे ।
भयन्ते विश्वा भुवना मरुद्भ्यो राजान इव त्वेषसंदृशो नरः॥
verses.tr: śūrā ivedyu yuyudhayo na jagmayaḥ śravasyavo na pṛtanāsu yetire bhayante viśvā bhuvanā marudbhyo rājāna iva tveṣasaṃdṛśo naraḥ
verses.en: In sooth like heroes fain for fight they rush about, like combatants fame-seeking have they striven in war. Before the Maruts every creature is afraid: the men are like to Kings, terrible to behold.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा यद् वज्रं सुकृतं हिरण्ययं सहस्रभृष्टिं स्वपा अवर्तयत् ।
धत्त इन्द्रो नर्यपांसि कर्तवे ऽहन् वृत्रं निरपामौब्जदर्णवम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā yad vajraṃ sukṛtaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṃ svapā avartayat dhatta indro naryapāṃsi kartave 'han vṛtraṃ nirapāmaubjadarṇavam
verses.en: When Tvastar deft of hand had turned the thunderbolt, golden, with thousand edges, fashioned more skilfully, Indra received it to perform heroic deeds. Vrtra he slew, and forced the flood of water forth.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं नुनुद्रेऽवतं त ओजसा दादृहाणं चिद् बिभिदुर्वि पर्वतम् ।
धमन्तो वाणं मरुतः सुदानवो मदे सोमस्य रण्यानि चक्रिरे॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvaṃ nunudre'vataṃ ta ojasā dādṛhāṇaṃ cid bibhidurvi parvatam dhamanto vāṇaṃ marutaḥ sudānavo made somasya raṇyāni cakrire
verses.en: They with their vigorous strength pushed the well up on high, and clove the cloud in twain though it was passing strong. The Maruts, bounteous Givers, sending forth their voice, in the wild joy of Soma wrought their glorious deeds.

verses.sa:
जिह्मं नुनुद्रेऽवतं तया दिशासिञ्चन्नुत्सं गोतमाय तृष्णजे ।
आ गच्छन्तीमवसा चित्रभानवः कामं विप्रस्य तर्पयन्त धामभिः॥
verses.tr: jihmaṃ nunudre'vataṃ tayā diśāsiñcannutsaṃ gotamāya tṛṣṇaje ā gacchantīmavasā citrabhānavaḥ kāmaṃ viprasya tarpayanta dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: They drave the cloud transverse directed hitherward, and poured the fountain forth for thirsting Gotama. Shining with varied light they come to him with help: they with their might fulfilled the longing of the sage.

verses.sa:
या वः शर्म शशमानाय सन्ति त्रिधातूनि दाशुषे यच्छताधि ।
अस्मभ्यं तानि मरुतो वि यन्त रयिं नो धत्त वृषणः सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi tridhātūni dāśuṣe yacchatādhi asmabhyaṃ tāni maruto vi yanta rayiṃ no dhatta vṛṣaṇaḥ suvīram
verses.en: The shelters which ye have for him who lauds you, bestow them threefold on the man who offers. Extend the same boons unto us, ye Maruts. Give us, O Heroes, wealth with noble offspring.

verses.sa: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये पाथा दिवो विमहसः । स सुगोपातमो जनः॥
verses.tr: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ sa sugopātamo janaḥ
verses.en: The best of guardians hath that man within whose dwelling place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sa: यज्ञैर्वा यज्ञवाहसो विप्रस्य वा मतीनाम् । मरुतः शृणुता हवम्॥
verses.tr: yajñairvā yajñavāhaso viprasya vā matīnām marutaḥ śṛṇutā havam
verses.en: Honoured with sacrifice or with the worship of the sages' hymns, O Maruts, listen to the call.

verses.sa: उत वा यस्य वाजिनो ऽनु विप्रमतक्षत । स गन्ता गोमति व्रजे॥
verses.tr: uta vā yasya vājino 'nu vipramatakṣata sa gantā gomati vraje
verses.en: Yea, the strong man to whom ye have vouchsafed to give a sage, shall move Into a stable rich in kine.

verses.sa: अस्य वीरस्य बर्हिषि सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु । उक्थं मदश्च शस्यते॥
verses.tr: asya vīrasya barhiṣi sutaḥ somo diviṣṭiṣu ukthaṃ madaśca śasyate
verses.en: Upon this hero's sacred grass Soma is poured in daily rites: Praise and delight are sung aloud.

verses.sa: अस्य श्रोषन्त्वा भुवो विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभि । सूरं चित् सस्रुषीरिषः॥
verses.tr: asya śroṣantvā bhuvo viśvā yaścarṣaṇīrabhi sūraṃ cit sasruṣīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Let the strong Maruts hear him, him surpassing all men: strength be his That reaches even to the Sun.

verses.sa: पूर्वीभिर्हि ददाशिम शरद्भिर्मरुतो वयम् । अवोभिश्चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: pūrvībhirhi dadāśima śaradbhirmaruto vayam avobhiścarṣaṇīnām
verses.en: For, through the swift Gods' loving help, in many an autumn, Maruts, we Have offered up our sacrifice.

verses.sa: सुभगः स प्रयज्यवो मरुतो अस्तु मर्त्यः । यस्य प्रयांसि पर्षथ॥
verses.tr: subhagaḥ sa prayajyavo maruto astu martyaḥ yasya prayāṃsi parṣatha
verses.en: Fortunate shall that mortal be, O Maruts most adorable, Whose offerings ye bear away.

verses.sa: शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः । विदा कामस्य वेनतः॥
verses.tr: śaśamānasya vā naraḥ svedasya satyaśavasaḥ vidā kāmasya venataḥ
verses.en: O Heroes truly strong, ye know the toil of him who sings your praise, The heart's desire of him who loves.

verses.sa: यूयं तत् सत्यशवस आविष्कर्त महित्वना । विध्यता विद्युता रक्षः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ tat satyaśavasa āviṣkarta mahitvanā vidhyatā vidyutā rakṣaḥ
verses.en: O ye of true strength, make this thing manifest by your greatness: strike The demon with your thunderbolt.

verses.sa: गूहता गुह्यं तमो वि यात विश्वमत्रिणम् । ज्योतिष्कर्ता यदुश्मसि॥
verses.tr: gūhatā guhyaṃ tamo vi yāta viśvamatriṇam jyotiṣkartā yaduśmasi
verses.en: Conceal the horrid darkness, drive far from us each devouring fiend. Create the light for which we long.

verses.sa:
प्रत्वक्षसः प्रतवसो विरप्शिनो ऽनानता अविथुरा ऋजीषिणः ।
जुष्टतमासो नृतमासो अञ्जिभिर्व्यानज्रे के चिदुस्रा इव स्तृभिः॥
verses.tr: pratvakṣasaḥ pratavaso virapśino 'nānatā avithurā ṛjīṣiṇaḥ juṣṭatamāso nṛtamāso añjibhirvyānajre ke cidusrā iva stṛbhiḥ
verses.en: Loud Singers, never humbled, active, full of strength, immovable, impetuous, manliest, best-beloved, They have displayed themselves with glittering ornaments, a few in number only, like the heavens with stars.

verses.sa:
उपह्वरेषु यदचिध्वं ययिं वय इव मरुतः केन चित् पथा ।
श्चोतन्ति कोशा उप वो रथेष्वा घृतमुक्षता मधुवर्णमर्चते॥
verses.tr: upahvareṣu yadacidhvaṃ yayiṃ vaya iva marutaḥ kena cit pathā ścotanti kośā upa vo ratheṣvā ghṛtamukṣatā madhuvarṇamarcate
verses.en: When, Maruts, on the steeps ye pile the moving cloud, ye are like birds on whatsoever path it be. Clouds everywhere shed forth the rain upon your cars. Drop fatness, honey-hued, for him who sings your praise.

verses.sa:
प्रैषामज्मेषु विथुरेव रेजते भूमिर्यामेषु यद्ध युञ्जते शुभे ।
ते क्रीळयो धुनयो भ्राजदृष्टयः स्वयं महित्वं पनयन्त धूतयः॥
verses.tr: praiṣāmajmeṣu vithureva rejate bhūmiryāmeṣu yaddha yuñjate śubhe te krīḻayo dhunayo bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ svayaṃ mahitvaṃ panayanta dhūtayaḥ
verses.en: Earth at their racings trembles as if weak and worn, when on their ways they yoke their cars for victory. They, sportive, loudly roaring, armed with glittering spears, shakers of all, themselves admire their mightiness.

verses.sa:
स हि स्वसृत् पृषदश्वो युवा गणो ३ ऽया ईशानस्तविषीभिरावृतः ।
असि सत्य ऋणयावानेद्यो ऽस्या धियः प्राविताथा वृषा गणः॥
verses.tr: sa hi svasṛt pṛṣadaśvo yuvā gaṇo 3 'yā īśānastaviṣībhirāvṛtaḥ asi satya ṛṇayāvānedyo 'syā dhiyaḥ prāvitāthā vṛṣā gaṇaḥ
verses.en: Self-moving is that youthful band, with spotted steeds; thus it hath lordly sway, endued with power and might. Truthful art thou, and blameless, searcher out of sin: so thou, Strong Host, wilt be protector of this prayer.

verses.sa:
पितुः प्रत्नस्य जन्मना वदामसि सोमस्य जिह्वा प्र जिगाति चक्षसा ।
यदीमिन्द्रं शम्यृक्वाण आशतादिन्नामानि यज्ञियानि दधिरे॥
verses.tr: pituḥ pratnasya janmanā vadāmasi somasya jihvā pra jigāti cakṣasā yadīmindraṃ śamyṛkvāṇa āśatādinnāmāni yajñiyāni dadhire
verses.en: We speak by our descent from our primeval Sire; our tongue, when we behold the Soma, stirs itself. When, shouting, they had joined Indra in toil of fight, then only they obtained their sacrificial names.

verses.sa:
श्रियसे कं भानुभिः सं मिमिक्षिरे ते रश्मिभिस्त ऋक्वभिः सुखादयः ।
ते वाशीमन्त इष्मिणो अभीरवो विद्रे प्रियस्य मारुतस्य धाम्नः॥
verses.tr: śriyase kaṃ bhānubhiḥ saṃ mimikṣire te raśmibhista ṛkvabhiḥ sukhādayaḥ te vāśīmanta iṣmiṇo abhīravo vidre priyasya mārutasya dhāmnaḥ
verses.en: Splendours they gained for glory, they who wear bright rings; rays they obtained, and men to celebrate their praise. Armed with their swords, impetuous and fearing naught, they have possessed the Maruts' own beloved home.

verses.sa:
आ विद्युन्मद्भिर्मरुतः स्वर्कै रथेभिर्यात ऋष्टिमद्भिरश्वपर्णैः ।
आ वर्षिष्ठया न इषा वयो न पप्तता सुमायाः॥
verses.tr: ā vidyunmadbhirmarutaḥ svarkai rathebhiryāta ṛṣṭimadbhiraśvaparṇaiḥ ā varṣiṣṭhayā na iṣā vayo na paptatā sumāyāḥ
verses.en: Come hither, Maruts, on your lightning laden cars, sounding with sweet songs, armed with lances, winged with steeds. Fly unto us with noblest food, like birds, O ye of mighty power.

verses.sa:
तेऽरुणेभिर्वरमा पिशङ्गैः शुभे कं यान्ति रथतूर्भिरश्वैः ।
रुक्मो न चित्रः स्वधितीवान् पव्या रथस्य जङ्घनन्त भूम॥
verses.tr: te'ruṇebhirvaramā piśaṅgaiḥ śubhe kaṃ yānti rathatūrbhiraśvaiḥ rukmo na citraḥ svadhitīvān pavyā rathasya jaṅghananta bhūma
verses.en: With their red-hued or, haply, tawny coursers which speed their chariots on, they come for glory. Brilliant like gold is he who holds the thunder. Earth have they smitten with the chariot's felly.

verses.sa:
श्रिये कं वो अधि तनूषु वाशीर्मेधा वना न कृणवन्त ऊर्ध्वा ।
युष्मभ्यं कं मरुतः सुजातास्तुविद्युम्नासो धनयन्ते अद्रिम्॥
verses.tr: śriye kaṃ vo adhi tanūṣu vāśīrmedhā vanā na kṛṇavanta ūrdhvā yuṣmabhyaṃ kaṃ marutaḥ sujātāstuvidyumnāso dhanayante adrim
verses.en: For beauty ye have swords upon your bodies. As they stir woods so may they stir our spirits. For your sake, O ye Maruts very mighty and well-born, have they set the stone, in motion.

verses.sa:
अहानि गृध्राः पर्या व आगुरिमां धियं वार्कार्यां च देवीम् ।
ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो गोतमासो अर्कैरूर्ध्वं नुनुद्र उत्सधिं पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: ahāni gṛdhrāḥ paryā va āgurimāṃ dhiyaṃ vārkāryāṃ ca devīm brahma kṛṇvanto gotamāso arkairūrdhvaṃ nunudra utsadhiṃ pibadhyai
verses.en: The days went round you and came back O yearners, back, to this prayer and to this solemn worship. The Gotamas making their prayer with singing have pushed the well's lid up to drink the water.

verses.sa:
एतत् त्यन्न योजनमचेति सस्वर्ह यन्मरुतो गोतमो वः ।
पश्यन् हिरण्यचक्रानयोदंष्ट्रान् विधावतो वराहून्॥
verses.tr: etat tyanna yojanamaceti sasvarha yanmaruto gotamo vaḥ paśyan hiraṇyacakrānayodaṃṣṭrān vidhāvato varāhūn
verses.en: No hymn way ever known like this aforetime which Gotama sang forth for you, O Maruts, What time upon your golden wheels he saw you, wild boars rushing about with tusks of iron.

verses.sa:
एषा स्या वो मरुतोऽनुभर्त्री प्रति ष्टोभति वाघतो न वाणी ।
अस्तोभयद् वृथासामनु स्वधां गभस्त्योः॥
verses.tr: eṣā syā vo maruto'nubhartrī prati ṣṭobhati vāghato na vāṇī astobhayad vṛthāsāmanu svadhāṃ gabhastyoḥ
verses.en: To you this freshening draught of Soma rusheth, O Maruts, like the voice of one who prayeth. It rusheth freely from our hands as these libations wont to flow.

sections.label: May auspicious thoughts come to us
sections.name: Mandala 1, hymn 89

verses.sa:
आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतो ऽदब्धासो अपरीतास उद्भिदः ।
देवा नो यथा सदमिद् वृधे असन्नप्रायुवो रक्षितारो दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato 'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ devā no yathā sadamid vṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro divedive
verses.en: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered, and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day unceasing in their care.

verses.sa:
देवानां भद्रा सुमतिर्ऋजूयतां देवानां रातिरभि नो नि वर्तताम् ।
देवानां सख्यमुप सेदिमा वयं देवा न आयुः प्र तिरन्तु जीवसे॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no ni vartatām devānāṃ sakhyamupa sedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pra tirantu jīvase
verses.en: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

verses.sa:
तान् पूर्वया निविदा हूमहे वयं भगं मित्रमदितिं दक्षमस्रिधम् ।
अर्यमणं वरुणं सोममश्विना सरस्वती नः सुभगा मयस्करत्॥
verses.tr: tān pūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat
verses.en: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksa, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvati, auspicious, grant felicity.

verses.sa:
तन्नो वातो मयोभु वातु भेषजं तन्माता पृथिवी तत् पिता द्यौः ।
तद् ग्रावाणः सोमसुतो मयोभुवस्तदश्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या युवम्॥
verses.tr: tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tat pitā dyauḥ tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam
verses.en: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

verses.sa:
तमीशानं जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं धियंजिन्वमवसे हूमहे वयम् ।
पूषा नो यथा वेदसामसद् वृधे रक्षिता पायुरदब्धः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyaṃjinvamavase hūmahe vayam pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye
verses.en: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pusan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः ।
स्वस्ति नस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु॥
verses.tr: svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu
verses.en: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pusan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Tarksya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brhaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

verses.sa:
पृषदश्वा मरुतः पृश्निमातरः शुभंयावानो विदथेषु जग्मयः ।
अग्निजिह्वा मनवः सूरचक्षसो विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्निह॥
verses.tr: pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasā gamanniha
verses.en: The Maruts, Sons of Prsni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni, brilliant as the Sun,--hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

verses.sa:
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः ।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥
verses.tr: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ
verses.en: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

verses.sa:
शतमिन्नु शरदो अन्ति देवा यत्रा नश्चक्रा जरसं तनूनाम् ।
पुत्रासो यत्र पितरो भवन्ति मा नो मध्या रीरिषतायुर्गन्तोः॥
verses.tr: śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ
verses.en: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षमदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः ।
विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्च जना अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम्॥
verses.tr: aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam
verses.en: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.

verses.sa: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयतु विद्वान् । अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: ṛjunītī no varuṇo mitro nayatu vidvān aryamā devaiḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: May Varuna with guidance straight, and Mitra lead us, he who knows, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.

verses.sa: ते हि वस्वो वसवानास्ते अप्रमूरा महोभिः । व्रता रक्षन्ते विश्वाहा॥
verses.tr: te hi vasvo vasavānāste apramūrā mahobhiḥ vratā rakṣante viśvāhā
verses.en: For they are dealers forth of wealth, and, not deluded, with their might Guard evermore the holy laws.

verses.sa: ते अस्मभ्यं शर्म यंसन्नमृता मर्त्येभ्यः । बाधमाना अप द्विषः॥
verses.tr: te asmabhyaṃ śarma yaṃsannamṛtā martyebhyaḥ bādhamānā apa dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Shelter may they vouchsafe to us, Immortal Gods to mortal men, Chasing our enemies away.

verses.sa: वि नः पथः सुविताय चियन्त्विन्द्रो मरुतः । पूषा भगो वन्द्यासः॥
verses.tr: vi naḥ pathaḥ suvitāya ciyantvindro marutaḥ pūṣā bhago vandyāsaḥ
verses.en: May they mark out our paths to bliss, Indra, the Maruts, Pusan, and Bhaga, the Gods to be adored.

verses.sa: उत नो धियो गोअग्राः पूषन् विष्णवेवयावः । कर्ता नः स्वस्तिमतः॥
verses.tr: uta no dhiyo goagrāḥ pūṣan viṣṇavevayāvaḥ kartā naḥ svastimataḥ
verses.en: Yea, Pusan, Visnu, ye who run your course, enrich our hymns with kine; Bless us with all prosperity.

verses.sa: मधु वाता ऋतायते मधु क्षरन्ति सिन्धवः । माध्वीर्नः सन्त्वोषधीः॥
verses.tr: madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ
verses.en: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law So may the plants be sweet for us.

verses.sa: मधु नक्तमुतोषसो मधुमत् पार्थिवं रजः । मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पिता॥
verses.tr: madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā
verses.en: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere; Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

verses.sa: मधुमान्नो वनस्पतिर्मधुमाँ अस्तु सूर्यः । माध्वीर्गावो भवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumāṃ astu sūryaḥ mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ
verses.en: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

verses.sa: शं नो मित्रः शं वरुणः शं नो भवत्वर्यमा । शं न इन्द्रो बृहस्पतिः शं नो विष्णुरुरुक्रमः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ
verses.en: Be Mitra gracious unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman: Indra, Brhaspati be kind, and Visnu of the mighty stride.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम प्र चिकितो मनीषा त्वं रजिष्ठमनु नेषि पन्थाम् ।
तव प्रणीती पितरो न इन्दो देवेषु रत्नमभजन्त धीराः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ
verses.en: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom; along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our wise forefathers by thy guidance, Indu, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम क्रतुभिः सुक्रतुर्भूस्त्वं दक्षैः सुदक्षो विश्ववेदाः ।
त्वं वृषा वृषत्वेभिर्महित्वा द्युम्नेभिर्द्युम्न्यभवो नृचक्षाः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ sukraturbhūstvaṃ dakṣaiḥ sudakṣo viśvavedāḥ tvaṃ vṛṣā vṛṣatvebhirmahitvā dyumnebhirdyumnyabhavo nṛcakṣāḥ
verses.en: Thou by thine insight art most wise, O Soma, strong by thine energies and all possessing, Mighty art thou by all thy powers and greatness, by glories art thou glorious, guide of mortals.

verses.sa:
राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद् गभीरं तव सोम धाम ।
शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम॥
verses.tr: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhad gabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma
verses.en: Thine are King Varuna's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory. All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि दिवि या पृथिव्यां या पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु ।
तेभिर्नो विश्वैः सुमना अहेळन् राजन्त्सोम प्रति हव्या गृभाय॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyāṃ yā parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu tebhirno viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḻan rājantsoma prati havyā gṛbhāya
verses.en: With all thy glories on the earth, in heaven, on mountains, in the plants, and in the waters,-- With all of these, well-pleased and not in anger, accept, O royal Soma, our oblations.

verses.sa: त्वं सोमासि सत्पतिस्त्वं राजोत वृत्रहा । त्वं भद्रो असि क्रतुः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ somāsi satpatistvaṃ rājota vṛtrahā tvaṃ bhadro asi kratuḥ
verses.en: Thou, Soma, art the Lord of heroes, King, yea, Vrtra-slayer thou: Thou art auspicious energy.

verses.sa: त्वं च सोम नो वशो जीवातुं न मरामहे । प्रियस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ ca soma no vaśo jīvātuṃ na marāmahe priyastotro vanaspatiḥ
verses.en: And, Soma, let it be thy wish that we may live and may not die: Praise-loving Lord of plants art thou.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम महे भगं त्वं यून ऋतायते । दक्षं दधासि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma mahe bhagaṃ tvaṃ yūna ṛtāyate dakṣaṃ dadhāsi jīvase
verses.en: To him who keeps the law, both old and young, thou givest happiness, And energy that he may live.

verses.sa: त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो रक्षा राजन्नघायतः । न रिष्येत् त्वावतः सखा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ naḥ soma viśvato rakṣā rājannaghāyataḥ na riṣyet tvāvataḥ sakhā
verses.en: Guard us, King Soma, on all sides from him who threatens us: never let The friend of one like thee be harmed.

verses.sa: सोम यास्ते मयोभुव ऊतयः सन्ति दाशुषे । ताभिर्नोऽविता भव॥
verses.tr: soma yāste mayobhuva ūtayaḥ santi dāśuṣe tābhirno'vitā bhava
verses.en: With those delightful aids which thou hast, Soma, for the worshipper,-- Even with those protect thou us.

verses.sa: इमं यज्ञमिदं वचो जुजुषाण उपागहि । सोम त्वं नो वृधे भव॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yajñamidaṃ vaco jujuṣāṇa upāgahi soma tvaṃ no vṛdhe bhava
verses.en: Accepting this our sacrifice and this our praise, O Soma, come, And be thou nigh to prosper us.

verses.sa: सोम गीर्भिष्ट्वा वयं वर्धयामो वचोविदः । सुमृळीको न आ विश॥
verses.tr: soma gīrbhiṣṭvā vayaṃ vardhayāmo vacovidaḥ sumṛḻīko na ā viśa
verses.en: Well-skilled in speech we magnify thee, Soma, with our sacred songs: Come thou to us, most gracious One.

verses.sa: गयस्फानो अमीवहा वसुवित् पुष्टिवर्धनः । सुमित्रः सोम नो भव॥
verses.tr: gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ sumitraḥ soma no bhava
verses.en: Enricher, healer of disease, wealth-finder, prospering our store, Be, Soma, a good Friend to us.

verses.sa: सोम रारन्धि नो हृदि गावो न यवसेष्वा । मर्य इव स्व ओक्ये॥
verses.tr: soma rārandhi no hṛdi gāvo na yavaseṣvā marya iva sva okye
verses.en: Soma, be happy in our heart, as milch-kine in the grassy meads, As a young man in his own house.

verses.sa: यः सोम सख्ये तव रारणद् देव मर्त्यः । तं दक्षः सचते कविः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ soma sakhye tava rāraṇad deva martyaḥ taṃ dakṣaḥ sacate kaviḥ
verses.en: O Soma, God, the mortal man who in thy friendship hath delight, Him doth the mighty Sage befriend.

verses.sa: उरुष्या णो अभिशस्तेः सोम नि पाह्यंहसः । सखा सुशेव एधि नः॥
verses.tr: uruṣyā ṇo abhiśasteḥ soma ni pāhyaṃhasaḥ sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ
verses.en: Save us from slanderous reproach, keep us., O Soma, from distress: Be unto us a gracious Friend.

verses.sa: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे॥
verses.tr: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam bhavā vājasya saṃgathe
verses.en: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-place of strength.

verses.sa: आ प्यायस्व मदिन्तम सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः । भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः सखा वृधे॥
verses.tr: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe
verses.en: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy rays of light, and be A Friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.

verses.sa:
सं ते पयांसि समु यन्तु वाजाः सं वृष्ण्यान्यभिमातिषाहः ।
आप्यायमानो अमृताय सोम दिवि श्रवांस्युत्तमानि धिष्व॥
verses.tr: saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva
verses.en: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and powers and mighty foe-subduing vigour, Waxing to immortality, O Soma: win highest glories for thyself in heaven.

verses.sa:
या ते धामानि हविषा यजन्ति ता ते विश्वा परिभूरस्तु यज्ञम् ।
गयस्फानः प्रतरणः सुवीरो ऽवीरहा प्र चरा सोम दुर्यान्॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tā te viśvā paribhūrastu yajñam gayasphānaḥ prataraṇaḥ suvīro 'vīrahā pra carā soma duryān
verses.en: Such of thy glories as with poured oblations men honour, may they all invest our worship. Wealth-giver, furtherer with troops of heroes, sparing the brave, come, Soma, to our houses.

verses.sa:
सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तमाशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति ।
सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै॥
verses.tr: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai
verses.en: To him who worships Soma gives the milch-cow, a fleet steed and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, meet for holy synod, for council meet, a glory to his father.

verses.sa:
अषाह्लं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम् ।
भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम॥
verses.tr: aṣāhlaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣāmapsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma
verses.en: Invincible in fight, saver in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water, Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee will we rejoice, O Soma.

verses.sa:
त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः ।
त्वमा ततन्थोर्व १ न्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ॥
verses.tr: tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ tvamā tatanthorva 1 ntarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha
verses.en: These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness.

verses.sa:
देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागं सहसावन्नभि युध्य ।
मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्र चिकित्सा गविष्टौ॥
verses.tr: devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvannabhi yudhya mā tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pra cikitsā gaviṣṭau
verses.en: Do thou, God Soma, with thy Godlike spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for both sides in the fray for booty.

verses.sa:
एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते ।
निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः॥
verses.tr: etā u tyā uṣasaḥ ketumakrata pūrve ardhe rajaso bhānumañjate niṣkṛṇvānā āyudhānīva dhṛṣṇavaḥ prati gāvo'ruṣīryanti mātaraḥ
verses.en: These Dawns have raised their banner; in the eastern half of the mid-air they spread abroad their shining light. Like heroes who prepare their weapons for the war, onward they come bright red in hue, the Mother Cows.

verses.sa:
उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत ।
अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः॥
verses.tr: udapaptannaruṇā bhānavo vṛthā svāyujo aruṣīrgā ayukṣata akrannuṣāso vayunāni pūrvathā ruśantaṃ bhānumaruṣīraśiśrayuḥ
verses.en: Readily have the purple beams of light shot up; the Red Cows have they harnessed, easy to be yoked. The Dawns have brought distinct perception as before: red-hued, they have attained their fulgent brilliancy.

verses.sa:
अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः ।
इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: arcanti nārīrapaso na viṣṭibhiḥ samānena yojanenā parāvataḥ iṣaṃ vahantīḥ sukṛte sudānave viśvedaha yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: They sing their song like women active in their tasks, along their common path hither from far away, Bringing refreshment to the liberal devotee, yea, all things to the worshipper who pours the juice.

verses.sa:
अधि पेशांसि वपते नृतूरिवापोर्णुते वक्ष उस्रेव बर्जहम् ।
ज्योतिर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय कृण्वती गावो न व्रजं व्यु १ षा आवर्तमः॥
verses.tr: adhi peśāṃsi vapate nṛtūrivāporṇute vakṣa usreva barjaham jyotirviśvasmai bhuvanāya kṛṇvatī gāvo na vrajaṃ vyu 1 ṣā āvartamaḥ
verses.en: She, like a dancer, puts her broidered garments on: as a cow yields her udder so she bares her breast. Creating light for all the world of life, the Dawn hath laid the darkness open as the cows their stall.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यर्ची रुशदस्या अदर्शि वि तिष्ठते बाधते कृष्णमभ्वम् ।
स्वरुं न पेशो विदथेष्वञ्जञ् चित्रं दिवो दुहिता भानुमश्रेत्॥
verses.tr: pratyarcī ruśadasyā adarśi vi tiṣṭhate bādhate kṛṣṇamabhvam svaruṃ na peśo vidatheṣvañjañ citraṃ divo duhitā bhānumaśret
verses.en: We have beheld the brightness of her shining; it spreads and drives away the darksome monster. Like tints that deck the Post at sacrifices, Heaven's Daughter hath attained her wondrous splendour.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्योषा उच्छन्ती वयुना कृणोति ।
श्रिये छन्दो न स्मयते विभाती सुप्रतीका सौमनसायाजीगः॥
verses.tr: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasyoṣā ucchantī vayunā kṛṇoti śriye chando na smayate vibhātī supratīkā saumanasāyājīgaḥ
verses.en: We have o'erpast the limit of this darkness; Dawn breaking forth again brings clear perception. She like a flatterer smiles in light for glory, and fair of face hath wakened to rejoice us.

verses.sa:
भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानां दिवः स्तवे दुहिता गोतमेभिः ।
प्रजावतो नृवतो अश्वबुध्यानुषो गोअग्राँ उप मासि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāṃ divaḥ stave duhitā gotamebhiḥ prajāvato nṛvato aśvabudhyānuṣo goagrāṃ upa māsi vājān
verses.en: The Gotamas have praised Heaven's radiant Daughter, the leader of the charm of pleasant voices. Dawn, thou conferrest on us strength with offspring and men, conspicuous with kine and horses.

verses.sa:
उषस्तमश्यां यशसं सुवीरं दासप्रवर्गं रयिमश्वबुध्यम् ।
सुदंससा श्रवसा या विभासि वाजप्रसूता सुभगे बृहन्तम्॥
verses.tr: uṣastamaśyāṃ yaśasaṃ suvīraṃ dāsapravargaṃ rayimaśvabudhyam sudaṃsasā śravasā yā vibhāsi vājaprasūtā subhage bṛhantam
verses.en: O thou who shinest forth in wondrous glory, urged onward by thy strength, auspicious Lady, Dawn, may I gain that wealth, renowned and ample, in brave sons, troops of slaves, far-famed for horses.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि देवी भुवनाभिचक्ष्या प्रतीची चक्षुरुर्विया वि भाति ।
विश्वं जीवं चरसे बोधयन्ती विश्वस्य वाचमविदन्मनायोः॥
verses.tr: viśvāni devī bhuvanābhicakṣyā pratīcī cakṣururviyā vi bhāti viśvaṃ jīvaṃ carase bodhayantī viśvasya vācamavidanmanāyoḥ
verses.en: Bending her looks on all the world, the Goddess shines, widely spreading with her bright eye westward. Waking to motion every living creature, she understands the voice of each adorer.

verses.sa:
पुनःपुनर्जायमाना पुराणी समानं वर्णमभि शुम्भमाना ।
श्वघ्नीव कृत्नुर्विज आमिनाना मर्तस्य देवी जरयन्त्यायुः॥
verses.tr: punaḥpunarjāyamānā purāṇī samānaṃ varṇamabhi śumbhamānā śvaghnīva kṛtnurvija āminānā martasya devī jarayantyāyuḥ
verses.en: Ancient of days, again again born newly, decking her beauty with the self-same raiment. The Goddess wastes away the life of mortals, like a skilled hunter cutting birds in pieces.

verses.sa:
व्यूर्ण्वती दिवो अन्ताँ अबोध्यप स्वसारं सनुतर्युयोति ।
प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि योषा जारस्य चक्षसा वि भाति॥
verses.tr: vyūrṇvatī divo antāṃ abodhyapa svasāraṃ sanutaryuyoti praminatī manuṣyā yugāni yoṣā jārasya cakṣasā vi bhāti
verses.en: She hath appeared discovering heaven's borders: to the far distance she drives off her Sister. Diminishing the days of human creatures, the Lady shines with all her lover's splendour.

verses.sa:
पशून्न चित्रा सुभगा प्रथाना सिन्धुर्न क्षोद उर्विया व्यश्वैत् ।
अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि सूर्यस्य चेति रश्मिभिर्दृशाना॥
verses.tr: paśūnna citrā subhagā prathānā sindhurna kṣoda urviyā vyaśvait aminatī daivyāni vratāni sūryasya ceti raśmibhirdṛśānā
verses.en: The bright, the blessed One shines forth extending her rays like kine, as a flood rolls his waters. Never transgressing the divine commandments, she is beheld visible with the sunbeams.

verses.sa: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति । येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे॥
verses.tr: uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe
verses.en: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us the wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.

verses.sa: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि । रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति॥
verses.tr: uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibhāvari revadasme vyuccha sūnṛtāvati
verses.en: Thou radiant mover of sweet sounds, with wealth of horses and of kine Shine thou on us this day, O Dawn auspiciously.

verses.sa: युक्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाँ अद्यारुणाँ उषः । अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह॥
verses.tr: yukṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvāṃ adyāruṇāṃ uṣaḥ athā no viśvā saubhagānyā vaha
verses.en: O Dawn enriched with holy rites, yoke to thy car thy purple steeds, And then bring thou unto us all felicities.

verses.sa: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद् दस्रा हिरण्यवत् । अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: aśvinā vartirasmadā gomad dasrā hiraṇyavat arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam
verses.en: O Asvins wonderful in act, do ye unanimous direct Your chariot to our home wealthy in kine and gold.

verses.sa: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः । आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम्॥
verses.tr: yāvitthā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakrathuḥ ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam
verses.en: Ye who brought down the hymn from heaven, a light that giveth light to man, Do ye, O Asvins, bring strength hither unto us.

verses.sa: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी । उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye
verses.en: Hither may they who wake at dawn bring, to drink Soma both the Gods Health-givers Wonder-Workers, borne on paths of gold.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमाविमं सु मे शृणुतं वृषणा हवम् ।
प्रति सूक्तानि हर्यतं भवतं दाशुषे मयः॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomāvimaṃ su me śṛṇutaṃ vṛṣaṇā havam prati sūktāni haryataṃ bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ
verses.en: Agni and Soma, mighty Pair, graciously hearken to my call, Accept in friendly wise my hymn, and prosper him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा यो अद्य वामिदं वचः सपर्यति ।
तस्मै धत्तं सुवीर्यं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā yo adya vāmidaṃ vacaḥ saparyati tasmai dhattaṃ suvīryaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam
verses.en: The man who honours you to-day, Agni and Soma, with this hymn, Bestow on him heroic strength, increase of kine, and noble steeds.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा य आहुतिं यो वां दाशाद्धविष्कृतिम् ।
स प्रजया सुवीर्यं विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवत्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśāddhaviṣkṛtim sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvamāyurvyaśnavat
verses.en: The man who offers holy oil and burnt oblations unto you, Agni and Soma, shall enjoy great strength, with offspring, all his life.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा चेति तद् वीर्यं वां यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गाः ।
अवातिरतं बृसयस्य शेषो ऽविन्दतं ज्योतिरेकं बहुभ्यः॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā ceti tad vīryaṃ vāṃ yadamuṣṇītamavasaṃ paṇiṃ gāḥ avātirataṃ bṛsayasya śeṣo 'vindataṃ jyotirekaṃ bahubhyaḥ
verses.en: Agni and Soma, famed is that your. prowess wherewith ye stole the kine, his food, from Pani. Ye caused the brood of Brsaya to perish; ye found the light, the single light for many.

verses.sa:
युवमेतानि दिवि रोचनान्यग्निश्च सोम सक्रतू अधत्तम् ।
युवं सिन्धूँरभिशस्तेरवद्यादग्नीषोमावमुञ्चतं गृभीतान्॥
verses.tr: yuvametāni divi rocanānyagniśca soma sakratū adhattam yuvaṃ sindhūṃrabhiśasteravadyādagnīṣomāvamuñcataṃ gṛbhītān
verses.en: Agni and Soma, joined in operation ye have set up the shining lights in heaven. From curse and from reproach, Agni and Soma, ye freed the rivers that were bound in fetters.

verses.sa:
आन्यं दिवो मातरिश्वा जभारामथ्नादन्यं परि श्येनो अद्रेः ।
अग्नीषोमा ब्रह्मणा वावृधानोरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: ānyaṃ divo mātariśvā jabhārāmathnādanyaṃ pari śyeno adreḥ agnīṣomā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānoruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokam
verses.en: One of you Matarisvan brought from heaven, the Falcon rent the other from the mountain. Strengthened by holy prayer Agni and Soma have made us ample room for sacrificing.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा हविषः प्रस्थितस्य वीतं हर्यतं वृषणा जुषेथाम् ।
सुशर्माणा स्ववसा हि भूतमथा धत्तं यजमानाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā haviṣaḥ prasthitasya vītaṃ haryataṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām suśarmāṇā svavasā hi bhūtamathā dhattaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: Taste, Agni, Soma, this prepared oblation; accept it, Mighty Ones, and let it please you. Vouchsafe us good protection and kind favour: grant to the sacrificer health and riches.

verses.sa:
यो अग्नीषोमा हविषा सपर्याद् देवद्रीचा मनसा यो घृतेन ।
तस्य व्रतं रक्षतं पातमंहसो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: yo agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyād devadrīcā manasā yo ghṛtena tasya vrataṃ rakṣataṃ pātamaṃhaso viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam
verses.en: Whoso with oil and poured oblation honours, with God-devoted heart, Agni and Soma,-- Protect his sacrifice, preserve him from distress, grant to the sacrificer great felicity.

verses.sa: अग्नीषोमा सवेदसा सहूती वनतं गिरः । सं देवत्रा बभूवथुः॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā savedasā sahūtī vanataṃ giraḥ saṃ devatrā babhūvathuḥ
verses.en: Invoked together, mates in wealth, Agni-Soma, accept our hymns: Together be among the Gods.

verses.sa: अग्नीषोमावनेन वां यो वां घृतेन दाशति । तस्मै दीदयतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomāvanena vāṃ yo vāṃ ghṛtena dāśati tasmai dīdayataṃ bṛhat
verses.en: Agni and Soma, unto him who worships you with holy oil Shine forth an ample recompense.

verses.sa: अग्नीषोमाविमानि नो युवं हव्या जुजोषतम् । आ यातमुप नः सचा॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomāvimāni no yuvaṃ havyā jujoṣatam ā yātamupa naḥ sacā
verses.en: Agni and Soma, be ye pleased with these oblations brought to you, And come, together, nigh to us.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा पिपृतमर्वतो न आ प्यायन्तामुस्रिया हव्यसूदः ।
अस्मे बलानि मघवत्सु धत्तं कृणुतं नो अध्वरं श्रुष्टिमन्तम्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā pipṛtamarvato na ā pyāyantāmusriyā havyasūdaḥ asme balāni maghavatsu dhattaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no adhvaraṃ śruṣṭimantam
verses.en: Agni and Soma, cherish well our horses, and let our cows be fat who yield oblations. Grant power to us and to our wealthy patrons, and cause our holy rites to be successful.

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया ।
भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य संसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: imaṃ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: For Jatavedas worthy of our praise will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car. For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वमायजसे स साधत्यनर्वा क्षेति दधते सुवीर्यम् ।
स तूताव नैनमश्नोत्यंहतिरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvamāyajase sa sādhatyanarvā kṣeti dadhate suvīryam sa tūtāva nainamaśnotyaṃhatiragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: The man for whom thou sacrificest prospereth, dwelleth without a foe, gaineth heroic might. He waxeth strong, distress never approacheth him. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
शकेम त्वा समिधं साधया धियस्त्वे देवा हविरदन्त्याहुतम् ।
त्वमादित्याँ आ वह तान्ह्यु १ श्मस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: śakema tvā samidhaṃ sādhayā dhiyastve devā haviradantyāhutam tvamādityāṃ ā vaha tānhyu 1 śmasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: May we have power to kindle thee. Fulfil our thoughts. In thee the Gods eat the presented offering, Bring hither the Adityas, for we long for them. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
भरामेध्मं कृणवामा हवींषि ते चितयन्तः पर्वणापर्वणा वयम् ।
जीवातवे प्रतरं साधया धियो ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: bharāmedhmaṃ kṛṇavāmā havīṃṣi te citayantaḥ parvaṇāparvaṇā vayam jīvātave prataraṃ sādhayā dhiyo 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: We will bring fuel and prepare burnt offerings, reminding thee at each successive festival. Fulfil our thought that so we may prolong our lives. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
विशां गोपा अस्य चरन्ति जन्तवो द्विपच्च यदुत चतुष्पदक्तुभिः ।
चित्रः प्रकेत उषसो महाँ अस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: viśāṃ gopā asya caranti jantavo dvipacca yaduta catuṣpadaktubhiḥ citraḥ praketa uṣaso mahāṃ asyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: His ministers move forth, the guardians of the folk, protecting quadruped and biped with their rays. Mighty art thou, the wondrous herald of the Dawn. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
त्वमध्वर्युरुत होतासि पूर्व्यः प्रशास्ता पोता जनुषा पुरोहितः ।
विश्वा विद्वाँ आर्त्विज्या धीर पुष्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: tvamadhvaryuruta hotāsi pūrvyaḥ praśāstā potā januṣā purohitaḥ viśvā vidvāṃ ārtvijyā dhīra puṣyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Thou art Presenter and the chief Invoker, thou Director, Purifier, great High Priest by birth. Knowing all priestly work thou perfectest it, Sage. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वतः सुप्रतीकः सदृङ्ङसि दूरे चित्सन्तळिदिवाति रोचसे ।
रात्र्याश्चिदन्धो अति देव पश्यस्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: yo viśvataḥ supratīkaḥ sadṛṅṅasi dūre citsantaḻidivāti rocase rātryāścidandho ati deva paśyasyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Lovely of form art thou, alike on every side; though far, thou shinest brightly as if close at hand. O God, thou seest through even the dark of night. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो देवा भवतु सुन्वतो रथो ऽस्माकं शंसो अभ्यस्तु दूढ्यः ।
तदा जानीतोत पुष्यता वचो ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: pūrvo devā bhavatu sunvato ratho 'smākaṃ śaṃso abhyastu dūḍhyaḥ tadā jānītota puṣyatā vaco 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Gods, foremost be his car who pours libations out, and let our hymn prevail o'er evil-hearted men. Attend to this our speech and make it prosper well. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
वधैर्दुःशंसाँ अप दूढ्यो जहि दूरे वा ये अन्ति वा के चिदत्रिणः ।
अथा यज्ञाय गृणते सुगं कृध्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: vadhairduḥśaṃsāṃ apa dūḍhyo jahi dūre vā ye anti vā ke cidatriṇaḥ athā yajñāya gṛṇate sugaṃ kṛdhyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Smite with thy weapons those of evil speech and thought, devouring demons, whether near or far away. Then to the singer give free way for sacrifice. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यदयुक्था अरुषा रोहिता रथे वातजूता वृषभस्येव ते रवः ।
आदिन्वसि वनिनो धूमकेतुना ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: yadayukthā aruṣā rohitā rathe vātajūtā vṛṣabhasyeva te ravaḥ ādinvasi vanino dhūmaketunā 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: When to thy chariot thou hadst yoked two red steeds and two ruddy steeds, wind-sped, thy roar was like a bull's. Thou with smoke-bannered flame attackest forest trees. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अध स्वनादुत बिभ्युः पतत्रिणो द्रप्सा यत्ते यवसादो व्यस्थिरन् ।
सुगं तत्ते तावकेभ्यो रथेभ्यो ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: adha svanāduta bibhyuḥ patatriṇo drapsā yatte yavasādo vyasthiran sugaṃ tatte tāvakebhyo rathebhyo 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Then at thy roar the very birds are terrified, when, eating-up the grass, thy sparks fly forth abroad. Then is it easy for thee and thy car to pass. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धायसे ऽवयातां मरुतां हेळो अद्भुतः ।
मृळा सु नो भूत्वेषां मनः पुनरग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāyase 'vayātāṃ marutāṃ heḻo adbhutaḥ mṛḻā su no bhūtveṣāṃ manaḥ punaragne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: He hath the Power to soothe Mitra and Varuna: wonderful is the Maruts' wrath when they descend. Be gracious; let their hearts he turned to us again. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
देवो देवानामसि मित्रो अद्भुतो वसुर्वसूनामसि चारुरध्वरे ।
शर्मन्त्स्याम तव सप्रथस्तमे ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: devo devānāmasi mitro adbhuto vasurvasūnāmasi cāruradhvare śarmantsyāma tava saprathastame 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: Thou art a God, thou art the wondrous Friend of Gods, the Vasu of the Vasus, fair in sacrifice. Under, thine own most wide protection may we dwell. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
तत्ते भद्रं यत् समिद्धः स्वे दमे सोमाहुतो जरसे मृळयत्तमः ।
दधासि रत्नं द्रविणं च दाशुषे ऽग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव॥
verses.tr: tatte bhadraṃ yat samiddhaḥ sve dame somāhuto jarase mṛḻayattamaḥ dadhāsi ratnaṃ draviṇaṃ ca dāśuṣe 'gne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava
verses.en: This is thy grace that, kindled in thine own abode, invoked with Soma thou soundest forth most benign, Thou givest wealth and treasure to the worshipper. Let us not in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं सुद्रविणो ददाशो ऽनागास्त्वमदिते सर्वताता ।
यं भद्रेण शवसा चोदयासि प्रजावता राधसा ते स्याम॥
verses.tr: yasmai tvaṃ sudraviṇo dadāśo 'nāgāstvamadite sarvatātā yaṃ bhadreṇa śavasā codayāsi prajāvatā rādhasā te syāma
verses.en: To whom thou, Lord of goodly riches, grantest freedom from every sin with perfect wholeness, Whom with good strength thou quikenest, with children and wealth--may we be they, Eternal Being.

verses.sa:
स त्वमग्ने सौभगत्वस्य विद्वानस्माकमायुः प्र तिरेह देव ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: sa tvamagne saubhagatvasya vidvānasmākamāyuḥ pra tireha deva tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Such, Agni, thou who knowest all good fortune, God, lengthen here the days of our existence. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
द्वे विरूपे चरतः स्वर्थे अन्यान्या वत्समुप धापयेते ।
हरिरन्यस्यां भवति स्वधावाञ् छुक्रो अन्यस्यां ददृशे सुवर्चाः॥
verses.tr: dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyānyā vatsamupa dhāpayete hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñ chukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ
verses.en: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant. One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour; bright and fair-shining, is he with the other.

verses.sa:
दशेमं त्वष्टुर्जनयन्त गर्भमतन्द्रासो युवतयो विभृत्रम् ।
तिग्मानीकं स्वयशसं जनेषु विरोचमानं परि षीं नयन्ति॥
verses.tr: daśemaṃ tvaṣṭurjanayanta garbhamatandrāso yuvatayo vibhṛtram tigmānīkaṃ svayaśasaṃ janeṣu virocamānaṃ pari ṣīṃ nayanti
verses.en: Tvastar's ten daughters, vigilant and youthful, produced this Infant borne to sundry quarters. They bear around him whose long flames are pointed, fulgent among mankind with native splendour.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि जाना परि भूषन्त्यस्य समुद्र एकं दिव्येकमप्सु ।
पूर्वामनु प्र दिशं पार्थिवानामृतून् प्रशासद् वि दधावनुष्ठु॥
verses.tr: trīṇi jānā pari bhūṣantyasya samudra ekaṃ divyekamapsu pūrvāmanu pra diśaṃ pārthivānāmṛtūn praśāsad vi dadhāvanuṣṭhu
verses.en: Three several places of his birth they honour, in mid-air, in the heaven, and in the waters. Governing in the east of earthly regions, the seasons hath he stablished in their order.

verses.sa:
क इमं वो निण्यमा चिकेत वत्सो मातॄर्जनयत स्वधाभिः ।
बह्वीनां गर्भो अपसामुपस्थान्महान् कविर्निश्चरति स्वधावान्॥
verses.tr: ka imaṃ vo niṇyamā ciketa vatso mātṝrjanayata svadhābhiḥ bahvīnāṃ garbho apasāmupasthānmahān kavirniścarati svadhāvān
verses.en: Who of you knows this secret One? The Infant by his own nature hath brought forth his Mothers. The germ of many, from the waters' bosom he goes forth, wise and great, of Godlike nature.

verses.sa:
आविष्ट्यो वर्धते चारुरासु जिह्मानामूर्ध्वः स्वयशा उपस्थे ।
उभे त्वष्टुर्बिभ्यतुर्जायमानात् प्रतीची सिंहं प्रति जोषयेते॥
verses.tr: āviṣṭyo vardhate cārurāsu jihmānāmūrdhvaḥ svayaśā upasthe ubhe tvaṣṭurbibhyaturjāyamānāt pratīcī siṃhaṃ prati joṣayete
verses.en: Visible, fair, he grows in native brightness uplifted in the lap of waving waters. When he was born both Tvastar's worlds were frightened: they turn to him and reverence the Lion.

verses.sa:
उभे भद्रे जोषयेते न मेने गावो न वाश्रा उप तस्थुरेवैः ।
स दक्षाणां दक्षपतिर्बभूवाञ्जन्ति यं दक्षिणतो हविर्भिः॥
verses.tr: ubhe bhadre joṣayete na mene gāvo na vāśrā upa tasthurevaiḥ sa dakṣāṇāṃ dakṣapatirbabhūvāñjanti yaṃ dakṣiṇato havirbhiḥ
verses.en: The Two auspicious Ones, like women, tend him: like lowing cows they seek him in their manner. He is the Lord of Might among the mighty; him, on the right, they balm with their oblations.

verses.sa:
उद् यंयमीति सवितेव बाहू उभे सिचौ यतते भीम ऋञ्जन् ।
उच्छुक्रमत्कमजते सिमस्मान्नवा मातृभ्यो वसना जहाति॥
verses.tr: ud yaṃyamīti saviteva bāhū ubhe sicau yatate bhīma ṛñjan ucchukramatkamajate simasmānnavā mātṛbhyo vasanā jahāti
verses.en: Like Savitar his arms with might he stretches; awful, he strives grasping the world's two borders. He forces out from all a brilliant vesture, yea, from his Mothers draws he forth new raiment.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं रूपं कृणुत उत्तरं यत् संपृञ्चानः सदने गोभिरद्भिः ।
कविर्बुध्नं परि मर्मृज्यते धीः सा देवताता समितिर्बभूव॥
verses.tr: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇuta uttaraṃ yat saṃpṛñcānaḥ sadane gobhiradbhiḥ kavirbudhnaṃ pari marmṛjyate dhīḥ sā devatātā samitirbabhūva
verses.en: He makes him a most noble form of splendour, decking him in his home with milk and waters. The Sage adorns the depths of air with wisdom: this is the meeting where the Gods are worshipped.

verses.sa:
उरु ते ज्रयः पर्येति बुध्नं विरोचमानं महिषस्य धाम ।
विश्वेभिरग्ने स्वयशोभिरिद्धो ऽदब्धेभिः पायुभिः पाह्यस्मान्॥
verses.tr: uru te jrayaḥ paryeti budhnaṃ virocamānaṃ mahiṣasya dhāma viśvebhiragne svayaśobhiriddho 'dabdhebhiḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhyasmān
verses.en: Wide through the firmament spreads forth triumphant the far-resplendent strength of thee the Mighty. Kindled by us do thou preserve us, Agni, with all thy self-bright undiminished succours.

verses.sa:
धन्वन्त्स्रोतः कृणुते गातुमूर्मिं शुक्रैरूर्मिभिरभि नक्षति क्षाम् ।
विश्वा सनानि जठरेषु धत्ते ऽन्तर्नवासु चरति प्रसूषु॥
verses.tr: dhanvantsrotaḥ kṛṇute gātumūrmiṃ śukrairūrmibhirabhi nakṣati kṣām viśvā sanāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte 'ntarnavāsu carati prasūṣu
verses.en: In dry spots he makes stream, and course, and torrent, and inundates the earth with floods that glisten. All ancient things within his maw he gathers, and moves among the new fresh-sprouting grasses.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत् पावक श्रवसे वि भाहि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revat pāvaka śravase vi bhāhi tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Fed with our fuel, purifying Agni, so blaze to us auspiciously for glory. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
स प्रत्नथा सहसा जायमानः सद्यः काव्यानि बळधत्त विश्वा ।
आपश्च मित्रं धिषणा च साधन् देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: sa pratnathā sahasā jāyamānaḥ sadyaḥ kāvyāni baḻadhatta viśvā āpaśca mitraṃ dhiṣaṇā ca sādhan devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: He in the ancient way by strength engendered, lo! straight hath taken to himself all wisdom. The waters and the bowl have made him friendly. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
स पूर्वया निविदा कव्यतायोरिमाः प्रजा अजनयन्मनूनाम् ।
विवस्वता चक्षसा द्यामपश्च देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: sa pūrvayā nividā kavyatāyorimāḥ prajā ajanayanmanūnām vivasvatā cakṣasā dyāmapaśca devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: At Ayu's ancient call he by his wisdom gave all this progeny of men their being, And, by refulgent light, heaven and the waters. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
तमीळत प्रथमं यज्ञसाधं विश आरीराहुतमृञ्जसानम् ।
ऊर्जः पुत्रं भरतं सृप्रदानुं देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: tamīḻata prathamaṃ yajñasādhaṃ viśa ārīrāhutamṛñjasānam ūrjaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ sṛpradānuṃ devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: Praise him, ye Aryan folk, as chief performer of sacrifice adored and ever toiling, Well-tended, Son of Strength, the Constant Giver. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
स मातरिश्वा पुरुवारपुष्टिर्विदद् गातुं तनयाय स्वर्वित् ।
विशां गोपा जनिता रोदस्योर्देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: sa mātariśvā puruvārapuṣṭirvidad gātuṃ tanayāya svarvit viśāṃ gopā janitā rodasyordevā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: That Matarisvan rich in wealth and treasure, light-winner, finds a pathway for his offspring. Guard of our folk, Father of earth and heaven. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
नक्तोषासा वर्णमामेम्याने धापयेते शिशुमेकं समीची ।
द्यावाक्षामा रुक्मो अन्तर्वि भाति देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: naktoṣāsā varṇamāmemyāne dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: Night and Dawn, changing each the other's colour, meeting together suckle one same Infant: Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
रायो बुध्नः संगमनो वसूनां यज्ञस्य केतुर्मन्मसाधनो वेः ।
अमृतत्वं रक्षमाणास एनं देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ yajñasya keturmanmasādhano veḥ amṛtatvaṃ rakṣamāṇāsa enaṃ devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: Root of wealth, gathering-place of treasures, banner of sacrifice, who grants the suppliant's wishes: Preserving him as their own life immortal, the Gods possessed the wealth-bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
नू च पुरा च सदनं रयीणां जातस्य च जायमानस्य च क्षाम् ।
सतश्च गोपां भवतश्च भूरेर्देवा अग्निं धारयन् द्रविणोदाम्॥
verses.tr: nū ca purā ca sadanaṃ rayīṇāṃ jātasya ca jāyamānasya ca kṣām sataśca gopāṃ bhavataśca bhūrerdevā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodām
verses.en: Now and of old the home of wealth, the mansion of what is born and what was born aforetime, Guard of what is and what will be hereafter,--the Gods possessed the wealth bestowing Agni.

verses.sa:
द्रविणोदा द्रविणसस्तुरस्य द्रविणोदाः सनरस्य प्र यंसत् ।
द्रविणोदा वीरवतीमिषं नो द्रविणोदा रासते दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: draviṇodā draviṇasasturasya draviṇodāḥ sanarasya pra yaṃsat draviṇodā vīravatīmiṣaṃ no draviṇodā rāsate dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: May the Wealth-Giver grant us conquering riches; may the Wealth-Giver grant us wealth with heroes. May the Wealth-Giver grant us food with offspring, and length of days may the Wealth-Giver send us.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने समिधा वृधानो रेवत् पावक श्रवस वि भाहि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: evā no agne samidhā vṛdhāno revat pāvaka śravasa vi bhāhi tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Fed with our fuel, purifying Agni, so blaze to us auspiciously for glory. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa: अप नः शोशुचदघमग्ने शुशुग्ध्या रयिम् । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: apa naḥ śośucadaghamagne śuśugdhyā rayim apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Chasing with light our sin away, O Agni, shine thou wealth on us. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: सुक्षेत्रिया सुगातुया वसूया च यजामहे । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: For goodly fields, for pleasant homes, for wealth we sacrifice to thee. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: प्र यद् भन्दिष्ठ एषां प्रास्माकासश्च सूरयः । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaśca sūrayaḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Best praiser of all these be he; foremost, our chiefs who sacrifice. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: प्र यत्ते अग्ने सूरयो जायेमहि प्र ते वयम् । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yatte agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: So that thy worshippers and we, thine, Agni, in our sons may live. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: प्र यदग्नेः सहस्वतो विश्वतो यन्ति भानवः । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: pra yadagneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: As ever-conquering Agni's beams of splendour go to every side, May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: त्वं हि विश्वतोमुख विश्वतः परिभूरसि । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūrasi apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: To every side thy face is turned, thou art triumphant everywhere. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: द्विषो नो विश्वतोमुखाति नावेव पारय । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: O thou whose face looks every way, bear us past foes as in a ship. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa: स नः सिन्धुमिव नावयाति पर्षा स्वस्तये । अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ sindhumiva nāvayāti parṣā svastaye apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: As in a ship, convey thou us for our advantage o'er the flood. May his light chase our sin away.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य सुमतौ स्याम राजा हि कं भुवनानामभिश्रीः ।
इतो जातो विश्वमिदं वि चष्टे वैश्वानरो यतते सूर्येण॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa
verses.en: Still in Vaisvanara's grace may we continue: yea, he is King supreme o'er all things living. Sprung hence to life upon this All he looketh. Vaisvanara hath rivalry with Surya.

verses.sa:
पृष्टो दिवि पृष्टो अग्निः पृथिव्यां पृष्टो विश्वा ओषधीरा विवेश ।
वैश्वानरः सहसा पृष्टो अग्निः स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam
verses.en: Present in heaven, in earth, all-present Agni,--all plants that grow on ground hath he pervaded. May Agni, may Vaisvanara with vigour, present, preserve us day and night from foemen.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानर तव तत् सत्यमस्त्वस्मान् रायो मघवानः सचन्ताम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānara tava tat satyamastvasmān rāyo maghavānaḥ sacantām tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Be this thy truth, Vaisvanara, to us-ward: let wealth in rich abundance gather round us. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
जातवेदसे सुनवाम सोममरातीयतो नि दहाति वेदः ।
स नः पर्षदति दुर्गाणि विश्वा नावेव सिन्धुं दुरितात्यग्निः॥
verses.tr: jātavedase sunavāma somamarātīyato ni dahāti vedaḥ sa naḥ parṣadati durgāṇi viśvā nāveva sindhuṃ duritātyagniḥ
verses.en: For Jatavedas let us press the Soma: may he consume the wealth of the malignant. May Agni carry us through all our troubles, through grief as in a boat across the river.

verses.sa:
स यो वृषा वृष्ण्येभिः समोका महो दिवः पृथिव्याश्च सम्राट् ।
सतीनसत्वा हव्यो भरेषु मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇyebhiḥ samokā maho divaḥ pṛthivyāśca samrāṭ satīnasatvā havyo bhareṣu marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: May he who hath his home with strength, the Mighty, the King supreme of earth and spacious heaven, Lord of true power, to he invoked in battles,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
यस्यानाप्तः सूर्यस्येव यामो भरेभरे वृत्रहा शुष्मो अस्ति ।
वृषन्तमः सखिभिः स्वेभिरेवैर्मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: yasyānāptaḥ sūryasyeva yāmo bharebhare vṛtrahā śuṣmo asti vṛṣantamaḥ sakhibhiḥ svebhirevairmarutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Whose way is unattainable like Surya's: he in each fight is the strong Vrtra-slayer, Mightiest with his Friends in his own courses. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
दिवो न यस्य रेतसो दुघानाः पन्थासो यन्ति शवसापरीताः ।
तरद्द्वेषाः सासहिः पौंस्येभिर्मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: divo na yasya retaso dughānāḥ panthāso yanti śavasāparītāḥ taraddveṣāḥ sāsahiḥ pauṃsyebhirmarutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Whose paths go forth in their great might resistless, forth milking, as it were, heaven's genial moisture. With manly strength triumphant, foe-subduer,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
सो अङ्गिरोभिरङ्गिरस्तमो भूद् वृषा वृषभिः सखिभिः सखा सन् ।
ऋग्मिभिर्ऋग्मी गातुभिर्ज्येष्ठो मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: so aṅgirobhiraṅgirastamo bhūd vṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sakhā san ṛgmibhirṛgmī gātubhirjyeṣṭho marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Among Angirases he was the chiefest, a Friend with friends, mighty amid the mighty. Praiser mid praisers, honoured most of singers. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स सूनुभिर्न रुद्रेभिर्ऋभ्वा नृषाह्ये सासह्वाँ अमित्रान् ।
सनीळेभिः श्रवस्यानि तूर्वन् मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa sūnubhirna rudrebhirṛbhvā nṛṣāhye sāsahvāṃ amitrān sanīḻebhiḥ śravasyāni tūrvan marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Strong with the Rudras as with his own children, in manly battle conquering his foemen ' With his close comrades doing deeds of glory,--may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स मन्युमीः समदनस्य कर्ता ऽस्माकेभिर्नृभिः सूर्यं सनत् ।
अस्मिन्नहन्त्सत्पतिः पुरुहूतो मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa manyumīḥ samadanasya kartā 'smākebhirnṛbhiḥ sūryaṃ sanat asminnahantsatpatiḥ puruhūto marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Humbler of pride, exciter of the conflict, the Lord of heroes, God invoked of many, May he this day gain with our men the sunlight. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तमूतयो रणयञ्छूरसातौ तं क्षेमस्य क्षितयः कृण्वत त्राम् ।
स विश्वस्य करुणस्येश एको मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: tamūtayo raṇayañchūrasātau taṃ kṣemasya kṣitayaḥ kṛṇvata trām sa viśvasya karuṇasyeśa eko marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: His help hath made him cheerer in the battle, the folk have made him guardian of their comfort. Sole Lord is he of every holy service. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तमप्सन्त शवस उत्सवेषु नरो नरमवसे तं धनाय ।
सो अन्धे चित् तमसि ज्योतिर्विदन् मरुत्वान्  नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: tamapsanta śavasa utsaveṣu naro naramavase taṃ dhanāya so andhe cit tamasi jyotirvidan marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: To him the Hero, on high days of prowess, heroes for help and booty shall betake them. He hath found light even in the blinding darkness. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स सव्येन यमति व्राधतश्चित् स दक्षिणे संगृभीता कृतानि ।
स कीरिणा चित् सनिता धनानि मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa savyena yamati vrādhataścit sa dakṣiṇe saṃgṛbhītā kṛtāni sa kīriṇā cit sanitā dhanāni marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: He with his left hand checketh even the mighty, and with his right hand gathereth up the booty. Even with the humble he acquireth riches. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स ग्रामेभिः सनिता स रथेभिर्विदे विश्वाभिः कृष्टिभिर्न्व१द्य ।
स पौंस्येभिरभिभूरशस्तीर्मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa grāmebhiḥ sanitā sa rathebhirvide viśvābhiḥ kṛṣṭibhirnva1dya sa pauṃsyebhirabhibhūraśastīrmarutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: With hosts on foot and cars he winneth treasures: well is he known this day by all the people. With manly might he conquereth those who hate him. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स जामिभिर्यत् समजाति मीह्ले ऽजामिभिर्वा पुरुहूत एवैः ।
अपां तोकस्य तनयस्य जेषे मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती ॥
verses.tr: sa jāmibhiryat samajāti mīhle 'jāmibhirvā puruhūta evaiḥ apāṃ tokasya tanayasya jeṣe marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: When in his ways with kinsmen or with strangers he speedeth to the fight, invoked of many, For gain of waters, and of sons and grandsons, may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
स वज्रभृद् दस्युहा भीम उग्रः सहस्रचेताः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।
चम्रीषो न शवसा पाञ्चजन्यो मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: sa vajrabhṛd dasyuhā bhīma ugraḥ sahasracetāḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā camrīṣo na śavasā pāñcajanyo marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Awful and fierce, fiend-slayer, thunder-wielder, with boundless knowledge, hymned by hundreds, mighty, In strength like Soma, guard of the Five Peoples, may Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
तस्य वज्रः क्रन्दति स्मत् स्वर्षा दिवो न त्वेषो रवथः शिमीवान् ।
तं सचन्ते सनयस्तं धनानि मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: tasya vajraḥ krandati smat svarṣā divo na tveṣo ravathaḥ śimīvān taṃ sacante sanayastaṃ dhanāni marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Winning the light, hitherward roars his thunder like the terrific mighty voice of Heaven. Rich gifts and treasures evermore attend him. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
यस्याजस्रं शवसा मानमुक्थं परिभुजद् रोदसी विश्वतः सीम् ।
स पारिषत् क्रतुभिर्मन्दसानो मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: yasyājasraṃ śavasā mānamukthaṃ paribhujad rodasī viśvataḥ sīm sa pāriṣat kratubhirmandasāno marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: Whose home eternal through his strength surrounds him on every side, his laud, the earth and heaven, May he, delighted with our service, save us. May Indra, girt by Maruts, be our succour.

verses.sa:
न यस्य देवा देवता न मर्ता आपश्चन शवसो अन्तमापुः ।
स प्ररिक्वा त्वक्षसा क्ष्मो दिवश्च मरुत्वान् नो भवत्विन्द्र ऊती॥
verses.tr: na yasya devā devatā na martā āpaścana śavaso antamāpuḥ sa prarikvā tvakṣasā kṣmo divaśca marutvān no bhavatvindra ūtī
verses.en: The limit of whose power not Gods by Godhead, nor mortal men have reached, nor yet the Waters. Both Earth and Heaven in vigour he surpasseth. May Indra, girt by Maruts, he our succour.

verses.sa:
रोहिच्छ्यावा सुमदंशुर्ललामीर्द्युक्षा राय ऋज्राश्वस्य ।
वृषण्वन्तं बिभ्रती धूर्षु रथं मन्द्रा चिकेत नाहुषीषु विक्षु॥
verses.tr: rohicchyāvā sumadaṃśurlalāmīrdyukṣā rāya ṛjrāśvasya vṛṣaṇvantaṃ bibhratī dhūrṣu rathaṃ mandrā ciketa nāhuṣīṣu vikṣu
verses.en: The red and tawny mare, blaze-marked, high standing, celestial who, to bring Rjrasva riches, Drew at the pole the chariot yoked with stallions, joyous, among the hosts of men was noted.

verses.sa:
एतत् त्यत् त इन्द्र वृष्ण उक्थं वार्षागिरा अभि गृणन्ति राधः ।
ऋज्राश्वः प्रष्टिभिरम्बरीषः सहदेवो भयमानः सुराधाः॥
verses.tr: etat tyat ta indra vṛṣṇa ukthaṃ vārṣāgirā abhi gṛṇanti rādhaḥ ṛjrāśvaḥ praṣṭibhirambarīṣaḥ sahadevo bhayamānaḥ surādhāḥ
verses.en: The Varsagiras unto thee, O Indra, the Mighty One, sing forth this laud to please thee, Rjrasva with his fellows, Ambarisa, Suradhas, Sahadeva, Bhayamana.

verses.sa:
दस्यूञ्छिम्यूँश्च पुरुहूत एवैर्हत्वा पृथिव्यां शर्वा नि बर्हीत् ।
सनत् क्षेत्रं सखिभिः श्वित्न्येभिः सनत् सूर्यं सनदपः सुवज्रः॥
verses.tr: dasyūñchimyūṃśca puruhūta evairhatvā pṛthivyāṃ śarvā ni barhīt sanat kṣetraṃ sakhibhiḥ śvitnyebhiḥ sanat sūryaṃ sanadapaḥ suvajraḥ
verses.en: He, much invoked, hath slain Dasyus and Simyus, after his wont, and laid them low with arrows. The mighty Thunderer with his fair-complexioned friends won the land, the sunlight, and the waters.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: May Indra evermore be our protector, and unimperilled may we win the booty. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना ।
अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: pra mandine pitumadarcatā vaco yaḥ kṛṣṇagarbhā nirahannṛjiśvanā avasyavo vṛṣaṇaṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: Sing, with oblation, praise to him who maketh glad, who with Rjisvan drove the dusky brood away. Fain for help, him the strong whose right hand wields the bolt, him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो व्यंसं जाहृषाणेन मन्युना यः शम्बरं यो अहन् पिप्रुमव्रतम् ।
इन्द्रो यः शुष्णमशुषं न्यावृणङ् मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yo vyaṃsaṃ jāhṛṣāṇena manyunā yaḥ śambaraṃ yo ahan piprumavratam indro yaḥ śuṣṇamaśuṣaṃ nyāvṛṇaṅ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: Indra, who with triumphant wrath smote Vyamsa down, and Sambara, and Pipru the unrighteous one; Who extirpated Susna the insatiate,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यस्य द्यावापृथिवी पौंस्यं महद् यस्य व्रते वरुणो यस्य सूर्यः ।
यस्येन्द्रस्य सिन्धवः सश्चति व्रतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yasya dyāvāpṛthivī pauṃsyaṃ mahad yasya vrate varuṇo yasya sūryaḥ yasyendrasya sindhavaḥ saścati vrataṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: He whose great work of manly might is heaven and earth, and Varuna and Surya keep his holy law; Indra, whose law the rivers follow as they flow,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वानां यो गवां गोपतिर्वशी य आरितः कर्मणिकर्मणि स्थिरः ।
वीळोश्चिदिन्द्रो यो असुन्वतो वधो मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ gopatirvaśī ya āritaḥ karmaṇikarmaṇi sthiraḥ vīḻościdindro yo asunvato vadho marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: He who is Lord and Master of the steeds and kine, honoured--the firm and sure--at every holy act; Stayer even of the strong who pours no offering out,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वस्य जगतः प्राणतस्पतिर्यो ब्रह्मणे प्रथमो गा अविन्दत् ।
इन्द्रो यो दस्यूँरधराँ अवातिरन् मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yo viśvasya jagataḥ prāṇataspatiryo brahmaṇe prathamo gā avindat indro yo dasyūṃradharāṃ avātiran marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: He who is Lord of all the world that moves and breathes, who for the Brahman first before all found the Cows; Indra who cast the Dasyus down beneath his feet,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यः शूरेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भीरुभिर्यो धावद्भिर्हूयते यश्च जिग्युभिः ।
इन्द्रं यं विश्वा भुवनाभि संदधुर्मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ śūrebhirhavyo yaśca bhīrubhiryo dhāvadbhirhūyate yaśca jigyubhiḥ indraṃ yaṃ viśvā bhuvanābhi saṃdadhurmarutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: Whom cowards must invoke and valiant men of war, invoked by those who conquer and by those who flee; Indra, to whom all beings turn their constant thought,--him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
रुद्राणामेति प्रदिशा विचक्षणो रुद्रेभिर्योषा तनुते पृथु ज्रयः ।
इन्द्रं मनीषा अभ्यर्चति श्रुतं मरुत्वन्तं सख्याय हवामहे॥
verses.tr: rudrāṇāmeti pradiśā vicakṣaṇo rudrebhiryoṣā tanute pṛthu jrayaḥ indraṃ manīṣā abhyarcati śrutaṃ marutvantaṃ sakhyāya havāmahe
verses.en: Refulgent in the Rudras' region he proceeds, and with the Rudras through the wide space speeds the Dame. The hymn of praise extols Indra the far-renowned: him girt by Maruts we invoke to be our Friend.

verses.sa:
यद्वा मरुत्वः परमे सधस्थे यद् वावमे वृजने मादयासे ।
अत आ याह्यध्वरं नो अच्छा त्वाया हविश्चकृमा सत्यराधः॥
verses.tr: yadvā marutvaḥ parame sadhasthe yad vāvame vṛjane mādayāse ata ā yāhyadhvaraṃ no acchā tvāyā haviścakṛmā satyarādhaḥ
verses.en: O girt by Maruts, whether thou delight thee in loftiest gathering-place or lowly dwelling, Come thence unto our rite, true boon-best-ower: through love of thee have we prepared oblations.

verses.sa:
त्वायेन्द्र सोमं सुषुमा सुदक्ष त्वाया हविश्चकृमा ब्रह्मवाहः ।
अधा नियुत्वः सगणो मरुद्भिरस्मिन् यज्ञे बर्हिषि मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: tvāyendra somaṃ suṣumā sudakṣa tvāyā haviścakṛmā brahmavāhaḥ adhā niyutvaḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmin yajñe barhiṣi mādayasva
verses.en: We, fain for thee, strong Indra, have pressed Soma, and, O thou sought with prayer, have made oblations. Now at this sacrifice, with all thy Maruts, on sacred grass, O team-borne God, rejoice thee.

verses.sa:
मादयस्व हरिभिर्ये त इन्द्र वि ष्यस्व शिप्रे वि सृजस्व धेने ।
आ त्वा सुशिप्र हरयो वहन्तूशन् हव्यानि प्रति नो जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: mādayasva haribhirye ta indra vi ṣyasva śipre vi sṛjasva dhene ā tvā suśipra harayo vahantūśan havyāni prati no juṣasva
verses.en: Rejoice thee with thine own Bay Steeds, O Indra, unclose thy jaws and let thy lips be open. Thou with the fair cheek, let thy Bay Steeds bring thee: gracious to us, he pleased with our oblation.

verses.sa:
मरुत्स्तोत्रस्य वृजनस्य गोपा वयमिन्द्रेण सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: marutstotrasya vṛjanasya gopā vayamindreṇa sanuyāma vājam tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Guards of the camp whose praisers are the Maruts, may we through Indra, get ourselves the booty. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इमां ते धियं प्र भरे महो महीमस्य स्तोत्रे धिषणा यत्त आनजे ।
तमुत्सवे च प्रसवे च सासहिमिन्द्रं देवासः शवसामदन्ननु॥
verses.tr: imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadannanu
verses.en: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea in him victorious through his strength, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्रवो नद्यः सप्त बिभ्रति द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी दर्शतं वपुः ।
अस्मे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभिचक्षे श्रद्धे कमिन्द्र चरतो वितर्तुरम्॥
verses.tr: asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ asme sūryācandramasābhicakṣe śraddhe kamindra carato vitarturam
verses.en: The Seven Rivers bear his glory far and wide, and heaven and sky and earth display his comely form. The Sun and Moon in change alternate run their course, that we, O Indra, may behold and may have faith.

verses.sa:
तं स्मा रथं मघवन् प्राव सातये जैत्रं यं ते अनुमदाम संगमे ।
आजा न इन्द्र मनसा पुरुष्टुत त्वायद्भ्यो मघवञ्छर्म यच्छ नः॥
verses.tr: taṃ smā rathaṃ maghavan prāva sātaye jaitraṃ yaṃ te anumadāma saṃgame ājā na indra manasā puruṣṭuta tvāyadbhyo maghavañcharma yaccha naḥ
verses.en: Maghavan, grant us that same car to bring us spoil, thy conquering car in which we joy in shock of fight. Thou, Indra, whom our hearts praise highly in the war, grant shelter, Maghavan, to us who love thee well.

verses.sa:
वयं जयेम त्वया युजा वृतमस्माकमंशमुदवा भरेभरे ।
अस्मभ्यमिन्द्र वरिवः सुगं कृधि प्र शत्रूणां मघवन् वृष्ण्या रुज॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ jayema tvayā yujā vṛtamasmākamaṃśamudavā bharebhare asmabhyamindra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇyā ruja
verses.en: Encourage thou our side in every fight: may we, with thee for our ally, conquer the foeman's host. Indra, bestow on us joy and felicity break down, O Maghavan, the vigour of our foes.

verses.sa:
नाना हि त्वा हवमाना जना इमे धनानां धर्तरवसा विपन्यवः ।
अस्माकं स्मा रथमा तिष्ठ सातये जैत्रं हीन्द्र निभृतं मनस्तव॥
verses.tr: nānā hi tvā havamānā janā ime dhanānāṃ dhartaravasā vipanyavaḥ asmākaṃ smā rathamā tiṣṭha sātaye jaitraṃ hīndra nibhṛtaṃ manastava
verses.en: For here in divers ways these men invoking thee, holder of treasures, sing hymns to win thine aid. Ascend the car that thou mayest bring spoil to us, for, Indra, thy fixt winneth the victory.

verses.sa:
गोजिता बाहू अमितक्रतुः सिमः कर्मन्कर्मञ्छतमूतिः खजंकरः ।
अकल्प इन्द्रः प्रतिमानमोजसाथा जना वि ह्वयन्ते सिषासवः॥
verses.tr: gojitā bāhū amitakratuḥ simaḥ karmankarmañchatamūtiḥ khajaṃkaraḥ akalpa indraḥ pratimānamojasāthā janā vi hvayante siṣāsavaḥ
verses.en: His arms win kine, his power is boundless in each act best, with a hundred helps waker of battle's din Is Indra: none may rival him in mighty strength. Hence, eager for the spoil the people call on him.

verses.sa:
उत्ते शतान्मघवन्नुच्च भूयस उत् सहस्राद् रिरिचे कृष्टिषु श्रवः ।
अमात्रं त्वा धिषणा तित्विषे मह्यधा वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे पुरंदर॥
verses.tr: utte śatānmaghavannucca bhūyasa ut sahasrād ririce kṛṣṭiṣu śravaḥ amātraṃ tvā dhiṣaṇā titviṣe mahyadhā vṛtrāṇi jighnase puraṃdara
verses.en: Thy glory, Maghavan, exceeds a hundred yea, more than a hundred, than a thousand mid the folk, The great bowl hath inspirited thee boundlessly: so mayst thou slay the Vrtras breaker-down of forts!

verses.sa:
त्रिविष्टिधातु प्रतिमानमोजसस्तिस्रो भूमीर्नृपते त्रीणि रोचना ।
अतीदं विश्वं भुवनं ववक्षिथाशत्रुरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि॥
verses.tr: triviṣṭidhātu pratimānamojasastisro bhūmīrnṛpate trīṇi rocanā atīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vavakṣithāśatrurindra januṣā sanādasi
verses.en: Of thy great might there is a three counterpart, the three earths, Lord men and the three realms of light. Above this whole world, Indra, thou hast waxen great: without a foe art thou, nature, from of old.

verses.sa:
त्वां देवेषु प्रथमं हवामहे त्वं बभूथ पृतनासु सासहिः ।
सेमं नः कारुमुपमन्युमुद्भिदमिन्द्रः कृणोतु प्रसवे रथं पुरः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvaṃ babhūtha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ semaṃ naḥ kārumupamanyumudbhidamindraḥ kṛṇotu prasave rathaṃ puraḥ
verses.en: We invocate thee first among the Deities: thou hast become a mighty Conquer in fight. May Indra fill with spirit this our singer's heart, and make our car impetuous, foremost in attack.

verses.sa:
त्वं जिगेथ न धना रुरोधिथार्भेष्वाजा मघवन् महत्सु च ।
त्वामुग्रमवसे सं शिशीमस्यथा न इन्द्र हवनेषु चोदय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ jigetha na dhanā rurodhithārbheṣvājā maghavan mahatsu ca tvāmugramavase saṃ śiśīmasyathā na indra havaneṣu codaya
verses.en: Thou hast prevailed, and hast not kept the booty back, in trifling battles in those of great account. We make thee keen, the Mighty One, succour us: inspire us, Maghavan, when we defy the foe.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहेन्द्रो अधिवक्ता नो अस्त्वपरिह्वृताः सनुयाम वाजम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: viśvāhendro adhivaktā no astvaparihvṛtāḥ sanuyāma vājam tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: May Indra evermore be our Protector, and unimperilled may we win the booty. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
तत् त इन्द्रियं परमं पराचैरधारयन्त कवयः पुरेदम् ।
क्षमेदमन्यद् दिव्य १ न्यदस्य समी पृच्यते समनेव केतुः॥
verses.tr: tat ta indriyaṃ paramaṃ parācairadhārayanta kavayaḥ puredam kṣamedamanyad divya 1 nyadasya samī pṛcyate samaneva ketuḥ
verses.en: That highest Indra-power of thine is distant: that which is here sages possessed aforetime. This one is on the earth, in heaven the other, and both unite as flag with flag in battle.

verses.sa:
स धारयत् पृथिवीं पप्रथच्च वज्रेण हत्वा निरपः ससर्ज ।
अहन्नहिमभिनद्रौहिणं व्यहन् व्यंसं मघवा शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: sa dhārayat pṛthivīṃ paprathacca vajreṇa hatvā nirapaḥ sasarja ahannahimabhinadrauhiṇaṃ vyahan vyaṃsaṃ maghavā śacībhiḥ
verses.en: He spread the wide earth out and firmly fixed it, smote with his thunderbolt and loosed the waters. Maghavan with his puissance struck down Ahi, rent Rauhina to death and slaughtered Vyamsa.

verses.sa:
स जातूभर्मा श्रद्दधान ओजः पुरो विभिन्दन्नचरद् वि दासीः ।
विद्वान् वज्रिन् दस्यवे हेतिमस्याऽऽर्यं सहो वर्धया द्युम्नमिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: sa jātūbharmā śraddadhāna ojaḥ puro vibhindannacarad vi dāsīḥ vidvān vajrin dasyave hetimasyā''ryaṃ saho vardhayā dyumnamindra
verses.en: Armed with his bolt and trusting in his prowess he wandered shattering the forts of Dasas. Cast thy dart, knowing, Thunderer, at the Dasyu; increase the Arya's might and glory, Indra.

verses.sa:
