तदूचुषे मानुषेमा युगानि कीर्तेन्यं मघवा नाम बिभ्रत् ।
उपप्रयन् दस्युहत्याय वज्री यद्ध सूनुः श्रवसे नाम दधे॥
verses.tr: tadūcuṣe mānuṣemā yugāni kīrtenyaṃ maghavā nāma bibhrat upaprayan dasyuhatyāya vajrī yaddha sūnuḥ śravase nāma dadhe
verses.en: For him who thus hath taught these human races, Maghavan, bearing a fame-worthy title, Thunderer, drawing nigh to slay the Dasyus, hath given himself the name of Son for glory.

verses.sa:
तदस्येदं पश्यता भूरि पुष्टं श्रदिन्द्रस्य धत्तन वीर्याय ।
स गा अविन्दत् सो अविन्ददश्वान् त्स ओषधीः सो अपः स वनानि॥
verses.tr: tadasyedaṃ paśyatā bhūri puṣṭaṃ śradindrasya dhattana vīryāya sa gā avindat so avindadaśvān tsa oṣadhīḥ so apaḥ sa vanāni
verses.en: See this abundant wealth that he possesses, and put your trust in Indra's hero vigour. He found the cattle, and he found the horses, he found the plants, the forests and the waters.

verses.sa:
भूरिकर्मणे वृषभाय वृष्णे सत्यशुष्माय सुनवाम सोमम् ।
य आदृत्या परिपन्थीव शूरो ऽयज्वनो विभजन्नेति वेदः॥
verses.tr: bhūrikarmaṇe vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe satyaśuṣmāya sunavāma somam ya ādṛtyā paripanthīva śūro 'yajvano vibhajanneti vedaḥ
verses.en: To him the truly strong, whose deeds are many, to him the strong Bull let us pour the Soma. The Hero, watching like a thief in ambush, goes parting the possessions of the godless.

verses.sa:
तदिन्द्र प्रेव वीर्यं चकर्थ यत् ससन्तं वज्रेणाबोधयोऽहिम् ।
अनु त्वा पत्नीर्हृषितं वयश्च विश्वे देवासो अमदन्ननु त्वा॥
verses.tr: tadindra preva vīryaṃ cakartha yat sasantaṃ vajreṇābodhayo'him anu tvā patnīrhṛṣitaṃ vayaśca viśve devāso amadannanu tvā
verses.en: Well didst thou do that hero deed, O Indra, in waking with thy bolt the slumbering Ahi. in thee, delighted, Dames divine rejoiced them, the flying Maruts and all Gods were joyful.

verses.sa:
शुष्णं पिप्रुं कुयवं वृत्रमिन्द्र यदावधीर्वि पुरः शम्बरस्य ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: śuṣṇaṃ pipruṃ kuyavaṃ vṛtramindra yadāvadhīrvi puraḥ śambarasya tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: As thou hast smitten Susna, Pipru, Vrtra and Kuyava, and Sambara's forts O Indra. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
योनिष्ट इन्द्र निषदे अकारि तमा नि षीद स्वानो नार्वा ।
विमुच्या वयोऽवसायाश्वान् दोषा वस्तोर्वहीयसः प्रपित्वे॥
verses.tr: yoniṣṭa indra niṣade akāri tamā ni ṣīda svāno nārvā vimucyā vayo'vasāyāśvān doṣā vastorvahīyasaḥ prapitve
verses.en: The altar hath been made for thee to rest on: come like a panting courser and be seated. Loosen thy flying Steeds, set free thy Horses who bear thee swiftly nigh at eve and morning.

verses.sa:
ओ त्ये नर इन्द्रमूतये गुर्नू चित् तान् त्सद्यो अध्वनो जगम्यात् ।
देवासो मन्युं दासस्य श्चम्नन् ते न आ वक्षन् त्सुविताय वर्णम्॥
verses.tr: o tye nara indramūtaye gurnū cit tān tsadyo adhvano jagamyāt devāso manyuṃ dāsasya ścamnan te na ā vakṣan tsuvitāya varṇam
verses.en: These men have come to Indra for assistance: shall he not quickly come upon these pathways? May the Gods quell the fury of the Dasa, and may they lead our folk to happy fortune.

verses.sa:
अव त्मना भरते केतवेदा अव त्मना भरते फेनमुदन् ।
क्षीरेण स्नातः कुयवस्य योषे हते ते स्यातां प्रवणे शिफायाः॥
verses.tr: ava tmanā bharate ketavedā ava tmanā bharate phenamudan kṣīreṇa snātaḥ kuyavasya yoṣe hate te syātāṃ pravaṇe śiphāyāḥ
verses.en: He who hath only wish as his possession casts on himself, casts foam amid the waters. Both wives of Kuyava in milk have bathed them: may they be drowned within the depth of Sipha.

verses.sa:
युयोप नाभिरुपरस्यायोः प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते राष्टि शूरः ।
अञ्जसी कुलिशी वीरपत्नी पयो हिन्वाना उदभिर्भरन्ते॥
verses.tr: yuyopa nābhiruparasyāyoḥ pra pūrvābhistirate rāṣṭi śūraḥ añjasī kuliśī vīrapatnī payo hinvānā udabhirbharante
verses.en: This hath his kinship checked who lives beside us: with ancient streams forth speeds and rules the Hero, Añjasi, Kulisi, and Virapatni, delighting him, bear milk upon their waters.

verses.sa:
प्रति यत् स्या नीथादर्शि दस्योरोको नाच्छा सदनं जानती गात् ।
अध स्मा नो मघवञ्चर्कृतादिन्मा नो मघेव निष्षपी परा दाः॥
verses.tr: prati yat syā nīthādarśi dasyoroko nācchā sadanaṃ jānatī gāt adha smā no maghavañcarkṛtādinmā no magheva niṣṣapī parā dāḥ
verses.en: Soon as this Dasyu's traces were discovered, as she who knows her home, he sought the dwelling. Now think thou of us, Maghavan, nor cast us away as doth a profligate his treasure.

verses.sa:
स त्वं न इन्द्र सूर्ये सो अप्स्वनागास्त्व आ भज जीवशंसे ।
मान्तरां भुजमा रीरिषो नः श्रद्धितं ते महत इन्द्रियाय॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ na indra sūrye so apsvanāgāstva ā bhaja jīvaśaṃse māntarāṃ bhujamā rīriṣo naḥ śraddhitaṃ te mahata indriyāya
verses.en: Indra, as such, give us a share of sunlight, of waters, sinlessness, and reputation. Do thou no harm to our yet unborn offspring: our trust is in thy mighty Indra-power.

verses.sa:
अधा मन्ये श्रत् ते अस्मा अधायि वृषा चोदस्व महते धनाय ।
मा नो अकृते पुरुहूत योनाविन्द्र क्षुध्यद्भ्यो वय आसुतिं दाः॥
verses.tr: adhā manye śrat te asmā adhāyi vṛṣā codasva mahate dhanāya mā no akṛte puruhūta yonāvindra kṣudhyadbhyo vaya āsutiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Now we, I think, in thee as such have trusted: lead us on, Mighty One, to ample riches. In no unready house give us, O Indra invoked of many, food and drink when hungry.

verses.sa:
मा नो वधीरिन्द्र मा परा दा मा नः प्रिया भोजनानि प्र मोषीः ।
आण्डा मा नो मघवञ्छक्र निर्भेन्मा नः पात्रा भेत् सहजानुषाणि॥
verses.tr: mā no vadhīrindra mā parā dā mā naḥ priyā bhojanāni pra moṣīḥ āṇḍā mā no maghavañchakra nirbhenmā naḥ pātrā bhet sahajānuṣāṇi
verses.en: Slay us not, Indra; do not thou forsake us: steal not away the joys which we delight in. Rend not our unborn brood, strong Lord of Bounty! our vessels with the life that is within them.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङेहि सोमकामं त्वाहुरयं सुतस्तस्य पिबा मदाय ।
उरुव्यचा जठर आ वृषस्व पितेव नः शृणुहि हूयमानः॥
verses.tr: arvāṅehi somakāmaṃ tvāhurayaṃ sutastasya pibā madāya uruvyacā jaṭhara ā vṛṣasva piteva naḥ śṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ
verses.en: Come to us; they have called thee Soma-lover: here is the pressed juice. Drink thereof for rapture. Widely-capacious, pour it down within thee, and, invocated, hear us like a Father.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा अप्स्व १ न्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि ।
न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: candramā apsva 1 ntarā suparṇo dhāvate divi na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Within the waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings in heaven. Ye lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अर्थमिद् वा उ अर्थिन आ जाया युवते पतिम् ।
तुञ्जाते वृष्ण्यं पयः परिदाय रसं दुहे वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: arthamid vā u arthina ā jāyā yuvate patim tuñjāte vṛṣṇyaṃ payaḥ paridāya rasaṃ duhe vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Surely men crave and gain their wish. Close to her husband clings the wife. And, in embraces intertwined, both give and take the bliss of love. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
मो षु देवा अदः स्व १ रव पादि दिवस्परि ।
मा सोम्यस्य शम्भुवः शूने भूम कदा चन वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu devā adaḥ sva 1 rava pādi divaspari mā somyasya śambhuvaḥ śūne bhūma kadā cana vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: O never may that light, ye Gods, fall from its station in the sky. Ne'er fail us one like Soma sweet, the spring of our felicity. Mark this my woe ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्ञं पृच्छाम्यवमं स तद् दूतो वि वोचति ।
क्व ऋतं पूर्व्यं गतं कस्तद् बिभर्ति नूतनो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: yajñaṃ pṛcchāmyavamaṃ sa tad dūto vi vocati kva ṛtaṃ pūrvyaṃ gataṃ kastad bibharti nūtano vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: I ask the last of sacrifice. As envoy he shall tell it forth. Where is the ancient law divine? Who is its new diffuser now? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये देवाः स्थन त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ।
कद् व ऋतं कदनृतं क्व प्रत्ना व आहुतिर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: amī ye devāḥ sthana triṣvā rocane divaḥ kad va ṛtaṃ kadanṛtaṃ kva pratnā va āhutirvittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Ye Gods who yonder have your home in the three lucid realms of heaven, What count ye truth and what untruth? Where is mine ancient call on you? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
कद् व ऋतस्य धर्णसि कद् वरुणस्य चक्षणम् ।
कदर्यम्णो महस्पथाति क्रामेम दूढ्यो  वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: kad va ṛtasya dharṇasi kad varuṇasya cakṣaṇam kadaryamṇo mahaspathāti krāmema dūḍhyo vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: What is your firm support of Law? What Varuna's observant eye? How may we pass the wicked on the path of mighty Aryaman? Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अहं सो अस्मि यः पुरा सुते वदामि कानि चित् ।
तं मा व्यन्त्याध्यो ३ वृको न तृष्णजं मृगं  वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ so asmi yaḥ purā sute vadāmi kāni cit taṃ mā vyantyādhyo 3 vṛko na tṛṣṇajaṃ mṛgaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: I am the man who sang of old full many a laud when Soma flowed. Yet torturing cares consume me as the wolf assails the thirsty deer. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सं मा तपन्त्यभितः सपत्नीरिव पर्शवः ।
मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्यः स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: saṃ mā tapantyabhitaḥ sapatnīriva parśavaḥ mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhyaḥ stotāraṃ te śatakrato vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Like rival wives on every side enclosing ribs oppress me sore. O Satakratu, biting cares devour me, singer of thy praise, as rats devour the weaver's threads. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये सप्त रश्मयस्तत्रा मे नाभिरातता ।
त्रितस्तद् वेदाप्त्यः स जामित्वाय रेभति   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: amī ye sapta raśmayastatrā me nābhirātatā tritastad vedāptyaḥ sa jāmitvāya rebhati vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Where those seven rays are shining, thence my home and family extend. This Trta Aptya knoweth well, and speaketh out for brotherhood. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अमी ये पञ्चोक्षणो मध्ये तस्थुर्महो दिवः ।
देवत्रा नु प्रवाच्यं सध्रीचीना नि वावृतुर्वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: amī ye pañcokṣaṇo madhye tasthurmaho divaḥ devatrā nu pravācyaṃ sadhrīcīnā ni vāvṛturvittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: May those five Bulls which stand on high full in the midst of mighty heaven, Having together swiftly borne my praises to the Gods, return. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा एत आसते मध्य आरोधने दिवः ।
ते सेधन्ति पथो वृकं तरन्तं यह्वतीरपो   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: suparṇā eta āsate madhya ārodhane divaḥ te sedhanti patho vṛkaṃ tarantaṃ yahvatīrapo vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: High in the mid ascent of heaven those Birds of beauteous pinion sit. Back from his path they drive the wolf as he would cross the restless floods. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
नव्यं तदुक्थ्यं हितं देवासः सुप्रवाचनम् ।
ऋतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः सत्यं तातान सूर्यो   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: navyaṃ tadukthyaṃ hitaṃ devāsaḥ supravācanam ṛtamarṣanti sindhavaḥ satyaṃ tātāna sūryo vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Firm is this new-wrought hymn of praise, and meet to be told forth, O Gods. The flowing of the floods is Law, Truth is the Sun's extended light. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव त्यदुक्थ्यं देवेष्वस्त्याप्यम् ।
स नः सत्तो मनुष्वदा देवान् यक्षि विदुष्टरो   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: agne tava tyadukthyaṃ deveṣvastyāpyam sa naḥ satto manuṣvadā devān yakṣi viduṣṭaro vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Worthy of laud, O Agni, is that kinship which thou hast with Gods. Here seat thee like a man: most wise, bring thou the Gods for sacrifice. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
सत्तो होता मनुष्वदा देवाँ अच्छा विदुष्टरः ।
अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरो   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: satto hotā manuṣvadā devāṃ acchā viduṣṭaraḥ agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiro vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Here seated, man-like as a priest shall wisest Agni to the Gods Speed onward our oblations, God among the Gods, intelligent. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा कृणोति वरुणो गातुविदं तमीमहे ।
व्यूर्णोति हृदा मतिं नव्यो जायतामृतं वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: brahmā kṛṇoti varuṇo gātuvidaṃ tamīmahe vyūrṇoti hṛdā matiṃ navyo jāyatāmṛtaṃ vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Varuna makes the holy prayer. To him who finds the path we pray. He in the heart reveals his thought. Let sacred worship rise anew. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
असौ यः पन्था आदित्यो दिवि प्रवाच्यं कृतः ।
न स देवा अतिक्रमे तं मर्तासो न पश्यथ   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: asau yaḥ panthā ādityo divi pravācyaṃ kṛtaḥ na sa devā atikrame taṃ martāso na paśyatha vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: That pathway of the Sun in heaven, made to be highly glorified, Is not to be transgressed, O Gods. O mortals, ye behold it not. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
त्रितः कूपेऽवहितो देवान् हवत ऊतये ।
तच्छुश्राव बृहस्पतिः कृण्वन्नंहूरणादुरु  वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: tritaḥ kūpe'vahito devān havata ūtaye tacchuśrāva bṛhaspatiḥ kṛṇvannaṃhūraṇāduru vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Trita, when buried in the well, calls on the Gods to succour him. That call of his Brhaspati heard and released him from distress. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
अरुणो मा सकृद् वृकः पथा यन्तं ददर्श हि ।
उज्जिहीते निचाय्या तष्टेव पृष्ट्यामयी   वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: aruṇo mā sakṛd vṛkaḥ pathā yantaṃ dadarśa hi ujjihīte nicāyyā taṣṭeva pṛṣṭyāmayī vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: A ruddy wolf beheld me once, as I was faring on my path. He, like a carpenter whose back is aching crouched and slunk away. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
एनाङ्गूषेण वयमिन्द्रवन्तो ऽभि ष्याम वृजने सर्ववीराः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: enāṅgūṣeṇa vayamindravanto 'bhi ṣyāma vṛjane sarvavīrāḥ tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Through this our song may we, allied with Indra, with all our heroes conquer in the battle. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमूतये मारुतं शर्धो अदितिं हवामहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: Call we for aid on Indra, Mitra, Varuna and Agni and the Marut host and Aditi. Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
त आदित्या आ गता सर्वतातये भूत देवा वृत्रतूर्येषु शम्भुवः ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śambhuvaḥ rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: Come ye Adityas for our full prosperity, in conquests of the foe, ye Gods, bring joy to us. Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
अवन्तु नः पितरः सुप्रवाचना उत देवी देवपुत्रे ऋतावृधा ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: May the most glorious Fathers aid us, and the two Goddesses, Mothers of the Gods, who strengthen Law. Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
नराशंसं वाजिनं वाजयन्निह क्षयद्वीरं पूषणं सुम्नैरीमहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayanniha kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnairīmahe rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: To mighty Narasamsa, strengthening his might, to Pusan, ruler over men, we pray with hymns. Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते सदमिन्नः सुगं कृधि शं योर्यत् ते मनुर्हितं तदीमहे ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate sadaminnaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yoryat te manurhitaṃ tadīmahe rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: Brhaspati, make us evermore an easy path: we crave what boon thou hast for men in rest and stir. Like as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं कुत्सो वृत्रहणं शचीपतिं काटे निबाह्ल ऋषिरह्वदूतये ।
रथं न दुर्गाद् वसवः सुदानवो विश्वस्मान्नो अंहसो निष्पिपर्तन॥
verses.tr: indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāhla ṛṣirahvadūtaye rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmānno aṃhaso niṣpipartana
verses.en: Sunk in the pit the Rsi Kutsa called, to aid, Indra the Vrtra-slayer, Lord of power and might. Even as a chariot from a difficult ravine, bountiful Vasus, rescue us from all distress.

verses.sa:
देवैर्नो देव्यदितिर्नि पातु देवस्त्राता त्रायतामप्रयुच्छन् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: devairno devyaditirni pātu devastrātā trāyatāmaprayucchan tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: May Aditi the Goddess guard us with the Gods: may the protecting God keep us with ceaseless care. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो देवानां प्रत्येति सुम्नमादित्यासो भवता मृळयन्तः ।
आ वोऽर्वाची सुमतिर्ववृत्यादंहोश्चिद्या वरिवोवित्तरासत्॥
verses.tr: yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḻayantaḥ ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādaṃhościdyā varivovittarāsat
verses.en: The sacrifice obtains the Gods' acceptance: be graciously inclined to us, Adityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed, and be our best deliverer from trouble.

verses.sa:
उप नो देवा अवसा गमन्त्वङ्गिरसां सामभिः स्तूयमानाः ।
इन्द्र इन्द्रियैर्मरुतो मरुद्भिरादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यंसत्॥
verses.tr: upa no devā avasā gamantvaṅgirasāṃ sāmabhiḥ stūyamānāḥ indra indriyairmaruto marudbhirādityairno aditiḥ śarma yaṃsat
verses.en: By praise-songs of Angirases exalted, may the Gods come to us with their protection. May Indra with his powers, Maruts with Maruts, Aditi with Adityas grant us shelter.

verses.sa:
तन्न इन्द्रस्तद् वरुणस्तदग्निस्तदर्यमा तत् सविता चनो धात् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: tanna indrastad varuṇastadagnistadaryamā tat savitā cano dhāt tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: This laud of ours may Varuna and Indra, Aryaman Agni, Savitar find pleasant. This prayer' of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्राग्नी चित्रतमो रथो वामभि विश्वानि भुवनानि चष्टे ।
तेना यातं सरथं तस्थिवांसाथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: ya indrāgnī citratamo ratho vāmabhi viśvāni bhuvanāni caṣṭe tenā yātaṃ sarathaṃ tasthivāṃsāthā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: On that most wondrous car of yours, O Indra and Agni, which looks round on all things living, Take ye your stand and come to us together, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यावदिदं भुवनं विश्वमस्त्युरुव्यचा वरिमता गभीरम् ।
तावाँ अयं पातवे सोमो अस्त्वरमिन्द्राग्नी मनसे युवभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: yāvadidaṃ bhuvanaṃ viśvamastyuruvyacā varimatā gabhīram tāvāṃ ayaṃ pātave somo astvaramindrāgnī manase yuvabhyām
verses.en: As vast as all this world is in its compass, deep as it is, with its far-stretching surface, So let this Soma be, Indra and Agni, made for your drinking till your soul be sated.

verses.sa:
चक्राथे हि सध्र्य १ ङ्नाम भद्रं सध्रीचीना वृत्रहणा उत स्थः ।
ताविन्द्राग्नी सध्र्यञ्चा निषद्या वृष्णः सोमस्य वृषणा वृषेथाम्॥
verses.tr: cakrāthe hi sadhrya 1 ṅnāma bhadraṃ sadhrīcīnā vṛtrahaṇā uta sthaḥ tāvindrāgnī sadhryañcā niṣadyā vṛṣṇaḥ somasya vṛṣaṇā vṛṣethām
verses.en: For ye have won a blessed name together: yea, with one aim ye strove, O Vrtra-slayers. So Indra-Agni, seated here together, pour in, ye Mighty Ones, the mighty Soma.

verses.sa:
समिद्धेष्वग्निष्वानजाना यतस्रुचा बर्हिरु तिस्तिराणा ।
तीव्रैः सोमैः परिषिक्तेभिरर्वागेन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम्॥
verses.tr: samiddheṣvagniṣvānajānā yatasrucā barhiru tistirāṇā tīvraiḥ somaiḥ pariṣiktebhirarvāgendrāgnī saumanasāya yātam
verses.en: Both stand adorned, when fires are duly kindled, spreading the sacred grass, with lifted ladles. Drawn by strong Soma juice poured forth around us, come, Indra-Agni, and display your favour.

verses.sa:
यानीन्द्राग्नी चक्रथुर्वीर्याणि यानि रूपाण्युत वृष्ण्यानि ।
या वां प्रत्नानि सख्या शिवानि तेभिः सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yānīndrāgnī cakrathurvīryāṇi yāni rūpāṇyuta vṛṣṇyāni yā vāṃ pratnāni sakhyā śivāni tebhiḥ somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: The brave deeds ye have done, Indra and Agni, the forms ye have displayed and mighty exploits, The ancient and auspicious bonds of friendship,--for sake of these drink of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदब्रवं प्रथमं वां वृणानो ३ ऽयं सोमो असुरैर्नो विहव्यः ।
तां सत्यां श्रद्धामभ्या हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadabravaṃ prathamaṃ vāṃ vṛṇāno 3 'yaṃ somo asurairno vihavyaḥ tāṃ satyāṃ śraddhāmabhyā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: As first I said when choosing you, in battle we must contend with Asuras for this Soma. So came ye unto this my true conviction, and drank libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी मदथः स्वे दुरोणे यद् ब्रह्मणि राजनि वा यजत्रा ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī madathaḥ sve duroṇe yad brahmaṇi rājani vā yajatrā ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: If in your dwelling, or with prince or Brahman, ye, Indra-Agni, Holy Ones, rejoice you, Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libation of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी यदुषु तुर्वशेषु यद् द्रुह्युष्वनुषु पूरुषु स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī yaduṣu turvaśeṣu yad druhyuṣvanuṣu pūruṣu sthaḥ ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: If with, the Yadus, Turvasas, ye sojourn, with Druhyus, Anus, Purus, Indra-Agni! Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी अवमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यां परमस्यामुत स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī avamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāṃ paramasyāmuta sthaḥ ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: Whether, O Indra-Agni, ye be dwelling in lowest earth, in central, or in highest. Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी परमस्यां पृथिव्यां मध्यमस्यामवमस्यामुत स्थः ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī paramasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ madhyamasyāmavamasyāmuta sthaḥ ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: Whether, O Indra-Agni, ye be dwelling in highest earth, in central, or in lowest, Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी दिवि ष्ठो यत् पृथिव्यां यत् पर्वतेष्वोषधीष्वप्सु ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī divi ṣṭho yat pṛthivyāṃ yat parvateṣvoṣadhīṣvapsu ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: Whether ye be in heaven, O Indra-Agni, on earth, on mountains, in the herbs, or waters, Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी उदिता सूर्यस्य मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयेथे ।
अतः परि वृषणावा हि यातमथा सोमस्य पिबतं सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yadindrāgnī uditā sūryasya madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayethe ataḥ pari vṛṣaṇāvā hi yātamathā somasya pibataṃ sutasya
verses.en: If, when the Sun to the mid-heaven hath mounted, ye take delight in food, O Indra-Agni, Even from thence, ye mighty Lords, come hither, and drink libations of the flowing Soma.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्नी पपिवांसा सुतस्य विश्वास्मभ्यं सं जयतं धनानि ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: evendrāgnī papivāṃsā sutasya viśvāsmabhyaṃ saṃ jayataṃ dhanāni tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Thus having drunk your fill of our libation, win us all kinds of wealth, Indra and Agni. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
वि ह्यख्यं मनसा वस्य इच्छन्निन्द्राग्नी ज्ञास उत वा सजातान् ।
नान्या युवत् प्रमतिरस्ति मह्यं स वां धियं वाजयन्तीमतक्षम्॥
verses.tr: vi hyakhyaṃ manasā vasya icchannindrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān nānyā yuvat pramatirasti mahyaṃ sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīmatakṣam
verses.en: Longing for weal I looked around, in spirit, for kinsmen, Indra-Agni, or for brothers. No providence but yours alone is with me so have I wrought for you this hymn for succour.

verses.sa:
अश्रवं हि भूरिदावत्तरा वां विजामातुरुत वा घा स्यालात् ।
अथा सोमस्य प्रयती युवभ्यामिन्द्राग्नी स्तोमं जनयामि नव्यम्॥
verses.tr: aśravaṃ hi bhūridāvattarā vāṃ vijāmāturuta vā ghā syālāt athā somasya prayatī yuvabhyāmindrāgnī stomaṃ janayāmi navyam
verses.en: For I have heard that ye give wealth more freely than worthless son-in-law or spouse's brother. So offering to you this draught of Soma, I make you this new hymn, Indra and Agni,

verses.sa:
मा च्छेद्म रश्मीँरिति नाधमानाः पितॄणां शक्तीरनुयच्छमानाः ।
इन्द्राग्निभ्यां कं वृषणो मदन्ति ता ह्यद्री धिषणाया उपस्थे॥
verses.tr: mā cchedma raśmīṃriti nādhamānāḥ pitṝṇāṃ śaktīranuyacchamānāḥ indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti tā hyadrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe
verses.en: Let us not break the cords: with this petition we strive to gain the powers of our forefathers. For Indra-Agni the strong drops are joyful, for here in the bowl's lap are both the press-stones.

verses.sa:
युवाभ्यां देवी धिषणा मदायेन्द्राग्नी सोममुशती सुनोति ।
तावश्विना भद्रहस्ता सुपाणी आ धावतं मधुना पृङ्क्तमप्सु॥
verses.tr: yuvābhyāṃ devī dhiṣaṇā madāyendrāgnī somamuśatī sunoti tāvaśvinā bhadrahastā supāṇī ā dhāvataṃ madhunā pṛṅktamapsu
verses.en: For you the bowl divine, Indra and Agni, presses the Soma gladly to delight you. With hands auspicious and fair arms, ye Asvins, haste, sprinkle it with sweetness in the waters.

verses.sa:
युवामिन्द्राग्नी वसुनो विभागे तवस्तमा शुश्रव वृत्रहत्ये ।
तावासद्या बर्हिषि यज्ञे अस्मिन् प्र चर्षणी मादयेथां सुतस्य॥
verses.tr: yuvāmindrāgnī vasuno vibhāge tavastamā śuśrava vṛtrahatye tāvāsadyā barhiṣi yajñe asmin pra carṣaṇī mādayethāṃ sutasya
verses.en: You, I have heard, were mightiest, Indra-Agni, when Vrtra fell and when the spoil was parted. Sit at this sacrifice, ye ever active, on the strewn grass, and with the juice delight you.

verses.sa:
प्र चर्षणिभ्यः पृतनाहवेषु प्र पृथिव्या रिरिचाथे दिवश्च ।
प्र सिन्धुभ्यः प्र गिरिभ्यो महित्वा प्रेन्द्राग्नी विश्वा भुवनात्यन्या॥
verses.tr: pra carṣaṇibhyaḥ pṛtanāhaveṣu pra pṛthivyā riricāthe divaśca pra sindhubhyaḥ pra giribhyo mahitvā prendrāgnī viśvā bhuvanātyanyā
verses.en: Surpassing all men where they shout for battle, ye Twain exceed the earth and heaven in greatness. Greater are ye than rivers and than mountains, O Indra-Agni, and all things beside them.

verses.sa:
आ भरतं शिक्षतं वज्रबाहू अस्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं शचीभिः ।
इमे नु ते रश्मयः सूर्यस्य येभिः सपित्वं पितरो न आसन्॥
verses.tr: ā bharataṃ śikṣataṃ vajrabāhū asmāṃ indrāgnī avataṃ śacībhiḥ ime nu te raśmayaḥ sūryasya yebhiḥ sapitvaṃ pitaro na āsan
verses.en: Bring wealth and give it, ye whose arms wield thunder: Indra and Agni, with your powers protect us. Now of a truth these be the very sunbeams wherewith our fathers were of old united.

verses.sa:
पुरंदरा शिक्षतं वज्रहस्तास्माँ इन्द्राग्नी अवतं भरेषु ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: puraṃdarā śikṣataṃ vajrahastāsmāṃ indrāgnī avataṃ bhareṣu tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Give, ye who shatter forts, whose hands wield thunder: Indra and Agni, save us in our battles. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ततं मे अपस्तदु तायते पुनः स्वादिष्ठा धीतिरुचथाय शस्यते ।
अयं समुद्र इह विश्वदेव्यः स्वाहाकृतस्य समु तृप्णुत ऋभवः॥
verses.tr: tataṃ me apastadu tāyate punaḥ svādiṣṭhā dhītirucathāya śasyate ayaṃ samudra iha viśvadevyaḥ svāhākṛtasya samu tṛpṇuta ṛbhavaḥ
verses.en: The holy work I wrought before is wrought again: my sweetest hymn is sung to celebrate your praise. Here, O ye Rbhus, is this sea for all the Gods: sate you with Soma offered with the hallowing word.

verses.sa:
आभोगयं प्र यदिच्छन्त ऐतनापाकाः प्राञ्चो मम के चिदापयः ।
सौधन्वनासश्चरितस्य भूमनागच्छत सवितुर्दाशुषो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: ābhogayaṃ pra yadicchanta aitanāpākāḥ prāñco mama ke cidāpayaḥ saudhanvanāsaścaritasya bhūmanāgacchata saviturdāśuṣo gṛham
verses.en: When, seeking your enjoyment onward from afar, ye, certain of my kinsmen, wandered on your way, Sons of Sudhanvan, after your long journeying, ye came unto the home of liberal Savitar.

verses.sa:
तत् सविता वोऽमृतत्वमासुवदगोह्यं यच्छ्रवयन्त ऐतन ।
त्यं चिच्चमसमसुरस्य भक्षणमेकं सन्तमकृणुता चतुर्वयम्॥
verses.tr: tat savitā vo'mṛtatvamāsuvadagohyaṃ yacchravayanta aitana tyaṃ ciccamasamasurasya bhakṣaṇamekaṃ santamakṛṇutā caturvayam
verses.en: Savitar therefore gave you immortality, because ye came proclaiming him whom naught can hide; And this the drinking-chalice of the Asura, which till that time was one, ye made to be fourfold.

verses.sa:
विष्ट्वी शमी तरणित्वेन वाघतो मर्तासः सन्तो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।
सौधन्वना ऋभवः सूरचक्षसः संवत्सरे समपृच्यन्त धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: viṣṭvī śamī taraṇitvena vāghato martāsaḥ santo amṛtatvamānaśuḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ sūracakṣasaḥ saṃvatsare samapṛcyanta dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: When they had served with zeal at sacrifice as priests, they, mortal as they were, gained immortality. The Rbhus, children of Sudhanvan, bright as suns, were in a year's course made associate with prayers.

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रमिव वि ममुस्तेजनेनँ एकं पात्रमृभवो जेहमानम् ।
उपस्तुता उपमं नाधमाना अमर्त्येषु श्रव इच्छमानाः॥
verses.tr: kṣetramiva vi mamustejanenaṃ ekaṃ pātramṛbhavo jehamānam upastutā upamaṃ nādhamānā amartyeṣu śrava icchamānāḥ
verses.en: The Rbhus, with a rod measured, as 'twere a field, the single sacrificial chalice. wide of mouth, Lauded of all who saw, praying for what is best, desiring glorious fame among Immortal Gods.

verses.sa:
आ मनीषामन्तरिक्षस्य नृभ्यः स्रुचेव घृतं जुहवाम विद्मना ।
तरणित्वा ये पितुरस्य सश्चिर ऋभवो वाजमरुहन् दिवो रजः॥
verses.tr: ā manīṣāmantarikṣasya nṛbhyaḥ sruceva ghṛtaṃ juhavāma vidmanā taraṇitvā ye piturasya saścira ṛbhavo vājamaruhan divo rajaḥ
verses.en: As oil in ladles, we through knowledge will present unto the Heroes of the firmament our hymn,-- The Rbhus who came near with this great Father's speed, and rose to heaven's high sphere to eat the strengthening food.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्न इन्द्रः शवसा नवीयानृभुर्वाजेभिर्वसुभिर्वसुर्ददिः ।
युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रिये ३ ऽभि तिष्ठेम पृत्सुतीरसुन्वताम्॥
verses.tr: ṛbhurna indraḥ śavasā navīyānṛbhurvājebhirvasubhirvasurdadiḥ yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priye 3 'bhi tiṣṭhema pṛtsutīrasunvatām
verses.en: Rbhu to us is Indra freshest in his might, Rbhu with powers and wealth is giver of rich gifts. Gods, through your favour may we on the happy day quell the attacks of those who pour no offerings forth.

verses.sa:
निश्चर्मण ऋभवो गामपिंशत सं वत्सेनासृजता मातरं पुनः ।
सौधन्वनासः स्वपस्यया नरो जिव्री युवाना पितराकृणोतन॥
verses.tr: niścarmaṇa ṛbhavo gāmapiṃśata saṃ vatsenāsṛjatā mātaraṃ punaḥ saudhanvanāsaḥ svapasyayā naro jivrī yuvānā pitarākṛṇotana
verses.en: Out of a skin, O Rbhus, once ye formed a cow, and brought the mother close unto her calf again. Sons of Sudhanvan, Heroes, with surpassing skill ye made your aged Parents youthful as before.

verses.sa:
वाजेभिर्नो वाजसातावविड्ढ्यृभुमाँ इन्द्र चित्रमा दर्षि राधः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: vājebhirno vājasātāvaviḍḍhyṛbhumāṃ indra citramā darṣi rādhaḥ tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Help us with strength where spoil is won, O Indra: joined with the Rbhus give us varied bounty. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
तक्षन् रथं सुवृतं विद्मनापसस्तक्षन् हरी इन्द्रवाहा वृषण्वसू ।
तक्षन् पितृभ्यामृभवो युवद् वयस्तक्षन् वत्साय मातरं सचाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: takṣan rathaṃ suvṛtaṃ vidmanāpasastakṣan harī indravāhā vṛṣaṇvasū takṣan pitṛbhyāmṛbhavo yuvad vayastakṣan vatsāya mātaraṃ sacābhuvam
verses.en: Working with skill they wrought the lightly rolling car: they wrought the Bays who bear Indra and bring great gifts. The Rbhus for their Parents made life young again; and fashioned for the calf a mother by its side.

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञाय तक्षत ऋभुमद्वयः क्रत्वे दक्षाय सुप्रजावतीमिषम् ।
यथा क्षयाम सर्ववीरया विशा तन्नः शर्धाय धासथा स्विन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñāya takṣata ṛbhumadvayaḥ kratve dakṣāya suprajāvatīmiṣam yathā kṣayāma sarvavīrayā viśā tannaḥ śardhāya dhāsathā svindriyam
verses.en: For sacrifice make for us active vital power for skill and wisdom food with noble progeny. Grant to our company this power most excellent, that with a family all-heroic we may dwell.

verses.sa:
आ तक्षत सातिमस्मभ्यमृभवः सातिं रथाय सातिमर्वते नरः ।
सातिं नो जैत्रीं सं महेत विश्वहा जामिमजामिं पृतनासु सक्षणिम्॥
verses.tr: ā takṣata sātimasmabhyamṛbhavaḥ sātiṃ rathāya sātimarvate naraḥ sātiṃ no jaitrīṃ saṃ maheta viśvahā jāmimajāmiṃ pṛtanāsu sakṣaṇim
verses.en: Do ye, O Rbhus, make prosperity for us, prosperity for car, ye Heroes, and for steed. Grant us prosperity victorious evermore, conquering foes in battle, strangers or akin.

verses.sa:
ऋभुक्षणमिन्द्रमा हुव ऊतय ऋभून् वाजान् मरुतः सोमपीतये ।
उभा मित्रावरुणा नूनमश्विना ते नो हिन्वन्तु सातये धिये जिषे॥
verses.tr: ṛbhukṣaṇamindramā huva ūtaya ṛbhūn vājān marutaḥ somapītaye ubhā mitrāvaruṇā nūnamaśvinā te no hinvantu sātaye dhiye jiṣe
verses.en: Indra, the Rbhus' Lord, I invocate for aid, the Rbhus, Vajas, Maruts to the Soma draught. Varuna, Mitra, both, yea, and the Asvins Twain: let them speed us to wealth, wisdom, and victory.

verses.sa:
ऋभुर्भराय सं शिशातु सातिं समर्यजिद्वाजो अस्माँ अविष्टु ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: ṛbhurbharāya saṃ śiśātu sātiṃ samaryajidvājo asmāṃ aviṣṭu tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: May Rbhu send prosperity for battle, may Vaja conquering in the fight protect us. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
ईळे द्यावापृथिवी पूर्वचित्तये ऽग्निं घर्मं सुरुचं यामन्निष्टये ।
याभिर्भरे कारमंशाय जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: īḻe dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvacittaye 'gniṃ gharmaṃ surucaṃ yāmanniṣṭaye yābhirbhare kāramaṃśāya jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: To give first thought to them, I worship Heaven and Earth, and Agni, fair bright glow, to hasten their approach. Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith in fight ye speed the war-cry to the spoil.

verses.sa:
युवोर्दानाय सुभरा असश्चतो रथमा तस्थुर्वचसं न मन्तवे ।
याभिर्धियोऽवथः कर्मन्निष्टये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvordānāya subharā asaścato rathamā tasthurvacasaṃ na mantave yābhirdhiyo'vathaḥ karmanniṣṭaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Ample, unfailing, they have mounted as it were an eloquent car that ye may think of us and give. Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye help our thoughts to further holy acts.

verses.sa:
युवं तासां दिव्यस्य प्र शासने विशां क्षयथो अमृतस्य मज्मना ।
याभिर्धेनुमस्वं १ पिन्वथो नरा ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ tāsāṃ divyasya pra śāsane viśāṃ kṣayatho amṛtasya majmanā yābhirdhenumasvaṃ 1 pinvatho narā tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Ye by the might which heavenly nectar giveth you are in supreme dominion Lords of all these folk. Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids wherewith ye, Heroes, made the barren cow give milk.

verses.sa:
याभिः परिज्मा तनयस्य मज्मना द्विमाता तूर्षु तरणिर्विभूषति ।
याभिस्त्रिमन्तुरभवद् विचक्षणस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ parijmā tanayasya majmanā dvimātā tūrṣu taraṇirvibhūṣati yābhistrimanturabhavad vicakṣaṇastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: The aids wherewith the Wanderer through his offspring's might, or the Two-Mothered Son shows swiftest mid the swift; Wherewith the sapient one acquired his triple lore,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभी रेभं निवृतं सितमद्भ्य उद् वन्दनमैरयतं स्वर्दृशे ।
याभिः कण्वं प्र सिषासन्तमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhī rebhaṃ nivṛtaṃ sitamadbhya ud vandanamairayataṃ svardṛśe yābhiḥ kaṇvaṃ pra siṣāsantamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye raised from waters, prisoned and fast bound, Rebha, and Vandana to look upon the light; Wherewith ye succoured Kanva as he strove to win,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिरन्तकं जसमानमारणे भुज्युं याभिरव्यथिभिर्जिजिन्वथुः ।
याभिः कर्कन्धुं वय्यं च जिन्वथस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirantakaṃ jasamānamāraṇe bhujyuṃ yābhiravyathibhirjijinvathuḥ yābhiḥ karkandhuṃ vayyaṃ ca jinvathastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye rescued Antaka when languishing deep in the pit, and Bhujyu with unfailing help. And comforted Karkandhu, Vayya, in their woe,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शुचन्तिं धनसां सुषंसदं तप्तं घर्ममोम्यावन्तमत्रये ।
याभिः पृश्निगुं पुरुकुत्समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ śucantiṃ dhanasāṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ taptaṃ gharmamomyāvantamatraye yābhiḥ pṛśniguṃ purukutsamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye gave Sucanti wealth and happy home, and made the fiery pit friendly for Atri's sake; Wherewith ye guarded Purukutsa, Prsnigu,--Come hither unto us, O Asvin;, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शचीभिर्वृषणा परावृजं प्रान्धं श्रोणं चक्षस एतवे कृथः ।
याभिर्वर्तिकां ग्रसिताममुञ्चतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ śacībhirvṛṣaṇā parāvṛjaṃ prāndhaṃ śroṇaṃ cakṣasa etave kṛthaḥ yābhirvartikāṃ grasitāmamuñcataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Mighty Ones, with what powers ye gave Paravrj aid what time ye made the blind and lame to see and walk; Wherewith ye set at liberty the swallowed quail,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सिन्धुं मधुमन्तमसश्चतं वसिष्ठं याभिरजरावजिन्वतम् ।
याभिः कुत्सं श्रुतर्यं नर्यमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ sindhuṃ madhumantamasaścataṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ yābhirajarāvajinvatam yābhiḥ kutsaṃ śrutaryaṃ naryamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye quickened the most sweet exhaustless flood, and comforted Vasistha, ye who ne'er decay; And to Srutarya, Kutsa, Narya gave your help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्विश्पलां धनसामथर्व्यं सहस्रमीह्ल आजावजिन्वतम् ।
याभिर्वशमश्व्यं प्रेणिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirviśpalāṃ dhanasāmatharvyaṃ sahasramīhla ājāvajinvatam yābhirvaśamaśvyaṃ preṇimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye helped, in battle of a thousand spoils, Vispala seeking booty, powerless to move. Wherewith ye guarded friendly Vasa, Asva's son,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सुदानू औशिजाय वणिजे दीर्घश्रवसे मधु कोशो अक्षरत् ।
कक्षीवन्तं स्तोतारं याभिरावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ sudānū auśijāya vaṇije dīrghaśravase madhu kośo akṣarat kakṣīvantaṃ stotāraṃ yābhirāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Whereby the cloud, ye Bounteous Givers, shed sweet rain for Dirghasravas, for the merchant Ausija, Wherewith ye helped Kaksivan, singer of your praise,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभी रसां क्षोदसोद्नः पिपिन्वथुरनश्वं याभी रथमावतं जिषे ।
याभिस्त्रिशोक उस्रिया उदाजत ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhī rasāṃ kṣodasodnaḥ pipinvathuranaśvaṃ yābhī rathamāvataṃ jiṣe yābhistriśoka usriyā udājata tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye made Rasa swell full with water-floods, and urged to victory the car without a horse; Wherewith Trisoka drove forth his recovered cows,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः सूर्यं परियाथः परावति मन्धातारं क्षैत्रपत्येष्वावतम् ।
याभिर्विप्रं प्र भरद्वाजमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ sūryaṃ pariyāthaḥ parāvati mandhātāraṃ kṣaitrapatyeṣvāvatam yābhirvipraṃ pra bharadvājamāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye, compass round the Sun when far away, strengthened Mandhatar in his tasks as lord of lands, And to sage Bharadvaja gave protecting help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्महामतिथिग्वं कशोजुवं दिवोदासं शम्बरहत्य आवतम् ।
याभिः पूर्भिद्ये त्रसदस्युमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirmahāmatithigvaṃ kaśojuvaṃ divodāsaṃ śambarahatya āvatam yābhiḥ pūrbhidye trasadasyumāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith, when Sambara was slain, ye guarded well great Atithigva, Divodisa, Kasoju, And Trasadasyu when the forts were shattered down,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्वम्रं विपिपानमुपस्तुतं कलिं याभिर्वित्तजानिं दुवस्यथः ।
याभिर्व्यश्वमुत पृथिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirvamraṃ vipipānamupastutaṃ kaliṃ yābhirvittajāniṃ duvasyathaḥ yābhirvyaśvamuta pṛthimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye honoured the great drinker Vamra, and Upastuta and Kali when he gained his wife, And lent to Vyasva and to Prthi favouring help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्नरा शयवे याभिरत्रये याभिः पुरा मनवे गातुमीषथुः ।
याभिः शारीराजतं स्यूमरश्मये ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirnarā śayave yābhiratraye yābhiḥ purā manave gātumīṣathuḥ yābhiḥ śārīrājataṃ syūmaraśmaye tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith, O Heroes, ye vouchsafed deliverance to Sayu, Atri, and to Manu long ago; Wherewith ye shot your shafts in Syumarasmi's cause.--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः पठर्वा जठरस्य मज्मनाग्निर्नादीदेच्चित इद्धो अज्मन्ना ।
याभिः शर्यातमवथो महाधने ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ paṭharvā jaṭharasya majmanāgnirnādīdeccita iddho ajmannā yābhiḥ śaryātamavatho mahādhane tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith Patharva, in his majesty of form, shone in his course like to a gathered kindled fire; Wherewith ye helped Saryata in the mighty fray,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिरङ्गिरो मनसा निरण्यथो ऽग्रं गच्छथो विवरे गोअर्णसः ।
याभिर्मनुं शूरमिषा समावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiraṅgiro manasā niraṇyatho 'graṃ gacchatho vivare goarṇasaḥ yābhirmanuṃ śūramiṣā samāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith, Angirases! ye triumphed in your heart, and onward went to liberate the flood of milk; Wherewith ye helped the hero Manu with new strength,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः पत्नीर्विमदाय न्यूहथुरा घ वा याभिररुणीरशिक्षतम् ।
याभिः सुदास ऊहथुः सुदेव्यं १ ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ patnīrvimadāya nyūhathurā gha vā yābhiraruṇīraśikṣatam yābhiḥ sudāsa ūhathuḥ sudevyaṃ 1 tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye brought a wife for Vimada to wed, wherewith ye freely gave the ruddy cows away; Wherewith ye brought the host of kind Gods to Sudas--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः शंताती भवथो ददाशुषे भुज्युं याभिरवथो याभिरध्रिगुम् ।
ओम्यावतीं सुभरामृतस्तुभं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ śaṃtātī bhavatho dadāśuṣe bhujyuṃ yābhiravatho yābhiradhrigum omyāvatīṃ subharāmṛtastubhaṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye bring great bliss to him who offers gifts, wherewith ye have protected Bhujyu, Adhrigu, And good and gracious Subhara and Rtastup,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः कृशानुमसने दुवस्यथो जवे याभिर्यूनो अर्वन्तमावतम् ।
मधु प्रियं भरथो यत् सरड्भ्यस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ kṛśānumasane duvasyatho jave yābhiryūno arvantamāvatam madhu priyaṃ bharatho yat saraḍbhyastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye served Krsanu where the shafts were shot, and helped the young man's horse to swiftness in the race; Wherewith ye bring delicious honey to the bees,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिर्नरं गोषुयुधं नृषाह्ये क्षेत्रस्य साता तनयस्य जिन्वथः ।
याभी रथाँ अवथो याभिरर्वतस्ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhirnaraṃ goṣuyudhaṃ nṛṣāhye kṣetrasya sātā tanayasya jinvathaḥ yābhī rathāṃ avatho yābhirarvatastābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye speed the hero as he fights for kine in hero battle, in the strife for land and sons, Wherewith ye safely guard his horses and his car,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins with those aids.

verses.sa:
याभिः कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतू प्र तुर्वीतिं प्र च दभीतिमावतम् ।
याभिर्ध्वसन्तिं पुरुषन्तिमावतं ताभिरू षु ऊतिभिरश्विना गतम्॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ kutsamārjuneyaṃ śatakratū pra turvītiṃ pra ca dabhītimāvatam yābhirdhvasantiṃ puruṣantimāvataṃ tābhirū ṣu ūtibhiraśvinā gatam
verses.en: Wherewith ye, Lords of Hundred Powers, helped Kutsa, son of Arjuni, gave Turviti and Dabhiti strength, Favoured Dhvasanti and lent Purusanti help,--Come hither unto us, O Asvins, with those aids.

verses.sa:
अप्नस्वतीमश्विना वाचमस्मे कृतं नो दस्रा वृषणा मनीषाम् ।
अद्यूत्येऽवसे नि ह्वये वां वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: apnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām adyūtye'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau
verses.en: Make ye our speech effectual, O ye Asvins, and this our hymn, ye mighty Wonder-Workers. In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us also on the field of battle.

verses.sa:
द्युभिरक्तुभिः परि पातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: dyubhiraktubhiḥ pari pātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: With, undiminished blessings, O ye Asvins, for evermore both night and day protect us. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इदं श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा ।
यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायँ एवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirāgāccitraḥ praketo ajaniṣṭa vibhvā yathā prasūtā savituḥ savāyaṃ evā rātryuṣase yonimāraik
verses.en: This light is come, amid all lights the fairest; born is the brilliant, far-extending brightness. Night, sent away for Savitar's uprising, hath yielded up a birth-place for the Morning.

verses.sa:
रुशद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः ।
समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने॥
verses.tr: ruśadvatsā ruśatī śvetyāgādāraigu kṛṣṇā sadanānyasyāḥ samānabandhū amṛte anūcī dyāvā varṇaṃ carata āmināne
verses.en: The Fair, the Bright is come with her white offspring; to her the Dark One hath resigned her dwelling. Akin, immortal, following each other, changing their colours both the heavens move onward.

verses.sa:
समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे ।
न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे॥
verses.tr: samāno adhvā svasroranantastamanyānyā carato devaśiṣṭe na methete na tasthatuḥ sumeke naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe
verses.en: Common, unending is the Sisters' pathway; taught by the Gods, alternately they travel. Fair-formed, of different hues and yet one-minded, Night and Dawn clash not, neither do they travel.

verses.sa:
भास्वती नेत्री सूनृतानामचेति चित्रा वि दुरो न आवः ।
प्रार्प्या जगद्व्यु नो रायो अख्यदुषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: bhāsvatī netrī sūnṛtānāmaceti citrā vi duro na āvaḥ prārpyā jagadvyu no rāyo akhyaduṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: Bright leader of glad sounds, our eyes behold her; splendid in hue she hath unclosed the portals. She, stirring up the world, hath shown us riches: Dawn hath awakened every living creature.

verses.sa:
जिह्मश्ये ३ चरितवे मघोन्याभोगय इष्टये राय उ त्वम् ।
दभ्रं पश्यद्भ्य उर्विया विचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: jihmaśye 3 caritave maghonyābhogaya iṣṭaye rāya u tvam dabhraṃ paśyadbhya urviyā vicakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: Rich Dawn, she sets afoot the coiled-up sleeper, one for enjoyment, one for wealth or worship, Those who saw little for extended vision. All living creatures hath the Dawn awakened.

verses.sa:
क्षत्राय त्वं श्रवसे त्वं महीया इष्टये त्वमर्थमिव त्वमित्यै ।
विसदृशा जीविताभिप्रचक्ष उषा अजीगर्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: kṣatrāya tvaṃ śravase tvaṃ mahīyā iṣṭaye tvamarthamiva tvamityai visadṛśā jīvitābhipracakṣa uṣā ajīgarbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: One to high sway, one to exalted glory, one to pursue his gain, and one his labour: All to regard their different vocations, all moving creatures hath the Dawn awakened.

verses.sa:
एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि व्युच्छन्ती युवतिः शुक्रवासाः ।
विश्वस्येशाना पार्थिवस्य वस्व उषो अद्येह सुभगे व्युच्छ॥
verses.tr: eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi vyucchantī yuvatiḥ śukravāsāḥ viśvasyeśānā pārthivasya vasva uṣo adyeha subhage vyuccha
verses.en: We see her there, the Child of Heaven apparent, the young Maid, flushing in her shining raiment. Thou sovran Lady of all earthly treasure, flush on us here, auspicious Dawn, this morning.

verses.sa:
परायतीनामन्वेति पाथ आयतीनां प्रथमा शश्वतीनाम् ।
व्युच्छन्ती जीवमुदीरयन्त्युषा मृतं कं चन बोधयन्ती॥
verses.tr: parāyatīnāmanveti pātha āyatīnāṃ prathamā śaśvatīnām vyucchantī jīvamudīrayantyuṣā mṛtaṃ kaṃ cana bodhayantī
verses.en: She first of endless morns to come hereafter, follows the path of morns that have departed. Dawn, at her rising, urges forth the living him who is dead she wakes not from his slumber.

verses.sa:
उषो यदग्निं समिधे चकर्थ वि यदावश्चक्षसा सूर्यस्य ।
यन्मानुषान् यक्ष्यमाणाँ अजीगस्तद् देवेषु चकृषे भद्रमप्नः॥
verses.tr: uṣo yadagniṃ samidhe cakartha vi yadāvaścakṣasā sūryasya yanmānuṣān yakṣyamāṇāṃ ajīgastad deveṣu cakṛṣe bhadramapnaḥ
verses.en: As thou, Dawn, hast caused Agni to be kindled, and with the Sun's eye hast revealed creation. And hast awakened men to offer worship, thou hast performed, for Gods, a noble service.

verses.sa:
कियात्या यत् समया भवाति या व्यूषुर्याश्च नूनं व्युच्छान् ।
अनु पूर्वाः कृपते वावशाना प्रदीध्याना जोषमन्याभिरेति॥
verses.tr: kiyātyā yat samayā bhavāti yā vyūṣuryāśca nūnaṃ vyucchān anu pūrvāḥ kṛpate vāvaśānā pradīdhyānā joṣamanyābhireti
verses.en: How long a time, and they shall be together,--Dawns that have shone and Dawns to shine hereafter? She yearns for former Dawns with eager longing, and goes forth gladly shining with the others.

verses.sa:
ईयुष्टे ये पूर्वतरामपश्यन् व्युच्छन्तीमुषसं मर्त्यासः ।
अस्माभिरू नु प्रतिचक्ष्याभूदो ते यन्ति ये अपरीषु पश्यान्॥
verses.tr: īyuṣṭe ye pūrvatarāmapaśyan vyucchantīmuṣasaṃ martyāsaḥ asmābhirū nu praticakṣyābhūdo te yanti ye aparīṣu paśyān
verses.en: Gone are the men who in the days before us looked on the rising of the earlier Morning. We, we the living, now behold her brightness and they come nigh who shall hereafter see her.

verses.sa:
यावयद् द्वेषा ऋतपा ऋतेजाः सुम्नावरी सूनृता ईरयन्ती ।
सुमङ्गलीर्बिभ्रती देववीतिमिहाद्योषः श्रेष्ठतमा व्युच्छ॥
verses.tr: yāvayad dveṣā ṛtapā ṛtejāḥ sumnāvarī sūnṛtā īrayantī sumaṅgalīrbibhratī devavītimihādyoṣaḥ śreṣṭhatamā vyuccha
verses.en: Foe-chaser, born of Law, the Law's protectress, joy-giver, waker of all pleasant voices, Auspicious, bringing food for Gods' enjoyment, shine on us here, most bright, O Dawn, this morning.

verses.sa:
शश्वत् पुरोषा व्युवास देव्यथो अद्येदं व्यावो मघोनी ।
अथो व्युच्छादुत्तराँ अनु द्यूनजरामृता चरति स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: śaśvat puroṣā vyuvāsa devyatho adyedaṃ vyāvo maghonī atho vyucchāduttarāṃ anu dyūnajarāmṛtā carati svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: From days eternal hath Dawn shone, the Goddess, and shows this light to-day, endowed with riches. So will she shine on days to come immortal she moves on in her own strength, undecaying.

verses.sa:
व्य १ ञ्जिभिर्दिव आतास्वद्यौदप कृष्णां निर्णिजं देव्यावः ।
प्रबोधयन्त्यरुणेभिरश्वैरोषा याति सुयुजा रथेन॥
verses.tr: vya 1 ñjibhirdiva ātāsvadyaudapa kṛṣṇāṃ nirṇijaṃ devyāvaḥ prabodhayantyaruṇebhiraśvairoṣā yāti suyujā rathena
verses.en: In the sky's borders hath she shone in splendour: the Goddess hath thrown off the veil of darkness. Awakening the world with purple horses, on her well-harnessed chariot Dawn approaches.

verses.sa:
आवहन्ती पोष्या वार्याणि चित्रं केतुं कृणुते चेकिताना ।
ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनां विभातीनां प्रथमोषा व्यश्वैत्॥
verses.tr: āvahantī poṣyā vāryāṇi citraṃ ketuṃ kṛṇute cekitānā īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāṃ vibhātīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyaśvait
verses.en: Bringing all life-sustaining blessings with her, showing herself she sends forth brilliant lustre. Last of the countless mornings that have vanished, first of bright morns to come hath Dawn arisen.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ध्वं जीवो असुर्न आगादप प्रागात् तम आ ज्योतिरेति ।
आरैक् पन्थां यातवे सूर्यायागन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: udīrdhvaṃ jīvo asurna āgādapa prāgāt tama ā jyotireti āraik panthāṃ yātave sūryāyāganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: Arise! the breath, the life, again hath reached us: darkness hath passed away and light approacheth. She for the Sun hath left a path to travel we have arrived where men prolong existence.

verses.sa:
स्यूमना वाच उदियर्ति वह्निः स्तवानो रेभ उषसो विभातीः ।
अद्या तदुच्छ गृणते मघोन्यस्मे आयुर्नि दिदीहि प्रजावत्॥
verses.tr: syūmanā vāca udiyarti vahniḥ stavāno rebha uṣaso vibhātīḥ adyā taduccha gṛṇate maghonyasme āyurni didīhi prajāvat
verses.en: Singing the praises of refulgent Mornings with his hymn's web the priest, the poet rises. Shine then to-day, rich Maid, on him who lauds thee, shine down on us the gift of life and offspring.

verses.sa:
या गोमतीरुषसः सर्ववीरा व्युच्छन्ति दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
वायोरिव सूनृतानामुदर्के ता अश्वदा अश्नवत् सोमसुत्वा॥
verses.tr: yā gomatīruṣasaḥ sarvavīrā vyucchanti dāśuṣe martyāya vāyoriva sūnṛtānāmudarke tā aśvadā aśnavat somasutvā
verses.en: Dawns giving sons all heroes, kine and horses, shining upon the man who brings oblations,-- These let the Soma-presser gain when ending his glad songs louder than the voice of Vayu.

verses.sa:
माता देवानामदितेरनीकं यज्ञस्य केतुर्बृहती वि भाहि ।
प्रशस्तिकृद्ब्र ब्रह्मणे नो व्यु १ च्छा नो जने जनय विश्ववारे॥
verses.tr: mātā devānāmaditeranīkaṃ yajñasya keturbṛhatī vi bhāhi praśastikṛdbra brahmaṇe no vyu 1 cchā no jane janaya viśvavāre
verses.en: Mother of Gods, Aditi's form of glory, ensign of sacrifice, shine forth exalted. Rise up, bestowing praise on our devotion all-bounteous, make us chief among the people.

verses.sa:
यच्चित्रमप्न उषसो वहन्तीजानाय शशमानाय भद्रम् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: yaccitramapna uṣaso vahantījānāya śaśamānāya bhadram tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Whatever splendid wealth the Dawns bring with them to bless the man who offers praise and worship, Even that may Mitra, Varuna vouchsafe us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
इमा रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतीः ।
यथा शमसद् द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वं पुष्टं ग्रामे अस्मिन्ननातुरम्॥
verses.tr: imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ yathā śamasad dvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam
verses.en: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.

verses.sa:
मृळा नो रुद्रोत नो मयस्कृधि क्षयद्वीराय नमसा विधेम ते ।
यच्छं च योश्च मनुरायेजे पिता तदश्याम तव रुद्र प्रणीतिषु॥
verses.tr: mṛḻā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhi kṣayadvīrāya namasā vidhema te yacchaṃ ca yośca manurāyeje pitā tadaśyāma tava rudra praṇītiṣu
verses.en: Be gracious unto us, O Rudra, bring us joy: thee, Lord of Heroes, thee with reverence will we serve. Whatever health and strength our father Manu won by sacrifice may we, under thy guidance, gain.

verses.sa:
अश्याम ते सुमतिं देवयज्यया क्षयद्वीरस्य तव रुद्र मीढ्वः ।
सुम्नायन्निद्  विशो अस्माकमा चरारिष्टवीरा जुहवाम ते हविः॥
verses.tr: aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ sumnāyannid viśo asmākamā carāriṣṭavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ
verses.en: By worship of the Gods may we, O Bounteous One, O Rudra, gain thy grace, Ruler of valiant men. Come to our families, bringing them bliss: may we, whose heroes are uninjured, bring thee sacred gifts,

verses.sa:
त्वेषं वयं रुद्रं यज्ञसाधं वङ्कुं कविमवसे नि ह्वयामहे ।
आरे अस्मद् दैव्यं हेळो अस्यतु सुमतिमिद् वयमस्या वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhaṃ vaṅkuṃ kavimavase ni hvayāmahe āre asmad daivyaṃ heḻo asyatu sumatimid vayamasyā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Hither we call for aid the wise, the wanderer, impetuous Rudra, perfecter of sacrifice. May he repel from us the anger of the Gods: verily we desire his favourable grace.

verses.sa:
दिवो वराहमरुषं कपर्दिनं त्वेषं रूपं नमसा नि ह्वयामहे ।
हस्ते बिभ्रद् भेषजा वार्याणि शर्म वर्म च्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं यंसत्॥
verses.tr: divo varāhamaruṣaṃ kapardinaṃ tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ namasā ni hvayāmahe haste bibhrad bheṣajā vāryāṇi śarma varma cchardirasmabhyaṃ yaṃsat
verses.en: Him with the braided hair we call with reverence down, the wild-boar of the sky, the red, the dazzling shape. May he, his hand filled full of sovran medicines, grant us protection, shelter, and a home secure.

verses.sa:
इदं पित्रे मरुतामुच्यते वचः स्वादोः स्वादीयो रुद्राय वर्धनम् ।
रास्वा च नो अमृत मर्तभोजनं त्मने तोकाय तनयाय मृळ॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pitre marutāmucyate vacaḥ svādoḥ svādīyo rudrāya vardhanam rāsvā ca no amṛta martabhojanaṃ tmane tokāya tanayāya mṛḻa
verses.en: To him the Maruts' Father is this hymn addressed, to strengthen Rudra's might, a song more sweet than sweet. Grant us, Immortal One, the food which mortals eat: be gracious unto me, my seed, my progeny.

verses.sa:
मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम् ।
मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरं मा नः प्रियास्तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः॥
verses.tr: mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ mā naḥ priyāstanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Rudra, harm not either great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full-grown man. Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra, do not harm.

verses.sa:
मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयौ मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः ।
वीरान् मा नो रुद्र भामितो वधीर्हविष्मन्तः सदमित् त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyau mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ vīrān mā no rudra bhāmito vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadamit tvā havāmahe
verses.en: Harm us not, Rudra, in our seed and progeny, harm us not in the living, nor in cows or steeds, Slay not our heroes in the fury of thy wrath. Bringing oblations evermore we call to thee.

verses.sa:
उप ते स्तोमान् पशुपा इवाकरं रास्वा पितर्मरुतां सुम्नमस्मे ।
भद्रा हि ते सुमतिर्मृळयत्तमाथा वयमव इत्ते वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: upa te stomān paśupā ivākaraṃ rāsvā pitarmarutāṃ sumnamasme bhadrā hi te sumatirmṛḻayattamāthā vayamava itte vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: Even as a herdsman I have brought thee hymns of praise: O Father of the Maruts, give us happiness, Blessed is thy most favouring benevolence, so, verily, do we desire thy saving help.

verses.sa:
आरे ते गोघ्नमुत पूरुषघ्नं क्षयद्वीर सुम्नमस्मे ते अस्तु ।
मृळा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देवाधा च नः शर्म यच्छ द्विबर्हाः॥
verses.tr: āre te goghnamuta pūruṣaghnaṃ kṣayadvīra sumnamasme te astu mṛḻā ca no adhi ca brūhi devādhā ca naḥ śarma yaccha dvibarhāḥ
verses.en: Far be thy dart that killeth men or cattle: thy bliss be with us, O thou Lord of Heroes. Be gracious unto us, O God, and bless us, and then vouchsafe us doubly-strong protection.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम नमो अस्मा अवस्यवः शृणोतु नो हवं रुद्रो मरुत्वान् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: avocāma namo asmā avasyavaḥ śṛṇotu no havaṃ rudro marutvān tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: We, seeking help, have spoken and adored him: may Rudra, girt by Maruts, hear our calling. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः ।
आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca
verses.en: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो देवीमुषसं रोचमानां मर्यो न योषामभ्येति पश्चात् ।
यत्रा नरो देवयन्तो युगानि वितन्वते प्रति भद्राय भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānāṃ maryo na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt yatrā naro devayanto yugāni vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram
verses.en: Like as a young man followeth a maiden, so doth the Sun the Dawn, refulgent Goddess: Where pious men extend their generations, before the Auspicious One for happy fortune.

verses.sa:
भद्रा अश्वा हरितः सूर्यस्य चित्रा एतग्वा अनुमाद्यासः ।
नमस्यन्तो दिव आ पृष्ठमस्थुः परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति सद्यः॥
verses.tr: bhadrā aśvā haritaḥ sūryasya citrā etagvā anumādyāsaḥ namasyanto diva ā pṛṣṭhamasthuḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ
verses.en: Auspicious are the Sun's Bay-coloured Horses, bright, changing hues, meet for our shouts of triumph. Bearing our prayers, the sky's ridge have they mounted, and in a moment speed round earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
तत्सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वं मध्या कर्तोर्विततं सं जभार ।
यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थादाद्रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै॥
verses.tr: tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai
verses.en: This is the Godhead, this might of Surya: he hath withdrawn what spread o'er work unfinished. When he hath loosed his Horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

verses.sa:
तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे ।
अनन्तमन्यद् रुशदस्य पाजः कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः सं भरन्ति॥
verses.tr: tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe anantamanyad ruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti
verses.en: In the sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth that Varuna and Mitra may behold it. His Bay Steeds well maintain his power eternal, at one time bright and darksome at another.

verses.sa:
अद्या देवा उदिता सूर्यस्य निरंहसः पिपृता निरवद्यात् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: This day, O Gods, while Surya is ascending, deliver us from trouble and dishonour. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
नासत्याभ्यां बर्हिरिव प्र वृञ्जे स्तोमाँ इयर्म्यभ्रियेव वातः ।
यावर्भगाय विमदाय जायां सेनाजुवा न्यूहतू रथेन॥
verses.tr: nāsatyābhyāṃ barhiriva pra vṛñje stomāṃ iyarmyabhriyeva vātaḥ yāvarbhagāya vimadāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyūhatū rathena
verses.en: I TRIM like grass my song for the Nasatyas and send their lauds forth as the wind drives rain-clouds, Who, in a chariot rapid as an arrow, brought to the youthful Vimada a consort.

verses.sa:
वीळुपत्मभिराशुहेमभिर्वा देवानां वा जूतिभिः शाशदाना ।
तद् रासभो नासत्या सहस्रमाजा यमस्य प्रधने जिगाय॥
verses.tr: vīḻupatmabhirāśuhemabhirvā devānāṃ vā jūtibhiḥ śāśadānā tad rāsabho nāsatyā sahasramājā yamasya pradhane jigāya
verses.en: Borne on by rapid steeds of mighty pinion, or proudly trusting in the Gods' incitements. That stallion ass of yours won, O Nasatyas, that thousand in the race, in Yama's contest.

verses.sa:
तुग्रो ह भुज्युमश्विनोदमेघे रयिं न कश्चिन्ममृवाँ अवाहाः ।
तमूहथुर्नौभिरात्मन्वतीभिरन्तरिक्षप्रुद्भिरपोदकाभिः॥
verses.tr: tugro ha bhujyumaśvinodameghe rayiṃ na kaścinmamṛvāṃ avāhāḥ tamūhathurnaubhirātmanvatībhirantarikṣaprudbhirapodakābhiḥ
verses.en: Yea, Asvins, as a dead man leaves his riches, Tugra left Bhujyu in the cloud of waters. Ye brought him back in animated vessels, traversing air, unwetted by the billows.

verses.sa:
तिस्रः क्षपस्त्रिरहातिव्रजद्भिर्नासत्या भुज्युमूहथुः पतंगैः ।
समुद्रस्य धन्वन्नार्द्रस्य पारे त्रिभी रथैः शतपद्भिः षळश्वैः॥
verses.tr: tisraḥ kṣapastrirahātivrajadbhirnāsatyā bhujyumūhathuḥ pataṃgaiḥ samudrasya dhanvannārdrasya pāre tribhī rathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ ṣaḻaśvaiḥ
verses.en: Bhujyu ye bore with winged things, Nasatyas, which for three nights, three days full swiftly travelled, To the sea's farther shore, the strand of ocean, in three cars, hundred-footed, with six horses.

verses.sa:
अनारम्भणे तदवीरयेथामनास्थाने अग्रभणे समुद्रे ।
यदश्विना ऊहथुर्भुज्युमस्तं शतारित्रां नावमातस्थिवांसम्॥
verses.tr: anārambhaṇe tadavīrayethāmanāsthāne agrabhaṇe samudre yadaśvinā ūhathurbhujyumastaṃ śatāritrāṃ nāvamātasthivāṃsam
verses.en: Ye wrought that hero exploit in the ocean which giveth no support, or hold or station, What time ye carried Bhujyu to his dwelling, borne in a ship with hundred oars, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
यमश्विना ददथुः श्वेतमश्वमघाश्वाय शश्वदित् स्वस्ति ।
तद् वां दात्रं महि कीर्तेन्यं भूत् पैद्वो वाजी सदमिद्धव्यो अर्यः॥
verses.tr: yamaśvinā dadathuḥ śvetamaśvamaghāśvāya śaśvadit svasti tad vāṃ dātraṃ mahi kīrtenyaṃ bhūt paidvo vājī sadamiddhavyo aryaḥ
verses.en: The white horse which of old ye gave Aghasva, Asvins, a gift to be his wealth for ever,-- Still to be praised is that your glorious present, still to be famed is the brave horse of Pedu.

verses.sa:
युवं नरा स्तुवते पज्रियाय कक्षीवते अरदतं पुरंधिम् ।
कारोतराच्छफादश्वस्य वृष्णः शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं सुरायाः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ narā stuvate pajriyāya kakṣīvate aradataṃ puraṃdhim kārotarācchaphādaśvasya vṛṣṇaḥ śataṃ kumbhāṃ asiñcataṃ surāyāḥ
verses.en: O Heroes, ye gave wisdom to Kaksivan who sprang from Pajra's line, who sang your praises. Ye poured forth from the hoof of your strong charger a hundred jars of wine as from a strainer.

verses.sa:
हिमेनाग्निं घ्रंसमवारयेथां पितुमतीमूर्जमस्मा अधत्तम् ।
ऋबीसे अत्रिमश्विनावनीतमुन्निन्यथुः सर्वगणं स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: himenāgniṃ ghraṃsamavārayethāṃ pitumatīmūrjamasmā adhattam ṛbīse atrimaśvināvanītamunninyathuḥ sarvagaṇaṃ svasti
verses.en: Ye warded off with cold the fire's fierce burning; food very rich in nourishment ye furnished. Atri, cast downward in the cavern, Asvins ye brought, with all his people, forth to comfort.

verses.sa:
परावतं नासत्यानुदेथामुच्चाबुध्नं चक्रथुर्जिह्मबारम् ।
क्षरन्नापो न पायनाय राये सहस्राय तृष्यते गोतमस्य॥
verses.tr: parāvataṃ nāsatyānudethāmuccābudhnaṃ cakrathurjihmabāram kṣarannāpo na pāyanāya rāye sahasrāya tṛṣyate gotamasya
verses.en: Ye lifted up the well, O ye Nasatyas, and set the base on high to open downward. Streams flowed for folk of Gotama who thirsted, like rain to bring forth thousandfold abundance.

verses.sa:
जुजुरुषो नासत्योत वव्रिं प्रामुञ्चतं द्रापिमिव च्यवानात् ।
प्रातिरतं जहितस्यायुर्दस्रादित् पतिमकृणुतं कनीनाम्॥
verses.tr: jujuruṣo nāsatyota vavriṃ prāmuñcataṃ drāpimiva cyavānāt prātirataṃ jahitasyāyurdasrādit patimakṛṇutaṃ kanīnām
verses.en: Ye from the old Cyavana, O Nasatyas, stripped, as 'twere mail, the skin upon his body, Lengthened his life when all had left him helpless, Dasras! and made him lord of youthful maidens.

verses.sa:
तद् वां नरा शंस्यं राध्यं चाभिष्टिमन्नासत्या वरूथम् ।
यद् विद्वांसा निधिमिवापगूह्लमुद् दर्शतादूपथुर्वन्दनाय॥
verses.tr: tad vāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ rādhyaṃ cābhiṣṭimannāsatyā varūtham yad vidvāṃsā nidhimivāpagūhlamud darśatādūpathurvandanāya
verses.en: Worthy of praise and worth the winning, Heroes, is that your favouring succour O Nasatyas, What time ye, knowing well his case, delivered Vandana from the pit like hidden treasure.

verses.sa:
तद् वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रमाविष्कृणोमि तन्यतुर्न वृष्टिम् ।
दध्यङ् ह यन्मध्वाथर्वणो वामश्वस्य शीर्ष्णा प्र यदीमुवाच॥
verses.tr: tad vāṃ narā sanaye daṃsa ugramāviṣkṛṇomi tanyaturna vṛṣṭim dadhyaṅ ha yanmadhvātharvaṇo vāmaśvasya śīrṣṇā pra yadīmuvāca
verses.en: That mighty deed of yours, for gain, O Heroes, as thunder heraldeth the rain, I publish, When, by the horse's head, Atharvan's offspring Dadhyac made known to you the Soma's sweetness.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीन्नासत्या करा वां महे यामन् पुरुभुजा पुरंधिः ।
श्रुतं तच्छासुरिव वध्रिमत्या हिरण्यहस्तमश्विनावदत्तम्॥
verses.tr: ajohavīnnāsatyā karā vāṃ mahe yāman purubhujā puraṃdhiḥ śrutaṃ tacchāsuriva vadhrimatyā hiraṇyahastamaśvināvadattam
verses.en: In the great rite the wise dame called, Nasatyas, you, Lords of many treasures, to assist her. Ye heard the weakling's wife, as 'twere an order, and gave to her a son Hiranyahasta.

verses.sa:
आस्नो वृकस्य वर्तिकामभीके युवं नरा नासत्यामुमुक्तम् ।
उतो कविं पुरुभुजा युवं ह कृपमाणमकृणुतं विचक्षे॥
verses.tr: āsno vṛkasya vartikāmabhīke yuvaṃ narā nāsatyāmumuktam uto kaviṃ purubhujā yuvaṃ ha kṛpamāṇamakṛṇutaṃ vicakṣe
verses.en: Ye from the wolf's jaws, as ye stood together, set free the quail, O Heroes, O Nasatyas. Ye, Lords of many treasures, gave the poet his perfect vision as he mourned his trouble.

verses.sa:
चरित्रं हि वेरिवाच्छेदि पर्णमाजा खेलस्य परितक्म्यायाम् ।
सद्यो जङ्घामायसीं विश्पलायै धने हिते सर्तवे प्रत्यधत्तम्॥
verses.tr: caritraṃ hi verivācchedi parṇamājā khelasya paritakmyāyām sadyo jaṅghāmāyasīṃ viśpalāyai dhane hite sartave pratyadhattam
verses.en: When in the time of night, in Khela's battle, a leg was severed like a wild bird's pinion, Straight ye gave Vispala a leg of iron that she might move what time the conflict opened.

verses.sa:
शतं मेषान् वृक्ये चक्षदानमृज्राश्वं तं पितान्धं चकार ।
तस्मा अक्षी नासत्या विचक्ष आधत्तं दस्रा भिषजावनर्वन्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ meṣān vṛkye cakṣadānamṛjrāśvaṃ taṃ pitāndhaṃ cakāra tasmā akṣī nāsatyā vicakṣa ādhattaṃ dasrā bhiṣajāvanarvan
verses.en: His father robbed Rjrasva of his eyesight who for the she-wolf slew a hundred wethers. Ye gave him eyes, Nasatyas, Wonder-Workers, Physicians, that he saw with sight uninjured.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य कार्ष्मेवातिष्ठदर्वता जयन्ती ।
विश्वे देवा अन्वमन्यन्त हृद्भिः समु श्रिया नासत्या सचेथे॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya kārṣmevātiṣṭhadarvatā jayantī viśve devā anvamanyanta hṛdbhiḥ samu śriyā nāsatyā sacethe
verses.en: The Daughter of the Sun your car ascended, first reaching as it were the goal with coursers. All Deities within their hearts assented, and ye, Nasatyas, are close linked with glory.

verses.sa:
यदयातं दिवोदासाय वर्तिर्भरद्वाजायाश्विना हयन्ता ।
रेवदुवाह सचनो रथो वां वृषभश्च शिंशुमारश्च युक्ता॥
verses.tr: yadayātaṃ divodāsāya vartirbharadvājāyāśvinā hayantā revaduvāha sacano ratho vāṃ vṛṣabhaśca śiṃśumāraśca yuktā
verses.en: When to his house ye came, to Divodasa, hasting to Bharadvaja, O ye Asvins, The car that came with you brought splendid riches: a porpoise and a bull were yoked together.

verses.sa:
रयिं सुक्षत्रं स्वपत्यमायुः सुवीर्यं नासत्या वहन्ता ।
आ जह्नावीं समनसोप वाजैस्त्रिरह्नो भागं दधतीमयातम्॥
verses.tr: rayiṃ sukṣatraṃ svapatyamāyuḥ suvīryaṃ nāsatyā vahantā ā jahnāvīṃ samanasopa vājaistrirahno bhāgaṃ dadhatīmayātam
verses.en: Ye, bringing wealth with rule, and life with offspring, life rich in noble heroes; O Nasatyas, Accordant came with strength to Jahnu's children who offered you thrice every day your portion.

verses.sa:
परिविष्टं जाहुषं विश्वतः सीं सुगेभिर्नक्तमूहथू रजोभिः ।
विभिन्दुना नासत्या रथेन वि पर्वताँ अजरयू अयातम्॥
verses.tr: pariviṣṭaṃ jāhuṣaṃ viśvataḥ sīṃ sugebhirnaktamūhathū rajobhiḥ vibhindunā nāsatyā rathena vi parvatāṃ ajarayū ayātam
verses.en: Ye bore away at night by easy pathways Jahusa compassed round on every quarter, And, with your car that cleaves the toe asunder, Nasatyas never decaying! rent the mountains.

verses.sa:
एकस्या वस्तोरावतं रणाय वशमश्विना सनये सहस्रा ।
निरहतं दुच्छुना इन्द्रवन्ता पृथुश्रवसो वृषणावरातीः॥
verses.tr: ekasyā vastorāvataṃ raṇāya vaśamaśvinā sanaye sahasrā nirahataṃ ducchunā indravantā pṛthuśravaso vṛṣaṇāvarātīḥ
verses.en: One morn ye strengthened Vasa for the battle, to gather spoils that might be told in thousands. With Indra joined ye drove away misfortunes, yea foes of Prthusravas, O ye mighty.

verses.sa:
शरस्य चिदार्चत्कस्यावतादा नीचादुच्चा चक्रथुः पातवे वाः ।
शयवे चिन्नासत्या शचीभिर्जसुरये स्तर्यं पिप्यथुर्गाम्॥
verses.tr: śarasya cidārcatkasyāvatādā nīcāduccā cakrathuḥ pātave vāḥ śayave cinnāsatyā śacībhirjasuraye staryaṃ pipyathurgām
verses.en: From the deep well ye raised on high the water, so that Rcatka's son, Sara, should drink it; And with your might, to help the weary Sayu, ye made the barren cow yield milk, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
अवस्यते स्तुवते कृष्णियाय ऋजूयते नासत्या शचीभिः ।
पशुं न नष्टमिव दर्शनाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय॥
verses.tr: avasyate stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya ṛjūyate nāsatyā śacībhiḥ paśuṃ na naṣṭamiva darśanāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya
verses.en: To Visvaka, Nasatyas! son of Krsna, the righteous man who sought your aid and praised you, Ye with your powers restored, like some lost creature, his son Visnapu for his eyes to look on.

verses.sa:
दश रात्रीरशिवेना नव द्यूनवनद्धं श्नथितमप्स्व १न्तः ।
विप्रुतं रेभमुदनि प्रवृक्तमुन्निन्यथुः सोममिव स्रुवेण॥
verses.tr: daśa rātrīraśivenā nava dyūnavanaddhaṃ śnathitamapsva 1ntaḥ viprutaṃ rebhamudani pravṛktamunninyathuḥ somamiva sruveṇa
verses.en: Asvins, ye raised, like Soma in a ladle Rebha, who for ten days and ten nights, fettered. Had lain in cruel bonds, immersed and wounded, suffering sore affliction, in the waters.

verses.sa:
प्र वां दंसांस्यश्विनाववोचमस्य पतिः स्यां सुगवः सुवीरः ।
उत पश्यन्नश्नुवन् दीर्घमायुरस्तमिवेज्जरिमाणं जगम्याम्॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ daṃsāṃsyaśvināvavocamasya patiḥ syāṃ sugavaḥ suvīraḥ uta paśyannaśnuvan dīrghamāyurastamivejjarimāṇaṃ jagamyām
verses.en: 1 have declared your wondrous deeds, O Asvins: may this be mine, and many kine and heroes. May I, enjoying lengthened life, still seeing, enter old age as 'twere the house I live in.

verses.sa:
मध्वः सोमस्याश्विना मदाय प्रत्नो होता विवासते वाम् ।
बर्हिष्मती रातिर्विश्रिता गीरिषा यातं नासत्योप वाजैः॥
verses.tr: madhvaḥ somasyāśvinā madāya pratno hotā vivāsate vām barhiṣmatī rātirviśritā gīriṣā yātaṃ nāsatyopa vājaiḥ
verses.en: Asvins, your ancient priest invites you hither to gladden you with draughts of meath of Soma. Our gift is on the grass, our song apportioned: with food and strength come hither, O Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
यो वामश्विना मनसो जवीयान् रथः स्वश्वो विश आजिगाति ।
येन गच्छथः सुकृतो दुरोणं तेन नरा वर्तिरस्मभ्यं यातम्॥
verses.tr: yo vāmaśvinā manaso javīyān rathaḥ svaśvo viśa ājigāti yena gacchathaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tena narā vartirasmabhyaṃ yātam
verses.en: That car of yours, swifter than thought, O Asvins, which drawn by brave steeds cometh to the people, Whereon ye seek the dwelling of the pious,--come ye thereon to our abode, O Heroes.

verses.sa:
ऋषिं नरावंहसः पाञ्चजन्यमृबीसादत्रिं मुञ्चथो गणेन ।
मिनन्ता दस्योरशिवस्य माया अनुपूर्वं वृषणा चोदयन्ता॥
verses.tr: ṛṣiṃ narāvaṃhasaḥ pāñcajanyamṛbīsādatriṃ muñcatho gaṇena minantā dasyoraśivasya māyā anupūrvaṃ vṛṣaṇā codayantā
verses.en: Ye freed sage Atri, whom the Five Tribes honoured, from the strait pit, ye Heroes with his people, Baffling the guiles of the malignant Dasyu, repelling them, ye Mighty in succession.

verses.sa:
अश्वं न गूह्लमश्विना दुरेवीर्ऋषिं नरा वृषणा रेभमप्सु ।
सं तं रिणीथो विप्रुतं दंसोभिर्न वां जूर्यन्ति पूर्व्या कृतानि॥
verses.tr: aśvaṃ na gūhlamaśvinā durevīrṛṣiṃ narā vṛṣaṇā rebhamapsu saṃ taṃ riṇītho viprutaṃ daṃsobhirna vāṃ jūryanti pūrvyā kṛtāni
verses.en: Rebha the sage, ye mighty Heroes, Asvins! whom, like a horse, vile men had sunk in water,-- Him, wounded, with your wondrous power ye rescued: your exploits of old time endure for ever.

verses.sa:
सुषुप्वांसं न निर्ऋतेरुपस्थे सूर्यं न दस्रा तमसि क्षियन्तम् ।
शुभे रुक्मं न दर्शतं निखातमुदूपथुरश्विना वन्दनाय॥
verses.tr: suṣupvāṃsaṃ na nirṛterupasthe sūryaṃ na dasrā tamasi kṣiyantam śubhe rukmaṃ na darśataṃ nikhātamudūpathuraśvinā vandanāya
verses.en: Ye brought forth Vandana, ye Wonder-Workers, for triumph, like fair gold that hath been buried, Like one who slumbered in destruction's bosom, or like the Sun when dwelling in the darkness.

verses.sa:
तद् वां नरा शंस्यं पज्रियेण कक्षीवता नासत्या परिज्मन् ।
शफादश्वस्य वाजिनो जनाय शतं कुम्भाँ असिञ्चतं मधूनाम्॥
verses.tr: tad vāṃ narā śaṃsyaṃ pajriyeṇa kakṣīvatā nāsatyā parijman śaphādaśvasya vājino janāya śataṃ kumbhāṃ asiñcataṃ madhūnām
verses.en: Kaksivan, Pajra's son, must laud that exploit of yours, Nasatyas, Heroes, ye who wander! When from the hoof of your strong horse ye showered a hundred jars of honey for the people.

verses.sa:
युवं नरा स्तुवते कृष्णियाय विष्णाप्वं ददथुर्विश्वकाय ।
घोषायै चित् पितृषदे दुरोणे पतिं जूर्यन्त्या अश्विनावदत्तम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ narā stuvate kṛṣṇiyāya viṣṇāpvaṃ dadathurviśvakāya ghoṣāyai cit pitṛṣade duroṇe patiṃ jūryantyā aśvināvadattam
verses.en: To Krsna's son, to Visvaka who praised you, O Heroes, ye restored his son Visnapu. To Ghosa, living in her father's dwelling, stricken in years, ye gave a husband, Asvins.

verses.sa:
युवं श्यावाय रुशतीमदत्तं महः क्षोणस्याश्विना कण्वाय ।
प्रवाच्यं तद्वृषणा कृतं वां यन्नार्षदाय श्रवो अध्यधत्तम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śyāvāya ruśatīmadattaṃ mahaḥ kṣoṇasyāśvinā kaṇvāya pravācyaṃ tadvṛṣaṇā kṛtaṃ vāṃ yannārṣadāya śravo adhyadhattam
verses.en: Rusati, of the mighty people, Asvins, ye gave to Syava of the line of Kanva. This deed of yours, ye Strong Ones should be published, that ye gave glory to the son of Nrsad.

verses.sa:
पुरू वर्पांस्यश्विना दधाना नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वम् ।
सहस्रसां वाजिनमप्रतीतमहिहनं श्रवस्यं १ तरुत्रम्॥
verses.tr: purū varpāṃsyaśvinā dadhānā ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam sahasrasāṃ vājinamapratītamahihanaṃ śravasyaṃ 1 tarutram
verses.en: O Asvins, wearing many forms at pleasure, on Pedu ye bestowed a fleet-foot courser, Strong, winner of a thousand spoils, resistless the serpent slayer, glorious, triumphant.

verses.sa:
एतानि वां श्रवस्या सुदानू ब्रह्माङ्गूषं सदनं रोदस्योः ।
यद् वां पज्रासो अश्विना हवन्ते यातमिषा च विदुषे च वाजम्॥
verses.tr: etāni vāṃ śravasyā sudānū brahmāṅgūṣaṃ sadanaṃ rodasyoḥ yad vāṃ pajrāso aśvinā havante yātamiṣā ca viduṣe ca vājam
verses.en: These glorious things are yours, ye Bounteous Givers; prayer, praise in both worlds are your habitation. O Asvins, when the sons of Pajra call you, send strength with nourishment to him who knoweth.

verses.sa:
सूनोर्मानेनाश्विना गृणाना वाजं विप्राय भुरणा रदन्ता ।
अगस्त्ये ब्रह्मणा वावृधाना सं विश्पलां नासत्यारिणीतम्॥
verses.tr: sūnormānenāśvinā gṛṇānā vājaṃ viprāya bhuraṇā radantā agastye brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānā saṃ viśpalāṃ nāsatyāriṇītam
verses.en: Hymned with the reverence of a son, O Asvins ye Swift Ones giving booty to the singer, Glorified by Agastya with devotion, established Vispala again, Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
कुह यान्ता सुष्टुतिं काव्यस्य दिवो नपाता वृषणा शयुत्रा ।
हिरण्यस्येव कलशं निखातमुदूपथुर्दशमे अश्विनाहन्॥
verses.tr: kuha yāntā suṣṭutiṃ kāvyasya divo napātā vṛṣaṇā śayutrā hiraṇyasyeva kalaśaṃ nikhātamudūpathurdaśame aśvināhan
verses.en: Ye Sons of Heaven, ye Mighty, whither went ye, sought ye, for his fair praise the home of Kavya. When, like a pitcher full of gold, O Asvins, on the tenth day ye lifted up the buried?

verses.sa:
युवं च्यवानमश्विना जरन्तं पुनर्युवानं चक्रथुः शचीभिः ।
युवो रथं दुहिता सूर्यस्य सह श्रिया नासत्यावृणीत॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ cyavānamaśvinā jarantaṃ punaryuvānaṃ cakrathuḥ śacībhiḥ yuvo rathaṃ duhitā sūryasya saha śriyā nāsatyāvṛṇīta
verses.en: Ye with the aid of your great powers, O Asvins, restored to youth the ancient man Cyavana. The Daughter of the Sun with all her glory, O ye Nasatyas, chose your car to bear her.

verses.sa:
युवं तुग्राय पूर्व्येभिरेवैः पुनर्मन्यावभवतं युवाना ।
युवं भुज्युमर्णसो निः समुद्राद् विभिरूहथुर्ऋज्रेभिरश्वैः॥
