verses.tr: yuvaṃ tugrāya pūrvyebhirevaiḥ punarmanyāvabhavataṃ yuvānā yuvaṃ bhujyumarṇaso niḥ samudrād vibhirūhathurṛjrebhiraśvaiḥ
verses.en: Ye, ever-youthful Ones, again remembered Tugra, according to your ancient manner: With horses brown of hue that flew with swift wings ye brought back Bhujyu from the sea of billows.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीदश्विना तौग्र्यो वां प्रोह्लः समुद्रमव्यथिर्जगन्वान् ।
निष्टमूहथुः सुयुजा रथेन मनोजवसा वृषणा स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: ajohavīdaśvinā taugryo vāṃ prohlaḥ samudramavyathirjaganvān niṣṭamūhathuḥ suyujā rathena manojavasā vṛṣaṇā svasti
verses.en: The son of Tugra had invoked you, Asvins; borne on he went uninjured through the ocean. Ye with your chariot swift as thought, well-harnessed, carried him off, O Mighty Ones, to safety.

verses.sa:
अजोहवीदश्विना वर्तिका वामास्नो यत्सीममुञ्चतं वृकस्य ।
वि जयुषा ययथुः सान्वद्रेर्जातं विष्वाचो अहतं विषेण॥
verses.tr: ajohavīdaśvinā vartikā vāmāsno yatsīmamuñcataṃ vṛkasya vi jayuṣā yayathuḥ sānvadrerjātaṃ viṣvāco ahataṃ viṣeṇa
verses.en: The quail had invocated you, O Asvins, when from the wolf's devouring jaws ye freed her. With conquering car ye cleft the mountain's ridges: the offspring of Visvac ye killed with poison.

verses.sa:
शतं मेषान् वृक्ये मामहानं तमः प्रणीतमशिवेन पित्रा ।
आक्षी ऋज्राश्वे अश्विनावधत्तं ज्योतिरन्धाय चक्रथुर्विचक्षे॥
verses.tr: śataṃ meṣān vṛkye māmahānaṃ tamaḥ praṇītamaśivena pitrā ākṣī ṛjrāśve aśvināvadhattaṃ jyotirandhāya cakrathurvicakṣe
verses.en: He whom for furnishing a hundred wethers to the she-wolf, his wicked father blinded,-- To him, Rjrasva, gave ye eyes, O Asvins; light to the blind ye sent for perfect vision.

verses.sa:
शुनमन्धाय भरमह्वयत् सा वृकीरश्विना वृषणा नरेति ।
जारः कनीन इव चक्षदान ऋज्राश्वः शतमेकं च मेषान्॥
verses.tr: śunamandhāya bharamahvayat sā vṛkīraśvinā vṛṣaṇā nareti jāraḥ kanīna iva cakṣadāna ṛjrāśvaḥ śatamekaṃ ca meṣān
verses.en: To bring the blind man joy thus cried the she-wolf: O Asvins, O ye Mighty Ones, O Heroes, For me Rjrasva, like a youthful lover, hath. cut piecemeal one and a hundred wethers.

verses.sa:
मही वामूतिरश्विना मयोभूरुत स्रामं धिष्ण्या सं रिणीथः ।
अथा युवामिदह्वयत् पुरंधिरागच्छतं सीं वृषणाववोभिः॥
verses.tr: mahī vāmūtiraśvinā mayobhūruta srāmaṃ dhiṣṇyā saṃ riṇīthaḥ athā yuvāmidahvayat puraṃdhirāgacchataṃ sīṃ vṛṣaṇāvavobhiḥ
verses.en: Great and weal-giving is your aid, O Asvins, ye, objects of all thought, made whole the cripple. Purandhi also for this cause invoked you, and ye, O mighty, came to her with succours.

verses.sa:
अधेनुं दस्रा स्तर्यं१ विषक्तामपिन्वतं शयवे अश्विना गाम् ।
युवं शचीभिर्विमदाय जायां न्यूहथुः पुरुमित्रस्य योषाम्॥
verses.tr: adhenuṃ dasrā staryaṃ1 viṣaktāmapinvataṃ śayave aśvinā gām yuvaṃ śacībhirvimadāya jāyāṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣām
verses.en: Ye, Wonder-Workers, filled with milk for Sayu the milkless cow, emaciated, barren; And by your powers the child of Purumitra ye brought to Vimada to be his consort.

verses.sa:
यवं वृकेणाश्विना वपन्तेषं दुहन्ता मनुषाय दस्रा ।
अभि दस्युं बकुरेणा धमन्तोरु ज्योतिश्चक्रथुरार्याय॥
verses.tr: yavaṃ vṛkeṇāśvinā vapanteṣaṃ duhantā manuṣāya dasrā abhi dasyuṃ bakureṇā dhamantoru jyotiścakrathurāryāya
verses.en: Ploughing and sowing barley, O ye Asvins, milking out food for men, ye Wonder-Workers, Blasting away the Dasyu with your trumpet, ye gave far-spreading light unto the Arya.

verses.sa:
आथर्वणायाश्विना दधीचे ऽश्व्यं शिरः प्रत्यैरयतम् ।
स वां मधु प्र वोचदृतायन् त्वाष्ट्रं यद् दस्रावपिकक्ष्यं वाम्॥
verses.tr: ātharvaṇāyāśvinā dadhīce 'śvyaṃ śiraḥ pratyairayatam sa vāṃ madhu pra vocadṛtāyan tvāṣṭraṃ yad dasrāvapikakṣyaṃ vām
verses.en: Ye brought the horse's head, Asvins, and gave it unto Dadhyac the offspring of Atharvan. True, he revealed to you, O Wonder-Workers, sweet Soma, Tvastar's secret, as your girdle.

verses.sa:
सदा कवी सुमतिमा चके वां विश्वा धियो अश्विना प्रावतं मे ।
अस्मे रयिं नासत्या बृहन्तमपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं रराथाम्॥
verses.tr: sadā kavī sumatimā cake vāṃ viśvā dhiyo aśvinā prāvataṃ me asme rayiṃ nāsatyā bṛhantamapatyasācaṃ śrutyaṃ rarāthām
verses.en: O Sages, evermore I crave your favour: be gracious unto all my prayers, O Asvins. Grant me, Nasatyas, riches in abundance, wealth famous and accompanied with children.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यहस्तमश्विना रराणा पुत्रं नरा वध्रिमत्या अदत्तम् ।
त्रिधा ह श्यावमश्विना विकस्तमुज्जीवस ऐरयतं सुदानू॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyahastamaśvinā rarāṇā putraṃ narā vadhrimatyā adattam tridhā ha śyāvamaśvinā vikastamujjīvasa airayataṃ sudānū
verses.en: With liberal bounty to the weakling's consorts ye, Heroes, gave a son Hiranyahasta; And Syava, cut into three several pieces, ye brought to life again, O bounteous Asvins.

verses.sa:
एतानि वामश्विना वीर्याणि प्र पूर्व्याण्यायवोऽवोचन् ।
ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तो वृषणा युवभ्यां सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम॥
verses.tr: etāni vāmaśvinā vīryāṇi pra pūrvyāṇyāyavo'vocan brahma kṛṇvanto vṛṣaṇā yuvabhyāṃ suvīrāso vidathamā vadema
verses.en: These your heroic exploits, O ye Asvins, done in the days. of old, have men related. May we, addressing prayer to you, ye Mighty, speak with brave sons about us to the synod.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो अश्विना श्येनपत्वा सुमृळीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ् ।
यो मर्त्यस्य मनसो जवीयान् त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा वातरंहाः॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ ratho aśvinā śyenapatvā sumṛḻīkaḥ svavāṃ yātvarvāṅ yo martyasya manaso javīyān trivandhuro vṛṣaṇā vātaraṃhāḥ
verses.en: Flying, with falcons, may your chariot, Asvins, most gracious, bringing friendly help, come hither,-- Your chariot, swifter than the mind of mortal, fleet as the wind, three-seated O ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेन त्रिचक्रेण सुवृता यातमर्वाक् ।
पिन्वतं गा जिन्वतमर्वतो नो वर्धयतमश्विना वीरमस्मे॥
verses.tr: trivandhureṇa trivṛtā rathena tricakreṇa suvṛtā yātamarvāk pinvataṃ gā jinvatamarvato no vardhayatamaśvinā vīramasme
verses.en: Come to us with your chariot triple seated, three-wheeled, of triple form, that rolleth lightly. Fill full our cows, give mettle to our horses, and make each hero son grow strong, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
प्रवद्यामना सुवृता रथेन दस्राविमं शृणुतं श्लोकमद्रेः ।
किमङ्ग वां प्रत्यवर्तिं गमिष्ठाहुर्विप्रासो अश्विना पुराजाः॥
verses.tr: pravadyāmanā suvṛtā rathena dasrāvimaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokamadreḥ kimaṅga vāṃ pratyavartiṃ gamiṣṭhāhurviprāso aśvinā purājāḥ
verses.en: With your well-rolling car, descending swiftly, hear this the press-stone's song, ye Wonder-Workers. How then have ancient sages said, O Asvins, that ye most swiftly come to stay affliction?

verses.sa:
आ वां श्येनासो अश्विना वहन्तु रथे युक्तास आशवः पतंगाः ।
ये अप्तुरो दिव्यासो न गृध्रा अभि प्रयो नासत्या वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ śyenāso aśvinā vahantu rathe yuktāsa āśavaḥ pataṃgāḥ ye apturo divyāso na gṛdhrā abhi prayo nāsatyā vahanti
verses.en: O Asvins, let your falcons bear you hither, yoked to your chariot, swift, with flying pinions, Which, ever active, like the airy eagles, carry you, O Nasatyas, to the banquet.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं युवतिस्तिष्ठदत्र जुष्ट्वी नरा दुहिता सूर्यस्य ।
परि वामश्वा वपुषः पतंगा वयो वहन्त्वरुषा अभीके॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ rathaṃ yuvatistiṣṭhadatra juṣṭvī narā duhitā sūryasya pari vāmaśvā vapuṣaḥ pataṃgā vayo vahantvaruṣā abhīke
verses.en: The youthful Daughter of the Sun, delighting in you, ascended there your chariot, Heroes. Borne on their swift wings let your beauteous horses, your birds of ruddy hue, convey you near us.

verses.sa:
उद् वन्दनमैरतं दंसनाभिरुद्रेभं दस्रा वृषणा शचीभिः ।
निष्टौग्र्यं पारयथः समुद्रात् पुनश्च्यवानं चक्रथुर्युवानम्॥
verses.tr: ud vandanamairataṃ daṃsanābhirudrebhaṃ dasrā vṛṣaṇā śacībhiḥ niṣṭaugryaṃ pārayathaḥ samudrāt punaścyavānaṃ cakrathuryuvānam
verses.en: Ye raised up Vandana, strong Wonder-Workers! with great might, and with power ye rescued Rebha. From out the sea ye saved the son of Tugra, and gave his youth again unto Cyavana.

verses.sa:
युवमत्रयेऽवनीताय तप्तमूर्जमोमानमश्विनावधत्तम् ।
युवं कण्वायापिरिप्ताय चक्षुः प्रत्यधत्तं सुष्टुतिं जुजुषाणा॥
verses.tr: yuvamatraye'vanītāya taptamūrjamomānamaśvināvadhattam yuvaṃ kaṇvāyāpiriptāya cakṣuḥ pratyadhattaṃ suṣṭutiṃ jujuṣāṇā
verses.en: To Atri, cast down to the fire that scorched him, ye gave, O Asvins, strengthening food and favour. Accepting his fair praises with approval, ye gave his eyes again to blinded Kanva.

verses.sa:
युवं धेनुं शयवे नाधितायापिन्वतमश्विना पूर्व्याय ।
अमुञ्चतं वर्तिकामंहसो निः प्रति जङ्घां विश्पलाया अधत्तम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ dhenuṃ śayave nādhitāyāpinvatamaśvinā pūrvyāya amuñcataṃ vartikāmaṃhaso niḥ prati jaṅghāṃ viśpalāyā adhattam
verses.en: For ancient Sayu in his sore affliction ye caused his cow to swell with milk, O Asvins. The quail from her great misery ye delivered, and a new leg for Vispala provided.

verses.sa:
युवं श्वेतं पेदव इन्द्रजूतमहिहनमश्विनादत्तमश्वम् ।
जोहूत्रमर्यो अभिभूतिमुग्रं सहस्रसां वृषणं वीड्वङ्गम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ śvetaṃ pedava indrajūtamahihanamaśvinādattamaśvam johūtramaryo abhibhūtimugraṃ sahasrasāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vīḍvaṅgam
verses.en: A white horse, Asvins, ye bestowed on Pedu, a serpent-slaying steed sent down by Indra, Loud-neighing, conquering the foe, high-mettled, firm-limbed and vigorous, winning thousand treasures.

verses.sa:
ता वां नरा स्ववसे सुजाता हवामहे अश्विना नाधमानाः ।
आ न उप वसुमता रथेन गिरो जुषाणा सुविताय यातम्॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ narā svavase sujātā havāmahe aśvinā nādhamānāḥ ā na upa vasumatā rathena giro juṣāṇā suvitāya yātam
verses.en: Such as ye are, O nobly born, O Heroes, we in our trouble call on you for succour. Accepting these our songs, for our wellbeing come to us on your chariot treasure-laden.

verses.sa:
आ श्येनस्य जवसा नूतनेनास्मे यातं नासत्या सजोषाः ।
हवे हि वामश्विना रातहव्यः शश्वत्तमाया उषसो व्युष्टौ॥
verses.tr: ā śyenasya javasā nūtanenāsme yātaṃ nāsatyā sajoṣāḥ have hi vāmaśvinā rātahavyaḥ śaśvattamāyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau
verses.en: Come unto us combined in love, Nasatyas come with the fresh swift vigour of the falcon. Bearing oblations I invoke you, Asvins, at the first break of everlasting morning.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथं पुरुमायं मनोजुवं जीराश्वं यज्ञियं जीवसे हुवे ।
सहस्रकेतुं वनिनं शतद्वसुं श्रुष्टीवानं वरिवोधामभि प्रयः॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ rathaṃ purumāyaṃ manojuvaṃ jīrāśvaṃ yajñiyaṃ jīvase huve sahasraketuṃ vaninaṃ śatadvasuṃ śruṣṭīvānaṃ varivodhāmabhi prayaḥ
verses.en: Hither, that I may live, I call unto the feast your wondrous car, thought-swift, borne on by rapid steeds. With thousand banners, hundred treasures, pouring gifts, promptly obedient, bestowing ample room.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा धीतिः प्रत्यस्य प्रयामन्यधायि शस्मन्त्समयन्त आ दिशः ।
स्वदामि घर्मं प्रति यन्त्यूतय आ वामूर्जानी रथमश्विनारुहत्॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvā dhītiḥ pratyasya prayāmanyadhāyi śasmantsamayanta ā diśaḥ svadāmi gharmaṃ prati yantyūtaya ā vāmūrjānī rathamaśvināruhat
verses.en: Even as it moveth near my hymn is lifted up, and all the regions come together to sing praise. I sweeten the oblations; now the helpers come. Urjani hath, O Asvins, mounted on your car.

verses.sa:
सं यन्मिथः पस्पृधानासो अग्मत शुभे मखा अमिता जायवो रणे ।
युवोरह प्रवणे चेकिते रथो यदश्विना वहथः सूरिमा वरम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ yanmithaḥ paspṛdhānāso agmata śubhe makhā amitā jāyavo raṇe yuvoraha pravaṇe cekite ratho yadaśvinā vahathaḥ sūrimā varam
verses.en: When striving man with man for glory they have met, brisk, measureless, eager for victory in fight, Then verily your car is seen upon the slope when ye, O Asvins, bring some choice boon to the prince.

verses.sa:
युवं भुज्युं भुरमाणं विभिर्गतं स्वयुक्तिभिर्निवहन्ता पितृभ्य आ ।
यासिष्टं वर्तिर्वृषणा विजेन्यं१ दिवोदासाय महि चेति वामवः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ bhujyuṃ bhuramāṇaṃ vibhirgataṃ svayuktibhirnivahantā pitṛbhya ā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartirvṛṣaṇā vijenyaṃ1 divodāsāya mahi ceti vāmavaḥ
verses.en: Ye came to Bhujyu while he struggled in the flood, with flying birds, self-yoked, ye bore him to his sires. Ye went to the far-distant home, O Mighty Ones; and famed is your great aid to Divodisa given.

verses.sa:
युवोरश्विना वपुषे युवायुजं रथं वाणी येमतुरस्य शर्ध्यम् ।
आ वां पतित्वं सख्याय जग्मुषी योषावृणीत जेन्या युवां पती॥
verses.tr: yuvoraśvinā vapuṣe yuvāyujaṃ rathaṃ vāṇī yematurasya śardhyam ā vāṃ patitvaṃ sakhyāya jagmuṣī yoṣāvṛṇīta jenyā yuvāṃ patī
verses.en: Asvins, the car which you had yoked for glorious show your own two voices urged directed to its goal. Then she who came for friendship, Maid of noble birth, elected you as Husbands, you to be her Lords.

verses.sa:
युवं रेभं परिषूतेरुरुष्यथो हिमेन घर्मं परितप्तमत्रये ।
युवं शयोरवसं पिप्यथुर्गवि प्र दीर्घेण वन्दनस्तार्यायुषा॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ rebhaṃ pariṣūteruruṣyatho himena gharmaṃ paritaptamatraye yuvaṃ śayoravasaṃ pipyathurgavi pra dīrgheṇa vandanastāryāyuṣā
verses.en: Rebha ye saved from tyranny; for Atri's sake ye quenched with cold the fiery pit that compassed him. Ye made the cow of Sayu stream refreshing milk, and Vandana was holpen to extended life.

verses.sa:
युवं वन्दनं निर्ऋतं जरण्यया रथं न दस्रा करणा समिन्वथः ।
क्षेत्रादा विप्रं जनथो विपन्यया प्र वामत्र विधते दंसना भुवत्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ vandanaṃ nirṛtaṃ jaraṇyayā rathaṃ na dasrā karaṇā saminvathaḥ kṣetrādā vipraṃ janatho vipanyayā pra vāmatra vidhate daṃsanā bhuvat
verses.en: Doers of marvels, skilful workers, ye restored Vandana, like a car, worn out with length of days. From earth ye brought the sage to life in wondrous mode; be your great deeds done here for him who honours you.

verses.sa:
अगच्छतं कृपमाणं परावति पितुः स्वस्य त्यजसा निबाधितम् ।
स्वर्वतीरित ऊतीर्युवोरह चित्रा अभीके अभवन्नभिष्टयः॥
verses.tr: agacchataṃ kṛpamāṇaṃ parāvati pituḥ svasya tyajasā nibādhitam svarvatīrita ūtīryuvoraha citrā abhīke abhavannabhiṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Ye went to him who mourned in a far distant place, him who was left forlorn by treachery of his sire. Rich with the light of heaven was then the help ye gave, and marvellous your succour when ye stood by him.

verses.sa:
उत स्या वां मधुमन्मक्षिकारपन्मदे सोमस्यौशिजो हुवन्यति ।
युवं दधीचो मन आ विवासथो ऽथा शिरः प्रति वामश्व्यं वदत्॥
verses.tr: uta syā vāṃ madhumanmakṣikārapanmade somasyauśijo huvanyati yuvaṃ dadhīco mana ā vivāsatho 'thā śiraḥ prati vāmaśvyaṃ vadat
verses.en: To you in praise of sweetness sang the honey-bee: Ausija calleth you in Soma's rapturous joy. Ye drew unto yourselves the spirit of Dadhyac, and then the horse's head uttered his words to you.

verses.sa:
युवं पेदवे पुरुवारमश्विना स्पृधां श्वेतं तरुतारं दुवस्यथः ।
शर्यैरभिद्युं पृतनासु दुष्टरं चर्कृत्यमिन्द्रमिव चर्षणीसहम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ pedave puruvāramaśvinā spṛdhāṃ śvetaṃ tarutāraṃ duvasyathaḥ śaryairabhidyuṃ pṛtanāsu duṣṭaraṃ carkṛtyamindramiva carṣaṇīsaham
verses.en: A horse did ye provide for Pedu, excellent, white, O ye Asvins, conqueror of combatants, Invincible in war by arrows, seeking heaven worthy of fame, like Indra, vanquisher of men.

verses.sa: का राधद्धोत्राश्विना वां को वां जोष उभयोः । कथा विधात्यप्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: kā rādhaddhotrāśvinā vāṃ ko vāṃ joṣa ubhayoḥ kathā vidhātyapracetāḥ
verses.en: Asvins, what praise may win your grace? Who may be pleasing to you both? How shall the ignorant worship you?

verses.sa: विद्वांसाविद् दुरः पृच्छेदविद्वानित्थापरो अचेताः । नू चिन्नु मर्ते अक्रौ॥
verses.tr: vidvāṃsāvid duraḥ pṛcchedavidvānitthāparo acetāḥ nū cinnu marte akrau
verses.en: Here let the ignorant ask the means of you who know--for none beside you knoweth aught-- Not of a spiritless mortal man.

verses.sa: ता विद्वांसा हवामहे वां ता नो विद्वांसा मन्म वोचेतमद्य । प्रार्चद् दयमानो युवाकुः॥
verses.tr: tā vidvāṃsā havāmahe vāṃ tā no vidvāṃsā manma vocetamadya prārcad dayamāno yuvākuḥ
verses.en: Such as ye: are, all-wise, we call you. Ye wise, declare to us this day accepted prayer. Loving you well your servant lauds you.

verses.sa: वि पृच्छामि पाक्या ३ न देवान् वषट्कृतस्याद्भुतस्य दस्रा । पातं च सह्यसो युवं च रभ्यसो नः॥
verses.tr: vi pṛcchāmi pākyā 3 na devān vaṣaṭkṛtasyādbhutasya dasrā pātaṃ ca sahyaso yuvaṃ ca rabhyaso naḥ
verses.en: Simply, ye Mighty Ones, I ask the Gods of that wondrous oblation hallowed by the mystic word. Save us from what is stronger, fiercer than ourselves.

verses.sa: प्र या घोषे भृगवाणे न शोभे यया वाचा यजति पज्रियो वाम् । प्रैषयुर्न विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: pra yā ghoṣe bhṛgavāṇe na śobhe yayā vācā yajati pajriyo vām praiṣayurna vidvān
verses.en: Forth go the hymn that shone in Ghosa Bhrgu's like, the song wherewith the son of Pajra worships you, Like some wise minister.

verses.sa: श्रुतं गायत्रं तकवानस्याहं चिद्धि रिरेभाश्विना वाम् । आक्षी शुभस्पती दन्॥
verses.tr: śrutaṃ gāyatraṃ takavānasyāhaṃ ciddhi rirebhāśvinā vām ākṣī śubhaspatī dan
verses.en: Hear ye the song of him who hastens speedily. O Asvins, I am he who sang your praise. Hither, ye Lords of Splendour, hither turn your eyes.

verses.sa: युवं ह्यास्तं महो रन् युवं वा यन्निरततंसतम् । ता नो वसू सुगोपा स्यातं पातं नो वृकादघायोः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ hyāstaṃ maho ran yuvaṃ vā yanniratataṃsatam tā no vasū sugopā syātaṃ pātaṃ no vṛkādaghāyoḥ
verses.en: For ye were ever nigh to deal forth ample wealth, to give the wealth that ye had gathered up. As such, ye Vasus, guard us well, and keep us safely from the wicked wolf.

verses.sa: मा कस्मै धातमभ्यमित्रिणे नो माकुत्रा नो गृहेभ्यो धेनवो गुः । स्तनाभुजो अशिश्वीः॥
verses.tr: mā kasmai dhātamabhyamitriṇe no mākutrā no gṛhebhyo dhenavo guḥ stanābhujo aśiśvīḥ
verses.en: Give us not up to any man who hateth us, nor let our milch-cows stray, whose udders give us food, Far from our homes without their calves.

verses.sa: दुहीयन् मित्रधितये युवाकु राये च नो मिमीतं वाजवत्यै । इषे च नो मिमीतं धेनुमत्यै॥
verses.tr: duhīyan mitradhitaye yuvāku rāye ca no mimītaṃ vājavatyai iṣe ca no mimītaṃ dhenumatyai
verses.en: May they who love you gain you for their Friends. Prepare ye us for opulence with strengthening food, Prepare us for the food that floweth from our cows

verses.sa: अश्विनोरसनं रथमनश्वं वाजिनीवतोः । तेनाहं भूरि चाकन॥
verses.tr: aśvinorasanaṃ rathamanaśvaṃ vājinīvatoḥ tenāhaṃ bhūri cākana
verses.en: I have obtained the horseless car of Asvins rich in sacrifice, And I am well content therewith.

verses.sa: अयं समह मा तनूह्याते जनाँ अनु । सोमपेयं सुखो रथः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ samaha mā tanūhyāte janāṃ anu somapeyaṃ sukho rathaḥ
verses.en: May it convey me evermore: may the light chariot pass from men To men unto the Soma draught.

verses.sa: अध स्वप्नस्य निर्विदे ऽभुञ्जतश्च रेवतः । उभा ता बस्रि नश्यतः॥
verses.tr: adha svapnasya nirvide 'bhuñjataśca revataḥ ubhā tā basri naśyataḥ
verses.en: It holdeth slumber in contempt. and the rich who enjoyeth not: Both vanish quickly and are lost.

verses.sa:
कदित्था नॄँः पात्रं देवयतां श्रवद् गिरो अङ्गिरसां तुरण्यन् ।
प्र यदानड्विश आ हर्म्यस्योरु क्रंसते अध्वरे यजत्रः॥
verses.tr: kaditthā nṝṃḥ pātraṃ devayatāṃ śravad giro aṅgirasāṃ turaṇyan pra yadānaḍviśa ā harmyasyoru kraṃsate adhvare yajatraḥ
verses.en: When Will men's guardians hasting hear with favour the song of Angiras's pious children? When to the people of the home he cometh he strideth to the sacrifice, the Holy.

verses.sa:
स्तम्भीद्ध द्यां स धरुणं प्रुषायदृभुर्वाजाय द्रविणं नरो गोः ।
अनु स्वजां महिषश्चक्षत व्रां मेनामश्वस्य परि मातरं गोः॥
verses.tr: stambhīddha dyāṃ sa dharuṇaṃ pruṣāyadṛbhurvājāya draviṇaṃ naro goḥ anu svajāṃ mahiṣaścakṣata vrāṃ menāmaśvasya pari mātaraṃ goḥ
verses.en: He stablished heaven; he poured forth, skilful worker, the wealth of kine, for strength, that nurtures heroes. The Mighty One his self-born host regarded, the horse's mate, the mother of the heifer.

verses.sa:
नक्षद्धवमरुणीः पूर्व्यं राट् तुरो विशामङ्गिरसामनु द्यून् ।
तक्षद् वज्रं नियुतं तस्तम्भद् द्यां चतुष्पदे नर्याय द्विपादे॥
verses.tr: nakṣaddhavamaruṇīḥ pūrvyaṃ rāṭ turo viśāmaṅgirasāmanu dyūn takṣad vajraṃ niyutaṃ tastambhad dyāṃ catuṣpade naryāya dvipāde
verses.en: Lord of red dawns, he came victorious, daily to the Angirases' former invocation. His bolt and team hath he prepared, and stablished the heaven for quadrupeds and men two-footed.

verses.sa:
अस्य मदे स्वर्यं दा ऋतायापीवृतमुस्रियाणामनीकम् ।
यद्ध प्रसर्गे त्रिककुम्निवर्तदप द्रुहो मानुषस्य दुरो वः॥
verses.tr: asya made svaryaṃ dā ṛtāyāpīvṛtamusriyāṇāmanīkam yaddha prasarge trikakumnivartadapa druho mānuṣasya duro vaḥ
verses.en: In joy of this thou didst restore, for worship, the lowing company of hidden cattle. When the three-pointed one descends with onslaught he opens wide the doors that cause man trouble.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं पयो यत् पितरावनीतां राधः सुरेतस्तुरणे भुरण्यू ।
शुचि यत् ते रेक्ण आयजन्त सबर्दुघायाः पय उस्रियायाः॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ payo yat pitarāvanītāṃ rādhaḥ suretasturaṇe bhuraṇyū śuci yat te rekṇa āyajanta sabardughāyāḥ paya usriyāyāḥ
verses.en: Thine is that milk which thy swift-moving Parents brought down, a strengthening genial gift for conquest; When the pure treasure unto thee they offered, the milk shed from the cow who streameth nectar.

verses.sa:
अध प्र जज्ञे तरणिर्ममत्तु प्र रोच्यस्या उषसो न सूरः ।
इन्दुर्येभिराष्ट स्वेदुहव्यैः स्रुवेण सिञ्चञ्जरणाभि धाम॥
verses.tr: adha pra jajñe taraṇirmamattu pra rocyasyā uṣaso na sūraḥ induryebhirāṣṭa sveduhavyaiḥ sruveṇa siñcañjaraṇābhi dhāma
verses.en: There is he born. May the Swift give us rapture, and like the Sun shine forth from yonder dawning, Indu, even us who drank, whose toils are offerings, poured from the spoon, with praise, upon the altar.

verses.sa:
स्विध्मा यद् वनधितिरपस्यात् सूरो अध्वरे परि रोधना गोः ।
यद्ध प्रभासि कृत्व्याँ अनु द्यूननर्विशे पश्विषे तुराय॥
verses.tr: svidhmā yad vanadhitirapasyāt sūro adhvare pari rodhanā goḥ yaddha prabhāsi kṛtvyāṃ anu dyūnanarviśe paśviṣe turāya
verses.en: When the wood-pile, made of good logs, is ready, at the Sun's worship to bind fast the Bullock, Then when thou shinest forth through days of action for the Car-borne, the Swift, the Cattle-seeker.

verses.sa:
अष्टा महो दिव आदो हरी इह द्युम्नासाहमभि योधान उत्सम् ।
हरिं यत्ते मन्दिनं दुक्षन् वृधे गोरभसमद्रिभिर्वाताप्यम्॥
verses.tr: aṣṭā maho diva ādo harī iha dyumnāsāhamabhi yodhāna utsam hariṃ yatte mandinaṃ dukṣan vṛdhe gorabhasamadribhirvātāpyam
verses.en: Eight steeds thou broughtest down from mighty heaven, when fighting for the well that giveth splendour, That men might press with stones the gladdening yellow, strengthened with milk, fermenting, to exalt thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमायसं प्रति वर्तयो गोर्दिवो अश्मानमुपनीतमृभ्वा ।
कुत्साय यत्र पुरुहूत वन्वञ्छुष्णमनन्तैः परियासि वधैः॥
verses.tr: tvamāyasaṃ prati vartayo gordivo aśmānamupanītamṛbhvā kutsāya yatra puruhūta vanvañchuṣṇamanantaiḥ pariyāsi vadhaiḥ
verses.en: Thou hurledst forth from heaven the iron missile, brought by the Skilful, from the sling of leather, When thou, O Much-invoked, assisting Kutsa with endless deadly darts didst compass Susna.

verses.sa:
पुरा यत् सूरस्तमसो अपीतेस्तमद्रिवः फलिगं हेतिमस्य ।
शुष्णस्य चित् परिहितं यदोजो दिवस्परि सुग्रथितं तदादः॥
verses.tr: purā yat sūrastamaso apītestamadrivaḥ phaligaṃ hetimasya śuṣṇasya cit parihitaṃ yadojo divaspari sugrathitaṃ tadādaḥ
verses.en: Bolt-armed, ere darkness overtook the sunlight, thou castest at the veiling cloud thy weapon, Thou rentest, out of heaven, though firmly knotted, the might of Susna that was thrown around him.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा मही पाजसी अचक्रे द्यावाक्षामा मदतामिन्द्र कर्मन् ।
त्वं वृत्रमाशयानं सिरासु महो वज्रेण सिष्वपो वराहुम्॥
verses.tr: anu tvā mahī pājasī acakre dyāvākṣāmā madatāmindra karman tvaṃ vṛtramāśayānaṃ sirāsu maho vajreṇa siṣvapo varāhum
verses.en: The mighty Heaven and Earth, those bright expanses that have no wheels, joyed, Indra, at thine exploit. Vrtra, the boar who lay amid the waters, to sleep thou sentest with thy mighty thunder.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र नर्यो याँ अवो नॄन् तिष्ठा वातस्य सुयुजो वहिष्ठान् ।
यं ते काव्य उशना मन्दिनं दाद् वृत्रहणं पार्यं ततक्ष वज्रम्॥
verses.tr: tvamindra naryo yāṃ avo nṝn tiṣṭhā vātasya suyujo vahiṣṭhān yaṃ te kāvya uśanā mandinaṃ dād vṛtrahaṇaṃ pāryaṃ tatakṣa vajram
verses.en: Mount Indra, lover of the men thou guardest, the well-yoked horses of the wind, best bearers. The bolt which Kavya Usana erst gave thee, strong, gladdening, Vrtra-slaying, hath he fashioned.

verses.sa:
त्वं सूरो हरितो रामयो नॄन् भरच्चक्रमेतशो नायमिन्द्र ।
प्रास्य पारं नवतिं नाव्यानामपि कर्तमवर्तयोऽयज्यून्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sūro harito rāmayo nṝn bharaccakrametaśo nāyamindra prāsya pāraṃ navatiṃ nāvyānāmapi kartamavartayo'yajyūn
verses.en: The strong Bay Horses of the Sun thou stayedst: this Etasa drew not the wheel, O Indra. Casting them forth beyond the ninety rivers thou dravest down into the pit the godless.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अस्या इन्द्र दुर्हणायाः पाहि वज्रिवो दुरितादभीके ।
प्र नो वाजान् रथ्यो ३ अश्वबुध्यानिषे यन्धि श्रवसे सूनृतायै॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no asyā indra durhaṇāyāḥ pāhi vajrivo duritādabhīke pra no vājān rathyo 3 aśvabudhyāniṣe yandhi śravase sūnṛtāyai
verses.en: Indra, preserve thou us from this affliction Thunder-armed, save us from the misery near us. Vouchsafe us affluence in chariots, founded on horses, for our food and fame and gladness.

verses.sa:
मा सा ते अस्मत् सुमतिर्वि दसद् वाजप्रमहः समिषो वरन्त ।
आ नो भज मघवन् गोष्वर्यो मंहिष्ठास्ते सधमादः स्याम॥
verses.tr: mā sā te asmat sumatirvi dasad vājapramahaḥ samiṣo varanta ā no bhaja maghavan goṣvaryo maṃhiṣṭhāste sadhamādaḥ syāma
verses.en: Never may this thy loving-kindness fail us; mighty in strength, may plenteous food surround us. Maghavan, make us share the foeman's cattle: may we be thy most liberal feast companions.

verses.sa:
प्र वः पान्तं रघुमन्यवोऽन्धो यज्ञं रुद्राय मीह्लुषे भरध्वम् ।
दिवो अस्तोष्यसुरस्य वीरैरिषुध्येव मरुतो रोदस्योः॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ pāntaṃ raghumanyavo'ndho yajñaṃ rudrāya mīhluṣe bharadhvam divo astoṣyasurasya vīrairiṣudhyeva maruto rodasyoḥ
verses.en: Say, bringing sacrifice to bounteous Rudra, This juice for drink to you whose wrath is fleeting! With Dyaus the Asura's Heroes I have lauded the Maruts as with prayer to Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
पत्नीव पूर्वहूतिं वावृधध्या उषासानक्ता पुरुधा विदाने ।
स्तरीर्नात्कं व्युतं वसाना सूर्यस्य श्रिया सुदृशी हिरण्यैः॥
verses.tr: patnīva pūrvahūtiṃ vāvṛdhadhyā uṣāsānaktā purudhā vidāne starīrnātkaṃ vyutaṃ vasānā sūryasya śriyā sudṛśī hiraṇyaiḥ
verses.en: Strong to exalt the early invocation are Night and Dawn who show with varied aspect. The Barren clothes her in wide-woven raiment, and fair Morn shines with Surya's golden splendour.

verses.sa:
ममत्तु नः परिज्मा वसर्हा ममत्तु वातो अपां वृषण्वान् ।
शिशीतमिन्द्रापर्वता युवं नस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: mamattu naḥ parijmā vasarhā mamattu vāto apāṃ vṛṣaṇvān śiśītamindrāparvatā yuvaṃ nastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ
verses.en: Cheer us the Roamer round, who strikes at morning, the Wind delight us, pourer forth of waters! Sharpen our wits, O Parvata and Indra. May all the Gods vouchsafe to us this favour.

verses.sa:
उत त्या मे यशसा श्वेतनायै व्यन्ता पान्तौशिजो हुवध्यै ।
प्र वो नपातमपां कृणुध्वं प्र मातरा रास्पिनस्यायोः॥
verses.tr: uta tyā me yaśasā śvetanāyai vyantā pāntauśijo huvadhyai pra vo napātamapāṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra mātarā rāspinasyāyoḥ
verses.en: And Ausija shall call for me that famous Pair who enjoy and drink, who come to brighten. Set ye the Offspring of the Floods before you; both Mothers of the Living One who beameth.

verses.sa:
आ वो रुवण्युमौशिजो हुवध्यै घोषेव शंसमर्जुनस्य नंशे ।
प्र वः पूष्णे दावन आँ अच्छा वोचेय वसुतातिमग्नेः॥
verses.tr: ā vo ruvaṇyumauśijo huvadhyai ghoṣeva śaṃsamarjunasya naṃśe pra vaḥ pūṣṇe dāvana āṃ acchā voceya vasutātimagneḥ
verses.en: For you shall Ausija call him who thunders, as, to win Arjuna's assent, cried Ghosa. I will invoke, that Pusan may be bounteous to you, the rich munificence of Agni.

verses.sa:
श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमोत श्रुतं सदने विश्वतः सीम् ।
श्रोतु नः श्रोतुरातिः सुश्रोतुः सुक्षेत्रा सिन्धुरद्भिः॥
verses.tr: śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemota śrutaṃ sadane viśvataḥ sīm śrotu naḥ śroturātiḥ suśrotuḥ sukṣetrā sindhuradbhiḥ
verses.en: Hear, Mitra-Varuna, these mine invocations, hear them from all men in the hall of worship. Giver of famous gifts, kind hearer, Sindhu who gives fair fields, listen with all his waters!

verses.sa:
स्तुषे सा वां वरुण मित्र रातिर्गवां शता पृक्षयामेषु पज्रे ।
श्रुतरथे प्रियरथे दधानाः सद्यः पुष्टिं निरुन्धानासो अग्मन्॥
verses.tr: stuṣe sā vāṃ varuṇa mitra rātirgavāṃ śatā pṛkṣayāmeṣu pajre śrutarathe priyarathe dadhānāḥ sadyaḥ puṣṭiṃ nirundhānāso agman
verses.en: Praised, Mitra, Varuna! is your gift, a hundred cows to the Prksayamas and the Pajra. Presented by car-famous Priyaratha, supplying nourishment, they came directly.

verses.sa:
अस्य स्तुषे महिमघस्य राधः सचा सनेम नहुषः सुवीराः ।
जनो यः पज्रेभ्यो वाजिनीवानश्वावतो रथिनो मह्यं सूरिः॥
verses.tr: asya stuṣe mahimaghasya rādhaḥ sacā sanema nahuṣaḥ suvīrāḥ jano yaḥ pajrebhyo vājinīvānaśvāvato rathino mahyaṃ sūriḥ
verses.en: Praised is the gift of him the very wealthy: may we enjoy it, men with hero children: His who hath many gifts to give the Pajras, a chief who makes me rich in cars and horses.

verses.sa:
जनो यो मित्रावरुणावभिध्रुगपो न वां सुनोत्यक्ष्णयाध्रुक् ।
स्वयं स यक्ष्मं हृदये नि धत्त आप यदीं होत्राभिर्ऋतावा॥
verses.tr: jano yo mitrāvaruṇāvabhidhrugapo na vāṃ sunotyakṣṇayādhruk svayaṃ sa yakṣmaṃ hṛdaye ni dhatta āpa yadīṃ hotrābhirṛtāvā
verses.en: The folk, O Mitra-Varuna, who hate you, who sinfully hating pour you no libations, Lay in their hearts, themselves, a wasting sickness, whereas the righteous gaineth all by worship.

verses.sa:
स व्राधतो नहुषो दंसुजूतः शर्धस्तरो नरां गूर्तश्रवाः ।
विसृष्टरातिर्याति बाह्लसृत्वा विश्वासु पृत्सु सदमिच्छूरः॥
verses.tr: sa vrādhato nahuṣo daṃsujūtaḥ śardhastaro narāṃ gūrtaśravāḥ visṛṣṭarātiryāti bāhlasṛtvā viśvāsu pṛtsu sadamicchūraḥ
verses.en: That man, most puissant, wondrously urged onward, famed among heroes, liberal in giving, Moveth a warrior, evermore undaunted in all encounters even with the mighty.

verses.sa:
अध ग्मन्ता नहुषो हवं सूरेः श्रोता राजानो अमृतस्य मन्द्राः ।
नभोजुवो यन्निरवस्य राधः प्रशस्तये महिना रथवते॥
verses.tr: adha gmantā nahuṣo havaṃ sūreḥ śrotā rājāno amṛtasya mandrāḥ nabhojuvo yanniravasya rādhaḥ praśastaye mahinā rathavate
verses.en: Come to the man's, the sacrificer's calling: hear, Kings of Immortality, joy-givers! While ye who speed through clouds decree your bounty largely, for fame, to him the chariot rider.

verses.sa:
एतं शर्धं धाम यस्य सूरेरित्यवोचन् दशतयस्य नंशे ।
द्युम्नानि येषु वसुताती रारन् विश्वे सन्वन्तु प्रभृथेषु वाजम्॥
verses.tr: etaṃ śardhaṃ dhāma yasya sūrerityavocan daśatayasya naṃśe dyumnāni yeṣu vasutātī rāran viśve sanvantu prabhṛtheṣu vājam
verses.en: Vigour will we bestow on that adorer whose tenfold draught we come to taste, so spake they. May all in whom rest splendour and great riches obtain refreshment in these sacrifices.

verses.sa:
मन्दामहे दशतयस्य धासेर्द्विर्यत् पञ्च बिभ्रतो यन्त्यन्ना ।
किमिष्टाश्व इष्टरश्मिरेत ईशानासस्तरुष ऋञ्जते नॄन्॥
verses.tr: mandāmahe daśatayasya dhāserdviryat pañca bibhrato yantyannā kimiṣṭāśva iṣṭaraśmireta īśānāsastaruṣa ṛñjate nṝn
verses.en: We will rejoice to drink the tenfold present when the twicefive come bearing sacred viands. What can he do whose steeds and reins are choicest? These, the all-potent, urge brave men to conquest.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकर्णं मणिग्रीवमर्णस्तन्नो विश्वे वरिवस्यन्तु देवाः ।
अर्यो गिरः सद्य आ जग्मुषीरोस्राश्चाकन्तूभयेष्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyakarṇaṃ maṇigrīvamarṇastanno viśve varivasyantu devāḥ aryo giraḥ sadya ā jagmuṣīrosrāścākantūbhayeṣvasme
verses.en: The sea and all the Deities shall give us him with the golden ear and neck bejewelled. Dawns, hasting to the praises of the pious, be pleased with us, both offerers and singers.

verses.sa:
चत्वारो मा मशर्शारस्य शिश्वस्त्रयो राज्ञ आयवसस्य जिष्णोः ।
रथो वां मित्रावरुणा दीर्घाप्साः स्यूमगभस्तिः सूरो नाद्यौत्॥
verses.tr: catvāro mā maśarśārasya śiśvastrayo rājña āyavasasya jiṣṇoḥ ratho vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dīrghāpsāḥ syūmagabhastiḥ sūro nādyaut
verses.en: Four youthful sons of Masarsara vex me, three, of the king, the conquering Ayavasa. Now like the Sun, O Varuna and Mitra, your car hath shone, long-shaped and reined with splendour.

verses.sa:
पृथू रथो दक्षिणाया अयोज्यैनं देवासो अमृतासो अस्थुः ।
कृष्णादुदस्थादर्या ३ विहायाश्चिकित्सन्ती मानुषाय क्षयाय॥
verses.tr: pṛthū ratho dakṣiṇāyā ayojyainaṃ devāso amṛtāso asthuḥ kṛṣṇādudasthādaryā 3 vihāyāścikitsantī mānuṣāya kṣayāya
verses.en: The Daksina's broad chariot hath been harnessed: this car the Gods Immortal have ascended. Fain to bring light to homes of men the noble and active Goddess hath emerged from darkness.

verses.sa:
पूर्वा विश्वस्माद् भुवनादबोधि जयन्ती वाजं बृहती सनुत्री ।
उच्चा व्यख्यद् युवतिः पुनर्भूरोषा अगन् प्रथमा पूर्वहूतौ॥
verses.tr: pūrvā viśvasmād bhuvanādabodhi jayantī vājaṃ bṛhatī sanutrī uccā vyakhyad yuvatiḥ punarbhūroṣā agan prathamā pūrvahūtau
verses.en: She before all the living world hath wakened, the Lofty One who wins and gathers treasure. Revived and ever young on high she glances. Dawn hath come first unto our morning worship.

verses.sa:
यदद्य भागं विभजासि नृभ्य उषो देवि मर्त्यत्रा सुजाते ।
देवो नो अत्र सविता दमूना अनागसो वोचति सूर्याय॥
verses.tr: yadadya bhāgaṃ vibhajāsi nṛbhya uṣo devi martyatrā sujāte devo no atra savitā damūnā anāgaso vocati sūryāya
verses.en: If, Dawn, thou Goddess nobly born, thou dealest fortune this day to all the race of mortals, May Savitar the God, Friend of the homestead, declare before the Sun that we are sinless.

verses.sa:
गृहंगृहमहना यात्यच्छा दिवेदिवे अधि नामा दधाना ।
सिषासन्ती द्योतना शश्वदागादग्रमग्रमिद् भजते वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: gṛhaṃgṛhamahanā yātyacchā divedive adhi nāmā dadhānā siṣāsantī dyotanā śaśvadāgādagramagramid bhajate vasūnām
verses.en: Showing her wonted form each day that passeth, spreading the light she visiteth each dwelling. Eager for conquest, with bright sheen she cometh. Her portion is the best of goodly treasures.

verses.sa:
भगस्य स्वसा वरुणस्य जामिरुषः सूनृते प्रथमा जरस्व ।
पश्चा स दघ्या यो अघस्य धाता जयेम तं दक्षिणया रथेन॥
verses.tr: bhagasya svasā varuṇasya jāmiruṣaḥ sūnṛte prathamā jarasva paścā sa daghyā yo aghasya dhātā jayema taṃ dakṣiṇayā rathena
verses.en: Sister of Varuna, sister of Bhaga, first among all sing forth, O joyous Morning. Weak be the strength of him who worketh evil: may we subdue him with our car the guerdon.

verses.sa:
उदीरतां सूनृता उत् पुरन्धीरुदग्नयः शुशुचानासो अस्थुः ।
स्पार्हा वसूनि तमसापगूह्लविष्कृण्वन्त्युषसो विभातीः॥
verses.tr: udīratāṃ sūnṛtā ut purandhīrudagnayaḥ śuśucānāso asthuḥ spārhā vasūni tamasāpagūhlaviṣkṛṇvantyuṣaso vibhātīḥ
verses.en: Let our glad hymns and holy thoughts rise upward, for the flames brightly burning have ascended. The far-refulgent Mornings make apparent the lovely treasures which the darkness covered.

verses.sa:
अपान्यदेत्यभ्य १ न्यदेति विषुरूपे अहनी सं चरेते ।
परिक्षितोस्तमो अन्या गुहाकरद्यौदुषाः शोशुचता रथेन॥
verses.tr: apānyadetyabhya 1 nyadeti viṣurūpe ahanī saṃ carete parikṣitostamo anyā guhākaradyauduṣāḥ śośucatā rathena
verses.en: The one departeth and the other cometh: unlike in hue day's, halves march on successive. One hides the gloom of the surrounding Parents. Dawn on her shining chariot is resplendent.

verses.sa:
सदृशीरद्य सदृशीरिदु श्वो दीर्घं सचन्ते वरुणस्य धाम ।
अनवद्यास्त्रिंशतं योजनान्येकैका क्रतुं परि यन्ति सद्यः॥
verses.tr: sadṛśīradya sadṛśīridu śvo dīrghaṃ sacante varuṇasya dhāma anavadyāstriṃśataṃ yojanānyekaikā kratuṃ pari yanti sadyaḥ
verses.en: The same in form to-day, the same tomorrow, they still keep Varuna's eternal statute. Blameless, in turn they traverse thirty regions, and dart across the spirit in a moment.

verses.sa:
जानत्यह्नः प्रथमस्य नाम शुक्रा कृष्णादजनिष्ट श्वितीची ।
ऋतस्य योषा न मिनाति धामाहरहर्निष्कृतमाचरन्ती॥
verses.tr: jānatyahnaḥ prathamasya nāma śukrā kṛṣṇādajaniṣṭa śvitīcī ṛtasya yoṣā na mināti dhāmāharaharniṣkṛtamācarantī
verses.en: She who hath knowledge Of the first day's nature is born refulgent white from out the darkness. The Maiden breaketh not the law of Order, day by day coming to the place appointed.

verses.sa:
कन्येव तन्वा ३ शाशदानाँ एषि देवि देवमियक्षमाणम् ।
संस्मयमाना युवतिः पुरस्तादाविर्वक्षांसि कृणुषे विभाती॥
verses.tr: kanyeva tanvā 3 śāśadānāṃ eṣi devi devamiyakṣamāṇam saṃsmayamānā yuvatiḥ purastādāvirvakṣāṃsi kṛṇuṣe vibhātī
verses.en: In pride of beauty like a maid thou goest, O Goddess, to the God who longs to win thee, And smiling youthful, as thou shinest brightly, before him thou discoverest thy bosom.

verses.sa:
सुसंकाशा मातृमृष्टेव योषाविस्तन्वं कृणुषे दृशे कम् ।
भद्रा त्वमुषो वितरं व्युच्छ न तत्ते अन्या उषसो नशन्त॥
verses.tr: susaṃkāśā mātṛmṛṣṭeva yoṣāvistanvaṃ kṛṇuṣe dṛśe kam bhadrā tvamuṣo vitaraṃ vyuccha na tatte anyā uṣaso naśanta
verses.en: Fair as a bride embellished by her mother thou showest forth thy form that all may see it. Blessed art thou O Dawn. Shine yet more widely. No other Dawns have reached what thou attainest.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्विश्ववारा यतमाना रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्य ।
परा च यन्ति पुनरा च यन्ति भद्रा नाम वहमाना उषासः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīrgomatīrviśvavārā yatamānā raśmibhiḥ sūryasya parā ca yanti punarā ca yanti bhadrā nāma vahamānā uṣāsaḥ
verses.en: Rich in kine, horses, and all goodly treasures, in constant operation with the sunbeams, The Dawns depart and come again assuming their wonted forms that promise happy fortune.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य रश्मिमनुयच्छमाना भद्रम्भद्रं क्रतुमस्मासु धेहि ।
उषो नो अद्य सुहवा व्युच्छास्मासु रायो मघवत्सु च स्युः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya raśmimanuyacchamānā bhadrambhadraṃ kratumasmāsu dhehi uṣo no adya suhavā vyucchāsmāsu rāyo maghavatsu ca syuḥ
verses.en: Obedient to the rein of Law Eternal give us each thought that more and more shall bless us. Shine thou on us to-day, Dawn, swift to listen. With us be riches and with chiefs who worship.

verses.sa:
उषा उच्छन्ती समिधाने अग्ना उद्यन्त्सूर्य उर्विया ज्योतिरश्रेत् ।
देवो नो अत्र सविता न्वर्थं प्रासावीद् द्विपत् प्र चतुष्पदित्यै॥
verses.tr: uṣā ucchantī samidhāne agnā udyantsūrya urviyā jyotiraśret devo no atra savitā nvarthaṃ prāsāvīd dvipat pra catuṣpadityai
verses.en: The Dawn refulgent when the fire is kindled, and the Sun rising, far diffuse their brightness. Savitar, God, hath sent us forth to labour, each quadruped, each biped, to be active.

verses.sa:
अमिनती दैव्यानि व्रतानि प्रमिनती मनुष्या युगानि ।
ईयुषीणामुपमा शश्वतीनामायतीनां प्रथमोषा व्यद्यौत्॥
verses.tr: aminatī daivyāni vratāni praminatī manuṣyā yugāni īyuṣīṇāmupamā śaśvatīnāmāyatīnāṃ prathamoṣā vyadyaut
verses.en: Not interrupting heavenly ordinances, although she minisheth human generations. The last of endless morns that have departed, the first of those that come, Dawn brightly shineth.

verses.sa:
एषा दिवो दुहिता प्रत्यदर्शि ज्योतिर्वसाना समना पुरस्तात् ।
ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति॥
verses.tr: eṣā divo duhitā pratyadarśi jyotirvasānā samanā purastāt ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti
verses.en: There in the eastern region she, Heaven's Daughter, arrayed in garments all of light, appeareth. Truly she followeth the path of Order, nor faileth, knowing well, the heavenly quarters.

verses.sa:
उपो अदर्शि शुन्ध्युवो न वक्षो नोधा इवाविरकृत प्रियाणि ।
अद्मसन्न ससतो बोधयन्ती शश्वत्तमागात् पुनरेयुषीणाम्॥
verses.tr: upo adarśi śundhyuvo na vakṣo nodhā ivāvirakṛta priyāṇi admasanna sasato bodhayantī śaśvattamāgāt punareyuṣīṇām
verses.en: Near is she seen, as 'twere the Bright One's bosom: she showeth sweet things like a new song-singer. She cometh like a fly awaking sleepers, of all returning dames most true and constant.

verses.sa:
पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो अप्त्यस्य गवां जनित्र्यकृत प्र केतुम् ।
व्यु प्रथते वितरं वरीय ओभा पृणन्ती पित्रोरुपस्था॥
verses.tr: pūrve ardhe rajaso aptyasya gavāṃ janitryakṛta pra ketum vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīya obhā pṛṇantī pitrorupasthā
verses.en: There in the east half of the watery region the Mother of the Cows hath shown her ensign. Wider and wider still she spreadeth onward, and filleth full the laps of both heir Parents.

verses.sa:
एवेदेषा पुरुतमा दृशे कं नाजामिं न परि वृणक्ति जामिम् ।
अरेपसा तन्वा ३ शाशदाना नार्भादीषते न महो विभाती॥
verses.tr: evedeṣā purutamā dṛśe kaṃ nājāmiṃ na pari vṛṇakti jāmim arepasā tanvā 3 śāśadānā nārbhādīṣate na maho vibhātī
verses.en: She, verily, exceeding vast to look on debarreth from her light nor kin nor stranger. Proud of her spotless form she, brightly shining, turneth not from the high nor from the humble.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातेव पुंस एति प्रतीची गर्तारुगिव सनये धनानाम् ।
जायेव पत्य उशती सुवासा उषा हस्रेव नि रिणीते अप्सः॥
verses.tr: abhrāteva puṃsa eti pratīcī gartārugiva sanaye dhanānām jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsā uṣā hasreva ni riṇīte apsaḥ
verses.en: She seeketh men, as she who hath no brother, mounting her car, as 'twere to gather riches. Dawn, like a loving matron for her husband, smiling and well attired, unmasks her beauty.

verses.sa:
स्वसा स्वस्रे ज्यायस्यै योनिमारैगपैत्यस्याः प्रतिचक्ष्येव ।
व्युच्छन्ती रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्याञ्ज्यङ्क्ते समनगा इव व्राः॥
verses.tr: svasā svasre jyāyasyai yonimāraigapaityasyāḥ praticakṣyeva vyucchantī raśmibhiḥ sūryasyāñjyaṅkte samanagā iva vrāḥ
verses.en: The Sister quitteth, for the elder Sister, her place, and having looked on her departeth. She decks her beauty, shining forth with sunbeams, like women trooping to the festal meeting.

verses.sa:
आसां पूर्वासामहसु स्वसॄणामपरा पूर्वामभ्येति पश्चात् ।
ताः प्रत्नवन्नव्यसीर्नूनमस्मे रेवदुच्छन्तु सुदिना उषासः॥
verses.tr: āsāṃ pūrvāsāmahasu svasṝṇāmaparā pūrvāmabhyeti paścāt tāḥ pratnavannavyasīrnūnamasme revaducchantu sudinā uṣāsaḥ
verses.en: To all these Sisters who ere now have vanished a later one each day in course succeedeth. So, like the past, with days of happy fortune, may the new Dawns shine forth on us with riches.

verses.sa:
प्र बोधयोषः पृणतो मघोन्यबुध्यमानाः पणयः ससन्तु ।
रेवदुच्छ मघवद्भ्यो मघोनि रेवत् स्तोत्रे सूनृते जारयन्ती॥
verses.tr: pra bodhayoṣaḥ pṛṇato maghonyabudhyamānāḥ paṇayaḥ sasantu revaduccha maghavadbhyo maghoni revat stotre sūnṛte jārayantī
verses.en: Rouse up, O Wealthy One, the liberal givers; let niggard traffickers sleep on unwakened: Shine richly, Wealthy One, on those who worship, richly, glad. Dawn while wasting, on the singer.

verses.sa:
अवेयमश्वैद् युवतिः पुरस्ताद् युङ्क्ते गवामरुणानामनीकम् ।
वि नूनमुच्छादसति प्र केतुर्गृहंगृहमुप तिष्ठाते अग्निः॥
verses.tr: aveyamaśvaid yuvatiḥ purastād yuṅkte gavāmaruṇānāmanīkam vi nūnamucchādasati pra keturgṛhaṃgṛhamupa tiṣṭhāte agniḥ
verses.en: This young Maid from the east hath shone upon us; she harnesseth her team of bright red oxen. She will beam forth, the light will hasten hither, and Agni will be present in each dwelling.

verses.sa:
उत् ते वयश्चिद् वसतेरपप्तन् नरश्च ये पितुभाजो व्युष्टौ ।
अमा सते वहसि भूरि वाममुषो देवि दाशुषे मर्त्याय॥
verses.tr: ut te vayaścid vasaterapaptan naraśca ye pitubhājo vyuṣṭau amā sate vahasi bhūri vāmamuṣo devi dāśuṣe martyāya
verses.en: As the birds fly forth from their resting places, so men with store of food rise at thy dawning. Yea, to the liberal mortal who remaineth at home, O Goddess Dawn, much good thou bringest.

verses.sa:
अस्तोढ्वं स्तोम्या ब्रह्मणा मे ऽवीवृधध्वमुशतीरुषासः ।
युष्माकं देवीरवसा सनेम सहस्रिणं च शतिनं च वाजम्॥
verses.tr: astoḍhvaṃ stomyā brahmaṇā me 'vīvṛdhadhvamuśatīruṣāsaḥ yuṣmākaṃ devīravasā sanema sahasriṇaṃ ca śatinaṃ ca vājam
verses.en: Praised through my prayer be ye who should be lauded. Ye have increased our wealth, ye Dawns who love us. Goddesses, may we win by your good favour wealth to be told by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.sa:
प्राता रत्नं प्रातरित्वा दधाति तं चिकित्वान् प्रतिगृह्या नि धत्ते ।
तेन प्रजां वर्धयमान आयू रायस्पोषेण सचते सुवीरः॥
verses.tr: prātā ratnaṃ prātaritvā dadhāti taṃ cikitvān pratigṛhyā ni dhatte tena prajāṃ vardhayamāna āyū rāyaspoṣeṇa sacate suvīraḥ
verses.en: Coming at early morn he gives his treasure; the prudent one receives and entertains him. Thereby increasing still his life and offspring, he comes with brave sons to abundant riches.

verses.sa:
सुगुरसत् सुहिरण्यः स्वश्वो बृहदस्मै वय इन्द्रो दधाति ।
यस्त्वायन्तं वसुना प्रातरित्वो मुक्षीजयेव पदिमुत्सिनाति॥
verses.tr: sugurasat suhiraṇyaḥ svaśvo bṛhadasmai vaya indro dadhāti yastvāyantaṃ vasunā prātaritvo mukṣījayeva padimutsināti
verses.en: Rich shall he be in gold and kine and horses. Indra bestows on him great vital power, Who stays thee, as thou comest, with his treasure, like game caught in the net, O early comer.

verses.sa:
आयमद्य सुकृतं प्रातरिच्छन्निष्टेः पुत्रं वसुमता रथेन ।
अंशोः सुतं पायय मत्सरस्य क्षयद्वीरं वर्धय सूनृताभिः॥
verses.tr: āyamadya sukṛtaṃ prātaricchanniṣṭeḥ putraṃ vasumatā rathena aṃśoḥ sutaṃ pāyaya matsarasya kṣayadvīraṃ vardhaya sūnṛtābhiḥ
verses.en: Longing, I came this morning to the pious, the son of sacrifice, with car wealth-laden. Give him to drink juice of the stalk that gladdens; prosper with pleasant hymns the Lord of Heroes.

verses.sa:
उप क्षरन्ति सिन्धवो मयोभुव ईजानं च यक्ष्यमाणं च धेनवः ।
पृणन्तं च पपुरिं च श्रवस्यवो घृतस्य धारा उप यन्ति विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: upa kṣaranti sindhavo mayobhuva ījānaṃ ca yakṣyamāṇaṃ ca dhenavaḥ pṛṇantaṃ ca papuriṃ ca śravasyavo ghṛtasya dhārā upa yanti viśvataḥ
verses.en: Health-bringing streams, as milch-cows, flow to profit him who hath worshipped, him who now will worship. To him who freely gives and fills on all sides full streams of fatness flow and make him famous.

verses.sa:
नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि तिष्ठति श्रितो यः पृणाति स ह देवेषु गच्छति ।
तस्मा आपो घृतमर्षन्ति सिन्धवस्तस्मा इयं दक्षिणा पिन्वते सदा॥
verses.tr: nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi tiṣṭhati śrito yaḥ pṛṇāti sa ha deveṣu gacchati tasmā āpo ghṛtamarṣanti sindhavastasmā iyaṃ dakṣiṇā pinvate sadā
verses.en: On the high ridge of heaven he stands exalted, yea, to the Gods he goes, the liberal giver. The streams, the waters flow for him with fatness: to him this guerdon ever yields abundance.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणावतामिदिमानि चित्रा दक्षिणावतां दिवि सूर्यासः ।
दक्षिणावन्तो अमृतं भजन्ते दक्षिणावन्तः प्र तिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāvatāmidimāni citrā dakṣiṇāvatāṃ divi sūryāsaḥ dakṣiṇāvanto amṛtaṃ bhajante dakṣiṇāvantaḥ pra tiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: For those who give rich meeds are all these splendours, for those who give rich meeds suns shine in heaven. The givers of rich meeds are made immortal; the givers of rich fees prolong their lifetime.

verses.sa:
मा पृणन्तो दुरितमेन आरन् मा जारिषुः सूरयः सुव्रतासः ।
अन्यस्तेषां परिधिरस्तु कश्चिदपृणन्तमभि सं यन्तु शोकाः॥
verses.tr: mā pṛṇanto duritamena āran mā jāriṣuḥ sūrayaḥ suvratāsaḥ anyasteṣāṃ paridhirastu kaścidapṛṇantamabhi saṃ yantu śokāḥ
verses.en: Let not the liberal sink to sin and sorrow, never decay the pious chiefs who worship! Let every man besides be their protection, and let affliction fall upon the niggard.

verses.sa:
अमन्दान् त्स्तोमान् प्र भरे मनीषा सिन्धावधि क्षियतो भाव्यस्य ।
यो मे सहस्रममिमीत सवानतूर्तो राजा श्रव इच्छमानः॥
verses.tr: amandān tstomān pra bhare manīṣā sindhāvadhi kṣiyato bhāvyasya yo me sahasramamimīta savānatūrto rājā śrava icchamānaḥ
verses.en: With wisdom I present these lively praises of Bhavya dweller on the bank of Sindhu; For he, unconquered King, desiring glory, hath furnished me a thousand sacrifices.

verses.sa:
शतं राज्ञो नाधमानस्य निष्काञ् छतमश्वान् प्रयतान् त्सद्य आदम् ।
शतं कक्षीवाँ असुरस्य गोनां दिवि श्रवोऽजरमा ततान॥
verses.tr: śataṃ rājño nādhamānasya niṣkāñ chatamaśvān prayatān tsadya ādam śataṃ kakṣīvāṃ asurasya gonāṃ divi śravo'jaramā tatāna
verses.en: A hundred necklets from the King, beseeching, a hundred gift-steeds I at once accepted; Of the lord's cows a thousand, I Kaksivan. His deathless glory hath he spread to heaven.

verses.sa:
उप मा श्यावाः स्वनयेन दत्ता वधूमन्तो दश रथासो अस्थुः ।
षष्टिः सहस्रमनु गव्यमागात् सनत् कक्षीवाँ अभिपित्वे अह्नाम्॥
verses.tr: upa mā śyāvāḥ svanayena dattā vadhūmanto daśa rathāso asthuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ sahasramanu gavyamāgāt sanat kakṣīvāṃ abhipitve ahnām
verses.en: Horses of dusky colour stood beside me, ten chariots, Svanaya's gift, with mares to draw them. Kine numbering sixty thousand followed after. Kaksivan gained them when the days were closing.

verses.sa:
चत्वारिंशद् दशरथस्य शोणाः सहस्रस्याग्रे श्रेणिं नयन्ति ।
मदच्युतः कृशनावतो अत्यान् कक्षीवन्त उदमृक्षन्त पज्राः॥
verses.tr: catvāriṃśad daśarathasya śoṇāḥ sahasrasyāgre śreṇiṃ nayanti madacyutaḥ kṛśanāvato atyān kakṣīvanta udamṛkṣanta pajrāḥ
verses.en: Forty bay horses of the ten cars' master before a thousand lead the long procession. Reeling in joy Kaksivan's sons and Pajra's have grounded the coursers decked with pearly trappings.

verses.sa:
पूर्वामनु प्रयतिमा ददे वस्त्रीन् युक्ताँ अष्टावरिधायसो गाः ।
सुबन्धवो ये विश्या इव व्रा अनस्वन्तः श्रव ऐषन्त पज्राः॥
verses.tr: pūrvāmanu prayatimā dade vastrīn yuktāṃ aṣṭāvaridhāyaso gāḥ subandhavo ye viśyā iva vrā anasvantaḥ śrava aiṣanta pajrāḥ
verses.en: An earlier gift for you have I accepted eight cows, good milkers, and three harnessed horses, Pajras, who with your wains with your great kinsman, like troops of subjects, have been fain for glory.

verses.sa:
आगधिता परिगधिता या कशीकेव जङ्गहे ।
ददाति मह्यं यादुरी याशूनां भोज्या शता॥
verses.tr: āgadhitā parigadhitā yā kaśīkeva jaṅgahe dadāti mahyaṃ yādurī yāśūnāṃ bhojyā śatā
verses.en: [Ille loquitur]. Adhaerens, arcte adhaerens, illa quae mustelae similis se abdidit, multum humorem effundens, dat mihi complexuum centum gaudia.

verses.sa:
उपोप मे परा मृश मा मे दभ्राणि मन्यथाः ।
सर्वाहमस्मि रोमशा गन्धारीणामिवाविका॥
verses.tr: upopa me parā mṛśa mā me dabhrāṇi manyathāḥ sarvāhamasmi romaśā gandhārīṇāmivāvikā
verses.en: [Ille loquitur]. Prope, prope accede; molliter me tange. Ne putes pilos corporis mei-paucos esse: tota sum villosa sicut Gandharium ovis.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसुं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् ।
य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा ।
घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु वष्टि शोचिषा ऽऽजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣā ''juhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ
verses.en: Agni I hold as herald, the munificent, the gracious, Son of Strength, who knoweth all that live, as holy Singer, knowing all, Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the holy oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः ।
परिज्मानमिव द्यां होतारं चर्षणीनाम् ।
शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः॥
verses.tr: yajiṣṭhaṃ tvā yajamānā huvema jyeṣṭhamaṅgirasāṃ vipra manmabhirviprebhiḥ śukra manmabhiḥ parijmānamiva dyāṃ hotāraṃ carṣaṇīnām śociṣkeśaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ yamimā viśaḥ prāvantu jūtaye viśaḥ
verses.en: We, sacrificing, call on thee best worshipper, the eldest of Angirases, Singer, with hymns, thee, brilliant One! with singers' hymns; Thee, wandering round as 't were the sky, who art the invoking Priest of men, Whom, Bull with hair of flame the people must observe, the people that he speed them on.

verses.sa:
स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहंतरः परशुर्न द्रुहंतरः ।
वीळु चिद् यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद् वनेव यत् स्थिरम् ।
निष्षहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते॥
verses.tr: sa hi purū cidojasā virukmatā dīdyāno bhavati druhaṃtaraḥ paraśurna druhaṃtaraḥ vīḻu cid yasya samṛtau śruvad vaneva yat sthiram niṣṣahamāṇo yamate nāyate dhanvāsahā nāyate
verses.en: He with his shining glory blazing far and wide, he verily it is who slayeth demon foes, slayeth the demons like an axe: At whose close touch things solid shake, and what is stable yields like trees. Subduing all, he keeps his ground and flinches not, from the skilled archer flinches not.

verses.sa:
दृह्ला चिदस्मा अनु दुर्यथा विदे तेजिष्ठाभिररणिभिर्दाष्ट्यवसे ऽग्नये दाष्ट्यवसे ।
प्र यः पुरूणि गाहते तक्षद् वनेव शोचिषा ।
स्थिरा चिदन्ना नि रिणात्योजसा नि स्थिराणि चिदोजसा॥
verses.tr: dṛhlā cidasmā anu duryathā vide tejiṣṭhābhiraraṇibhirdāṣṭyavase 'gnaye dāṣṭyavase pra yaḥ purūṇi gāhate takṣad vaneva śociṣā sthirā cidannā ni riṇātyojasā ni sthirāṇi cidojasā
verses.en: To him, as one who knows, even things solid yield: unrough fire-sticks heated hot he gives his gifts to aid. Men offer Agni gifts for aid. He deeply piercing many a thing hews it like wood with fervent glow. Even hard and solid food he crunches with his might, yea, hard and solid food with might.

verses.sa:
तमस्य पृक्षमुपरासु धीमहि नक्तं यः सुदर्शतरो दिवातरादप्रायुषे दिवातरात् ।
आदस्यायुर्ग्रभणवद् वीळु शर्म न सूनवे ।
भक्तमभक्तमवो व्यन्तो अजरा अग्नयो व्यन्तो अजराः॥
verses.tr: tamasya pṛkṣamuparāsu dhīmahi naktaṃ yaḥ sudarśataro divātarādaprāyuṣe divātarāt ādasyāyurgrabhaṇavad vīḻu śarma na sūnave bhaktamabhaktamavo vyanto ajarā agnayo vyanto ajarāḥ
verses.en: Here near we place the sacrificial food for him who shines forth fairer in the night than in the day, with life then stronger than by day. His life gives sure and firm defence as that one giveth to a son. The during fires enjoy things given and things not given, the during fires enjoy as food.

verses.sa:
स हि शर्धो न मारुतं तुविष्वणिरप्नस्वतीषूर्वरास्विष्टनिरार्तनास्विष्टनिः ।
आदद्धव्यान्याददिर्यज्ञस्य केतुरर्हणा ।
अध स्मास्य हर्षतो हृषीवतो विश्वे जुषन्त पन्थां नरः शुभे न पन्थाम्॥
verses.tr: sa hi śardho na mārutaṃ tuviṣvaṇirapnasvatīṣūrvarāsviṣṭanirārtanāsviṣṭaniḥ ādaddhavyānyādadiryajñasya keturarhaṇā adha smāsya harṣato hṛṣīvato viśve juṣanta panthāṃ naraḥ śubhe na panthām
verses.en: He, roaring very loudly like the Maruts' host, in fertile cultivated fields adorable, in desert spots adorable, Accepts and eats our offered gifts, ensign of sacrifice by desert; So let all, joying, love his path when he is glad, as men pursue a path for bliss.

verses.sa:
द्विता यदीं कीस्तासो अभिद्यवो नमस्यन्त उपवोचन्त भृगवो मथ्नन्तो दाशा भृगवः ।
अग्निरीशे वसूनां शुचिर्यो धर्णिरेषाम् ।
प्रियाँ अपिधीँर्वनिषीष्ट मेधिर आ वनिषीष्ट मेधिरः॥
verses.tr: dvitā yadīṃ kīstāso abhidyavo namasyanta upavocanta bhṛgavo mathnanto dāśā bhṛgavaḥ agnirīśe vasūnāṃ śuciryo dharṇireṣām priyāṃ apidhīṃrvaniṣīṣṭa medhira ā vaniṣīṣṭa medhiraḥ
verses.en: Even as they who sang forth hymns, addressed to heaven, the Bhrgus with their prayer and praise invited him, the Bhrgus rubbing, offering gifts. For radiant Agni, Lord of all these treasures, is exceeding strong. May he, the wise, accept the grateful coverings, the wise accept the coverings.

verses.sa:
विश्वासां त्वा विशां पतिं हवामहे सर्वासां समानं दम्पतिं भुजे सत्यगिर्वाहसं भुजे ।
अतिथिं मानुषाणां पितुर्न यस्यासया ।
अमी च विश्वे अमृतास आ वयो हव्या देवेष्वा वयः॥
verses.tr: viśvāsāṃ tvā viśāṃ patiṃ havāmahe sarvāsāṃ samānaṃ dampatiṃ bhuje satyagirvāhasaṃ bhuje atithiṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ piturna yasyāsayā amī ca viśve amṛtāsa ā vayo havyā deveṣvā vayaḥ
verses.en: Thee we invoke, the Lord of all our settled homes, common to all, the household's guardian, to enjoy, bearer of true hymns, to enjoy. Thee we invoke, the guest of men, by whose mouth, even as a sire's, All these Immortals come to gain their food of life, oblations come to Gods as food.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सहसा सहन्तमः शुष्मिन्तमो जायसे देवतातये रयिर्न देवतातये ।
शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः ।
अध स्मा ते परि चरन्त्यजर श्रुष्टीवानो नाजर॥
verses.tr: tvamagne sahasā sahantamaḥ śuṣmintamo jāyase devatātaye rayirna devatātaye śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ adha smā te pari carantyajara śruṣṭīvāno nājara
verses.en: Thou, Agni, most victorious with thy conquering strength, most Mighty One, art born for service of the Gods, like wealth for service of the Gods. Most mighty is thine ecstasy, most splendid is thy mental power. Therefore men wait upon thee, undecaying One, like vassals, undecaying One.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे सहसा सहस्वत उषर्बुधे पशुषे नाग्नये स्तोमो बभूत्वग्नये ।
प्रति यदीं हविष्मान् विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे ।
अग्रे रेभो न जरत ऋषूणां जूर्णिर्होत ऋषूणाम्॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe sahasā sahasvata uṣarbudhe paśuṣe nāgnaye stomo babhūtvagnaye prati yadīṃ haviṣmān viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve agre rebho na jarata ṛṣūṇāṃ jūrṇirhota ṛṣūṇām
verses.en: To him the mighty, conquering with victorious strength, to Agni walking with the dawn, who sendeth kine, be sung your laud, to Agni sung; As he who with oblation comes calls him aloud in every place. Before the brands of fire he shouteth singerlike, the herald, kindler of the brands.

verses.sa:
स नो नेदिष्ठं ददृशान आ भराग्ने देवेभिः सचनाः सुचेतुना महो रायः सुचेतुना ।
महि शविष्ठ नस्कृधि संचक्षे भुजे अस्यै ।
महि स्तोतृभ्यो मघवन् त्सुवीर्यं मथीरुग्रो न शवसा॥
verses.tr: sa no nediṣṭhaṃ dadṛśāna ā bharāgne devebhiḥ sacanāḥ sucetunā maho rāyaḥ sucetunā mahi śaviṣṭha naskṛdhi saṃcakṣe bhuje asyai mahi stotṛbhyo maghavan tsuvīryaṃ mathīrugro na śavasā
verses.en: Agni, beheld by us in nearest neighbourhood, accordant with the Gods, bring us, with gracious love, great riches with thy gracious love. Give us O Mightiest, what is great, to see and to enjoy the earth. As one of awful power, stir up heroic might for those who praise thee, Bounteous Lord!

verses.sa:
अयं जायत मनुषो धरीमणि होता यजिष्ठ उशिजामनु व्रतमग्निः स्वमनु व्रतम् ।
विश्वश्रुष्टिः सखीयते रयिरिव श्रवस्यते ।
अदब्धो होता नि षददिळस्पदे परिवीत इळस्पदे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ jāyata manuṣo dharīmaṇi hotā yajiṣṭha uśijāmanu vratamagniḥ svamanu vratam viśvaśruṣṭiḥ sakhīyate rayiriva śravasyate adabdho hotā ni ṣadadiḻaspade parivīta iḻaspade
verses.en: By Manu's law was born this Agni, Priest most skilled, born for the holy work of those who yearn therefore, yea, born for his own holy work. All ear to him who seeks his love and wealth to him who strives for fame, Priest ne'er deceived, he sits in Ila's holy place, girt round in Ila's holy place.

verses.sa:
तं यज्ञसाधमपि वातयामस्यृतस्य पथा नमसा हविष्मता देवताता हविष्मता ।
स न ऊर्जामुपाभृत्यया कृपा न जूर्यति ।
यं मातरिश्वा मनवे परावतो देवं भाः परावतः॥
verses.tr: taṃ yajñasādhamapi vātayāmasyṛtasya pathā namasā haviṣmatā devatātā haviṣmatā sa na ūrjāmupābhṛtyayā kṛpā na jūryati yaṃ mātariśvā manave parāvato devaṃ bhāḥ parāvataḥ
verses.en: We call that perfecter of worship by the path or sacrifice; with reverence rich in offerings, with worship rich in offerings. Through presentation of our food he grows not old in this his from; The God whom Matarisvan brought from far away, for Manu brought from far away.

verses.sa:
एवेन सद्यः पर्येति पार्थिवं मुहुर्गी रेतो वृषभः कनिक्रदद् दधद् रेतः कनिक्रदत् ।
शतं चक्षाणो अक्षभिर्देवो वनेषु तुर्वणिः ।
सदो दधान उपरेषु सानुष्वग्निः परेषु सानुषु॥
verses.tr: evena sadyaḥ paryeti pārthivaṃ muhurgī reto vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradad dadhad retaḥ kanikradat śataṃ cakṣāṇo akṣabhirdevo vaneṣu turvaṇiḥ sado dadhāna upareṣu sānuṣvagniḥ pareṣu sānuṣu
verses.en: In ordered course forthwith he traverses the earth, swift-swallowing, bellowing Steer, bearing the genial seed, bearing the seed and bellowing. Observant with a hundred eyes the God is conqueror in the wood: Agni, who hath his seat in broad plains here below, and in the high lands far away.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतुः पुरोहितो दमेदमे ऽग्निर्यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य चेतति क्रत्वा यज्ञस्य चेतति ।
क्रत्वा वेधा इषूयते विश्वा जातानि पस्पशे ।
यतो घृतश्रीरतिथिरजायत वह्निर्वेधा अजायत॥
verses.tr: sa sukratuḥ purohito damedame 'gniryajñasyādhvarasya cetati kratvā yajñasya cetati kratvā vedhā iṣūyate viśvā jātāni paspaśe yato ghṛtaśrīratithirajāyata vahnirvedhā ajāyata
verses.en: That Agni, wise High-Priest, in every house takes thought for sacrifice and holy service, yea, takes thought, with mental power, for sacrifice. Disposer, he with mental power shows all things unto him who strives; Whence he was born a guest enriched with holy oil, born as Ordainer and as Priest.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा यदस्य तविषीषु पृञ्चते ऽग्नेरवेण मरुतां न भोज्येषिराय न भोज्या ।
स हि ष्मा दानमिन्वति वसूनां च मज्मना ।
स नस्त्रासते दुरितादभिह्रुतः शंसादघादभिह्रुतः॥
verses.tr: kratvā yadasya taviṣīṣu pṛñcate 'gneraveṇa marutāṃ na bhojyeṣirāya na bhojyā sa hi ṣmā dānaminvati vasūnāṃ ca majmanā sa nastrāsate duritādabhihrutaḥ śaṃsādaghādabhihrutaḥ
verses.en: When through his power and in his strong prevailing flames the Maruts' gladdening boons mingle with Agni's roar, boons gladdening for the active One, Then he accelerates the gift, and by the greatness of his wealth, Shall rescue us from overwhelming misery, from curse and overwhelming woe.

verses.sa:
विश्वो विहाया अरतिर्वसुर्दधे हस्ते दक्षिणे तरणिर्न शिश्रथच्छ्रवस्यया न शिश्रथत् ।
विश्वस्मा इदिषुध्यते देवत्रा हव्यमोहिषे ।
विश्वस्मा इत् सुकृते वारमृण्वत्यग्निर्द्वारा व्यृण्वति॥
verses.tr: viśvo vihāyā aratirvasurdadhe haste dakṣiṇe taraṇirna śiśrathacchravasyayā na śiśrathat viśvasmā idiṣudhyate devatrā havyamohiṣe viśvasmā it sukṛte vāramṛṇvatyagnirdvārā vyṛṇvati
verses.en: Vast, universal, good he was made messenger; the speeder with his right hand hath not loosed his hold, through love of fame not loosed his hold. He bears oblations to the Gods for whosoever supplicates. Agni bestows a blessing on each pious man, and opens wide the doors for him.

verses.sa:
स मानुषे वृजने शंतमो हितो ३ ऽग्निर्यज्ञेषु जेन्यो न विश्पतिः प्रियो यज्ञेषु विश्पतिः ।
स हव्या मानुषाणामिळा कृतानि पत्यते ।
स नस्त्रासते वरुणस्य धूर्तेर्महो देवस्य धूर्तेः॥
verses.tr: sa mānuṣe vṛjane śaṃtamo hito 3 'gniryajñeṣu jenyo na viśpatiḥ priyo yajñeṣu viśpatiḥ sa havyā mānuṣāṇāmiḻā kṛtāni patyate sa nastrāsate varuṇasya dhūrtermaho devasya dhūrteḥ
verses.en: That Agni hath been set most kind in camp of men, in sacrifice like a Lord victorious, like a dear Lord in sacred rites. His are the oblations of mankind when offered up at Ila's place. He shall preserve us from Varuna's chastisement, yea, from the great God's chastisement.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारमीळते वसुधितिं प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं न्येरिरे हव्यवाहं न्येरिरे ।
विश्वायुं विश्ववेदसं होतारं यजतं कविम् ।
देवासो रण्वमवसे वसूयवो गीर्भी रण्वं वसूयवः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hotāramīḻate vasudhitiṃ priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ nyerire havyavāhaṃ nyerire viśvāyuṃ viśvavedasaṃ hotāraṃ yajataṃ kavim devāso raṇvamavase vasūyavo gīrbhī raṇvaṃ vasūyavaḥ
verses.en: Agni the Priest they supplicate to grant them wealth: him, dear, most thoughtful, have they made their messenger, him, offering-bearer have they made, Beloved of all, who knoweth all, the Priest, the Holy one, the Sage-- Him, Friend, for help, the Gods when they are fain for wealth, him, Friend, with hymns, when fain for wealth.

verses.sa:
यं त्वं रथमिन्द्र मेधसातये ऽपाका सन्तमिषिर प्रणयसि प्रानवद्य नयसि ।
सद्यश्चित्तमभिष्टये करो वशश्च वाजिनम् ।
सास्माकमनवद्य तूतुजान वेधसामिमां वाचं न वेधसाम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvaṃ rathamindra medhasātaye 'pākā santamiṣira praṇayasi prānavadya nayasi sadyaścittamabhiṣṭaye karo vaśaśca vājinam sāsmākamanavadya tūtujāna vedhasāmimāṃ vācaṃ na vedhasām
verses.en: The car which Indra, thou, for service of the Gods though it be far away, O swift One, bringest near, which, Blameless One, thou bringest near, Place swiftly nigh us for our help: be it thy will that it be strong. Blameless and active, hear this speech of orderers, this speech of us like orderers.

verses.sa:
स श्रुधि यः स्मा पृतनासु कासु चिद् दक्षाय्य इन्द्र भरहूतये नृभिरसि प्रतूर्तये नृभिः ।
यः शूरैः स्व १ः सनिता यो विप्रैर्वाजं तरुता ।
तमीशानास इरधन्त वाजिनं पृक्षमत्यं न वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: sa śrudhi yaḥ smā pṛtanāsu kāsu cid dakṣāyya indra bharahūtaye nṛbhirasi pratūrtaye nṛbhiḥ yaḥ śūraiḥ sva 1ḥ sanitā yo viprairvājaṃ tarutā tamīśānāsa iradhanta vājinaṃ pṛkṣamatyaṃ na vājinam
verses.en: Hear, Indra, thou whom men in every fight must call to show thy strength, for cry of battle with the men, with men of war for victory. He who with heroes wins the light, who with the singers gains the prize, Him the rich seek to gain even as a swift strong steed, even as a courser fleet and strong.

verses.sa:
दस्मो हि ष्मा वृषणं पिन्वसि त्वचं कं चिद् यावीरररुं शूर मर्त्यं परिवृणक्षि मर्त्यम् ।
इन्द्रोत तुभ्यं तद् दिवे तद् रुद्राय स्वयशसे ।
मित्राय वोचं वरुणाय सप्रथः सुमृळीकाय सप्रथः॥
verses.tr: dasmo hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇaṃ pinvasi tvacaṃ kaṃ cid yāvīrararuṃ śūra martyaṃ parivṛṇakṣi martyam indrota tubhyaṃ tad dive tad rudrāya svayaśase mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya saprathaḥ sumṛḻīkāya saprathaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Mighty, pourest forth the hide that holds the rain, thou keepest far away, Hero, the wicked man, thou shuttest out the wicked man. Indra, to thee I sing, to Dyaus, to Rudra glorious in himself, To Mitra, Varuna I sing a far-famed hymn to the kind God a far-famed hymn.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं व इन्द्रमुश्मसीष्टये सखायं विश्वायुं प्रासहं युजं वाजेषु प्रासहं युजम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्मोतये ऽवा पृत्सुषु कासु चित् ।
नहि त्वा शत्रुः स्तरतेः स्तृणोषि यं विश्वं शत्रुंः स्तृणोषि यम्॥
verses.tr: asmākaṃ va indramuśmasīṣṭaye sakhāyaṃ viśvāyuṃ prāsahaṃ yujaṃ vājeṣu prāsahaṃ yujam asmākaṃ brahmotaye 'vā pṛtsuṣu kāsu cit nahi tvā śatruḥ starateḥ stṛṇoṣi yaṃ viśvaṃ śatruṃḥ stṛṇoṣi yam
verses.en: We wish our Indra here that he may further you, the Friend, beloved of all, the very strong ally, in wars the very strong ally In all encounters strengthen thou our prayer to be a help to us. No enemy--whom thou smitest down--subdueth thee, no enemy, whom thou smitest down.

verses.sa:
नि षू नमातिमतिं कयस्य चित् तेजिष्ठाभिररणिभिर्नोतिभिरुग्राभिरुग्रोतिभिः ।
नेषि णो यथा पुराऽनेनाः शूर मन्यसे ।
विश्वानि पूरोरप पर्षि वह्निरासा वह्निर्नो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: ni ṣū namātimatiṃ kayasya cit tejiṣṭhābhiraraṇibhirnotibhirugrābhirugrotibhiḥ neṣi ṇo yathā purā'nenāḥ śūra manyase viśvāni pūrorapa parṣi vahnirāsā vahnirno accha
verses.en: Bow down the overweening pride of every foe with succour like to kindling-wood in fiercest flame, with mighty succour, Mighty One. Guide us, thou Hero, as of old, so art thou counted blameless still. Thou drivest, as a Priest, all sins of man away, as Priest, in person, seeking us.

verses.sa:
प्र तद् वोचेयं भव्यायेन्दवे हव्यो न य इषवान् मन्म रेजति रक्षोहा मन्म रेजति ।
स्वयं सो अस्मदा निदो वधैरजेत दुर्मतिम् ।
अव स्रवेदघशंसोऽवतरमव क्षुद्रमिव स्रवेत्॥
verses.tr: pra tad voceyaṃ bhavyāyendave havyo na ya iṣavān manma rejati rakṣohā manma rejati svayaṃ so asmadā nido vadhairajeta durmatim ava sravedaghaśaṃso'vataramava kṣudramiva sravet
verses.en: This may I utter to the present Soma-drop, which, meet to be invoked, with power, awakes the prayer, awakes the demon-slaying prayer. May he himself with darts of death drive far from us the scorner's hate. Far let him flee away who speaketh wickedness and vanish like a mote of dust.

verses.sa:
वनेम तद्धोत्रया चितन्त्या वनेम रयिं रयिवः सुवीर्यं रण्वं सन्तं सुवीर्यम् ।
दुर्मन्मानं सुमन्तुभिरेमिषा पृचीमहि ।
आ सत्याभिरिन्द्रं द्युम्नहूतिभिर्यजत्रं द्युम्नहूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: vanema taddhotrayā citantyā vanema rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīryaṃ raṇvaṃ santaṃ suvīryam durmanmānaṃ sumantubhiremiṣā pṛcīmahi ā satyābhirindraṃ dyumnahūtibhiryajatraṃ dyumnahūtibhiḥ
verses.en: By thoughtful invocation this may we obtain, obtain great wealth, O Wealthy One, with Hero sons, wealth that is sweet with hero sons. Him who is wroth we pacify with sacred food and eulogies, Indra the Holy with our calls inspired and true, the Holy One with calls inspired.

verses.sa:
प्रप्रा वो अस्मे स्वयशोभिरूती परिवर्ग इन्द्रो दुर्मतीनां दरीमन् दुर्मतीनाम् ।
स्वयं सा रिषयध्यै या न उपेषे अत्रैः ।
हतेमसन्न वक्षति क्षिप्ता जूर्णिर्न वक्षति॥
verses.tr: praprā vo asme svayaśobhirūtī parivarga indro durmatīnāṃ darīman durmatīnām svayaṃ sā riṣayadhyai yā na upeṣe atraiḥ hatemasanna vakṣati kṣiptā jūrṇirna vakṣati
verses.en: On, for your good and ours, come Indra with the aid of his own lordliness to drive the wicked hence, to rend the evil-hearted ones! The weapon which devouring fiends cast at us shall destroy themselves. Struck down, it shall not reach the mark; hurled forth, the fire-brand shall not strike.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र राया परीणसा याहि पथाँ अनेहसा पुरो याह्यरक्षसा ।
सचस्व नः पराक आ सचस्वास्तमीक आ ।
पाहि नो दूरादारादभिष्टिभिः सदा पाह्यभिष्टिभिः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra rāyā parīṇasā yāhi pathāṃ anehasā puro yāhyarakṣasā sacasva naḥ parāka ā sacasvāstamīka ā pāhi no dūrādārādabhiṣṭibhiḥ sadā pāhyabhiṣṭibhiḥ
verses.en: With riches in abundance, Indra, come to us, come by an unobstructed path, come by a path from demons free. Be with us when we stray afar, be with us when our home is nigh. Protect us with thy help both near and far away: protect us ever with thy help.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र राया तरूषसोग्रं चित् त्वा महिमा सक्षदवसे महे मित्रं नावसे ।
ओजिष्ठ त्रातरविता रथं कं चिदमर्त्य ।
अन्यमस्मद् रिरिषेः कं चिदद्रिवो रिरिक्षन्तं चिदद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ na indra rāyā tarūṣasograṃ cit tvā mahimā sakṣadavase mahe mitraṃ nāvase ojiṣṭha trātaravitā rathaṃ kaṃ cidamartya anyamasmad ririṣeḥ kaṃ cidadrivo ririkṣantaṃ cidadrivaḥ
verses.en: Thou art our own, O Indra, with victorious wealth: let might accompany thee, the Strong, to give us aid, like Mitra, to give mighty aid. O strongest saviour, helper thou, Immortal! of each warrior's car. Hurt thou another and not us, O Thunder-armed, one who would hurt, O Thunder-armed!

verses.sa:
पाहि न इन्द्र सुष्टुत स्रिधो ऽवयाता सदमिद् दुर्मतीनां देवः सन्दुर्मतीनाम् ।
हन्ता पापस्य रक्षसस्त्राता विप्रस्य मावतः ।
अधा हि त्वा जनिता जीजनद् वसो रक्षोहणं त्वा जीजनद् वसो॥
verses.tr: pāhi na indra suṣṭuta sridho 'vayātā sadamid durmatīnāṃ devaḥ sandurmatīnām hantā pāpasya rakṣasastrātā viprasya māvataḥ adhā hi tvā janitā jījanad vaso rakṣohaṇaṃ tvā jījanad vaso
verses.en: Save us from injury, thou who art well extolled: ever the warder-off art thou of wicked ones, even as a God, of wicked ones; Thou slayer of the evil fiend, saviour of singer such as I. Good Lord, the Father made thee slayer of the fiends, made thee, good Lord, to slay the fiends.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याह्युप नः परावतो नायमच्छा विदथानीव सत्पतिरस्तं राजेव सत्पतिः ।
हवामहे त्वा वयं प्रयस्वन्तः सुते सचा ।
पुत्रासो न पितरं वाजसातये मंहिष्ठं वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: endra yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastaṃ rājeva satpatiḥ havāmahe tvā vayaṃ prayasvantaḥ sute sacā putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye
verses.en: Come to us, Indra, from afar, conducting us even as a lord of heroes to the gatherings, home, like a King, his heroes' lord. We come with gifts of pleasant food, with juice poured forth, invoking thee, As sons invite a sire, that thou mayst get thee strength thee, bounteousest, to get thee strength.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोममिन्द्र सुवानमद्रिभिः कोशेन सिक्तमवतं न वंसगस्तातृषाणो न वंसगः ।
मदाय हर्यताय ते तुविष्टमाय धायसे ।
आ त्वा यच्छन्तु हरितो न सूर्यमहा विश्वेव सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: pibā somamindra suvānamadribhiḥ kośena siktamavataṃ na vaṃsagastātṛṣāṇo na vaṃsagaḥ madāya haryatāya te tuviṣṭamāya dhāyase ā tvā yacchantu harito na sūryamahā viśveva sūryam
verses.en: O Indra, drink the Soma juice pressed out with stones. poured from the reservoir, as an ox drinks the spring, a very thirsty bull the spring. For the sweet draught that gladdens thee, for mightiest freshening of thy strength. Let thy Bay Horses bring thee hither as the Sun, as every day they bring the Sun.

verses.sa:
अविन्दद् दिवो निहितं गुहा निधिं वेर्न गर्भं परिवीतमश्मन्यनन्ते अन्तरश्मनि ।
व्रजं वज्री गवामिव सिषासन्नङ्गिरस्तमः ।
अपावृणोदिष इन्द्रः परीवृता द्वार इषः परीवृताः॥
verses.tr: avindad divo nihitaṃ guhā nidhiṃ verna garbhaṃ parivītamaśmanyanante antaraśmani vrajaṃ vajrī gavāmiva siṣāsannaṅgirastamaḥ apāvṛṇodiṣa indraḥ parīvṛtā dvāra iṣaḥ parīvṛtāḥ
verses.en: He found the treasure brought from heaven that lay concealed, close-hidden, like the nestling of a bird, in rock, enclosed in never-ending rock. Best Angiras, bolt-armed, he strove to win, as 'twere, the stall of kine; So Indra hath disclosed the food concealed, disclosed the doors, the food that lay concealed.

verses.sa:
दादृहाणो वज्रमिन्द्रो गभस्त्योः क्षद्मेव तिग्ममसनाय सं श्यदहिहत्याय सं श्यत् ।
संविव्यान ओजसा शवोभिरिन्द्र मज्मना ।
तष्टेव वृक्षं वनिनो नि वृश्चसि परश्वेव नि वृश्चसि॥
verses.tr: dādṛhāṇo vajramindro gabhastyoḥ kṣadmeva tigmamasanāya saṃ śyadahihatyāya saṃ śyat saṃvivyāna ojasā śavobhirindra majmanā taṣṭeva vṛkṣaṃ vanino ni vṛścasi paraśveva ni vṛścasi
verses.en: Grasping his thunderbolt with both hands, Indra made its edge most keen, for hurling, like a carving-knife for Ahi's slaughter made it keen. Endued with majesty and strength, O Indra, and with lordly might, Thou crashest down the trees, as when a craftsman fells, crashest them down as with an axe.

verses.sa:
त्वं वृथा नद्य इन्द्र सर्तवे ऽच्छा समुद्रमसृजो रथाँ इव वाजयतो रथाँ इव ।
इत ऊतीरयुञ्जत समानमर्थमक्षितम् ।
धेनूरिव मनवे विश्वदोहसो जनाय विश्वदोहसः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ vṛthā nadya indra sartave 'cchā samudramasṛjo rathāṃ iva vājayato rathāṃ iva ita ūtīrayuñjata samānamarthamakṣitam dhenūriva manave viśvadohaso janāya viśvadohasaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, without effort hast let loose the floods to run their free course down, like chariots, to the sea, like chariots showing forth their strength. They, reaching hence away, have joined their strength for one eternal end, Even as the cows who poured forth every thing for man, Yea, poured forth all things for mankind.

verses.sa:
इमां ते वाचं वसूयन्त आयवो रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षिषुः सुम्नाय त्वामतक्षिषुः ।
शुम्भन्तो जेन्यं यथा वाजेषु विप्र वाजिनम् ।
अत्यमिव शवसे सातये धना विश्वा धनानि सातये॥
verses.tr: imāṃ te vācaṃ vasūyanta āyavo rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣiṣuḥ sumnāya tvāmatakṣiṣuḥ śumbhanto jenyaṃ yathā vājeṣu vipra vājinam atyamiva śavase sātaye dhanā viśvā dhanāni sātaye
verses.en: Eager for riches, men have formed for thee this song, like as a skilful craftsman fashioneth a car, so have they wrought thee to their bliss; Adorning thee, O Singer, like a generous steed for deeds of might, Yea, like a steed to show his strength and win the prize, that he may bear each prize away.

verses.sa:
भिनत् पुरो नवतिमिन्द्र पूरवे दिवोदासाय महि दाशुषे नृतो वज्रेण दाशुषे नृतो ।
अतिथिग्वाय शम्बरं गिरेरुग्रो अवाभरत् ।
महो धनानि दयमान ओजसा विश्वा धनान्योजसा॥
verses.tr: bhinat puro navatimindra pūrave divodāsāya mahi dāśuṣe nṛto vajreṇa dāśuṣe nṛto atithigvāya śambaraṃ girerugro avābharat maho dhanāni dayamāna ojasā viśvā dhanānyojasā
verses.en: For Puru thou hast shattered, Indra ninety forts, for Divodasa thy boon servant with thy bolt, O Dancer, for thy worshipper. For Atithigva he, the Strong, brought Sambara. from the mountain down, Distributing the mighty treasures with his strength, parting all treasures with his strength.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः समत्सु यजमानमार्यं प्रावद् विश्वेषु शतमूतिराजिषु स्वर्मीह्लेष्वाजिषु ।
मनवे शासदव्रतान् त्वचं कृष्णामरन्धयत् ।
दक्षन्न विश्वं ततृषाणमोषति न्यर्शसानमोषति॥
verses.tr: indraḥ samatsu yajamānamāryaṃ prāvad viśveṣu śatamūtirājiṣu svarmīhleṣvājiṣu manave śāsadavratān tvacaṃ kṛṣṇāmarandhayat dakṣanna viśvaṃ tatṛṣāṇamoṣati nyarśasānamoṣati
verses.en: Indra in battles help his Aryan worshipper, he who hath hundred helps at hand in every fray, in frays that win the light of heaven. Plaguing the lawless he gave up to Manu's seed the dusky skin; Blazing, 'twere, he burns each covetous man away, he burns, the tyrannous away.

verses.sa:
सूरश्चक्रं प्र वृहज्जात ओजसा प्रपित्वे वाचमरुणो मुषायतीशान आ मुषायति ।
उशना यत् परावतो ऽजगन्नूतये कवे ।
सुम्नानि विश्वा मनुषेव तुर्वणिरहा विश्वेव तुर्वणिः॥
verses.tr: sūraścakraṃ pra vṛhajjāta ojasā prapitve vācamaruṇo muṣāyatīśāna ā muṣāyati uśanā yat parāvato 'jagannūtaye kave sumnāni viśvā manuṣeva turvaṇirahā viśveva turvaṇiḥ
verses.en: Waxed strong in might at dawn he tore the Sun's wheel off. Bright red, he steals away their speech, the Lord of Power, their speech he steals away from them, As thou with eager speed, O Sage, hast come from far away to help, As winning for thine own all happiness of men, winning all happiness each day.

verses.sa:
स नो नव्येभिर्वृषकर्मन्नुक्थैः पुरां दर्तः पायुभिः पाहि शग्मैः ।
दिवोदासेभिरिन्द्र स्तवानो वावृधीथा अहोभिरिव द्यौः॥
verses.tr: sa no navyebhirvṛṣakarmannukthaiḥ purāṃ dartaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ divodāsebhirindra stavāno vāvṛdhīthā ahobhiriva dyauḥ
verses.en: Lauded with our new hymns, O vigorous in deed, save us with strengthening help, thou Shatterer of the Forts! Thou, Indra, praised by Divodasa's clansmen, as heaven grows great with days, shalt wax in glory.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय हि द्यौरसुरो अनम्नतेन्द्राय मही पृथिवी वरीमभिर्द्युम्नसाता वरीमभिः ।
इन्द्रं विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो दधिरे पुरः ।
इन्द्राय विश्वा सवनानि मानुषा रातानि सन्तु मानुषा॥
verses.tr: indrāya hi dyaurasuro anamnatendrāya mahī pṛthivī varīmabhirdyumnasātā varīmabhiḥ indraṃ viśve sajoṣaso devāso dadhire puraḥ indrāya viśvā savanāni mānuṣā rātāni santu mānuṣā
verses.en: To Indra Dyaus the Asura hath bowed him down, to Indra mighty Earth with wide-extending tracts, to win the light, with wide-spread tracts. All Gods of one accord have set Indra in front preeminent. For Indra all libations must be set apart, all man's libations set apart.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषु हि त्वा सवनेषु तुञ्जते समानमेकं वृषमण्यवः पृथक् स्वः सनिष्यवः पृथक् ।
तं त्वा नावं न पर्षणिं शूषस्य धुरि धीमहि ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैश्चितयन्त आयवः स्तोमेभिरिन्द्रमायवः॥
verses.tr: viśveṣu hi tvā savaneṣu tuñjate samānamekaṃ vṛṣamaṇyavaḥ pṛthak svaḥ saniṣyavaḥ pṛthak taṃ tvā nāvaṃ na parṣaṇiṃ śūṣasya dhuri dhīmahi indraṃ na yajñaiścitayanta āyavaḥ stomebhirindramāyavaḥ
verses.en: In all libations men with hero spirit urge the Universal One, each seeking several light, each fain to win the light apart. Thee, furthering like a ship, will we set to the chariot-pole of strength, As men who win with sacrifices Indra's thought, men who win Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa:
वि त्वा ततस्रे मिथुना अवस्यवो व्रजस्य साता गव्यस्य निःसृजः सक्षन्त इन्द्र निःसृजः ।
यद् गव्यन्ता द्वा जना स्व १र्यन्ता समूहसि ।
आविष्करिक्रद् वृषणं सचाभुवं वज्रमिन्द्र सचाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: vi tvā tatasre mithunā avasyavo vrajasya sātā gavyasya niḥsṛjaḥ sakṣanta indra niḥsṛjaḥ yad gavyantā dvā janā sva 1ryantā samūhasi āviṣkarikrad vṛṣaṇaṃ sacābhuvaṃ vajramindra sacābhuvam
verses.en: Couples desirous of thine aid are storming thee, pouring their presents forth to win a stall of kine, pouring gifts, Indra, seeking thee. When two men seeking spoil or heaven thou bringest face to face in war, Thou showest, Indra, then the bolt thy constant friend, the Bull that ever waits on thee.

verses.sa:
विदुष्टे अस्य वीर्यस्य पूरवः पुरो यदिन्द्र शारदीरवातिरः सासहानो अवातिरः ।
शासस्तमिन्द्र मर्त्यमयज्युं शवसस्पते ।
महीममुष्णाः पृथिवीमिमा अपो मन्दसान इमा अपः॥
verses.tr: viduṣṭe asya vīryasya pūravaḥ puro yadindra śāradīravātiraḥ sāsahāno avātiraḥ śāsastamindra martyamayajyuṃ śavasaspate mahīmamuṣṇāḥ pṛthivīmimā apo mandasāna imā apaḥ
verses.en: This thine heroic power men of old time have known, wherewith thou breakest down, Indra, autumnal forts, breakest them down with conquering might. Thou hast chastised, O Indra, Lord of Strength, the man who worships not, And made thine own this great earth and these water-floods; with joyous heart these water-floods.

verses.sa:
आदित् ते अस्य वीर्यस्य चर्किरन् मदेषु वृषन्नुशिजो यदाविथ सखीयतो यदाविथ ।
चकर्थ कारमेभ्यः पृतनासु प्रवन्तवे ।
ते अन्यामन्यां नद्यं सनिष्णत श्रवस्यन्तः सनिष्णत॥
verses.tr: ādit te asya vīryasya carkiran madeṣu vṛṣannuśijo yadāvitha sakhīyato yadāvitha cakartha kāramebhyaḥ pṛtanāsu pravantave te anyāmanyāṃ nadyaṃ saniṣṇata śravasyantaḥ saniṣṇata
verses.en: And they have bruited far this hero-might when thou, O Strong One, in thy joy helpest thy suppliants, who sought to win thee for their Friend. Their battle-cry thou madest sound victorious in the shocks of war. One stream after another have they gained from thee, eager for glory have they gained.

verses.sa:
उतो नो अस्या उषसो जुषेत ह्य १र्कस्य बोधि हविषो हवीमभिः स्वर्षाता हवीमभिः ।
यदिन्द्र हन्तवे मृधो वृषा वज्रिञ्चिकेतसि ।
आ मे अस्य वेधसो नवीयसो मन्म श्रुधि नवीयसः॥
verses.tr: uto no asyā uṣaso juṣeta hya 1rkasya bodhi haviṣo havīmabhiḥ svarṣātā havīmabhiḥ yadindra hantave mṛdho vṛṣā vajriñciketasi ā me asya vedhaso navīyaso manma śrudhi navīyasaḥ
verses.en: Also this morn may he be well inclined to us, mark at our call our offerings and our song of praise, our call that we may win the light. As thou, O Indra Thunder-armed, wilt, as the Strong One, slay the foe, Listen thou to the prayer of me a later sage, hear thou a later sage's prayer.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र वावृधानो अस्मयुरमित्रयन्तं तुविजात मर्त्यं वज्रेण शूर मर्त्यम् ।
जहि यो नो अघायति शृणुष्व सुश्रवस्तमः ।
रिष्टं न यामन्नप भूतु दुर्मतिर्विश्वाप भूतु दुर्मतिः॥
