verses.tr: tvaṃ tamindra vāvṛdhāno asmayuramitrayantaṃ tuvijāta martyaṃ vajreṇa śūra martyam jahi yo no aghāyati śṛṇuṣva suśravastamaḥ riṣṭaṃ na yāmannapa bhūtu durmatirviśvāpa bhūtu durmatiḥ
verses.en: O Indra, waxen strong and well-inclined to us, thou very mighty, slay the man that is our foe, slay the man, Hero! with thy bolt. Slay thou the man who injures us: hear thou, as readiest, to hear. Far be malignity, like mischief on the march, afar be all malignity.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं मघवन् पूर्व्ये धन इन्द्रत्वोताः सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतः ।
नेदिष्ठे अस्मिन्नहन्यधि वोचा नु सुन्वते ।
अस्मिन् यज्ञे वि चयेमा भरे कृतं वाजयन्तो भरे कृतम्॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ maghavan pūrvye dhana indratvotāḥ sāsahyāma pṛtanyato vanuyāma vanuṣyataḥ nediṣṭhe asminnahanyadhi vocā nu sunvate asmin yajñe vi cayemā bhare kṛtaṃ vājayanto bhare kṛtam
verses.en: Helped, Indra Maghavan, by thee in war of old, may we subdue in fight the men who strive with us, conquer the men who war with us. This day that now is close at hand bless him who pours the Soma juice. In this our sacrifice may we divide the spoil, showing our strength, the spoil of war.

verses.sa:
स्वर्जेषे भर आप्रस्य वक्मन्युषर्बुधः स्वस्मिन्नञ्जसि क्राणस्य स्वस्मिन्नञ्जसि ।
अहन्निन्द्रो यथा विदे शीर्ष्णाशीर्ष्णोपवाच्यः ।
अस्मत्रा ते सध्र्यक् सन्तु रातयो भद्रा भद्रस्य रातयः॥
verses.tr: svarjeṣe bhara āprasya vakmanyuṣarbudhaḥ svasminnañjasi krāṇasya svasminnañjasi ahannindro yathā vide śīrṣṇāśīrṣṇopavācyaḥ asmatrā te sadhryak santu rātayo bhadrā bhadrasya rātayaḥ
verses.en: In war which wins the light, at the free-giver's call, at due oblation of the early-rising one, oblation of the active one, Indra slew, even as we know--whom each bowed head must reverence. May all thy bounteous gifts be gathered up for us, yea, the good gifts of thee the Good.

verses.sa:
तत् तु प्रयः प्रत्नथा ते शुशुक्वनं यस्मिन् यज्ञे वारमकृण्वत क्षयमृतस्य वारसि क्षयम् ।
वि तद् वोचेरध द्विताऽन्तः पश्यन्ति रश्मिभिः ।
स घा विदे अन्विन्द्रो गवेषणो बन्धुक्षिद्भ्यो गवेषणः॥
verses.tr: tat tu prayaḥ pratnathā te śuśukvanaṃ yasmin yajñe vāramakṛṇvata kṣayamṛtasya vārasi kṣayam vi tad voceradha dvitā'ntaḥ paśyanti raśmibhiḥ sa ghā vide anvindro gaveṣaṇo bandhukṣidbhyo gaveṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: This food glows for thee as of old at sacrifice, wherein they made thee chooser of the place, for thou choosest the place of sacrifice. Speak thou and make it known to us: they see within with beams of light. Indra, indeed, is found a seeker after spoil, spoil-seeker for his own allies.

verses.sa:
नू इत्था ते पूर्वथा च प्रवाच्यं यदङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरप व्रजमिन्द्र शिक्षन्नप व्रजम् ।
ऐभ्यः समान्या दिशा ऽस्मभ्यं जेषि योत्सि च ।
सुन्वद्भ्यो रन्धया कं चिदव्रतं हृणायन्तं चिदव्रतम्॥
verses.tr: nū itthā te pūrvathā ca pravācyaṃ yadaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapa vrajamindra śikṣannapa vrajam aibhyaḥ samānyā diśā 'smabhyaṃ jeṣi yotsi ca sunvadbhyo randhayā kaṃ cidavrataṃ hṛṇāyantaṃ cidavratam
verses.en: So now must thy great deed be lauded as of old, when for the Angirases thou openedst the stall, openedst, giving aid, the stall. In the same manner for us here fight thou and be victorious: To him who pours the juice give up the lawless man, the lawless who is wroth with us.

verses.sa:
सं यज्जनान् क्रतुभिः शूर ईक्षयद्धने हिते तरुषन्त श्रवस्यवः प्र यक्षन्त श्रवस्यवः ।
तस्मा आयुः प्रजावदिद् बाधे अर्चन्त्योजसा ।
इन्द्र ओक्यं दिधिषन्त धीतयो देवाँ अच्छा न धीतयः॥
verses.tr: saṃ yajjanān kratubhiḥ śūra īkṣayaddhane hite taruṣanta śravasyavaḥ pra yakṣanta śravasyavaḥ tasmā āyuḥ prajāvadid bādhe arcantyojasā indra okyaṃ didhiṣanta dhītayo devāṃ acchā na dhītayaḥ
verses.en: When with wise plan the Hero leads the people forth, they conquer in the ordered battle, seeking fame, press, eager, onward seeking fame. To him in time of need they sing for life with offspring and with strength. Their hymns with Indra find a welcome place of rest: the hymns go forward to the Gods.

verses.sa:
युवं तमिन्द्रापर्वता पुरोयुधा यो नः पृतन्यादप तंतमिद्धतं वज्रेण तंतमिद्धतम् ।
दूरे चत्ताय च्छन्त्सद् गहनं यदिनक्षत् ।
अस्माकं शत्रून् परि शूर विश्वतो दर्मा दर्षीष्ट विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ tamindrāparvatā puroyudhā yo naḥ pṛtanyādapa taṃtamiddhataṃ vajreṇa taṃtamiddhatam dūre cattāya cchantsad gahanaṃ yadinakṣat asmākaṃ śatrūn pari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ
verses.en: Indra and Parvata, our champions in the fight, drive ye away each man who fain would war with us, drive him far from us with the bolt. Welcome to him concealed afar shall he the lair that he hath found. So may the Render rend our foes on every side, rend them, O Hero, everywhere.

verses.sa:
उभे पुनामि रोदसी ऋतेन द्रुहो दहामि सं महीरनिन्द्राः ।
अभिव्लग्य यत्र हता अमित्रा वैलस्थानं परि तृह्ला अशेरन्॥
verses.tr: ubhe punāmi rodasī ṛtena druho dahāmi saṃ mahīranindrāḥ abhivlagya yatra hatā amitrā vailasthānaṃ pari tṛhlā aśeran
verses.en: With sacrifice I purge both earth and heaven: I burn up great she-fiends who serve not Indra, Where throttled by thy hand the foes were slaughtered, and in the pit of death lay pierced and mangled.

verses.sa:
अभिव्लग्या चिदद्रिवः शीर्षा यातुमतीनाम् ।
छिन्धि वटूरिणा पदा महावटूरिणा पदा॥
verses.tr: abhivlagyā cidadrivaḥ śīrṣā yātumatīnām chindhi vaṭūriṇā padā mahāvaṭūriṇā padā
verses.en: O thou who castest forth the stones crushing the sorceresses' heads, Break them with thy wide-spreading foot, with thy wide-spreading mighty foot.

verses.sa:
अवासां मघवञ्जहि शर्धो यातुमतीनाम् ।
वैलस्थानके अर्मके महावैलस्थे अर्मके॥
verses.tr: avāsāṃ maghavañjahi śardho yātumatīnām vailasthānake armake mahāvailasthe armake
verses.en: Do thou, O Maghavan, beat off these sorceresses' daring strength. Cast them within the narrow pit. within the deep and narrow pit.

verses.sa:
यासां तिस्रः पञ्चाशतो ऽभिव्लङ्गैरपावपः ।
तत् सु ते मनायति तकत् सु ते मनायति॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ tisraḥ pañcāśato 'bhivlaṅgairapāvapaḥ tat su te manāyati takat su te manāyati
verses.en: Of whom thou hast ere now destroyed thrice-fifty with thy fierce attacks. That deed they count a glorious deed, though small to thee, a glorious deed.

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गभृष्टिमम्भृणं पिशाचिमिन्द्र सं मृण ।
सर्वं रक्षो नि बर्हय॥
verses.tr: piśaṅgabhṛṣṭimambhṛṇaṃ piśācimindra saṃ mṛṇa sarvaṃ rakṣo ni barhaya
verses.en: O Indra, crush and bray to bits the fearful fiery-weaponed fiend: Strike every demon to the ground.

verses.sa:
अवर्मह इन्द्र दादृहि श्रुधी नः शुशोच हि द्यौः क्षा न भीषाँ अद्रिवो घृणान्न भीषाँ अद्रिवः ।
शुष्मिन्तमो हि शुष्मिभिर्वधैरुग्रेभिरीयसे ।
अपूरुषघ्नो अप्रतीत शूर सत्वभिस्त्रिसप्तैः शूर सत्वभिः॥
verses.tr: avarmaha indra dādṛhi śrudhī naḥ śuśoca hi dyauḥ kṣā na bhīṣāṃ adrivo ghṛṇānna bhīṣāṃ adrivaḥ śuṣmintamo hi śuṣmibhirvadhairugrebhirīyase apūruṣaghno apratīta śūra satvabhistrisaptaiḥ śūra satvabhiḥ
verses.en: Tear down the mighty ones. O Indra, hear thou us. For heaven hath glowed like earth in fear, O Thunder-armed, as dreading fierce heat, Thunder-armed! Most Mighty mid the Mighty Ones thou speedest with strong bolts of death, Not slaying men, unconquered Hero with the brave, O Hero, with the thrice-seven brave.

verses.sa:
वनोति हि सुन्वन् क्षयं परीणसः सुन्वानो हि ष्मा यजत्यव द्विषो देवानामव द्विषः ।
सुन्वान इत् सिषासति सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः ।
सुन्वानायेन्द्रो ददात्याभुवं रयिं ददात्याभुवम्॥
verses.tr: vanoti hi sunvan kṣayaṃ parīṇasaḥ sunvāno hi ṣmā yajatyava dviṣo devānāmava dviṣaḥ sunvāna it siṣāsati sahasrā vājyavṛtaḥ sunvānāyendro dadātyābhuvaṃ rayiṃ dadātyābhuvam
verses.en: The pourer of libations gains the home of wealth, pouring his gift conciliates hostilities, yea, the hostilities of Gods. Pouring, he strives, unchecked and strong, to win him riches thousandfold. Indra gives lasting wealth to him who pours forth gifts, yea, wealth he gives that long shall last.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा जुवो रारहाणा अभि प्रयो वायो वहन्त्विह पूर्वपीतये सोमस्य पूर्वपीतये ।
ऊर्ध्वा ते अनु सूनृता मनस्तिष्ठतु जानती ।
नियुत्वता रथेना याहि दावने वायो मखस्य दावने॥
verses.tr: ā tvā juvo rārahāṇā abhi prayo vāyo vahantviha pūrvapītaye somasya pūrvapītaye ūrdhvā te anu sūnṛtā manastiṣṭhatu jānatī niyutvatā rathenā yāhi dāvane vāyo makhasya dāvane
verses.en: Vayu, let fleet-foot coursers bring thee speedily to this our feast, to drink first of the juice we pour, to the first draught of Soma juice. May our glad hymn, discerning well, uplifted, gratify thy mind. Come with thy team-drawn car, O Vayu, to the gift, come to the sacrificer's gift.

verses.sa:
मन्दन्तु त्वा मन्दिनो वायविन्दवो ऽस्मत् क्राणासः सुकृता अभिद्यवो गोभिः क्राणा अभिद्यवः ।
यद्ध क्राणा इरध्यै दक्षं सचन्त ऊतयः ।
सध्रीचीना नियुतो दावने धिय उप ब्रुवत ईं धियः॥
verses.tr: mandantu tvā mandino vāyavindavo 'smat krāṇāsaḥ sukṛtā abhidyavo gobhiḥ krāṇā abhidyavaḥ yaddha krāṇā iradhyai dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ sadhrīcīnā niyuto dāvane dhiya upa bruvata īṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: May the joy-giving drops, O Vayu gladden thee, effectual, well prepared, directed to the heavens, strong, blent with milk and seeking heaven; That aids, effectual to fulfil, may wait upon our skilful power. Associate teams come hitherward to grant our prayers: they shall address the hymns we sing.

verses.sa:
वायुर्युङ्क्ते रोहिता वायुररुणा वायू रथे अजिरा धुरि वोह्लवे वहिष्ठा धुरि वोह्लवे ।
प्र बोधया पुरंधिं जार आ ससतीमिव ।
प्र चक्षय रोदसी वासयोषसः श्रवसे वासयोषसः॥
verses.tr: vāyuryuṅkte rohitā vāyuraruṇā vāyū rathe ajirā dhuri vohlave vahiṣṭhā dhuri vohlave pra bodhayā puraṃdhiṃ jāra ā sasatīmiva pra cakṣaya rodasī vāsayoṣasaḥ śravase vāsayoṣasaḥ
verses.en: Two red steeds Vayu yokes, Vayu two purple steeds, swift-footed, to the chariot, to the pole to draw, most able, at the pole, to draw. Wake up intelligence, as when a lover wakes his sleeping love. Illumine heaven and earth, make thou the Dawns to shine, for glory make the Dawns to shine.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमुषासः शुचयः परावति भद्रा वस्त्रा तन्वते दंसु रश्मिषु चित्रा नव्येषु रश्मिषु ।
तुभ्यं धेनुः सबर्दुघा विश्वा वसूनि दोहते ।
अजनयो मरुतो वक्षणाभ्यो दिव आ वक्षणाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: tubhyamuṣāsaḥ śucayaḥ parāvati bhadrā vastrā tanvate daṃsu raśmiṣu citrā navyeṣu raśmiṣu tubhyaṃ dhenuḥ sabardughā viśvā vasūni dohate ajanayo maruto vakṣaṇābhyo diva ā vakṣaṇābhyaḥ
verses.en: For thee the radiant Dawns in the far-distant sky broaden their lovely garments forth in wondrous beams, bright-coloured in their new-born beams. For thee the nectar-yielding Cow pours all rich treasures forth as milk. The Marut host hast thou engendered from the womb, the Maruts from the womb of heaven.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं शुक्रासः शुचयस्तुरण्यवो मदेषूग्रा इषणन्त भुर्वण्यपामिषन्त भुर्वणि ।
त्वां त्सारी दसमानो भगमीट्टे तक्ववीये ।
त्वं विश्वस्माद् भुवनात् पासि धर्मणासुर्यात् पासि धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayasturaṇyavo madeṣūgrā iṣaṇanta bhurvaṇyapāmiṣanta bhurvaṇi tvāṃ tsārī dasamāno bhagamīṭṭe takvavīye tvaṃ viśvasmād bhuvanāt pāsi dharmaṇāsuryāt pāsi dharmaṇā
verses.en: For thee the pure bright quickly-flowing Soma-drops, strong in their heightening power, hasten to mix themselves, hasten to the water to be mixed. To thee the weary coward prays for luck that he may speed away. Thou by thy law protectest us from every world, yea, from the world of highest Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो वायवेषामपूर्व्यः सोमानां प्रथमः पीतिमर्हसि सुतानां पीतिमर्हसि ।
उतो विहुत्मतीनां विशां ववर्जुषीणाम् ।
विश्वा इत् ते धेनवो दुह्र आशिरं घृतं दुह्रत आशिरम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no vāyaveṣāmapūrvyaḥ somānāṃ prathamaḥ pītimarhasi sutānāṃ pītimarhasi uto vihutmatīnāṃ viśāṃ vavarjuṣīṇām viśvā it te dhenavo duhra āśiraṃ ghṛtaṃ duhrata āśiram
verses.en: Thou, Vayu, who hast none before thee, first of all hast right to drink these offerings of Soma juice, hast right to drink the juice out-poured, Yea, poured by all invoking tribes who free themselves from taint of sin, For thee all cows are milked to yield the Soma-milk, to yield the butter and the milk.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णं बर्हिरुप नो याहि वीतये सहस्रेण नियुता नियुत्वते शतिनीभिर्नियुत्वते ।
तुभ्यं हि पूर्वपीतये देवा देवाय येमिरे ।
प्र ते सुतासो मधुमन्तो अस्थिरन् मदाय क्रत्वे अस्थिरन्॥
verses.tr: stīrṇaṃ barhirupa no yāhi vītaye sahasreṇa niyutā niyutvate śatinībhirniyutvate tubhyaṃ hi pūrvapītaye devā devāya yemire pra te sutāso madhumanto asthiran madāya kratve asthiran
verses.en: Strewn is the sacred grass; come Vayu, to our feast, with team of thousands, come, Lord of the harnessed team, with hundreds, Lord of harnessed steeds! The drops divine are lifted up for thee, the God, to drink them first. The juices rich in sweets have raised them for thy joy, have raised themselves to give thee strength.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यायं सोमः परिपूतो अद्रिभिः स्पार्हा वसानः परि कोशमर्षति शुक्रा वसानो अर्षति ।
तवायं भाग आयुषु सोमो देवेषु हूयते ।
वह वायो नियुतो याह्यस्मयुर्जुषाणो याह्यस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: tubhyāyaṃ somaḥ paripūto adribhiḥ spārhā vasānaḥ pari kośamarṣati śukrā vasāno arṣati tavāyaṃ bhāga āyuṣu somo deveṣu hūyate vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyasmayurjuṣāṇo yāhyasmayuḥ
verses.en: Purified by the stones the Soma flows for thee, clothed with its lovely splendours, to the reservoir, flows clad in its refulgent light. For thee the Soma is poured forth, thy portioned share mid Gods and men. Drive thou thy horses, Vayu, come to us with love, come well-inclined and loving us.

verses.sa:
आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि वीतये वायो हव्यानि वीतये ।
तवायं भाग ऋत्वियः सरश्मिः सूर्ये सचा ।
अध्वर्युभिर्भरमाणा अयंसत वायो शुक्रा अयंसत॥
verses.tr: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye tavāyaṃ bhāga ṛtviyaḥ saraśmiḥ sūrye sacā adhvaryubhirbharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata
verses.en: Come thou with hundreds, come with thousands in thy team to this our solemn rite, to taste the sacred food, Vayu, to taste the offerings. This is thy seasonable share, that comes co-radiant with the Sun. Brought by attendant priests pure juice is offered up, Vayu, pure juice is offered up.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो नियुत्वान् वक्षदवसे ऽभि प्रयांसि सुधितानि वीतये वायो हव्यानि वीतये ।
पिबतं मध्वो अन्धसः पूर्वपेयं हि वां हितम् ।
वायवा चन्द्रेण राधसा गतमिन्द्रश्च राधसा गतम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ ratho niyutvān vakṣadavase 'bhi prayāṃsi sudhitāni vītaye vāyo havyāni vītaye pibataṃ madhvo andhasaḥ pūrvapeyaṃ hi vāṃ hitam vāyavā candreṇa rādhasā gatamindraśca rādhasā gatam
verses.en: The chariot with its team of horses bring you both, to guard us and to taste the well-appointed food, Vayu, to taste the offerings! Drink of the pleasant-flavoured juice: the first draught is assigned to you. O Vayu, with your splendid bounty come ye both, Indra, with bounty come ye both.

verses.sa:
आ वां धियो ववृत्युरध्वराँ उपेममिन्दुं मर्मृजन्त वाजिनमाशुमत्यं न वाजिनम् ।
तेषां पिबतमस्मयू आ नो गन्तमिहोत्या ।
इन्द्रवायू सुतानामद्रिभिर्युवं मदाय वाजदा युवम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ dhiyo vavṛtyuradhvarāṃ upemaminduṃ marmṛjanta vājinamāśumatyaṃ na vājinam teṣāṃ pibatamasmayū ā no gantamihotyā indravāyū sutānāmadribhiryuvaṃ madāya vājadā yuvam
verses.en: May our songs bring you hither to our solemn rites: these drops of mighty vigour have they beautified, like a swift steed of mighty strength. Drink of them well-inclined to us, come hitherward to be our help. Drink, Indra-Vayu, of these Juices pressed with stones, Strength-givers! till they gladden you.

verses.sa:
इमे वां सोमा अप्स्वा सुता इहाध्वर्युभिर्भरमाणा अयंसत वायो शुक्रा अयंसत ।
एते वामभ्यसृक्षत तिरः पवित्रमाशवः ।
युवायवोऽति रोमाण्यव्यया सोमासो अत्यव्यया॥
verses.tr: ime vāṃ somā apsvā sutā ihādhvaryubhirbharamāṇā ayaṃsata vāyo śukrā ayaṃsata ete vāmabhyasṛkṣata tiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ yuvāyavo'ti romāṇyavyayā somāso atyavyayā
verses.en: These Soma juices pressed for you in waters here, borne by attendant priests, are offered up to you: bright, Vayu, are they offered up. Swift through the strainer have they flowed, and here are shed for both of you, Soma-drops, fain for you, over the wether's fleece, Somas over the wether's fleece.

verses.sa:
अति वायो ससतो याहि शश्वतो यत्र ग्रावा वदति तत्र गच्छतं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गच्छतम् ।
वि सूनृता ददृशे रीयते घृतमा पूर्णया नियुता याथो अध्वरमिन्द्रश्च याथो अध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: ati vāyo sasato yāhi śaśvato yatra grāvā vadati tatra gacchataṃ gṛhamindraśca gacchatam vi sūnṛtā dadṛśe rīyate ghṛtamā pūrṇayā niyutā yātho adhvaramindraśca yātho adhvaram
verses.en: O Vayu, pass thou over all the slumberers, and where the press-stone rings enter ye both that house, yea, Indra, go ye both within. The joyous Maiden is beheld, the butter flows. With richly laden team come to our solemn rite, yea, Indra, come ye to the rite.

verses.sa:
अत्राह तद् वहेथे मध्व आहुतिं यमश्वत्थमुपतिष्ठन्त जायवो ऽस्मे ते सन्तु जायवः ।
साकं गावः सुवते पच्यते यवो न ते वाय उप दस्यन्ति धेनवो नाप दस्यन्ति धेनवः॥
verses.tr: atrāha tad vahethe madhva āhutiṃ yamaśvatthamupatiṣṭhanta jāyavo 'sme te santu jāyavaḥ sākaṃ gāvaḥ suvate pacyate yavo na te vāya upa dasyanti dhenavo nāpa dasyanti dhenavaḥ
verses.en: Ride hither to the offering of the pleasant juice, the holy Fig-tree which victorious priests surround: victorious be they still for us. At once the cows yield milk, the barley-meal is dressed. For thee, O Vayu, never shall the cows grow thin, never for thee shall they be dry.

verses.sa:
इमे ये ते सु वायो बाह्वोजसो ऽन्तर्नदी ते पतयन्त्युक्षणो महि व्राधन्त उक्षणः ।
धन्वञ्चिद् ये अनाशवो जीराश्चिदगिरौकसः ।
सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो दुर्नियन्तवो हस्तयोर्दुर्नियन्तवः॥
verses.tr: ime ye te su vāyo bāhvojaso 'ntarnadī te patayantyukṣaṇo mahi vrādhanta ukṣaṇaḥ dhanvañcid ye anāśavo jīrāścidagiraukasaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayo durniyantavo hastayordurniyantavaḥ
verses.en: These Bulls of thine, O Vayu with the arm of strength, who swiftly fly within the current of thy stream, the Bulls increasing in their might, Horseless, yet even through the waste swift-moving, whom no shout can stay, Hard to be checked are they, like sunbeams, in their course. hard to be checked by both the hands.

verses.sa:
प्र सु ज्येष्ठं निचिराभ्यां बृहन्नमो हव्यं मतिं भरता मृळयद्भ्यां स्वादिष्ठं मृळयद्भ्याम् ।
ता सम्राजा घृतासुती यज्ञेयज्ञ उपस्तुता ।
अथैनोः क्षत्रं न कुतश्चनाधृषे देवत्वं नू चिदाधृषे॥
verses.tr: pra su jyeṣṭhaṃ nicirābhyāṃ bṛhannamo havyaṃ matiṃ bharatā mṛḻayadbhyāṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ mṛḻayadbhyām tā samrājā ghṛtāsutī yajñeyajña upastutā athainoḥ kṣatraṃ na kutaścanādhṛṣe devatvaṃ nū cidādhṛṣe
verses.en: Bring adoration ample and most excellent, hymn, offerings, to the watchful Twain, the bountiful, your sweetest to the bounteous Ones. Sovrans adored with streams of oil and praised at every sacrifice. Their high imperial might may nowhere be assailed, ne'er may their Godhead be assailed.

verses.sa:
अदर्शि गातुरुरवे वरीयसी पन्था ऋतस्य समयंस्त रश्मिभिश्चक्षुर्भगस्य रश्मिभिः ।
द्युक्षं मित्रस्य सादनमर्यम्णो वरुणस्य च ।
अथा दधाते बृहदुक्थ्यं १ वय उपस्तुत्यं बृहद् वयः॥
verses.tr: adarśi gātururave varīyasī panthā ṛtasya samayaṃsta raśmibhiścakṣurbhagasya raśmibhiḥ dyukṣaṃ mitrasya sādanamaryamṇo varuṇasya ca athā dadhāte bṛhadukthyaṃ 1 vaya upastutyaṃ bṛhad vayaḥ
verses.en: For the broad Sun was seen a path more widely laid, the path of holy law hath been maintained with rays, the eye with Bhaga's rays of light. Firm-set in heaven is Mitra's home, and Aryaman's and Varuna's. Thence they give forth great vital strength which merits praise, high power of life that men shall praise.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिष्मतीमदितिं धारयत्क्षितिं स्वर्वतीमा सचेते दिवेदिवे जागृवांसा दिवेदिवे ।
ज्योतिष्मत् क्षत्रमाशाते आदित्या दानुनस्पती ।
मित्रस्तयोर्वरुणो यातयज्जनो ऽर्यमा यातयज्जनः॥
verses.tr: jyotiṣmatīmaditiṃ dhārayatkṣitiṃ svarvatīmā sacete divedive jāgṛvāṃsā divedive jyotiṣmat kṣatramāśāte ādityā dānunaspatī mitrastayorvaruṇo yātayajjano 'ryamā yātayajjanaḥ
verses.en: With Aditi the luminous, the celestial, upholder of the people, come ye day by day, ye who watch sleepless, day by day. Resplendent might have ye obtained, Adityas, Lords of liberal gifts. Movers of men, mild both, are Mitra, Varuna, mover of men is Aryaman.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः सोमो भूत्ववपानेष्वाभगो देवो देवेष्वाभगः ।
तं देवासो जुषेरत विश्वे अद्य सजोषसः ।
तथा राजाना करथो यदीमह ऋतावाना यदीमहे ॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya śaṃtamaḥ somo bhūtvavapāneṣvābhago devo deveṣvābhagaḥ taṃ devāso juṣerata viśve adya sajoṣasaḥ tathā rājānā karatho yadīmaha ṛtāvānā yadīmahe
verses.en: This Soma be most sweet to Mitra, Varuna: he in the drinking-feasts, shall have a share thereof, sharing, a God, among the Gods. May all the Gods of one accord accept it joyfully to-day. Therefore do ye, O Kings, accomplish what we ask, ye Righteous Ones, whate'er we ask.

verses.sa:
यो मित्राय वरुणायाविधज्जनोऽनर्वाणं तं परि पातो अंहसो दाश्वांसं मर्तमंहसः ।
तमर्यमाभि रक्षत्यृजूयन्तमनु व्रतम् ।
उक्थैर्य एनोः परिभूषति व्रतं स्तोमैराभूषति व्रतम्॥
verses.tr: yo mitrāya varuṇāyāvidhajjano'narvāṇaṃ taṃ pari pāto aṃhaso dāśvāṃsaṃ martamaṃhasaḥ tamaryamābhi rakṣatyṛjūyantamanu vratam ukthairya enoḥ paribhūṣati vrataṃ stomairābhūṣati vratam
verses.en: Whoso, with worship serves Mitra and Varuna, him guard ye carefully, uninjured, from distress, guard from distress the liberal man. Aryaman guards him well who acts uprightly following his law, Who beautifies their service with his lauds, who makes it beautiful with songs of praise.

verses.sa:
नमो दिवे बृहते रोदसीभ्यां मित्राय वोचं वरुणाय मीह्लुषे सुमृळीकाय मीह्लुषे ।
इन्द्रमग्निमुप स्तुहि द्युक्षमर्यमणं भगम् ।
ज्योग्जीवन्तः प्रजया सचेमहि सोमस्योती सचेमहि॥
verses.tr: namo dive bṛhate rodasībhyāṃ mitrāya vocaṃ varuṇāya mīhluṣe sumṛḻīkāya mīhluṣe indramagnimupa stuhi dyukṣamaryamaṇaṃ bhagam jyogjīvantaḥ prajayā sacemahi somasyotī sacemahi
verses.en: Worship will I profess to lofty Dyaus, to Heaven and Earth, to Mitra and to bounteous Varuna, the Bounteous, the Compassionate. Praise Indra, praise thou Agni, praise Bhaga and heavenly Aryaman. Long may we live and have attendant progeny, have progeny with Soma's help.

verses.sa:
ऊती देवानां वयमिन्द्रवन्तो मंसीमहि स्वयशसो मरुद्भिः ।
अग्निर्मित्रो वरुणः शर्म यंसन् तदश्याम मघवानो वयं च॥
verses.tr: ūtī devānāṃ vayamindravanto maṃsīmahi svayaśaso marudbhiḥ agnirmitro varuṇaḥ śarma yaṃsan tadaśyāma maghavāno vayaṃ ca
verses.en: With the Gods' help, with Indra still beside us, may we be held self-splendid with the Maruts. May Agni, Mitra, Varuna give us shelter this may we gain, we and our wealthy princes.

verses.sa:
सुषुमा यातमद्रिभिर्गोश्रीता मत्सरा इमे सोमासो मत्सरा इमे ।
आ राजाना दिविस्पृशा ऽस्मत्रा गन्तमुप नः ।
इमे वां मित्रावरुणा गवाशिरः सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः॥
verses.tr: suṣumā yātamadribhirgośrītā matsarā ime somāso matsarā ime ā rājānā divispṛśā 'smatrā gantamupa naḥ ime vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā gavāśiraḥ somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ
verses.en: With stones have we pressed out: O come; these gladdening drops are blent with milk, these Soma-drops which gladden you. Come to us, Kings who reach to heaven, approach us, coming hitherward. These milky drops are yours, Mitra and Varuna, bright Soma juices blent with milk.

verses.sa:
इम आ यातमिन्दवः सोमासो दध्याशिरः सुतासो दध्याशिरः ।
उत वामुषसो बुधि साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ।
सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय पीतये चारुर्ऋताय पीतये॥
verses.tr: ima ā yātamindavaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ sutāso dadhyāśiraḥ uta vāmuṣaso budhi sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ suto mitrāya varuṇāya pītaye cārurṛtāya pītaye
verses.en: Here are the droppings; come ye nigh the Soma-droppings blent with curd, juices expressed and blent with curd. Now for the wakening of your Dawn together with the Sun-God's rays, juice waits for Mitra and for Varuna to drink, fair juice for drink, for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तां वां धेनुं न वासरीमंशुं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः सोमं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः ।
अस्मत्रा गन्तमुप नोऽर्वाञ्चा सोमपीतये ।
अयं वां मित्रावरुणा नृभिः सुतः सोम आ पीतये सुतः॥
verses.tr: tāṃ vāṃ dhenuṃ na vāsarīmaṃśuṃ duhantyadribhiḥ somaṃ duhantyadribhiḥ asmatrā gantamupa no'rvāñcā somapītaye ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ soma ā pītaye sutaḥ
verses.en: As 'twere a radiant-coloured cow, they milk with stones the stalk for you, with stones they milk the Soma-plant. May ye come nigh us, may ye turn hither to drink the Soma juice. The men pressed out this juice, Mitra and Varuna, pressed out this Soma for your drink.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र पूष्णस्तुविजातस्य शस्यते महित्वमस्य तवसो न तन्दते स्तोत्रमस्य न तन्दते ।
अर्चामि सुम्नयन्नहमन्त्यूतिं मयोभुवम् ।
विश्वस्य यो मन आयुयुवे मखो देव आयुयुवे मखः॥
verses.tr: prapra pūṣṇastuvijātasya śasyate mahitvamasya tavaso na tandate stotramasya na tandate arcāmi sumnayannahamantyūtiṃ mayobhuvam viśvasya yo mana āyuyuve makho deva āyuyuve makhaḥ
verses.en: Strong Pusan's majesty is lauded evermore, the glory of his lordly might is never faint, his song of praise is never faint. Seeking felicity I laud him nigh to help, the source, of bliss, Who, Vigorous one, hath drawn to him the hearts of all, drawn them, the Vigorous One, the God.

verses.sa:
प्र हि त्वा पूषन्नजिरं न यामनि स्तोमेभिः कृण्व ऋणवो यथा मृध उष्ट्रो न पीपरो मृधः ।
हुवे यत् त्वा मयोभुवं देवं सख्याय मर्त्यः ।
अस्माकमाङ्गूषान् द्युम्निनस्कृधि वाजेषु द्युम्निनस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: pra hi tvā pūṣannajiraṃ na yāmani stomebhiḥ kṛṇva ṛṇavo yathā mṛdha uṣṭro na pīparo mṛdhaḥ huve yat tvā mayobhuvaṃ devaṃ sakhyāya martyaḥ asmākamāṅgūṣān dyumninaskṛdhi vājeṣu dyumninaskṛdhi
verses.en: Thee, then, O Pusan, like a swift one on his way, I urge with lauds that thou mayst make the foemen flee, drive, camel-like, our foes afar. As I, a man, call thee, a God, giver of bliss, to be my Friend, So make our loudly-chanted praises glorious, in battles make them glorious.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते पूषन् त्सख्ये विपन्यवः क्रत्वा चित् सन्तोऽवसा बुभुज्रिर इति क्रत्वा बुभुज्रिरे ।
तामनु त्वा नवीयसीं नियुतं राय ईमहे ।
अहेळमान उरुशंस सरी भव वाजेवाजे सरी भव॥
verses.tr: yasya te pūṣan tsakhye vipanyavaḥ kratvā cit santo'vasā bubhujrira iti kratvā bubhujrire tāmanu tvā navīyasīṃ niyutaṃ rāya īmahe aheḻamāna uruśaṃsa sarī bhava vājevāje sarī bhava
verses.en: Thou, Pusan, in whose friendship they who sing forth praise enjoy advantage, even in wisdom, through thy grace, in wisdom even they are advanced. So, after this most recent course, we come to thee with prayers for wealth. Not stirred to anger, O Wide-Ruler, come to us, come thou to us in every fight.

verses.sa:
अस्या ऊ षु ण उप सातये भुवो ऽहेळमानो ररिवाँ अजाश्व श्रवस्यतामजाश्व ।
ओ षु त्वा ववृतीमहि स्तोमेभिर्दस्म साधुभिः ।
नहि त्वा पूषन्नतिमन्य आघृणे न ते सख्यमपह्नुवे॥
verses.tr: asyā ū ṣu ṇa upa sātaye bhuvo 'heḻamāno rarivāṃ ajāśva śravasyatāmajāśva o ṣu tvā vavṛtīmahi stomebhirdasma sādhubhiḥ nahi tvā pūṣannatimanya āghṛṇe na te sakhyamapahnuve
verses.en: Not stirred to anger, come, Free-giver, nigh to us, to take this gift of ours, thou who hast goats for steeds, Goat-borne! their gift who long for fame. So, Wonder-Worker! may we turn thee hither with effectual lauds. I slight thee not, O Pusan, thou Resplendent One: thy friendship may not be despised.

verses.sa:
अस्तु श्रौषट् पुरो अग्निं धिया दध आ नु तच्छर्धो दिव्यं वृणीमह इन्द्रवायू वृणीमहे ।
यद्ध क्राणा विवस्वति नाभा संदायि नव्यसी ।
अध प्र सू न उप यन्तु धीतयो देवाँ अच्छा न धीतयः॥
verses.tr: astu śrauṣaṭ puro agniṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe yaddha krāṇā vivasvati nābhā saṃdāyi navyasī adha pra sū na upa yantu dhītayo devāṃ acchā na dhītayaḥ
verses.en: Heard be our prayer! In thought I honour Agni first: now straightway we elect this heavenly company, Indra and Vayu we elect. For when our latest thought is raised and on Vivasvan centred well, Then may our holy songs go forward on their way, our songs as 'twere unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
यद्ध त्यन्मित्रावरुणावृतादध्याददाथे अनृतं स्वेन मन्युना दक्षस्य स्वेन मन्युना ।
युवोरित्थाधि सद्मस्वपश्याम हिरण्ययम् ।
धीभिश्चन मनसा स्वेभिरक्षभिः सोमस्य स्वेभिरक्षभिः॥
verses.tr: yaddha tyanmitrāvaruṇāvṛtādadhyādadāthe anṛtaṃ svena manyunā dakṣasya svena manyunā yuvoritthādhi sadmasvapaśyāma hiraṇyayam dhībhiścana manasā svebhirakṣabhiḥ somasya svebhirakṣabhiḥ
verses.en: As there ye, Mitra, Varuna, above the true have taken to yourselves the untrue with your mind, with wisdom's mental energy, So in the seats wherein ye dwell have we beheld the Golden One, Not with our thoughts or spirit, but with these our eyes, yea, with the eyes that Soma gives.

verses.sa:
युवां स्तोमेभिर्देवयन्तो अश्विना ऽऽश्रावयन्त इव श्लोकमायवो युवां हव्याभ्या ३ यवः ।
युवोर्विश्वा अधि श्रियः पृक्षश्च विश्ववेदसा ।
प्रुषायन्ते वां पवयो हिरण्यये रथे दस्रा हिरण्यये॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ stomebhirdevayanto aśvinā ''śrāvayanta iva ślokamāyavo yuvāṃ havyābhyā 3 yavaḥ yuvorviśvā adhi śriyaḥ pṛkṣaśca viśvavedasā pruṣāyante vāṃ pavayo hiraṇyaye rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye
verses.en: Asvins, the pious call you with their hymns of praise, sounding their loud song forth to you, these living men, to their oblations, living men. All glories and all nourishment, Lords of all wealth! depend on you. The fellies of your golden chariot scatter drops, Mighty Ones! of your golden car.

verses.sa:
अचेति दस्रा व्यु १ नाकमृण्वथो युञ्जते वां रथयुजो दिविष्टिष्वध्वस्मानो दिविष्टिषु ।
अधि वां स्थाम वन्धुरे रथे दस्रा हिरण्यये ।
पथेव यन्तावनुशासता रजो ऽञ्जसा शासता रजः॥
verses.tr: aceti dasrā vyu 1 nākamṛṇvatho yuñjate vāṃ rathayujo diviṣṭiṣvadhvasmāno diviṣṭiṣu adhi vāṃ sthāma vandhure rathe dasrā hiraṇyaye patheva yantāvanuśāsatā rajo 'ñjasā śāsatā rajaḥ
verses.en: Well is it known, O Mighty Ones: ye open heaven; for you the chariot-steeds are yoked for morning rites, unswerving steeds for morning rites, We set you on the chariot-seat, ye Mighty, on the golden car. Ye seek mid-air as by a path that leads aright, as by a path that leads direct.

verses.sa:
शचीभिर्नः शचीवसू दिवा नक्तं दशस्यतम् ।
मा वां रातिरुप दसत् कदा चनास्मद्रातिः कदा चन॥
verses.tr: śacībhirnaḥ śacīvasū divā naktaṃ daśasyatam mā vāṃ rātirupa dasat kadā canāsmadrātiḥ kadā cana
verses.en: O Rich in Strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night. The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail, gifts brought by us shall never fail.

verses.sa:
वृषन्निन्द्र वृषपाणास इन्दव इमे सुता अद्रिषुतास उद्भिदस्तुभ्यं सुतास उद्भिदः ।
ते त्वा मन्दन्तु दावने महे चित्राय राधसे ।
गीर्भिर्गिर्वाहः स्तवमान आ गहि सुमृळीको न आ गहि॥
verses.tr: vṛṣannindra vṛṣapāṇāsa indava ime sutā adriṣutāsa udbhidastubhyaṃ sutāsa udbhidaḥ te tvā mandantu dāvane mahe citrāya rādhase gīrbhirgirvāhaḥ stavamāna ā gahi sumṛḻīko na ā gahi
verses.en: These Soma-drops, strong Indra! drink for heroes, poured, pressed out by pressing-stones, are welling forth for thee, for thee the drops are welling forth. They shall make glad thy heart to give, to give wealth great and wonderful. Thou who acceptest praise come glorified by hymns, come thou to us benevolent.

verses.sa:
ओ षू णो अग्ने शृणुहि त्वमीळितो देवेभ्यो ब्रवसि यज्ञियेभ्यो राजभ्यो यज्ञियेभ्यः ।
यद्ध त्यामङ्गिरोभ्यो धेनुं देवा अदत्तन ।
वि तां दुह्रे अर्यमा कर्तरी सचाँ एष तां वेद मे सचा ॥
verses.tr: o ṣū ṇo agne śṛṇuhi tvamīḻito devebhyo bravasi yajñiyebhyo rājabhyo yajñiyebhyaḥ yaddha tyāmaṅgirobhyo dhenuṃ devā adattana vi tāṃ duhre aryamā kartarī sacāṃ eṣa tāṃ veda me sacā
verses.en: Quickly, O Agni, hear us: magnified by us thou shalt speck for us to the Gods adorable yea, to the Kings adorable: When, O ye Deities, ye gave that Milch-cow to the Angirases, They milked her: Aryaman, joined with them, did the work: he knoweth her as well as I.

verses.sa:
मो षु वो अस्मदभि तानि पौंस्या सना भूवन्द्युम्नानि मोत जारिषुरस्मत् पुरोत जारिषुः ।
यद् वश्चित्रं युगेयुगे नव्यं घोषादमर्त्यम् ।
अस्मासु तन्मरुतो यच्च दुष्टरं दिधृता यच्च दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu vo asmadabhi tāni pauṃsyā sanā bhūvandyumnāni mota jāriṣurasmat purota jāriṣuḥ yad vaścitraṃ yugeyuge navyaṃ ghoṣādamartyam asmāsu tanmaruto yacca duṣṭaraṃ didhṛtā yacca duṣṭaram
verses.en: Ne'er may these manly deeds of yours for us grow old, never may your bright glories fall into decay, never before our time decay. What deed of yours, new every age, wondrous, surpassing man, rings forth, Whatever, Maruts! may be difficult to gain, grant us, whate'er is hard to gain.

verses.sa:
दध्यङ् ह मे जनुषं पूर्वो अङ्गिराः प्रियमेधः कण्वो अत्रिर्मनुर्विदुस्ते मे पूर्वे मनुर्विदुः ।
तेषां देवेष्वायतिरस्माकं तेषु नाभयः ।
तेषां पदेन मह्या नमे गिरेन्द्राग्नी आ नमे गिरा॥
verses.tr: dadhyaṅ ha me januṣaṃ pūrvo aṅgirāḥ priyamedhaḥ kaṇvo atrirmanurviduste me pūrve manurviduḥ teṣāṃ deveṣvāyatirasmākaṃ teṣu nābhayaḥ teṣāṃ padena mahyā name girendrāgnī ā name girā
verses.en: Dadhyac of old, Angiras, Priyamedha these, and Kanva, Atri, Manu knew my birth, yea, those of ancient days and Manu knew. Their long line stretcheth to the Gods, our birth-connexions are with them. To these, for their high station, I bow down with song, to Indra, Agni, bow with song.

verses.sa:
होता यक्षद् वनिनो वन्त वार्यं बृहस्पतिर्यजति वेन उक्षभिः पुरुवारेभिरुक्षभिः ।
जगृभ्मा दूरआदिशं श्लोकमद्रेरध त्मना ।
अधारयदररिन्दानि सुक्रतुः पुरू सद्मानि सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣad vanino vanta vāryaṃ bṛhaspatiryajati vena ukṣabhiḥ puruvārebhirukṣabhiḥ jagṛbhmā dūraādiśaṃ ślokamadreradha tmanā adhārayadararindāni sukratuḥ purū sadmāni sukratuḥ
verses.en: Let the Invoker bless: let offerers bring choice gifts; Brhaspati the Friend doth sacrifice with Steers, Steers that have many an excellence. Now with our ears we catch the sound of the press-stone that rings afar. The very Strong hath gained the waters by himself, the strong gained many a resting-place.

verses.sa:
ये देवासो दिव्येकादश स्थ पृथिव्यामध्येकादश स्थ ।
अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश स्थ ते देवासो यज्ञमिमं जुषध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ye devāso divyekādaśa stha pṛthivyāmadhyekādaśa stha apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣadhvam
verses.en: O ye Eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye Eleven who make earth your dwelling, Ye who with might, Eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, O Gods, with pleasure.

verses.sa:
वेदिषदे प्रियधामाय सुद्युते धासिमिव प्र भरा योनिमग्नये ।
वस्त्रेणेव वासया मन्मना शुचिं ज्योतीरथं शुक्रवर्णं तमोहनम्॥
verses.tr: vediṣade priyadhāmāya sudyute dhāsimiva pra bharā yonimagnaye vastreṇeva vāsayā manmanā śuciṃ jyotīrathaṃ śukravarṇaṃ tamohanam
verses.en: To splendid Agni seated by the altar, loving well his home, I bring the food as 'twere his place of birth. I clothe the bright One with my hymn as with a robe, him with the car of light, bright-hued, dispelling gloom.

verses.sa:
अभि द्विजन्मा त्रिवृदन्नमृज्यते संवत्सरे वावृधे जग्धमी पुनः ।
अन्यस्यासा जिह्वया जेन्यो वृषा न्य १न्येन वनिनो मृष्ट वारणः॥
verses.tr: abhi dvijanmā trivṛdannamṛjyate saṃvatsare vāvṛdhe jagdhamī punaḥ anyasyāsā jihvayā jenyo vṛṣā nya 1nyena vanino mṛṣṭa vāraṇaḥ
verses.en: Child of a double birth he grasps at triple food; in the year's course what he hath swallowed grows anew. He, by another's mouth and tongue a noble Bull, with other, as an elephant, consumes the trees.

verses.sa:
कृष्णप्रुतौ वेविजे अस्य सक्षिता उभा तरेते अभि मातरा शिशुम् ।
प्राचाजिह्वं ध्वसयन्तं तृषुच्युतमा साच्यं कुपयं वर्धनं पितुः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaprutau vevije asya sakṣitā ubhā tarete abhi mātarā śiśum prācājihvaṃ dhvasayantaṃ tṛṣucyutamā sācyaṃ kupayaṃ vardhanaṃ pituḥ
verses.en: The pair who dwell together, moving in the dark bestir themselves: both parents hasten to the babe, Impetuous-tongued, destroying, springing swiftly forth, one to be watched and cherished, strengthener of his sire.

verses.sa:
मुमुक्ष्वो ३ मनवे मानवस्यते रघुद्रुवः कृष्णसीतास ऊ जुवः ।
असमना अजिरासो रघुष्यदो वातजूता उप युज्यन्त आशवः॥
verses.tr: mumukṣvo 3 manave mānavasyate raghudruvaḥ kṛṣṇasītāsa ū juvaḥ asamanā ajirāso raghuṣyado vātajūtā upa yujyanta āśavaḥ
verses.en: For man, thou Friend of men, these steeds of thine are yoked, impatient, lightly running, ploughing blackened lines, Discordant-minded, fleet, gliding with easy speed, urged onward by the wind and rapid in their course.

verses.sa:
आदस्य ते ध्वसयन्तो वृथेरते कृष्णमभ्वं महि वर्पः करिक्रतः ।
यत्सीं महीमवनिं प्राभि मर्मृशदभिश्वसन् त्स्तनयन्नेति नानदत्॥
verses.tr: ādasya te dhvasayanto vṛtherate kṛṣṇamabhvaṃ mahi varpaḥ karikrataḥ yatsīṃ mahīmavaniṃ prābhi marmṛśadabhiśvasan tstanayanneti nānadat
verses.en: Dispelling on their way the horror of black gloom, making a glorious show these flames of his fly forth, When o'er the spacious tract he spreads himself abroad, and rushes panting on with thunder and with roar.

verses.sa:
भूषन् न योऽधि बभ्रूषु नम्नते वृषेव पत्नीरभ्येति रोरुवत् ।
ओजायमानस्तन्वश्च शुम्भते भीमो न शृङ्गा दविधाव दुर्गृभिः॥
verses.tr: bhūṣan na yo'dhi babhrūṣu namnate vṛṣeva patnīrabhyeti roruvat ojāyamānastanvaśca śumbhate bhīmo na śṛṅgā davidhāva durgṛbhiḥ
verses.en: Amid brown plants he stoops as if adorning them, and rushes bellowing like a bull upon his wives. Proving his might, he decks the glory of his form, and shakes his horns like one terrific, hard to stay.

verses.sa:
स संस्तिरो विष्टिरः सं गृभायति जानन्नेव जानतीर्नित्य आ शये ।
पुनर्वर्धन्ते अपि यन्ति देव्यमन्यद् वर्पः पित्रोः कृण्वते सचा॥
verses.tr: sa saṃstiro viṣṭiraḥ saṃ gṛbhāyati jānanneva jānatīrnitya ā śaye punarvardhante api yanti devyamanyad varpaḥ pitroḥ kṛṇvate sacā
verses.en: Now covered, now displayed he grasps as one who knows his resting-place in those who know him well. A second time they wax and gather Godlike power, and blending both together change their Parents' form.

verses.sa:
तमग्रुवः केशिनीः सं हि रेभिर ऊर्ध्वास्तस्थुर्मम्रुषीः प्रायवे पुनः ।
तासां जरां प्रमुञ्चन्नेति नानददसुं परं जनयञ्जीवमस्तृतम्॥
verses.tr: tamagruvaḥ keśinīḥ saṃ hi rebhira ūrdhvāstasthurmamruṣīḥ prāyave punaḥ tāsāṃ jarāṃ pramuñcanneti nānadadasuṃ paraṃ janayañjīvamastṛtam
verses.en: The maidens with long, tresses hold him in embrace; dead, they rise up again to meet the Living One. Releasing them from age with a loud roar he comes, filling them with new spirit, living, unsubdued.

verses.sa:
अधीवासं परि मातू रिहन्नह तुविग्रेभिः सत्वभिर्याति वि ज्रयः ।
वयो दधत् पद्वते रेरिहत् सदाऽनु श्येनी सचते वर्तनीरह॥
verses.tr: adhīvāsaṃ pari mātū rihannaha tuvigrebhiḥ satvabhiryāti vi jrayaḥ vayo dadhat padvate rerihat sadā'nu śyenī sacate vartanīraha
verses.en: Licking the mantle of the Mother, far and wide he wanders over fields with beasts that flee apace. Strengthening all that walk, licking up all around, a blackened path, forsooth, he leaves where'er he goes.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमग्ने मघवत्सु दीदिह्यध श्वसीवान् वृषभो दमूनाः ।
अवास्या शिशुमतीरदीदेर्वर्मेव युत्सु परिजर्भुराणः॥
verses.tr: asmākamagne maghavatsu dīdihyadha śvasīvān vṛṣabho damūnāḥ avāsyā śiśumatīradīdervarmeva yutsu parijarbhurāṇaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, shine resplendent with our wealthy chiefs, like a loud-snorting bull, accustomed to the house. Thou casting off thine infant wrappings blazest forth as though thou hadst put on a coat of mail for war.

verses.sa:
इदमग्ने सुधितं दुर्धितादधि प्रियादु चिन्मन्मनः प्रेयो अस्तु ते ।
यत्ते शुक्रं तन्वो ३ रोचते शुचि तेनास्मभ्यं वनसे रत्नमा त्वम्॥
verses.tr: idamagne sudhitaṃ durdhitādadhi priyādu cinmanmanaḥ preyo astu te yatte śukraṃ tanvo 3 rocate śuci tenāsmabhyaṃ vanase ratnamā tvam
verses.en: May this our perfect prayer be dearer unto thee than an imperfect prayer although it please thee well. With the pure brilliancy that radiates from thy form, mayest thou grant to us abundant store of wealth.

verses.sa:
रथाय नावमुत नो गृहाय नित्यारित्रां पद्वतीं रास्यग्ने ।
अस्माकं वीराँ उत नो मघोनो जनाँश्च या पारयाच्छर्म या च॥
verses.tr: rathāya nāvamuta no gṛhāya nityāritrāṃ padvatīṃ rāsyagne asmākaṃ vīrāṃ uta no maghono janāṃśca yā pārayāccharma yā ca
verses.en: Grant to our chariot, to our house, O Agni, a boat with moving feet and constant oarage, One that may further well our wealthy princes and all the folk, and be our certain refuge.

verses.sa:
अभी नो अग्न उक्थमिज्जुगुर्या द्यावाक्षामा सिन्धवश्च स्वगूर्ताः ।
गव्यं यव्यं यन्तो दीर्घाहेषं वरमरुण्यो वरन्त॥
verses.tr: abhī no agna ukthamijjuguryā dyāvākṣāmā sindhavaśca svagūrtāḥ gavyaṃ yavyaṃ yanto dīrghāheṣaṃ varamaruṇyo varanta
verses.en: Welcome our laud with thine approval, Agni. May earth and heaven and freely flowing rivers Yield us long life and food and corn and cattle, and may the red Dawns choose for us their choicest.

verses.sa:
बळित्था तद् वपुषे धायि दर्शतं देवस्य भर्गः सहसो यतो जनि ।
यदीमुप ह्वरते साधते मतिर्ऋतस्य धेना अनयन्त सस्रुतः॥
verses.tr: baḻitthā tad vapuṣe dhāyi darśataṃ devasya bhargaḥ sahaso yato jani yadīmupa hvarate sādhate matirṛtasya dhenā anayanta sasrutaḥ
verses.en: Yea, verily, the fair effulgence of the God for glory was established, since he sprang from strength. When he inclines thereto successful is the hymn: the songs of sacrifice have brought him as they flow

verses.sa:
पृक्षो वपुः पितुमान् नित्य आ शये द्वितीयमा सप्तशिवासु मातृषु ।
तृतीयमस्य वृषभस्य दोहसे दशप्रमतिं जनयन्त योषणः॥
verses.tr: pṛkṣo vapuḥ pitumān nitya ā śaye dvitīyamā saptaśivāsu mātṛṣu tṛtīyamasya vṛṣabhasya dohase daśapramatiṃ janayanta yoṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Wonderful, rich in nourishment, he dwells in food; next, in the seven auspicious Mothers is his home. Thirdly, that they might drain the treasures of the Bull, the maidens brought forth him for whom the ten provide.

verses.sa:
निर्यदीं बुध्नान्महिषस्य वर्पस ईशानासः शवसा क्रन्त सूरयः ।
यदीमनु प्रदिवो मध्व आधवे गुहा सन्तं मातरिश्वा मथायति॥
verses.tr: niryadīṃ budhnānmahiṣasya varpasa īśānāsaḥ śavasā kranta sūrayaḥ yadīmanu pradivo madhva ādhave guhā santaṃ mātariśvā mathāyati
verses.en: What time from out the deep, from the Steer's wondrous form, the Chiefs who had the power produced him with their strength; When Matarisvan rubbed forth him who lay concealed, for mixture of the sweet drink, in the days of old.

verses.sa:
प्र यत् पितुः परमान्नीयते पर्या पृक्षुधो वीरुधो दंसु रोहति ।
उभा यदस्य जनुषं यदिन्वत आदिद् यविष्ठो अभवद् घृणा शुचिः॥
verses.tr: pra yat pituḥ paramānnīyate paryā pṛkṣudho vīrudho daṃsu rohati ubhā yadasya januṣaṃ yadinvata ādid yaviṣṭho abhavad ghṛṇā śuciḥ
verses.en: When from the Highest Father he is brought to us, amid the plants he rises hungry, wondrously. As both together join to expedite his birth, most youthful he is born resplendent in his light.

verses.sa:
आदिन्मातॄराविशद् यास्वा शुचिरहिंस्यमान उर्विया वि वावृधे ।
अनु यत् पूर्वा अरुहत् सनाजुवो नि नव्यसीष्ववरासु धावते॥
verses.tr: ādinmātṝrāviśad yāsvā śucirahiṃsyamāna urviyā vi vāvṛdhe anu yat pūrvā aruhat sanājuvo ni navyasīṣvavarāsu dhāvate
verses.en: Then also entered he the Mothers, and in them pure and uninjured he increased in magnitude. As to the first he rose, the vigorous from of old, so now he runs among the younger lowest ones.

verses.sa:
आदिद्धोतारं वृणते दिविष्टिषु भगमिव पपृचानास ऋञ्जते ।
देवान् यत् क्रत्वा मज्मना पुरुष्टुतो मर्तं शंसं विश्वधा वेति धायसे॥
verses.tr: ādiddhotāraṃ vṛṇate diviṣṭiṣu bhagamiva papṛcānāsa ṛñjate devān yat kratvā majmanā puruṣṭuto martaṃ śaṃsaṃ viśvadhā veti dhāyase
verses.en: Therefore they choose him Herald at the morning rites, pressing to him as unto Bhaga, pouring gifts, When, much-praised, by the power and will of Gods, he goes at all times to his mortal worshipper to drink.

verses.sa:
वि यदस्थाद् यजतो वातचोदितो ह्वारो न वक्वा जरणा अनाकृतः ।
तस्य पत्मन् दक्षुषः कृष्णजंहसः शुचिजन्मनो रज आ व्यध्वनः॥
verses.tr: vi yadasthād yajato vātacodito hvāro na vakvā jaraṇā anākṛtaḥ tasya patman dakṣuṣaḥ kṛṣṇajaṃhasaḥ śucijanmano raja ā vyadhvanaḥ
verses.en: What time the Holy One, wind-urged, hath risen up, serpent-like winding through the dry grass unrestrained, Dust lies upon the way of him who burneth all, black-winged and pure of birth who follows sundry paths.

verses.sa:
रथो न यातः शिक्वभिः कृतो द्यामङ्गेभिररुषेभिरीयते ।
आदस्य ते कृष्णासो दक्षि सूरयः शूरस्येव त्वेषथादीषते वयः॥
verses.tr: ratho na yātaḥ śikvabhiḥ kṛto dyāmaṅgebhiraruṣebhirīyate ādasya te kṛṣṇāso dakṣi sūrayaḥ śūrasyeva tveṣathādīṣate vayaḥ
verses.en: Like a swift chariot made by men who know their art, he with his red limbs lifts himself aloft to heaven. Thy worshippers become by burning black of hue: their strength flies as before a hero's violence.

verses.sa:
त्वया ह्यग्ने वरुणो धृतव्रतो मित्रः शाशद्रे अर्यमा सुदानवः ।
यत् सीमनु क्रतुना विश्वथा विभुररान्न नेमिः परिभूरजायथाः॥
verses.tr: tvayā hyagne varuṇo dhṛtavrato mitraḥ śāśadre aryamā sudānavaḥ yat sīmanu kratunā viśvathā vibhurarānna nemiḥ paribhūrajāyathāḥ
verses.en: By thee, O Agni, Varuna who guards the Law, Mitra and Aryaman, the Bounteous, are made strong; For, as the felly holds the spokes, thou with thy might pervading hast been born encompassing them round.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने शशमानाय सुन्वते रत्नं यविष्ठ देवतातिमिन्वसि ।
तं त्वा नु नव्यं सहसो युवन् वयं भगं न कारे महिरत्न धीमहि॥
verses.tr: tvamagne śaśamānāya sunvate ratnaṃ yaviṣṭha devatātiminvasi taṃ tvā nu navyaṃ sahaso yuvan vayaṃ bhagaṃ na kāre mahiratna dhīmahi
verses.en: Agni, to him who toils and pours libations, thou, Most Youthful! sendest wealth and all the host of Gods. Thee, therefore, even as Bhaga, will we set anew, young Child of Strength, most wealthy! in our battle-song.

verses.sa:
अस्मे रयिं न स्वर्थं दमूनसं भगं दक्षं न पपृचासि धर्णसिम् ।
रश्मीँरिव यो यमति जन्मनी उभे देवानां शंसमृत आ च सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: asme rayiṃ na svarthaṃ damūnasaṃ bhagaṃ dakṣaṃ na papṛcāsi dharṇasim raśmīṃriva yo yamati janmanī ubhe devānāṃ śaṃsamṛta ā ca sukratuḥ
verses.en: Vouchsafe us riches turned to worthy ends, good luck abiding in the house, and strong capacity, Wealth that directs both worlds as they were guiding-reins, and, very Wise, the Gods' assent in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उत नः सुद्योत्मा जीराश्वो होता मन्द्रः शृणवच्चन्द्ररथः ।
स नो नेषन्नेषतमैरमूरो ऽग्निर्वामं सुवितं वस्यो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: uta naḥ sudyotmā jīrāśvo hotā mandraḥ śṛṇavaccandrarathaḥ sa no neṣanneṣatamairamūro 'gnirvāmaṃ suvitaṃ vasyo accha
verses.en: May he, the Priest resplendent, joyful, hear us, he with the radiant car and rapid horses. May Agni, ever wise, with best directions to bliss and highest happiness conduct us.

verses.sa:
अस्ताव्यग्निः शिमीवद्भिरर्कैः साम्राज्याय प्रतरं दधानः ।
अमी च ये मघवानो वयं च मिहं न सूरो अति निष्टतन्युः॥
verses.tr: astāvyagniḥ śimīvadbhirarkaiḥ sāmrājyāya prataraṃ dadhānaḥ amī ca ye maghavāno vayaṃ ca mihaṃ na sūro ati niṣṭatanyuḥ
verses.en: With hymns of might hath Agni now been lauded, advanced to height of universal kingship. Now may these wealthy chiefs and we together spread forth as spreads the Sun above the rain-clouds.

verses.sa: समिद्धो अग्न आ वह देवाँ अद्य यतस्रुचे । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं सुतसोमाय दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: samiddho agna ā vaha devāṃ adya yatasruce tantuṃ tanuṣva pūrvyaṃ sutasomāya dāśuṣe
verses.en: Kindled, bring, Agni, Gods to-day for him who lifts the ladle up. Spin out the ancient thread for him who sheds, with gifts, the Soma juice.

verses.sa: घृतवन्तमुप मासि मधुमन्तं तनूनपात् । यज्ञं विप्रस्य मावतः शशमानस्य दाशुषः॥
verses.tr: ghṛtavantamupa māsi madhumantaṃ tanūnapāt yajñaṃ viprasya māvataḥ śaśamānasya dāśuṣaḥ
verses.en: Thou dealest forth, Tanunapat, sweet sacrifice enriched with oil, Brought by a singer such as I who offers gifts and toils for thee.

verses.sa: शुचिः पावको अद्भुतो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्षति । नराशंसस्त्रिरा दिवो देवो देवेषु यज्ञियः॥
verses.tr: śuciḥ pāvako adbhuto madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣati narāśaṃsastrirā divo devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ
verses.en: He wondrous, sanctifying, bright, sprinkles the sacrifice with mead, Thrice, Narasamsa from the heavens, a God mid Gods adorable.

verses.sa: ईळितो अग्न आ वहेन्द्रं चित्रमिह प्रियम् । इयं हि त्वा मतिर्ममाच्छा सुजिह्व वच्यते॥
verses.tr: īḻito agna ā vahendraṃ citramiha priyam iyaṃ hi tvā matirmamācchā sujihva vacyate
verses.en: Agni, besought, bring hitherward Indra the Friend, the Wonderful, For this my hymn of praise, O sweet of tongue, is chanted forth to thee.

verses.sa: स्तृणानासो यतस्रुचो बर्हिर्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे । वृञ्जे देवव्यचस्तममिन्द्राय शर्म सप्रथः॥
verses.tr: stṛṇānāso yatasruco barhiryajñe svadhvare vṛñje devavyacastamamindrāya śarma saprathaḥ
verses.en: The ladle-holders strew trimmed grass at this well-ordered sacrifice; A home for Indra is adorned, wide, fittest to receive the Gods.

verses.sa: वि श्रयन्तामृतावृधः प्रयै देवेभ्यो महीः । पावकासः पुरुस्पृहो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः॥
verses.tr: vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdhaḥ prayai devebhyo mahīḥ pāvakāsaḥ puruspṛho dvāro devīrasaścataḥ
verses.en: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, High, purifying, much-desired, so that the Gods may enter in.

verses.sa: आ भन्दमाने उपाके नक्तोषासा सुपेशसा । यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा सीदतां बर्हिरा सुमत्॥
verses.tr: ā bhandamāne upāke naktoṣāsā supeśasā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā sīdatāṃ barhirā sumat
verses.en: May Night and Morning, hymned with lauds, united, fair to look upon, Strong Mothers of the sacrifice, seat them together on the grass.

verses.sa: मन्द्रजिह्वा जुगुर्वणी होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमं सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशम्॥
verses.tr: mandrajihvā jugurvaṇī hotārā daivyā kavī yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimaṃ sidhramadya divispṛśam
verses.en: May the two Priests Divine, the sage, the sweet-voiced lovers of the hymn, Complete this sacrifice of ours, effectual, reaching heaven to-day.

verses.sa: शुचिर्देवेष्वर्पिता होत्रा मरुत्सु भारती । इळा सरस्वती मही बर्हिः सीदन्तु यज्ञियाः॥
verses.tr: śucirdeveṣvarpitā hotrā marutsu bhāratī iḻā sarasvatī mahī barhiḥ sīdantu yajñiyāḥ
verses.en: Let Hotra pure, set among Gods, amid the Maruts Bharati, Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, rest on the grass, adorable.

verses.sa: तन्नस्तुरीपमद्भुतं पुरु वारं पुरु त्मना । त्वष्टा पोषाय वि ष्यतु राये नाभा नो अस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: tannasturīpamadbhutaṃ puru vāraṃ puru tmanā tvaṣṭā poṣāya vi ṣyatu rāye nābhā no asmayuḥ
verses.en: May Tvastar send us genial dew abundant, wondrous, rich in gifts, For increase and for growth of wealth, Tvastar our kinsman and our Friend.

verses.sa: अवसृजन्नुप त्मना देवान् यक्षि वनस्पते । अग्निर्हव्या सुषूदति देवो देवेषु मेधिरः॥
verses.tr: avasṛjannupa tmanā devān yakṣi vanaspate agnirhavyā suṣūdati devo deveṣu medhiraḥ
verses.en: Vanaspati, give forth, thyself, and call the Gods to sacrifice. May Agni, God intelligent, speed our oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa: पूषण्वते मरुत्वते विश्वदेवाय वायवे । स्वाहा गायत्रवेपसे हव्यमिन्द्राय कर्तन॥
verses.tr: pūṣaṇvate marutvate viśvadevāya vāyave svāhā gāyatravepase havyamindrāya kartana
verses.en: To Vayu joined with Pusan, with the Maruts, and the host of Gods, To Indra who inspires the hymn cry Glory! and present the gift.

verses.sa: स्वाहाकृतान्या गह्युप हव्यानि वीतये । इन्द्रा गहि श्रुधी हवं त्वां हवन्ते अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: svāhākṛtānyā gahyupa havyāni vītaye indrā gahi śrudhī havaṃ tvāṃ havante adhvare
verses.en: Come hither to enjoy the gifts prepared with cry of Glory! Come, O Indra, hear their calling; they invite thee to the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
प्र तव्यसीं नव्यसीं धीतिमग्नये वाचो मतिं सहसः सूनवे भरे ।
अपां नपाद् यो वसुभिः सह प्रियो होता पृथिव्यां न्यसीददृत्वियः॥
verses.tr: pra tavyasīṃ navyasīṃ dhītimagnaye vāco matiṃ sahasaḥ sūnave bhare apāṃ napād yo vasubhiḥ saha priyo hotā pṛthivyāṃ nyasīdadṛtviyaḥ
verses.en: To Agni I present a newer mightier hymn, I bring my words and song unto the Son of Strength, Who, Offspring of the Waters, bearing precious things sits on the earth, in season, dear Invoking Priest.

verses.sa:
स जायमानः परमे व्योमन्याविरग्निरभवन्मातरिश्वने ।
अस्य क्रत्वा समिधानस्य मज्मना प्र द्यावा शोचिः पृथिवी अरोचयत्॥
verses.tr: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomanyāviragnirabhavanmātariśvane asya kratvā samidhānasya majmanā pra dyāvā śociḥ pṛthivī arocayat
verses.en: Soon as he sprang to birth that Agni was shown forth to Matarisvan in the highest firmament. When he was kindled, through his power and majesty his fiery splendour made the heavens and earth to shine.

verses.sa:
अस्य त्वेषा अजरा अस्य भानवः सुसंदृशः सुप्रतीकस्य सुद्युतः ।
भात्वक्षसो अत्यक्तुर्न सिन्धवो ऽग्ने रेजन्ते अससन्तो अजराः॥
verses.tr: asya tveṣā ajarā asya bhānavaḥ susaṃdṛśaḥ supratīkasya sudyutaḥ bhātvakṣaso atyakturna sindhavo 'gne rejante asasanto ajarāḥ
verses.en: His flames that wax not old, beams fair to look upon of him whose face is lovely, shine with beauteous sheen. The rays of Agni, him whose active force is light, through the nights glimmer sleepless, ageless, like the floods.

verses.sa:
यमेरिरे भृगवो विश्ववेदसं नाभा पृथिव्या भुवनस्य मज्मना ।
अग्निं तं गीर्भिर्हिनुहि स्व आ दमे य एको वस्वो वरुणो न राजति॥
verses.tr: yamerire bhṛgavo viśvavedasaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā bhuvanasya majmanā agniṃ taṃ gīrbhirhinuhi sva ā dame ya eko vasvo varuṇo na rājati
verses.en: Send thou with hymns that Agni to his own abode, who rules, one Sovran Lord of wealth, like Varuna, Him, All-possessor, whom the Bhrgus with their might brought to earth's central point, the centre of the world.

verses.sa:
न यो वराय मरुतामिव स्वनः सेनेव सृष्टा दिव्या यथाशनिः ।
अग्निर्जम्भैस्तिगितैरत्ति भर्वति योधो न शत्रून् त्स वना न्यृञ्जते॥
verses.tr: na yo varāya marutāmiva svanaḥ seneva sṛṣṭā divyā yathāśaniḥ agnirjambhaistigitairatti bharvati yodho na śatrūn tsa vanā nyṛñjate
verses.en: He whom no force can stay, even as the Maruts' roar, like to a dart sent forth, even as the bolt from heaven, Agni with sharpened jaws chews up and eats the trees, and conquers them as when the warrior smites his foes.

verses.sa:
कुविन्नो अग्निरुचथस्य वीरसद् वसुष्कुविद् वसुभिः काममावरत् ।
चोदः कुवित् तुतुज्यात् सातये धियः शुचिप्रतीकं तमया धिया गृणे॥
verses.tr: kuvinno agnirucathasya vīrasad vasuṣkuvid vasubhiḥ kāmamāvarat codaḥ kuvit tutujyāt sātaye dhiyaḥ śucipratīkaṃ tamayā dhiyā gṛṇe
verses.en: And will not Agni find enjoyment in our praise, will not the Vasu grant our wish with gifts of wealth? Will not the Inspirer speed our prayers to gain their end? Him with the radiant glance I laud with this my song.

verses.sa:
घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदमग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते ।
इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यच्छुक्रवर्णामुदु नो यंसते धियम्॥
verses.tr: ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadamagniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyacchukravarṇāmudu no yaṃsate dhiyam
verses.en: The kindler of the flame wins Agni as a Friend, promoter of the Law, whose face is bright with oil. Inflamed and keen, refulgent in our gatherings, he lifts our hymn on high clad in his radiant hues.

verses.sa:
अप्रयुच्छन्नप्रयुच्छद्भिरग्ने शिवेभिर्नः पायुभिः पाहि शग्मैः ।
अदब्धेभिरदृपितेभिरिष्टे ऽनिमिषद्भिः परि पाहि नो जाः॥
verses.tr: aprayucchannaprayucchadbhiragne śivebhirnaḥ pāyubhiḥ pāhi śagmaiḥ adabdhebhiradṛpitebhiriṣṭe 'nimiṣadbhiḥ pari pāhi no jāḥ
verses.en: Keep us incessantly with guards that cease not, Agni, with guards auspicious, very mighty. With guards that never slumber, never heedless, never beguiled. O Helper, keep our children.

verses.sa:
एति प्र होता व्रतमस्य माययोर्ध्वां दधानः शुचिपेशसं धियम् ।
अभि स्रुचः क्रमते दक्षिणावृतो या अस्य धाम प्रथमं ह निंसते॥
verses.tr: eti pra hotā vratamasya māyayordhvāṃ dadhānaḥ śucipeśasaṃ dhiyam abhi srucaḥ kramate dakṣiṇāvṛto yā asya dhāma prathamaṃ ha niṃsate
verses.en: The Priest goes forth to sacrifice, with wondrous power sending aloft the hymn of glorious brilliancy. He moves to meet the ladles turning to the right, which are the first to kiss the place where he abides.

verses.sa:
अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषत योनौ देवस्य सदने परीवृताः ।
अपामुपस्थे विभृतो यदावसदध स्वधा अधयद् याभिरीयते॥
verses.tr: abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣata yonau devasya sadane parīvṛtāḥ apāmupasthe vibhṛto yadāvasadadha svadhā adhayad yābhirīyate
verses.en: To him sang forth the flowing streams of Holy Law, encompassed in the home and birth-place of the God. He, when he dwelt extended in the waters' lap, absorbed those Godlike powers for which he is adored.

verses.sa:
युयूषतः सवयसा तदिद् वपुः समानमर्थं वितरित्रता मिथः ।
आदीं भगो न हव्यः समस्मदा वोह्लुर्न रश्मीन् त्समयंस्त सारथिः॥
verses.tr: yuyūṣataḥ savayasā tadid vapuḥ samānamarthaṃ vitaritratā mithaḥ ādīṃ bhago na havyaḥ samasmadā vohlurna raśmīn tsamayaṃsta sārathiḥ
verses.en: Seeking in course altern to reach the selfsame end the two copartners strive to win this beauteous form. Like Bhaga must he be duly invoked by us, as he who drives the car holds fast the horse's reins.

verses.sa:
यमीं द्वा सवयसा सपर्यतः समाने योना मिथुना समोकसा ।
दिवा न नक्तं पलितो युवाजनि पुरू चरन्नजरो मानुषा युगा॥
verses.tr: yamīṃ dvā savayasā saparyataḥ samāne yonā mithunā samokasā divā na naktaṃ palito yuvājani purū carannajaro mānuṣā yugā
verses.en: He whom the two copartners with observance tend, the pair who dwell together in the same abode, By night as in the day the grey one was born young, passing untouched by eld through many an age of man.

verses.sa:
तमीं हिन्वन्ति धीतयो दश व्रिशो देवं मर्तास ऊतये हवामहे ।
धनोरधि प्रवत आ स ऋण्वत्यभिव्रजद्भिर्वयुना नवाधित॥
verses.tr: tamīṃ hinvanti dhītayo daśa vriśo devaṃ martāsa ūtaye havāmahe dhanoradhi pravata ā sa ṛṇvatyabhivrajadbhirvayunā navādhita
verses.en: Him the ten fingers, the devotions, animate: we mortals call on him a God to give us help. He speeds over the sloping surface of the land: new deeds hath he performed with those who gird him round.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यग्ने दिव्यस्य राजसि त्वं पार्थिवस्य पशुपा इव त्मना ।
एनी त एते बृहती अभिश्रिया हिरण्ययी वक्वरी बर्हिराशाते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hyagne divyasya rājasi tvaṃ pārthivasya paśupā iva tmanā enī ta ete bṛhatī abhiśriyā hiraṇyayī vakvarī barhirāśāte
verses.en: For, Agni, like a herdsman, thou by thine own might rulest o'er all that is in heaven and on the earth; And these two Mighty Ones, bright, golden closely joined, rolling them round are come unto thy sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जुषस्व प्रति हर्य तद् वचो मन्द्र स्वधाव ऋतजात सुक्रतो ।
यो विश्वतः प्रत्यङ्ङसि दर्शतो रण्वः संदृष्टौ पितुमाँ इव क्षयः॥
verses.tr: agne juṣasva prati harya tad vaco mandra svadhāva ṛtajāta sukrato yo viśvataḥ pratyaṅṅasi darśato raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumāṃ iva kṣayaḥ
verses.en: Agni, accept with joy, be glad in this our prayer, joy-giver, self-sustained, strong, born of Holy Law! For fair to see art thou turning to every side, pleasant to look on as a dwelling filled with food.

verses.sa:
तं पृच्छता स जगामा स वेद स चिकित्वाँ ईयते सा न्वीयते ।
तस्मिन् त्सन्ति प्रशिषस्तस्मिन्निष्टयः स वाजस्य शवसः शुष्मिणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: taṃ pṛcchatā sa jagāmā sa veda sa cikitvāṃ īyate sā nvīyate tasmin tsanti praśiṣastasminniṣṭayaḥ sa vājasya śavasaḥ śuṣmiṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: Ask ye of him for he is come, he knoweth it; he, full of wisdom, is implored, is now implored. With him are admonitions and with him commands: he is the Lord of Strength, the Lord of Power and Might.

verses.sa:
तमित् पृच्छन्ति न सिमो वि पृच्छति स्वेनेव धीरो मनसा यदग्रभीत् ।
न मृष्यते प्रथमं नापरं वचो ऽस्य क्रत्वा सचते अप्रदृपितः॥
verses.tr: tamit pṛcchanti na simo vi pṛcchati sveneva dhīro manasā yadagrabhīt na mṛṣyate prathamaṃ nāparaṃ vaco 'sya kratvā sacate apradṛpitaḥ
verses.en: They ask of him: not all learn by their questioning what he, the Sage, hath grasped, as 'twere, with his own mind. Forgetting not the former nor the later word, he goeth on, not careless, in his mental power.

verses.sa:
तमिद् गच्छन्ति जुह्व १स्तमर्वतीर्विश्वान्येकः शृणवद् वचांसि मे ।
पुरुप्रैषस्ततुरिर्यज्ञसाधनो ऽच्छिद्रोतिः शिशुरादत्त सं रभः॥
verses.tr: tamid gacchanti juhva 1stamarvatīrviśvānyekaḥ śṛṇavad vacāṃsi me purupraiṣastaturiryajñasādhano 'cchidrotiḥ śiśurādatta saṃ rabhaḥ
verses.en: To him these ladles go, to him these racing mares: he only will give ear to all the words I speak. All-speeding, victor, perfecter of sacrifice, the Babe with flawless help hath mustered vigorous might.

verses.sa:
उपस्थायं चरति यत् समारत सद्यो जातस्तत्सार युज्येभिः ।
अभि श्वान्तं मृशते नान्द्ये मुदे यदीं गच्छन्त्युशतीरपिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: upasthāyaṃ carati yat samārata sadyo jātastatsāra yujyebhiḥ abhi śvāntaṃ mṛśate nāndye mude yadīṃ gacchantyuśatīrapiṣṭhitam
verses.en: Whate'er he meets he grasps and then runs farther on, and straightway, newly born, creeps forward with his kin. He stirs the wearied man to pleasure and great joy what time the longing gifts approach him as he comes.

verses.sa:
स ईं मृगो अप्यो वनर्गुरुप त्वच्युपमस्यां नि धायि ।
व्यब्रवीद् वयुना मर्त्येभ्यो ऽग्निर्विद्वाँ ऋतचिद्धि सत्यः॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ mṛgo apyo vanargurupa tvacyupamasyāṃ ni dhāyi vyabravīd vayunā martyebhyo 'gnirvidvāṃ ṛtaciddhi satyaḥ
verses.en: He is a wild thing of the flood and forest: he hath been laid upon the highest surface. He hath declared the lore of works to mortals, Agni the Wise, for he knows Law, the Truthful.

verses.sa:
त्रिमूर्धानं सप्तरश्मिं गृणीषे ऽनूनमग्निं पित्रोरुपस्थे ।
निषत्तमस्य चरतो ध्रुवस्य विश्वा दिवो रोचनापप्रिवांसम्॥
verses.tr: trimūrdhānaṃ saptaraśmiṃ gṛṇīṣe 'nūnamagniṃ pitrorupasthe niṣattamasya carato dhruvasya viśvā divo rocanāpaprivāṃsam
verses.en: I LAUD the seven-rayed, the triple-headed, Agni all-perfect in his Parents' bosom, Sunk in the lap of all that moves and moves not, him who hath filled all luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sa:
उक्षा महाँ अभि ववक्ष एने अजरस्तस्थावितऊतिर्ऋष्वः ।
उर्व्याः पदो नि दधाति सानौ रिहन्त्यूधो अरुषासो अस्य॥
verses.tr: ukṣā mahāṃ abhi vavakṣa ene ajarastasthāvitaūtirṛṣvaḥ urvyāḥ pado ni dadhāti sānau rihantyūdho aruṣāso asya
verses.en: As a great Steer he grew to these his Parents; sublime he stands, untouched by eld, far-reaching. He plants his footsteps on the lofty ridges of the broad earth: his red flames lick the udder.

verses.sa:
समानं वत्समभि संचरन्ती विष्वग्धेनू वि चरतः सुमेके ।
अनपवृज्याँ अध्वनो मिमाने विश्वान् केताँ अधि महो दधाने॥
verses.tr: samānaṃ vatsamabhi saṃcarantī viṣvagdhenū vi carataḥ sumeke anapavṛjyāṃ adhvano mimāne viśvān ketāṃ adhi maho dadhāne
verses.en: Coming together to their common youngling both Cows, fairshaped, spread forth in all directions, Measuring out the paths that must be travelled, entrusting all desires to him the Mighty.

verses.sa:
धीरासः पदं कवयो नयन्ति नाना हृदा रक्षमाणा अजुर्यम् ।
सिषासन्तः पर्यपश्यन्त सिन्धुमाविरेभ्यो अभवत् सूर्यो नॄन्॥
verses.tr: dhīrāsaḥ padaṃ kavayo nayanti nānā hṛdā rakṣamāṇā ajuryam siṣāsantaḥ paryapaśyanta sindhumāvirebhyo abhavat sūryo nṝn
verses.en: The prudent sages lead him to his dwelling, guarding with varied skill the Ever-Youthful. Longing, they turned their eyes unto the River: to these the Sun of men was manifested.

verses.sa:
दिदृक्षेण्यः परि काष्ठासु जेन्य ईळेन्यो महो अर्भाय जीवसे ।
पुरुत्रा यदभवत् सूरहैभ्यो गर्भेभ्यो मघवा विश्वदर्शतः॥
verses.tr: didṛkṣeṇyaḥ pari kāṣṭhāsu jenya īḻenyo maho arbhāya jīvase purutrā yadabhavat sūrahaibhyo garbhebhyo maghavā viśvadarśataḥ
verses.en: Born noble in the regions, aim of all mens' eyes to be implored for life by great and small alike, Far as the Wealthy One hath spread himself abroad, he is the Sire all-visible of this progeny.

verses.sa:
कथा ते अग्ने शुचयन्त आयोर्ददाशुर्वाजेभिराशुषाणाः ।
उभे यत् तोके तनये दधाना ऋतस्य सामन् रणयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: kathā te agne śucayanta āyordadāśurvājebhirāśuṣāṇāḥ ubhe yat toke tanaye dadhānā ṛtasya sāman raṇayanta devāḥ
verses.en: How, Agni, have the radiant ones, aspiring, endued thee with the vigour of the living, So that on both sides fostering seed and offspring, the Gods may joy in Holy Law's fulfilment?

verses.sa:
बोधा मे अस्य वचसो यविष्ठ मंहिष्ठस्य प्रभृतस्य स्वधावः ।
पीयति त्वो अनु त्वो गृणाति वन्दारुस्ते तन्वं वन्दे अग्ने॥
verses.tr: bodhā me asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṃhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandāruste tanvaṃ vande agne
verses.en: Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou, Most Youthful! offered to thee by him who gives most freely. One hates thee, and another sings thy praises: I thine adorer laud thy form, O Agni.

verses.sa:
ये पायवो मामतेयं ते अग्ने पश्यन्तो अन्धं दुरितादरक्षन् ।
ररक्ष तान् त्सुकृतो विश्ववेदा दिप्सन्त इद् रिपवो नाह देभुः॥
verses.tr: ye pāyavo māmateyaṃ te agne paśyanto andhaṃ duritādarakṣan rarakṣa tān tsukṛto viśvavedā dipsanta id ripavo nāha debhuḥ
verses.en: Thy guardian rays, O Agni, when they saw him, preserved blind Mamateya from affliction. Lord of all riches, he preserved the pious the foes who fain would harm them did no mischief.

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्ने अररिवाँ अघायुररातीवा मर्चयति द्वयेन ।
मन्त्रो गुरुः पुनरस्तु सो अस्मा अनु मृक्षीष्ट तन्वं दुरुक्तैः॥
verses.tr: yo no agne ararivāṃ aghāyurarātīvā marcayati dvayena mantro guruḥ punarastu so asmā anu mṛkṣīṣṭa tanvaṃ duruktaiḥ
verses.en: The sinful man who worships not, O Agni, who, offering not, harms us with double-dealing,-- Be this in turn to him a heavy sentence may he distress himself by his revilings.

verses.sa:
उत वा यः सहस्य प्रविद्वान् मर्तो मर्तं मर्चयति द्वयेन ।
अतः पाहि स्तवमान स्तुवन्तमग्ने माकिर्नो दुरिताय धायीः॥
verses.tr: uta vā yaḥ sahasya pravidvān marto martaṃ marcayati dvayena ataḥ pāhi stavamāna stuvantamagne mākirno duritāya dhāyīḥ
verses.en: Yea, when a mortal knowingly, O Victor, injures with double tongue a fellow-mortal, From him, praised Agni! save thou him that lauds thee: bring us not into trouble and affliction.

verses.sa:
मथीद् यदीं विष्टो मातरिश्वा होतारं विश्वाप्सुं विश्वदेव्यम् ।
नि यं दधुर्मनुष्यासु विक्षु स्व १ र्ण चित्रं वपुषे विभावम्॥
verses.tr: mathīd yadīṃ viṣṭo mātariśvā hotāraṃ viśvāpsuṃ viśvadevyam ni yaṃ dadhurmanuṣyāsu vikṣu sva 1 rṇa citraṃ vapuṣe vibhāvam
verses.en: What Matarisvan, piercing, formed by friction, Herald of all the Gods. in varied figure, Is he whom they have set mid human houses, gay-hued as light and shining forth for beauty.

verses.sa:
ददानमिन्न ददभन्त मन्माग्निर्वरूथं मम तस्य चाकन् ।
जुषन्त विश्वान्यस्य कर्मोपस्तुतिं भरमाणस्य कारोः॥
verses.tr: dadānaminna dadabhanta manmāgnirvarūthaṃ mama tasya cākan juṣanta viśvānyasya karmopastutiṃ bharamāṇasya kāroḥ
verses.en: They shall not harm the man who brings thee praises: such as I am, Agni my help approves me. All acts of mine shall they accept with pleasure, laudation from the singer who presents it.

verses.sa:
नित्ये चिन्नु यं सदने जगृभ्रे प्रशस्तिभिर्दधिरे यज्ञियासः ।
प्र सू नयन्त गृभयन्त इष्टावश्वासो न रथ्यो रारहाणाः॥
verses.tr: nitye cinnu yaṃ sadane jagṛbhre praśastibhirdadhire yajñiyāsaḥ pra sū nayanta gṛbhayanta iṣṭāvaśvāso na rathyo rārahāṇāḥ
verses.en: Him in his constant seat men skilled in worship have taken and with praises have established. As, harnessed to a chariot fleet-foot horses, at his command let bearers lead him forward.

verses.sa:
पुरूणि दस्मो नि रिणाति जम्भैराद् रोचते वन आ विभावा ।
आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरस्तुर्न शर्यामसनामनु द्यून्॥
verses.tr: purūṇi dasmo ni riṇāti jambhairād rocate vana ā vibhāvā ādasya vāto anu vāti śocirasturna śaryāmasanāmanu dyūn
verses.en: Wondrous, full many a thing he chews and crunches: he shines amid the wood with spreading brightness. Upon his glowing flames the wind blows daily, driving them like the keen shaft of an archer.

verses.sa:
न यं रिपवो न रिषण्यवो गर्भे सन्तं रेषणा रेषयन्ति ।
अन्धा अपश्या न दभन्नभिख्या नित्यास ईं प्रेतारो अरक्षन्॥
verses.tr: na yaṃ ripavo na riṣaṇyavo garbhe santaṃ reṣaṇā reṣayanti andhā apaśyā na dabhannabhikhyā nityāsa īṃ pretāro arakṣan
verses.en: Him, whom while yet in embryo the hostile, both skilled and fain to harm, may never injure, Men blind and sightless through his splendour hurt not: his never-failing lovers have preserved him.

verses.sa:
महः स राय एषते पतिर्दन्निन इनस्य वसुनः पद आ ।
उप ध्रजन्तमद्रयो विधन्नित्॥
verses.tr: mahaḥ sa rāya eṣate patirdannina inasya vasunaḥ pada ā upa dhrajantamadrayo vidhannit
verses.en: Hither he hastens to give, Lord of great riches, King of the mighty, to the place of treasure. The pressing-stones shall serve him speeding near us.

verses.sa:
स यो वृषा नरां न रोदस्योः श्रवोभिरस्ति जीवपीतसर्गः ।
प्र यः सस्राणः शिश्रीत योनौ॥
verses.tr: sa yo vṛṣā narāṃ na rodasyoḥ śravobhirasti jīvapītasargaḥ pra yaḥ sasrāṇaḥ śiśrīta yonau
verses.en: As Steer of men so Steer of earth and heaven by glory, he whose streams all life hath drunken, Who hasting forward rests upon the altar.

verses.sa:
आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो ३ नार्वा ।
सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा॥
verses.tr: ā yaḥ puraṃ nārmiṇīmadīdedatyaḥ kavirnabhanyo 3 nārvā sūro na rurukvāñchatātmā
verses.en: He who hath lighted up the joyous castle, wise Courser like the Steed of cloudy heaven, Bright like the Sun, with hundredfold existence.

verses.sa:
अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजांसि शुशुचानो अस्थात् ।
होता यजिष्ठो अपां सधस्थश॥
verses.tr: abhi dvijanmā trī rocanāni viśvā rajāṃsi śuśucāno asthāt hotā yajiṣṭho apāṃ sadhasthaśa
verses.en: He, doubly born, hath spread in his effulgence through the three luminous realms, through all the regions, Best sacrificing Priest where waters gather.

verses.sa:
अयं स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या ।
मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa hotā yo dvijanmā viśvā dadhe vāryāṇi śravasyā marto yo asmai sutuko dadāśa
verses.en: Priest doubly born, he through his love of glory hath in his keeping all things worth the choosing, The man who brings him gifts hath noble offspring.

verses.sa: पुरु त्वा दाश्वान् वोचे ऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा । तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य॥
verses.tr: puru tvā dāśvān voce 'riragne tava svidā todasyeva śaraṇa ā mahasya
verses.en: Agni, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift, As in the keeping of the great inciting God;

verses.sa: व्यनिनस्य धनिनः प्रहोषे चिदररुषः । कदा चन प्रजिगतो अदेवयोः॥
verses.tr: vyaninasya dhaninaḥ prahoṣe cidararuṣaḥ kadā cana prajigato adevayoḥ
verses.en: Thou who ne'er movest thee to aid the indolent, the godless man, Him who though wealthy never brings an offering.

verses.sa: स चन्द्रो विप्र मर्त्यो महो व्राधन्तमो दिवि । प्रप्रेत् ते अग्ने वनुषः स्याम॥
verses.tr: sa candro vipra martyo maho vrādhantamo divi prapret te agne vanuṣaḥ syāma
verses.en: Splendid, O Singer, is that man, mightiest of the great in heaven. Agni, may we be foremost, we thy worshippers.

verses.sa:
मित्रं न यं शिम्या गोषु गव्यवः स्वाध्यो विदथे अप्सु जीजनन् ।
अरेजेतां रोदसी पाजसा गिरा प्रति प्रियं यजतं जनुषामवः॥
verses.tr: mitraṃ na yaṃ śimyā goṣu gavyavaḥ svādhyo vidathe apsu jījanan arejetāṃ rodasī pājasā girā prati priyaṃ yajataṃ januṣāmavaḥ
verses.en: Heaven and earth trembled at the might and voice of him, whom, loved and Holy One, helper of all mankind, The wise who longed for spoil in fight for kine brought forth with power, a Friend, mid waters, at the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यद्ध त्यद् वां पुरुमीळहस्य सोमिनः प्र मित्रासो न दधिरे स्वाभुवः ।
अध क्रतुं विदतं गातुमर्चत उत श्रुतं वृषणा पस्त्यावतः॥
verses.tr: yaddha tyad vāṃ purumīḻahasya sominaḥ pra mitrāso na dadhire svābhuvaḥ adha kratuṃ vidataṃ gātumarcata uta śrutaṃ vṛṣaṇā pastyāvataḥ
verses.en: As these, like friends, have done this work for you, these prompt servants of Purumilha Soma-offerer, Give mental power to him who sings the sacred song, and hearken, Strong Ones, to the master of the house.

verses.sa:
आ वां भूषन् क्षितयो जन्म रोदस्योः प्रवाच्यं वृषणा दक्षसे महे ।
यदीमृताय भरथो यदर्वते प्र होत्रया शिम्या वीथो अध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ bhūṣan kṣitayo janma rodasyoḥ pravācyaṃ vṛṣaṇā dakṣase mahe yadīmṛtāya bharatho yadarvate pra hotrayā śimyā vītho adhvaram
verses.en: The folk have glorified your birth from Earth and Heaven, to be extolled, ye Strong Ones, for your mighty power. Ye, when ye bring to singer and the rite, enjoy the sacrifice performed with holy praise and strength.

verses.sa:
प्र सा क्षितिरसुर या महि प्रिय ऋतावानावृतमा घोषथो बृहत् ।
युवं दिवो बृहतो दक्षमाभुवं गां न धुर्युप युञ्जाथे अपः॥
verses.tr: pra sā kṣitirasura yā mahi priya ṛtāvānāvṛtamā ghoṣatho bṛhat yuvaṃ divo bṛhato dakṣamābhuvaṃ gāṃ na dhuryupa yuñjāthe apaḥ
verses.en: The people prospers, Asuras! whom ye dearly love: ye, Righteous Ones, proclaim aloud the Holy Law. That efficacious power that comes from lofty heaven, ye bind unto the work, as to the pole an ox.

verses.sa:
मही अत्र महिना वारमृण्वथो ऽरेणवस्तुज आ सद्मन् धेनवः ।
स्वरन्ति ता उपरताति सूर्यमा निम्रुच उषसस्तक्ववीरिव॥
verses.tr: mahī atra mahinā vāramṛṇvatho 'reṇavastuja ā sadman dhenavaḥ svaranti tā uparatāti sūryamā nimruca uṣasastakvavīriva
verses.en: On this great earth ye send your treasure down with might: unstained by dust, the crowding kine are in the stalls. Here in the neighbourhood they cry unto the Sun at morning and at evening, like swift birds of prey.

verses.sa:
आ वामृताय केशिनीरनूषत मित्र यत्र वरुण गातुमर्चथः ।
अव त्मना सृजतं पिन्वतं धियो युवं विप्रस्य मन्मनामिरज्यथः॥
verses.tr: ā vāmṛtāya keśinīranūṣata mitra yatra varuṇa gātumarcathaḥ ava tmanā sṛjataṃ pinvataṃ dhiyo yuvaṃ viprasya manmanāmirajyathaḥ
verses.en: The flames with curling tresses serve your sacrifice, whereto ye sing the song, Mitra and Varuna. Send down of your free will, prosper our holy songs: ye are sole Masters of the singer's hymn of praise.

verses.sa:
यो वां यज्ञैः शशमानो ह दाशति कविर्होता यजति मन्मसाधनः ।
उपाह तं गच्छथो वीथो अध्वरमच्छा गिरः सुमतिं गन्तमस्मयू॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ yajñaiḥ śaśamāno ha dāśati kavirhotā yajati manmasādhanaḥ upāha taṃ gacchatho vītho adhvaramacchā giraḥ sumatiṃ gantamasmayū
verses.en: Whoso with sacrifices toiling brings you gifts, and worships, sage and priest, fulfilling your desire,-- To him do ye draw nigh and taste his sacrifice. Come well-inclined to us unto our songs and prayer.

verses.sa:
युवां यज्ञैः प्रथमा गोभिरञ्जत ऋतावाना मनसो न प्रयुक्तिषु ।
भरन्ति वां मन्मना संयता गिरो ऽदृप्यता मनसा रेवदाशाथे॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ yajñaiḥ prathamā gobhirañjata ṛtāvānā manaso na prayuktiṣu bharanti vāṃ manmanā saṃyatā giro 'dṛpyatā manasā revadāśāthe
verses.en: With sacrifices and with milk they deck you first, ye Righteous Ones, as if through stirrings of the mind. To you they bring their hymns with their collected thought, while ye with earnest soul come to us gloriously.

verses.sa:
रेवद् वयो दधाथे रेवदाशाथे नरा मायाभिरितऊति माहिनम् ।
न वां द्यावोऽहभिर्नोत सिन्धवो न देवत्वं पणयो नानशुर्मघम्॥
verses.tr: revad vayo dadhāthe revadāśāthe narā māyābhiritaūti māhinam na vāṃ dyāvo'habhirnota sindhavo na devatvaṃ paṇayo nānaśurmagham
verses.en: Rich strength of life is yours: ye, Heroes, have obtained through your surpassing powers rich far-extending might. Not the past days conjoined with nights, not rivers, not the Panis have attained your Godhead and your wealth.

verses.sa:
युवं वस्त्राणि पीवसा वसाथे युवोरच्छिद्रा मन्तवो ह सर्गाः ।
अवातिरतमनृतानि विश्व ऋतेन मित्रावरुणा सचेथे॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe yuvoracchidrā mantavo ha sargāḥ avātiratamanṛtāni viśva ṛtena mitrāvaruṇā sacethe
verses.en: The robes which ye put on abound with fatness: uninterrupted courses are your counsels. All falsehood, Mitra-Varuna! ye conquer, and closely cleave unto the Law Eternal.

verses.sa:
एतच्चन त्वो वि चिकेतदेषां सत्यो मन्त्रः कविशस्त ऋघावान् ।
त्रिरश्रिं हन्ति चतुरश्रिरुग्रो देवनिदो ह प्रथमा अजूर्यन्॥
verses.tr: etaccana tvo vi ciketadeṣāṃ satyo mantraḥ kaviśasta ṛghāvān triraśriṃ hanti caturaśrirugro devanido ha prathamā ajūryan
verses.en: This might of theirs hath no one comprehended. True is the crushing word the sage hath uttered, The fearful four-edged bolt smites down the three-edged, and those who hate the Gods first fall and perish.

verses.sa:
अपादेति प्रथमा पद्वतीनां कस्तद् वां मित्रावरुणा चिकेत ।
गर्भो भारं भरत्या चिदस्य ऋतं पिपर्त्यनृतं नि तारीत्॥
verses.tr: apādeti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kastad vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa garbho bhāraṃ bharatyā cidasya ṛtaṃ pipartyanṛtaṃ ni tārīt
verses.en: The Footless Maid precedeth footed creatures. Who marketh, Mitra-Varuna, this your doing? The Babe Unborn supporteth this world's burthen, fulfilleth Law and overcometh falsehood.

verses.sa:
प्रयन्तमित् परि जारं कनीनां पश्यामसि नोपनिपद्यमानम् ।
अनवपृग्णा वितता वसानं प्रियं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम॥
verses.tr: prayantamit pari jāraṃ kanīnāṃ paśyāmasi nopanipadyamānam anavapṛgṇā vitatā vasānaṃ priyaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma
verses.en: We look on him the darling of the Maidens, always advancing, never falling downward, Wearing inseparable, wide-spread raiment, Mitra's and Varuna's delightful glory.

verses.sa:
अनश्वो जातो अनभीशुरर्वा कनिक्रदत् पतयदूर्ध्वसानुः ।
अचित्तं ब्रह्म जुजुषुर्युवानः प्र मित्रे धाम वरुणे गृणन्तः॥
verses.tr: anaśvo jāto anabhīśurarvā kanikradat patayadūrdhvasānuḥ acittaṃ brahma jujuṣuryuvānaḥ pra mitre dhāma varuṇe gṛṇantaḥ
verses.en: Unbridled Courser, born but not of horses, neighing he flieth on with back uplifted. The youthful love mystery thought-surpassing, praising in Mitra-Varuna, its glory.

verses.sa:
आ धेनवो मामतेयमवन्तीर्ब्रह्मप्रियं पीपयन् त्सस्मिन्नूधन् ।
पित्वो भिक्षेत वयुनानि विद्वानासाविवासन्नदितिमुरुष्येत्॥
verses.tr: ā dhenavo māmateyamavantīrbrahmapriyaṃ pīpayan tsasminnūdhan pitvo bhikṣeta vayunāni vidvānāsāvivāsannaditimuruṣyet
verses.en: May the milch-kine who favour Mamateya prosper in this world him who loves devotion. May he, well skilled in rites, be food, and calling Aditi with his lips give us assistance.

verses.sa:
आ वां मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं नमसा देवाववसा ववृत्याम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु सह्या अस्माकं वृष्टिर्दिव्या सुपारा॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ namasā devāvavasā vavṛtyām asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu sahyā asmākaṃ vṛṣṭirdivyā supārā
verses.en: Gods, Mitra-Varuna, with love and worship, let me make you delight in this oblation. May our prayer be victorious in battles, may we have rain from heaven to make us prosper.

verses.sa:
यजामहे वां महः सजोषा हव्येभिर्मित्रावरुणा नमोभिः ।
घृतैर्घृतस्नू अध यद् वामस्मे अध्वर्यवो न धीतिभिर्भरन्ति॥
verses.tr: yajāmahe vāṃ mahaḥ sajoṣā havyebhirmitrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ ghṛtairghṛtasnū adha yad vāmasme adhvaryavo na dhītibhirbharanti
verses.en: We worship with our reverence and oblations you, Mitra Varuna, accordant, mighty, So that with us, ye Twain whose backs are sprinkled with oil, the priests with oil and hymns support you.

verses.sa:
प्रस्तुतिर्वां धाम न प्रयुक्तिरयामि मित्रावरुणा सुवृक्तिः ।
अनक्ति यद् वां विदथेषु होता सुम्नं वां सूरिर्वृषणावियक्षन्॥
verses.tr: prastutirvāṃ dhāma na prayuktirayāmi mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktiḥ anakti yad vāṃ vidatheṣu hotā sumnaṃ vāṃ sūrirvṛṣaṇāviyakṣan
verses.en: Your praise is like a mighty power, an impulse: to you, Twain Gods, a well-formed hymn is offered, As the priest decks yon, Strong Ones, in assemblies, and the prince fain to worship you for blessings.

verses.sa:
पीपाय धेनुरदितिर्ऋताय जनाय मित्रावरुणा हविर्दे ।
हिनोति यद् वां विदथे सपर्यन् त्स रातहव्यो मानुषो न होता॥
verses.tr: pīpāya dhenuraditirṛtāya janāya mitrāvaruṇā havirde hinoti yad vāṃ vidathe saparyan tsa rātahavyo mānuṣo na hotā
verses.en: O Mitra-Varuna, Aditi the Milch-cow streams for the rite, for folk who bring oblation, When in the assembly he who worships moves you, like to a human priest, with gifts presented.

verses.sa:
उत वां विक्षु मद्यास्वन्धो गाव आपश्च पीपयन्त देवीः ।
उतो नो अस्य पूर्व्यः पतिर्दन् वीतं पातं पयस उस्रियायाः॥
verses.tr: uta vāṃ vikṣu madyāsvandho gāva āpaśca pīpayanta devīḥ uto no asya pūrvyaḥ patirdan vītaṃ pātaṃ payasa usriyāyāḥ
verses.en: So may the kine and heavenly Waters pour you sweet drink in families that make you joyful. Of this may he, the ancient House-Lord, give us. Enjoy, drink of the milk the cow provideth.

verses.sa:
विष्णोर्नु कं वीर्याणि प्र वोचं यः पार्थिवानि विममे रजांसि ।
यो अस्कभायदुत्तरं सधस्थं विचक्रमाणस्त्रेधोरुगायः॥
verses.tr: viṣṇornu kaṃ vīryāṇi pra vocaṃ yaḥ pārthivāni vimame rajāṃsi yo askabhāyaduttaraṃ sadhasthaṃ vicakramāṇastredhorugāyaḥ
verses.en: I WILL declare the mighty deeds of Visnu, of him who measured out the earthly regions, Who propped the highest place of congregation, thrice setting down his footstep, widely striding.

verses.sa:
प्र तद् विष्णुः स्तवते वीर्येण मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः ।
यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमणेष्वधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: pra tad viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryeṇa mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: For this his mighty deed is Visnu lauded, like some wild beast, dread, prowling, mountain-roaming; He within whose three wide-extended paces all living creatures have their habitation.

verses.sa:
प्र विष्णवे शूषमेतु मन्म गिरिक्षित उरुगायाय वृष्णे ।
य इदं दीर्घं प्रयतं सधस्थमेको विममे त्रिभिरित् पदेभिः॥
verses.tr: pra viṣṇave śūṣametu manma girikṣita urugāyāya vṛṣṇe ya idaṃ dīrghaṃ prayataṃ sadhasthameko vimame tribhirit padebhiḥ
verses.en: Let the hymn lift itself as strength to Visnu, the Bull far-striding, dwelling on the mountains, Him who alone with triple step hath measured this common dwelling-place, long, far extended.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्री पूर्णा मधुना पदान्यक्षीयमाणा स्वधया मदन्ति ।
य उ त्रिधातु पृथिवीमुत द्यामेको दाधार भुवनानि विश्वा॥
