verses.tr: yasya trī pūrṇā madhunā padānyakṣīyamāṇā svadhayā madanti ya u tridhātu pṛthivīmuta dyāmeko dādhāra bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: Him whose three places that are filled with sweetness, imperishable, joy as it may list them, Who verily alone upholds the threefold, the earth, the heaven, and all living creatures.

verses.sa:
तदस्य प्रियमभि पाथो अश्यां नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति ।
उरुक्रमस्य स हि बन्धुरित्था विष्णोः पदे परमे मध्व उत्सः॥
verses.tr: tadasya priyamabhi pātho aśyāṃ naro yatra devayavo madanti urukramasya sa hi bandhuritthā viṣṇoḥ pade parame madhva utsaḥ
verses.en: May I attain to that his well-loved mansion where men devoted to the Gods are happy. For there springs, close akin to the Wide-Strider, the well of meath in Visnu's highest footstep.

verses.sa:
ता वां वास्तून्युश्मसि गमध्यै यत्र गावो भूरिशृङ्गा अयासः ।
अत्राह तदुरुगायस्य वृष्णः परमं पदमव भाति भूरि॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ vāstūnyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsaḥ atrāha tadurugāyasya vṛṣṇaḥ paramaṃ padamava bhāti bhūri
verses.en: Fain would we go unto your dwelling-places where there are many-horned and nimble oxen, For mightily, there, shineth down upon us the widely-striding Bull's sublimest mansion.

verses.sa:
प्र वः पान्तमन्धसो धियायते महे शूराय विष्णवे चार्चत ।
या सानुनि पर्वतानामदाभ्या महस्तस्थतुरर्वतेव साधुना॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ pāntamandhaso dhiyāyate mahe śūrāya viṣṇave cārcata yā sānuni parvatānāmadābhyā mahastasthaturarvateva sādhunā
verses.en: To the great Hero, him who sets his mind thereon, and Visnu, praise aloud in song your draught of juice,-- Gods ne'er beguiled, who borne as 'twere by noble steed, have stood upon the lofty ridges of the hills.

verses.sa:
त्वेषमित्था समरणं शिमीवतोरिन्द्राविष्णू सुतपा वामुरुष्यति ।
या मर्त्याय प्रतिधीयमानमित् कृशानोरस्तुरसनामुरुष्यथः॥
verses.tr: tveṣamitthā samaraṇaṃ śimīvatorindrāviṣṇū sutapā vāmuruṣyati yā martyāya pratidhīyamānamit kṛśānorasturasanāmuruṣyathaḥ
verses.en: Your Soma-drinker keeps afar your furious rush, Indra and Visnu, when ye come with all your might. That which hath been directed well at mortal man, bow-armed Krsanu's arrow, ye turn far aside.

verses.sa:
ता ईं वर्धन्ति मह्यस्य पौंस्यं नि मातरा नयति रेतसे भुजे ।
दधाति पुत्रोऽवरं परं पितुर्नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: tā īṃ vardhanti mahyasya pauṃsyaṃ ni mātarā nayati retase bhuje dadhāti putro'varaṃ paraṃ piturnāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ
verses.en: These offerings increase his mighty manly strength: he brings both Parents down to share the genial flow. He lowers, though a son, the Father's highest name; the third is that which is high in the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसीनस्य त्रातुरवृकस्य मीळहुषः ।
यः पार्थिवानि त्रिभिरिद् विगामभिरुरु क्रमिष्टोरुगायाय जीवसे॥
verses.tr: tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasīnasya trāturavṛkasya mīḻahuṣaḥ yaḥ pārthivāni tribhirid vigāmabhiruru kramiṣṭorugāyāya jīvase
verses.en: We laud this manly power of him the Mighty One, preserver, inoffensive, bounteous and benign; His who strode, widely pacing, with three steppings forth over the realms of earth for freedom and for life.

verses.sa:
द्वे इदस्य क्रमणे स्वर्दृशो ऽभिख्याय मर्त्यो भुरण्यति ।
तृतीयमस्य नकिरा दधर्षति वयश्चन पतयन्तः पतत्रिणः॥
verses.tr: dve idasya kramaṇe svardṛśo 'bhikhyāya martyo bhuraṇyati tṛtīyamasya nakirā dadharṣati vayaścana patayantaḥ patatriṇaḥ
verses.en: A mortal man, when he beholds two steps of him who looks upon the light, is restless with amaze. But his third step doth no one venture to approach, no, nor the feathered birds of air who fly with wings.

verses.sa:
चतुर्भिः साकं नवतिं च नामभिश्चक्रं न वृत्तं व्यतीँरवीविपत् ।
बृहच्छरीरो विमिमान ऋक्वभिर्युवाकुमारः प्रत्येत्याहवम्॥
verses.tr: caturbhiḥ sākaṃ navatiṃ ca nāmabhiścakraṃ na vṛttaṃ vyatīṃravīvipat bṛhaccharīro vimimāna ṛkvabhiryuvākumāraḥ pratyetyāhavam
verses.en: He, like a rounded wheel, hath in swift motion set his ninety racing steeds together with the four. Developed, vast in form, with those who sing forth praise, a youth, no more a child, he cometh to our call.

verses.sa:
भवा मित्रो न शेव्यो घृतासुतिर्विभूतद्युम्न एवया उ सप्रथाः ।
अधा ते विष्णो विदुषा चिदर्ध्यः स्तोमो यज्ञश्च राध्यो हविष्मता॥
verses.tr: bhavā mitro na śevyo ghṛtāsutirvibhūtadyumna evayā u saprathāḥ adhā te viṣṇo viduṣā cidardhyaḥ stomo yajñaśca rādhyo haviṣmatā
verses.en: Far-SHINING, widely famed, going thy wonted way, fed with the oil, be helpful. Mitra-like, to us. So, Visnu, e'en the wise must swell thy song of praise, and he who hath oblations pay thee solemn rites.

verses.sa:
यः पूर्व्याय वेधसे नवीयसे सुमज्जानये विष्णवे ददाशति ।
यो जातमस्य महतो महि ब्रवत् सेदु श्रवोभिर्युज्यं चिदभ्यसत्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pūrvyāya vedhase navīyase sumajjānaye viṣṇave dadāśati yo jātamasya mahato mahi bravat sedu śravobhiryujyaṃ cidabhyasat
verses.en: He who brings gifts to him the Ancient and the Last, to Visnu who ordains, together with his Spouse, Who tells the lofty birth of him the Lofty One, shall verily surpass in glory e'en his peer.

verses.sa:
तमु स्तोतारः पूर्व्यं यथा विद ऋतस्य गर्भं जनुषा पिपर्तन ।
आस्य जानन्तो नाम चिद् विवक्तन महस्ते विष्णो सुमतिं भजामहे॥
verses.tr: tamu stotāraḥ pūrvyaṃ yathā vida ṛtasya garbhaṃ januṣā pipartana āsya jānanto nāma cid vivaktana mahaste viṣṇo sumatiṃ bhajāmahe
verses.en: Him have ye satisfied, singers, as well as ye know, primeval gem of Order even from his birth. Ye, knowing e'en his name, have told it forth: may we, Visnu, enjoy the grace of thee the Mighty One.

verses.sa:
तमस्य राजा वरुणस्तमश्विना क्रतुं सचन्त मारुतस्य वेधसः ।
दाधार दक्षमुत्तममहर्विदं व्रजं च विष्णुः सखिवाँ अपोर्णुते॥
verses.tr: tamasya rājā varuṇastamaśvinā kratuṃ sacanta mārutasya vedhasaḥ dādhāra dakṣamuttamamaharvidaṃ vrajaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ sakhivāṃ aporṇute
verses.en: The Sovran Varuna and both the Asvins wait on this the will of him who guides the Marut host. Visnu hath power supreme and might that finds the day, and with his Friend unbars the stable of the kine.

verses.sa:
आ यो विवाय सचथाय दैव्य इन्द्राय विष्णुः सुकृते सुकृत्तरः ।
वेधा अजिन्वत् त्रिषधस्थ आर्यमृतस्य भागे यजमानमाभजत्॥
verses.tr: ā yo vivāya sacathāya daivya indrāya viṣṇuḥ sukṛte sukṛttaraḥ vedhā ajinvat triṣadhastha āryamṛtasya bhāge yajamānamābhajat
verses.en: Even he the Heavenly One who came for fellowship, Visnu to Indra, godly to the godlier, Who Maker, throned in three worlds, helps the Aryan man, and gives the worshipper his share of Holy Law.

verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्यु १षाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा ।
आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद् देवः सविता जगत् पृथक्॥
verses.tr: abodhyagnirjma udeti sūryo vyu 1ṣāścandrā mahyāvo arciṣā āyukṣātāmaśvinā yātave rathaṃ prāsāvīd devaḥ savitā jagat pṛthak
verses.en: Agni is wakened: Surya riseth from the earth. Mighty, refulgent Dawn hath shone with all her light. The Asvins have equipped their chariot for the course. God Savitar hath moved the folk in sundry ways.

verses.sa:
यद् युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि॥
verses.tr: yad yuñjāthe vṛṣaṇamaśvinā rathaṃ ghṛtena no madhunā kṣatramukṣatam asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu jinvataṃ vayaṃ dhanā śūrasātā bhajemahi
verses.en: When, Asvins, ye equip your very mighty car, bedew, ye Twain, our power with honey and with oil. To our devotion give victorious strength in war: may we win riches in the heroes' strife for spoil.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङ् त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः ।
त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद् द्विपदे चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: arvāṅ tricakro madhuvāhano ratho jīrāśvo aśvinoryātu suṣṭutaḥ trivandhuro maghavā viśvasaubhagaḥ śaṃ na ā vakṣad dvipade catuṣpade
verses.en: Nigh to us come the Asvins' lauded three-wheeled car, the car laden with meath and drawn by fleet-foot steeds, Three-seated, opulent, bestowing all delight. may it bring weal to us, to cattle and to men.

verses.sa:
आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवं मधुमत्या नः कशया मिमिक्षतम् ।
प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा॥
verses.tr: ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvaṃ madhumatyā naḥ kaśayā mimikṣatam prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā
verses.en: Bring hither nourishment for us, ye Asvins Twain; sprinkle us with your whip that drops with honey-dew. Prolong our days of life, wipe out our trespasses; destroy our foes, be our companions and our Friends.

verses.sa:
युवं ह गर्भं जगतीषु धत्थो युवं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः ।
युवमग्निं च वृषणावपश्च वनस्पतीँरश्विनावैरयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha garbhaṃ jagatīṣu dhattho yuvaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvantaḥ yuvamagniṃ ca vṛṣaṇāvapaśca vanaspatīṃraśvināvairayethām
verses.en: Ye store the germ of life in female creatures, ye lay it up within all living beings. Ye have sent forth, O Asvins passing mighty, the fire, the sovrans of the wood, the waters,

verses.sa:
युवं ह स्थो भिषजा भेषजेभिरथो ह स्थो रथ्या ३ राथ्येभिः ।
अथो ह क्षत्रमधि धत्थ उग्रा यो वां हविष्मान् मनसा ददाश॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha stho bhiṣajā bheṣajebhiratho ha stho rathyā 3 rāthyebhiḥ atho ha kṣatramadhi dhattha ugrā yo vāṃ haviṣmān manasā dadāśa
verses.en: Leeches are ye with medicines to heal us, and charioteers are ye with skill in driving. Ye Strong, give sway to him who brings oblation and with his heart pours out his gift before you.

verses.sa:
वसू रुद्रा पुरुमन्तू वृधन्ता दशस्यतं नो वृषणावभिष्टौ ।
दस्रा ह यद् रेक्ण औचथ्यो वां प्र यत् सस्राथे अकवाभिरूती॥
verses.tr: vasū rudrā purumantū vṛdhantā daśasyataṃ no vṛṣaṇāvabhiṣṭau dasrā ha yad rekṇa aucathyo vāṃ pra yat sasrāthe akavābhirūtī
verses.en: Ye Vasus Twain, ye Rudras full of counsel, grant us, Strong Strengtheners, when ye stand beside us, What wealth Aucathya craves of you, great Helpers when ye come forward with no niggard succour.

verses.sa:
को वां दाशत् सुमतये चिदस्यै वसू यद् धेथे नमसा पदे गोः ।
जिगृतमस्मे रेवतीः पुरंधीः कामप्रेणेव मनसा चरन्ता॥
verses.tr: ko vāṃ dāśat sumataye cidasyai vasū yad dhethe namasā pade goḥ jigṛtamasme revatīḥ puraṃdhīḥ kāmapreṇeva manasā carantā
verses.en: Who may give you aught, Vasus, for your favour, for what, at the Cow's place, ye grant through worship? Wake for us understanding full of riches, come with a heart that will fulfil our longing.

verses.sa:
युक्तो ह यद् वां तौग्र्याय पेरुर्वि मध्ये अर्णसो धायि पज्रः ।
उप वामवः शरणं गमेयं शूरो नाज्म पतयद्भिरेवैः॥
verses.tr: yukto ha yad vāṃ taugryāya perurvi madhye arṇaso dhāyi pajraḥ upa vāmavaḥ śaraṇaṃ gameyaṃ śūro nājma patayadbhirevaiḥ
verses.en: As erst for Tugra's son your car, sea-crossing, strong, was equipped and set amid the waters, So may I gain your shelter and protection as with winged course a hero seeks his army.

verses.sa:
उपस्तुतिरौचथ्यमुरुष्येन्मा मामिमे पतत्रिणी वि दुग्धाम् ।
मा मामेधो दशतयश्चितो धाक् प्र यद् वां बद्धस्त्मनि खादति क्षाम्॥
verses.tr: upastutiraucathyamuruṣyenmā māmime patatriṇī vi dugdhām mā māmedho daśatayaścito dhāk pra yad vāṃ baddhastmani khādati kṣām
verses.en: May this my praise preserve Ucathya's offspring: let not these Twain who fly with wings exhaust me. Let not the wood ten times up-piled consume me, when fixed for you it bites the ground it stands on.

verses.sa:
न मा गरन् नद्यो मातृतमा दासा यदीं सुसमुब्धमवाधुः ।
शिरो यदस्य त्रैतनो वितक्षत् स्वयं दास उरो अंसावपि ग्ध॥
verses.tr: na mā garan nadyo mātṛtamā dāsā yadīṃ susamubdhamavādhuḥ śiro yadasya traitano vitakṣat svayaṃ dāsa uro aṃsāvapi gdha
verses.en: The most maternal streams, wherein the Dasas cast me securely bound, have not devoured me. When Traitana would cleave my head asunder, the Dasa wounded his own breast and shoulders.

verses.sa:
दीर्घतमा मामतेयो जुजुर्वान् दशमे युगे ।
अपामर्थं यतीनां ब्रह्मा भवति सारथिः॥
verses.tr: dīrghatamā māmateyo jujurvān daśame yuge apāmarthaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmā bhavati sārathiḥ
verses.en: Dirghatamas the son of Mamata hath come to length of days in the tenth age of human kind. He is the Brahman of the waters as they strive to reach their end and aim: their charioteer is he.

verses.sa:
प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा मही स्तुषे विदथेषु प्रचेतसा ।
देवेभिर्ये देवपुत्रे सुदंससेत्था धिया वार्याणि प्रभूषतः॥
verses.tr: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā mahī stuṣe vidatheṣu pracetasā devebhirye devaputre sudaṃsasetthā dhiyā vāryāṇi prabhūṣataḥ
verses.en: I PRAISE with sacrifices mighty Heaven and Earth at festivals, the wise, the Strengtheners of Law. Who, having Gods for progeny, conjoined with Gods, through wonder-working wisdom bring forth choicest boons.

verses.sa:
उत मन्ये पितुरद्रुहो मनो मातुर्महि स्वतवस्तद्धवीमभिः ।
सुरेतसा पितरा भूम चक्रतुरुरु प्रजाया अमृतं वरीमभिः॥
verses.tr: uta manye pituradruho mano māturmahi svatavastaddhavīmabhiḥ suretasā pitarā bhūma cakratururu prajāyā amṛtaṃ varīmabhiḥ
verses.en: With invocations, on the gracious Father's mind, and on the Mother's great inherent power I muse. Prolific Parents, they have made the world of life, and for their brood all round wide immortality.

verses.sa:
ते सूनवः स्वपसः सुदंससो मही जज्ञुर्मातरा पूर्वचित्तये ।
स्थातुश्च सत्यं जगतश्च धर्मणि पुत्रस्य पाथः पदमद्वयाविनः॥
verses.tr: te sūnavaḥ svapasaḥ sudaṃsaso mahī jajñurmātarā pūrvacittaye sthātuśca satyaṃ jagataśca dharmaṇi putrasya pāthaḥ padamadvayāvinaḥ
verses.en: These Sons of yours well skilled in work, of wondrous power, brought forth to life the two great Mothers first of all. To keep the truth of all that stands and all that moves, ye guard the station of your Son who knows no guile.

verses.sa:
ते मायिनो ममिरे सुप्रचेतसो जामी सयोनी मिथुना समोकसा ।
नव्यंनव्यं तन्तुमा तन्वते दिवि समुद्रे अन्तः कवयः सुदीतयः॥
verses.tr: te māyino mamire supracetaso jāmī sayonī mithunā samokasā navyaṃnavyaṃ tantumā tanvate divi samudre antaḥ kavayaḥ sudītayaḥ
verses.en: They with surpassing skill, most wise, have measured out the Twins united in their birth and in their home. They, the refulgent Sages, weave within the sky, yea, in the depths of sea, a web for ever new.

verses.sa:
तद् राधो अद्य सवितुर्वरेण्यं वयं देवस्य प्रसवे मनामहे ।
अस्मभ्यं द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं शतग्विनम्॥
verses.tr: tad rādho adya saviturvareṇyaṃ vayaṃ devasya prasave manāmahe asmabhyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ śatagvinam
verses.en: This is to-day the goodliest gift of Savitar: this thought we have when now the God is furthering us. On us with loving-kindness Heaven and Earth bestow riches and various wealth and treasure hundredfold!

verses.sa:
ते हि द्यावापृथिवी विश्वशम्भुव ऋतावरी रजसो धारयत्कवी ।
सुजन्मनी धिषणे अन्तरीयते देवो देवी धर्मणा सूर्यः शुचिः॥
verses.tr: te hi dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuva ṛtāvarī rajaso dhārayatkavī sujanmanī dhiṣaṇe antarīyate devo devī dharmaṇā sūryaḥ śuciḥ
verses.en: These, Heaven and Earth, bestow prosperity on all, sustainers of the region, Holy Ones and wise, Two Bowls of noble kind: between these Goddesses the God, the fulgent Sun, travels by fixed decree.

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचसा महिनी असश्चता पिता माता च भुवनानि रक्षतः ।
सुधृष्टमे वपुष्ये ३ न रोदसी पिता यत् सीमभि रूपैरवासयत्॥
verses.tr: uruvyacasā mahinī asaścatā pitā mātā ca bhuvanāni rakṣataḥ sudhṛṣṭame vapuṣye 3 na rodasī pitā yat sīmabhi rūpairavāsayat
verses.en: Widely-capacious Pair, mighty, that never fail, the Father and the Mother keep all creatures safe: The two world-halves, the spirited, the beautiful, because the Father hath clothed them in goodly forms.

verses.sa:
स वह्निः पुत्रः पित्रोः पवित्रवान् पुनाति धीरो भुवनानि मायया ।
धेनुं च पृश्निं वृषभं सुरेतसं विश्वाहा शुक्रं पयो अस्य दुक्षत॥
verses.tr: sa vahniḥ putraḥ pitroḥ pavitravān punāti dhīro bhuvanāni māyayā dhenuṃ ca pṛśniṃ vṛṣabhaṃ suretasaṃ viśvāhā śukraṃ payo asya dukṣata
verses.en: Son of these Parents, he the Priest with power to cleanse, Sage, sanctifies the worlds with his surpassing power. Thereto for his bright milk he milked through all the days the party-coloured Cow and the prolific Bull.

verses.sa:
अयं देवानामपसामपस्तमो यो जजान रोदसी विश्वशम्भुवा ।
वि यो ममे रजसी सुक्रतूयया ऽजरेभिः स्कम्भनेभिः समानृचे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ devānāmapasāmapastamo yo jajāna rodasī viśvaśambhuvā vi yo mame rajasī sukratūyayā 'jarebhiḥ skambhanebhiḥ samānṛce
verses.en: Among the skilful Gods most skilled is he, who made the two world-halves which bring prosperity to all; Who with great wisdom measured both the regions out, and stablished them with pillars that shall ne'er decay.

verses.sa:
ते नो गृणाने महिनी महि श्रवः क्षत्रं द्यावापृथिवी धासथो बृहत् ।
येनाभि कृष्टीस्ततनाम विश्वहा पनाय्यमोजो अस्मे समिन्वतम्॥
verses.tr: te no gṛṇāne mahinī mahi śravaḥ kṣatraṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dhāsatho bṛhat yenābhi kṛṣṭīstatanāma viśvahā panāyyamojo asme saminvatam
verses.en: Extolled in song, O Heaven and Earth, bestow on us, ye mighty Pair, great glory and high lordly sway, Whereby we may extend ourselves ever over the folk; and send us strength that shall deserve the praise of men.

verses.sa:
किमु श्रेष्ठः किं यविष्ठो न आजगन् किमीयते दूत्यं १ कद् यदूचिम ।
न निन्दिम चमसं यो महाकुलो ऽग्ने भ्रातर्द्रुण इद् भूतिमूदिम॥
verses.tr: kimu śreṣṭhaḥ kiṃ yaviṣṭho na ājagan kimīyate dūtyaṃ 1 kad yadūcima na nindima camasaṃ yo mahākulo 'gne bhrātardruṇa id bhūtimūdima
verses.en: Why hath the Best, why hath the Youngest come to us? Upon what embassy comes he? What have we said? We have not blamed the chalice of illustrious birth. We, Brother Agni, praised the goodness of the wood.

verses.sa:
एकं चमसं चतुरः कृणोतन तद्वो देवा अब्रुवन् तद्व आगमम् ।
सौधन्वना यद्येवा करिष्यथ साकं देवैर्यज्ञियासो भविष्यथ॥
verses.tr: ekaṃ camasaṃ caturaḥ kṛṇotana tadvo devā abruvan tadva āgamam saudhanvanā yadyevā kariṣyatha sākaṃ devairyajñiyāso bhaviṣyatha
verses.en: The chalice that is single make ye into four: thus have the Gods commanded; therefore am I come. If, O Sudhanvan's Children, ye will do this thing ye shall participate in sacrifice with Gods.

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं प्रति यदब्रवीतनाश्वः कर्त्वो रथ उतेह कर्त्वः ।
धेनुः कर्त्वा युवशा कर्त्वा द्वा तानि भ्रातरनु वः कृत्व्येमसि॥
verses.tr: agniṃ dūtaṃ prati yadabravītanāśvaḥ kartvo ratha uteha kartvaḥ dhenuḥ kartvā yuvaśā kartvā dvā tāni bhrātaranu vaḥ kṛtvyemasi
verses.en: What to the envoy Agni in reply ye spake, A courser must be made, a chariot fashioned here, A cow must be created, and the Twain made young. When we have done these things, Brother, we turn to you.

verses.sa:
चकृवांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छत क्वेदभूद् यः स्य दूतो न आजगन् ।
यदावाख्यच्चमसाञ्चतुरः कृतानादित् त्वष्टा ग्नास्वन्तर्न्यानजे॥
verses.tr: cakṛvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchata kvedabhūd yaḥ sya dūto na ājagan yadāvākhyaccamasāñcaturaḥ kṛtānādit tvaṣṭā gnāsvantarnyānaje
verses.en: When thus, O Rbhus, ye had done ye questioned thus, Whither went he who came to us a messenger? Then Tvastar, when he viewed the four wrought chalices, concealed himself among the Consorts of the Gods.

verses.sa:
हनामैनाँ इति त्वष्टा यदब्रवीच्चमसं ये देवपानमनिन्दिषुः ।
अन्या नामानि कृण्वते सुते सचाँ अन्यैरेनान्कन्या ३ नामभिः स्परत्॥
verses.tr: hanāmaināṃ iti tvaṣṭā yadabravīccamasaṃ ye devapānamanindiṣuḥ anyā nāmāni kṛṇvate sute sacāṃ anyairenānkanyā 3 nāmabhiḥ sparat
verses.en: As Tvastar thus had spoken, Let us slay these men who have reviled the chalice, drinking-cup of Gods, They gave themselves new names when Soma juice was shed, and under these new names the Maiden welcomed them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो हरी युयुजे अश्विना रथं बृहस्पतिर्विश्वरूपामुपाजत ।
ऋभुर्विभ्वा वाजो देवाँ अगच्छत स्वपसो यज्ञियं भागमैतन॥
verses.tr: indro harī yuyuje aśvinā rathaṃ bṛhaspatirviśvarūpāmupājata ṛbhurvibhvā vājo devāṃ agacchata svapaso yajñiyaṃ bhāgamaitana
verses.en: Indra hath yoked his Bays, the Asvins' car is horsed, Brhaspati hath brought the Cow of every hue. Ye went as Rbhus, Vibhvan, Vaja to the Gods, and skilled in war, obtained your share in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
निश्चर्मणो गामरिणीत धीतिभिर्या जरन्ता युवशा ताकृणोतन ।
सौधन्वना अश्वादश्वमतक्षत युक्त्वा रथमुप देवाँ अयातन॥
verses.tr: niścarmaṇo gāmariṇīta dhītibhiryā jarantā yuvaśā tākṛṇotana saudhanvanā aśvādaśvamatakṣata yuktvā rathamupa devāṃ ayātana
verses.en: Ye by your wisdom brought a cow from out a hide; unto that ancient Pair ye gave again their youth. Out of a horse, Sudhanvan's Sons, ye formed a horse: a chariot ye equipped, and went unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
इदमुदकं पिबतेत्यब्रवीतनेदं वा घा पिबता मुञ्जनेजनम् ।
सौधन्वना यदि तन्नेव हर्यथ तृतीये घा सवने मादयाध्वै॥
verses.tr: idamudakaṃ pibatetyabravītanedaṃ vā ghā pibatā muñjanejanam saudhanvanā yadi tanneva haryatha tṛtīye ghā savane mādayādhvai
verses.en: Drink ye this water, were the words ye spake to them; or drink ye this, the rinsing of the Muñja-grass. If ye approve not even this, Sudhanvan's Sons, then at the third libation gladden ye yourselves.

verses.sa:
आपो भूयिष्ठा इत्येको अब्रवीदग्निर्भूयिष्ठ इत्यन्यो अब्रवीत् ।
वधर्यन्तीं बहुभ्यः प्रैको अब्रवीदृता वदन्तश्चमसाँ अपिंशत॥
verses.tr: āpo bhūyiṣṭhā ityeko abravīdagnirbhūyiṣṭha ityanyo abravīt vadharyantīṃ bahubhyaḥ praiko abravīdṛtā vadantaścamasāṃ apiṃśata
verses.en: Most excellent are waters, thus said one of you; most excellent is Agni, thus another said. Another praised to many a one the lightning cloud. Then did ye shape the cups, speaking the words of truth.

verses.sa:
श्रोणामेक उदकं गामवाजति मांसमेकः पिंशति सूनयाभृतम् ।
आ निम्रुचः शकृदेको अपाभरत् किं स्वित् पुत्रेभ्यः पितरा उपावतुः॥
verses.tr: śroṇāmeka udakaṃ gāmavājati māṃsamekaḥ piṃśati sūnayābhṛtam ā nimrucaḥ śakṛdeko apābharat kiṃ svit putrebhyaḥ pitarā upāvatuḥ
verses.en: One downward to the water drives the crippled cow, another trims the flesh brought on the carving-board. One carries off the refuse at the set of sun. How did the Parents aid their children in their task!

verses.sa:
उद्वत्स्वस्मा अकृणोतना तृणं निवत्स्वपः स्वपस्यया नरः ।
अगोह्यस्य यदसस्तना गृहे तदद्येदमृभवो नानु गच्छथ॥
verses.tr: udvatsvasmā akṛṇotanā tṛṇaṃ nivatsvapaḥ svapasyayā naraḥ agohyasya yadasastanā gṛhe tadadyedamṛbhavo nānu gacchatha
verses.en: On the high places ye have made the grass for man, and water in the valleys, by your skill, O Men. Rbhus, ye iterate not to-day that act of yours, your sleeping in the house of him whom naught can hide.

verses.sa:
सम्मील्य यद् भुवना पर्यसर्पत क्व स्वित् तात्या पितरा व आसतुः ।
अशपत यः करस्नं व आददे यः प्राब्रवीत् प्रो तस्मा अब्रवीतन॥
verses.tr: sammīlya yad bhuvanā paryasarpata kva svit tātyā pitarā va āsatuḥ aśapata yaḥ karasnaṃ va ādade yaḥ prābravīt pro tasmā abravītana
verses.en: As, compassing them round, ye glided through the worlds, where had the venerable Parents their abode? Ye laid a curse on him who raised his arm at you: to him who spake aloud to you ye spake again.

verses.sa:
सुषुप्वांस ऋभवस्तदपृच्छतागोह्य क इदं नो अबूबुधत् ।
श्वानं बस्तो बोधयितारमब्रवीत् संवत्सर इदमद्या व्यख्यत॥
verses.tr: suṣupvāṃsa ṛbhavastadapṛcchatāgohya ka idaṃ no abūbudhat śvānaṃ basto bodhayitāramabravīt saṃvatsara idamadyā vyakhyata
verses.en: When ye had slept your fill, ye Rbhus, thus ye asked, O thou whom naught may hide, who now hath wakened us? The goat declared the hound to be your wakener. That day, in a full year, ye first unclosed our eyes.

verses.sa:
दिवा यान्ति मरुतो भूम्याग्निरयं वातो अन्तरिक्षेण याति ।
अद्भिर्याति वरुणः समुद्रैर्युष्माँ इच्छन्तः शवसो नपातः॥
verses.tr: divā yānti maruto bhūmyāgnirayaṃ vāto antarikṣeṇa yāti adbhiryāti varuṇaḥ samudrairyuṣmāṃ icchantaḥ śavaso napātaḥ
verses.en: The Maruts move in heaven, on earth this Agni; through the mid-firmament the Wind approaches. Varuna comes in the sea's gathered waters, O Sons of Strength, desirous of your presence.

verses.sa:
मा नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतः परि ख्यन् ।
यद् वाजिनो देवजातस्य सप्तेः प्रवक्ष्यामो विदथे वीर्याणि॥
verses.tr: mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan yad vājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi
verses.en: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Rbhuksan, Indra, Ayu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the strong Steed, God-descended.

verses.sa:
यन्निर्णिजा रेक्णसा प्रावृतस्य रातिं गृभीतां मुखतो नयन्ति ।
सुप्राङजो मेम्यद् विश्वरूप इन्द्रापूष्णोः प्रियमप्येति पाथः॥
verses.tr: yannirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti suprāṅajo memyad viśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamapyeti pāthaḥ
verses.en: What time they bear before the Courser, covered with trappings and with wealth, the grasped oblation, The dappled goat goeth straightforward, bleating, to the place dear to Indra and to Pusan.

verses.sa:
एष च्छागः पुरो अश्वेन वाजिना पूष्णो भागो नीयते विश्वदेव्यः ।
अभिप्रियं यत्पुरोळाशमर्वता त्वष्टेदेनं सौश्रवसाय जिन्वति॥
verses.tr: eṣa cchāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ abhipriyaṃ yatpuroḻāśamarvatā tvaṣṭedenaṃ sauśravasāya jinvati
verses.en: Dear to all Gods, this goat, the share of Pusan, is first led forward with the vigorous Courser, While Tvastar sends him forward with the Charger, acceptable for sacrifice, to glory.

verses.sa:
यद्धविष्यमृतुशो देवयानं त्रिर्मानुषाः पर्यश्वं नयन्ति ।
अत्रा पूष्णः प्रथमो भाग एति यज्ञं देवेभ्यः प्रतिवेदयन्नजः॥
verses.tr: yaddhaviṣyamṛtuśo devayānaṃ trirmānuṣāḥ paryaśvaṃ nayanti atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñaṃ devebhyaḥ prativedayannajaḥ
verses.en: When thrice the men lead round the Steed, in order, who goeth to the Gods as meet oblation, The goat precedeth him, the share of Pusan, and to the Gods the sacrifice announceth.

verses.sa:
होताध्वर्युरावया अग्निमिन्धो ग्रावग्राभ उत शंस्ता सुविप्रः ।
तेन यज्ञेन स्वरंकृतेन स्विष्टेन वक्षणा आ पृणध्वम्॥
verses.tr: hotādhvaryurāvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṃstā suvipraḥ tena yajñena svaraṃkṛtena sviṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam
verses.en: Invoker, ministering priest, atoner, fire-kindler Soma-presser, sage, reciter, With this well ordered sacrifice, well finished, do ye fill full the channels of the rivers.

verses.sa:
यूपव्रस्का उत ये यूपवाहाश्चषालं ये अश्वयूपाय तक्षति ।
ये चार्वते पचनं सम्भरन्त्युतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु॥
verses.tr: yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati ye cārvate pacanaṃ sambharantyuto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu
verses.en: The hewers of the post and those who carry it, and those who carve the knob to deck the Horse's stake; Those who prepare the cooking-vessels for the Steed,--may the approving help of these promote our work.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात् सुमन्मेऽधायि मन्म देवानामाशा उप वीतपृष्ठः ।
अन्वेनं विप्रा ऋषयो मदन्ति देवानां पुष्टे चकृमा सुबन्धुम्॥
verses.tr: upa prāgāt sumanme'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum
verses.en: Forth, for the regions of the Gods, the Charger with his smooth back is come my prayer attends him. In him rejoice the singers and the sages. A good friend have we won for the Gods' banquet.

verses.sa:
यद् वाजिनो दाम संदानमर्वतो या शीर्षण्या रशना रज्जुरस्य ।
यद् वा घास्य प्रभृतमास्ये ३ तृणं सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: yad vājino dāma saṃdānamarvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjurasya yad vā ghāsya prabhṛtamāsye 3 tṛṇaṃ sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: May the fleet Courser's halter and his heel-ropes, the head-stall and the girths and cords about him. And the grass put within his mouth to bait him,--among the Gods, too, let all these be with thee.

verses.sa:
यदश्वस्य क्रविषो मक्षिकाश यद् वा स्वरौ स्वधितौ रिप्तमस्ति ।
यद्धस्तयोः शमितुर्यन्नखेषु सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: yadaśvasya kraviṣo makṣikāśa yad vā svarau svadhitau riptamasti yaddhastayoḥ śamituryannakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: What part of the Steed's flesh the fly hath eaten, or is left sticking to the post or hatchet, Or to the slayer's hands and nails adhereth,--among the Gods, too, may all this be with thee.

verses.sa:
यदूवध्यमुदरस्यापवाति य आमस्य क्रविषो गन्धो अस्ति ।
सुकृता तच्छमितारः कृण्वन्तूत मेधं शृतपाकं पचन्तु॥
verses.tr: yadūvadhyamudarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti sukṛtā tacchamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṃ śṛtapākaṃ pacantu
verses.en: Food undigested steaming from his belly, and any odour of raw flesh remaining, This let the immolators set in order and dress the sacrifice with perfect cooking.

verses.sa:
यत् ते गात्रादग्निना पच्यमानादभि शूलं निहतस्यावधावति ।
मा तद् भूम्यामा श्रिषन्मा तृणेषु देवेभ्यस्तदुशद्भ्यो रातमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yat te gātrādagninā pacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati mā tad bhūmyāmā śriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśadbhyo rātamastu
verses.en: What from thy body which with fire is roasted, when thou art set upon the spit, distilleth, Let not that lie on earth or grass neglected, but to the longing Gods let all be offered.

verses.sa:
ये वाजिनं परिपश्यन्ति पक्वं य ईमाहुः सुरभिर्निर्हरेति ।
ये चार्वतो मांसभिक्षामुपासत उतो तेषामभिगूर्तिर्न इन्वतु॥
verses.tr: ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakvaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhirnirhareti ye cārvato māṃsabhikṣāmupāsata uto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu
verses.en: They who observing that the Horse is ready call out and say, the smell is good; remove it; And, craving meat, await the distribution,--may their approving help promote labour.

verses.sa:
यन्नीक्षणं मांस्पचन्या उखाया या पात्राणि यूष्ण आसेचनानि ।
ऊष्मण्यापिधाना चरूणामङ्काः सूनाः परि भूषन्त्यश्वम्॥
verses.tr: yannīkṣaṇaṃ māṃspacanyā ukhāyā yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇa āsecanāni ūṣmaṇyāpidhānā carūṇāmaṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣantyaśvam
verses.en: The trial-fork of the flesh-cooking caldron, the vessels out of which the broth is sprinkled, The warming-pots, the covers of the dishes, hooks, carving-boards,--all these attend the Charger.

verses.sa:
निक्रमणं निषदनं विवर्तनं यच्च पड्बीशमर्वतः ।
यच्च पपौ यच्च घासिं जघास सर्वा ता ते अपि देवेष्वस्तु॥
verses.tr: nikramaṇaṃ niṣadanaṃ vivartanaṃ yacca paḍbīśamarvataḥ yacca papau yacca ghāsiṃ jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu
verses.en: The starting-place, his place of rest and rolling, the ropes wherewith the Charger's feet were fastened, The water that he drank, the food he tasted,--among the Gods, too, may all these attend thee.

verses.sa:
मा त्वाग्निर्ध्वनयीद्धूमगन्धिर्मोखा भ्राजन्त्यभि विक्त जघ्रिः ।
इष्टं वीतमभिगूर्तं वषट्कृतं तं देवासः प्रति गृभ्णन्त्यश्वम्॥
verses.tr: mā tvāgnirdhvanayīddhūmagandhirmokhā bhrājantyabhi vikta jaghriḥ iṣṭaṃ vītamabhigūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇantyaśvam
verses.en: Let not the fire, smoke-scented, make thee crackle, nor glowing caldron smell and break to pieces. Offered, beloved, approved, and consecrated,--such Charger do the Gods accept with favour.

verses.sa:
यदश्वाय वास उपस्तृणन्त्यधीवासं या हिरण्यान्यस्मै ।
संदानमर्वन्तं पड्बीशं प्रिया देवेष्वा यामयन्ति॥
verses.tr: yadaśvāya vāsa upastṛṇantyadhīvāsaṃ yā hiraṇyānyasmai saṃdānamarvantaṃ paḍbīśaṃ priyā deveṣvā yāmayanti
verses.en: The robe they spread upon the Horse to clothe him, the upper covering and the golden trappings, The halters which restrain the Steed, the heel-ropes,--all these, as grateful to the Gods, they offer.

verses.sa:
यत् ते सादे महसा शूकृतस्य पार्ष्ण्या वा कशया वा तुतोद ।
स्रुचेव ता हविषो अध्वरेषु सर्वा ता ते ब्रह्मणा सूदयामि॥
verses.tr: yat te sāde mahasā śūkṛtasya pārṣṇyā vā kaśayā vā tutoda sruceva tā haviṣo adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi
verses.en: If one, when seated, with excessive urging hath with his heel or with his whip distressed thee, All these thy woes, as with the oblations' ladle at sacrifices, with my prayer I banish.

verses.sa:
चतुस्त्रिंशद् वाजिनो देवबन्धोर्वङ्क्रीरश्वस्य स्वधितिः समेति ।
अच्छिद्रा गात्रा वयुना कृणोत परुष्परुरनुघुष्या वि शस्त॥
verses.tr: catustriṃśad vājino devabandhorvaṅkrīraśvasya svadhitiḥ sameti acchidrā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparuranughuṣyā vi śasta
verses.en: The four-and-thirty ribs of the. Swift Charger, kin to the Gods, the slayer's hatchet pierces. Cut ye with skill, so that the parts be flawless, and piece by piece declaring them dissect them.

verses.sa:
एकस्त्वष्टुरश्वस्या विशस्ता द्वा यन्तारा भवतस्तथ ऋतुः ।
या ते गात्राणामृतुथा कृणोमि ताता पिण्डानां प्र जुहोम्यग्नौ॥
verses.tr: ekastvaṣṭuraśvasyā viśastā dvā yantārā bhavatastatha ṛtuḥ yā te gātrāṇāmṛtuthā kṛṇomi tātā piṇḍānāṃ pra juhomyagnau
verses.en: Of Tvastar's Charger there is one dissector,--this is the custom-two there are who guide him. Such of his limbs as I divide in order, these, amid the balls, in fire I offer.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा तपत् प्रिय आत्मापियन्तं मा स्वधितिस्तन्व १ आ तिष्ठिपत्ते ।
मा ते गृध्नुरविशस्तातिहाय छिद्रा गात्राण्यसिना मिथू कः॥
verses.tr: mā tvā tapat priya ātmāpiyantaṃ mā svadhitistanva 1 ā tiṣṭhipatte mā te gṛdhnuraviśastātihāya chidrā gātrāṇyasinā mithū kaḥ
verses.en: Let not thy dear soul burn thee as thou comest, let not the hatchet linger in thy body. Let not a greedy clumsy immolator, missing the joints, mangle thy limbs unduly.

verses.sa:
न वा उ एतन्म्रियसे न रिष्यसि देवाँ इदेषि पथिभिः सुगेभिः ।
हरी ते युञ्जा पृषती अभूतामुपास्थाद् वाजी धुरि रासभस्य॥
verses.tr: na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devāṃ ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ harī te yuñjā pṛṣatī abhūtāmupāsthād vājī dhuri rāsabhasya
verses.en: No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured: by easy paths unto the Gods thou goest. Both Bays, both spotted mares are now thy fellows, and to the ass's pole is yoked the Charger.

verses.sa:
सुगव्यं नो वाजी स्वश्व्यं पुंसः पुत्राँ उत विश्वापुषं रयिम् ।
अनागास्त्वं नो अदितिः कृणोतु क्षत्रं नो अश्वो वनतां हविष्मान्॥
verses.tr: sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyaṃ puṃsaḥ putrāṃ uta viśvāpuṣaṃ rayim anāgāstvaṃ no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatraṃ no aśvo vanatāṃ haviṣmān
verses.en: May this Steed bring us all-sustaining riches, wealth in good kine, good horses, manly offspring. Freedom from sin may Aditi vouchsafe us: the Steed with our oblations gain us lordship!

verses.sa:
यदक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमान उद्यन् त्समुद्रादुत वा पुरीषात् ।
श्येनस्य पक्षा हरिणस्य बाहू उपस्तुत्यं महि जातं ते अर्वन्॥
verses.tr: yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyan tsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan
verses.en: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or upper waters, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is nigh and must be lauded.

verses.sa:
यमेन दत्तं त्रित एनमायुनगिन्द्र एणं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत् ।
गन्धर्वो अस्य रशनामगृभ्णात् सूरादश्वं वसवो निरतष्ट॥
verses.tr: yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindra eṇaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat gandharvo asya raśanāmagṛbhṇāt sūrādaśvaṃ vasavo nirataṣṭa
verses.en: This Steed which Yama gave hath Trita harnessed, and him, the first of all, hath Indra mounted. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.

verses.sa:
असि यमो अस्यादित्यो अर्वन्नसि त्रितो गुह्येन व्रतेन ।
असि सोमेन समया विपृक्त आहुस्ते त्रीणि दिवि बन्धनानि॥
verses.tr: asi yamo asyādityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni
verses.en: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Aditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. Thou art divided thoroughly from Soma. They say thou hast three bonds in heaven that hold thee.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि त आहुर्दिवि बन्धनानि त्रीण्यप्सु त्रीण्यन्तः समुद्रे ।
उतेव मे वरुणश्छन्त्स्यर्वन् यत्रा त आहुः परमं जनित्रम्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre uteva me varuṇaśchantsyarvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram
verses.en: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven that bind thee, three in the waters, three within the ocean. To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birth-place.

verses.sa:
इमा ते वाजिन्नवमार्जनानीमा शफानां सनितुर्निधाना ।
अत्रा ते भद्रा रशना अपश्यमृतस्य या अभिरक्षन्ति गोपाः॥
verses.tr: imā te vājinnavamārjanānīmā śaphānāṃ saniturnidhānā atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyamṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ
verses.en: Here-, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee, here are the traces of thy hoofs as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.

verses.sa:
आत्मानं ते मनसारादजानामवो दिवा पतयन्तं पतंगम् ।
शिरो अपश्यं पथिभिः सुगेभिररेणुभिर्जेहमानं पतत्रि॥
verses.tr: ātmānaṃ te manasārādajānāmavo divā patayantaṃ pataṃgam śiro apaśyaṃ pathibhiḥ sugebhirareṇubhirjehamānaṃ patatri
verses.en: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit,--a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.

verses.sa:
अत्रा ते रूपमुत्तममपश्यं जिगीषमाणमिष आ पदे गोः ।
यदा ते मर्तो अनु भोगमानळादिद् ग्रसिष्ठ ओषधीरजीगः॥
verses.tr: atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḻādid grasiṣṭha oṣadhīrajīgaḥ
verses.en: Here I beheld thy form, matchless in glory, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Whene'er a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the plants most greedy eater.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा रथो अनु मर्यो अर्वन्ननु गावोऽनु भगः कनीनाम् ।
अनु व्रातासस्तव सख्यमीयुरनु देवा ममिरे वीर्यं ते॥
verses.tr: anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvannanu gāvo'nu bhagaḥ kanīnām anu vrātāsastava sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te
verses.en: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have copied.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यशृङ्गोऽयो अस्य पादा मनोजवा अवर इन्द्र आसीत् ।
देवा इदस्य हविरद्यमायन् यो अर्वन्तं प्रथमो अध्यतिष्ठत्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt devā idasya haviradyamāyan yo arvantaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat
verses.en: Horns made of gold hath he: his feet are iron: less fleet than he, though swift as thought, is Indra. The Gods have come that they may taste the oblation of him who mounted, first of all, the Courser.

verses.sa:
ईर्मान्तासः सिलिकमध्यमासः सं शूरणासो दिव्यासो अत्याः ।
हंसा इव श्रेणिशो यतन्ते यदाक्षिषुर्दिव्यमज्ममश्वाः॥
verses.tr: īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ haṃsā iva śreṇiśo yatante yadākṣiṣurdivyamajmamaśvāḥ
verses.en: Symmetrical in flank, with rounded haunches, mettled like heroes, the Celestial Coursers Put forth their strength, like swans in lengthened order, when they, the Steeds, have reached the heavenly causeway.

verses.sa:
तव शरीरं पतयिष्ण्वर्वन् तव चित्तं वात इव ध्रजीमान् ।
तव शृङ्गाणि विष्ठिता पुरुत्रारण्येषज जर्भुराणा चरन्ति॥
verses.tr: tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvan tava cittaṃ vāta iva dhrajīmān tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣaja jarbhurāṇā caranti
verses.en: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions: they move with restless beat in wildernesses.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागाच्छसनं वाज्यर्वा देवद्रीचा मनसा दीध्यानः ।
अजः पुरो नीयते नाभिरस्यानु पश्चात् कवयो यन्ति रेभाः॥
verses.tr: upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājyarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścāt kavayo yanti rebhāḥ
verses.en: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him the sages and the singers follow after.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात् परमं यत् सधस्थमर्वाँ अच्छा पितरं मातरं च ।
अद्या देवाञ्जुष्टतमो हि गम्या अथा शास्ते दाशुषे वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: upa prāgāt paramaṃ yat sadhasthamarvāṃ acchā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.en: The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who offers.

verses.sa:
अस्य वामस्य पलितस्य होतुस्तस्य भ्राता मध्यमो अस्त्यश्नः ।
तृतीयो भ्राता घृतपृष्ठो अस्यात्रापश्यं विश्पतिं सप्तपुत्रम्॥
verses.tr: asya vāmasya palitasya hotustasya bhrātā madhyamo astyaśnaḥ tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asyātrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram
verses.en: Of this benignant Priest, with eld grey-coloured, the brother midmost of the three is lightning. The third is he whose back with oil is sprinkled. Here I behold the Chief with seven male children.

verses.sa:
सप्त युञ्जन्ति रथमेकचक्रमेको अश्वो वहति सप्तनामा ।
त्रिनाभि चक्रमजरमनर्वं यत्रेमा विश्वा भुवनाधि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: sapta yuñjanti rathamekacakrameko aśvo vahati saptanāmā trinābhi cakramajaramanarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhi tasthuḥ
verses.en: Seven to the one-wheeled chariot yoke the Courser; bearing seven names the single Courser draws it. Three-naved the wheel is, sound and undecaying, whereon are resting all these worlds of being.

verses.sa:
इमं रथमधि ये सप्त तस्थुः सप्तचक्रं सप्त वहन्त्यश्वाः ।
सप्त स्वसारो अभि सं नवन्ते यत्र गवां निहिता सप्त नाम॥
verses.tr: imaṃ rathamadhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahantyaśvāḥ sapta svasāro abhi saṃ navante yatra gavāṃ nihitā sapta nāma
verses.en: The seven who on the seven-wheeled car are mounted have horses, seven in tale, who draw them onward. Seven Sisters utter songs of praise together, in whom the names of the seven Cows are treasured.

verses.sa:
को ददर्श प्रथमं जायमानमस्थन्वन्तं यदनस्था बिभर्ति ।
भूम्या असुरसृगात्मा क्व स्वित् को विद्वांसमुप गात् प्रष्टुमेतत्॥
verses.tr: ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānamasthanvantaṃ yadanasthā bibharti bhūmyā asurasṛgātmā kva svit ko vidvāṃsamupa gāt praṣṭumetat
verses.en: Who hath beheld him as he sprang to being, seen how the boneless One supports the bony? Where is the blood of earth, the life, the spirit? Who may approach the man who knows, to ask it?

verses.sa:
पाकः पृच्छामि मनसाविजानन् देवानामेना निहिता पदानि ।
वत्से बष्कयेऽधि सप्त तन्तून् वि तत्निरे कवय ओतवा उ॥
verses.tr: pākaḥ pṛcchāmi manasāvijānan devānāmenā nihitā padāni vatse baṣkaye'dhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavaya otavā u
verses.en: Unripe in mind, in spirit undiscerning, I ask of these the Gods' established places; For up above the yearling Calf the sages, to form a web, their own seven threads have woven.

verses.sa:
अचिकित्वाञ्चिकितुषश्चिदत्र कवीन् पृच्छामि विद्मने न विद्वान् ।
वि यस्तस्तम्भ षळिमा रजांस्यजस्य रूपे किमपि स्विदेकम्॥
verses.tr: acikitvāñcikituṣaścidatra kavīn pṛcchāmi vidmane na vidvān vi yastastambha ṣaḻimā rajāṃsyajasya rūpe kimapi svidekam
verses.en: I ask, unknowing, those who know, the sages, as one all ignorant for sake of knowledge, What was that ONE who in the Unborn's image hath stablished and fixed firm these worlds' six regions.

verses.sa:
इह ब्रवीतु य ईमङ्ग वेदास्य वामस्य निहितं पदं वेः ।
शीर्ष्णः क्षीरं दुह्रते गावो अस्य वव्रिं वसाना उदकं पदापुः॥
verses.tr: iha bravītu ya īmaṅga vedāsya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padāpuḥ
verses.en: Let him who knoweth presently declare it, this lovely Bird's securely founded station. Forth from his head the Cows draw milk, and, wearing his vesture, with their foot have drunk the water.

verses.sa:
माता पितरमृत आ बभाज धीत्यग्रे मनसा सं हि जग्मे ।
सा बीभत्सुर्गर्भरसा निविद्धा नमस्वन्त इदुपवाकमीयुः॥
verses.tr: mātā pitaramṛta ā babhāja dhītyagre manasā saṃ hi jagme sā bībhatsurgarbharasā nividdhā namasvanta idupavākamīyuḥ
verses.en: The Mother gave the Sire his share of Order: with thought, at first, she wedded him in spirit. She, the coy Dame, was filled with dew prolific: with adoration men approached to praise her.

verses.sa:
युक्ता मातासीद् धुरि दक्षिणाया अतिष्ठद् गर्भो वृजनीष्वन्तः ।
अमीमेद् वत्सो अनु गामपश्यद् विश्वरूप्यं त्रिषु योजनेषु॥
verses.tr: yuktā mātāsīd dhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhad garbho vṛjanīṣvantaḥ amīmed vatso anu gāmapaśyad viśvarūpyaṃ triṣu yojaneṣu
verses.en: Yoked was the Mother to the boon Cow's car-pole: in the dank rows of cloud the Infant rested. Then the Calf lowed, and looked upon the Mother, the Cow who wears all shapes in three directions.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो मातॄस्त्रीन् पितॄन् बिभ्रदेक ऊर्ध्वस्तस्थौ नेमव ग्लापयन्ति ।
मन्त्रयन्ते दिवो अमुष्य पृष्ठे विश्वविदं वाचमविश्वमिन्वाम्॥
verses.tr: tisro mātṝstrīn pitṝn bibhradeka ūrdhvastasthau nemava glāpayanti mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavidaṃ vācamaviśvaminvām
verses.en: Bearing three Mothers and three Fathers, single he stood erect: they never make him weary. There on the pitch of heaven they speak together in speech all-knowing but not all-impelling.

verses.sa:
द्वादशारं नहि तज्जराय वर्वर्ति चक्रं परि द्यामृतस्य ।
आ पुत्रा अग्ने मिथुनासो अत्र सप्त शतानि विंशतिश्च तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: dvādaśāraṃ nahi tajjarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyāmṛtasya ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiśca tasthuḥ
verses.en: Formed with twelve spokes, by length of time, unweakened, rolls round the heaven this wheel of during Order. Herein established, joined in pairs together, seven hundred Sons and twenty stand, O Agni.

verses.sa:
पञ्चपादं पितरं द्वादशाकृतिं दिव आहुः परे अर्धे पुरीषिणम् ।
अथेमे अन्य उपरे विचक्षणं सप्तचक्रे षळर आहुरर्पितम्॥
verses.tr: pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam atheme anya upare vicakṣaṇaṃ saptacakre ṣaḻara āhurarpitam
verses.en: They call him in the farther half of heaven the Sire five-footed, of twelve forms, wealthy in watery store. These others say that he, God with far-seeing eyes, is mounted on the lower seven-wheeled, six-spoked car.

verses.sa:
पञ्चारे चक्रे परिवर्तमाने तस्मिन्ना तस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तस्य नाक्षस्तप्यते भूरिभारः सनादेव न शीर्यते सनाभिः॥
verses.tr: pañcāre cakre parivartamāne tasminnā tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā tasya nākṣastapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanādeva na śīryate sanābhiḥ
verses.en: Upon this five-spoked wheel revolving ever all living creatures rest and are dependent. Its axle, heavy-laden, is not heated: the nave from ancient time remains unbroken.

verses.sa:
सनेमि चक्रमजरं वि वावृत उत्तानायां दश युक्ता वहन्ति ।
सूर्यस्य चक्षू रजसैत्यावृतं तस्मिन्नार्पिता भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: sanemi cakramajaraṃ vi vāvṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti sūryasya cakṣū rajasaityāvṛtaṃ tasminnārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: The wheel revolves, unwasting, with its felly: ten draw it, yoked to the far-stretching car-pole. The Sun's eye moves encompassed by the region: on him dependent rest all living creatures.

verses.sa:
साकंजानां सप्तथमाहुरेकजं षळिद् यमा ऋषयो देवजा इति ।
तेषामिष्टानि विहितानि धामशः स्थात्रे रेजन्ते विकृतानि रूपशः॥
verses.tr: sākaṃjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajaṃ ṣaḻid yamā ṛṣayo devajā iti teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśaḥ sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ
verses.en: Of the co-born they call the seventh single-born; the six twin pairs are called Rsis, Children of Gods. Their good gifts sought of men are ranged in order due, and various in their form move for the Lord who guides.

verses.sa:
स्त्रियः सतीस्ताँ उ मे पुंस आहुः पश्यदक्षण्वान्न वि चेतदन्धः ।
कविर्यः पुत्रः स ईमा चिकेत यस्ता विजानात् स पितुष्पितासत्॥
verses.tr: striyaḥ satīstāṃ u me puṃsa āhuḥ paśyadakṣaṇvānna vi cetadandhaḥ kaviryaḥ putraḥ sa īmā ciketa yastā vijānāt sa pituṣpitāsat
verses.en: They told me these were males, though truly females: he who hath eyes sees this, the blind discerns not. The son who is a sage hath comprehended: who knows this rightly is his father's father.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पर एनावरेण पदा वत्सं बिभ्रती गौरुदस्थात् ।
सा कद्रीची कं स्विदर्धं परागात् क्व स्वित् सूते नहि यूथे अन्तः॥
verses.tr: avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaurudasthāt sā kadrīcī kaṃ svidardhaṃ parāgāt kva svit sūte nahi yūthe antaḥ
verses.en: Beneath the upper realm, above this lower, bearing her calf at foot the Cow hath risen. Witherward, to what place hath she departed? Where calves she? Not amid this herd of cattle.

verses.sa:
अवः परेण पितरं यो अस्यानुवेद पर एनावरेण ।
कवीयमानः क इह प्र वोचद् देवं मनः कुतो अधि प्रजातम्॥
verses.tr: avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asyānuveda para enāvareṇa kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocad devaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam
verses.en: Who, that the father of this Calf discerneth beneath the upper realm, above the lower, Showing himself a sage, may here declare it? Whence hath the Godlike spirit had its rising?

verses.sa:
ये अर्वाञ्चस्ताँ उ पराच आहुर्ये पराञ्चस्ताँ उ अर्वाच आहुः ।
इन्द्रश्च या चक्रथुः सोम तानि धुरा न युक्ता रजसो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ye arvāñcastāṃ u parāca āhurye parāñcastāṃ u arvāca āhuḥ indraśca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā na yuktā rajaso vahanti
verses.en: Those that come hitherward they call departing, those that depart they call directed hither. And what so ye have made, Indra and Soma, steeds bear as 'twere yoked to the region's car-pole.

verses.sa:
द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परि षस्वजाते ।
तयोरन्यः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वत्त्यनश्नन्नन्यो अभि चाकशीति॥
verses.tr: dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhi cākaśīti
verses.en: Two Birds with fair wings, knit with bonds of friendship, in the same sheltering tree have found a refuge. One of the twain eats the sweet Fig-tree's fruitage; the other eating not regardeth only.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुपर्णा अमृतस्य भागमनिमेषं विदथाभिस्वरन्ति ।
इनो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः स मा धीरः पाकमत्रा विवेश॥
verses.tr: yatrā suparṇā amṛtasya bhāgamanimeṣaṃ vidathābhisvaranti ino viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ sa mā dhīraḥ pākamatrā viveśa
verses.en: Where those fine Birds hymn ceaselessly their portion of life eternal, and the sacred synods, There is the Universe's mighty Keeper, who, wise, hath entered into me the simple.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् वृक्षे मध्वदः सुपर्णा निविशन्ते सुवते चाधि विश्वे ।
तस्येदाहुः पिप्पलं स्वाद्वग्रे तन्नोन्नशद्यः पितरं न वेद॥
verses.tr: yasmin vṛkṣe madhvadaḥ suparṇā niviśante suvate cādhi viśve tasyedāhuḥ pippalaṃ svādvagre tannonnaśadyaḥ pitaraṃ na veda
verses.en: The, tree whereon the fine Birds eat the sweetness, where they all rest and procreate their offspring,-- Upon its top they say the fig is luscious none gaineth it who knoweth not the Father.

verses.sa:
यद् गायत्रे अधि गायत्रमाहितं त्रैष्टुभाद् वा त्रैष्टुभं निरतक्षत ।
यद् वा जगज्जगत्याहितं पदं य इत् तद् विदुस्ते अमृतत्वमानशुः॥
verses.tr: yad gāyatre adhi gāyatramāhitaṃ traiṣṭubhād vā traiṣṭubhaṃ niratakṣata yad vā jagajjagatyāhitaṃ padaṃ ya it tad viduste amṛtatvamānaśuḥ
verses.en: How on the Gayatri the Gayatri was based, how from the Tristup they fashioned the Tristup forth, How on the Jagati was based the Jagati,--they who know this have won themselves immortal life.

verses.sa:
गायत्रेण प्रति मिमीते अर्कमर्केण साम त्रैष्टुभेन वाकम् ।
वाकेन वाकं द्विपदा चतुष्पदा ऽक्षरेण मिमते सप्त वाणीः॥
verses.tr: gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkamarkeṇa sāma traiṣṭubhena vākam vākena vākaṃ dvipadā catuṣpadā 'kṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ
verses.en: With Gayatri he measures out the praise-song, Sama with praise-song, triplet with the Tristup. The triplet with the two or four-foot measure, and with the syllable they form seven metres.

verses.sa:
जगता सिन्धुं दिव्यस्तभायद् रथंतरे सूर्यं पर्यपश्यत् ।
गायत्रस्य समिधस्तिस्र आहुस्ततो मह्ना प्र रिरिचे महित्वा॥
verses.tr: jagatā sindhuṃ divyastabhāyad rathaṃtare sūryaṃ paryapaśyat gāyatrasya samidhastisra āhustato mahnā pra ririce mahitvā
verses.en: With Jagati the flood in heaven he stablished, and saw the Sun in the Rathantara Saman. Gayatri hath, they say, three brands for kindling: hence it excels in majesty and vigour.

verses.sa:
उप ह्वये सुदुघां धेनुमेतां सुहस्तो गोधुगुत दोहदेनाम् ।
श्रेष्ठं सवं सविता साविषन्नो ऽभीद्धो घर्मस्तदु षु प्र वोचम्॥
verses.tr: upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenumetāṃ suhasto godhuguta dohadenām śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣanno 'bhīddho gharmastadu ṣu pra vocam
verses.en: I invocate the milch-cow good for milking so that the milker, deft of hand, may drain her. May Savitar give goodliest stimulation. The caldron is made hot; I will proclaim it.

verses.sa:
हिङ्कृण्वती वसुपत्नी वसूनां वत्समिच्छन्ती मनसाभ्यागात् ।
दुहामश्विभ्यां पयो अघ्न्येयं सा वर्धतां महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: hiṅkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsamicchantī manasābhyāgāt duhāmaśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: She, lady of all treasure, is come hither yearning in spirit for her calf and lowing. May this cow yield her milk for both the Asvins, and may she prosper to our high advantage.

verses.sa:
गौरमीमेदनु वत्सं मिषन्तं मूर्धानं हिङ्ङकृणोन्मातवा उ ।
सृक्वाणं घर्ममभि वावशाना मिमाति मायुं पयते पयोभिः॥
verses.tr: gauramīmedanu vatsaṃ miṣantaṃ mūrdhānaṃ hiṅṅakṛṇonmātavā u sṛkvāṇaṃ gharmamabhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ
verses.en: The cow hath lowed after her blinking youngling; she licks his forehead, as she lows, to form it. His mouth she fondly calls to her warm udder, and suckles him with milk while gently lowing.

verses.sa:
अयं स शिङ्क्ते येन गौरभीवृता मिमाति मायुं ध्वसनावधि श्रिता ।
सा चित्तिभिर्नि हि चकार मर्त्यं विद्युद् भवन्ती प्रति वव्रिमौहत॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaurabhīvṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāvadhi śritā sā cittibhirni hi cakāra martyaṃ vidyud bhavantī prati vavrimauhata
verses.en: He also snorts, by whom encompassed round the Cow laws as she clings unto the shedder of the rain. She with her shrilling cries hath humbled mortal man, and, turned to lightning, hath stripped off her covering robe.

verses.sa:
अनच्छये तुरगातु जीवमेजद्ध्रुवं मध्य आ पस्त्यानाम् ।
जीवो मृतस्य चरति स्वधाभिरमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः॥
verses.tr: anacchaye turagātu jīvamejaddhruvaṃ madhya ā pastyānām jīvo mṛtasya carati svadhābhiramartyo martyenā sayoniḥ
verses.en: That which hath breath and speed and life and motion lies firmly stablished in the midst of houses. Living, by offerings to the Dead he moveth Immortal One, the brother of the mortal.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानमा च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् ।
स सध्रीचीः स विषूचीर्वसान आ वरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ
verses.en: I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing. He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sa:
य ईं चकार न सो अस्य वेद य ईं ददर्श हिरुगिन्नु तस्मात् ।
स मातुर्योना परिवीतो अन्तर्बहुप्रजा निर्ऋतिमा विवेश॥
verses.tr: ya īṃ cakāra na so asya veda ya īṃ dadarśa hiruginnu tasmāt sa māturyonā parivīto antarbahuprajā nirṛtimā viveśa
verses.en: He who hath made him cloth not comprehend him: from him who saw him surely is he hidden. He, yet enveloped in his Mother's bosom, source of much life, hath sunk into destruction.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्मे पिता जनिता नाभिरत्र बन्धुर्मे माता पृथिवी महीयम् ।
उत्तानयोश्चम्वो३र्योनिरन्तरत्रा पिता दुहितुर्गर्भमाधात्॥
verses.tr: dyaurme pitā janitā nābhiratra bandhurme mātā pṛthivī mahīyam uttānayoścamvo3ryonirantaratrā pitā duhiturgarbhamādhāt
verses.en: Dyaus is my Father, my begetter: kinship is here. This great earth is my kin and Mother. Between the wide-spread world-halves is the birth-place: the Father laid the Daughter's germ within it.

verses.sa:
पृच्छामि त्वा परमन्तं पृथिव्याः पृच्छामि यत्र भुवनस्य नाभिः ।
पृच्छामि त्वा वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः पृच्छामि वाचः परमं व्योम॥
verses.tr: pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi yatra bhuvanasya nābhiḥ pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma
verses.en: I ask thee of the earth's extremest limit, where is the centre of the world, I ask thee. I ask thee of the Stallion's seed prolific, I ask of highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
इयं वेदिः परो अन्तः पृथिव्या अयं यज्ञो भुवनस्य नाभिः ।
अयं सोमो वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतो ब्रह्मायं वाचः परमं व्योम ॥३॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ yajño bhuvanasya nābhiḥ ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto brahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma 3
verses.en: This altar is the earth's extremest limit; this sacrifice of ours is the world's centre. The Stallion's seed prolific is the Soma; this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sa:
सप्तार्धगर्भा भुवनस्य रेतो विष्णोस्तिष्ठन्ति प्रदिशा विधर्मणि ।
ते धीतिभिर्मनसा ते विपश्चितः परिभुवः परि भवन्ति विश्वतः ॥३॥
verses.tr: saptārdhagarbhā bhuvanasya reto viṣṇostiṣṭhanti pradiśā vidharmaṇi te dhītibhirmanasā te vipaścitaḥ paribhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ 3
verses.en: Seven germs unripened yet are heaven's prolific seed: their functions they maintain by Visnu's ordinance. Endued with wisdom through intelligence and thought, they compass us about present on every side.

verses.sa:
न वि जानामि यदिवेदमस्मि निण्यः संनद्धो मनसा चरामि ।
यदा मागन् प्रथमजा ऋतस्यादिद् वाचो अश्नुवे भागमस्याः ॥३॥
verses.tr: na vi jānāmi yadivedamasmi niṇyaḥ saṃnaddho manasā carāmi yadā māgan prathamajā ṛtasyādid vāco aśnuve bhāgamasyāḥ 3
verses.en: What thing I truly am I know not clearly: mysterious, fettered in my mind I wander. When the first-born of holy Law approached me, then of this speech I first obtain a portion.

verses.sa:
अपाङ् प्राङेति स्वधया गृभीतो ऽमर्त्यो मर्त्येना सयोनिः ।
ता शश्वन्ता विषूचीना वियन्ता न्य१न्यं चिक्युर्न नि चिक्युरन्यम् ॥३॥
verses.tr: apāṅ prāṅeti svadhayā gṛbhīto 'martyo martyenā sayoniḥ tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā nya1nyaṃ cikyurna ni cikyuranyam 3
verses.en: Back, forward goes he, grasped by strength inherent, the Immortal born the brother of the mortal Ceaseless they move in opposite directions: men mark the one, and fail to mark the other.

verses.sa:
ऋचो अक्षरे परमे व्योमन् यस्मिन् देवा अधि विश्वे निषेदुः ।
यस्तन्न वेद किमृचा करिष्यति य इत् तद् विदुस्त इमे समासते ॥३॥
verses.tr: ṛco akṣare parame vyoman yasmin devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya it tad vidusta ime samāsate 3
verses.en: Upon what syllable of holy praise-song, as twere their highest heaven, the Gods repose them,-- Who knows not this, what will he do with praise-song? But they who know it well sit here assembled.

verses.sa:
सूयवसाद् भगवती हि भूया अथो वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
अद्धि तृणमघ्न्ये विश्वदानीं पिब शुद्धमुदकमाचरन्ती ॥४॥
verses.tr: sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantī 4
verses.en: Fortunate mayst thou be with goodly pasture, and may we also be exceeding wealthy. Feed on the grass, O Cow, at every season, and coming hitherward drink limpid water.

verses.sa:
गौरीर्मिमाय सलिलानि तक्षत्येकपदी द्विपदी सा चतुष्पदी ।
अष्टापदी नवपदी बभूवुषी सहस्राक्षरा परमे व्योमन् ॥४॥
verses.tr: gaurīrmimāya salilāni takṣatyekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā parame vyoman 4
verses.en: Forming the water-floods, the buffalo hath lowed, one-footed or two-footed or four-footed, she, Who hath become eight-footed or hath got nine feet, the thousand-syllabled in the sublimest heaven.

verses.sa:
तस्याः समुद्रा अधि वि क्षरन्ति तेन जीवन्ति प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
ततः क्षरत्यक्षरं तद् विश्वमुप जीवति ॥४॥
verses.tr: tasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ tataḥ kṣaratyakṣaraṃ tad viśvamupa jīvati 4
verses.en: From her descend in streams the seas of water; thereby the world's four regions have their being, Thence flows the imperishable flood and thence the universe hath life.

verses.sa:
शकमयं धूममारादपश्यं विषूवता पर एनावरेण ।
उक्षाणं पृश्निमपचन्त वीरास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ॥४॥
verses.tr: śakamayaṃ dhūmamārādapaśyaṃ viṣūvatā para enāvareṇa ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimapacanta vīrāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan 4
verses.en: I saw from far away the smoke of fuel with spires that rose on high o'er that beneath it. The Mighty Men have dressed the spotted bullock. These were the customs in the days aforetime,

verses.sa:
त्रयः केशिन ऋतुथा वि चक्षते संवत्सरे वपत एक एषाम् ।
विश्वमेको अभि चष्टे शचीभिर्ध्राजिरेकस्य ददृशे न रूपम् ॥४॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ keśina ṛtuthā vi cakṣate saṃvatsare vapata eka eṣām viśvameko abhi caṣṭe śacībhirdhrājirekasya dadṛśe na rūpam 4
verses.en: Three with long tresses show in ordered season. One of them sheareth when the year is ended. One with his powers the universe regardeth: Of one, the sweep is seen, but his figure.

verses.sa:
चत्वारि वाक् परिमिता पदानि तानि विदुर्ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः ।
गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्ति तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्या वदन्ति ॥४॥
verses.tr: catvāri vāk parimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti 4
verses.en: Speech hath been measured out in four divisions, the Brahmans who have understanding know them. Three kept in close concealment cause no motion; of speech, men speak only the fourth division.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं मित्रं वरुणमग्निमाहुरथो दिव्यः स सुपर्णो गरुत्मान् ।
एकं सद् विप्रा बहुधा वदन्त्यग्निं यमं मातरिश्वानमाहुः ॥४॥
verses.tr: indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇamagnimāhuratho divyaḥ sa suparṇo garutmān ekaṃ sad viprā bahudhā vadantyagniṃ yamaṃ mātariśvānamāhuḥ 4
verses.en: They call him Indra, Mitra, Varuna, Agni, and he is heavenly nobly-winged Garutman. To what is One, sages give many a title they call it Agni, Yama, Matarisvan.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत्पतन्ति ।
त आववृत्रन् त्सदनादृतस्यादिद् घृतेन पृथिवी व्युद्यते ॥४॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divamutpatanti ta āvavṛtran tsadanādṛtasyādid ghṛtena pṛthivī vyudyate 4
verses.en: Dark the descent: the birds are golden-coloured; up to the heaven they fly robed in the waters. Again descend they from the seat of Order, and all the earth is moistened with their fatness.

verses.sa:
द्वादश प्रधयश्चक्रमेकं त्रीणि नभ्यानि क उ तच्चिकेत ।
तस्मिन्त्सा त्साकं त्रिशता न शङ्कवो ऽर्पिताः षष्टिर्न चलाचलासः ॥४॥
verses.tr: dvādaśa pradhayaścakramekaṃ trīṇi nabhyāni ka u tacciketa tasmintsā tsākaṃ triśatā na śaṅkavo 'rpitāḥ ṣaṣṭirna calācalāsaḥ 4
verses.en: Twelve are the fellies, and the wheel is single; three are the naves. What man hath understood it? Therein are set together spokes three hundred and sixty, which in nowise can be loosened.

verses.sa:
यस्ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूर्येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि ।
यो रत्नधा वसुविद् यः सुदत्रः सरस्वति तमिह धातवे कः ॥४॥
verses.tr: yaste stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūryena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi yo ratnadhā vasuvid yaḥ sudatraḥ sarasvati tamiha dhātave kaḥ 4
verses.en: That breast of thine exhaustless, spring of pleasure, wherewith thou feedest all things that are choicest, Wealth-giver, treasure. finder, free bestower,--bring that, Sarasvati, that we may drain it.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन् ।
ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः ॥५॥
verses.tr: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ 5
verses.en: By means of sacrifice the Gods accomplished their sacrifice: these were the earliest ordinances. These Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sadhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa:
समानमेतदुदकमुच्चैत्यव चाहभिः ।
भूमिं पर्जन्या जिन्वन्ति दिवं जिन्वन्त्यग्नयः ॥५॥
verses.tr: samānametadudakamuccaityava cāhabhiḥ bhūmiṃ parjanyā jinvanti divaṃ jinvantyagnayaḥ 5
verses.en: Uniform, with the passing days, this water mounts and fails again. The tempest-clouds give life to earth, and fires re-animate the heaven.

verses.sa:
दिव्यं सुपर्णं वायसं बृहन्तमपां गर्भं दर्शतमोषधीनाम् ।
अभीपतो वृष्टिभिस्तर्पयन्तं सरस्वन्तमवसे जोहवीमि ॥५॥
verses.tr: divyaṃ suparṇaṃ vāyasaṃ bṛhantamapāṃ garbhaṃ darśatamoṣadhīnām abhīpato vṛṣṭibhistarpayantaṃ sarasvantamavase johavīmi 5
verses.en: The Bird Celestial, vast with noble pinion, the lovely germ of plants, the germ of waters, Him who delighteth us with rain in season, Sarasvan I invoke that he may help us.

verses.sa:
कया शुभा सवयसः सनीळाः समान्या मरुतः सं मिमिक्षुः ।
कया मती कुत एतास एते ऽर्चन्ति शुष्मं वृषणो वसूया॥
verses.tr: kayā śubhā savayasaḥ sanīḻāḥ samānyā marutaḥ saṃ mimikṣuḥ kayā matī kuta etāsa ete 'rcanti śuṣmaṃ vṛṣaṇo vasūyā
verses.en: With what bright beauty are the Maruts jointly invested, peers in age, who dwell together? From what place have they come? With what intention? Sing they their strength through love of wealth, these Heroes?

verses.sa:
कस्य ब्रह्माणि जुजुषुर्युवानः को अध्वरे मरुत आ ववर्त ।
श्येनाँ इव ध्रजतो अन्तरिक्षे केन महा मनसा रीरमाम॥
verses.tr: kasya brahmāṇi jujuṣuryuvānaḥ ko adhvare maruta ā vavarta śyenāṃ iva dhrajato antarikṣe kena mahā manasā rīramāma
verses.en: Whose prayers have they, the Youthful Ones, accepted? Who to his sacrifice hath turned the Maruts? We will delay them on their journey sweeping--with what high spirit!--through the air like eagles.

verses.sa:
कुतस्त्वमिन्द्र माहिनः सन्नेको यासि सत्पते किं त इत्था ।
सं पृच्छसे समराणः शुभानैर्वोचेस्तन्नो हरिवो यत्ते अस्मे॥
verses.tr: kutastvamindra māhinaḥ sanneko yāsi satpate kiṃ ta itthā saṃ pṛcchase samarāṇaḥ śubhānairvocestanno harivo yatte asme
verses.en: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us when meeting us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माणि मे मतयः शं सुतासः शुष्म इयर्ति प्रभृतो मे अद्रिः ।
आ शासते प्रति हर्यन्त्युक्थेमा हरी वहतस्ता नो अच्छ॥
verses.tr: brahmāṇi me matayaḥ śaṃ sutāsaḥ śuṣma iyarti prabhṛto me adriḥ ā śāsate prati haryantyukthemā harī vahatastā no accha
verses.en: Mine are devotions, hymns; sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my bolt of thunder. They call for me, their lauds are longing for me. These my Bay Steeds bear me to these oblations.

verses.sa:
अतो वयमन्तमेभिर्युजानाः स्वक्षत्रेभिस्तन्व१ शुम्भमानाः ।
महोभिरेताँ उप युज्महे न्विन्द्र स्वधामनु हि नो बभूथ॥
verses.tr: ato vayamantamebhiryujānāḥ svakṣatrebhistanva1 śumbhamānāḥ mahobhiretāṃ upa yujmahe nvindra svadhāmanu hi no babhūtha
verses.en: Therefore together with our strong companions, having adorned our bodies, now we harness, Our spotted deer with might, for thou, O Indra, hast learnt and understood our Godlike nature.

verses.sa:
क्व१ स्या वो मरुतः स्वधासीद् यन्मामेकं समधत्ताहिहत्ये ।
अहं ह्यु१ग्रस्तविषस्तुविष्मान् विश्वस्य शत्रोरनमं वधस्नैः॥
verses.tr: kva1 syā vo marutaḥ svadhāsīd yanmāmekaṃ samadhattāhihatye ahaṃ hyu1grastaviṣastuviṣmān viśvasya śatroranamaṃ vadhasnaiḥ
verses.en: Where was that nature then of yours, O Maruts, that ye charged me alone to slay the Dragon? For I in truth am fierce and strong and mighty. I bent away from every foeman's weapons.

verses.sa:
भूरि चकर्थ युज्येभिरस्मे समानेभिर्वृषभ पौंस्येभिः ।
भूरीणि हि कृणवामा शविष्ठेन्द्र क्रत्वा मरुतो यद् वशाम॥
verses.tr: bhūri cakartha yujyebhirasme samānebhirvṛṣabha pauṃsyebhiḥ bhūrīṇi hi kṛṇavāmā śaviṣṭhendra kratvā maruto yad vaśāma
verses.en: Yea, much hast thou achieved with us for comrades, with manly valour like thine own, thou Hero. Much may we too achieve, O mightiest Indra, with our great power, we Maruts, when we will it.

verses.sa:
वधीं वृत्रं मरुत इन्द्रियेण स्वेन भामेन तविषो बभूवान् ।
अहमेता मनवे विश्वश्चन्द्राः सुगा अपश्चकर वज्रबाहुः॥
verses.tr: vadhīṃ vṛtraṃ maruta indriyeṇa svena bhāmena taviṣo babhūvān ahametā manave viśvaścandrāḥ sugā apaścakara vajrabāhuḥ
verses.en: Vrtra I slew by mine own strength, O Maruts, having waxed mighty in mine indignation. I with the thunder in my hand created for man these lucid softly flowing waters.

verses.sa:
अनुत्तमा ते मघवन्नकिर्नु न त्वावाँ अस्ति देवता विदानः ।
न जायमानो नशते न जातो यानि करिष्या कृणुहि प्रवृद्ध॥
verses.tr: anuttamā te maghavannakirnu na tvāvāṃ asti devatā vidānaḥ na jāyamāno naśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha
verses.en: Nothing, O Maghavan, stands firm before thee; among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes nigh thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty?

verses.sa:
एकस्य चिन्मे विभ्व१स्त्वोजो या नु दधृष्वान् कृणवै मनीषा ।
अहं ह्यु१ग्रो मरुतो विदानो यानि च्यवमिन्द्र इदीश एषाम्॥
verses.tr: ekasya cinme vibhva1stvojo yā nu dadhṛṣvān kṛṇavai manīṣā ahaṃ hyu1gro maruto vidāno yāni cyavamindra idīśa eṣām
verses.en: Mine only be transcendent power, whatever I, daring in my spirit, may accomplish. For I am known as terrible, O Maruts I, Indra, am the Lord of what I ruined.

verses.sa:
अमन्दन्मा मरुतः स्तोमो अत्र यन्मे नरः श्रुत्यं ब्रह्म चक्र ।
इन्द्राय वृष्णे सुमखाय मह्यं सख्ये सखायस्तन्वे तनूभिः॥
verses.tr: amandanmā marutaḥ stomo atra yanme naraḥ śrutyaṃ brahma cakra indrāya vṛṣṇe sumakhāya mahyaṃ sakhye sakhāyastanve tanūbhiḥ
verses.en: Now, O ye Maruts, hath your praise rejoiced me, the glorious hymn which ye have made me, Heroes! For me, for Indra, champion strong in battle, for me, yourselves, as lovers for a lover.

verses.sa:
एवेदेते प्रति मा रोचमाना अनेद्यः श्रव एषो दधानाः ।
संचक्ष्या मरुतश्चन्द्रवर्णा अच्छान्त मे छदयाथा च नूनम्॥
verses.tr: evedete prati mā rocamānā anedyaḥ śrava eṣo dadhānāḥ saṃcakṣyā marutaścandravarṇā acchānta me chadayāthā ca nūnam
verses.en: Here, truly, they send forth their sheen to meet me, wearing their blameless glory and their vigour. When I have seen you, Maruts, in gay splendour, ye have delighted me, so now delight me.

verses.sa:
को न्वत्र मरुतो मामहे वः प्र यातन सखीँरच्छा सखायः ।
मन्मानि चित्रा अपिवातयन्त एषां भूत नवेदा म ऋतानाम्॥
verses.tr: ko nvatra maruto māmahe vaḥ pra yātana sakhīṃracchā sakhāyaḥ manmāni citrā apivātayanta eṣāṃ bhūta navedā ma ṛtānām
verses.en: Who here hath magnified you, O ye Maruts? speed forward, O ye lovers, to your lovers. Ye Radiant Ones, assisting their devotions, of these my holy rites he ye regardful.

verses.sa:
आ यद् दुवस्याद् दुवसे न कारुरस्माञ्चक्रे मान्यस्य मेधा ।
ओ षु वर्त्त मरुतो विप्रमच्छेमा ब्रह्माणि जरिता वो अर्चत्॥
verses.tr: ā yad duvasyād duvase na kārurasmāñcakre mānyasya medhā o ṣu vartta maruto vipramacchemā brahmāṇi jaritā vo arcat
verses.en: To this hath Manya's wisdom brought us, so as to aid, as aids the poet him who worships. Bring hither quick! On to the sage, ye Maruts! These prayers for you the singer hath recited.

verses.sa:
एष वः स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa vaḥ stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's son, Mandarya, Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance!

verses.sa:
तन्नु वोचाम रभसाय जन्मने पूर्वं महित्वं वृषभस्य केतवे ।
ऐधेव यामन् मरुतस्तुविष्वणो युधेव शक्रास्तविषाणि कर्तन॥
verses.tr: tannu vocāma rabhasāya janmane pūrvaṃ mahitvaṃ vṛṣabhasya ketave aidheva yāman marutastuviṣvaṇo yudheva śakrāstaviṣāṇi kartana
verses.en: Now let us publish, for the vigorous company the herald of the Strong One, their primeval might. With fire upon your way, O Maruts loud of voice, with battle, Mighty Ones, achieve your deeds of strength.

verses.sa:
नित्यं न सूनुं मधु बिभ्रत उप क्रीळन्ति क्रीळा विदथेषु घृष्वयः ।
नक्षन्ति रुद्रा अवसा नमस्विनं न मर्धन्ति स्वतवसो हविष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: nityaṃ na sūnuṃ madhu bibhrata upa krīḻanti krīḻā vidatheṣu ghṛṣvayaḥ nakṣanti rudrā avasā namasvinaṃ na mardhanti svatavaso haviṣkṛtam
verses.en: Bringing the pleasant meath as 'twere their own dear son, they sport in sportive wise gay at their gatherings. The Rudras come with succour to the worshipper; self-strong they fail not him who offers sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यस्मा ऊमासो अमृता अरासत रायस्पोषं च हविषा ददाशुषे ।
उक्षन्त्यस्मै मरुतो हिता इव पुरू रजांसि पयसा मयोभुवः॥
verses.tr: yasmā ūmāso amṛtā arāsata rāyaspoṣaṃ ca haviṣā dadāśuṣe ukṣantyasmai maruto hitā iva purū rajāṃsi payasā mayobhuvaḥ
verses.en: To whomsoever, bringer of oblations, they immortal guardians, have given plenteous wealth, For him, like loving friends, the Maruts bringing bliss bedew the regions round with milk abundantly.

verses.sa:
आ ये रजांसि तविषीभिरव्यत प्र व एवासः स्वयतासो अध्रजन् ।
भयन्ते विश्वा भुवनानि हर्म्या चित्रो वो यामः प्रयतास्वृष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: ā ye rajāṃsi taviṣībhiravyata pra va evāsaḥ svayatāso adhrajan bhayante viśvā bhuvanāni harmyā citro vo yāmaḥ prayatāsvṛṣṭiṣu
verses.en: Ye who with mighty powers have stirred the regions up, your coursers have sped forth directed by themselves. All creatures of the earth, all dwellings are afraid, for brilliant is your coming with your spears advanced.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वेषयामा नदयन्त पर्वतान् दिवो वा पृष्ठं नर्या अचुच्यवुः ।
विश्वो वो अज्मन् भयते वनस्पती रथीयन्तीव प्र जिहीत ओषधिः॥
verses.tr: yat tveṣayāmā nadayanta parvatān divo vā pṛṣṭhaṃ naryā acucyavuḥ viśvo vo ajman bhayate vanaspatī rathīyantīva pra jihīta oṣadhiḥ
verses.en: When they in dazzling rush have made the mountains roar, and shaken heaven's high back in their heroic strength, Each sovran of the forest fears as ye drive near, aid the shrubs fly before you swift as whirling wheels.

verses.sa:
यूयं न उग्रा मरुतः सुचेतुना ऽरिष्टग्रामाः सुमतिं पिपर्तन ।
यत्रा वो दिद्युद् रदति क्रिविर्दती रिणाति पश्वः सुधितेव बर्हणा॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ na ugrā marutaḥ sucetunā 'riṣṭagrāmāḥ sumatiṃ pipartana yatrā vo didyud radati krivirdatī riṇāti paśvaḥ sudhiteva barhaṇā
verses.en: Terrible Maruts, ye with ne'er-diminished host, with great benevolence fulfil our heart's desire. Where'er your lightning bites armed with its gory teeth it crunches up the cattle like a well-aimed dart.

verses.sa:
प्र स्कम्भदेष्णा अनवभ्रराधसो ऽलातृणासो विदथेषु सुष्टुताः ।
अर्चन्त्यर्कं मदिरस्य पीतये विदुर्वीरस्य प्रथमानि पौंस्या॥
verses.tr: pra skambhadeṣṇā anavabhrarādhaso 'lātṛṇāso vidatheṣu suṣṭutāḥ arcantyarkaṃ madirasya pītaye vidurvīrasya prathamāni pauṃsyā
verses.en: Givers of during gifts whose bounties never fail, free from ill-will, at sacrifices glorified, They sing their song aloud that they may drink sweet juice: well do they know the Hero's first heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
शतभुजिभिस्तमभिह्रुतेरघात् पूर्भी रक्षता मरुतो यमावत ।
जनं यमुग्रास्तवसो विरप्शिनः पाथना शंसात् तनयस्य पुष्टिषु॥
verses.tr: śatabhujibhistamabhihruteraghāt pūrbhī rakṣatā maruto yamāvata janaṃ yamugrāstavaso virapśinaḥ pāthanā śaṃsāt tanayasya puṣṭiṣu
verses.en: With castles hundredfold, O Maruts, guard ye well the man whom ye have loved from ruin and from sin,-- The man whom ye the fierce, the Mighty ones who roar, preserve from calumny by cherishing his seed.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि भद्रा मरुतो रथेषु वो मिथस्पृध्येव तविषाण्याहिता ।
अंसेष्वा वः प्रपथेषु खादयो ऽक्षो वश्चक्रा समया वि वावृते॥
verses.tr: viśvāni bhadrā maruto ratheṣu vo mithaspṛdhyeva taviṣāṇyāhitā aṃseṣvā vaḥ prapatheṣu khādayo 'kṣo vaścakrā samayā vi vāvṛte
verses.en: O Maruts, in your cars are all things that are good: great powers are set as 'twere in rivalry therein. Rings are upon your shoulders when ye journey forth: your axle turns together both the chariot wheels.

verses.sa:
भूरीणि भद्रा नर्येषु बाहुषु वक्षस्सु रुक्मा रभसासो अञ्जयः ।
अंसेष्वेताः पविषु क्षुरा अधि वयो न पक्षान् व्यनु श्रियो धिरे॥
verses.tr: bhūrīṇi bhadrā naryeṣu bāhuṣu vakṣassu rukmā rabhasāso añjayaḥ aṃseṣvetāḥ paviṣu kṣurā adhi vayo na pakṣān vyanu śriyo dhire
verses.en: Held in your manly arms are many goodly things, gold chains are on your chests, and glistering ornaments, Deer-skins are on their shoulders, on their fellies knives: they spread their glory out as birds spread out their wings.

verses.sa:
महान्तो मह्ना विभ्वो३ विभूतयो दूरेदृशो ये दिव्या इव स्तृभिः ।
मन्द्राः सुजिह्वाः स्वरितार आसभिः सम्मिश्ला इन्द्रे मरुतः परिष्टुभः॥
verses.tr: mahānto mahnā vibhvo3 vibhūtayo dūredṛśo ye divyā iva stṛbhiḥ mandrāḥ sujihvāḥ svaritāra āsabhiḥ sammiślā indre marutaḥ pariṣṭubhaḥ
verses.en: Mighty in mightiness, pervading, passing strong, visible from afar as 'twere with stars of heaven, Lovely with pleasant tongues, sweet singers with their mouths, the Maruts, joined with Indra, shout forth all around.

verses.sa:
तद् वः सुजाता मरुतो महित्वनं दीर्घं वो दात्रमदितेरिव व्रतम् ।
इन्द्रश्चन त्यजसा वि ह्रुणाति तज्जनाय यस्मै सुकृते अराध्वम्॥
verses.tr: tad vaḥ sujātā maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ vo dātramaditeriva vratam indraścana tyajasā vi hruṇāti tajjanāya yasmai sukṛte arādhvam
verses.en: This is your majesty, ye Maruts nobly born, far as the sway of Aditi your bounty spreads. Even Indra by desertion never disannuls the boon bestowed by you upon the pious man.

verses.sa:
तद् वो जामित्वं मरुतः परे युगे पुरू यच्छंसममृतास आवत ।
अया धिया मनवे श्रुष्टिमाव्या साकं नरो दंसनैरा चिकित्रिरे॥
verses.tr: tad vo jāmitvaṃ marutaḥ pare yuge purū yacchaṃsamamṛtāsa āvata ayā dhiyā manave śruṣṭimāvyā sākaṃ naro daṃsanairā cikitrire
verses.en: This is your kinship, Maruts, that, Immortals, ye were oft in olden time regardful of our call, Having vouchsafed to man a hearing through this prayer, by wondrous deeds the Heroes have displayed their might.

verses.sa:
येन दीर्घं मरुतः शूशवाम युष्माकेन परीणसा तुरासः ।
आ यत् ततनन् वृजने जनास एभिर्यज्ञेभिस्तदभीष्टिमश्याम्॥
verses.tr: yena dīrghaṃ marutaḥ śūśavāma yuṣmākena parīṇasā turāsaḥ ā yat tatanan vṛjane janāsa ebhiryajñebhistadabhīṣṭimaśyām
verses.en: That, O ye Maruts, we may long time flourish through your abundant riches, O swift movers, And that our men may spread in the encampment, let me complete the rite with these oblations.

verses.sa:
एष वः स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa vaḥ stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: May this your laud, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's son, Mandarya, Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
सहस्रं त इन्द्रोतयो नः सहस्रमिषो हरिवो गूर्ततमाः ।
सहस्रं रायो मादयध्यै सहस्रिण उप नो यन्तु वाजाः॥
verses.tr: sahasraṃ ta indrotayo naḥ sahasramiṣo harivo gūrtatamāḥ sahasraṃ rāyo mādayadhyai sahasriṇa upa no yantu vājāḥ
verses.en: A THOUSAND are thy helps for us, O Indra: a thousand, Lord of Bays, thy choice refreshments. Wealth of a thousand sorts hast thou to cheer us: may precious goods come nigh to us in thousands.

verses.sa:
आ नोऽवोभिर्मरुतो यान्त्वच्छा ज्येष्ठेभिर्वा बृहद् दिवैः सुमायाः ।
अध यदेषां नियुतः परमाः समुद्रस्य चिद् धनयन्त पारे॥
verses.tr: ā no'vobhirmaruto yāntvacchā jyeṣṭhebhirvā bṛhad divaiḥ sumāyāḥ adha yadeṣāṃ niyutaḥ paramāḥ samudrasya cid dhanayanta pāre
verses.en: May the most sapient Maruts, with protection, with best boons brought from lofty heaven, approach us, Now when their team of the most noble horses speeds even on the sea's extremest limit.

verses.sa:
मिम्यक्ष येषु सुधिता घृताची हिरण्यनिर्णिगुपरा न ऋष्टिः ।
गुहा चरन्ती मनुषो न योषा सभावती विदथ्येव सं वाक्॥
verses.tr: mimyakṣa yeṣu sudhitā ghṛtācī hiraṇyanirṇiguparā na ṛṣṭiḥ guhā carantī manuṣo na yoṣā sabhāvatī vidathyeva saṃ vāk
verses.en: Close to them clings one moving in seclusion, like a man's wife, like a spear carried rearward, Well grasped, bright, decked with gold there is Vak also, like to a courtly, eloquent dame, among them.

verses.sa:
परा शुभ्रा अयासो यव्या साधारण्येव मरुतो मिमिक्षुः ।
न रोदसी अप नुदन्त घोरा जुषन्त वृधं सख्याय देवाः॥
verses.tr: parā śubhrā ayāso yavyā sādhāraṇyeva maruto mimikṣuḥ na rodasī apa nudanta ghorā juṣanta vṛdhaṃ sakhyāya devāḥ
verses.en: Far off the brilliant, never-weary Maruts cling to the young Maid as a joint possession. The fierce Gods drave not Rodasi before them, but wished for her to grow their friend and fellow.

verses.sa:
जोषद् यदीमसुर्या सचध्यै विषितस्तुका रोदसी नृमणाः ।
आ सूर्येव विधतो रथं गात् त्वेषप्रतीका नभसो नेत्या॥
verses.tr: joṣad yadīmasuryā sacadhyai viṣitastukā rodasī nṛmaṇāḥ ā sūryeva vidhato rathaṃ gāt tveṣapratīkā nabhaso netyā
verses.en: When chose immortal Rodasi to follow--she with loose tresses and heroic spirit-- She climbed her servant's chariot, she like Surya with cloud-like motion and refulgent aspect.

verses.sa:
आस्थापयन्त युवतिं युवानः शुभे निमिश्लां विदथेषु पज्राम् ।
अर्को यद् वो मरुतो हविष्मान् गायद् गाथं सुतसोमो दुवस्यन्॥
verses.tr: āsthāpayanta yuvatiṃ yuvānaḥ śubhe nimiślāṃ vidatheṣu pajrām arko yad vo maruto haviṣmān gāyad gāthaṃ sutasomo duvasyan
verses.en: Upon their car the young men set the Maiden wedded to glory, mighty in assemblies, When your song, Maruts, rose, and, with oblation, the Soma-pourer sang his hymn in worship.

verses.sa:
प्र तं विवक्मि वक्म्यो य एषां मरुतां महिमा सत्यो अस्ति ।
सचा यदीं वृषमणा अहंयुः स्थिरा चिज्जनीर्वहते सुभागाः॥
verses.tr: pra taṃ vivakmi vakmyo ya eṣāṃ marutāṃ mahimā satyo asti sacā yadīṃ vṛṣamaṇā ahaṃyuḥ sthirā cijjanīrvahate subhāgāḥ
verses.en: I will declare the greatness of these Maruts, their real greatness, worthy to be lauded, How, with them, she though firm, strong-minded, haughty, travels to women happy in their fortune.

verses.sa:
पान्ति मित्रावरुणाववद्याच्चयत ईमर्यमो अप्रशस्तान् ।
उत च्यवन्ते अच्युता ध्रुवाणि वावृध ईं मरुतो दातिवारः॥
verses.tr: pānti mitrāvaruṇāvavadyāccayata īmaryamo apraśastān uta cyavante acyutā dhruvāṇi vāvṛdha īṃ maruto dātivāraḥ
