verses.en: Mitra and Varuna they guard from censure: Aryaman too, discovers worthless sinners Firm things are overthrown that ne'er were shaken: he prospers, Maruts, who gives choice oblations.

verses.sa:
नही नु वो मरुतो अन्त्यस्मे आरात्ताच्चिच्छवसो अन्तमापुः ।
ते धृष्णुना शवसा शूशुवांसो ऽर्णो न द्वेषो धृषता परि ष्ठुः॥
verses.tr: nahī nu vo maruto antyasme ārāttāccicchavaso antamāpuḥ te dhṛṣṇunā śavasā śūśuvāṃso 'rṇo na dveṣo dhṛṣatā pari ṣṭhuḥ
verses.en: None of us, Maruts, near or at a distance, hath ever reached the limit of your vigour. They in courageous might still waxing boldly have compassed round their foemen like an ocean.

verses.sa:
वयमद्येन्द्रस्य प्रेष्ठा वयं श्वो वोचेमहि समर्ये ।
वयं पुरा महि च नो अनु द्यून् तन्न ऋभुक्षा नरामनु ष्यात्॥
verses.tr: vayamadyendrasya preṣṭhā vayaṃ śvo vocemahi samarye vayaṃ purā mahi ca no anu dyūn tanna ṛbhukṣā narāmanu ṣyāt
verses.en: May we this day be dearest friends of Indra, and let us call on him in fight to-morrow. So were we erst. New might attend us daily! So be with us! Rbhuksan of the Heroes!

verses.sa:
एष वः स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa vaḥ stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: May this your laud, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mana's son, Mandarya, Bring offspring for ourselves with. food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
यज्ञायज्ञा वः समना तुतुर्वणिर्धियंधियं वो देवया उ दधिध्वे ।
आ वोऽर्वाचः सुविताय रोदस्योर्महे ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: yajñāyajñā vaḥ samanā tuturvaṇirdhiyaṃdhiyaṃ vo devayā u dadhidhve ā vo'rvācaḥ suvitāya rodasyormahe vavṛtyāmavase suvṛktibhiḥ
verses.en: Swift gain is his who hath you near at every rite: ye welcome every song of him who serves the Gods. So may I turn you hither with fair hymns of praise to give great succour for the weal of both the worlds.

verses.sa:
वव्रासो न ये स्वजाः स्वतवस इषं स्वरभिजायन्त धूतयः ।
सहस्रियासो अपां नोर्मय आसा गावो वन्द्यासो नोक्षणः॥
verses.tr: vavrāso na ye svajāḥ svatavasa iṣaṃ svarabhijāyanta dhūtayaḥ sahasriyāso apāṃ normaya āsā gāvo vandyāso nokṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Surrounding, as it were, self-born, self-powerful, they spring to life the shakers-down of food and light; Like as the countess undulations of the floods, worthy of praise when near, like bullocks and like kine.

verses.sa:
सोमासो न ये सुतास्तृप्तांशवो हृत्सु पीतासो दुवसो नासते ।
ऐषामंसेषु रम्भिणीव रारभे हस्तेषु खादिश्च कृतिश्च सं दधे॥
verses.tr: somāso na ye sutāstṛptāṃśavo hṛtsu pītāso duvaso nāsate aiṣāmaṃseṣu rambhiṇīva rārabhe hasteṣu khādiśca kṛtiśca saṃ dadhe
verses.en: They who, like Somas with their well-grown stalks pressed out, imbibed within the heart, dwell there in friendly wise. Upon their shoulders rests as 'twere a warrior's spear and in their hand they hold a dagger and a ring.

verses.sa:
अव स्वयुक्ता दिव आ वृथा ययुरमर्त्याः कशया चोदत त्मना ।
अरेणवस्तुविजाता अचुच्यवुर्दृळहानि चिन्मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: ava svayuktā diva ā vṛthā yayuramartyāḥ kaśayā codata tmanā areṇavastuvijātā acucyavurdṛḻahāni cinmaruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Self-yoked they have descended lightly from the sky. With your own lash, Immortals, urge yourselves to speed. Unstained by dust the Maruts, mighty in their strength, have cast down e'en firm things, armed with their shining spears.

verses.sa:
को वोऽन्तर्मरुत ऋष्टिविद्युतो रेजति त्मना हन्वेव जिह्वया ।
धन्वच्युत इषां न यामनि पुरुप्रैषा अहन्यो३ नैतशः॥
verses.tr: ko vo'ntarmaruta ṛṣṭividyuto rejati tmanā hanveva jihvayā dhanvacyuta iṣāṃ na yāmani purupraiṣā ahanyo3 naitaśaḥ
verses.en: Who among you, O Maruts armed with lightning-spears, moveth you by himself, as with the tongue his jaws? Ye rush from heaven's floor as though ye sought for food, on many errands like the Sun's diurnal Steed.

verses.sa:
क्व स्विदस्य रजसो महस्परं क्वावरं मरुतो यस्मिन्नायय ।
यच्च्यावयथ विथुरेव संहितं व्यद्रिणा पतथ त्वेषमर्णवम्॥
verses.tr: kva svidasya rajaso mahasparaṃ kvāvaraṃ maruto yasminnāyaya yaccyāvayatha vithureva saṃhitaṃ vyadriṇā patatha tveṣamarṇavam
verses.en: Say where, then, is this mighty region's farthest bound, where, Maruts, is the lowest depth that ye have reached, When ye cast down like chaff the firmly stablished pile, and from the mountain send the glittering water-flood?

verses.sa:
सातिर्न वोऽमवती स्वर्वती त्वेषा विपाका मरुतः पिपिष्वती ।
भद्रा वो रातिः पृणतो न दक्षिणा पृथुज्रयी असुर्येव जञ्जती॥
verses.tr: sātirna vo'mavatī svarvatī tveṣā vipākā marutaḥ pipiṣvatī bhadrā vo rātiḥ pṛṇato na dakṣiṇā pṛthujrayī asuryeva jañjatī
verses.en: Your winning is with strength, dazzling, with heavenly light, with fruit mature, O Maruts, fall of plenteousness. Auspicious is your gift like a free giver's meed, victorious, spreading far, as of immortal Gods.

verses.sa:
प्रति ष्टोभन्ति सिन्धवः पविभ्यो यदभ्रियां वाचमुदीरयन्ति ।
अव स्मयन्त विद्युतः पृथिव्यां यदी घृतं मरुतः प्रुष्णुवन्ति॥
verses.tr: prati ṣṭobhanti sindhavaḥ pavibhyo yadabhriyāṃ vācamudīrayanti ava smayanta vidyutaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yadī ghṛtaṃ marutaḥ pruṣṇuvanti
verses.en: The rivers roar before your chariot fellies when they are uttering the voice of rain-clouds. The lightnings laugh upon the earth beneath them, what time the Maruts scatter forth their fatness.

verses.sa:
असूत पृश्निर्महते रणाय त्वेषमयासां मरुतामनीकम् ।
ते सप्सरासोऽजनयन्ताभ्वमादित् स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन्॥
verses.tr: asūta pṛśnirmahate raṇāya tveṣamayāsāṃ marutāmanīkam te sapsarāso'janayantābhvamādit svadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan
verses.en: Prsni brought forth, to fight the mighty battle, the glittering army of the restless Maruts. Nurtured together they begat the monster, and then looked round them for the food that strengthens.

verses.sa:
एष वः स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः ।
एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa vaḥ stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: May this your laud, may this your song O Maruts, sung by the poet Mana's son, Mandarya, Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
महश्चित् त्वमिन्द्र यत एतान् महश्चिदसि त्यजसो वरूता ।
स नो वेधो मरुतां चिकित्वान् त्सुम्ना वनुष्व तव हि प्रेष्ठा॥
verses.tr: mahaścit tvamindra yata etān mahaścidasi tyajaso varūtā sa no vedho marutāṃ cikitvān tsumnā vanuṣva tava hi preṣṭhā
verses.en: As, Indra, from great treason thou protectest, yea, from great treachery these who approach us, So, marking well, Controller of the Maruts grant us their blessings, for they are thy dearest.

verses.sa:
अयुज्रन्त इन्द्र विश्वकृष्टीर्विदानासो निष्षिधो मर्त्यत्रा ।
मरुतां पृत्सुतिर्हासमाना स्वर्मीळहस्य प्रधनस्य सातौ॥
verses.tr: ayujranta indra viśvakṛṣṭīrvidānāso niṣṣidho martyatrā marutāṃ pṛtsutirhāsamānā svarmīḻahasya pradhanasya sātau
verses.en: The various doings of all mortal people by thee are ordered, in thy wisdom, Indra. The host of Maruts goeth forth exulting to win the light-bestowing spoil of battle.

verses.sa:
अम्यक् सा त इन्द्र ऋष्टिरस्मे सनेम्यभ्वं मरुतो जुनन्ति ।
अग्निश्चिद्धि ष्मातसे शुशुक्वानापो न द्वीपं दधति प्रयांसि॥
verses.tr: amyak sā ta indra ṛṣṭirasme sanemyabhvaṃ maruto junanti agniściddhi ṣmātase śuśukvānāpo na dvīpaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi
verses.en: That spear of thine sat firm for us, O Indra: the Maruts set their whole dread power in motion. E'en Agni shines resplendent in the brush-wood: the viands hold him as floods hold an island.

verses.sa:
त्वं तू न इन्द्र तं रयिं दा ओजिष्ठया दक्षिणयेव रातिम् ।
स्तुतश्च यास्ते चकनन्त वायोः स्तनं न मध्वः पीपयन्त वाजैः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tū na indra taṃ rayiṃ dā ojiṣṭhayā dakṣiṇayeva rātim stutaśca yāste cakananta vāyoḥ stanaṃ na madhvaḥ pīpayanta vājaiḥ
verses.en: Vouchsafe us now that opulence, O Indra, as guerdon won by mightiest donation. May hymns that please thee cause the breast of Vayu to swell as with the mead's refreshing sweetness.

verses.sa:
त्वे राय इन्द्र तोशतमाः प्रणेतारः कस्य चिदृतायोः ।
ते षु णो मरुतो मृळयन्तु ये स्मा पुरा गातूयन्तीव देवाः॥
verses.tr: tve rāya indra tośatamāḥ praṇetāraḥ kasya cidṛtāyoḥ te ṣu ṇo maruto mṛḻayantu ye smā purā gātūyantīva devāḥ
verses.en: With thee, O Indra, are most bounteous riches that further every one who lives uprightly. Now may these Maruts show us loving-kindness, Gods who of old were ever prompt to help us.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्र याहीन्द्र मीळहुषो नॄन् महः पार्थिवे सदने यतस्व ।
अध यदेषां पृथुबुध्नास एतास्तीर्थे नार्यः पौंस्यानि तस्थुः॥
verses.tr: prati pra yāhīndra mīḻahuṣo nṝn mahaḥ pārthive sadane yatasva adha yadeṣāṃ pṛthubudhnāsa etāstīrthe nāryaḥ pauṃsyāni tasthuḥ
verses.en: Bring forth the Men who rain down boons, O Indra: exert thee in the great terrestrial region; For their broad-chested speckled deer are standing like a King's armies on the field of battle.

verses.sa:
प्रति घोराणामेतानामयासां मरुतां शृण्व आयतामुपब्दिः ।
ये मर्त्यं पृतनायन्तमूमैर्ऋणावानं न पतयन्त सर्गैः॥
verses.tr: prati ghorāṇāmetānāmayāsāṃ marutāṃ śṛṇva āyatāmupabdiḥ ye martyaṃ pṛtanāyantamūmairṛṇāvānaṃ na patayanta sargaiḥ
verses.en: Heard is the roar of the advancing Maruts, terrific, glittering, and swiftly moving, Who with their rush o'erthrow as 'twere a sinner the mortal who would fight with those who love him

verses.sa:
त्वं मानेभ्य इन्द्र विश्वजन्या रदा मरुद्भिः शुरुधो गोअग्राः ।
स्तवानेभिः स्तवसे देव देवैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ mānebhya indra viśvajanyā radā marudbhiḥ śurudho goagrāḥ stavānebhiḥ stavase deva devairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Give to the Manas, Indra with Maruts, gifts universal, gifts of cattle foremost. Thou, God, art praised with Gods who must be lauded. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
न नूनमस्ति नो श्वः कस्तद् वेद यदद्भुतम् ।
अन्यस्य चित्तमभि संचरेण्यमुताधीतं वि नश्यति॥
verses.tr: na nūnamasti no śvaḥ kastad veda yadadbhutam anyasya cittamabhi saṃcareṇyamutādhītaṃ vi naśyati
verses.en: Naught is to-day, to-morrow naught. Who comprehends the mystery? We must address ourselves unto another's thought, and lost is then the hope we formed.

verses.sa:
किं न इन्द्र जिघांससि भ्रातरो मरुतस्तव ।
तेभिः कल्पस्व साधुया मा नः समरणे वधीः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ na indra jighāṃsasi bhrātaro marutastava tebhiḥ kalpasva sādhuyā mā naḥ samaraṇe vadhīḥ
verses.en: The Maruts are thy brothers. Why, O Indra, wouldst thou take our lives? Agree with them in friendly wise, and do not slay us in the fight.

verses.sa:
किं नो भ्रातरगस्त्य सखा सन्नति मन्यसे ।
विद्मा हि ते यथा मनो ऽस्मभ्यमिन्न दित्ससि॥
verses.tr: kiṃ no bhrātaragastya sakhā sannati manyase vidmā hi te yathā mano 'smabhyaminna ditsasi
verses.en: Agastya, brother, why dost thou neglect us, thou who art our friend? We know the nature of thy mind. Verity thou wilt give us naught.

verses.sa:
अरं कृण्वन्तु वेदिं समग्निमिन्धतां पुरः ।
तत्रामृतस्य चेतनं यज्ञं ते तनवावहै॥
verses.tr: araṃ kṛṇvantu vediṃ samagnimindhatāṃ puraḥ tatrāmṛtasya cetanaṃ yajñaṃ te tanavāvahai
verses.en: Let them prepare the altar, let them kindle fire in front: we two Here will spread sacrifice for thee, that the Immortal may observe.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे वसुपते वसूनां त्वं मित्राणां मित्रपते धेष्ठः ।
इन्द्र त्वं मरुद्भिः सं वदस्वाध प्राशान ऋतुथा हवींषि॥
verses.tr: tvamīśiṣe vasupate vasūnāṃ tvaṃ mitrāṇāṃ mitrapate dheṣṭhaḥ indra tvaṃ marudbhiḥ saṃ vadasvādha prāśāna ṛtuthā havīṃṣi
verses.en: Thou, Lord of Wealth, art Master of all treasures, thou, Lord of friends, art thy friends' best supporter. O Indra, speak thou kindly with the Maruts, and taste oblations in their proper season.

verses.sa:
प्रति व एना नमसाहमेमि सूक्तेन भिक्षे सुमतिं तुराणाम् ।
रराणता मरुतो वेद्याभिर्नि हेळो धत्त वि मुचध्वमश्वान्॥
verses.tr: prati va enā namasāhamemi sūktena bhikṣe sumatiṃ turāṇām rarāṇatā maruto vedyābhirni heḻo dhatta vi mucadhvamaśvān
verses.en: To you I come with this mine adoration, and with a hymn I crave the Strong Ones' favour A hymn that truly makes you joyful, Maruts. Suppress your anger and unyoke your horses.

verses.sa:
एष वः स्तोमो मरुतो नमस्वान् हृदा तष्टो मनसा धायि देवाः ।
उपेमा यात मनसा जुषाणा यूयं हि ष्ठा नमस इद् वृधासः॥
verses.tr: eṣa vaḥ stomo maruto namasvān hṛdā taṣṭo manasā dhāyi devāḥ upemā yāta manasā juṣāṇā yūyaṃ hi ṣṭhā namasa id vṛdhāsaḥ
verses.en: Maruts, to you this laud with prayer and worship, formed in the mind and heart, ye Gods, is offered. Come ye to us, rejoicing in your spirit, for ye are they who make our prayer effective.

verses.sa:
स्तुतासो नो मरुतो मृळयन्तूत स्तुतो मघवा शम्भविष्ठः ।
ऊर्ध्वा नः सन्तु कोम्या वनान्यहानि विश्वा मरुतो जिगीषा॥
verses.tr: stutāso no maruto mṛḻayantūta stuto maghavā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ ūrdhvā naḥ santu komyā vanānyahāni viśvā maruto jigīṣā
verses.en: The Maruts, praised by us, shall show us favour; Maghavan, lauded, shall be most propitious. Maruts,, may all our days that are to follow be very pleasant, lovely and triumphant.

verses.sa:
अस्मादहं तविषादीषमाण इन्द्राद् भिया मरुतो रेजमानः ।
युष्मभ्यं हव्या निशितान्यासन् तान्यारे चकृमा मृळता नः॥
verses.tr: asmādahaṃ taviṣādīṣamāṇa indrād bhiyā maruto rejamānaḥ yuṣmabhyaṃ havyā niśitānyāsan tānyāre cakṛmā mṛḻatā naḥ
verses.en: I fled in terror from this mighty Indra, my body trembling in alarm, O Maruts. Oblations meant for you had been made ready; these have we set aside: for this forgive us.

verses.sa:
येन मानासश्चितयन्त उस्रा व्युष्टिषु शवसा शश्वतीनाम् ।
स नो मरुद्भिर्वृषभ श्रवो धा उग्र उग्रेभिः स्थविरः सहोदाः॥
verses.tr: yena mānāsaścitayanta usrā vyuṣṭiṣu śavasā śaśvatīnām sa no marudbhirvṛṣabha śravo dhā ugra ugrebhiḥ sthaviraḥ sahodāḥ
verses.en: By whom the Manas recognize the day-springs, by whose strength at the dawn of endless mornings, Give us, thou Mighty, glory with Maruts. fierce with the fierce, the Strong who givest triumph.

verses.sa:
त्वं पाहीन्द्र सहीयसो नॄन् भवा मरुद्भिरवयातहेळाः ।
सुप्रकेतेभिः सासहिर्दधानो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ pāhīndra sahīyaso nṝn bhavā marudbhiravayātaheḻāḥ supraketebhiḥ sāsahirdadhāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Do thou, O Indra, guard the conquering Heroes, and rid thee of thy wrath against the Maruts, With them, the wise, victorious and bestowing. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa: चित्रो वोऽस्तु यामश्चित्र ऊती सुदानवः । मरुतो अहिभानवः॥
verses.tr: citro vo'stu yāmaścitra ūtī sudānavaḥ maruto ahibhānavaḥ
verses.en: Wonderful let your coming be, wondrous with help, ye Bounteous Ones, Maruts, who gleam as serpents gleam.

verses.sa: आरे सा वः सुदानवो मरुत ऋञ्जती शरुः । आरे अश्मा यमस्यथ॥
verses.tr: āre sā vaḥ sudānavo maruta ṛñjatī śaruḥ āre aśmā yamasyatha
verses.en: Far be from us, O Maruts, ye free givers, your impetuous shaft; Far from us be the stone ye hurl.

verses.sa: तृणस्कन्दस्य नु विशः परि वृङ्क्त सुदानवः । ऊर्ध्वान् नः कर्त जीवसे॥
verses.tr: tṛṇaskandasya nu viśaḥ pari vṛṅkta sudānavaḥ ūrdhvān naḥ karta jīvase
verses.en: O Bounteous Givers, touch ye not, O Maruts, Trnskanda's folk; Lift ye us up that we may live.

verses.sa:
गायत् साम नभन्यं१ यथा वेरर्चाम तद् वावृधानं स्वर्वत् ।
गावो धेनवो बर्हिष्यदब्धा आ यत् सद्मानं दिव्यं विवासान्॥
verses.tr: gāyat sāma nabhanyaṃ1 yathā verarcāma tad vāvṛdhānaṃ svarvat gāvo dhenavo barhiṣyadabdhā ā yat sadmānaṃ divyaṃ vivāsān
verses.en: The praise-song let him sing forth bursting bird-like: sing we that hymn which like heaven's light expandeth, That the milk-giving cows may, unimpeded call to the sacred grass the Gods' assembly.

verses.sa:
अर्चद् वृषा वृषभिः स्वेदुहव्यैर्मृगो नाश्नो अति यज्जुगुर्यात् ।
प्र मन्दयुर्मनां गूर्त होता भरते मर्यो मिथुना यजत्रः॥
verses.tr: arcad vṛṣā vṛṣabhiḥ sveduhavyairmṛgo nāśno ati yajjuguryāt pra mandayurmanāṃ gūrta hotā bharate maryo mithunā yajatraḥ
verses.en: Let the Bull sing with Bulls whose toil is worship, with a loud roar like some wild beast that hungers. Praised God! the glad priest brings his heart's devotion; the holy youth presents twofold oblation.

verses.sa:
नक्षद्धोता परि सद्म मिता यन् भरद् गर्भमा शरदः पृथिव्याः ।
क्रन्ददश्वो नयमानो रुवद् गौरन्तर्दूतो न रोदसी चरद् वाक्॥
verses.tr: nakṣaddhotā pari sadma mitā yan bharad garbhamā śaradaḥ pṛthivyāḥ krandadaśvo nayamāno ruvad gaurantardūto na rodasī carad vāk
verses.en: May the Priest come circling the measured stations, and with him bring the earth's autumnal fruitage. Let the Horse neigh led near, let the Steer bellow: let the Voice go between both worlds as herald,

verses.sa:
ता कर्माषतरास्मै प्र च्यौत्नानि देवयन्तो भरन्ते ।
जुजोषदिन्द्रो दस्मवर्चा नासत्येव सुग्म्यो रथेष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: tā karmāṣatarāsmai pra cyautnāni devayanto bharante jujoṣadindro dasmavarcā nāsatyeva sugmyo ratheṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: To him we offer welcomest oblations, the pious bring their strength-inspiring praises. May Indra, wondrous in his might, accept them, car-borne and swift to move like the Nasatyas.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहीन्द्रं यो ह सत्वा यः शूरो मघवा यो रथेष्ठाः ।
प्रतीचश्चिद् योधीयान् वृषण्वान् ववव्रुषश्चित्तमसो विहन्ता॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭuhīndraṃ yo ha satvā yaḥ śūro maghavā yo ratheṣṭhāḥ pratīcaścid yodhīyān vṛṣaṇvān vavavruṣaścittamaso vihantā
verses.en: Praise thou that Indra who is truly mighty, the car-borne Warrior, Maghavan the Hero; Stronger in war than those who fight against him, borne by strong steeds, who kills enclosing darkness;

verses.sa:
प्र यदित्था महिना नृभ्यो अस्त्यरं रोदसी कक्ष्ये३ नास्मै ।
सं विव्य इन्द्रो वृजनं न भूमा भर्ति स्वधावाँ ओपशमिव द्याम्॥
verses.tr: pra yaditthā mahinā nṛbhyo astyaraṃ rodasī kakṣye3 nāsmai saṃ vivya indro vṛjanaṃ na bhūmā bharti svadhāvāṃ opaśamiva dyām
verses.en: Him who surpasses heroes in his greatness: the earth and heavens suffice not for his girdles. Indra endues the earth to be his garment, and, God-like, wears the heaven as 'twere a frontlet,

verses.sa:
समत्सु त्वा शूर सतामुराणं प्रपथिन्तमं परितंसयध्यै ।
सजोषस इन्द्रं मदे क्षोणीः सूरिं चिद्ये अनुमदन्ति वाजैः॥
verses.tr: samatsu tvā śūra satāmurāṇaṃ prapathintamaṃ paritaṃsayadhyai sajoṣasa indraṃ made kṣoṇīḥ sūriṃ cidye anumadanti vājaiḥ
verses.en: Thee, Hero, guardian of the brave in battles, who roamest in the van,--to draw thee hither, Indra, the hosts agree beside the Soma, and joy, for his great actions, in the Chieftain.

verses.sa:
एवा हि ते शं सवना समुद्र आपो यत् त आसु मदन्ति देवीः ।
विश्वा ते अनु जोष्या भूद् गौः सूरीँश्चिद् यदि धिषा वेषि जनान्॥
verses.tr: evā hi te śaṃ savanā samudra āpo yat ta āsu madanti devīḥ viśvā te anu joṣyā bhūd gauḥ sūrīṃścid yadi dhiṣā veṣi janān
verses.en: Libations in the sea to thee are pleasant, when thy divine Floods come to cheer these people. To thee the Cow is sum of all things grateful when with the wish thou seekest men and princes.

verses.sa:
असाम यथा सुषखाय एन स्वभिष्टयो नरां न शंसैः ।
असद् यथा न इन्द्रो वन्दनेष्ठास्तुरो न कर्म नयमान उक्था॥
verses.tr: asāma yathā suṣakhāya ena svabhiṣṭayo narāṃ na śaṃsaiḥ asad yathā na indro vandaneṣṭhāsturo na karma nayamāna ukthā
verses.en: So may we in this One be well befriended, well aided as it were through praise of chieftains, That Indra still may linger at our worship, as one led swift to work, to hear our praises.

verses.sa:
विष्पर्धसो नरां न शंसैरस्माकासदिन्द्रो वज्रहस्तः ।
मित्रायुवो न पूर्पतिं सुशिष्टौ मध्यायुव उप शिक्षन्ति यज्ञैः॥
verses.tr: viṣpardhaso narāṃ na śaṃsairasmākāsadindro vajrahastaḥ mitrāyuvo na pūrpatiṃ suśiṣṭau madhyāyuva upa śikṣanti yajñaiḥ
verses.en: Like men in rivalry extolling princes, our Friend be Indra, wielder of the thunder. Like true friends of some city's lord within them held in good rule with sacrifice they help him.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो हि ष्मेन्द्रं कश्चिदृन्धञ्जुहुराणश्चिन्मनसा परियन् ।
तीर्थे नाच्छा तातृषाणमोको दीर्घो न सिध्रमा कृणोत्यध्वा॥
verses.tr: yajño hi ṣmendraṃ kaścidṛndhañjuhurāṇaścinmanasā pariyan tīrthe nācchā tātṛṣāṇamoko dīrgho na sidhramā kṛṇotyadhvā
verses.en: For every sacrifice makes Indra stronger, yea, when he goes around angry in spirit; As pleasure at the ford invites the thirsty, as the long way brings him who gains his object.

verses.sa:
मो षू ण इन्द्रात्र पृत्सु देवैरस्ति हि ष्मा ते शुष्मिन्नवयाः ।
महश्चिद् यस्य मीळहुषो यव्या हविष्मतो मरुतो वन्दते गीः॥
verses.tr: mo ṣū ṇa indrātra pṛtsu devairasti hi ṣmā te śuṣminnavayāḥ mahaścid yasya mīḻahuṣo yavyā haviṣmato maruto vandate gīḥ
verses.en: Let us not here contend with Gods, O Indra, for here, O Mighty One, is thine own portion, The Great, whose Friends the bounteous Maruts honour, as with a stream, his song who pours oblations.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोम इन्द्र तुभ्यमस्मे एतेन गातुं हरिवो विदो नः ।
आ नो ववृत्याः सुविताय देव विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa stoma indra tubhyamasme etena gātuṃ harivo vido naḥ ā no vavṛtyāḥ suvitāya deva vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Addressed to thee is this our praise, O Indra: Lord of Bay Steeds, find us hereby advancement. So mayst thou lead us on, O God, to comfort. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
त्वं राजेन्द्र ये च देवा रक्षा नॄन् पाह्यसुर त्वमस्मान् ।
त्वं सत्पतिर्मघवा नस्तरुत्रस्त्वं सत्यो वसवानः सहोदाः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ rājendra ye ca devā rakṣā nṝn pāhyasura tvamasmān tvaṃ satpatirmaghavā nastarutrastvaṃ satyo vasavānaḥ sahodāḥ
verses.en: Thou art the King of all the Gods, O Indra: protect the men, O Asura, preserve us. Thou Lord of Heroes, Maghavan, our saver, art faithful, very rich, the victory-giver.

verses.sa:
दनो विश इन्द्र मृध्रवाचः सप्त यत् पुरः शर्म शारदीर्दर्त् ।
ऋणोरपो अनवद्यार्णा यूने वृत्रं पुरुकुत्साय रन्धीः॥
verses.tr: dano viśa indra mṛdhravācaḥ sapta yat puraḥ śarma śāradīrdart ṛṇorapo anavadyārṇā yūne vṛtraṃ purukutsāya randhīḥ
verses.en: Indra, thou humbledst tribes that spake with insult by breaking down seven autumn forts, their refuge. Thou stirredst, Blameless! billowy floods, and gavest his foe a prey to youthful Purukutsa.

verses.sa:
अजा वृत इन्द्र शूरपत्नीर्द्यां च येभिः पुरुहूत नूनम् ।
रक्षो अग्निमशुषं तूर्वयाणं सिंहो न दमे अपांसि वस्तोः॥
verses.tr: ajā vṛta indra śūrapatnīrdyāṃ ca yebhiḥ puruhūta nūnam rakṣo agnimaśuṣaṃ tūrvayāṇaṃ siṃho na dame apāṃsi vastoḥ
verses.en: With whom thou drivest troops whose lords are heroes, and bringest daylight now, much worshipped Indra, With them guard lion-like wasting active Agni to dwell in our tilled fields and in our homestead.

verses.sa:
शेषन् नु त इन्द्र सस्मिन् योनौ प्रशस्तये पवीरवस्य मह्ना ।
सृजदर्णांस्यव यद् युधागास्तिष्ठद्धरी धृषता मृष्ट वाजान्॥
verses.tr: śeṣan nu ta indra sasmin yonau praśastaye pavīravasya mahnā sṛjadarṇāṃsyava yad yudhāgāstiṣṭhaddharī dhṛṣatā mṛṣṭa vājān
verses.en: They through the greatness of thy spear, O Indra, shall, to thy praise, rest in this earthly station. To loose the floods, to seek, for kine, the battle, his Bays he mounted boldly seized the booty.

verses.sa:
वह कुत्समिन्द्र यस्मिञ्चाकन् त्स्यूमन्यू ऋज्रा वातस्याश्वा ।
प्र सूरश्चक्रं वृहतादभीके ऽभि स्पृधो यासिषद् वज्रबाहुः॥
verses.tr: vaha kutsamindra yasmiñcākan tsyūmanyū ṛjrā vātasyāśvā pra sūraścakraṃ vṛhatādabhīke 'bhi spṛdho yāsiṣad vajrabāhuḥ
verses.en: Indra, bear Kutsa, him in whom thou joyest: the dark-red horses of the Wind are docile. Let the Sun roll his chariot wheel anear us, and let the Thunderer go to meet the foemen.

verses.sa:
जघन्वाँ इन्द्र मित्रेरूञ्चोदप्रवृद्धो हरिवो अदाशून् ।
प्र ये पश्यन्नर्यमणं सचायोस्त्वया शूर्ता वहमाना अपत्यम्॥
verses.tr: jaghanvāṃ indra mitrerūñcodapravṛddho harivo adāśūn pra ye paśyannaryamaṇaṃ sacāyostvayā śūrtā vahamānā apatyam
verses.en: Thou Indra, Lord of Bays, made strong by impulse, hast slain the vexers of thy friends, who give not. They who beheld the Friend beside the living were cast aside by thee as they rode onward.

verses.sa:
रपत् कविरिन्द्रार्कसातौ क्षां दासायोपबर्हणीं कः ।
करत् तिस्रो मघवा दानुचित्रा नि दुर्योणे कुयवाचं मृधि श्रेत्॥
verses.tr: rapat kavirindrārkasātau kṣāṃ dāsāyopabarhaṇīṃ kaḥ karat tisro maghavā dānucitrā ni duryoṇe kuyavācaṃ mṛdhi śret
verses.en: Indra, the bard sang forth in inspiration: thou madest earth a covering for the Dasa. Maghavan made the three that gleam with moisture, and to his home brought Kuyavac to slay him.

verses.sa:
सना ता त इन्द्र नव्या आगुः सहो नभोऽविरणाय पूर्वीः ।
भिनत् पुरो न भिदो अदेवीर्ननमो वधरदेवस्य पीयोः॥
verses.tr: sanā tā ta indra navyā āguḥ saho nabho'viraṇāya pūrvīḥ bhinat puro na bhido adevīrnanamo vadharadevasya pīyoḥ
verses.en: These thine old deeds new bards have sung, O Indra. Thou conqueredst, boundest many tribes for ever. Like castles thou hast crushed the godless races, and bowed the godless scorner's deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
त्वं धुनिरिन्द्र धुनिमतीर्ऋणोरपः सीरा न स्रवन्तीः ।
प्र यत् समुद्रमति शूर पर्षि पारया तुर्वशं यदुं स्वस्ति॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dhunirindra dhunimatīrṛṇorapaḥ sīrā na sravantīḥ pra yat samudramati śūra parṣi pārayā turvaśaṃ yaduṃ svasti
verses.en: A Stormer thou hast made the stormy waters flow down, O Indra, like the running rivers. When o'er the flood thou broughtest them, O Hero, thou keptest Turvasa and Yadu safely.

verses.sa:
त्वमस्माकमिन्द्र विश्वध स्या अवृकतमो नरां नृपाता ।
स नो विश्वासां स्पृधां सहोदा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: tvamasmākamindra viśvadha syā avṛkatamo narāṃ nṛpātā sa no viśvāsāṃ spṛdhāṃ sahodā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Indra, mayst thou be ours in all occasions, protector of the men, most gentle-hearted, Giving us victory over all our rivals. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः ।
वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः॥
verses.tr: matsyapāyi te mahaḥ pātrasyeva harivo matsaro madaḥ vṛṣā te vṛṣṇa indurvājī sahasrasātamaḥ
verses.en: Glad thee: thy glory hath been quaffed, Lord of Bay Steeds, as 'twere the bowl's enlivening mead. For thee the Strong there is strong drink, mighty, omnipotent to win.

verses.sa: आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः । सहावाँ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनाषाळमर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: ā naste gantu matsaro vṛṣā mado vareṇyaḥ sahāvāṃ indra sānasiḥ pṛtanāṣāḻamartyaḥ
verses.en: Let our strong drink, most excellent, exhilarating, come to thee, Victorious, Indra! bringing gain, immortal conquering in fight,

verses.sa: त्वं हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् । सहावान् दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi śūraḥ sanitā codayo manuṣo ratham sahāvān dasyumavratamoṣaḥ pātraṃ na śociṣā
verses.en: Thou, Hero, winner of the spoil, urgest to speed the car of man. Burn, like a vessel with the flame, the lawless Dasyu, Conqueror!

verses.sa: मुषाय सूर्यं कवे चक्रमीशान ओजसा । वह शुष्णाय वधं कुत्सं वातस्याश्वैः॥
verses.tr: muṣāya sūryaṃ kave cakramīśāna ojasā vaha śuṣṇāya vadhaṃ kutsaṃ vātasyāśvaiḥ
verses.en: Empowered by thine own might, O Sage, thou stolest Surya's chariot wheel. Thou barest Kutsa with the steeds of Wind to Susna as his death.

verses.sa: शुष्मिन्तमो हि ते मदो द्युम्निन्तम उत क्रतुः । वृत्रघ्ना वरिवोविदा मंसीष्ठा अश्वसातमः॥
verses.tr: śuṣmintamo hi te mado dyumnintama uta kratuḥ vṛtraghnā varivovidā maṃsīṣṭhā aśvasātamaḥ
verses.en: Most mighty is thy rapturous joy, most splendid is thine active power, Wherewith, foe-slaying, sending bliss, thou art supreme in gaining steeds.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ ।
तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: As thou, O Indra, to the ancient singers wast ever joy, as water to the thirsty, So unto thee I sing this invocation. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
मत्सि नो वस्य इष्टय इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ।
ऋघायमाण इन्वसि शत्रुमन्ति न विन्दसि॥
verses.tr: matsi no vasya iṣṭaya indramindo vṛṣā viśa ṛghāyamāṇa invasi śatrumanti na vindasi
verses.en: Cheer thee with draughts to win us bliss: Soma, pierce Indra in thy strength. Thou stormest trembling in thy rage, and findest not a foeman nigh.

verses.sa:
तस्मिन्ना वेशया गिरो य एकश्चर्षणीनाम् ।
अनु स्वधा यमुप्यते यवं न चर्कृषद् वृषा॥
verses.tr: tasminnā veśayā giro ya ekaścarṣaṇīnām anu svadhā yamupyate yavaṃ na carkṛṣad vṛṣā
verses.en: Make our songs penetrate to him who is the Only One of men; For whom the sacred food is spread, as the steer ploughs the barley in.

verses.sa:
यस्य विश्वानि हस्तयोः पञ्च क्षितीनां वसु ।
स्पाशयस्व यो अस्मध्रुग्दिव्येवाशनिर्जहि॥
verses.tr: yasya viśvāni hastayoḥ pañca kṣitīnāṃ vasu spāśayasva yo asmadhrugdivyevāśanirjahi
verses.en: Within whose hands deposited all the Five Peoples' treasures rest. Mark thou the man who injures us and kill him like the heavenly bolt.

verses.sa:
असुन्वन्तं समं जहि दूणाशं यो न ते मयः ।
अस्मभ्यमस्य वेदनं दद्धि सूरिश्चिदोहते॥
verses.tr: asunvantaṃ samaṃ jahi dūṇāśaṃ yo na te mayaḥ asmabhyamasya vedanaṃ daddhi sūriścidohate
verses.en: Slay everyone who pours no gift, who, hard to reach, delights thee not. Bestow on us what wealth he hath: this even the worshipper awaits.

verses.sa:
आवो यस्य द्विबर्हसोऽर्केषु सानुषगसत् ।
आजाविन्द्रस्येन्दो प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: āvo yasya dvibarhaso'rkeṣu sānuṣagasat ājāvindrasyendo prāvo vājeṣu vājinam
verses.en: Thou helpest him the doubly strong whose hymns were sung unceasingly. When Indra fought, O Soma, thou helpest the mighty in the fray.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यो जरितृभ्य इन्द्र मय इवापो न तृष्यते बभूथ ।
तामनु त्वा निविदं जोहवीमि विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: yathā pūrvebhyo jaritṛbhya indra maya ivāpo na tṛṣyate babhūtha tāmanu tvā nividaṃ johavīmi vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: As thou, O Indra, to the ancient singers wast ever joy, like water to the thirsty, So unto thee I sing this invocation. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
आ चर्षणिप्रा वृषभो जनानां राजा कृष्टीनां पुरुहूत इन्द्रः ।
स्तुतः श्रवस्यन्नवसोप मद्रिग्युक्त्वा हरी वृषणा याह्यर्वाङ्॥
verses.tr: ā carṣaṇiprā vṛṣabho janānāṃ rājā kṛṣṭīnāṃ puruhūta indraḥ stutaḥ śravasyannavasopa madrigyuktvā harī vṛṣaṇā yāhyarvāṅ
verses.en: The Bull of men, who cherishes all people, King of the Races, Indra, called of many, Fame-loving, praised, hither to me with succour turn having yoked both vigorous Bay Horses!

verses.sa:
ये ते वृषणो वृषभास इन्द्र ब्रह्मयुजो वृषरथासो अत्याः ।
ताँ आ तिष्ठ तेभिरा याह्यर्वाङ् हवामहे त्वा सुत इन्द्र सोमे॥
verses.tr: ye te vṛṣaṇo vṛṣabhāsa indra brahmayujo vṛṣarathāso atyāḥ tāṃ ā tiṣṭha tebhirā yāhyarvāṅ havāmahe tvā suta indra some
verses.en: Thy mighty Stallions, yoked by prayer, O Indra, thy. Coursers to thy mighty chariot harnessed,-- Ascend thou these, and borne by them come hither: with Soma juice out. poured, Indra, we call thee.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठ रथं वृषणं वृषा ते सुतः सोमः परिषिक्ता मधूनि ।
युक्त्वा वृषभ्यां वृषभ क्षितीनां हरिभ्यां याहि प्रवतोप मद्रिक्॥
verses.tr: ā tiṣṭha rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣā te sutaḥ somaḥ pariṣiktā madhūni yuktvā vṛṣabhyāṃ vṛṣabha kṣitīnāṃ haribhyāṃ yāhi pravatopa madrik
verses.en: Ascend thy mighty car: the mighty Soma is poured for thee and sweets are sprinkled round us. Come down to us-ward, Bull of human races, come, having harnessed them, with strong Bay Horses.

verses.sa:
अयं यज्ञो देवया अयं मियेध इमा ब्रह्माण्ययमिन्द्र सोमः ।
स्तीर्णं बर्हिरा तु शक्र प्र याहि पिबा निषद्य वि मुचा हरी इह॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yajño devayā ayaṃ miyedha imā brahmāṇyayamindra somaḥ stīrṇaṃ barhirā tu śakra pra yāhi pibā niṣadya vi mucā harī iha
verses.en: Here is God-reaching sacrifice, here the victim; here, Indra, are the prayers, here is the Soma. Strewn is the sacred grass: come hither, Sakra; seat thee and drink: unyoke thy two Bay Coursers.

verses.sa:
ओ सुष्टुत इन्द्र याह्यर्वाङुप ब्रह्माणि मान्यस्य कारोः ।
विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: o suṣṭuta indra yāhyarvāṅupa brahmāṇi mānyasya kāroḥ vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Come to us, Indra, come thou highly lauded to the devotions of the singer Mana. Singing, may we find early through thy succour, may we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
यद्ध स्या त इन्द्र श्रुष्टिरस्ति यया बभूथ जरितृभ्य ऊती ।
मा नः कामं महयन्तमा धग्विश्वा ते अश्यां पर्याप आयोः॥
verses.tr: yaddha syā ta indra śruṣṭirasti yayā babhūtha jaritṛbhya ūtī mā naḥ kāmaṃ mahayantamā dhagviśvā te aśyāṃ paryāpa āyoḥ
verses.en: If, Indra, thou hast given that gracious hearing where with thou helpest those who sang thy praises. Blast not the wish that would exalt us may I gain all from thee, and pay all man's devotions.

verses.sa:
न घा राजेन्द्र आ दभन्नो या नु स्वसारा कृणवन्त योनौ ।
आपश्चिदस्मै सुतुका अवेषन् गमन्न इन्द्रः सख्या वयश्च॥
verses.tr: na ghā rājendra ā dabhanno yā nu svasārā kṛṇavanta yonau āpaścidasmai sutukā aveṣan gamanna indraḥ sakhyā vayaśca
verses.en: Let not the Sovran Indra disappoint us in what shall bring both Sisters to our dwelling. To him have run the quickly flowing waters. May Indra come to us with life and friendship.

verses.sa:
जेता नृभिरिन्द्रः पृत्सु शूरः श्रोता हवं नाधमानस्य कारोः ।
प्रभर्ता रथं दाशुष उपाक उद्यन्ता गिरो यदि च त्मना भूत्॥
verses.tr: jetā nṛbhirindraḥ pṛtsu śūraḥ śrotā havaṃ nādhamānasya kāroḥ prabhartā rathaṃ dāśuṣa upāka udyantā giro yadi ca tmanā bhūt
verses.en: Victorious with the men, Hero in battles, Indra, who hears the singer's supplication, Will bring his car nigh to the man who offers, if he himself upholds the songs that praise him.

verses.sa:
एवा नृभिरिन्द्रः सुश्रवस्या प्रखादः पृक्षो अभि मित्रिणो भूत् ।
समर्य इषः स्तवते विवाचि सत्राकरो यजमानस्य शंसः॥
verses.tr: evā nṛbhirindraḥ suśravasyā prakhādaḥ pṛkṣo abhi mitriṇo bhūt samarya iṣaḥ stavate vivāci satrākaro yajamānasya śaṃsaḥ
verses.en: Yea, Indra, with the men, through love of glory consumes the sacred food which friends have offered. The ever-strengthening song of him who worships is sung in fight amid the clash of voices.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं मघवन्निन्द्र शत्रूनभि ष्याम महतो मन्यमानान् ।
त्वं त्राता त्वमु नो वृधे भूर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ maghavannindra śatrūnabhi ṣyāma mahato manyamānān tvaṃ trātā tvamu no vṛdhe bhūrvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Aided by thee, O Maghavan, O Indra, may we subdue our foes who count them mighty. Be our protector, strengthen and increase us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

sections.label: Lopamudra and Agastya
sections.name: Mandala 1, hymn 179
intro: Griffith did not translate this hymn into English; it is given here in Sanskrit with its transliteration.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरहं शरदः शश्रमाणा दोषा वस्तोरुषसो जरयन्तीः ।
मिनाति श्रियं जरिमा तनूनामप्यू नु पत्नीर्वृषणो जगम्युः॥
verses.tr: pūrvīrahaṃ śaradaḥ śaśramāṇā doṣā vastoruṣaso jarayantīḥ mināti śriyaṃ jarimā tanūnāmapyū nu patnīrvṛṣaṇo jagamyuḥ

verses.sa:
ये चिद्धि पूर्व ऋतसाप आसन् त्साकं देवेभिरवदन्नृतानि ।
ते चिदवासुर्नह्यन्तमापुः समू नु पत्नीर्वृषभिर्जगम्युः॥
verses.tr: ye ciddhi pūrva ṛtasāpa āsan tsākaṃ devebhiravadannṛtāni te cidavāsurnahyantamāpuḥ samū nu patnīrvṛṣabhirjagamyuḥ

verses.sa:
न मृषा श्रान्तं यदवन्ति देवा विश्वा इत् स्पृधो अभ्यश्नवाव ।
जयावेदत्र शतनीथमाजिं यत् सम्यञ्चा मिथुनावभ्यजाव॥
verses.tr: na mṛṣā śrāntaṃ yadavanti devā viśvā it spṛdho abhyaśnavāva jayāvedatra śatanīthamājiṃ yat samyañcā mithunāvabhyajāva

verses.sa:
नदस्य मा रुधतः काम आगन्नित आजातो अमुतः कुतश्चित् ।
लोपामुद्रा वृषणं नी रिणाति धीरमधीरा धयति श्वसन्तम्॥
verses.tr: nadasya mā rudhataḥ kāma āgannita ājāto amutaḥ kutaścit lopāmudrā vṛṣaṇaṃ nī riṇāti dhīramadhīrā dhayati śvasantam

verses.sa:
इमं नु सोममन्तितो हृत्सु पीतमुप ब्रुवे ।
यत् सीमागश्चकृमा तत् सु मृळतु पुलुकामो हि मर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ nu somamantito hṛtsu pītamupa bruve yat sīmāgaścakṛmā tat su mṛḻatu pulukāmo hi martyaḥ

verses.sa:
अगस्त्यः खनमानः खनित्रैः प्रजामपत्यं बलमिच्छमानः ।
उभौ वर्णावृषिरुग्रः पुपोष सत्या देवेष्वाशिषो जगाम॥
verses.tr: agastyaḥ khanamānaḥ khanitraiḥ prajāmapatyaṃ balamicchamānaḥ ubhau varṇāvṛṣirugraḥ pupoṣa satyā deveṣvāśiṣo jagāma

verses.sa:
युवो रजांसि सुयमासो अश्वा रथो यद्वां पर्यर्णांसि दीयत् ।
हिरण्यया वां पवयः प्रुषायन् मध्वः पिबन्ता उषसः सचेथे॥
verses.tr: yuvo rajāṃsi suyamāso aśvā ratho yadvāṃ paryarṇāṃsi dīyat hiraṇyayā vāṃ pavayaḥ pruṣāyan madhvaḥ pibantā uṣasaḥ sacethe
verses.en: Lightly your coursers travel through the regions when round the sea of air your car is flying. Your golden fellies scatter drops of moisture: drinking the sweetness ye attend the Mornings.

verses.sa:
युवमत्यस्याव नक्षथो यद् विपत्मनो नर्यस्य प्रयज्योः ।
स्वसा यद् वां विश्वगूर्ती भराति वाजायेट्टे मधुपाविषे च॥
verses.tr: yuvamatyasyāva nakṣatho yad vipatmano naryasya prayajyoḥ svasā yad vāṃ viśvagūrtī bharāti vājāyeṭṭe madhupāviṣe ca
verses.en: Ye as ye travel overtake the Courser who flies apart, the Friend of man, most holy. The prayer is that the Sister may convey you, all praised, meath-drinkers! to support and strengthen.

verses.sa:
युवं पय उस्रियायामधत्तं पक्वमामायामव पूर्व्यं गोः ।
अन्तर्यद् वनिनो वामृतप्सू ह्वारो न शुचिर्यजते हविष्मान्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ paya usriyāyāmadhattaṃ pakvamāmāyāmava pūrvyaṃ goḥ antaryad vanino vāmṛtapsū hvāro na śuciryajate haviṣmān
verses.en: Ye have deposited, matured within her, in the raw cow the first milk of the milch-cow, Which the bright offerer, shining like a serpent mid trees, presents to you whose form is perfect.

verses.sa:
युवं ह घर्मं मधुमन्तमत्रये ऽपो न क्षोदोऽवृणीतमेषे ।
तद् वां नरावश्विना पश्वइष्टी रथ्येव चक्रा प्रति यन्ति मध्वः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ ha gharmaṃ madhumantamatraye 'po na kṣodo'vṛṇītameṣe tad vāṃ narāvaśvinā paśvaiṣṭī rathyeva cakrā prati yanti madhvaḥ
verses.en: Ye made the fierce heat to be full of sweetness for Atri at his wish, like streaming water. Fire-offering thence is yours, O Asvins, Heroes: your car-wheels speed to us like springs of honey.

verses.sa:
आ वां दानाय ववृतीय दस्रा गोरोहेण तौग्र्यो न जिव्रिः ।
अपः क्षोणी सचते माहिना वां जूर्णो वामक्षुरंहसो यजत्रा॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ dānāya vavṛtīya dasrā goroheṇa taugryo na jivriḥ apaḥ kṣoṇī sacate māhinā vāṃ jūrṇo vāmakṣuraṃhaso yajatrā
verses.en: Like Tugra's ancient son may I, ye Mighty, bring you to give your gifts with milk-oblations. Your greatness compasseth Earth, Heaven, and Waters: decayed for you is sorrow's net, ye Holy.

verses.sa:
नि यद् युवेथे नियुतः सुदानू उप स्वधाभिः सृजथः पुरंधिम् ।
प्रेषद् वेषद् वातो न सूरिरा महे ददे सुव्रतो न वाजम्॥
verses.tr: ni yad yuvethe niyutaḥ sudānū upa svadhābhiḥ sṛjathaḥ puraṃdhim preṣad veṣad vāto na sūrirā mahe dade suvrato na vājam
verses.en: When, Bounteous Ones, ye drive your yoked team downward, ye send, by your own natures, understanding. Swift as the wind let the prince please and feast you: he, like a pious man, gains strength for increase.

verses.sa:
वयं चिद्धि वां जरितारः सत्या विपन्यामहे वि पणिर्हितावान् ।
अधा चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनिन्द्या पाथो हि ष्मा वृषणावन्तिदेवम्॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ ciddhi vāṃ jaritāraḥ satyā vipanyāmahe vi paṇirhitāvān adhā ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanindyā pātho hi ṣmā vṛṣaṇāvantidevam
verses.en: For verily we truthful singers praise you the niggard trafficker is here excluded. Now, even now do ye O blameless Asvins, ye Mighty, guard the man whose God is near him.

verses.sa:
युवां चिद्धि ष्माश्विनावनु द्यून् विरुद्रस्य प्रस्रवणस्य सातौ ।
अगस्त्यो नरां नृषु प्रशस्तः काराधुनीव चितयत् सहस्रैः॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ ciddhi ṣmāśvināvanu dyūn virudrasya prasravaṇasya sātau agastyo narāṃ nṛṣu praśastaḥ kārādhunīva citayat sahasraiḥ
verses.en: You of a truth day after day, O Asvins, that he might win the very plenteous torrent, Agastya, famous among mortal heroes, roused with a thousand lauds like sounds of music.

verses.sa:
प्र यद् वहेथे महिना रथस्य प्र स्यन्द्रा याथो मनुषो न होता ।
धत्तं सूरिभ्य उत वा स्वश्व्यं नासत्या रयिषाचः स्याम॥
verses.tr: pra yad vahethe mahinā rathasya pra syandrā yātho manuṣo na hotā dhattaṃ sūribhya uta vā svaśvyaṃ nāsatyā rayiṣācaḥ syāma
verses.en: When with the glory of your car ye travel, when we go speeding like the priest of mortals, And give good horses to sacrificers, may we, Nasatyas! gain our share of riches.

verses.sa:
तं वां रथं वयमद्या हुवेम स्तोमैरश्विना सुविताय नव्यम् ।
अरिष्टनेमिं परि द्यामियानं विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vāṃ rathaṃ vayamadyā huvema stomairaśvinā suvitāya navyam ariṣṭanemiṃ pari dyāmiyānaṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: With songs of praise we call to-day, O Asvins, that your new chariot, for our own well-being, That circles heaven with never-injured fellies. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
कदु प्रेष्टाविषां रयीणामध्वर्यन्ता यदुन्निनीथो अपाम् ।
अयं वां यज्ञो अकृत प्रशस्तिं वसुधिती अवितारा जनानाम्॥
verses.tr: kadu preṣṭāviṣāṃ rayīṇāmadhvaryantā yadunninītho apām ayaṃ vāṃ yajño akṛta praśastiṃ vasudhitī avitārā janānām
verses.en: What, dearest Pair, is this in strength and riches that ye as Priests are bring from the waters? This sacrifice is your glorification, ye who protect mankind and give them treasures.

verses.sa:
आ वामश्वासः शुचयः पयस्पा वातरंहसो दिव्यासो अत्याः ।
मनोजुवो वृषणो वीतपृष्ठा एह स्वराजो अश्विना वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā vāmaśvāsaḥ śucayaḥ payaspā vātaraṃhaso divyāso atyāḥ manojuvo vṛṣaṇo vītapṛṣṭhā eha svarājo aśvinā vahantu
verses.en: May your pure steeds, rain-drinkers, bring you hither, swift as the tempest, your celestial coursers, Rapid as thought, with fair backs, full of vigour, resplendent in their native light, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथोऽवनिर्न प्रवत्वान् त्सृप्रवन्धुरः सुविताय गम्याः ।
वृष्णः स्थातारा मनसो जवीयानहम्पूर्वो यजतो धिष्ण्या यः॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ ratho'vanirna pravatvān tsṛpravandhuraḥ suvitāya gamyāḥ vṛṣṇaḥ sthātārā manaso javīyānahampūrvo yajato dhiṣṇyā yaḥ
verses.en: Your car is like a torrent rushing downward: may it come nigh, broad-seated, for our welfare,-- Car holy, strong, that ever would be foremost, thought-swift, which ye, for whom we long, have mounted.

verses.sa:
इहेह जाता समवावशीतामरेपसा तन्वा३ नामभिः स्वैः ।
जिष्णुर्वामन्यः सुमखस्य सूरिर्दिवो अन्यः सुभगः पुत्र ऊहे॥
verses.tr: iheha jātā samavāvaśītāmarepasā tanvā3 nāmabhiḥ svaiḥ jiṣṇurvāmanyaḥ sumakhasya sūrirdivo anyaḥ subhagaḥ putra ūhe
verses.en: Here sprung to life, they both have sung together, with bodies free from stain, with signs that mark them; One of you Prince of Sacrifice, the Victor, the other counts as Heaven's auspicious offspring.

verses.sa:
प्र वां निचेरुः ककुहो वशाँ अनु पिशङ्गरूपः सदनानि गम्याः ।
हरी अन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्मथ्रा रजांस्यश्विना वि घोषैः ॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ niceruḥ kakuho vaśāṃ anu piśaṅgarūpaḥ sadanāni gamyāḥ harī anyasya pīpayanta vājairmathrā rajāṃsyaśvinā vi ghoṣaiḥ
verses.en: May your car-seat, down-gliding, golden-coloured, according to your wish approach our dwellings. Men shall feed full the bay steeds of the other, and, Asvins they with roars shall stir the regions.

verses.sa:
५प्र वां शरद्वान् वृषभो न निष्षाट् पूर्वीरिषश्चरति मध्व इष्णन् ।
एवैरन्यस्य पीपयन्त वाजैर्वेषन्तीरूर्ध्वा नद्यो न आगुः॥
verses.tr: 5pra vāṃ śaradvān vṛṣabho na niṣṣāṭ pūrvīriṣaścarati madhva iṣṇan evairanyasya pīpayanta vājairveṣantīrūrdhvā nadyo na āguḥ
verses.en: Forth comes your strong Bull like a cloud of autumn, sending abundant food of liquid sweetness. Let them feed with the other's ways and vigour: the upper streams have come and do us service.

verses.sa:
असर्जि वां स्थविरा वेधसा गीर्बाळहे अश्विना त्रेधा क्षरन्ती ।
उपस्तुताववतं नाधमानं यामन्नयामञ्छृणुतं हवं मे॥
verses.tr: asarji vāṃ sthavirā vedhasā gīrbāḻahe aśvinā tredhā kṣarantī upastutāvavataṃ nādhamānaṃ yāmannayāmañchṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me
verses.en: Your constant song hath been sent forth, Disposers! that flows threefold in mighty strength, O Asvins. Thus lauded, give the suppliant protection moving or resting hear mine invocation.

verses.sa:
उत स्या वां रुशतो वप्ससो गीस्त्रिबर्हिषि सदसि पिन्वते नॄन् ।
वृषा वां मेघो वृषणा पीपाय गोर्न सेके मनुषो दशस्यन्॥
verses.tr: uta syā vāṃ ruśato vapsaso gīstribarhiṣi sadasi pinvate nṝn vṛṣā vāṃ megho vṛṣaṇā pīpāya gorna seke manuṣo daśasyan
verses.en: This song of bright contents for you is swelling in the men's hall where three-fold grass is ready. Your strong rain-cloud, ye Mighty Ones, hath swollen, honouring men as 'twere with milk's outpouring.

verses.sa:
युवां पूषेवाश्विना पुरंधिरग्निमुषां न जरते हविष्मान् ।
हुवे यद् वां वरिवस्या गृणानो विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ pūṣevāśvinā puraṃdhiragnimuṣāṃ na jarate haviṣmān huve yad vāṃ varivasyā gṛṇāno vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: The prudent worshipper, like Pusan, Asvins! praises you as he praises Dawn and Agni, When, singing with devotion, he invokes you. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
अभूदिदं वयुनमो षु भूषता रथो वृषण्वान् मदता मनीषिणः ।
धियंजिन्वा धिष्ण्या विश्पलावसू दिवो नपाता सुकृते शुचिव्रता॥
verses.tr: abhūdidaṃ vayunamo ṣu bhūṣatā ratho vṛṣaṇvān madatā manīṣiṇaḥ dhiyaṃjinvā dhiṣṇyā viśpalāvasū divo napātā sukṛte śucivratā
verses.en: This was the task. Appear promptly, ye prudent Ones. Here is the chariot drawn by strong steeds: be ye glad. Heart-stirring, longed for, succourers of Vispala, here are Heaven's Sons whose sway blesses the pious man.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रतमा हि धिष्ण्या मरुत्तमा दस्रा दंसिष्ठा रथ्या रथीतमा ।
पूर्णं रथं वहेथे मध्व आचितं तेन दाश्वांसमुप याथो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: indratamā hi dhiṣṇyā maruttamā dasrā daṃsiṣṭhā rathyā rathītamā pūrṇaṃ rathaṃ vahethe madhva ācitaṃ tena dāśvāṃsamupa yātho aśvinā
verses.en: Longed for, most Indra-like, mighty, most Marut-like, most wonderful in deed, car-borne, best charioteers, Bring your full chariot hither heaped with liquid sweet: thereon, ye Asvins, come to him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
किमत्र दस्रा कृणुथः किमासाथे जनो यः कश्चिदहविर्महीयते ।
अति क्रमिष्टं जुरतं पणेरसुं ज्योतिर्विप्राय कृणुतं वचस्यवे॥
verses.tr: kimatra dasrā kṛṇuthaḥ kimāsāthe jano yaḥ kaścidahavirmahīyate ati kramiṣṭaṃ jurataṃ paṇerasuṃ jyotirviprāya kṛṇutaṃ vacasyave
verses.en: What make ye there, ye Mighty? Wherefore linger ye with folk who, offering not, are held in high esteem? Pass over them; make ye the niggard's life decay: give light unto the singer eloquent in praise.

verses.sa:
जम्भयतमभितो रायतः शुनो हतं मृधो विदथुस्तान्यश्विना ।
वाचंवाचं जरितू रत्निनीं कृतमुभा शंसं नासत्यावतं मम॥
verses.tr: jambhayatamabhito rāyataḥ śuno hataṃ mṛdho vidathustānyaśvinā vācaṃvācaṃ jaritū ratninīṃ kṛtamubhā śaṃsaṃ nāsatyāvataṃ mama
verses.en: Crunch up on. every side the dogs who bark at us: slay ye our foes, O Asvins this ye understand. Make wealthy every word of him who praises you: accept with favour, both Nasatyas, this my laud.

verses.sa:
युवमेतं चक्रथुः सिन्धुषु प्लवमात्मन्वन्तं पक्षिणं तौग्र्याय कम् ।
येन देवत्रा मनसा निरूहथुः सुपप्तनी पेतथुः क्षोदसो महः॥
verses.tr: yuvametaṃ cakrathuḥ sindhuṣu plavamātmanvantaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ taugryāya kam yena devatrā manasā nirūhathuḥ supaptanī petathuḥ kṣodaso mahaḥ
verses.en: Ye made for Tugra's son amid the water-floods that animated ship with wings to fly withal, Whereon with God-devoted mind ye brought him forth, and fled with easy flight from out the mighty surge.

verses.sa:
अवविद्धं तौग्र्यमप्स्व१न्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्रविद्धम् ।
चतस्रो नावो जठलस्य जुष्टा उदश्विभ्यामिषिताः पारयन्ति॥
verses.tr: avaviddhaṃ taugryamapsva1ntaranārambhaṇe tamasi praviddham catasro nāvo jaṭhalasya juṣṭā udaśvibhyāmiṣitāḥ pārayanti
verses.en: Four ships most welcome in the midst of ocean, urged by the Asvins, save the son of Tugra, Him who was cast down headlong in the waters, plunged in the thick inevitable darkness.

verses.sa:
कः स्विद् वृक्षो निष्ठितो मध्ये अर्णसो यं तौग्र्यो नाधितः पर्यषस्वजत् ।
पर्णा मृगस्य पतरोरिवारभ उदश्विना ऊहथुः श्रोमताय कम्॥
verses.tr: kaḥ svid vṛkṣo niṣṭhito madhye arṇaso yaṃ taugryo nādhitaḥ paryaṣasvajat parṇā mṛgasya patarorivārabha udaśvinā ūhathuḥ śromatāya kam
verses.en: What tree was that which stood fixed in surrounding sea to which the son of Tugra supplicating clung? Like twigs, of which some winged creature may take hold, ye, Asvins, bore him off safely to your renown.

verses.sa:
तद् वां नरा नासत्यावनु ष्याद् यद् वां मानास उचथमवोचन् ।
अस्मादद्य सदसः सोम्यादा विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: tad vāṃ narā nāsatyāvanu ṣyād yad vāṃ mānāsa ucathamavocan asmādadya sadasaḥ somyādā vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Welcome to you be this the hymn of praises uttered by Manas, O Nasatyas, Heroes, From this our gathering where we offer Soma. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
तं युञ्जाथां मनसो यो जवीयान् त्रिवन्धुरो वृषणा यस्त्रिचक्रः ।
येनोपयाथः सुकृतो दुरोणं त्रिधातुना पतथो विर्न पर्णैः॥
verses.tr: taṃ yuñjāthāṃ manaso yo javīyān trivandhuro vṛṣaṇā yastricakraḥ yenopayāthaḥ sukṛto duroṇaṃ tridhātunā patatho virna parṇaiḥ
verses.en: Make ready that which passes thought in swiftness, that hath three wheels and triple seat, ye Mighty, Whereon ye seek the dwelling of the pious, whereon, threefold, ye fly like birds with pinions.

verses.sa:
सुवृद् रथो वर्तते यन्नभि क्षां यत् तिष्ठथः क्रतुमन्तानु पृक्षे ।
वपुर्वपुष्या सचतामियं गीर्दिवो दुहित्रोषसा सचेथे॥
verses.tr: suvṛd ratho vartate yannabhi kṣāṃ yat tiṣṭhathaḥ kratumantānu pṛkṣe vapurvapuṣyā sacatāmiyaṃ gīrdivo duhitroṣasā sacethe
verses.en: Light rolls your easy chariot faring earthward, what time, for food, ye, full of wisdom, mount it. May this song, wondrous fair, attend your glory: ye, as ye travel, wait on Dawn Heaven's Daughter.

verses.sa:
आ तिष्ठतं सुवृतं यो रथो वामनु व्रतानि वर्तते हविष्मान् ।
येन नरा नासत्येषयध्यै वर्तिर्याथस्तनयाय त्मने च॥
verses.tr: ā tiṣṭhataṃ suvṛtaṃ yo ratho vāmanu vratāni vartate haviṣmān yena narā nāsatyeṣayadhyai vartiryāthastanayāya tmane ca
verses.en: Ascend your lightly rolling car, approaching the worshipper who turns him to his duties,-- Whereon ye come unto the house to quicken man and his offspring, O Nasatyas, Heroes.

verses.sa:
मा वां वृको मा वृकीरा दधर्षीन्मा परि वर्क्तमुत माति धक्तम् ।
अयं वां भागो निहित इयं गीर्दस्राविमे वां निधयो मधूनाम्॥
verses.tr: mā vāṃ vṛko mā vṛkīrā dadharṣīnmā pari varktamuta māti dhaktam ayaṃ vāṃ bhāgo nihita iyaṃ gīrdasrāvime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām
verses.en: Let not the wolf, let not the she-wolf harm you. Forsake me not, nor pass me by or others. Here stands your share, here is your hymn, ye Mighty: yours are these vessels, full of pleasant juices.

verses.sa:
युवां गोतमः पुरुमीळहो अत्रिर्दस्रा हवतेऽवसे हविष्मान् ।
दिशं न दिष्टामृजूयेव यन्ता मे हवं नासत्योप यातम्॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ gotamaḥ purumīḻaho atrirdasrā havate'vase haviṣmān diśaṃ na diṣṭāmṛjūyeva yantā me havaṃ nāsatyopa yātam
verses.en: Gotama, Purumilha, Atri bringing oblations all invoke you for protection. Like one who goes straight to the point directed, ye Nasatyas, to mine invocation.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि ।
एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: We have passed o'er the limit of this darkness: our praise hath been bestowed on you, O Asvins. Come hitherward by paths which Gods have travelled. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
ता वामद्य तावपरं हुवेमोच्छन्त्यामुषसि वह्निरुक्थैः ।
नासत्या कुह चित् सन्तावर्यो दिवो नपाता सुदास्तराय॥
verses.tr: tā vāmadya tāvaparaṃ huvemocchantyāmuṣasi vahnirukthaiḥ nāsatyā kuha cit santāvaryo divo napātā sudāstarāya
verses.en: Let us invoke you both this day and after the priest is here with lauds when morn is breaking: Nasatyas, wheresoe'er ye be, Heaven's Children, for him who is more liberal than the godless.

verses.sa:
अस्मे ऊ षु वृषणा मादयेथामुत् पणीँर्हतमूर्म्या मदन्ता ।
श्रुतं मे अच्छोक्तिभिर्मतीनामेष्टा नरा निचेतारा च कर्णैः॥
verses.tr: asme ū ṣu vṛṣaṇā mādayethāmut paṇīṃrhatamūrmyā madantā śrutaṃ me acchoktibhirmatīnāmeṣṭā narā nicetārā ca karṇaiḥ
verses.en: With us, ye Mighty, let yourselves be joyful, glad in our stream of Soma slay the niggards. Graciously hear my hymns and invitations, marking, O Heroes, with your cars my longing.

verses.sa:
श्रिये पूषन्निषुकृतेव देवा नासत्या वहतुं सूर्यायाः ।
वच्यन्ते वां ककुहा अप्सु जाता युगा जूर्णेव वरुणस्य भूरेः॥
verses.tr: śriye pūṣanniṣukṛteva devā nāsatyā vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ vacyante vāṃ kakuhā apsu jātā yugā jūrṇeva varuṇasya bhūreḥ
verses.en: Nasatyas, Pusans, ye as Gods for glory arranged and set in order Surya's bridal. Your giant steeds move on, sprung from the waters, like ancient times of Varuna the Mighty.

verses.sa:
अस्मे सा वां माध्वी रातिरस्तु स्तोमं हिनोतं मान्यस्य कारोः ।
अनु यद् वां श्रवस्या सुदानू सुवीर्याय चर्षणयो मदन्ति॥
verses.tr: asme sā vāṃ mādhvī rātirastu stomaṃ hinotaṃ mānyasya kāroḥ anu yad vāṃ śravasyā sudānū suvīryāya carṣaṇayo madanti
verses.en: Your grace be with us, ye who love sweet juices: further the hymn sung by the poet Mana, When men are joyful in your glorious actions, to win heroic strength, ye Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
एष वां स्तोमो अश्विनावकारि मानेभिर्मघवाना सुवृक्ति ।
यातं वर्तिस्तनयाय त्मने चागस्त्ये नासत्या मदन्ता॥
verses.tr: eṣa vāṃ stomo aśvināvakāri mānebhirmaghavānā suvṛkti yātaṃ vartistanayāya tmane cāgastye nāsatyā madantā
verses.en: This praise was made, O liberal Lords, O Asvins, for you with fair adornment by the Manas. Come to our house for us and for our children, rejoicing, O Nasatyas, in Agastya.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति वां स्तोमो अश्विनावधायि ।
एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati vāṃ stomo aśvināvadhāyi eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: We have passed o'er the limit of this darkness: our praise hath been bestowed on you, O Asvins. Come hitherward by paths which Gods have travelled. may we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
कतरा पूर्वा कतरापरायोः कथा जाते कवयः को वि वेद ।
विश्वं त्मना बिभृतो यद्ध नाम वि वर्तेते अहनी चक्रियेव॥
verses.tr: katarā pūrvā katarāparāyoḥ kathā jāte kavayaḥ ko vi veda viśvaṃ tmanā bibhṛto yaddha nāma vi vartete ahanī cakriyeva
verses.en: Whether of these is elder, whether later? How were they born? Who knoweth it, ye sages? These of themselves support all things existing: as on a car the Day and Night roll onward.

verses.sa:
भूरिं द्वे अचरन्ती चरन्तं पद्वन्तं गर्भमपदी दधाते ।
नित्यं न सूनुं पित्रोरुपस्थे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: bhūriṃ dve acarantī carantaṃ padvantaṃ garbhamapadī dadhāte nityaṃ na sūnuṃ pitrorupasthe dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: The Twain uphold, though motionless and footless, a widespread offspring having feet and moving. Like your own son upon his parents' bosom, protect us, Heaven and earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
अनेहो दात्रमदितेरनर्वं हुवे स्वर्वदवधं नमस्वत् ।
तद् रोदसी जनयतं जरित्रे द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: aneho dātramaditeranarvaṃ huve svarvadavadhaṃ namasvat tad rodasī janayataṃ jaritre dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: I call for Aditi's unrivalled bounty, perfect, celestial, deathless, meet for worship. Produce this, ye Twain Worlds, for him who lauds you. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
अतप्यमाने अवसावन्ती अनु ष्याम रोदसी देवपुत्रे ।
उभे देवानामुभयेभिरह्नां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: atapyamāne avasāvantī anu ṣyāma rodasī devaputre ubhe devānāmubhayebhirahnāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: May we be close to both the Worlds who suffer no pain, Parents of Gods, who aid with favour, Both mid the Gods, with Day and Night alternate. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
संगच्छमाने युवती समन्ते स्वसारा जामी पित्रोरुपस्थे ।
अभिजिघ्रन्ती भुवनस्य नाभिं द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: saṃgacchamāne yuvatī samante svasārā jāmī pitrorupasthe abhijighrantī bhuvanasya nābhiṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: Faring together, young, with meeting limits, Twin Sisters lying in their Parents' bosom, Kissing the centre of the world together. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उर्वी सद्मनी बृहती ऋतेन हुवे देवानामवसा जनित्री ।
दधाते ये अमृतं सुप्रतीके द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: urvī sadmanī bṛhatī ṛtena huve devānāmavasā janitrī dadhāte ye amṛtaṃ supratīke dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: Duly I call the two wide seats, the mighty, the general Parents, with the God's protection. Who, beautiful to look on, make the nectar. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उर्वी पृथ्वी बहुले दूरेअन्ते उप ब्रुवे नमसा यज्ञे अस्मिन् ।
दधाते ये सुभगे सुप्रतूर्ती द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: urvī pṛthvī bahule dūreante upa bruve namasā yajñe asmin dadhāte ye subhage supratūrtī dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: Wide, vast, and manifold, whose bounds are distant,--these, reverent, I address at this our worship, The blessed Pair, victorious, all-sustaining. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
देवान् वा यच्चकृमा कच्चिदागः सखायं वा सदमिज्जास्पतिं वा ।
इयं धीर्भूया अवयानमेषां द्यावा रक्षतं पृथिवी नो अभ्वात्॥
verses.tr: devān vā yaccakṛmā kaccidāgaḥ sakhāyaṃ vā sadamijjāspatiṃ vā iyaṃ dhīrbhūyā avayānameṣāṃ dyāvā rakṣataṃ pṛthivī no abhvāt
verses.en: What sin we have at any time committed against the Gods, our friend, our house's chieftain, Thereof may this our hymn be expiation. Protect us, Heaven and Earth, from fearful danger.

verses.sa:
उभा शंसा नर्या मामविष्टामुभे मामूती अवसा सचेताम् ।
भूरि चिदर्यः सुदास्तरायेषा मदन्त इषयेम देवाः॥
verses.tr: ubhā śaṃsā naryā māmaviṣṭāmubhe māmūtī avasā sacetām bhūri cidaryaḥ sudāstarāyeṣā madanta iṣayema devāḥ
verses.en: May both these Friends of man, who bless, preserve me, may they attend me with their help and favour. Enrich the man more liberal than the godless. May we, ye Gods, be strong with food rejoicing.

verses.sa:
ऋतं दिवे तदवोचं पृथिव्या अभिश्रावाय प्रथमं सुमेधाः ।
पातामवद्याद् दुरितादभीके पिता माता च रक्षतामवोभिः॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ dive tadavocaṃ pṛthivyā abhiśrāvāya prathamaṃ sumedhāḥ pātāmavadyād duritādabhīke pitā mātā ca rakṣatāmavobhiḥ
verses.en: Endowed with understanding, I have uttered this truth, for all to hear, to Earth and Heaven. Be near us, keep us from reproach and trouble. Father and Mother, with your help preserve us.

verses.sa:
इदं द्यावापृथिवी सत्यमस्तु पितर्मातर्यदिहोपब्रुवे वाम् ।
भूतं देवानामवमे अवोभिर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī satyamastu pitarmātaryadihopabruve vām bhūtaṃ devānāmavame avobhirvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: Be this my prayer fulfilled, O Earth and Heaven, wherewith, Father and Mother, I address you. Nearest of Gods be ye with your protection. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
आ न इळाभिर्विदथे सुशस्ति विश्वानरः सविता देव एतु ।
अपि यथा युवानो मत्सथा नो विश्वं जगदभिपित्वे मनीषा॥
verses.tr: ā na iḻābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā
verses.en: Loved of all men, may Savitar, through praises offered as sacred food, come to our synod, That you too, through-our hymn, ye ever-youthful, may gladden, at your visit, all our people.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्व आस्क्रा गमन्तु देवा मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः ।
भुवन् यथा नो विश्वे वृधासः करन्त्सुषाहा विथुरं न शवः॥
verses.tr: ā no viśva āskrā gamantu devā mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ bhuvan yathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ karantsuṣāhā vithuraṃ na śavaḥ
verses.en: To us may all the Gods come trooped together, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna concordant, That all may be promoters of our welfare, and with great might preserve our strength from slackness.

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं गृणीषे ऽग्निं शस्तिभिस्तुर्वणिः सजोषाः ।
असद् यथा नो वरुणः सुकीर्तिरिषश्च पर्षदरिगूर्तः सूरिः॥
verses.tr: preṣṭhaṃ vo atithiṃ gṛṇīṣe 'gniṃ śastibhisturvaṇiḥ sajoṣāḥ asad yathā no varuṇaḥ sukīrtiriṣaśca parṣadarigūrtaḥ sūriḥ
verses.en: Agni I sing, the guest you love most dearly: the Conqueror through our lauds is friendly-minded. That he may be our Varuna rich in glory and send food like a prince praised by the godly.

verses.sa:
उप व एषे नमसा जिगीषोषासानक्ता सुदुघेव धेनुः ।
समाने अहन् विमिमानो अर्कं विषुरूपे पयसि सस्मिन्नूधन्॥
verses.tr: upa va eṣe namasā jigīṣoṣāsānaktā sudugheva dhenuḥ samāne ahan vimimāno arkaṃ viṣurūpe payasi sasminnūdhan
verses.en: To you I seek with reverence, Night and Morning, like a cow good to milk, with hope to conquer, Preparing on a common day the praise. song with milk of various hues within this udder.

verses.sa:
उत नो ऽहिर्बुध्न्यो३ मयस्कः शिशुं न पिप्युषीव वेति सिन्धुः ।
येन नपातमपां जुनाम मनोजुवो वृषणो यं वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: uta no 'hirbudhnyo3 mayaskaḥ śiśuṃ na pipyuṣīva veti sindhuḥ yena napātamapāṃ junāma manojuvo vṛṣaṇo yaṃ vahanti
verses.en: May the great Dragon of the Deep rejoice us: as one who nourishes her young comes Sindhu, With whom we will incite the Child of Waters whom vigorous course swift as thought bring hither.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं त्वष्टा गन्त्वच्छा स्मत् सूरिभिरभिपित्वे सजोषाः ।
आ वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणिप्रास्तुविष्टमो नरां न इह गम्याः॥
verses.tr: uta na īṃ tvaṣṭā gantvacchā smat sūribhirabhipitve sajoṣāḥ ā vṛtrahendraścarṣaṇiprāstuviṣṭamo narāṃ na iha gamyāḥ
verses.en: Moreover Tvastar also shall approach us, one-minded with the princes at his visit. Hither shall come the Vrtra-slayer Indra, Ruler of men, as strongest of the Heroes.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं मतयोऽश्वयोगाः शिशुं न गावस्तरुणं रिहन्ति ।
तमीं गिरो जनयो न पत्नीः सुरभिष्टमं नरां नसन्त॥
verses.tr: uta na īṃ matayo'śvayogāḥ śiśuṃ na gāvastaruṇaṃ rihanti tamīṃ giro janayo na patnīḥ surabhiṣṭamaṃ narāṃ nasanta
verses.en: Him too our hymns delight, that yoke swift horses, like mother cows who lick their tender youngling. To him our songs shall yield themselves like spouses, to him the most delightful of the Heroes.

verses.sa:
उत न ईं मरुतो वृद्धसेनाः स्मद् रोदसी समनसः सदन्तु ।
पृषदश्वासोऽवनयो न रथा रिशादसो मित्रयुजो न देवाः॥
verses.tr: uta na īṃ maruto vṛddhasenāḥ smad rodasī samanasaḥ sadantu pṛṣadaśvāso'vanayo na rathā riśādaso mitrayujo na devāḥ
verses.en: So may the Maruts, armed with mighty weapons, rest here on heaven and earth with hearts in concord, As Gods whose cars have dappled steeds like torrents, destroyers of the foe allies of Mitra.

verses.sa:
प्र नु यदेषां महिना चिकित्रे प्र युञ्जते प्रयुजस्ते सुवृक्ति ।
अध यदेषां सुदिने न शरुर्विश्वमेरिणं प्रुषायन्त सेनाः॥
verses.tr: pra nu yadeṣāṃ mahinā cikitre pra yuñjate prayujaste suvṛkti adha yadeṣāṃ sudine na śarurviśvameriṇaṃ pruṣāyanta senāḥ
verses.en: They hasten on to happy termination their orders when they are made known by glory. As on a fair bright day the arrow flieth o'er all the barren soil their missiles sparkle.

verses.sa:
प्रो अश्विनाववसे कृणुध्वं प्र पूषणं स्वतवसो हि सन्ति ।
अद्वेषो विष्णुर्वात ऋभुक्षा अच्छा सुम्नाय ववृतीय देवान्॥
verses.tr: pro aśvināvavase kṛṇudhvaṃ pra pūṣaṇaṃ svatavaso hi santi adveṣo viṣṇurvāta ṛbhukṣā acchā sumnāya vavṛtīya devān
verses.en: Incline the Asvins to show grace, and Pusan, for power and might have they, their own possession. Friendly are Visnu, Vata, and Rbhuksan so may I bring the Gods to make us happy.

verses.sa:
इयं सा वो अस्मे दीधितिर्यजत्रा अपिप्राणी च सदनी च भूयाः ।
नि या देवेषु यतते वसूयुर्विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ sā vo asme dīdhitiryajatrā apiprāṇī ca sadanī ca bhūyāḥ ni yā deveṣu yatate vasūyurvidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: This is my reverent thought of you, ye Holy; may it inspire you, make you dwell among us,-- Thought, toiling for the Gods and seeking treasure. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa: पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम् । यस्य त्रितो व्योजसा वृत्रं विपर्वमर्दयत्॥
verses.tr: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat
verses.en: Now will I glorify Food that upholds great strength, By whose invigorating power Trita rent Vrtra limb from limb.

verses.sa: स्वादो पितो मधो पितो वयं त्वा ववृमहे । अस्माकमविता भव॥
verses.tr: svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe asmākamavitā bhava
verses.en: O pleasant Food, O Food of meath, thee have we chosen for our own, So be our kind protector thou.

verses.sa: उप नः पितवा चर शिवः शिवाभिरूतिभिः । मयोभुरद्विषेण्यः सखा सुशेवो अद्वयाः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ pitavā cara śivaḥ śivābhirūtibhiḥ mayobhuradviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ
verses.en: Come hitherward to us, O Food, auspicious with auspicious help, Health-bringing, not unkind, a dear and guileless friend.

verses.sa: तव त्ये पितो रसा रजांस्यनु विष्ठिताः । दिवि वाता इव श्रिताः॥
verses.tr: tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsyanu viṣṭhitāḥ divi vātā iva śritāḥ
verses.en: These juices which, O Food, are thine throughout the regions are diffused. like winds they have their place in heaven.

verses.sa: तव त्ये पितो ददतस्तव स्वादिष्ठ ते पितो । प्र स्वाद्मानो रसानां तुविग्रीवा इवेरते॥
verses.tr: tava tye pito dadatastava svādiṣṭha te pito pra svādmāno rasānāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate
verses.en: These gifts of thine, O Food, O Food most sweet to taste, These savours of thy juices work like creatures that have mighty necks.

verses.sa: त्वे पितो महानां देवानां मनो हितम् । अकारि चारु केतुना तवाहिमवसावधीत्॥
verses.tr: tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam akāri cāru ketunā tavāhimavasāvadhīt
verses.en: In thee, O Food, is set the spirit of great Gods. Under thy flag brave deeds were done he slew the Dragon with thy help.

verses.sa: यददो पितो अजगन्विवस्व पर्वतानाम् । अत्रा चिन्नो मधो पितो ऽरं भक्षाय गम्याः॥
verses.tr: yadado pito ajaganvivasva parvatānām atrā cinno madho pito 'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ
verses.en: If thou be gone unto the splendour of the clouds, Even from thence, O Food of meath, prepared for our enjoyment, come.

verses.sa: यदपामोषधीनां परिंशमारिशामहे । वातापे पीव इद् भव॥
verses.tr: yadapāmoṣadhīnāṃ pariṃśamāriśāmahe vātāpe pīva id bhava
verses.en: Whatever morsel we consume from waters or from plants of earth, O Soma, wax thou fat thereby.

verses.sa: यत् ते सोम गवाशिरो यवाशिरो भजामहे । वातापे पीव इद् भव॥
verses.tr: yat te soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe vātāpe pīva id bhava
verses.en: What Soma, we enjoy from thee in milky food or barley-brew, Vatapi, grow thou fat thereby.

verses.sa: करम्भ ओषधे भव पीवो वृक्क उदारथिः । वातापे पीव इद् भव॥
verses.tr: karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ vātāpe pīva id bhava
verses.en: O Vegetable, Cake of meal, he wholesome, firm, and strengthening: Vatapi, grow thou fat thereby.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं पितो वचोभिर्गावो न हव्या सुषूदिम ।
देवेभ्यस्त्वा सधमादमस्मभ्यं त्वा सधमादम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhirgāvo na havyā suṣūdima devebhyastvā sadhamādamasmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādam
verses.en: O Food, from thee as such have we drawn forth with lauds, like cows, our sacrificial gifts, From thee who banquetest with Gods, from thee who banquetest with us.

verses.sa: समिद्धो अद्य राजसि देवो देवैः सहस्रजित् । दूतो हव्या कविर्वह॥
verses.tr: samiddho adya rājasi devo devaiḥ sahasrajit dūto havyā kavirvaha
verses.en: Winner of thousands, kindled, thou shinest a God with Gods to-day. Bear out oblations, envoy, Sage.

verses.sa: तनूनपादृतं यते मध्वा यज्ञः समज्यते । दधत् सहस्रिणीरिषः॥
verses.tr: tanūnapādṛtaṃ yate madhvā yajñaḥ samajyate dadhat sahasriṇīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Child of Thyself the sacrifice is for the righteous blent with meath, Presenting viands thousandfold.

verses.sa: आजुह्वानो न ईड्यो देवाँ आ वक्षि यज्ञियान् । अग्ने सहस्रसा असि॥
verses.tr: ājuhvāno na īḍyo devāṃ ā vakṣi yajñiyān agne sahasrasā asi
verses.en: Invoked and worthy of our praise bring Gods whose due is sacrifice: Thou, Agni, givest countless gifts.

verses.sa: प्राचीनं बर्हिरोजसा सहस्रवीरमस्तृणन् । यत्रादित्या विराजथ॥
verses.tr: prācīnaṃ barhirojasā sahasravīramastṛṇan yatrādityā virājatha
verses.en: To seat a thousand Heroes they eastward have strewn the grass with might, Whereon, Adityas, ye shine forth.

verses.sa: विराट् सम्राड्विभ्वीः प्रभ्वीर्बह्वीश्च भूयसीश्च याः । दुरो घृतान्यक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: virāṭ samrāḍvibhvīḥ prabhvīrbahvīśca bhūyasīśca yāḥ duro ghṛtānyakṣaran
verses.en: The sovran all-imperial Doors, wide, good, many and manifold, Have poured their streams of holy oil.

verses.sa: सुरुक्मे हि सुपेशसा ऽधि श्रिया विराजतः । उषासावेह सीदताम्॥
verses.tr: surukme hi supeśasā 'dhi śriyā virājataḥ uṣāsāveha sīdatām
verses.en: With gay adornment, fair to see, in glorious beauty shine they forth: Let Night and Morning rest them here.

verses.sa: प्रथमा हि सुवाचसा होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम्॥
verses.tr: prathamā hi suvācasā hotārā daivyā kavī yajñaṃ no yakṣatāmimam
verses.en: Let these two Sages first of all, heralds divine and eloquent, Perform for us this sacrifice.

verses.sa: भारतीळे सरस्वति या वः सर्वा उपब्रुवे । ता नश्चोदयत श्रिये॥
verses.tr: bhāratīḻe sarasvati yā vaḥ sarvā upabruve tā naścodayata śriye
verses.en: You I address, Sarasvati, and Bharati, and Ila, all: Urge ye us on to glorious fame.

verses.sa: त्वष्टा रूपाणि हि प्रभुः पशून् विश्वान् त्समानजे । तेषां नः स्फातिमा यज॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi hi prabhuḥ paśūn viśvān tsamānaje teṣāṃ naḥ sphātimā yaja
verses.en: Tvastar the Lord hath made all forms and all the cattle of the field Cause them to multiply for us.

verses.sa: उप त्मन्या वनस्पते पाथो देवेभ्यः सृज । अग्निर्हव्यानि सिष्वदत्॥
verses.tr: upa tmanyā vanaspate pātho devebhyaḥ sṛja agnirhavyāni siṣvadat
verses.en: Send to the Gods, Vanaspati, thyself, the sacrificial draught: Let Agni make the oblations sweet.

verses.sa: पुरोगा अग्निर्देवानां गायत्रेण समज्यते । स्वाहाकृतीषु रोचते॥
verses.tr: purogā agnirdevānāṃ gāyatreṇa samajyate svāhākṛtīṣu rocate
verses.en: Agni, preceder of the Gods, is honoured with the sacred song: He glows at offerings blest with Hail!

verses.sa:
अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
युयोध्य१स्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नमउक्तिं विधेम॥
verses.tr: agne naya supathā rāye asmān viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān yuyodhya1smajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te namauktiṃ vidhema
verses.en: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander. most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वं पारया नव्यो अस्मान् त्स्वस्तिभिरति दुर्गाणि विश्वा ।
पूश्च पृथ्वी बहुला न उर्वी भवा तोकाय तनयाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmān tsvastibhirati durgāṇi viśvā pūśca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: Lead us anew to happiness, O Agni; lead us beyond all danger and affliction. Be unto us a wide broad ample castle bless, prosper on their way our sons and offspring.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वमस्मद् युयोध्यमीवा अनग्नित्रा अभ्यमन्त कृष्टीः ।
पुनरस्मभ्यं सुविताय देव क्षां विश्वेभिरमृतेभिर्यजत्र॥
verses.tr: agne tvamasmad yuyodhyamīvā anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ punarasmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva kṣāṃ viśvebhiramṛtebhiryajatra
verses.en: Far from us, Agni, put thou all diseases let them strike lauds that have no saving Agni. God, make our home again to be a blessing, with all the Immortal Deities, O Holy.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्ने पायुभिरजस्रैरुत प्रिये सदन आ शुशुक्वान् ।
मा ते भयं जरितारं यविष्ठ नूनं विदन्मापरं सहस्वः॥
verses.tr: pāhi no agne pāyubhirajasrairuta priye sadana ā śuśukvān mā te bhayaṃ jaritāraṃ yaviṣṭha nūnaṃ vidanmāparaṃ sahasvaḥ
verses.en: Preserve us, Agni, with perpetual succour, refulgent in the dwelling which thou lovest. O Conqueror, most youthful, let no danger touch him who praises thee to-day or after.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्नेऽव सृजो अघाया ऽविष्यवे रिपवे दुच्छुनायै ।
मा दत्वते दशते मादते नो मा रीषते सहसावन् परा दाः॥
verses.tr: mā no agne'va sṛjo aghāyā 'viṣyave ripave ducchunāyai mā datvate daśate mādate no mā rīṣate sahasāvan parā dāḥ
verses.en: Give not us up a prey to sin, O Agni, the greedy enemy that brings us trouble; Not to the fanged that bites, not to the toothless: give not us up, thou Conqueror, to the spoiler.

verses.sa:
वि घ त्वावाँ ऋतजात यंसद् गृणानो अग्ने तन्वे३ वरूथम् ।
विश्वाद् रिरिक्षोरुत वा निनित्सोरभिह्रुतामसि हि देव विष्पट्॥
verses.tr: vi gha tvāvāṃ ṛtajāta yaṃsad gṛṇāno agne tanve3 varūtham viśvād ririkṣoruta vā ninitsorabhihrutāmasi hi deva viṣpaṭ
verses.en: Such as thou art, born after Law, O Agni when lauded give protection to our bodies, From whosoever would reproach or injure: for thou, God, rescuest from all oppression.

verses.sa:
त्वं ताँ अग्न उभयान् वि विद्वान् वेषि प्रपित्वे मनुषो यजत्र ।
अभिपित्वे मनवे शास्यो भूर्मर्मृजेन्य उशिग्भिर्नाक्रः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tāṃ agna ubhayān vi vidvān veṣi prapitve manuṣo yajatra abhipitve manave śāsyo bhūrmarmṛjenya uśigbhirnākraḥ
verses.en: Thou, well discerning both these classes, comest to men at early morn, O holy Agni. Be thou obedient unto man at evening, to be adorned, as keen, by eager suitors.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम निवचनान्यस्मिन् मानस्य सूनुः सहसाने अग्नौ ।
वयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सनेम विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: avocāma nivacanānyasmin mānasya sūnuḥ sahasāne agnau vayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sanema vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: To him have we addressed our pious speeches, I, Mana's son, to him victorious Agni. May we gain countless riches with the sages. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
अनर्वाणं वृषभं मन्द्रजिह्वं बृहस्पतिं वर्धया नव्यमर्कैः ।
गाथान्यः सुरुचो यस्य देवा आशृण्वन्ति नवमानस्य मर्ताः॥
verses.tr: anarvāṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ mandrajihvaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vardhayā navyamarkaiḥ gāthānyaḥ suruco yasya devā āśṛṇvanti navamānasya martāḥ
verses.en: Glorify thou Brhaspati, the scatheless, who must be praised with hymns, sweet-tongued and mighty, To whom as leader of the song, resplendent, worthy of lauds, both Gods and mortals listen.

verses.sa:
तमृत्विया उप वाचः सचन्ते सर्गो न यो देवयतामसर्जि ।
बृहस्पतिः स ह्यञ्जो वरांसि विभ्वाभवत् समृते मातरिश्वा॥
verses.tr: tamṛtviyā upa vācaḥ sacante sargo na yo devayatāmasarji bṛhaspatiḥ sa hyañjo varāṃsi vibhvābhavat samṛte mātariśvā
verses.en: On him wait songs according to the season even as a stream of pious men set moving. Brhaspati--for he laid out the expanses--was, at the sacrifice, vast Matarisvan.

verses.sa:
उपस्तुतिं नमस उद्यतिं च श्लोकं यंसत् सवितेव प्र बाहू ।
अस्य क्रत्वाहन्यो३ यो अस्ति मृगो न भीमो अरक्षसस्तुविष्मान्॥
verses.tr: upastutiṃ namasa udyatiṃ ca ślokaṃ yaṃsat saviteva pra bāhū asya kratvāhanyo3 yo asti mṛgo na bhīmo arakṣasastuviṣmān
verses.en: The praise, the verse that offers adoration, may he bring forth, as the Sun sends his arms out, He who gives daily light through this God's wisdom, strong as a dread wild beast, and inoffensive.

verses.sa:
अस्य श्लोको दिवीयते पृथिव्यामत्यो न यंसद् यक्षभृद् विचेताः ।
मृगाणां न हेतयो यन्ति चेमा बृहस्पतेरहिमायाँ अभि द्यून्॥
verses.tr: asya śloko divīyate pṛthivyāmatyo na yaṃsad yakṣabhṛd vicetāḥ mṛgāṇāṃ na hetayo yanti cemā bṛhaspaterahimāyāṃ abhi dyūn
verses.en: His song of praise pervades the earth and heaven: let the wise worshipper draw it, like a courser. These of Brhaspati, like hunters' arrows, go to the skies that change their hue like serpents.

verses.sa:
ये त्वा देवोस्रिकं मन्यमानाः पापा भद्रमुपजीवन्ति पज्राः ।
न दूढ्ये३ अनु ददासि वामं बृहस्पते चयस इत् पियारुम्॥
verses.tr: ye tvā devosrikaṃ manyamānāḥ pāpā bhadramupajīvanti pajrāḥ na dūḍhye3 anu dadāsi vāmaṃ bṛhaspate cayasa it piyārum
verses.en: Those, God, who count thee as a worthless bullock, and, wealthy sinners, live on thee the Bounteous,-- On fools like these no blessing thou bestowest: Brhaspati, thou punishest the spiteful.

verses.sa:
सुप्रैतुः सूयवसो न पन्था दुर्नियन्तुः परिप्रीतो न मित्रः ।
अनर्वाणो अभि ये चक्षते नोऽपीवृता अपोर्णुवन्तो अस्थुः॥
verses.tr: supraituḥ sūyavaso na panthā durniyantuḥ pariprīto na mitraḥ anarvāṇo abhi ye cakṣate no'pīvṛtā aporṇuvanto asthuḥ
verses.en: Like a fair path is he, where grass is pleasant, though hard to win, a Friend beloved most early. Those who unharmed by enemies behold us, while they would make them bare, stood closely compassed.

verses.sa:
सं यं स्तुभोऽवनयो न यन्ति समुद्रं न स्रवतो रोधचक्राः ।
स विद्वाँ उभयं चष्टे अन्तर्बृहस्पतिस्तर आपश्च गृध्रः॥
verses.tr: saṃ yaṃ stubho'vanayo na yanti samudraṃ na sravato rodhacakrāḥ sa vidvāṃ ubhayaṃ caṣṭe antarbṛhaspatistara āpaśca gṛdhraḥ
verses.en: He to whom songs of praise go forth like torrents, as rivers eddying under banks flow sea-ward-- Brhaspati the wise, the eager, closely looks upon both, the waters and the vessel.

verses.sa:
एवा महस्तुविजातस्तुविष्मान् बृहस्पतिर्वृषभो धायि देवः ।
स नः स्तुतो वीरवद् धातु गोमद् विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: evā mahastuvijātastuviṣmān bṛhaspatirvṛṣabho dhāyi devaḥ sa naḥ stuto vīravad dhātu gomad vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: So hath Brhaspati, great, strong and mighty, the God exceeding powerful, been brought hither. May he thus lauded give us kine and horses. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa:
१६ अग्स्त्यो मैत्रावरुणिः । (विषघ्नोपनिषद्)। अनुष्टुप्, १०-१२ महा पंक्तिः, १३ महबृहती।
कङ्कतो न कङ्कतो ऽथो सतीनकङ्कतः ।
द्वाविति प्लुषी इति न्य१दृष्टा अलिप्सत॥
verses.tr: 16 agstyo maitrāvaruṇiḥ (viṣaghnopaniṣad) anuṣṭup, 10-12 mahā paṃktiḥ, 13 mahabṛhatī kaṅkato na kaṅkato 'tho satīnakaṅkataḥ dvāviti pluṣī iti nya1dṛṣṭā alipsata
verses.en: Venomous, slightly venomous, or venomous aquatic worm,-- Both creatures, stinging, unobserved, with poison have infected me.

verses.sa:
अदृष्टान् हन्त्यायत्यथो हन्ति परायती ।
अथो अवघ्नती हन्त्यथो पिनष्टि पिंषती॥
verses.tr: adṛṣṭān hantyāyatyatho hanti parāyatī atho avaghnatī hantyatho pinaṣṭi piṃṣatī
verses.en: Coming, it kills the unobserved; it kills them as it goes away, It kills them as it drives them off, and bruising bruises them to death.

verses.sa:
शरासः कुशरासो दर्भासः सैर्या उत ।
मौञ्जा अदृष्टा वैरिणाः सर्वे साकं न्यलिप्सत॥
verses.tr: śarāsaḥ kuśarāso darbhāsaḥ sairyā uta mauñjā adṛṣṭā vairiṇāḥ sarve sākaṃ nyalipsata
verses.en: Sara grass, Darbha, Kusara, and Sairya, Muñja, Virana, Where all these creatures dwell unseen, with poison have infected me.

verses.sa:
नि गावो गोष्ठे असदन् नि मृगासो अविक्षत ।
नि केतवो जनानां न्य१दृष्टा अलिप्सत॥
verses.tr: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadan ni mṛgāso avikṣata ni ketavo janānāṃ nya1dṛṣṭā alipsata
verses.en: The cows had settled in their stalls, the beasts of prey had sought their lairs, Extinguished were the lights of men, when things unseen infected me.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये प्रत्यदृश्रन् प्रदोषं तस्करा इव ।
अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टाः प्रतिबुद्धा अभूतन॥
verses.tr: eta u tye pratyadṛśran pradoṣaṃ taskarā iva adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāḥ pratibuddhā abhūtana
verses.en: Or these, these reptiles, are observed, like lurking thieves at evening time. Seers of all, themselves unseen: be therefore very vigilant.

verses.sa:
द्यौर्वः पिता पृथिवी माता सोमो भ्रातादितिः स्वसा ।
अदृष्टा विश्वदृष्टास्तिष्ठतेलयता सु कम्॥
verses.tr: dyaurvaḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā somo bhrātāditiḥ svasā adṛṣṭā viśvadṛṣṭāstiṣṭhatelayatā su kam
verses.en: Heaven is your Sire, your Mother Earth, Soma your Brother, Aditi Your Sister: seeing all, unseen, keep still and dwell ye happily.

verses.sa:
ये अंस्या ये अङ्ग्याः सूचीका ये प्रकङ्कताः ।
अदृष्टाः किं चनेह वः सर्वे साकं नि जस्यत॥
verses.tr: ye aṃsyā ye aṅgyāḥ sūcīkā ye prakaṅkatāḥ adṛṣṭāḥ kiṃ caneha vaḥ sarve sākaṃ ni jasyata
verses.en: Biters of shoulder or of limb, with needle-stings, most venomous, Unseen, whatever ye may be, vanish together and be gone.

verses.sa:
उत् पुरस्तात् सूर्य एति विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ।
अदृष्टान् त्सर्वाञ्जम्भयन् त्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्यः॥
verses.tr: ut purastāt sūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā adṛṣṭān tsarvāñjambhayan tsarvāśca yātudhānyaḥ
verses.en: Slayer of things unseen, the Sun, beheld of all, mounts, eastward, up, Consuming all that are not seen, and evil spirits of the night.

verses.sa:
उदपप्तदसौ सूर्यः पुरु विश्वानि जूर्वन् ।
आदित्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा॥
verses.tr: udapaptadasau sūryaḥ puru viśvāni jūrvan ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā
verses.en: There hath the Sun-God mounted up, who scorches much and everything. Even the Aditya from the hills, all-seen, destroying things unseen.

verses.sa:
सूर्ये विषमा सजामि दृतिं सुरावतो गृहे ।
सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामाऽऽरे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार॥
verses.tr: sūrye viṣamā sajāmi dṛtiṃ surāvato gṛhe so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmā''re asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
verses.en: I hang the poison in the Sun, a wine-skin in a vintner's house, He will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
इयत्तिका शकुन्तिका सका जघास ते विषम् ।
सो चिन्नु न मराति नो वयं मरामाऽऽरे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार॥
verses.tr: iyattikā śakuntikā sakā jaghāsa te viṣam so cinnu na marāti no vayaṃ marāmā''re asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
verses.en: This little bird, so very small, hath swallowed all thy poison up. She will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त विष्पुलिङ्गका विषस्य पुष्यमक्षन् ।
ताश्चिन्नु न मरन्ति नो वयं मरामाऽऽरे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार॥
verses.tr: triḥ sapta viṣpuliṅgakā viṣasya puṣyamakṣan tāścinnu na maranti no vayaṃ marāmā''re asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
verses.en: The three-times-seven bright sparks of fire have swallowed up the poison's strength. They will not die, nor shall we die: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
नवानां नवतीनां विषस्य रोपुषीणाम् ।
सर्वासामग्रभं नामाऽऽरे अस्य योजनं हरिष्ठा मधु त्वा मधुला चकार॥
verses.tr: navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām sarvāsāmagrabhaṃ nāmā''re asya yojanaṃ hariṣṭhā madhu tvā madhulā cakāra
verses.en: Of ninety rivers and of nine with power to stay the venom's course,-- The names of all I have secured: his path is far: he whom Bay Horses bear hath turned thee to sweet meath.

verses.sa:
त्रिः सप्त मयूर्यः सप्त स्वसारो अग्रुवः ।
तास्ते विषं वि जभ्रिर उदकं कुम्भिनीरिव॥
verses.tr: triḥ sapta mayūryaḥ sapta svasāro agruvaḥ tāste viṣaṃ vi jabhrira udakaṃ kumbhinīriva
verses.en: So have the peahens three-times-seven, so have the maiden Sisters Seven Carried thy venom far away, as girls bear water in their jars.

verses.sa:
इयत्तकः कुषुम्भकस्तकं भिनद्म्यश्मना ।
ततो विषं प्र वावृते पराचीरनु संवतः॥
verses.tr: iyattakaḥ kuṣumbhakastakaṃ bhinadmyaśmanā tato viṣaṃ pra vāvṛte parācīranu saṃvataḥ
verses.en: The poison-insect is so small; I crush the creature with a stone. I turn the poison hence away, departed unto distant lands.

verses.sa:
कुषुम्भकस्तदब्रवीद् गिरेः प्रवर्तमानकः ।
वृश्चिकस्यारसं विषमरसं वृश्चिक ते विषम्॥
verses.tr: kuṣumbhakastadabravīd gireḥ pravartamānakaḥ vṛścikasyārasaṃ viṣamarasaṃ vṛścika te viṣam
verses.en: Forth issuing from the mountain's side the poison-insect spake and said: Scorpion, they venom is but weak.
